An MP from the PVV asked why the Dutch embassy in Tehran had a stand at an Iranian agrifood fair with no Dutch firms present, who ordered it, its cost, and why agricultural knowledge is exported to Iran. The minister answered that the presence supports trade promotion and food security, cost 15,000 euro, and that COVID measures were observed, without reconsidering the participation.
Participation in trade fairs is part of the Netherlands' regular trade promotion with countries worldwide.
Deelname aan handelsbeurzen maakt onderdeel uit van de reguliere handelsbevordering van Nederland met landen wereldwijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Roon over steun van de Palestijnse autoriteit voor antisemitisme

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how she views Palestinian Authority support for demonstrations featuring burning Stars of David and swastikas in Samaria, and whether she will condemn it. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns antisemitism, raised the matter with the Palestinian authorities in Ramallah on 1 September, and says the Netherlands and the EU keep pressing responsible parties to stop hatred and violence.

Following the mentioned events at the demonstrations on the West Bank, the Dutch representative in Ramallah conveyed this message again on 1 September in a bilateral conversation with the Palestinian authorities.

Naar aanleiding van de genoemde gebeurtenissen bij de demonstraties op de West Bank heeft de Nederlandse vertegenwoordiger in Ramallah op 1 september jl. in een bilateraal gesprek met de Palestijnse autoriteiten deze boodschap nogmaals overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over risico’s voor het MH17-onderzoek

MP De Roon asks the government whether reports of the dismissal of the Ukrainian prosecutor leading the MH17 investigation put the investigation at risk, and what it will do about it. The minister answers that cooperation with Ukraine remains good, that personnel changes have not affected the investigation's priority or progress, that the government will not interfere in Ukraine's internal personnel matters, but will keep stressing the importance of cooperation.
It is not for the cabinet to interfere in the internal personnel matters of the Ukrainian Public Prosecution Service.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om zich te mengen in de interne personele aangelegenheden van het Oekraïense Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over inhuldiging van Raisi als president van Iran

De Roon (PVV) asked whether the EU and the Dutch government should refrain from sending representatives to the inauguration of Iranian president Raisi, whom he called a mass murderer. Minister Kaag answered that the EU sends its deputy secretary-general for the nuclear talks as a mediator, and that the Dutch ambassador will attend as with all EU states represented in Iran.
Like all EU countries represented in Iran, the Netherlands will be represented at the inauguration of the Iranian president by the ambassador.
Net als alle in Iran vertegenwoordigde EU-landen zal Nederland bij de inauguratie van de Iraanse president vertegenwoordigd worden door de ambassadeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Fritsma over het bericht dat Nederland deelneemt aan een militaire oefening in de Westelijke Sahara

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Dutch troops were taking part in the African Lion 2021 exercise, whether it took place in Western Sahara, and why parliament was not informed. The minister confirmed Dutch participation at US invitation but stated the exercise does not take place in Western Sahara according to USAFRICOM, and that it is not customary to inform parliament about participation in exercises.
Moreover, it is not customary to inform the House about Dutch participation in military exercises.
Daarnaast is het niet gebruikelijk om de Kamer over de Nederlandse deelname aan militaire oefeningen te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over een verklaring van de Amerikaanse minister van buitenlandse zaken

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the government views a US statement on Taiwan's participation in the WHO assembly, and whether a similar Dutch statement would be published. The minister said the Netherlands supports meaningful Taiwanese participation in WHO-related matters and that prior statements are already public.
These answers as well as earlier written and oral statements of the same tenor by the cabinet to your House are already public.
Deze antwoorden alsook eerdere schriftelijke en mondelinge uitlatingen van gelijke strekking van het kabinet aan uw Kamer zijn reeds openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht dat Iran is verkozen tot lid van een VN-vrouwenrechtencommissie

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why Iran was elected to a UN women's rights commission, whether the Netherlands voted against it, and whether it would protest and stop funding the body. Minister Blok confirmed the election, said the secret vote cannot be disclosed, expressed concern about Iran's women's rights record, and declined to protest or change funding, noting indirect Dutch funding via UN Women.
The Netherlands does not publicly state its voting behaviour in secret ballots, because countries must be able to rely on the confidentiality of their vote.
Nederland doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over stemgedrag bij geheime stemmingen, omdat landen moeten kunnen rekenen op de vertrouwelijkheid van de door hun uitgebrachte stem
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Beertema en Fritsma over het bericht dat tientallen Chinese onderzoekers in Delft banden hadden met het Chinese leger

PVV MPs asked whether dozens of Chinese researchers at TU Delft had ties to the Chinese military, whether knowledge flowed to the PLA, whether intelligence services screen Chinese researchers, and whether universities should stop cooperating with the 'Seven Sons' universities. The government answered that the TU Delft figures are limited and that an inventory and binding risk-assessment framework on knowledge security is underway, while it declined to provide nationality data, a blacklist, or confirmation of specific knowledge transfer.

The cabinet is working on a country-neutral package of measures that together offers a course of action for both knowledge institutions and central government to counter undesirable knowledge transfer.

Het kabinet werkt aan een landenneutraal pakket maatregelen dat samengenomen een handelingsperspectief biedt aan zowel de kennisinstellingen als de rijksoverheid om ongewenste kennisoverdracht tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het verwerpelijke Nederlandse stemgedrag in de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why the Netherlands voted alongside states like China and Pakistan on an anti-Israel resolution in the UN Human Rights Council, why it keeps cooperating despite Israel's many condemnations, and whether it will leave the Council. The minister answered that the Netherlands seeks to reduce disproportionate focus on Israel through negotiation with the Palestinians while still criticizing serious rights violations, and that it will remain a Council member to engage with states holding different views.
The Dutch approach remains aimed at countering disproportionate attention to one country within the UN, in line with the motion by MP Van der Staaij.
De Nederlandse inzet blijft erop gericht om disproportionele aandacht voor één land binnen de VN tegen te gaan, conform motie van het lid Van der Staaij
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over een oud-ambassadeur van Soedan die in verband is gebracht met een ernstig terreurplan

MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about a former Sudanese ambassador linked to a terror plot, including how he was screened, why he received a royal honour, and whether he can be barred from the Netherlands. The minister answered that agrément procedures are confidential and individual cases cannot be discussed, that the honour cannot be revoked as no prison sentence was imposed, and that no national sanctions listing applies.
To conduct such discussions effectively, it is important that countries can rely on these discussions being held in confidence between the two countries and not becoming public.

Om dergelijke discussies effectief te kunnen voeren, is het belangrijk dat landen er van op aan kunnen dat deze discussie in vertrouwen tussen beide landen gevoerd wordt en niet in de openbaarheid komt.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Roon over de Nederlandse positie ten aanzien van terreurorganisatie Ahrar al-Sham

An MP asks the foreign and development ministers whether Ahrar al-Sham should be treated as a terrorist organisation, whether it should be placed on the national terrorism list, whether former members should be prosecuted and residence permits revoked, and whether Non-Lethal Assistance funds reached the group. The government replies that the ministry relies on UN/EU lists and intelligence assessments, that the group is not considered a direct national security threat, that no NLA reached it, and that the national sanctions list lacks Dutch links so no listing is made.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has had no contact with the Syrian arrested recently in Rijssen.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft geen contact gehad met de onlangs in Rijssen gearresteerde Syriër.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over miskenning door Nederlandse regering van de Joodse relatie met de Tempelberg te Jerusalem

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why the Netherlands voted for UN resolution A/RES/75/98, which refers to the Temple Mount only as Haram al-Sharif, and whether it would apologise to Israel. Minister Blok defended the vote as a judgement on the resolution's overall content, said the Netherlands tried to have the Temple Mount name removed, and refused to apologise.
The Netherlands assesses each resolution on its total content and merits.
Nederland beoordeelt iedere resolutie op zijn totale inhoud en merites.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de dreigende vrijlating van de moordenaar van Daniel Pearl en straffeloosheid van de imam die een fatwa over Geert Wilders uitsprak

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether he would press Pakistan to prevent the release of a suspect in the murder of journalist Daniel Pearl and to act against the imam who issued a fatwa against Geert Wilders. The minister replied that the case is before Pakistani courts and the Netherlands does not intervene in foreign legal proceedings, that the imam has died so prosecution is no longer possible, and that the Public Prosecution Service is investigating other threats while withholding details of that investigation.
The Netherlands does not intervene in legal proceedings in other countries.
Nederland intervenieert niet in de rechtsgang in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over een medewerker van de Eritrese ambassade die onder dwang geld inzamelde bij zijn landgenoten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the expulsion-type declaration against an Eritrean embassy employee who allegedly extorted money from compatriots was enforced, whether he posed as a consul, why he was not removed, and whether victims were reimbursed. The minister replied that Eritrea was asked to end the contract and confirmed it, that he was not registered as diplomatic staff, that he holds Dutch nationality so cannot be removed, and that victims were called to file reports for police and prosecutors to investigate.
To establish whether there was indeed coercion and intimidation in the fundraising and what amounts are involved, victims have been called upon to file a report.

Om vast te stellen of er bij de geldinzamelingen inderdaad sprake is geweest van dwang en intimidatie en om vast te kunnen stellen om wat voor bedragen het gaat, zijn slachtoffers opgeroepen om aangifte te doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Kuiken, Van Ojik, De Roon, Karabulut en Voordewind over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, dat ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneem

Six MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice why the Dutch child Insiya, abducted to India by her father, has not been returned, what steps have been taken, and whether ministers will personally intervene. The government answered that Dutch court rulings are not automatically binding in India, that it keeps raising the case bilaterally and at high level, and that it has contact persons for the mother, but that return depends on Indian legal procedures and it will not detail enforcement steps against the father.
The Netherlands will keep drawing India's attention to the rulings of the Dutch court and will closely follow the proceedings in India.
Nederland zal de uitspraken van de Nederlandse rechter bij India onder de aandacht blijven brengen en zal uitspraak in de procedures in India nauwlettend volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Fritsma en Markuszower over de beroerde informatievoorziening aan de Tweede Kamer inzake de inspectie van een koopvaardijschip door marineschip de Zr. Ms. De Ruyter

PVV MPs asked the Justice, Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers why information on the Dutch navy's boarding of a merchant ship (Zr. Ms. De Ruyter) was withheld, and asked about the legal basis, the cargo, sanctions and links to Operation Irini. Minister Grapperhaus refused details citing an ongoing criminal investigation, cited the Criminal Code as legal basis, denied any link to Irini, and promised to inform parliament once possible.
As is customary, your House will be informed as soon as the still ongoing criminal investigation allows for this.
Zoals te doen gebruikelijk zal uw Kamer worden geïnformeerd zodra daar gezien het thans nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek de mogelijkheid toe bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Beertema over samenwerking tussen Amsterdamse universiteiten en de Chinese onderneming Huawei

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether Amsterdam universities' joint AI search-technology project with Huawei Finland risks handing advanced technology to a dictatorship that uses such tools for repression, and whether the project should be stopped. The government answered that export controls apply to dual-use goods, that AI as a field is too broad to fall under them, that the cooperation is for civilian consumer search and the institutions are autonomous, so the cabinet has no formal role in approving or blocking such agreements, while a broader review of knowledge security is ongoing.
The cabinet has no formal role in approving or disapproving cooperation agreements of institutions.
Het kabinet heeft geen formele rol in het goed- of afkeuren van samenwerkingsovereenkomsten van instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders en Van Weerdenburg over ‘nog meer Nederlands hulpgeld voor Palestijnse terroristen’

MPs De Roon, Wilders and Van Weerdenburg (PVV) asked why Dutch aid money goes to Palestinian NGO Al-Mezan, alleged to have ties with PFLP and Hamas, and demanded vetting of all Palestinian aid recipients and suspension of aid. The government denied evidence of links, said it will await an external investigation into UAWC, promised to remove posts from individual staff, and refused to halt aid or close the Ramallah mission.
The cabinet does not provide support to organisations that have ties with terrorist organisations and checks whether the Dutch contribution to these organisations is spent on the agreed objectives.

Het kabinet geeft geen steun aan organisaties die banden hebben met terroristische organisaties en controleert of de Nederlandse bijdrage aan deze organisaties wordt besteed aan de afgesproken doelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over berichten dat NAVO-lid Turkije moslimextremisten uit Syrië naar Azerbeidzjan stuurt en ook aan de strijd deelneemt

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether Turkey is sending Islamist fighters from Syria to Azerbaijan, whether Turkey is directly fighting, whether the government will press Turkey to stop, what measures will protect Armenians, and whether Turkey should be removed from NATO. The minister replied that the government has no independent information confirming the transfers or Turkish combat involvement, which both countries deny, urged de-escalation and dialogue, and said expulsion from NATO is neither in the Dutch nor the alliance's interest and is not provided for by the treaty.
The cabinet has no independent information that Turkey has transferred foreign fighters to Azerbaijan.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie dat Turkije buitenlandse strijders naar Azerbeidzjan heeft overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over dreigementen van de EU aan het adres van Servië en Kosovo vanwege plannen ambassades te openen in Jeruzalem

An MP asked whether EU warnings to Serbia and Kosovo over plans to open embassies in Jerusalem amount to coercion, and whether the Dutch embassy should move to Jerusalem. The minister rejected the characterization of threats or blackmail, said accession candidates voluntarily align with EU foreign policy, and reaffirmed the Dutch position of keeping its embassy in Tel Aviv.
The cabinet's position on relocating the Dutch embassy is unchanged.
Het standpunt van het kabinet over een verhuizing van de Nederlandse ambassade is onveranderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders, Markuszower en Graus over heksenjacht door NVWA

MPs De Roon, Wilders, Markuszower and Graus asked whether the government instructed the NVWA to target the Israel Producten Centrum over labelling of wine from Judea and Samaria, and why Israel is treated differently from other countries. Minister Blok answered that the NVWA acts on complaints under EU origin-labelling rules applied equally to all countries, and that a binding CJEU ruling requires settlement-origin labelling.
No. Following a complaint received, the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA) carried out an inspection in April 2019.
Nee. Naar aanleiding van een binnengekomen klacht heeft de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) in april 2019 een inspectie uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over toenemende agressie van Hezbollah tegen Israël

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister about rising Hezbollah aggression against Israel, including the EU's failure to list Hezbollah's political wing, the role of UNIFIL, and Dutch support for Israel. The minister answered that the situation is tense but not escalated, that UNIFIL supports de-escalation under resolution 1701, that the Netherlands lists all of Hezbollah as terrorist, and that no Israeli request for aid exists.
The Netherlands has designated Hezbollah in its entirety as a terrorist organisation since 2004, making no distinction between the political and military wings of the organisation.
Nederland bestempelt Hezbollah sinds 2004 in zijn geheel als terroristische organisatie, waarbij geen onderscheid wordt gemaakt tussen de politieke en militaire tak van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over illegale wapenleveranties Iran en het instellen van sancties

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands was informed of an intercepted Iranian weapons shipment to the Houthis, why it keeps dialogue with Iran, and whether it will impose unilateral sanctions and push for extension of the UN arms embargo. The minister answers that the Netherlands was not separately informed, rejects unilateral sanctions in favour of EU/UN action, and says it supports seeking a broad solution on the arms embargo while noting the EU autonomous embargo remains in force.
The Netherlands sees no added value in imposing unilateral sanctions.
Nederland ziet geen meerwaarde in het instellen van unilaterale sancties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Popken en Markuszower over een inspectie door het marineschip Zr. Ms. De Ruyter

MPs De Roon, Popken and Markuszower asked whether the frigate De Ruyter carried out a ship inspection over a possible sanctions violation, which vessel and flag were involved, what evidence existed, and with whom findings were shared. The government confirmed the inspection, said details could not be disclosed because a criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service is ongoing and shared findings only with that service, and declined to give operational details of the ship's operations.
As you know, as Minister of Justice and Security I do not make substantive statements about an ongoing criminal investigation.
Zoals bij u bekend doe ik als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid geen inhoudelijke mededelingen over een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Weverling, Van der Staaij en De Roon over het bericht dat twee terreurverdachten indirect salaris hebben ontvangen met behulp van Nederlandse financiële steun aan de Palestijns

Four MPs asked why the government kept funding the Palestinian NGO UAWC after learning that two suspected terror-linked employees received salary via Dutch-funded overhead, and whether this shows inadequate vetting and BDS-related risks. The minister admitted the earlier conclusion was wrong, suspended payments, commissioned an external investigation, but largely defended the vetting process, rejected reconsidering funding for BDS-adjacent organisations, and answered each question.
Because careful action on this point is extremely important, I have decided to commission an external investigation into possible links between PFLP and UAWC.
Omdat zorgvuldig handelen op dit punt uiterst belangrijk is heb ik besloten om een extern onderzoek te laten verrichten naar eventuele banden tussen PFLP en UAWC
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Markuszower en Wilders over Hezbollah en ammoniumnitraat

Three PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hezbollah stored ammonium nitrate and about threats by its leader, and whether the Beirut explosion's chemicals belonged to Hezbollah and how to undermine the group internationally. The minister replied that the Beirut blast was an accident involving seized substances, that the Netherlands supports independent international investigation, and that Hezbollah's military wing has been on the EU terrorist list since 2013 while the Dutch push for listing the political wing lacks support.
The Netherlands strongly advocates thorough, independent international investigation into the explosion and is exploring contributing technical expertise to it.
Nederland maakt zich hard voor gedegen, onafhankelijk internationaal onderzoek naar de explosie en onderzoekt de mogelijkheid om hieraan bij te dragen met technische expertise.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over “subsidieverlening aan een Palestijnse organisatie met terreurbanden”

Two PVV MPs asked whether the Netherlands gave about 23 million dollars in subsidies to the Palestinian NGO UAWC, whether its staff were linked to terrorism, why a petition to stop funding was ignored, and whether funding will stop immediately. The ministers confirmed funding of roughly 11.7 million euros plus earlier programmes, said two staff members arrested for an alleged bombing had received overhead salary payments, paused further payments, and ordered an external investigation before deciding on continued cooperation.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over het bericht dat de Nederlandse regering waarschuwingen zou negeren over het financieren van een NGO met banden met terrorisme

MPs Van der Staaij, De Roon and Voordewind asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch funding to the Union of Agricultural Work Committees (UAWC) was linked to a terror group, after reports that the government ignored warnings. The minister answered that no evidence of links to listed terror organisations was found, but that after two former UAWC staff were arrested over a bombing, payments were suspended and an external investigation was commissioned.
Because careful action on this point is so important, I have decided to commission external research into possible links between the PFLP and UAWC.
Omdat zorgvuldig handelen op dit punt dermate belangrijk is heb ik besloten om extern onderzoek te laten verrichten naar eventuele banden tussen PFLP en UAWC
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, De Roon, Van der Staaij, Karabulut, Van Helvert en Van Ojik over de bombardementen van Turkije in de Iraakse regio Sinjar

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish bombings in the Sinjar region of Iraq, including alleged strikes on a refugee camp, a hospital and Yezidi areas, and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification or condemn them. The minister confirmed awareness, said the camp and hospital were reportedly not directly hit according to local sources, cited PKK presence as the reason for Turkish strikes, and said the Netherlands raised the bombings with EU partners and urges restraint and respect for international humanitarian law.
I have also recently raised the Turkish bombings with my European colleagues at the Foreign Affairs Council on 13 July.
Ook heb ik de Turkse bombardementen recentelijk opgebracht bij mijn Europese collega's tijdens de Raad Buitenlandse zaken op 13 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders en Markuszower over Iraniërs die dreigen met de vernietiging van historische Joodse graftombes

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he would publicly condemn the arson at the Jewish tomb of Esther and Mordechai in Iran, whether he still considered it adequately protected, and whether he would press Iran to protect it. The minister said the Netherlands regularly raises antisemitism concerns with Iran, that local authorities opened an investigation, and that the Supreme Leader's threatening rhetoric is unacceptable, but gave no commitment beyond continued diplomatic engagement.
The Netherlands regularly raises concerns about antisemitism and anti-Zionism in Iran in talks with the Iranian authorities and will continue to do so.
Nederland brengt met regelmaat zorgen over antisemitisme en antizionisme in Iran over in gesprekken met de Iraanse autoriteiten en zal dit blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Maeijer over mogelijke Chinese spionage bij Europese instellingen via de ambassade van Malta

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Maltese embassy in Brussels was used by China for espionage against EU institutions, whether China paid for its renovation, and what the Netherlands does to prevent such practices. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, cited Malta's statement that it paid for the renovation and that furniture was donated by China, and declined to comment on specific cases, stating that the government is alert to state actors' covert influence and runs an integrated approach.
The cabinet makes no public statements on case matters that affect the current knowledge level and modus operandi of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over casuïstiek die het actuele kennisniveau en de modus operandi van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten raken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Roon over een Nederlandse diplomaat als spreker bij de organisatie FEMYSO

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a Dutch diplomat took part in an online event of FEMYSO, the youth wing of the European Muslim Brotherhood, and whether such events are subsidised or occur often. The minister answered that the diplomat participated as a private person, that the organisation used his title without approval and he objected, that the ministry does not subsidise FEMYSO, and that officials are reminded of their conduct obligations.
Participation in the event, however, took place as a private individual.
Deelname van het event gebeurde echter als privépersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de lancering van een militaire satelliet door Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Iran's launch of a military satellite violates the nuclear deal and UN resolution 2231, and what the Iranian space programme is for. The minister confirmed the launch from open sources, said the IRGC's programme is not regular civilian space activity, and stated the launch is not a breach of the letter of the JCPOA or resolution 2231 though it runs against its spirit, while expressing concern about Iran's ballistic missile programme.
The cabinet is concerned about Iran's ballistic missile programme and regularly raises these concerns in bilateral and multilateral settings.
Het kabinet maakt zich zorgen over het ballistische raketprogramma van Iran en spreekt met grote regelmaat in bilateraal en multilateraal verband deze zorgen uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Popken over de waarnemingen van De Zr. Ms. De Ruyter van het incident in de Golf van Oman

MPs De Roon and Popken asked what the Dutch frigate De Ruyter observed of the reported Iranian seizure of the chemical tanker SC Taipei, whether Iran was involved and whether Iran's provocations should be condemned. The Defence Minister declined to share observations for operational reasons, said no cargo was seized as far as the government knows, and stated the government's commitment to de-escalation through the EMASoH mission.
No statements can be made about the observations of Zr. Ms. De Ruyter for operational reasons.
Over de waarnemingen van De Zr. Ms. De Ruyter kunnen om operationele redenen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Helvert, De Roon, Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind, Van Raan, Krol, Van der Staaij, Kuzu, Baudet, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Haga over de repatriëring van Nederlander

MPs asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded abroad, why repatriation costs are charged, and whether a 300-euro rate should extend to more countries and hardship cases. The minister replied that about 8,000 registered Dutch nationals still wished assistance, that the registration closed on 8 April, that costs are charged after the fact, that Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories will be considered favourably, and that a coulance regime is not appropriate given personal responsibility and budget impact.
I am willing to look favourably at the request to add Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories to the list for which the 300-euro rate applies.
Ik ben bereid welwillend te kijken naar het verzoek om Jordanië, Israël, Libanon en de Palestijnse Gebieden toe te voegen aan de lijst waarvoor het tarief van 300 euro geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het gebruik van MANPADS in de Syrische provincie Idlib en de risico’s voor de burgerluchtvaart

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Infrastructure whether Turkey or Turkish-backed groups used MANPADS in Idlib, whether Turkey's policy was being raised, and what the risks to civil aviation were. The government said it could not confirm who operated the systems, that the matter was raised diplomatically with Turkey, and that Dutch airlines avoid Syrian airspace so no further investigation was needed.
The cabinet does not make public statements about which groups have or have not received NLA support from the Netherlands.
229 ) doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de groepen die al-dan-niet NLA-steun hebben ontvangen van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de zwarte lijst van de VN met bedrijven die zaken doen in Israël

An MP asked the foreign minister about the UN Human Rights Council's list of companies active in Israeli settlements, whether the government would act to get Dutch firms removed or protect them against BDS, and whether the UN is selective and whether the Netherlands should leave the Council. The ministers answered that the list concerns settlement activity rather than doing business in Israel, that the Netherlands abstained but accepts the database must be implemented with hearing rights, that the UN disproportionately targets Israel, and that they will not withdraw from the Council.
The Netherlands urged the High Commissioner for transparency and for hearing and right of reply for the companies concerned.
Nederland heeft bij de Hoge Commissaris aangedrongen op transparantie en hoor- en wederhoor met de betreffende bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over het bericht dat de VN een zwarte lijst gepubliceerd heeft van bedrijven die zakendoen in Israëlische nederzettingen

Three MPs asked the foreign minister whether the UN Human Rights Council's published list of businesses active in Israeli settlements is justified, whether it amounts to political condemnation fuelling BDS, and whether the Netherlands will oppose it. The ministers answered that the list follows a 2016 Council mandate, carries no legal judgment or call for boycott, that the Netherlands discourages economic ties with settlements, and that they will raise concerns with EU partners while pushing to remove the agenda item.
The cabinet consults with European partners on the joint approach to the Middle East peace process and the joint approach in the UN Human Rights Council.
Het kabinet overlegt met de Europese partners over de gezamenlijke inzet in het Midden-Oosten Vredesproces en de gezamenlijke inzet in de VN Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Iraniërs die dreigen met de vernietiging van historische Joodse graftombes

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of threats by Iranians to destroy the historic Jewish tombs of Esther and Mordechai, how Iranian authorities responded, whether the Basij militia belongs to the IRGC and should be listed in the Netherlands, whether the tombs are still registered as heritage, and whether he would press Iran to protect them. The minister confirmed awareness, said Iranian authorities had not responded as far as known, described the Basij-IRGC links and sanctions listings, confirmed the tombs remain registered heritage, and said national legislation already protects them so no need for further pressure appears to exist.
Since the tombs are already adequately protected through national legislation, there does not appear to be any need for this.
Nu de graftombes reeds adequaat beschermd worden middels nationale wetgeving, lijkt hiertoe geen noodzaak te bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Markuszower en Wilders over Erdogan die dreigt politieke tegenstanders in Europa te kidnappen of vermoorden

MPs De Roon, Markuszower and Wilders asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers whether Erdogan's reported threats to kidnap or kill political opponents in Europe were known, how many Turkish extradition requests Netherlands received since 2016, and what measures were taken. The government said it knows of reports on repatriation of Turkish nationals from third countries, has no indication of Turkish kidnapping teams active in the Netherlands, and that police and prosecutors are alert and urge victims to file complaints.
The cabinet currently has no indication that Turkish abduction teams are active in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet heeft op dit moment geen aanwijzing dat er in Nederland Turkse ontvoeringsteams actief zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind en De Roon over een rapport over mensenrechtenschendingen in het noorden van Syrië

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the government views a Human Rights Watch report on abuses by Turkish-backed Syrian National Army forces in northern Syria, including whether Turkey is responsible and whether former Dutch non-lethal aid reached groups fighting with Turkey and the Syrian Kurds. The minister says Turkey bears responsibility, that Nederland raises this with Turkey, that the groups concerned cannot be named publicly, and that it cannot exclude that Dutch-supplied vehicle parts were used in Operation Peace Spring.
Because the names of the moderate armed groups previously supported by the Netherlands could be traced, this cannot be addressed publicly here.
In verband met herleidbaarheid naar de namen van de gematigde gewapende groepen die voorheen door Nederland gesteund zijn kan hier in het openbaar niet op in worden gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Popken en Helder over piraterij in de Golf van Mexico

MPs De Roon, Popken and Helder asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Defence and Justice and Security about piracy in the Gulf of Mexico, including the reported rise in attacks, any signals of attacks on Dutch-flagged ships, monitoring and cooperation, and whether armed private guards could be allowed on Dutch ships. The government answered that it cannot confirm the attack figures, has received no signals of attacks on Dutch-flagged ships, relies on cooperation with the US and Mexico, and noted that armed guards may become possible under the new Wet ter Bescherming Koopvaardij in designated High Risk Areas, which the Gulf is not currently.
To date we have not yet received any signals that ships sailing under the Dutch flag were targeted by pirates in the Gulf of Mexico.
Tot op heden hebben wij nog geen signalen ontvangen dat schepen varende onder de Nederlandse vlag doelwit waren van piraten in de Golf van Mexico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de Turkse aanval op Koerden in Syrië en de chantagepraktijken van Erdogan

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether Turkey demanded 28 billion euros in a migrant deal, the status of EU-Turkey accession talks, and how to stop EU funds reaching Erdogan after Turkey's military incursion into Syria. The minister said no such request is known, accession talks are effectively frozen, the Netherlands opposes pre-accession aid, and Turkey remains a valued NATO ally.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over inzet door Turkije van fosforbommen en/of -granaten in Noord-Syrië

The MP asked whether Turkish use of white phosphorus munitions in Noord-Syrië civilian areas violates the Geneva Conventions, and whether the government would push for investigation and prosecution. The minister replied that phosphorus munition is not banned per se but must comply with proportionality and civilian-protection rules, that no confirmation of such use against civilians is available, and that the OPCW is the appropriate body and the Netherlands supports it.
At this moment I do not have information confirming that phosphorus munitions have actually been used against the civilian population in northern Syria.
Op dit moment beschik ik niet over informatie die bevestigt dat er daadwerkelijk fosformunitie is gebruikt tegen de burgerbevolking in Noord-Syrië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Maeijer en Wilders (allen PVV) over een door de Europese Unie gefinancierd Turks rapport over islamofobie

Three PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU funded a Turkish think tank's report on Islamophobia that they say is government propaganda, how much money was involved, and whether Brussels will stop the funding. The minister confirmed the report was partly EU-funded through a civil society dialogue programme selected by Turkey's foreign ministry, said the EU does not endorse its content, and said the Netherlands has pushed to suspend pre-accession aid without sufficient support.
In this specific case, 90% of the total budget of € 126,951.81 for this SETA publication was financed by the CSD.
In dit specifieke geval is 90% van het totaalbudget van € 126,951.81 voor deze publicatie van SETA door CSD gefinancierd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkije dat IS-veteranen rekruteert, traint en bewapent in Afrin

De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister whether IS veterans fight for Turkey-backed groups in Afrin, whether Turkey cooperates with them, whether Dutch nationals are on a list of 40 veterans, and whether Dutch NLA support reached such groups, and whether NATO membership should be reconsidered. Minister Blok answered that he has no information on MIT cooperation, that no Dutch nationals are known on the list, that NLA recipients will not be named publicly, and that Turkey remains an essential NATO and anti-ISIS partner, so no investigation or change of position is planned.
The cabinet makes no public statements about which groups did or did not receive NLA support from the Netherlands.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de groepen die al-dan-niet NLA-steun hebben ontvangen van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat president Macron namens de EU 15 miljard euro aanbiedt aan Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether President Macron offered 15 billion euros on behalf of the EU to Iran, and whether Dutch taxpayers would contribute. The minister answered that Macron offered no EU funds, that only France could offer funds without prior consent, and that the Netherlands currently grants no subsidies to Iran and would judge any future proposals on their merits.
Contrary to the above reporting, President Macron has not pledged any European money to Iran.
In tegenstelling tot bovengenoemde berichtgeving heeft president Macron geen Europees geld toegezegd aan Iran.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over vrouwenrechten in Saoedi-Arabië

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether Saudi reforms truly improve women's rights, given the continued detention of women's rights activists and the male guardianship system. The minister acknowledged limited reforms (passport, civil registration, labour protections) but said implementation is unclear, that the Netherlands raises activists' cases bilaterally and multilaterally, and that closing the Riyadh embassy is not an option.
The Netherlands also raises women's rights and the protection and support of women's rights activists within the EU and in the appropriate multilateral fora.
Nederland stelt de onderwerpen vrouwenrechten en de bescherming en ondersteuning van vrouwenrechtenactivisten tevens aan de orde in EU-verband en in de daarvoor geëigende multilaterale fora.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Stoffer, Voordewind, Koopmans, De Roon en Baudet over de uitvoering van de motie-Van der Staaij c.s. over eenzijdige resoluties bij de VN

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands voted for a UN ECOSOC resolution on Palestinian women, how often Israel is condemned in UN bodies compared to other countries, and how the government implemented the Van der Staaij motion against disproportionate UN resolutions targeting Israel. The minister confirmed the Dutch vote, said Israel is condemned far more often than states like Saudi Arabia, and explained that the vote was taken to secure a more balanced text while committing to continue reducing disproportionate attention.
The Netherlands will continue to actively work against disproportionate attention in the UN and for reducing the number of resolutions on Israel and the occupied territories.
Nederland zal zich daarom actief blijven inzetten om disproportionele aandacht tegen te gaan in de VN en voor het verminderen van het aantal resoluties over Israël en de bezette gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg en De Roon over het corruptieschandaal bij de UNRWA

PVV MPs asked the minister about an ethics report alleging abuse of power, corruption and excessive travel at UNRWA, and asked for an account of Dutch funds lost, a halt to all Dutch funding, and a repayment of transferred money. The minister answered that she awaits the UN OIOS findings, that Dutch funding is held back pending UN clarification, that no fraud is established in UNRWA's core tasks, and that the annual contribution of 13 million euro will likely continue.
I am awaiting the judgment of the independent inspectorate of the United Nations in New York.
Ik wacht het oordeel van de onafhankelijke inspectie van de Verenigde Naties in New York af
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat terrorismeverdachten toch geld kunnen opnemen van bevroren tegoeden

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether frozen funds of suspected Al Qaeda or IS supporters can be withdrawn for basic necessities, whether the UN exemption system and its lack of public deliberation and ex-post control should be revised, and whether the Netherlands voted on such requests while on the Security Council. The minister answers that UN Security Council sanctions committee deliberations are confidential, that exemptions are a national-level responsibility for spending control, and that the rules are public, without committing to reform.
Such an overview unfortunately cannot be shared because of the confidentiality of the deliberations of the UN Sanctions Committee.
Een dergelijk overzicht kan helaas niet worden gedeeld vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de beraadslagingen van het VN-Sanctiecomité.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der  Staaij, Koopmans, Voordewind, De Roon en Van Helvert over aanvallen door radicale moslims op christenen in Nigeria

Five MPs asked the foreign minister about the May 2019 killing of Nigerian Christians after a church visit near Jos and whether radical Muslims were responsible. The government confirmed the killings, framed the Middle Belt conflict as mainly driven by resource pressure rather than religion, and promised to raise the issue bilaterally, in the EU and UN, and through the special envoy for freedom of religion.
The conflict is on the agenda during bilateral talks and will also be discussed during Minister Kaag's visit to Nigeria in July.
Het conflict staat op de agenda tijdens bilaterale gesprekken en zal ook tijdens het bezoek van Minister Kaag aan Nigeria in juli worden besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het wegzenden van Taiwanese waarnemers bij het World Meteorological Congress 2019

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew that two Taiwanese experts were excluded from the WMO World Meteorological Congress after one day, and whether he would ask the WMO for an official explanation. The minister confirmed the reports and explained that the experts had not been invited by the WMO but accredited via a private industry association for a parallel expo, and were refused access once their nationality became known under the WMO's UN-recognised-country passport rule.
Inquiries with the WMO reveal that the two Taiwanese meteorological experts were not invited or accredited by the WMO to attend the World Meteorological Congress as observers.
Navraag bij WMO leert dat de twee Taiwanese meteorologische experts niet door WMO waren uitgenodigd of geaccrediteerd om als waarnemers bij het World Meteorological Congress aanwezig te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over erkenning van de Golanhoogten als deel van Israël

Three MPs asked whether the Netherlands recognises the Golan Heights as Israeli territory, on what resolutions its position rests, when it would recognise Israeli sovereignty, and whether residents are safer under Israel. The minister answered that the Golan remains Syrian territory under Israeli occupation, based on international law and UN Security Council resolutions 242 and 497, and that the Netherlands will only recognise border changes agreed by both parties.
The Netherlands will only recognise changes to the 1967 border if both parties, in this case Israel and Syria, agree to them.
Nederland zal alleen wijzigingen van de grens van 1967 erkennen als de beide partijen, in dit geval Israël en Syrië, daarover afspraken maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg, De Roon en Markuszower over de financiering van een aanval op onafhankelijke Israëlische rechtspraak

PVV MPs asked whether the Dutch government financed a critical B'Tselem report on Israel's High Court and whether this undermines judicial independence. The minister answered that the EUR 176,000 grant was given under a strategic plan with B'Tselem setting its own research aims and conclusions, that Nederland did not steer the report, and that it does not regard the funding as undermining judicial independence.
There has been no substantive steering by the Netherlands.
Er is geen sprake geweest van inhoudelijke sturing door Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, De Roon en Van der Staaij over het bericht op de website van de Jerusalem Post waarin staat dat Nederland een kritisch onderzoek naar het Israëlische hooggerechtshof heeft gefi

MPs Voordewind, De Roon and Van der Staaij asked why the Dutch government funded B'Tselem, a critical report on the Israeli Supreme Court, and whether the government shaped its aims or findings. The minister answered that the €176,000 grant was based on B'Tselem's own strategic plan, that the Dutch government did not steer its research goals or conclusions, and that funding critical civil society work fits Dutch support for human rights and the two-state solution.
The Netherlands in no way steered the research objectives or conclusions in advance or during the implementation of the research.
Nederland heeft op geen enkele manier op voorhand, of tijdens de uitvoering van het onderzoek sturing gegeven aan onderzoeksdoelen of conclusies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Ojik, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Koopmans, De Roon, Karabulut, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de uitzetting van Nederlandse journalist Boersma

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign and Justice ministers whether Turkey expelled Dutch journalist Ans Boersma on the basis of information Dutch authorities shared, and what Dutch government steps followed. The ministers confirm the expulsion, say an information request was made in a Dutch criminal investigation via operational channels without foreign ministry involvement, and decline to give further details citing the ongoing investigation.
Regarding the content of that information request, no further statements can be made because the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Over de inhoud van dat informatieverzoek kunnen, vanwege het nog lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek, geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over aanpassing van het reisadvies voor Marokko na de gruwelijke moord op twee Scandinavische toeristen

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister why the Morocco travel advice had stayed unchanged since April 2018, how many IS fighters returned to Morocco in 2018, and whether the advice would be tightened after two Scandinavian tourists were murdered. The minister answered that the advice was updated on 21 December 2018 to mention the killings and the heightened terrorism threat, with the main cities now rated yellow, and that no reason to change it existed before 17 December; the number of returning fighters is not known.
It is not known how many IS fighters returned from Syria and Iraq to Morocco in 2018.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel IS-strijders in 2018 uit Syrië en Irak naar Marokko zijn teruggekeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over een verdubbeling van Iraanse rakettesten, waaronder raketten die Europa kunnen bereiken

MP De Roon asked whether Iran doubled its missile tests, whether the tested missiles can carry weapons of mass destruction and reach Europe, why EU measures have had no effect, and whether the Netherlands will withdraw support for the nuclear deal. Minister Blok answered that the reports are worrying, that Iran's Category 1 missiles could in theory carry WMD and reach parts of Europe given the claimed 2,000 km range, that existing UN and EU measures are in place and the Netherlands raises the issue continuously, and that the Netherlands will not withdraw support for the JCPOA since it is working as intended.
The cabinet is not aware of Iran's intentions, but it is beyond doubt that the ballistic missile programme is a cause for concern.
Het kabinet is niet bekend met de intenties van Iran, maar het staat buiten kijf dat het ballistisch raket programma zorgen baart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Karabulut, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over arrestaties tijdens mensenrechtendemonstraties in West-Papoea

Eight MPs asked the Foreign Minister about mass arrests of protesters at Human Rights Day demonstrations in West Papua, the fairness of their trials, progress on human rights in Indonesia, the Dutch Community Policing Programme, and whether the Netherlands will keep pressing Indonesia on press freedom and violence against Papuans. The minister answered that roughly 132-137 people were detained and released without charge in a context of tension, that all were freed and will not be prosecuted, that human rights concerns remain despite socio-economic progress, and that the Netherlands raises these points bilaterally and within the EU.
All persons arrested have since been released. They will not be prosecuted.
Alle opgepakte personen zijn inmiddels weer vrijgelaten. Zij zullen niet vervolgd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de wapenstilstand en de VN waarnemingsmissie in Jemen

MP De Roon asked whether a UN monitoring mission in Yemen, reportedly led by Dutch general Patrick Cammaert, would include UN troops, and whether the Netherlands would rule out sending military personnel to Yemen. Minister Blok confirmed the leadership report, said details of the mission's composition are not yet known, and said the question of Dutch military deployment does not arise yet, with parliament to be informed under the regular procedure if a contribution is considered.
Should the Netherlands consider a contribution, your House will be informed about this in accordance with the regular procedure.
Mocht Nederland een bijdrage overwegen dan zal uw Kamer hierover conform de reguliere procedure worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Roon, Bosma en Fritsma over het bericht dat het Chinese leger massaal onderzoekers stuurt naar westerse universiteiten

PVV MPs asked whether Chinese military-linked researchers are entering Dutch universities such as TU Delft to develop dual-use technologies, and how immigration screening and a possible ban would work. The government answered that the intelligence services do not comment on their knowledge, that universities bear primary responsibility for screening students, and that a review of the policy framework is ongoing, with no statutory ban beyond the North Korea rule.
The intelligence and security services make no statements about their current level of knowledge.
De inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten doen geen uitspraken over hun actuele kennisniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Baudet, De Roon en Voordewind over de Nederlandse instemming met een Palestijns voorzitterschap van de G77

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands voted for a UN resolution granting the Palestinian delegation rights to chair the G77, given the resolution's reference to a "Palestinian State" and the Netherlands not recognising such a state. The minister answered that the rights are temporary and limited to the 2019 chairmanship, that the Netherlands reaffirmed its non-recognition in a vote explanation, and that the Kingdom will keep clarifying its position where needed.
At the same time, the Kingdom reaffirmed its long-standing consistent position on the non-recognition of the "State of Palestine" in a vote explanation.
Tegelijkertijd heeft het Koninkrijk zijn jarenlange consistente positie ten aanzien van de niet-erkenning van de «Staat Palestina» in een stemverklaring herbevestigd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Iran dat met ballistische raketten doelen heeft bestookt in Syrië

The MP De Roon asked whether Iran fired ballistic missiles at targets in Syria, whether the anti-IS coalition was informed, whether air traffic including Dutch F-16s was endangered, the damage, whether the missiles fall under MTCR Category 1, and whether the strike violates UN resolution 2231 and warrants more sanctions. The minister confirmed the strike, said it was not announced and posed no danger to aircraft, said damage is unknown, confirmed MTCR Category 1 status, and said it is legally not a violation of 2231 but inconsistent with Annex B, pointing to existing EU and JCPOA measures rather than new sanctions.
Firing these kinds of missiles is legally not a violation of UN Security Council Resolution 2231 (2015), but is inconsistent with paragraph 3 of Annex B of that resolution.
Het afvuren van dit soort raketten is juridisch gezien geen schending van VNVR-Resolutie 2231 (2015), maar wel inconsistent met paragraaf 3 van Annex B van die resolutie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over berechting Nederlandse terreurverdachten in Suriname

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government knows that two Surinamese-Dutch suspects are being prosecuted in Paramaribo for plotting a terror attack on the US ambassador, whether the Dutch embassy and police follow the trial and will report after each hearing, and whether Dutch roots of the plot are being investigated. The minister confirms awareness, says the embassy follows the case closely, notes one closed-door hearing, declines to send case reports to parliament, and declines to comment on an individual foreign case.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Justice and Security cannot send your House reports on individual foreign court cases.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid kunnen aan uw Kamer geen rapportages over individuele buitenlandse rechtszaken doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse internationaal opererende ontvoeringsteams

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Turkish presidential spokesman's remarks on possible global deployment of Turkish abduction teams, what the government will do against such teams in the Netherlands, and whether the Turkish ambassador will be summoned. The minister answered that there are no indications such teams are active in the Netherlands, that police and prosecutors are alert and urge victims to report, and that there is currently no reason to summon the ambassador.
The cabinet currently has no indications that such teams are active in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet heeft op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat dergelijke teams in Nederland actief zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat Iran de Nederlandse ambassadeur op het matje heeft geroepen

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about Iran summoning the Dutch ambassador over an attack in Ahwaz, whether the US view of Iran as the top state sponsor of terrorism is shared, and whether the Netherlands should distance itself from EU policy on the Iran nuclear deal. The minister answered that the ambassador conveyed condolences and that claims would be assessed on facts with EU partners, that the Netherlands shares concern about Iran's regional role and pursues pressure plus critical dialogue, and that the nuclear deal remains essential for Dutch security.
The Netherlands is greatly concerned about Iran's role in the region.
Nederland maakt zich grote zorgen over de Iraanse rol in de regio
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en De Roon over de uitlatingen van een Nederlandse diplomaat over het opgeven van het veto op het gebied van buitenland beleid

PVV MPs Maeijer and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of a Dutch diplomat's remarks on giving up the EU foreign-policy veto and whether the government would reject any loss of vetoes. Minister Blok confirmed the quotes, said the government favours efficient EU decision-making with a positive attitude, and promised a BNC-fiche on the Commission communication, without clearly ruling out giving up vetoes.
The cabinet will inform the House of Representatives, by means of a BNC-fiche, of its position on the Communication of the European Commission.
Het kabinet zal de Tweede Kamer door middel van een BNC-fiche informeren over zijn standpunt ten aanzien van de Mededeling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over het bericht dat Hamas een militaire opleiding runt met UNRWA geld

Two PVV MPs asked whether UNRWA schools in Gaza are used by Hamas for military training, how much of UNRWA's budget goes to Gaza, and whether the Dutch annual contribution of about 20 million euro should be stopped or not increased. The government said it has no evidence for the training claim, that UNRWA does not cooperate with Hamas summer camps, and that it intends to keep the annual 13 million euro contribution while assessing any additional funding case by case.
The government has no evidence for the claim in the article or the 2015 film referred to in the article.
Het kabinet heeft geen bewijs voor de claim uit het artikel of de film uit 2015 waar in het artikel naar verwezen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over de OIC-veroordeling van een cartoonwedstrijd in Nederland

PVV MPs Wilders and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the OIC's condemnation of a planned Mohammed cartoon contest in the Netherlands, questioning the OIC's standing, the Cairo Declaration's sharia clause, and whether the government would firmly reject OIC interference. Minister Blok answered that freedom of expression applies to all, that the Netherlands is not an OIC member and does not endorse the Cairo Declaration, that courts rather than the cabinet judge legal limits, and that he informed the OIC Secretary-General that the government has no involvement in the contest.
The OIC is free to speak out publicly in this debate.
Het staat de OIC vrij om zich openbaar uit te spreken in dit debat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, De Roon en Van der Staaij over een rapport over schoolboeken, uitgegeven door de Palestijnse Autoriteit

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government assesses a report finding that Palestinian Authority textbooks delegitimise Israel, glorify violence and lack peace education, and whether the government will press for change and join a British-led review. The ministers agree problematic elements remain, say Dutch and EU pressure on both sides against incitement has had limited results as relations deteriorate, and decline to contribute to the British review because the Netherlands is not a donor in education and lacks specific expertise.
However, the Netherlands is not a donor in the education sector and has no specific expertise on Palestinian education.
Nederland is echter geen donor in de onderwijssector en heeft geen specifieke expertise op het Palestijnse onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower, De Roon en Agema over het beleid van Jeugdbescherming Rijnmond inzake reisadviezen naar Israël

PVV MPs asked whether the Rotterdam youth protection agency JRR gives children under supervision a negative travel advice for Israel, why it differs from Turkey or Morocco, and whether it should allow travel to such areas when accompanied by an adult. The minister answered that the certified institution assesses each trip case by case for every destination, that the ministry's advice is only one factor, and that it will not restrict the institution's power to refuse travel when child development is at risk.
There is no general negative travel advice for any country.
Er is daarbij geen sprake van een algemeen negatief reisadvies voor welk land dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht dat Nederland lokale verkiezingen in Syrisch rebellengebied financierde

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether Dutch funds financed local elections in rebel-held Eastern Ghouta, whether this was covert political interference, and why Parliament was not informed. The minister confirmed a 4,800 euro contribution via the LDSPS programme, defended it as supporting transparent local governance and countering extremist influence, found no evidence of diversion to armed groups, and stated that non-humanitarian support to opposition areas has largely ended.
Through the Local Development and Small Projects Support (LDSPS) programme, the Netherlands supported the elections in Eastern Ghouta with 4,800 euros.
Nederland heeft via het Local Development and Small Projects Support (LDSPS) programma de verkiezingen in Oost-Ghouta met 4800,- euro ondersteund.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van het lid De Roon over de onrust in Nicaragua en het hoge aantal burgerdoden bij anti-regeringsprotesten

MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the reported high death toll from anti-government protests in Nicaragua, alleged summary executions by police and paramilitaries, and whether the Netherlands would press for UN Security Council action. The minister confirmed awareness of divergent death toll estimates (295 per IACHR, 448 per ANPDH), called the government's conduct of human rights very worrying, and said the Netherlands is supporting an OAS expert mission and suspended a development project for two months, but would wait for ongoing international initiatives before considering raising the matter in the Security Council.
The Netherlands intends to financially support an independent OAS expert mission.
Nederland is voornemens een onafhankelijke expertmissie van de OAS financieel te steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over een tsunami van islamitisch geweld tegen christenen in Nigeria

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether jihadists operate among Fulani herders and whether recent killings of Christians in Nigeria amount to ethnic cleansing or an Islamic agenda. The minister answered that the conflict is mainly driven by socio-economic factors with ethnic-religious elements, that there is no evidence of a religious agenda, and that the government raised the killings with President Buhari during his visit.
There are so far no indications that a premeditated religious agenda lies behind the acts of violence.
Er zijn vooralsnog geen aanwijzingen dat er achter de geweldplegingen een vooropgezette religieuze agenda schuilgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Oekraïense spionage gericht tegen Nederlanders die betrokken waren bij MH-17 onderzoek(en)

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether Ukraine spied on Dutch officials involved in the MH17 investigation, how this affected the Joint Investigation Team, and whether it undermined the findings. The government declined to confirm specific evidence publicly, said cooperation within the JIT remains constructive and the evidence is considered reliable, and said the matter was raised with Ukrainian authorities.
The cabinet cannot make any public statements about this.
Hierover kan het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over het vertrek van de Verenigde Staten uit de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

MPs Van der Staaij, De Roon and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about the US withdrawal from the UN Human Rights Council over alleged bias against Israel, and whether Dutch membership legitimises unreliable human rights policy. The minister rejects that view, acknowledges shortcomings such as agenda item 7, describes reform efforts and says the Netherlands will keep working in the Council rather than follow the US out.
The cabinet does not want to sideline itself, but rather wants to stay in dialogue within the Human Rights Council, including with the difficult countries.
Het kabinet wil zichzelf niet buiten spel zetten, maar wil juist in gesprek blijven in de Mensenrechtenraad, ook met de moeilijke landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het MH17 strafproces te voeren in de zittingslocatie Schiphol

The MP De Roon asked the Minister of Justice why the MH17 criminal trial was located at Schiphol, whether next of kin were consulted, and whether the location would be reconsidered. The Minister answered that the location was chosen on the basis of a programme of requirements set by the OM and judiciary, that Schiphol offers the needed facilities, and that the choice was carefully made, with next of kin able to follow the trial via live stream.
The decision on the hearing location was carefully prepared and made.
Het besluit over de zittingslocatie is zorgvuldig voorbereid en gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Maeijer over ontoegankelijkheid van Amerikaanse nieuwssites door EU regels

PVV MPs asked the government about US news sites blocking EU users because of GDPR rules and what it would do to protect Dutch access to US news. The minister replied that GDPR applies to non-EU firms, that the blocking is a temporary transition problem, that compliant alternatives exist, and that no action is planned.
At this moment I therefore see no reason to take action on this.
Op dit moment zie ik dan ook geen aanleiding om hier actie op te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over steun voor Israëlische tegenaanval

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands was aware of German and British support for Israel's counterstrike after an Iranian attack from Syria, and why the Dutch government had not expressed similar support, asking if it would do so now. The minister confirmed awareness, condemned Iranian threats and the attack at the UN Security Council, and called for calm and de-escalation, without expressing support for the Israeli strike.
The cabinet acknowledges Israel's security concerns and condemns the ongoing Iranian threats against Israel.
Het kabinet erkent de Israëlische veiligheidszorgen en veroordeelt de aanhoudende Iraanse dreigementen tegen Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert en De Roon over het bericht dat EU-subsidies terecht komen bij organisaties die oproepen tot boycot van Israël

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU funds organisations calling for a boycott of Israel (BDS), and whether funds reached Palestinian groups linked to terrorism. The government answered that the EU opposes a boycott, that BDS advocacy is protected speech and not a funding bar, that only one NGO was named in the report (training for youth including Hamas and PFLP members, funded by Norway), and that it sees no reason to ask the Commission to act.
The fact that organisations support the BDS movement is not a criterion for rejecting funding for the cabinet.
Het feit dat organisaties de BDS-beweging ondersteunen, is voor het kabinet geen afwijzingscriterium voor financiering
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Agema en De Roon over de arrestatie van de Britse activist en islamcriticus Tommy Robinson

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would protest to the UK over the arrest and sentencing of Tommy Robinson, citing free speech and his safety in prison, and whether the government accepts that suppressing Islam critics fuels public anger. The minister replied that free speech applies to everyone, that Robinson reportedly breached his earlier parole conditions, and that the government trusts the UK legal process and sees no reason to comment further.
The cabinet has confidence in the legal process in the United Kingdom and sees no reason to comment further on this.
Het kabinet heeft vertrouwen in de rechtsgang in het Verenigd Koninkrijk en ziet geen aanleiding zich hierover nader uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over een drugsbaron als consul op Aruba

MPs De Roon and De Graaf (PVV) asked whether the Netherlands should accept a consul-general from Venezuela on Aruba with a questionable reputation, citing alleged drug links, and whether the appointment should be reversed. Minister Blok answered that no grounds such as a conviction currently bar the exequatur, that the person is not on the US SDN list, and that he sees no reason to reverse the decision.
I currently see no reason, with reference to the answers to questions 1 and 3, to reverse the decision.
Ik zie, met verwijzing naar de antwoorden op vraag 1 en 3, momenteel geen reden om het besluit terug te draaien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over een uitspraak van president Erdogan

MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether Erdogan called the US and other NATO allies a 'priority threat', whether the minister would ask Turkey which allies are meant, and whether Turkey fits in NATO. The minister replied that the interview concerned alleged US arms supplies to groups Turkey sees as threats, that it contained no such characterisation of allies, that Turkey and the US are discussing mutual security concerns, and that Turkey's NATO membership is not in question.
The interview referred to in the question contains no statement by President Erdogan that the US and other allies are a 'priority threat'.
Het interview waar de vraag op doelt, bevat geen uitspraak van president Erdogan dat de VS en andere bondgenoten een « priority threat » zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse chantage met gegijzelde Grieken

The MP De Roon asks the Foreign Minister about Erdogan's linking the release of detained Greek soldiers to Greece handing over eight Turks to Turkey, whether this breaches NATO principles, why NATO membership has no consequences, and whether Turkish EU accession talks and visa liberalisation should be cancelled. The minister calls it a bilateral matter, affirms NATO's shared values while noting Turkey's contribution to collective defence, and states the government will keep EU accession talks fully frozen and keep visa benchmarks, but will not block Turkish visa-free travel without firm conditions.
This concerns a bilateral issue between Turkey and Greece.
Dit betreft een bilaterale kwestie tussen Turkije en Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Helvert en Voordewind over het benoemen van een defensieattaché in Iran

MPs from the SGP, PVV, CDA and ChristenUnie asked why the Netherlands plans to station a defence attaché in Tehran, how this relates to Iran's regional ambitions and missile programme, and to possible EU sanctions. The government answers that the posting improves monitoring of military developments and contacts with Iranian authorities, and that a parallel dialogue with Iran does not exclude concern about the missile programme.
Because of the Dutch interests in the region and Iran's role in it, it was chosen to station the new defence attaché in Tehran itself.
Vanwege de Nederlandse belangen in de regio en de rol van Iran daarin is ervoor gekozen de nieuwe defat in Teheran zelf te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Maeijer over virulent antisemitisme via Palestijns persbureau

Two Dutch MPs asked the foreign and development ministers about an antisemitic opinion piece by a former Hamas figure published on the Palestinian news agency Ma'an's website, and whether Dutch or EU funding to Ma'an should end. The ministers answered that the piece was removed and Ma'an publicly distanced itself from it, so the government does not intend to seek an end to EU cooperation.
In this case, the cabinet is of the view that Ma'an News Agency acted adequately by removing the opinion piece from its website and publicly distancing itself from its content.
In dit geval is het kabinet van oordeel dat Ma'an News Agency adequaat heeft opgetreden door het bewuste opiniestuk te verwijderen van diens website en openlijk afstand te nemen van de inhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg en De Roon over het bericht dat de Palestijnse Autoriteit voor 50 miljoen dollar een privéjet heeft aangeschaft voor Mahmoud Abbas

Two MPs asked the minister whether the Palestinian Authority bought a $50 million private jet for Abbas, whether that spending was needed, why the Netherlands rushed a 13 million euro UNRWA contribution, and whether all Dutch funding to the PA should stop. The minister confirmed a government aircraft was bought from PA and PLO funds with no Dutch or European money, defended the accelerated UNRWA payment, and rejected halting PA funding because it conflicts with the two-state goal.
No Dutch or European contributions were used for the purchase.
Er zijn geen Nederlandse of Europese bijdragen voor de aanschaf gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ploumen, Van Helvert, Voordewind, Van Ojik, Ten Broeke, Karabulut en De Roon over de onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

MPs asked the minister about the expulsion of a BBC journalist from Papua, press freedom, deteriorating human rights, and Dutch police training in Indonesia. The minister confirmed the expulsion, said foreign journalists need permits, described Dutch support for press freedom and the Community Policing Programme, and said human rights including Papua are raised in bilateral and EU/UN dialogue.
Enquiries showed that the BBC journalist indeed had to leave the province.
Bij navraag is gebleken dat de BBC-journaliste inderdaad de provincie moest verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Van Helvert over een nieuwe serie moorden onder christenen in Nigeria

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reported killings of Christians in Nigeria and whether Fulani herdsmen are responsible, why the Nigerian state fails to protect civilians, whether religion plays a role, Boko Haram's current strength, and how the Netherlands can help. The minister said the government cannot independently confirm the figures, attributed the violence mainly to economic and land-related causes rather than a religious agenda, and committed to pressing Nigerian authorities to document crimes and prosecute perpetrators.
The Netherlands will, preferably together with other partners or within the EU, press the Nigerian authorities that the perpetrators of the killings must not go unpunished
Nederland zal er, bij voorkeur ook samen met andere partners, dan wel in EU-verband, bij de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten op aandringen dat de daders van de moordpartijen niet vrijuit gaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, De Roon en Wilders over Diyanet

PVV MPs asked the government whether it would end its relationship with Diyanet Nederland (ISN/HDV) and close its mosques after Diyanet reportedly approved marriage and pregnancy of 9-year-old girls, and whether it would expel the Turkish ambassador or cut diplomatic ties. The minister answered that ISN is one of many dialogue partners with no formal cooperation, that Diyanet publicly condemned child marriage, that freedom of religion and association mean closing mosques is not possible, and that diplomatic relations are needed to discuss rule-of-law issues; no Turkish ambassador is currently accredited in the Netherlands.
There is no question of formal cooperation.
Er is geen sprake van formele samenwerking.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer, De Roon en Fritsma over de schamele korting op de financiële steun van de Europese Unie (EU) aan Turkije en het vooruitzicht op visumvrij reizen van miljoenen Turken

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether a reported 100 million euro cut in EU pre-accession aid to Turkey is real, whether Dutch money should still flow to Turkey, for a detailed overview of EU funds, and whether visa-free travel for Turks can be prevented.
