The minister confirmed about 50% cuts to annual and about 30% to multi-year pre-accession programmes in 2017, said the Netherlands favours suspension but lacks majority support, referred to existing documentation for fund details, and stated Turkey does not yet meet all visa liberalisation benchmarks so no Dutch position is needed yet.
The Netherlands is awaiting the Commission's proposals for limiting and reallocating the funds.
Nederland wacht de voorstellen van de Commissie voor inperking en herschikking van de middelen af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Graus over eenzijdig Chinees optreden bij instellen van vliegroutes over de Straat van Taiwan

PVV MPs De Roon and Graus asked whether the government shares US concern over China's unilateral setting of new flight routes over the Taiwan Strait and whether this endangers Dutch flights. The minister answered that the government and the EU call for a peaceful dialogue solution, that Dutch airlines do not use these routes so there is no reason to engage, and that Nederland and the EU will keep urging both sides toward constructive dialogue.
Dutch airlines, however, do not use the routes. The cabinet therefore sees no reason to enter into consultation on this.
Nederlandse luchtvaartmaatschappijen maken echter geen gebruik van de routes. Het kabinet heeft dan ook geen aanleiding hierover in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over de donorconferentie voor Irak

PVV MPs De Roon and Van Weerdenburg asked about Dutch participation and pledges at the February 2018 Iraq donor conference in Kuwait, including whether taxpayer money should go to Iraq rather than domestic needs, and whether a full list of pledges would be shared. The minister confirmed participation, cited a EUR 12 million stabilisation contribution and conditional aid, and said no full overview of pledges had been compiled, citing a roughly USD 30 billion total from the Kuwaiti chair.
No overview has been made of all the pledges made during the conference.
Er is geen overzicht gemaakt van alle toezeggingen gedaan tijdens de conferentie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Arissen, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Van Helvert, Ploumen, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het bericht dat moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers in Europa in voorbere

MPs from ten parties asked the government whether it knew of reports that assassinations of Turkish citizens in Europe were being planned, how it assessed these claims, and whether it would investigate and take extra security measures. The minister said the government is alert and monitors tensions and safety in the Turkish-Dutch community, cannot confirm the existence of such plans, and urged anyone threatened to report it.
I cannot confirm the existence of plans for assassinations of Turkish citizens.
Het bestaan van plannen voor moordaanslagen op Turkse burgers kan ik niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over een zelfmoordaanslag op een kerk in Pakistan

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a suicide attack on a church in Pakistan, its victim numbers, the attackers' background, the state of radical Islamist groups and Dutch efforts on religious freedom, including the cases of death-sentenced Christians. The minister answered with casualty figures, attributed the attack to ISIS-Khorasan, described the Pakistani government's counter-terrorism plan and reported Dutch and EU engagement on religious freedom.
It cannot be determined from the figures whether the victims were of terrorist, sectarian or separatist violence.
Het is niet uit de cijfers op te maken of het hierbij gaat om slachtoffers van terroristisch, sektarisch of separatistisch geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse journalisten die op een dodenlijst zijn gezet door Erdogan’s AK-partij

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about a reported Turkish death list of critical journalists, paramilitary threats, safety of Turkish journalists in the Netherlands, abduction risks, and continued EU pre-accession aid to Turkey. The minister said the column cited does not show a death list, that authorities monitor such groups and urge victims to report, and that pre-accession aid reduction was pursued at EU level without sufficient support, while the rule-of-law concerns are raised regularly.
The cabinet notes that on the basis of this column and the article you refer to, it cannot be concluded that a high-ranking Turkish politician has drawn up a death list for critical journalists.

Het kabinet constateert dat op basis van deze column en het artikel waar u naar verwijst, niet kan worden geconcludeerd dat een hooggeplaatste Turkse politicus een dodenlijst voor kritische journalisten heeft opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Van der Staaij over de omstandigheden in Noord-Koreaanse politieke gevangenissen

MPs from CDA, VVD, PVV and SGP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that North Korean political prisons resemble Nazi camps, including detention numbers, alleged crimes against humanity, UN and ICC action, and protection for Christians. The minister answered that the UN commission reports are authoritative, that Netherlands raises the issue at the UN and supports referral to the ICC though this requires Security Council agreement, and that it supports documentation projects and religious freedom.
The Netherlands, together with the EU, regularly raises the human rights situation in North Korea, including abuses in (political) prisons.
Nederland stelt de mensenrechtensituatie in Noord-Korea, inclusief misstanden in (politieke) gevangenissen, mede in EU-verband regelmatig aan de orde
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over extra maatregelen tegen Noord-Korea en de positie van Nederland als voorzitter van het VN-sanctiecomité Noord-Korea

The PVV MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the Dutch chairmanship of the UN North Korea sanctions committee in 2018, US calls to expand the shipping blacklist, enforcement capacity, cryptocurrency theft, tightening sanctions and attendance at the Vancouver meeting. The minister answered that the Netherlands will focus on effective implementation and outreach, that existing rules already allow ship inspections, that the expert panel supports enforcement, that no separate Dutch investigation into crypto theft is planned, and that the Netherlands supports resolution 2379 and will attend Vancouver.
Carrying out an independent Dutch investigation into the scale of North Korea's cryptocurrency trade and digital theft does not seem appropriate.
Uitvoering van een eigenstandig onderzoek door Nederland naar de schaal van de handel in cryptocurrencies door Noord-Korea en digitale diefstal daarvan ligt niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de immense schaal waarop kinderen worden misbruikt op islamitische scholen in Pakistan

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about reported widespread child sexual abuse at Islamic schools (madrassas) in Pakistan, including lack of oversight, funders, and whether Sharia and Islamic ideology enable abuse, and whether the Netherlands should push for an inquiry at the UN Security Council. The minister said the situation is very worrying but cannot be verified, that unregistered madrassas have little oversight, that funders are unknown to the government, that abuse is not caused by Islam or Sharia but impunity is a problem addressed in EU-Pakistan dialogue, and that the Security Council is not the right forum.
The cabinet does not have an overview of parties that financially contribute to Pakistani madrassas.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een overzicht van partijen die financieel bijdragen aan Pakistaanse madrassa's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de ziekelijke fantasieën van een Nederlandse VN vrouwenvertegenwoordiger

MP De Roon asks whether the Minister of Foreign Affairs appoints the Dutch UN women's representative, what the requirements are, whether her appointment should be reversed over violent remarks, and why not. The minister answers that the Dutch Women's Council (NVR) selects the representative without the ministry's involvement, outlines the NVR's criteria and selection process, says the government would deem such remarks unfit if made, and declines to reverse the appointment because the NVR made it.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is not involved in this and is only informed.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is hierbij niet betrokken en wordt alleen geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over VN-schoolboeken die uitpuilen van Israëlhaat en antisemitisme

Geert Wilders' party MP De Roon asked the government about UNRWA textbooks used with Palestinian children that allegedly contain anti-Israel and antisemitic content, whether UNRWA is responsible, and whether Netherlands will fight antisemitism in the UN and stop funding UNRWA. The ministers answered that the Palestinian Authority, not the UN, authored the books, that UNRWA says 90% are not used and the rest are being reviewed, and that the government will not stop UNRWA funding.
In a press release of 6 October, UNRWA reports that 90% of the books named in the study are not used in the current curriculum in UNRWA schools.
In een persbericht van 6 oktober jl. meldt UNRWA dat 90% van de in de studie genoemde boeken niet wordt gebruikt in het huidige curriculum in UNRWA-scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Markuszower over het bericht dat een niet bestaand land lid is geworden van Interpol

PVV MPs asked why the Palestinian Authority could join Interpol, whether the Netherlands supports this, and when aid would be cut given attacks on Israel. The government said the bid had sufficient support in Interpol's General Assembly, the Dutch delegations abstained because the Kingdom does not recognise a State of Palestine, and it sees no reason to revise relations with the Palestinian Authority.
The cabinet therefore sees no reason to revise the relationship with the Palestinian Authority.
Het kabinet ziet daarom geen aanleiding om de relatie met de Palestijnse Autoriteit te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg en De Roon over het bericht dat Robert Mugabe benoemd is tot goodwill-ambassadeur van de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO)

PVV MPs asked whether Robert Mugabe's appointment as WHO goodwill ambassador was justified, and whether Dutch funding or membership should be suspended or withdrawn if it was not reversed. The minister answered that the appointment was unfounded, that the Netherlands had lobbied for its withdrawal, which the WHO did, and that no further measures were needed.
It is good that this decision has been withdrawn. Therefore there is no need to take further measures.
Het is goed dat dit besluit is ingetrokken. Daarom is er geen noodzaak om verdere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Markuszower over het bericht dat Erdogan Interpol misbruikt om jacht te maken op politieke tegenstanders

MPs De Roon, Helder and Markuszower asked whether Turkey misuses Interpol systems to pursue political opponents, what safeguards exist, and whether Dutch nationals have been affected. The government answered that it shares concern, describes Interpol's safeguards (Constitution article 3, Secretary General review, the CCF complaints commission) and Dutch pre-checks of Red Notices, and says it knows of no cases involving Dutch nationals.
The cabinet is concerned about reports, such as this one, that Turkey uses INTERPOL for arrest requests that violate article 3 of the INTERPOL Constitution.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over berichten, zoals onderhavig rapport, dat INTERPOL door Turkije wordt gebruikt voor arrestatie-verzoeken die een schending vormen van artikel 3 van de INTERPOL Constitutie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders, Fritsma en Maeijer over toegang van terroristen tot het Europees Parlement

PVV MPs asked whether the government knew that Leila Khaled had been received in the European Parliament, whether it finds this absurd, how a convicted hijacker obtained a Schengen visa, and what will prevent recurrence. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to judge the Parliament's invitation decision, explained the SIS refusal mechanism in general terms without discussing the individual case, and stated no action on the invitation policy.
I see no reason to intervene in the assessment made by the European Parliament when inviting Ms Khaled.
Ik zie geen aanleiding te treden in de afweging die door het Europees parlement is gemaakt bij de uitnodiging aan mevrouw Khaled.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over het bericht dat België de hulp aan Palestijnse scholen opschort

MPs De Roon and Van Weerdenburg asked whether Dutch aid money had gone to Palestinian schools that were named after a terrorist and glorify violence, and whether a ban on all Dutch funding to such schools is warranted. The ministers answered that the Netherlands does not fund schools directly, that glorification of violence is unacceptable, that the EU and Netherlands press both parties on incitement, and that they do not agree that no Dutch money should go to Palestinian schools.
The Netherlands does not provide direct funding to schools, so also not to this particular school.
Nederland geeft geen directe financiering aan scholen, dus ook niet aan deze bewuste school.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en De Roon over het stopzetten van de financiering aan de Women’s Affairs Technical Committee (WATC)

MPs Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke and De Roon asked whether Dutch funding to the Women's Affairs Technical Committee (WATC) was stopped after WATC backed a youth centre named after a terrorist, and whether other subsidised organisations glorify terrorism. The ministers confirm the funding was halted with other donors, citing glorification of violence, and state that existing subsidy conditions are sufficient to prevent support to such organisations.
For this reason, the Netherlands, together with the other donors of the Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat, has decided to immediately end cooperation with WATC.
Om deze reden heeft Nederland – samen met de andere donoren van het Human Rights and International Humanitairan Law Secretariat – besloten de samenwerking met WATC per direct stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over terreurkampen voor Palestijnse kinderen georganiseerd door o.a. de Verenigde Naties

MPs De Roon and Van Weerdenburg (PVV) asked the government how many children attend alleged Hamas and UNRWA 'terror camps' and whether Dutch funding to UNRWA should stop. The government distinguishes Hamas camps from UNRWA summer camps, says it has no evidence of terrorist links to UNRWA camps, and refuses to halt UNRWA funding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de walgelijke uitspraken van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Hongarije

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether the Dutch ambassador to Hungary, who had compared Hungarian government action on immigration to Islamist terrorists, spoke on behalf of the government and whether he should apologise and be removed. Minister Koenders distanced the government from the remark as unfortunate, said the ambassador had been told so, and considered the matter closed while acknowledging concerns about Hungary's rule of law.
The Dutch ambassador's statement in Hungary about terrorism is therefore unfortunate.
De uitspraak van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Hongarije over terrorisme is daarom ongelukkig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, De Graaf en Wilders over beschermde identiteit voor teruggekeerde Zweedse jihadisten

MPs De Roon, De Graaf and Wilders asked whether returning Swedish jihadists receive protected identities to aid reintegration, whether they could travel and settle in the EU and Netherlands, and whether Dutch services know of them. The ministers replied that the reports are incorrect, that Sweden only offers privacy-data protection for threatened citizens and not new identities, and that the other questions therefore do not apply.
No, this report is not correct.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de veiligheidssituatie van diplomaten in Venezuela

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that US diplomats' families were being withdrawn from Venezuela due to security concerns, and what the Netherlands is doing to protect its diplomats and their families. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, declined to discuss security measures publicly, stated that the situation is monitored daily and that the travel advice was last updated on 2 August 2017.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs cannot make public statements about the security or security measures for diplomats and their families.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlands Zaken kan geen openbare uitspraken doen over de veiligheid c.q. veiligheidsmaatregelen ten behoeve van diplomaten en hun families.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Roon over het bezoek van diplomaten aan de Evin-gevangenis in Teheran

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about a visit by 45 diplomats, including the Dutch ambassador, to Tehran's Evin prison, a photo showing the Dutch flag, and whether the visit was a propaganda stunt shown only the 'luxury' part of the prison. The minister confirmed the visit and the Dutch participation, said the programme was not known in advance, and defended joining with like-minded countries to raise human rights concerns directly with Iran.
The visit did not give a complete picture of the facilities in Evin prison, nor of the prisoners' living conditions.
Het bezoek gaf geen volledig beeld van de faciliteiten in de Evin-gevangenis, noch van de leefomstandigheden van de gevangenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over mogelijke marginalisering van Assyriërs in Koerdisch gebied in Irak

The MP asks whether the government finds it troubling that Kurdish authorities removed an Assyrian mayor and whether the Assyrian mayor of Tel Keppe is under pressure from the KDP, and asks the government to warn Iraqi and Kurdish authorities that ethnic or religious administrative purges would lead to withdrawal of Dutch support, and whether an autonomous Christian region in the Nineveh Plain is preferable. The minister says the government has no independent information on the mayoral changes, shares concern for minorities, treats internal administration as an Iraqi matter while urging inclusive governance, and does not see federal self-rule as a durable solution.
The cabinet has no independent information on the background of the administrative changes in Tel Keppe.
Het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over de achtergronden van de bestuurswisselingen in Tel Keppe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over mogelijke marginalisering van Assyriërs in Koerdisch gebied in Irak

An MP asked whether the government was aware of the appointment of a Muslim Kurd as mayor of a traditionally Christian municipality in Kurdish Iraq, why, and whether it would raise Christian fears of political marginalisation with Iraqi and Kurdish authorities. The minister acknowledged the appointment, called it an internal Iraqi matter, said the Netherlands raises inclusive governance and minority rights in bilateral and multilateral channels, but argued self-rule alone does not solve the problem.
Internal governance matters such as this are first and foremost a domestic Iraqi issue.
Interne bestuursaangelegenheden als deze zijn in de eerste plaats een Iraakse binnenlandse kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de Turkse legerleiding die Turkse NAVO-militairen tot spionage beveelt

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkish military leadership had ordered Turkish NATO personnel to spy on former colleagues, whether such practices are banned in the Netherlands, and whether NATO is investigating. The minister answered that foreign intelligence services may not operate in the Netherlands without permission, that the government acts against unauthorised activity but does not discuss specific cases publicly, and that NATO sees no specific threat to the organisation, so the matter is for the national state concerned.
As you know, specific matters are not discussed in public.
Zoals u bekend wordt er in het openbaar niet ingegaan op specifieke zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over het besluit van Unesco over de Oude Stad van Hebron

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether UNESCO's decision to place the Old City of Hebron on the World Heritage List, which they said neglects Jewish history, distorts history, and whether the Netherlands will protest. The minister answered that the decision was taken by the World Heritage Committee members, that ICOMOS could not verify the emergency procedure criteria because Israel denied a site visit, that the cabinet follows ICOMOS advice, and that the Netherlands will not protest but will urge coexistence.
The cabinet's position is that it follows the advice of ICOMOS.
Het kabinet hanteert als standpunt dat het de adviezen van ICOMOS volgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Karabulut, Van Raan, De Roon en Van der Staaij over de confiscaties door Turkse overheid van Aramese kerken en kerkbezittingen

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's transfer of over 50 Aramaic churches and monasteries to the Diyanet amounts to confiscation, and whether the Netherlands would seek clarification and urge EU partners to respond. The minister said the transfers stem from administrative reorganisation under Turkish law, that Diyanet denied receiving property and Mardin confirmed this, but that the Aramaic community has lost property it used for over a thousand years; the embassy will raise minority rights and a field visit with EU partners is planned.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the rights of religious minorities in Turkey with the authorities.
Nederland zal de rechten van religieuze minderheden in Turkije bij de autoriteiten blijven aankaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Popken over een schip dat in de nabijheid van marineschepen is geëxplodeerd voor de kust van Somalië

MPs De Roon and Popken asked the ministers whether a ship exploding near naval vessels off Somalia was a navy ship, whether EU navies were involved, and which navies were present, and whether the cause would be investigated before a Dutch ship deployed there. The government said it could not confirm the reports, that the ship was very likely not a naval vessel, that an Italian frigate found nothing on investigation, and that the incident gave no reason for further inquiry.
Neither the initial incident report nor the subsequent actions of EUNAVFOR Atalanta give reason to carry out further investigation.
Zowel de initiële incidentmelding als de daaropvolgende acties van EUNAVFOR Atalanta geven geen aanleiding om verder onderzoek te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Saoedi-Arabië dat is verkozen tot lid van de VN-vrouwenraad

Two PVV MPs asked why Saudi Arabia was elected to the UN Commission on the Status of Women, whether the Netherlands supported it, and whether Dutch funding of UN human rights bodies should stop. The Minister replied that the vote in ECOSOC is secret so countries cannot be held to account for it, that the Netherlands did not support the election, that a seat offers a chance to raise women's position with Saudi Arabia, and that the Commission is funded from the general UN budget rather than directly by the Netherlands.
The vote in ECOSOC is secret.
De stemming in de ECOSOC is geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en De Roon over financiële steun van de EU aan Turkije

MPs Maeijer and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether EU financial aid to Turkey has been assessed for effectiveness, whether monitoring existed, and whether Turkey's accession talks should be terminated and pre-accession aid stopped and recovered. The minister said the European Court of Auditors is free to choose its audits, that IPA projects are monitored, and that accession talks are effectively stalled, with the Commission to report in 2018 on constitutional changes, while Netherlands keeps pressing to suspend pre-accession aid but lacks Council support.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Noord-Korea en de veiligheidsrisico’s voor Nederlandse toeristen

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the number of Dutch tourists to North Korea, the risk of hostage-taking and evacuation in case of military conflict, travel advice, sanctions, a possible US terrorism-list designation, and Dutch political and economic ties. The minister answered that registration is voluntary, that risks rise with tensions, that there is no Dutch embassy and only limited consular help, that the travel advice would be updated if needed, and that Dutch policy is critical engagement with minimal bilateral contact.
The House is only informed about specific areas of attention and the current knowledge level of the MIVD through the appropriate channels.
Over specifieke aandachtsgebieden en het actueel kennisniveau van de MIVD wordt de Kamer slechts via de daartoe geëigende kanalen geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke en De Roon over de berichten dat Turkije Koerdische doelen in Noord-Syrië en Noord-Irak heeft aangevallen

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reported Turkish strikes on Kurdish targets in northern Syria and Iraq, including whether evidence supports Turkey's claim the targets were PKK smugglers and what is known of casualties among Syrian Christians and Yazidis. The minister answered that Turkey has a right to self-defence but should show restraint and act proportionately, that the government has no evidence to confirm or refute Turkey's claim, and that it has no independent information on casualties, only open-source reports of protests.
The Netherlands does not have independent intelligence on the basis of which these reports can be confirmed or refuted.
Nederland beschikt niet over eigenstandige inlichtingen op basis waarvan deze berichten bevestigd of ontkracht kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de Nederlandse financiering van mobiele (sharia) rechtbanken in Somalië

An MP asked whether the Netherlands' 2 million euro contribution to Somalia's Joint Rule of Law Programme funds sharia-based mobile courts, and whether the money should be withdrawn. The minister answered that the funds target access to formal justice, that the formal system is being strengthened to reduce space for sharia and armed-group courts, and that the government will press Somalia on anti-piracy legislation.
The cabinet of course maintains close oversight of the spending of Dutch funds.
Het kabinet houdt uiteraard goed toezicht op de besteding van de Nederlandse middelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Helvert, De Roon, Karabulut, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Diks, Van den Hul en Sjoerdsma over de veroordeling van de gouverneur Tjahaja Purnama van Jakarta

MPs from nine parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the two-year prison sentence of Jakarta governor Purnama for blasphemy, whether it will press Indonesia for his release and raise the case in the EU-Indonesia human rights dialogue. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that the human rights ambassador raised it with Indonesian officials, that the EU issued a statement, and that the case will be followed closely, without committing to demand release.
The Dutch government will continue to closely monitor the case and the situation regarding freedom of expression and of religion or belief, together with other EU partners.
De Nederlandse regering zal de zaak en de situatie rondom de vrijheid van meningsuiting en van godsdienst en levensovertuiging, samen met andere EU-partners, nauw blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, De Roon en Wilders over het bericht 'Turkije haalt uit: Nederland is xenofoob en islamofoob'

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers whether the Turkish ambassador should be expelled after Turkey accused the Netherlands of xenophobia and Islamophobia, and whether Turkey's human rights record should be taken into account. The government answered that it seeks to de-escalate diplomatic tensions and does not consider sending the ambassador back desirable.
The Cabinet is aiming to de-escalate the diplomatic tensions between the two countries.
Het Kabinet zet in op de-escalatie van de diplomatieke spanningen tussen beide landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Baudet, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en Knops over haatzaaien in Palestijnse schoolboeken

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether Palestinian schoolbooks incite hatred against Israel, glorify martyrdom and fuel terrorism, and whether the Netherlands funds such curricula. The minister answered that UNRWA screens textbooks and found problematic passages in some, that the government has no comparative data showing a trend toward more incitement, and that the Netherlands is not a donor to the Palestinian education sector.
The Netherlands is not a donor to the Palestinian education sector and therefore does not contribute to the curriculum.
Nederland is geen donor voor de Palestijnse onderwijssector en draagt derhalve ook niet bij aan het curriculum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat Turkije een Turkse beul heeft aangesteld bij een VN-vredesmissie

The MP asks the Foreign Minister how the government views reports that a Turkish police officer suspected of torture was assigned to a UN mission in South Sudan, and whether UN screening leaves vetting to contributing countries. The minister says the allegations cannot be verified, that persons under criminal investigation should not be deployed, explains the UN candidate screening procedure, and maintains the Dutch contribution to UNMISS.
The cabinet cannot, however, verify what is described in the article and therefore cannot confirm it either.
Het kabinet kan hetgeen beschreven is in het artikel echter niet verifiëren en dus ook niet bevestigen.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Ten Broeke over het bericht dat UNESCO een resolutie in stemming wil brengen waarin de soevereiniteit van Israël over West-Jeruzalem ontkend

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PVV and VVD asked whether the government would use its influence in UNESCO to block a draft resolution denying Israeli sovereignty over West Jerusalem, and why UNESCO engages with such politicised texts. The minister said the Netherlands criticised the draft, voted against the adopted version together with Germany, Greece and Lithuania, and that UNESCO's focus on the Old City reflects its World Heritage listings, but did not commit to further action.
The Netherlands therefore voted against the decision, as explained in a joint statement of vote with Germany, Greece and Lithuania.
Nederland heeft daarom tegen het besluit gestemd, zoals toegelicht in een gezamenlijke stemverklaring met Duitsland, Griekenland en Litouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Martin Bosma over de roofmoord op een Nederlander in Zuid-Afrika

PVV MPs De Roon and Bosma asked the Foreign Minister about the robbery-murder of a Dutch national on his farm in South Africa, the rising number of farm murders, conviction rates, police follow-up, and pressure on the South African government. The minister confirmed the killing, said official data on a rise is lacking, cited an AfriForum report showing 23 percent of suspects convicted, said the embassy and Dutch police are following the investigation, and said the government raises public order concerns through existing cooperation and the EU human rights dialogue.
The Dutch Embassy in Pretoria is in contact with the Barberton police, the South African police force investigating the murder.
De Nederlandse Ambassade in Pretoria staat in contact met de politie van Barberton, het Zuid-Afrikaanse politiekorps dat de moord onderzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van der Staaij, Van Klaveren en Voordewind over de vluchtelingendeal met Turkije

MPs from several parties asked whether PM Rutte and Chancellor Merkel made a gentlemen's agreement with Turkey to resettle 150,000-250,000 Syrian refugees a year, and whether the government asked Turkey to postpone a visit by Minister Cavusoglu. The government denied any side agreement, pointed to the EU-Turkey statement of 18 March 2016 and ongoing EU resettlement talks, denied any request to postpone the visit, and declined to answer the questions one by one before the requested deadline.
No. Agreements have only been made at European level on resettling Syrian refugees from Turkey.
Antwoord 4 Er zijn enkel in Europees verband afspraken gemaakt over het hervestigen van Syrische vluchtelingen vanuit Turkije.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over een interventie door het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken in een onderzoek naar een smeergeldaffaire waarin het Saoedisch koningshuis betrokken zou zijn

MPs De Roon and Helder asked whether the Foreign Ministry intervened to halt a bribery investigation involving Saudi royals, including cancelling the hearing of a Saudi witness, and whether a criminal investigation may be blocked for diplomatic reasons. The ministers answered that the decision not to send a mutual legal assistance request followed the normal procedure, weighing security risks to the witness rather than diplomatic relations, and declined to launch a separate inquiry.
Contrary to what the questions suggest, relations with the country to be approached are not decisive in weighing whether a legal assistance request is submitted.
Anders dan in de vragen wordt gesuggereerd, zijn verhoudingen met het aan te zoeken land niet van doorslaggevend belang bij de afweging of een rechtshulpverzoek wordt ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en De Roon over aanslagen op christenen in de Sinaï, Egypte

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about ISIS killings of Christians in North Sinai, whether Egypt can protect them, whether the government will raise concerns with Egypt and President Sisi, and whether Dutch radar deliveries to the Egyptian navy improve Sinai surveillance. The minister answered that the government is concerned, cannot judge the army's protection capacity given limited access and information, will raise concerns bilaterally and via the EU, and that the radars are not yet operational and are not clearly linked to Sinai surveillance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over een Chinees radarsysteem waarvoor de JSF niet langer onzichtbaar zou zijn

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether Chinese state media reports of a quantum radar test threaten the stealth of the F-35 and whether the Netherlands will verify its stealth itself. The minister answered that quantum radar is still experimental, that stealth reduces but does not eliminate detection, and that the Dutch air force has its own means to assess stealth on delivered aircraft.
The production process ensures that the aircraft meets the stealth specifications upon delivery.
Het productieproces waarborgt dat het toestel bij aflevering aan de stealth specificaties voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Roon over een tweet van de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Denemarken

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about a tweet by the Dutch ambassador to Denmark calling a possible VVD refusal to govern with the PVV 'Good news! No more feeding the beast?', and whether this denigrates PVV voters and whether it fits an official's conduct. The minister says the ambassador apologised, that the tweet should not have been posted, and that social media use by ambassadors is encouraged within the integrity code.
The ambassador has decided to apologise on Twitter.
De ambassadeur heeft besloten op Twitter zijn excuses aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Knops en Van Bommel over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2017 van Open Doors

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2017 ranking of Christian persecution, including whether the rise in persecution, the role of religious nationalism and Saudi-linked financing in Sub-Saharan Africa, Dutch policy and the fight against ISIS are being addressed. The minister confirmed the increase in persecution, said the causes are hard to pin down, described Dutch efforts through the Human Rights Fund and diplomacy, and said the fight against ISIS also serves Christians.
To gain more clarity on this, the Netherlands is supporting research in the region into both the sources and the effects of these financing flows in the Horn of Africa.
Om hier meer duidelijkheid over te krijgen steunt Nederland onderzoek in de regio naar zowel bronnen als effecten van deze financieringsstromen in de Hoorn van Afrika.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Marinier is homo op Aruba’

An MP asked the Defence Minister how many marines on Aruba had registered same-sex partnerships to obtain a higher foreign allowance, what it cost, whether it was checked elsewhere and whether money would be recovered. The minister said such partnerships made purely for the allowance are no longer tolerated and requests will be refused, but Defence does not record how many occurred for privacy reasons, and no recovery was needed as there was no formal misuse.
For reasons of privacy, Defence does not register the nature of a relationship when such an application is made.
Om redenen van privacy registreert Defensie bij een dergelijke aanvraag namelijk niet de aard van een relatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Van Klaveren en Knops over de wapenopbouw van Hezbollah

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Hezbollah's arms build-up in southern Lebanon, Iranian supply, civilian shielding, and possible Dutch support for Israel and tougher action against Iran. The minister answered that the government cannot verify the reports, condemns any use of civilians as shields, urges Iran to play a constructive role, and says new sanctions against Iran are not currently on the table.
The government has taken note with concern of the media reports but cannot comment on the accuracy of this information.
Het kabinet heeft met zorg kennisgenomen van de berichtgeving in de media maar kan geen uitspraken doen over de juistheid van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het tekort aan materieel voor de missie in Mali

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister why parliament learned of an equipment shortage for the Mali (MINUSMA) mission from the press, when this was known, whether the shortage is shameful, and whether the mission should be ended. The minister acknowledged delayed equipment delivery and said the required gear is now in the operating area, while declining to end the mission, which was extended to the end of 2017.
There is a delayed delivery of equipment.
Er is sprake van een vertraagde levering van materieel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en De Roon over het artikel "Qatar financiert omstreden Deense moskee via Den Haag"

PVV MPs De Graaf and De Roon asked whether the government knows of an NRC report that Qatar channels funding for a controversial Danish mosque via its Hague embassy, whether embassies should finance Islamic infrastructure, and whether other cases exist and the Qatari ambassador should be expelled. The minister answered that transparency rules on foreign religious funding are being drafted, that the embassy is also accredited to Denmark so the matter is bilateral, and referred to a separate letter.
The cabinet is therefore drawing up further rules on the transparency of financing flows.
Het kabinet stelt daarom nadere regels op over de transparantie van financieringsstromen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de bescherming van Nederlandse militairen tegen jihaddrones in Irak

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister whether Dutch soldiers in Iraq face risks from jihadist explosive-laden drones, how they are protected and why drone-detection procurement was postponed. The Minister confirmed a nearby drone attack, described limited detection capacity with an expansion planned for 2023, and said the project was delayed by one year due to competing needs.
For security reasons, no further information will be provided on this.
In verband met de veiligheid worden hierover verder geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Graus over de relatie tussen Taiwan en luchtvaartorganisatie ICAO

Two PVV MPs asked the government why Taiwan is excluded from ICAO while North Korea is a member, and whether the Netherlands will support Taiwan's permanent presence at ICAO meetings. The minister answered that only states can be members, that Taiwan gets ICAO information through indirect channels, and that the Netherlands will weigh participation case by case under the one-China policy without committing to permanent presence.
For future ICAO meetings, a case-by-case assessment will be made to determine whether some form of pragmatic cooperation with Taiwan is possible.
Voor toekomstige vergaderingen van de ICAO wordt per geval een afweging gemaakt om te bezien of enigerlei vorm van pragmatische samenwerking met Taiwan mogelijk is of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de onrust binnen het Korps Commandotroepen

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister about reported unrest and shortcomings in the Commando Troops (KCT), including unsafe training sites, equipment shortages and the need for drones. The minister denied that the KCT is not being heard, said safety measures were taken after a fatal training accident under investigation, referred the detailed equipment shortfall to a confidential letter, and said drone needs are being reviewed with an expansion expected in mid-2017.
Defence regards this as operationally sensitive information.
Defensie beschouwt dit als operationeel gevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op de vragen leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Knops over het wereldwijd toegenomen geweld tegen Joden

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a reported global rise in violence against Jews, including the Pew Research figures, its causes, the countries affected, Dutch funding of BDS-linked organisations, monitoring, and follow-up on a motion on antisemitism. The minister answered that the findings are concerning, that causes are complex and context-specific, that BDS activities are protected by free speech, and listed Dutch and EU initiatives against discrimination and antisemitism.
These findings from Pew Research are very concerning.
Deze bevindingen van Pew Research zijn zeer zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Turkse steun voor jihadi’s en een Turks verzoek om de inzet van  inlichtingendiensten voor de jacht op opponenten van Erdogan

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether a Turkish request for German intelligence help in hunting Erdogan opponents had reached Dutch services, whether Turkish support for jihadists was known to the AIVD and MIVD, and whether cooperation should end. The government said it cannot discuss concrete contacts with foreign services publicly, outlined its cooperation criteria, and declined to give details on the services' knowledge.
The government cannot publicly discuss concrete contacts between Dutch and foreign intelligence and security services.
De regering kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op concrete contacten tussen Nederlandse en buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, De Graaf en Wilders over het organiseren van een lezing die wordt gegeven door een terroristenknuffelaar

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the ministry hosted a lecture by John Esposito, whom they called an apologist for Saudi Arabia and Islamist groups, and what it costs and who was invited. The minister answered that Esposito cancelled his trip for family reasons, described the event as part of broader counter-radicalisation outreach, and said costs fall on the hosting organisations while invitees were experts from inside and outside government.
Unfortunately, for family reasons he had to cancel his trip to Europe.
Helaas heeft hij wegens familieomstandigheden zijn reis naar Europa moeten afzeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de aanschaf van nieuwe tanker/transportvliegtuigen

An MP asks the Defence Minister why Parliament was only informed on the day of contract signing about the costs of buying two MRTT tanker aircraft, why the partner countries withdrew, and why cost estimates vary widely. The Minister answers that the offer deadline forced quick signing, that Luxembourg (about 10 percent) is the remaining partner with options for others, that the cost range is given confidentially within the DMP framework, and declines to give exact prices for commercial confidentiality reasons.
On the day of contract signing, 28 July, I informed the House immediately by letter (Kamerstuk 27 830, no. 183).
Op de dag van de ondertekening van het contract, op 28 juli jl., heb ik de Kamer direct per brief (Kamerstuk 27 830, nr. 183 ) geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over de beperking van godsdienstvrijheid in islamitische landen

MPs Van der Staaij, De Roon and Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister about restrictions on religious freedom in Islamic countries, the US State Department findings, Dutch action, and Boko Haram's calls for violence against Christians. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described Dutch human rights support and multilateral efforts, and outlined counter-Boko Haram measures without providing precise casualty figures.
It is not possible to provide precise figures on the number of Christians and churches affected by violence in Islamic countries in the recent period.
Het is niet mogelijk om precieze cijfers te verstrekken van het aantal christenen en kerken dat in de afgelopen periode getroffen is door geweld in islamitische landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind c.s. over de bijdrage van Nederland aan politietrainingen op Papua

Dutch MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Dutch support for police training on Papua, including monitoring of Indonesian security forces, possible human rights abuses by trained officers, and the Community Policing Programme's design and evaluation. The minister answered that a mid-term evaluation shows gradual progress, that no guarantee can be given that trained officers did not commit abuses, and that embassy staff monitor the situation through dialogue with local actors.
No guarantee can be given that trained officers did not take part in violating human rights.
Er kan geen garantie worden gegeven dat getrainde agenten niet hebben deelgenomen aan het schenden van mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de situatie in Zuid-Soedan en de evacuatie van Nederlandse militairen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Defence about the security situation in Juba, South Sudan, the whereabouts and protection of six Dutch staff officers, UN peacekeeper casualties, and whether Dutch soldiers should be evacuated immediately. The answer refers the MP to a separate letter, 'Recente ontwikkelingen Zuid-Sudan', rather than answering the questions in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over aan Jordanië verkochte F-16’s

The MP De Roon asked how many F-16s the Netherlands sold to Jordan, whether they are operational, whether external inspections are possible, and whether they were resold to Pakistan. The government answered that 21 were sold (6 delivered), the six delivered are still in use, post-shipment controls are complex but the Dutch ambassador confirmed with Jordan that no resale to Pakistan will occur.
Post-shipment controls are a complex matter, because the Netherlands has no jurisdiction in the country of end use.
Controles na levering ( post shipment controls ) zijn een complexe zaak, omdat Nederland geen jurisdictie in het land van eindgebruik heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over de ‘etikettering van Israëlische producten’

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether an action by BDS supporters checking supermarket products for Israeli origin was antisemitic and whether the government would distance itself, and whether it would ignore the EU interpretative notice on labelling Israeli settlement products. The minister said consumers may freely investigate product origin, the government distances itself from any discriminatory or violent incidents, and the EU notice merely clarifies existing law which the NVWA enforces.
Consumers are generally free to investigate the origin of products, regardless of the effects intended.
Het staat consumenten in algemene zin vrij om onderzoek te doen naar de herkomst van producten, ongeacht welke effecten ermee worden beoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Dijkgraaf, Jasper van Dijk, Bruins, De Roon en Grashoff over de voorlopige toepassing van het vrijhandelsverdrag met Canada (CETA)

MPs asked whether Netherlands had an effective veto over provisional application of the Ukraine association agreement and would have one over provisional application of CETA, and requested legal advice on provisional application. The minister confirmed unanimity applied for the association agreement, said CETA's voting rule depends on the legal basis not yet determined, and stated the government knows of no written legal advice received on provisional application.
Whether decision-making on signature and provisional application of CETA will be by unanimity or qualified majority depends on the legal basis.
Of besluitvorming over ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing van CETA zal geschieden met unanimiteit of gekwalificeerde meerderheid is afhankelijk van de rechtsgrondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Jasper van Dijk, Dijkgraaf, Grashoff, De Roon, Jan Vos en Agnes Mulder over de voorlopige inwerkingtreding van het handelsakkoord tussen de EU en Canada (CETA)

Seven MPs asked the trade minister whether the Commission's plan to provisionally apply the EU-Canada CETA would be put to parliament, how the parliamentary reservation demanded by an earlier motion would be implemented, and whether CETA will be a mixed agreement. The minister answered that the Commissioner's commitment to consult the European Parliament is noted, that the government will formally register a parliamentary reservation in the Council once a proposal is tabled and inform the Tweede Kamer promptly, and that which parts would apply provisionally is not yet known.

If the Commission has submitted a proposal for a Council decision on signature and provisional application, the cabinet will formally implement the motion by stating in the Council that the Netherlands cannot agree to the proposal before it has been discussed with the House of Representatives.

Als de Commissie een voorstel heeft gedaan voor een Raadsbesluit voor ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing, zal het kabinet formeel uitvoering geven aan de motie door in de Raad kenbaar te maken dat Nederland niet kan instemmen met het voorstel voordat het voorstel is besproken met de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Voordewind en Knops over geweld tegen christenen door extremistische hindoes in India

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about attacks on Christians by extremist Hindus in India, including whether police intervened and what the government would do internationally. The minister acknowledged rising religiously motivated violence, said six suspects were arrested, and described diplomatic efforts on religious freedom without committing to new concrete steps.
The cabinet uses various opportunities to raise human rights, including freedom of religion and belief, with India.
Het kabinet maakt van verschillende mogelijkheden gebruik om mensenrechten – en daarbinnen vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging – in India aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Knops, De Roon, Van der Staaij en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Abbas confirms PA still paying terrorists’ salaries’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the shift of prisoner salary payments from the Palestinian Authority to the PLO is merely cosmetic, given EU and Dutch funding, and whether the Netherlands will object as Norway did. The minister replied that the Netherlands has no objection in principle to support for prisoners if transparent and proportionate, that the Dutch Pegase contribution does not fund prisoner payments and has robust verification, and that the government will keep raising the issue bilaterally.
The government has no insight into the total income or expenditure of the PLO.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzage in de totale inkomsten of uitgaven van de PLO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over ‘islamitische koekoeks-jongen bij de krijgsmacht’

De Roon (PVV) asks the Defence Minister how she views reports that 29 ex-German soldiers joined jihadist groups, whether Defence risks being misused as training for jihadists, how many (ex-)soldiers have gone to Syria/Iraq and are monitored, how many Islamic personnel have been removed, and whether dual nationals should be excluded from the armed forces. The Minister says intelligence services investigate such cases, declines to publish numbers of (ex-)soldiers who travelled to conflict zones, states that conduct rather than faith is central at Defence, and refers back to earlier answers on dual nationals without adding anything.
In the letter I sent to your House on 29 May 2015 on this matter, I concluded that this is not possible.
In de brief die ik op 29 mei 2015 hierover aan uw Kamer heb gezonden (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 311 ), kom ik tot de conclusie dat dit niet mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de ernstige schade aan het voortstuwingssysteem van Zr.Ms. Karel Doorman

The MP De Roon asks the Defence Minister about the choice of a diesel-electric propulsion configuration, whether 2006-2009 design cost cuts caused a motor defect, whether a deck or hull must be cut to replace the motor, who pays, whether such motors are designed to be replaceable, what warranty clauses apply and whether the Ebola deployment affects recovery of costs. The Minister answers that the cuts did not affect the motors, that the damaged motor was removed through a shaft in intermediate decks, that costs fall under the builder's warranty, that the contract cannot be published as it is commercially confidential, and that the Ebola mission does not affect the warranty claim.
The specific warranty provisions cannot be made public because they concern commercially confidential information.
De specifieke garantiebepalingen kunnen niet openbaar worden gemaakt omdat het om commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van De Roon de trage afhandeling van klachtbrieven door het ministerie van Defensie

An MP asked why the Defence Ministry has not sped up handling of complaint letters, which is costing large sums in penalty payments, and how many late decisions occurred over five years. The minister explained that late decisions stem from complex court rulings on staff allowances, that penalty payments totalled about 318,000 euros in 2015, and that accuracy takes priority over speed without committing to a concrete new measure.
The Ministry of Defence does what it can to make decisions within the statutory deadline.
Defensie doet wat zij kan om binnen de wettelijke termijn besluiten te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over illegale bouwactiviteiten in Judea en/of Samaria, gefinancierd door Nederland en/of de Europese Unie

MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch and EU aid funds building in area C of the West Bank without Israeli permits, and how much was spent including rebuilding demolished structures. The minister answered that such aid supports Palestinian communities under international law, that Israel has obligations as occupying power, reported EU spending of about 65 million euros in 2011-2015, and rejected the characterisation of this as wasteful.
How much money has the Netherlands and how much money has the European Union spent on this in the past five years?
Hoeveel geld heeft Nederland en hoeveel geld heeft de Europese Unie daaraan uitgegeven in de afgelopen vijf jaren?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over Nederlandse subsidies aan de Israëlische NGO Breaking the Silence

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and PVV asked whether Dutch subsidies to the Israeli NGO Breaking the Silence should be reconsidered after reports it collected classified IDF information, and how the government ensures subsidies are lawfully spent. The minister replied that no charges have been filed, that the government is concerned about NGO space in Israel, and that the Human Rights Secretariat has strict selection and monitoring procedures with no finding of breach so far.
However, no such finding has been made in the case of the Israeli NGO Breaking the Silence.
Van een dergelijke constatering is in het geval van de Israëlische NGO Breaking the Silence evenwel geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over lancering van raketten die kernwapens kunnen dragen door Iran

The MP asks the Foreign Minister how the government views Iran's March 2016 ballistic missile launches, which are capable of carrying nuclear weapons, and whether the Netherlands co-signed a letter from the US and other European states to the UN. The minister says the missiles likely fall under MTCR Category 1, that the tests are highly undesirable, and that the Netherlands was not a signatory but fully supports the letter's content.
The cabinet fully supports the content and purport of this letter.
Het kabinet steunt de inhoud en strekking van deze brief ten volle.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de Iraanse luchtvaartmaatschappij Mahan Air

An MP asked the ministers about US sanctions on Iranian airline Mahan Air, whether it operates in the Netherlands and links to Aviareps, and whether EU sanctions exist and why the airline should not be banned from the Netherlands. The minister replied that the US sanctions are a US sovereign matter, Mahan Air is not active in the Netherlands, Aviareps is a service provider, EU sanctions require unanimity and lacked support, and no action is needed since the airline is not active here.
Het instellen van sancties vergt unanimiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse kritiek op aanwezigheid van een Nederlandse diplomaat bij een strafproces tegen journalisten

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkish leaders' objections to Dutch diplomats attending a criminal trial of journalists reporting on alleged Turkish arms supplies to Syrian militants, and whether the Netherlands would continue sending diplomats and summon the Turkish ambassador. The minister confirmed the criticism, said diplomats routinely observe trials under the Vienna Convention, and stated that the Netherlands values this role and raised concerns with Turkish authorities, without announcing that it would summon the ambassador.
In a conversation with Turkish authorities in Ankara this was clearly pointed out, and surprise and criticism were also expressed about President Erdoğan's statements on this issue.
In een gesprek met Turkse autoriteiten in Ankara is hier duidelijk op gewezen, en is er ook verbazing en kritiek uitgesproken over de uitspraken van President Erdoğan over deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat er mogelijk honderden ontslagen vallen bij defensie

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Defence whether hundreds of dismissals were coming at the Defence Materiel Organisation, whether staff elsewhere should fear redundancy, how IT problems would be prevented from worsening, and what would be done about calls for voluntary-departure compensation. The Minister confirmed awareness, said ongoing reorganisations may create redundancy, stated IT renewal is underway, and said talks with public-sector unions on the 'knelpuntcategorie' instrument are ongoing.
Talks are being held with the public-sector union federations about possibly using the 'knelpuntcategorie' instrument for staff categories where redundancy will likely occur.
Met de centrales van overheidspersoneel wordt gesproken over de mogelijke inzet van het instrument «knelpuntcategorie» voor personeelscategorieën waarbij waarschijnlijk overtolligheid zal optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid De Roon over personeelstekorten bij de Koninklijke Marechaussee

An MP asked the Defence Minister about staff shortages at the Royal Marechaussee, including reallocation of personnel, deployment abroad and whether the force can still fulfil its core tasks amid migration and terrorism pressures. The minister replied that capacity has been reprioritised, extra staff are being recruited, about 50 marechaussees were deployed abroad in 2015, and the force can still perform its core tasks though capacity is tight.
Frequent consultation on this is held with the Ministry of Security and Justice.
Hierover wordt frequent overleg gevoerd met Veiligheid en Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Voordewind over financiering van veroordeelde terroristen door de Palestijnse Autoriteiten

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether reports that the Palestinian Authority funds convicted terrorists with foreign aid should change Dutch donor policy and how the government implements earlier motions calling for pressure on the PLO to stop such payments. The minister replied that the Israeli deputy minister's claims are her own, that the World Bank made no such finding, and that the government keeps raising the PLO's payment policy bilaterally and in the EU, where only one member state shares the concern.
The cabinet continues to raise the PLO's policy in bilateral talks with the PA and the PLO.
Het kabinet blijft het beleid van de PLO aankaarten in bilaterale gesprekken met de PA en de PLO.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Omtzigt, De Roon, Sjoerdsma en Bontes over het rondetafelgesprek van 22 januari 2016 over de beleidsreactie onderzoeksrapporten over MH17

MPs asked the government to reflect on the January 2016 round-table discussion on prosecution of the MH17 downing, including suggestions on a possible Dutch-Russian tribunal, the interpretation of article 552y of the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure, and victims' relatives' rights in proceedings. The government answered that it keeps both national and international prosecution options open pending the criminal investigation, acknowledges that article 552y should be amended (a bill is with the Council of State), and will consider the concerns raised about relatives' participation.
Should there be a need to speed up the legislative process with a view to possible prosecution of offences related to the downing of MH17, the available options will be used.

Mocht er met het oog op de eventuele berechting van misdrijven gerelateerd aan het neerhalen van MH17 behoefte zijn om het wetgevingsproces te versnellen zullen de beschikbare mogelijkheden daartoe aangegrepen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, De Roon, Van Bommel en Knops over de deelneming van Arabische landen aan de bombardementen tegen ISIS

MPs from D66, PVV, SP and CDA asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how many airstrikes against ISIS were carried out by Arab coalition partners (Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, UAE, Jordan) and when they last struck. The minister answered that the US publishes total coalition strike counts without a breakdown by partner, that Bahrain was omitted from earlier answers by mistake, and that the precise share of Arab partners' airstrikes is not disclosed publicly.
No public statements are made about the precise share (number of airstrikes) of Arab allies in the air campaign against ISIS.
Over het precieze aandeel (aantallen luchtaanvallen) van Arabische bondgenoten in de luchtcampagne in de strijd tegen ISIS worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Knops en De Roon over de ranglijst christenvervolging van Open Doors

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and PVV asked the Foreign Minister about Open Doors' 2016 ranking on Christian persecution, including rising killings, Dutch policy response, a proposed UN inquiry and ISIS treatment of minorities. The minister said the government shares serious concern, cites funding for religious freedom projects and EU/UN engagement, but opposes a UN inquiry focused on one group in favour of an inclusive approach.
The cabinet is however not in favour of a UN inquiry focused on one specific group.
Het kabinet is echter geen voorstander van een VN-onderzoek gericht op één specifieke groep.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon, Voordewind, Grashoff, Van der Staaij, Thieme, Bontes, Kuzu, Van Vliet, Krol, Klein en Houwers over de levensbedreigende situatie

MPs asked the ministers about the humanitarian siege of Madaya in Syria, where about 40,000 people face starvation, and whether the Netherlands would press for a ceasefire, humanitarian access and airdrops. The ministers confirmed the severity of the situation, described Dutch funding and diplomatic efforts through the UN and ICRC, and explained why airdrops are not considered feasible.
The Netherlands has for some time been pressing within the UN for a ceasefire so that humanitarian aid can be provided to the population.
Nederland dringt in VN-verband al geruime tijd aan op een staakt-het-vuren zodat humanitaire hulp geboden kan worden aan de bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel, Knops, De Roon en Voordewind over de deelname van Arabische landen aan de bombardementen tegen ISIS

MPs from five parties asked the Foreign Minister whether Arab coalition partners such as Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, the UAE and Jordan have stopped bombing ISIS, citing a US statement, and requested monthly strike figures per country. The government declined to confirm the claims or publish country-level data, citing operational classified information and the need to present the coalition as one entity, though it listed the participating countries and aggregate sortie figures and did not meet the requested deadline.
Information on who carried out which bombings and when is not shared publicly.
Informatie over wie wanneer welke bombardementen heeft uitgevoerd, wordt niet in het openbaar gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over het politieonderzoek naar professor Maat, dat de minister keer op keer op keer weigerde om openbaar te maken

MPs Omtzigt and others asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the police investigation into professor Maat's MH17 role was kept confidential and heavily redacted under the Wob, and whether the termination of his cooperation was justified. The minister answered that the file was made available to parliament confidentially under article 68 of the Constitution, that redactions protected officials' personal policy views and witness cooperation, and that he apologised to Maat for reacting too emotionally.
the file, including the witness statements, has been made available for confidential inspection by your House since 2 December 2015.
het dossier, waaronder de getuigenverklaringen, vanaf 2 december 2015 ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd in uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Intolerantie in Somalië en Brunei

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether the reported bans on Christmas celebrations for Muslims in Somalia and Brunei justify freezing Dutch ties, and whether Dutch military support in Somalia should end. Minister Koenders answered that Nederland keeps bilateral political and economic ties with both countries, raises human rights including freedom of religion and expression in dialogue, EU and UN fora, and will keep contributing to Somalia's reconstruction and EU training mission.
Within this relationship, human rights can be discussed in a constructive manner.
Binnen deze relatie kan op constructieve wijze over mensenrechten worden gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Voordewind en De Roon over resoluties bij de Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties

MPs asked the Foreign Minister why 19 or 20 of the UN General Assembly resolutions in the 70th session target Israel, how the Netherlands voted, whether the Golan resolution language is fair, and how the UN could better address states that violate international law. The minister replied that the Netherlands pushed for balance and proportionate wording, supported 15 of 19 resolutions in EU coordination, saw many actors responsible for the Golan conflict, and pointed to resolutions on other states and the UN Human Rights Council review.
The Netherlands works in several ways to ensure that countries violating international law are called to account by the UN General Assembly.
Nederland zet zich er op verschillende manieren voor in dat landen die het internationaal recht schenden daarop worden aangesproken door de AVVN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over het oplaaiend geweld van Palestijnen

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the surge of Palestinian violence, President Abbas's role and silence on attacks, and Palestinian media incitement before Abbas's visit. The minister condemned attacks on Israelis, attributed the violence to lack of political perspective and largely youth-driven, social-media-organised attacks beyond Abbas's control, and said de-escalation and the issue would be raised during the visit.
During the visit, the current violence and the need for de-escalation will be discussed extensively, and it will naturally be urged that a call to renounce violence be made.
Bij het bezoek zal uitgebreid worden stilgestaan bij het huidige geweld, en de noodzaak tot de-escalatie, waarbij vanzelfsprekend ook zal worden aangedrongen op een oproep tot afzien van geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over aanstelling van een Saoediër als voorzitter van VN mensenrechtenpanel

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands played any role in appointing a Saudi diplomat as chair of a UN human rights selection panel and whether the UN Human Rights Council's credibility is damaged, urging Saudi Arabia's removal. The minister answered that the Netherlands had no role, that the Saudi representative was nominated by his regional group and the panel elects its own chair, and that the Council remains an important forum where all states, including Saudi Arabia, can be called to account.
The Netherlands did not play a role in this appointment.
Nederland heeft geen rol gespeeld bij deze benoeming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat hoge militairen en beleidsambtenaren businessclass vliegen

MP De Roon asked the Defence Minister about reports that senior military and policy officials fly business class, including ticket numbers since 2010, the Marechaussee share, intra-European business class, policy versus other ministries, and possible savings. The minister confirmed roughly 1,000 to 1,300 business class tickets a year, explained that much of this relates to close protection by the BSB, said intra-European business class is restricted since 2010 but still formally in the legal position, and noted that formal restriction requires agreement with public-sector unions.
Since 2010, business class flying within Europe has been restricted for budgetary reasons. However, this has not yet been recorded in the legal position.
Sinds 2010 is het businessclass vliegen binnen Europa om budgettaire redenen ingeperkt. Dit is echter nog niet in de rechtspositie vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over beproeving van een Nederlander door Cypriotische autoriteiten

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch national prevented from leaving Cyprus by Cypriot authorities and whether the government would act to end this. The minister confirmed awareness, said the embassy provides consular assistance and monitors the case, and stated the Dutch government does not intervene in another country's judicial process.
In that regard, under international agreements the Dutch government does not intervene in the legal process of another country.
Daarbij geldt dat de Nederlandse overheid op grond van internationale afspraken niet in de rechtsgang van een ander land treedt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over Saoediers hielden Wilders nauwgezet in de gaten

PVV MPs Wilders and De Roon asked whether Dutch authorities knew Saudi Arabia planned a lawsuit against Geert Wilders, whether the OIC and the Saudi crown prince were involved, and whether the ambassador disavowed Wilders' statements, and asked the government to break diplomatic ties. The minister declined to comment on substance because the reporting relied on allegedly confidential WikiLeaks documents, referred back to that answer for the other questions, and rejected breaking diplomatic relations.
The cabinet does not respond substantively to questions about reporting based on allegedly confidential documents published via WikiLeaks.
Het kabinet reageert niet inhoudelijk op vragen over berichtgeving die is gebaseerd op vermeende vertrouwelijke documenten welke zijn gepubliceerd via Wikileaks.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Roon over Chinese kruizen-furie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch government would condemn the Chinese demolition of church crosses in Zhejiang, seek explanation of the legal grounds and remedies, and avoid Dutch representation at the 3 September military parade. The minister acknowledged the demolitions, attributed them to a campaign against illegal buildings, called for respect for religious freedom through EU channels, and referred to earlier answers on the parade.
The Dutch government asks the Chinese authorities, partly within the EU framework, to respect human rights, including freedom of religion and conviction.
De Nederlandse regering vraagt de Chinese autoriteiten, mede in EU verband, om mensenrechten, waaronder vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging, te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over tekortkomingen van de Joint Strike Fighter (JSF) ten opzichte van potentiële tegenstanders

An MP asks the Defence Minister whether the F-35 fighter is inferior to potential adversaries in manoeuvrability, payload, range, stealth and whether it can be detected, and whether the Netherlands bought a pig in a poke. The minister rejects the critical conclusions, saying the aircraft's capabilities are sufficient, stealth reduces detection risk, and the F-35 is continuously upgraded.
No. The Netherlands chose the F-35 because this aircraft has the best capabilities from a military-operational perspective and is future-proof.
Nee. Nederland heeft voor de F-35 gekozen omdat dit toestel in militair-operationeel perspectief over de beste capaciteiten beschikt en toekomstbestendig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over satellietcommunicatie bij de krijgsmacht en de beveiliging daarvan

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether the armed forces use the Globalstar satellite system, which was reported as easy to hack, and how dependent Defence is on commercial satellite communications and whether there is a capacity shortage. The minister answered that Defence does not use Globalstar, plans to move to a 60% military and 40% commercial split from 2016 with the WGS system, and states there is no capacity shortage.
No, Defence does not use the Globalstar satellite system.
Nee, Defensie maakt geen gebruik van het Globalstar-satellietsysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over deelname van Nederlandse bewindslieden aan de herdenking van de Tweede Wereldoorlog in China

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch ministers would attend China's WWII commemoration parade in Beijing, given the Tiananmen associations and China's stance in the South China Sea. The minister answered that the government intends to send Minister of State Tjeenk Willink, citing shared wartime experience, reconciliation and the level of other countries' representation.
On the basis of that consideration, the cabinet intends to have the Netherlands represented by Minister of State Tjeenk Willink.
Op basis van die afweging is het kabinet voornemens Nederland te laten vertegenwoordigen door Minister van Staat Tjeenk Willink.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Kamervragen over Turkije als de grote gedoger en vriendelijke buur van Islamitische Staat

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether Turkey tolerates jihadists crossing its border to Syria and Iraq and whether Dutch Patriot missiles facilitated this, and asks why captured IS fighters are released quickly. The ministers answer that Turkey is tightening border controls, is active in the anti-ISIS coalition, and that the Patriots were a NATO defence deployment that did not facilitate jihadist transit.
No. The Dutch Patriot missiles were in Turkey until early this year under NATO command to protect the civilian population and territory of a NATO ally.
Nee. De Nederlandse Patriotraketten stonden tot begin dit jaar in NAVO-verband in Turkije om de burgerbevolking en het grondgebied van een NAVO-bondgenoot te beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse bombardementen op Koerdische stellingen in Noord-Irak

An MP asked the government whether Turkish airstrikes on Kurdish positions in northern Iraq are heavier than strikes on IS, whether NATO allies backed them and whether they fall under self-defence, and whether NATO support amounts to a blank cheque. The ministers confirmed the strikes, said they lack precise figures, stated that Turkey claims they target the PKK in response to attacks and that proportionality and de-escalation are required, and declined to take action on NATO membership.
The cabinet does not have the precise figures on the number or intensity of the attacks.
Het kabinet heeft niet de beschikking over de precieze cijfers met betrekking tot de aantallen dan wel de intensiteit van de aanvallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bewijs dat Turkije een nauwe band onderhield met Islamitische Staat

An MP asked the government whether seized IS data proves close ties between Turkey and Islamic State, and whether Turkey should be removed from NATO. The ministers replied that the Netherlands cannot confirm Turkish support for jihadist groups, that the findings will likely not be made public, and that Turkey is active in the anti-ISIS coalition.
