It is not likely that information on this will be made public or can be made public.
Het is niet waarschijnlijk dat informatie hierover openbaar gemaakt wordt of kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over toelating van een Hamas-mantelorganisatie tot de Economische en Sociale Raad (ECOSOC) van de Verenigde Naties

An MP asked the Foreign Minister what the government would do to prevent the Hamas-linked Palestinian Return Centre from obtaining consultative status at ECOSOC, whether it knows Sudan supported this, and whether Netherlands would distance itself from ECOSOC if admitted. The minister replied that the Netherlands is not an ECOSOC member and cannot vote, that the EU coordinated a common position, and that consultative status does not imply cooperation.
The Netherlands is not a member of ECOSOC and therefore has no voting right.
Nederland is geen lid van de ECOSOC en geniet zodoende geen stemrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de selectieve aandacht van VN-organisatie UNICEF voor vrouwenbesnijdenis

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether UNICEF's data on female genital mutilation underrepresents the Middle East and Indonesia/Malaysia and whether it is a 'Muslim problem'. The minister answered that UNICEF will update its data, that Indonesia has since been added, that religious leaders are engaged, and that the practice is a human rights violation to be addressed in all countries.
I urge UNICEF and other UN organisations to collect data in all countries where female genital mutilation occurs (possibly) and to report on it.
Ik dring er bij UNICEF en andere VN-organisaties op aan gegevens te verzamelen in alle landen waar vrouwenbesnijdenis (mogelijk) voorkomt en hierover te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Bosma over noodhulp aan Christelijke vluchtelingen in Noord-Irak en Syrië

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether Christian refugees from ISIS are being left last in line for emergency aid and whether Dutch aid reaches them. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, acknowledged food shortages from funding gaps, and stated that aid is allocated by need without discrimination by religion, while promising to press aid organisations to act if any discrimination is found.
I have no basis to assume that the claim by the CEO of Open Doors is correct, that Christian refugees would be disadvantaged when it comes to receiving humanitarian aid.
Ik heb geen basis om aan te nemen dat de bewering van de CEO van Open Doors juist is dat Christelijke vluchtelingen achtergesteld zouden worden wanneer het gaat om het ontvangen van humanitaire hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het gebrek aan persvrijheid in Papua

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about press freedom in Papua, including military monitoring of journalists, visa restrictions and whether the government had pressed for opening Papua to the press. The minister replied that press freedom in Indonesia is generally high, that the announced easing of rules for foreign journalists is encouraging and is being implemented, and that Nederland has raised the issue repeatedly and will monitor implementation.
The practice whereby journalists cannot obtain visas for Papua and their activities are closely monitored should therefore become a thing of the past.
De praktijk dat journalisten geen visa kunnen krijgen voor Papua en dat hun activiteiten nauwlettend worden gemonitord, zou dan ook tot het verleden moeten gaan behoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over een in 2004 verhinderde aanslag

Two PVV MPs asked whether reports that the Netherlands escaped an attack in 2004 were correct, whether two men filming the Israeli embassy were prosecuted, their nationality, and whether they were handed to Israeli authorities. The Minister answered that the attack claim cannot be confirmed, that four men were arrested but prosecution for preparing an attack failed for lack of evidence, that two were convicted on lesser charges (one later acquitted on appeal), that one man of Saudi nationality was expelled, that the nationality of the others cannot be established, and that there was no reason to hand them over to Israel.
The criminal investigation did not, however, lead to prosecution for preparing an attack, because insufficient evidence was found for that.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek heeft evenwel niet geleid tot een vervolging ter zake van het voorbereiden van een aanslag, omdat daartoe onvoldoende bewijs werd gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het blokkeren van Russische grondaankopen in de buurt van militaire terreinen

MP De Roon asked the Defence Minister whether Russian land purchases near military sites, which Finland is moving to block, occur in the Netherlands and whether the government can block them. The minister answered that no comparable cases are known, that the MIVD monitors espionage and undue influence without detailing activities, and that the government has no legal power to block private property transactions.
The government has no legal possibilities to block such transactions.
De overheid heeft geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om dergelijke transacties te blokkeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over investeren in China’s landjepik in de Zuid-Chinese zee

An MP asked whether investment opportunities offered by Chinese state firm CCCC in South China Sea island-reclamation projects are lawful, what risks investors face, and whether the government will block such investments. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands takes no position on territorial claims and leaves assessment to international law, left investment risk to investors, and offered no measures beyond referring to the earlier answer.
The Netherlands takes no position on the territorial claims in the South China Sea, but advocates peaceful settlement of disputes in accordance with international law.
Nederland neemt geen positie in over de territoriale claims in de Zuid-Chinese zee, maar pleit voor vreedzame beslechting van geschillen in overeenstemming met internationaal recht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over het bericht dat godsdienstige minderheden in India steeds meer in de knel komen

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and De Roon asked whether attacks on religious minorities in India are rising, particularly against Christians, and what Indian authorities and the Dutch government are doing about it. The minister answered that USCIRF reports rising religious violence while official Indian figures show a drop in communal incidents, that Indian leaders have condemned such violence and arrests were made, and that the Netherlands raises religious freedom through EU and UN channels and funds local dialogue projects.
Freedom of religion and belief is a priority of the Dutch human rights policy.
Vrijheid van godsdienst en levensovertuiging is een prioriteit van het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de oproep van de Turkse president Erdogan tot de verovering van Jeruzalem

MP De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister how the government views President Erdogan's call to conquer Jerusalem and whether this changes Dutch policy toward Turkey. The minister answered that such statements do not fit a country committed to European values, noted remaining rule-of-law concerns in Turkey, and said the government keeps its existing Turkey policy.
The cabinet therefore continues to choose the same policy toward Turkey, with a credible EU accession process that adheres to strict accession conditions.
Het kabinet blijft daarom kiezen voor hetzelfde beleid ten opzichte van Turkije, met een geloofwaardig EU-toetredingsproces dat vasthoudt aan strenge toetredingsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het dreigende zwarte gat in de informatievoorziening die de Nederlandse militairen moet behoeden voor aanslagen van ISIS

The MP De Roon asked whether US intelligence refusal to share technology, linked to the German NSA dispute, leaves Dutch troops in Iraq exposed to ISIS attacks, and about threat levels, dependence on US intelligence, the fall of Ramadi and force protection. The Minister declined to comment on the reported US-German intelligence cooperation and on operational intelligence ties, said the threat level for Dutch and German troops is the same, and gave only general statements on force protection, citing security.
The Dutch government never makes public statements about operational cooperation with foreign intelligence and security services.
De Nederlandse regering doet in het openbaar nooit uitspraken over operationele samenwerking met buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Roon over veiligheid van scheepvaart op de Middellandse Zee

MP De Roon asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about the attack on a Turkish-flagged merchant ship off Libya and what measures will protect Dutch merchant vessels, including the threat picture and armed guards policy. Minister Koenders answered that the government lacks its own information on the attack, that shipowners bear responsibility for security with government sharing relevant information, that no separate threat assessment exists, and that the armed guards policy will be sent to parliament before the summer recess, though answers could not be given by 1 June.
The cabinet does not have its own information about the circumstances of this attack.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigen informatie over de toedracht van deze aanval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de gevolgen van het noodlottige ongeval met een Apache gevechtshelikopter in Mali

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether Dutch Apache helicopters were grounded for nearly two months after a fatal crash in Mali, what that meant for troop safety and pilot training, how Boeing was involved in the investigation, whether Boeing would bear repair, replacement and compensation costs, and how the families were compensated. The minister confirmed the grounding, said alternative protection measures were used and the helicopters were operational again from 14 May, admitted a training backlog, and explained that Defence does not contractually hold manufacturers liable for technical causes during use under the Foreign Military Sales framework, with no direct replacement planned.
In general, Defence does not cover the risks of accidents during the use phase with contractual clauses that hold the manufacturer liable in case of technical causes.
In het algemeen dekt Defensie de risico's van ongevallen gedurende de gebruiksfase niet af met contractuele clausules die de fabrikant aansprakelijk stellen in geval van technische oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Bosma over Cyberdreiging vanuit Iran

Two MPs asked the ministers about a rise in Iranian cyberattacks on the West that exploit Western IT systems, and whether sanctions are failing to prevent Iranian access to such systems. The government answered that Dutch sanctions target Iran's nuclear programme rather than internet services in general, that providers bear responsibility for their customers, and that new cyber-specific sanctions are not currently under consideration.
The cabinet is of the view that the existing sanctions instruments are flexible enough to address cyber threats where desired.
Het kabinet is van mening dat het bestaande sanctie-instrumentarium flexibel genoeg is om desgewenst ook cyberdreigingen te kunnen ondervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de Iraanse dreiging voor scheepvaart in de Straat van Hormuz

Mr De Roon (PVV) asked whether the government agrees that Iran's seizure of a merchant ship in the Strait of Hormuz is an act of aggression, and about the safety of Dutch-flagged ships there. The government shares US concern that the seizure was unlawful, sees no current threat from Iran to Dutch-flagged or Dutch-crewed shipping, and reports no relevant incidents or shipowner requests.
The Netherlands shares the concerns of the US about this.
Nederland deelt de zorgen hierover van de VS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Iraanse dreiging voor scheepvaart in de Straat van Hormuz

MP De Roon asked whether the government would request, as the UK had, US naval escorts for Dutch merchant ships through the Strait of Hormuz. The ministers confirmed the British escorts and answered that no Dutch shipping firm had requested protection, so there was currently no reason to make such a request.
No requests from Dutch shipping companies regarding protection in the Strait of Hormuz have been received.
Er zijn geen verzoeken van Nederlandse reders ontvangen omtrent bescherming in de Straat van Hormuz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de gewelddadige arrestatie van twee journalisten in Papua

Mr De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister about the violent arrest of two journalists in Papua and whether Indonesia would be asked to clarify it, and about the situation of the Papuan population. The minister said press freedom in Indonesia is generally large but concern remains in Papua, that the Netherlands raises it regularly, and that the situation is part of the structural dialogue with Indonesia and the EU human rights dialogue.
In Papua and West Papua, however, the treatment of local journalists remains a point of concern, as the arrest of these two journalists shows.
In Papua en West-Papua blijft de omgang met lokale journalisten echter een punt van zorg, zoals blijkt uit de arrestatie van deze twee journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat Turkije lonkt naar een Russisch systeem voor luchtafweerraketten

The MP De Roon asked whether Turkey is reconsidering Russian S-300 air defence systems, whether Turkey still considers a Chinese system incompatible with NATO missile defence, and whether Turkey is distancing itself from NATO. The government replied that no concrete Turkish interest in the S-300 can be confirmed, that no decision timeline is known, that NATO allies have raised interoperability concerns, and that Article 5 is not in question.
It is not known when Turkey will decide on the purchase.
Het is niet bekend wanneer Turkije een besluit over de aanschaf zal nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over de kille wijze waarop een Nederlandse Holocaust overlevende is gekort op haar AOW-uitkering

PVV MPs asked why a Dutch Holocaust survivor living in the West Bank had her AOW pension cut by about 35 percent, whether all residents of Israeli settlements in occupied territories face such cuts, how many are affected, and whether the government will act against it. The government regretted the handling, said the affected survivor's situation was corrected, and decided that current single AOW recipients in occupied territory keep their benefit while new single recipients from 2016 get the 50 percent married-couple norm; it declined to change the treaty or contact Israeli counterparts.
The cabinet regrets how matters unfolded; for the person concerned the situation has now been adjusted and she has been informed of this.
Het kabinet betreurt de gang van zaken Voor betrokkene is de situatie nu aangepast en zij is daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vuijk, Teeven en De Roon over het project Data Communicatie Mobiel Optreden Long Range Communications (DCMO-LRC)

MPs Vuijk, Teeven and De Roon asked the Defence Minister about the DCMO-LRC communications project, its status, purpose, reliability in worst-case scenarios and lessons learned. The minister answered that the project is in its realisation phase due for completion in 2015, that LRC extends communication beyond VHF radio range, and that Defence uses a mix of transmission means, with the business partner FoxIT developing the basic module.
LRC is in the realisation phase.
LRC bevindt zich in de realisatiefase.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over risico’s van steunverlening aan Syrische strijdgroepen

An PVV MP asked the Foreign Minister which Syrian armed groups the Netherlands supports, how 'moderate' is determined, how aid is delivered and whether Dutch aid could fall into jihadist hands. The minister declined to name supported groups, partners or delivery organisations for security reasons, while stating that only carefully vetted groups qualify and that Dutch nationals joining armed groups can still be prosecuted.
In the interest of the safety of the parties involved in Dutch support, the cabinet makes no statements about the groups to which support is being considered.
In het belang van de veiligheid van de bij de Nederlandse steun betrokken partijen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken over de groepen waaraan steun wordt overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bewapenen van Afghaanse milities

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch-backed or US-backed Afghan militias, feared more than the Taliban, were being armed and whether the Netherlands had contributed to sponsoring them. The minister answered that the Afghan Local Police is an integral part of the ANSF under the Afghan Interior Ministry, that militia support is not part of Dutch policy or the Resolute Support exit strategy, and that the Netherlands may have indirectly contributed through support to the Afghan government in the early years.
The financing of militias, direct or indirect, has never been part of Dutch policy in Afghanistan.
De financiering van milities, direct of indirect, is nooit onderdeel geweest van het Nederlandse beleid in Afghanistan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Sponsoring conferentie Chatham House

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether the ministry sponsored a Muslim Brotherhood-linked congress, what it cost, and why the taxpayer should fund it. The minister denied it was a Muslim Brotherhood event, explained a 10,000 GBP contribution to a Chatham House Middle East conference, and refused to repay the money.
The Netherlands made a contribution of 10,000 British pounds to an activity of the Middle East and North Africa department of the renowned and independent British think tank Chatham House
Nederland heeft een bijdrage van 10.000 Britse Pond geleverd aan een activiteit van de afdeling Midden-Oosten en Noord-Afrika van de gerenommeerde en onafhankelijke Britse denktank Chatham House
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Roon over het bericht dat de Nederlandse ambassade in Zuid-Afrika anti-blanke quota’s promoot

PVV MPs Bosma and De Roon asked whether the Dutch embassy in South Africa promoting a helpdesk on Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment amounts to promoting anti-white quotas, and whether embassies should promote such laws. The minister answered that the helpdesk helps Dutch firms navigate an existing legal reality, that she did not know the cited research, and that embassies do not promote racial laws.
The helpdesk was set up to assist Dutch entrepreneurs in dealing with the BBBEE rules in order to increase their opportunities on the South African market.
De helpdesk is opgezet om Nederlandse ondernemers te assisteren bij het omgaan met de regels voor BBBEE om zo hun kansen op de Zuid-Afrikaanse markt te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Servaes, Van der Staaij, Sjoerdsma en De Roon over het nucleair akkoord met Iran

Five MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the framework nuclear deal with Iran, covering its assessment, the timing of sanctions relief, regional effects, human rights, EU and Dutch contributions, and prospects before the 30 June deadline. The minister welcomed the framework, said sanctions relief will be tied to Iranian steps and reinstated if Iran breaches the deal, and answered several questions only in general terms while leaving the concrete sequencing and any full assessment for later.
The cabinet will send a written response on the various aspects of the comprehensive agreement to the House once it is definitively concluded.
Het kabinet zal een schriftelijke reactie op de verschillende deelaspecten van het alomvattend akkoord naar de Kamer sturen als dit definitief is gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Roon over het bericht "Remove Paul Kruger statue within 7 days, or else: EFF"

PVV MPs Bosma and De Roon asked about an EFF ultimatum to remove the Paul Kruger statue in South Africa, including whether the Dutch embassy would act to protect it and whether the Culture Minister would seek UNESCO listing. The government answered that the matter is internal to South Africa, that the embassy has taken no action since no Dutch persons or property are involved, and that South African authorities decide on heritage and on responding to the EFF.
This concerns an internal South African matter in which no Dutch persons or property are involved.
Het betreft hier een interne Zuid-Afrikaanse zaak waarbij geen Nederlandse personen of bezittingen betrokken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over minder criminaliteit door militairen op straat

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government would deploy soldiers in the Netherlands to tackle crime at hotspots, after a Belgian report of reduced crime where soldiers patrol. The minister replied that the National Police is adequately equipped, but civilian authorities can request military assistance in specific situations.
The National Police is generally adequately equipped to tackle and combat crime, including at places referred to as hotspots.
De Nationale Politie is in het algemeen voldoende toegerust om criminaliteit aan te pakken en te bestrijden, ook op plaatsen waar aan wordt gerefereerd met de term «hot spots».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over door Iran gesteunde milities die de Iraakse bevolking terroriseren

An MP asks the Foreign Minister about Iran-backed Shiite militias allegedly terrorising Iraqi civilians, including reports of village destruction and displacement, and whether Dutch bombing helps these militias. The minister acknowledges the reports as serious, says Iraq must bring militias under state control (e.g. a National Guard), and states that Dutch raised concerns with Iraqi authorities but has no known role in sponsoring militias.
The Netherlands is also putting this issue on the Brussels agenda by advocating that the same message be conveyed to the Iraqi authorities and by urging reforms in the security sector.

Nederland zet deze kwestie eveneens op de Brusselse agenda door te pleiten voor het overbrengen van dezelfde boodschap aan de Iraakse autoriteiten en aan te dringen op hervormingen in de veiligheidssector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over islamitische militairen die door loyaliteitsproblemen niet geschikt zijn voor de Nederlandse krijgsmacht

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister about Islamic military personnel with alleged loyalty problems, questioning the choice of a commissioned study on religious chaplaincy, the number of Muslim soldiers and dual-nationality recruitment, and asking for ex-soldiers who joined jihadist groups and a recruitment campaign. The Minister rejected the premise that Muslim soldiers cannot be distinguished, stated that Defence does not register religious belief, cited a study finding about 1,600 soldiers with other non-Christian beliefs, refused to restrict dual nationals or launch the proposed campaign, and referred back to earlier answers on ex-soldiers.
Defence does not register the religious beliefs of its employees.
Defensie registreert de geloofsovertuiging van haar medewerkers niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over mogelijke aanwezigheid van Nederlandse bewindslieden bij de herdenking van de Tweede Wereldoorlog in China

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch ministers would attend China's September 2015 WWII commemoration parade, whether it serves to showcase military strength and frame Japan as aggressor, and what the policy is on attending such ceremonies. The minister answered that the Dutch armed forces have been invited, that the government has not yet decided on attendance or level, that the focus should be reconciliation, and that each attendance decision is weighed separately.
The cabinet is still considering whether, and if so at what level, to take part in the gathering in China on 3 September.
Het kabinet heeft nog in overweging of en zo ja, op welk niveau deelgenomen wordt aan de bijeenkomst in China op 3 september.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht 'recordbedrag aan buitenlandse investeringen'.

An MP from the PVV asked the minister whether the record foreign investment figures were inflated by one wind park investment costing taxpayers billions in subsidy, and whether foreign investment created fewer jobs and more closures in 2014. The government answered that NFIA support cost about 13 million euro, that the Gemini wind park is half the total, that jobs rose on the 2013 figures except for one year, and that net job effects of foreign investors are positive, while it does not know the revenue lost from closures.
It is not known what revenue the Netherlands has missed as a result.
Het is niet bekend welke inkomsten Nederland hiermee is misgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de eis “affiniteit met islam” in een wervingsadvertentie

An MP from PVV asked the Foreign Minister why an internship advertisement at the Dutch embassy in Sudan required 'affinity with Islam' and asked for its immediate withdrawal. The minister answered that it reflects professional interest in local religion and culture, that the embassy has a good record supporting women, LGBT people and dissidents, and that the profile is within normal criteria, so no change was promised.
As described above, I consider this profile to fall within the normal criteria for the qualifications desirable for this specific internship.
Als bovenbeschreven acht ik deze profielschets binnen de normale criteria van de voor deze specifieke stage wenselijke benodigdheden passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over beschimmelde marine kazerne

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister whether reports of mould in the Erfprins barracks in Den Helder were accurate, why the problem was not fixed earlier, and what would be done to improve sailors' housing. The minister answered that mould was found but posed no health risk, that a full renovation is planned for 2018 due to budget and logistical constraints, and that interim measures and quarterly checks are in place.
After implementation of the above measures, inspection takes place every three months and the measures are repeated where necessary.
Na uitvoering van bovenstaande maatregelen vindt elke drie maanden controle plaats en indien nodig worden de maatregelen opnieuw uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de aanwezigheid van een commandant van Islamitische Staat in Turkije

De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister whether a senior Islamic State commander receiving medical care in Turkey had been arrested for genocide, war crimes or other offences, and what the Netherlands would do to have him prosecuted. Minister Koenders answered that Turkish authorities report an ongoing legal investigation into an alleged ISIS member receiving treatment in Denizli, with no completion date known.
The Turkish authorities have indicated that a legal investigation is ongoing into an alleged ISIS member receiving medical care in Denizli in Turkey.
De Turkse autoriteiten hebben laten weten dat een juridisch onderzoek loopt naar een vermeend lid van ISIS dat medische verzorging krijgt in Denizli in Turkije.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt, Bontes, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het vermeende ongemak van politie en Openbaar Ministerie over de rol van de AIVD bij het onderzoek naar de ramp

MPs asked whether the AIVD is obstructing the MH17 investigation by withholding information from police and prosecutors, and whether ministers have signals of friction and will meet the organisations. The ministers reject the claim, say cooperation is good, report frequent ministerial and ministerial-commission contact, and decline further talks as unnecessary.
In response to the report "AIVD frustrates MH17 investigation", the cabinet strongly denies that the AIVD is withholding information in the investigation into the MH17 air disaster.
In reactie op het bericht «AIVD frustreert MH17-onderzoek» weerspreekt het kabinet met klem dat in het onderzoek naar de vliegramp met de MH17 door de AIVD informatie wordt achtergehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de stop op Duitse wapenexport naar Saoedi-Arabië

De Roon (PVV) asked whether Germany had halted arms exports to Saudi Arabia, on what grounds, whether the Netherlands was informed, and whether the Netherlands would also stop exports. Minister Koenders replied that media reports of a German halt were incorrect, that Dutch and German case-by-case assessments continue, and that the government opposes a unilateral total stop.
The cabinet is not in favour of a全 general stop on arms exports to Saudi Arabia.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander van een algehele stop op wapenexport naar Saudi-Arabië.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Bontes, De Roon, Thieme en Van Ojik over de tussenrapportages van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) onderzoeken

MPs asked whether the Safety Board (OVV) runs three MH17 investigations, whether interim reports were published, and under which ICAO Annex 13 reporting obligations. The minister confirmed three investigations, that only the cause investigation has a published preliminary report, and that the other two have no interim reports.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat veel geheimen van de JSF in Chinese handen zijn

De Roon (PVV) asked the Defence Minister whether the Netherlands and the Five Eyes were informed of serious damage to the JSF programme after reports that many JSF secrets had fallen into Chinese hands, and asked for details of the leak, what was stolen, and countermeasures. The minister replied that the JPO says no classified information was stolen, that serious damage is not the case, and that further details and specific countermeasures cannot be shared for security reasons.
For security reasons, the JPO does not provide further details.
Het JPO verstrekt om veiligheidsredenen geen nadere details.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat er enkele doden zijn gevallen bij een aanslag op een VN-konvooi nabij de luchthaven van Somalië

MP De Roon asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about a deadly attack on a UN convoy near Mogadishu airport, the safety of Dutch EUTM Somalia personnel, the security threat in Mogadishu, Al-Shabaab's strength, Kenya's role, and whether the Dutch training contribution should be withdrawn. The ministers answered that no Dutch personnel were present at the convoy, the mission remains in Mogadishu with security measures, and they will not end the Dutch contribution, while declining to engage on religious questions.
There were no Dutch nationals present with the UN convoy when the attack was carried out.
Er waren geen Nederlanders aanwezig bij het VN-konvooi toen de aanslag werd gepleegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over de transactie met militairen, verdacht van verduistering

PVV MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers why a settlement offer over alleged embezzlement by soldiers in Kunduz was made on embezzlement in a group rather than in a service relationship, and whether the suspects were Marechaussee members subject to dismissal. The Defence minister answered that the settlement was based on the suspicion of embezzlement committed in association, that the suspects were not Marechaussee members, and gave no further explanation of the omitted aggravating element.
Answer 2 See the answer to question 1.
Antwoord 2 Zie het antwoord op vraag 1.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Servaes, Ten Broeke over doodschieten van Papoea's door de Indonesische politie

Seven MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about reports that Indonesian police or soldiers shot dead five Papuans during a protest, and what the Netherlands would do. The Minister said the government deeply regrets the deaths, that Indonesia has launched an inquiry, that he will raise it with his counterpart, and that the Netherlands supports community policing and human rights training in Papua.
The Indonesian authorities immediately launched an investigation into the circumstances.
De Indonesische autoriteiten hebben direct een onderzoek naar de toedracht ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie tegen de plaatsing van het Armeens herdenkingsmonument

MPs asked the government about a demonstration against an Armenian genocide memorial in Almelo, alleged Turkish state involvement, verification of claims, and whether the government will take a clearer stance on the commemoration. The government answered that there was no direct Turkish state involvement in the demonstration, that it has raised the matter with Turkish authorities, that it does not keep lists of all contacts, and that it sees no need for special research, while declining to say when the prosecutor will decide on the complaints.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed the Ministry of Security and Justice that it cannot currently give certainty about when the assessment of the complaint will be completed.
Het openbaar ministerie heeft het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie meegedeeld dat het nu geen uitsluitsel kan geven over het moment waarop de beoordeling van de aangifte zal zijn afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over aantijgingen van de Turkse racismebeschuldiging

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey's accusations of Dutch racism and aggression were justified, whether the Turkish ambassador should be summoned, and whether the Patriot missiles should be withdrawn early. The minister replied that he had raised the remarks with the ambassador and Turkish counterpart, that Turkey denied accusing the Dutch state or people, and that the Patriots stay in place as NATO protection.
I see no reason to deny our NATO ally this protection of our Patriots and to withdraw these systems earlier than announced.
Ik zie geen reden om onze NAVO-bondgenoot deze bescherming van onze patriots te ontzeggen en deze systemen eerder dan aangekondigd terug te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over taartverbod in Saoedi-Arabië

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest in Saudi Arabia of bakery staff over cupcakes with text critical of Islam, and whether the Netherlands would act for their release and suggest an ambassador present a cake to the King. The minister confirmed the arrests and that the case is ongoing, said the Netherlands values free expression and raises it with Saudi authorities, and called the cake suggestion poor taste.
The Netherlands attaches great importance to freedom of expression and advocates it worldwide.
Nederland hecht groot belang aan de vrijheid van meningsuiting en bepleit dit wereldwijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Roon en Bosma over optreden van oproerpolitie in het parlement van Zuid-Afrika

Members De Roon and Bosma (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister whether South African riot police used force against opposition MPs in parliament and whether it was justified. The minister confirmed police were called to remove an EFF member from the chamber under South African rules, said it is not for the Dutch cabinet to judge the decision, and stated that the South African parliament itself should judge the matter.
It is not for the cabinet to assess whether the decision to do so was justified in this case.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te beoordelen of het besluit hiertoe in dit geval gerechtvaardigd was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over monddood maken van advocaten door Saoedi-Arabië

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the sentencing of three Saudi human rights lawyers to prison terms and media and travel bans over tweets, and whether this violates freedom of expression. The minister confirmed the case, said the convictions were for insulting the judiciary and Sharia and undermining public order via social media, that free expression remains a concern raised with Saudi Arabia and EU partners, and that the lawyers can still appeal.
The Netherlands is also in close contact with EU partners about this specific case.
Nederland staat daarnaast in nauw contact met EU-partners over deze specifieke zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Thieme en Van Klaveren over Beschuldiging van Turkse wapenleveranties aan terroristische organisaties

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about allegations that Turkey supplied arms to jihadist groups including IS, and about reports of recruitment centres and a prisoner swap. The minister said the government could not confirm the allegations, relied on Turkey's denials and its IS listing, and declined to seek clarification from Turkey or back an independent international inquiry.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, as is the House, but, as indicated in earlier answers to parliamentary questions, cannot confirm them.
Het kabinet is net als de Kamer op de hoogte van deze berichten, maar kan, zoals ook in eerdere antwoorden op Kamervragen aangegeven, deze niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht dat ISIS beschikt over chemische wapens

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that ISIS possesses chemical weapons, including outdated Iraqi stocks, alleged chemical attacks in Kobani, the risk to Dutch trainers, and whether border controls are needed. The ministers answered that the Iraqi weapons were destroyed, that the Netherlands cannot confirm the Kobani findings without samples, that protective measures will follow threat analyses, and that border controls are not necessary given existing EU customs risk regimes.
No, the cabinet sees no need for this.
Nee, het kabinet ziet daartoe geen noodzaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Fraude onder defensiemedewerkers

An MP asked the Defence Minister about alleged large-scale fraud by defence employees, whether they were military or civilian, whether the probe covered the whole armed forces, why offenders were not dismissed, and whether the results would be shared. The minister said three civilian staff at the US Army Garrison Schinnen had irregular travel claims totalling 200 to 1,250 euro each, received a pay-related disciplinary measure and repayment, and that a full answer by the requested date was not possible.

Given the nature and extent of the dereliction of duty, a disciplinary measure affecting pay was chosen that is proportionate to the dereliction committed, together with repayment of the fraudulent amounts.

Gelet op de aard en omvang van het plichtsverzuim is gekozen voor een disciplinaire maatregel in de sfeer van bezoldiging die proportioneel is in verhouding tot het gepleegde plichtsverzuim en het terugbetalen van de fraudebedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over het nieuws dat Turkije de man heeft vrijgelaten die in februari 2013 in Kopenhagen de Deense journalist Lars Hedegaard probeerde te vermoorden

PVV MPs Wilders and De Roon asked why Turkey released the man who attempted to murder Danish journalist Lars Hedegaard, whether the Netherlands should protest, press Turkey to re-arrest and extradite him, and whether a country releasing terrorists belongs in NATO. The minister replied that Denmark has raised the matter with Turkey, which has promised to investigate, and that the cabinet sees no reason to raise Turkey's NATO membership.
Denmark has made inquiries about this matter, which is primarily a criminal case between Denmark and Turkey, with the Turkish authorities.
Denemarken heeft navraag gedaan over deze kwestie, die in eerste instantie een strafrechtelijke zaak is tussen Denemarken en Turkije, bij de Turkse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Voordewind, De Roon, Servaes, Ten Broeke en Van Bommel over het doodvonnis van Asia Bibi

Six MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister how the government views the Pakistani appeal court's upholding of Asia Bibi's death sentence, what remaining appeal options exist, and what Dutch and international steps can prevent execution. The minister said the government deeply regrets the ruling, outlined the appeal path to the Pakistani Supreme Court, and listed bilateral and EU advocacy, embassy actions and planned follow-up without committing to a specific new step.

The Netherlands will continue to raise the case of Ms Asia Bibi, the blasphemy legislation and the death penalty with the Pakistani authorities at every opportunity, both bilaterally and within the EU.

Nederland zal bij iedere voorkomende gelegenheid bij de Pakistaanse autoriteiten aandacht blijven vragen voor mevrouw Asia Bibi, de blasfemiewetgeving en de doodstraf, zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ten Broeke en Omtzigt over ‘Gaza met onmiddellijke ingang onder controle van Hamas en Fatah’

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Hamas and Fatah would jointly govern Gaza, and about whether Dutch or EU funds could reach Hamas through Palestinian Authority salaries and prisoner payments. The minister answered that there is no joint budget, that Qatari one-off payments are not salaries, that EU-funded civil servant lists are unchanged, and that the prisoner payment rules remain duration-based, with the Netherlands continuing to press for reform.
The money concerns Qatar, not the EU or the Netherlands.
Het betreft geld van Qatar, niet van de EU of NL.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over inlichtingenverstrekking door Nederlands leger aan leger van Mali

MP De Roon asked whether Dutch military intelligence sharing with Mali's army in its internal conflict with Tuareg insurgents, and whether the government would prevent it. The ministers answered that the Netherlands shares no intelligence with the Malian army; the Dutch contribution to the UN ASIFU unit serves only MINUSMA and sharing with Mali is for the UN to decide.
The Netherlands does not share intelligence with the Malian army.
Nederland deelt geen inlichtingen met het Malinese leger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over escortering van een VN-schip naar Somalië

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister why a Dutch frigate was used to escort a UN food-aid ship to Somalia rather than embarked armed guards, whether this means fewer frigates are needed for anti-piracy, and whether the Netherlands will hand the escort task to other countries. The Minister answered that the WFP has no longer a contract and charters ships individually, so the armed-guard teams cannot be used; escorts are a core Atalanta task, other countries also escort, and the next WFP ship may again use a guard team.
On these transports the deployment of an AVPD team is not possible and therefore the EU operation Atalanta carries out escorts.
Op deze transporten is de inzet van een AVPD-team niet mogelijk en daarom voert de EU-operatie Atalanta escortes uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, De Roon en Wilders over de berichten ‘Werknemers pro forma tot de islam bekeerd’ en ‘werknemers bekeerd voor klus’

PVV MPs asked whether reports that Dutch workers were pro forma converted to Islam for a job in Saudi Arabia were known, and how their safety and the Saudi restrictions on non-Muslims were viewed. The minister confirmed awareness, said there were no indications the workers were at risk, declined to judge Saudi policy or the company director's stance, and said the matter would be raised in regular contacts.
The matter will be raised in the regular contacts between Saudi Arabia and the Netherlands.
De kwestie zal opgebracht worden in de reguliere contacten tussen Saoedi-Arabië en Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie op 1 juni tegen het Armeens herdenkingsmonument in Almelo

MPs from several parties asked the government about a June 2014 demonstration in Almelo against an Armenian genocide memorial, including alleged Turkish state involvement, slogans, and whether the Turkish consul or Diyanet mosques were involved. The government answered that the claims could not be verified in several cases, that demonstration rights were respected, that a criminal complaint was under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service, and that the issue would be considered in a separate parallel-communities study.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, but they could not be verified.
Deze berichtgeving is het kabinet bekend, maar deze was niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over piraterijbestrijding in de Golf van Guinee

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign and Defence Ministers about a US counter-piracy plan for the Gulf of Guinea, including armed private guards and convoys, and whether Dutch navy should act more in international waters. The government answered that it supports a regional, EU-coordinated approach focused on maritime capacity building, notes most attacks occur within coastal states' territorial waters, and sees no need for a more active navy role beyond existing exercises and training.
The cabinet favours a regional solution to maritime crime in the Gulf of Guinea, through regional prevention, prosecution and maritime capacity building.

Het kabinet is voorstander van een regionale oplossing voor het probleem van maritieme criminaliteit in de Golf van Guinee, door middel van regionale preventie, vervolging en maritieme capaciteitsopbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over piraterijbestrijding bij Somalië

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether pressuring Somali piracy protectors toward legal economic activity or destroying their landing facilities is a viable, cheaper policy. The government answered that naval missions have sharply reduced attacks, that state-building and the New Deal are the long-term answer, and that the 2012 raid on a pirate depot was a one-off with no exclusive pirate facilities remaining.
Since 2012 no ships have been hijacked.
Sinds 2012 zijn er geen schepen meer gekaapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en De Roon over de uitspraken van de Turkse premier Erdogan inzake het handelen van Israël in Gaza

Three MPs (Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon) asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemned Turkish PM Erdogan's comparisons of Israel's conduct in Gaza to Hitler, whether he would summon the Turkish ambassador, seek EU support against Turkey, suspend EU accession talks, or reconsider the Patriot mission. The minister answered that the remarks were regrettable, that summoning the ambassador was unnecessary, that accession talks remain the best lever, and that the Patriot mission fulfils NATO solidarity.
The cabinet does not consider it necessary to summon the Turkish ambassador specifically for this.
Het kabinet vindt het niet nodig specifiek hiervoor de Turkse ambassadeur te ontbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de rakettenregen van Hamas en Fatah onder toeziend oog van de terroristische Palestijnse “eenheidsregering"

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister why the Palestinian unity government and Fatah allowed rocket fire on Israel, whether the government condemned it, and whether all Dutch and EU financial and political support to the Palestinian government and Authority should be halted. The minister answered that the government condemns the rocket attacks, holds the technocratic government to its actions under the Quartet principles, and sees no reason to stop cooperation or funding since Hamas controls Gaza, not the new government.
On the basis of the above, the government sees no reason to stop cooperation with the Palestinian technocratic government.
Het kabinet ziet op grond van het bovenstaande geen aanleiding om de samenwerking met de Palestijnse technocratische regering stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse steun voor ISIS-strijders

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of reports of Turkish support for ISIS fighters, and whether he would seek an international inquiry and reconsider the Dutch Patriot deployment in Turkey. The minister referred to a separate letter answering these questions (Kamerstuk 32 623, nr. 135) without restating its substance.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, de Roon en van Bommel over de vrijlating en arrestatie van een zwangere vrouw in Sudan

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Merriam Ibrahim was re-arrested after a court acquitted her of a death sentence, on what grounds, and whether the Sudanese ambassador would be summoned. The minister confirmed she was held at the airport on suspicion of using false documents, released on 26 June and is now at the US embassy, and said international pressure is being raised through quiet diplomacy.
Ms Ibrahim was held on suspicion of using false documents, but she was not formally arrested.
Mevrouw Ibrahim werd vastgehouden op verdenking van het gebruik van valse documenten, maar zij is niet officieel gearresteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en De Roon over babysterfte ten gevolge van de ANC-rassenwetten

PVV MPs Bosma and De Roon asked whether South African black empowerment rules, which they call apartheid-style 'racial laws', are causing infant deaths through discrimination in water purification, and why the Netherlands funded the ANC via aid. The minister rejected the 'racial laws' label, described the policy as redress of past inequality, and said the Netherlands funded no party and that aid to South Africa is nearly phased out.
The ANC has not introduced 'racial laws'.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers, Dijkgraaf, Van Bommel en De Roon over het bericht ‘Verboden vlag overschaduwt Veteranendag’

MPs from several parties asked whether veterans were barred from carrying the Morgenster flag at the National Veterans Day parade because of sensitivities with Indonesia, and whether the government had raised the matter with Indonesian authorities. The minister replied that the organising committee decided in 2013 to allow only regimental flags at the formal parade, a rule agreed with veterans' associations and not a ban, that Indonesia had objected in past years without the committee being pressured, and that the decision is the committee's responsibility.
The committee discussed this with the veterans' associations and they agreed to it.
Het comité heeft dit met de veteranenverenigingen besproken en zij hebben hiermee ingestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de gevolgen van het sluiten van het consulaat te Atlanta

The MP De Roon asks the Foreign Minister about objections to closing the Atlanta consulate, including the economic damage compared with the savings, and which other US consulates face closure. The minister answers that the honorary consulate will not be closed, but its biometric visa and passport processing will be phased out by 1 January 2016 as part of a wider modernisation and budget cut affecting 37 honorary consulates in 12 countries, and that no US consulates will close.
The honorary consulate in Atlanta will not be closed.
Het honorair consulaat in Atlanta zal niet worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de integratie van de Nederlandse Luchtmobiele Brigade in de Duitse Division Schnelle Kräfte en Duits-Nederlandse defensiesamenwerking

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the sovereignty implications, legal basis, equipment cooperation and parliamentary oversight of integrating the Dutch Air Mobile Brigade into the German Division Schnelle Kräfte under the 2013 Dutch-German Declaration of Intent. The minister answered that the Netherlands keeps the final say over deployment of its units, that the DoI is non-binding but enables binding agreements later, and that the Dutch parliament will be informed under the standard procurement process.
Yes, for all equipment procurement the House is informed under the agreements of the Defence Materiel Process (DMP).
Ja, voor alle materieelverwerving geldt dat de Kamer wordt geïnformeerd volgens de afspraken van het Defensie Materieel Proces (DMP).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse weigering om slachtoffers van Turkse invasie op Cyprus te compenseren

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Turkey's reported refusal to pay the 90 million euro ECHR compensation to Greek Cypriot victims of the 1974 invasion and how to press Turkey to comply. The minister replied that ECtHR judgments are binding, the cabinet expects Turkey to comply, and the execution will be placed on the Council of Europe Committee of Ministers agenda where the Netherlands will push for compliance.
Now that the Court's judgment is in place, its execution will be placed on the agenda of the Committee of Ministers of the Council of Europe.
Nu de uitspraak van het Hof er ligt, zal de tenuitvoerlegging daarvan worden geagendeerd in het Comité van Ministers van de Raad van Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat de Joint Strike Fighter niet onzichtbaar is voor moderne Russische en Chinese radarsystemen

The MP De Roon asks whether the F-35's stealth features are compromised by modern Russian and Chinese radar and what consequences this would have for the purchase. The Minister says the F-35 must meet its stealth requirements under US Joint Program Office oversight, that Defence monitors radar developments, and that the aircraft is considered a fifth-generation fighter.
The F-35 will have to meet the stated operational and technical requirements, including those relating to stealth properties.
De F-35 zal moeten voldoen aan de gestelde operationele en technische eisen, waaronder die betreffende stealth eigenschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de arrestatie van een Brits politicus wegens het citeren van Winston Churchill

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the arrest of a British politician for quoting Churchill on Islam violates free speech, whether the UK should be pressed to drop charges, and how the Netherlands will defend free expression internationally. The minister answered that free speech limits are for an independent court to judge, that the Dutch government has no grounds to contact UK authorities, and that free expression is already a priority in Dutch human rights policy.
It is for an independent judge to determine whether the limits of freedom of expression have been exceeded in this case.
Het is aan een onafhankelijke rechter om vast te stellen of de grenzen van de vrijheid van meningsuiting in dit geval zijn overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het bericht dat de plaatsvervangend Secretaris-Generaal van de Navo Rusland tot tegenstander verklaarde

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister about a report that NATO's deputy Secretary General called Russia an adversary, asking on what basis, who authorised it, and whether NATO would retract it. The minister replied that the deputy SG spoke only in his personal capacity, that the government does not know the basis for his view, and that NATO is discussing the longer-term future of the Russia relationship rather than retracting the remark.
Deputy SG NATO Vershbow did not speak on behalf of the Alliance; he gave his own opinion.
Plv. SG NAVO Vershbow heeft niet namens het Bondgenootschap gesproken; hij heeft zijn eigen mening gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Roon over misdrijven plegende Afghaanse diplomaat en de uitzending van PowNews d.d. 17 april 2014

Parliamentarians Helder and De Roon asked why an Afghan diplomat who assaulted and damaged property was only reprimanded, not expelled, waived immunity or prosecuted, and what was done about his parking abuse and diplomatic plates. The government answered that the diplomat's conduct was unacceptable but did not warrant expulsion, that Nederland cannot waive or prosecute under absolute immunity, and that a New York-style plate revocation was studied and rejected for legal and practical reasons.
In this case the diplomat's conduct was indeed completely unacceptable, but it did not qualify for such a visible and politically charged sanction.
In dit geval was het gedrag van de betreffende diplomaat weliswaar volstrekt onacceptabel, maar kwalificeerde het niet voor het treffen van een dergelijke zichtbare en politiek beladen sanctie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over commerciële mogelijkheden in Myanmar

A PVV MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether she would act, as the US has, to expand commercial opportunities for Dutch firms in Myanmar, and whether Bangkok embassy support is adequate. The minister replied that the Dutch capacity in Bangkok was expanded, an economic mission office was opened in Yangon, and Myanmar was added to the Dutch Good Growth Fund for SMEs.

To give Dutch companies sufficient support to seize these opportunities in a socially responsible way, the cabinet decided in 2013 to expand the Burma/Myanmar capacity of the Dutch embassy in Bangkok.

Om Nederlandse bedrijven voldoende ondersteuning te geven deze kansen op een maatschappelijk verantwoorde manier te benutten, heeft het kabinet in 2013 besloten de Birma/Myanmar-capaciteit van de Nederlandse ambassade in Bangkok uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over hedendaagse veiligheidsrisico’s bij een amfibische operatie

An MP asked the Defence Minister about rising safety risks for amphibious landings from advanced anti-ship missiles, the detectability of marines by commercial radar, and whether landing craft need upgrades for longer distances. The minister acknowledged growing risks, said threat analyses guide operational choices, and noted a planned upgrade of the Landing Craft Utility to be reported to parliament later.
Defence is preparing an adaptation of the large landing craft (Landing Craft Utility), on which the House will be informed in due course under the Defence Materiel Process (DMP).

Momenteel is Defensie een aanpassing van de grote landingsvaartuigen ( Landing Craft Utility) aan het voorbereiden waarover de Kamer te zijner tijd volgens het Defensie Materieel Proces (DMP) zal worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon aan de minister van Defensie over binnendringers op Vliegbasis Volkel

An MP asked the Defence Minister why intruders at Volkel air base were only apprehended after about an hour and what would be done to speed up apprehension. The minister answered that the base is protected in a tiered manner, that intruders were spotted around 06:50 and arrested at 07:00, and that security is a continuous concern, but that no details of additional measures will be given for security reasons.
For security reasons, no statements are made about measures taken and any additional security measures.
Vanuit beveiligingsoverwegingen worden geen mededelingen gedaan over getroffen en eventueel aanvullende veiligheidsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over moderne antitankwapens in handen van Syrische rebellen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Syrian rebels obtained US-made TOW anti-tank missiles, and whether the US could be asked about supply, onward transfer notifications, and assurances of use. The minister confirmed the reported use by the Hazm Brigade, said the supplier is unknown, that the US gave no detail on specific deliveries, and that assurances cannot be given.
The US also did not make available more detail on specific deliveries to specific groups, even when asked.
Meer detail over specifieke leveranties aan specifieke groeperingen heeft de VS ook bij navraag niet beschikbaar gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over het bericht dat de Interpol database van gestolen en/of vermiste paspoorten nauwelijks wordt gecheckt

MPs De Roon and Helder asked whether Interpol's database of stolen and lost passports, which they said is rarely checked by governments, is adequately used at Dutch airports. The state secretary answered that the Koninklijke Marechaussee and national police have access to the database and consult it when needed, that the Schengen border check is secure, and that the Netherlands works with EU partners on passenger data.
I am currently examining the possibilities to better use this database to flag illegal immigration, serious crime and terrorism in passenger flows.
Ik onderzoek momenteel de mogelijkheden om deze databank beter te benutten bij het in passagiersstromen signaleren van illegale immigratie, zware criminaliteit en terrorisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de bouw van zeven schepen voor Qatar Armed Forces

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch naval shipbuilding know-how is being channelled via Damen and Keppel Verolme into warships for Qatar, thereby undermining Dutch arms export policy, and what can be done about such corporate structures. The minister confirms the links and the Qatar memorandum, states that export licences and brokering will be assessed against EU and UN criteria including diversion risk, and says that decisions on local cooperation are primarily commercial and that Dutch policy offers sufficient safeguards.
Export licence applications are assessed against the eight criteria of the EU Common Position on arms exports and the assessment criteria of the UN Arms Trade Treaty.
Vergunningaanvragen worden getoetst aan de acht criteria van het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt inzake wapenexport en aan de toetsingscriteria uit het VN-wapenhandelsverdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over samenwerking met Turkije bij terrorismebestrijding

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands will cooperate with Turkey on counterterrorism, given reports of Turkish ties to Hamas, arms transfers to jihadist groups in Syria, and alleged Al Qaeda bases, and why Turkey is considered a reliable partner. The minister answered that cooperation runs through existing channels, that Turkey holds a different view on Hamas, that the government does not recognise the arms-transfer claims, and that Turkey itself acknowledges the jihadist threat and has denied the Al Qaeda bases.
Based on recent contacts with the Turkish authorities, the cabinet does not recognise the suggestion that Turkey would tolerate arms deliveries to jihadist fighting groups.
Op basis van recente contacten met de Turkse autoriteiten herkent het kabinet zich niet in de suggestie dat Turkije wapenleveringen aan jihadistische strijdgroepen zou gedogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over EU-plan om Oekraine geld te geven

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would provide financial aid to Ukraine, how much per Dutch citizen, why it should not instead fund tax relief, and whether the EU's planned aid could be used for tax relief. The minister replied that the Netherlands gave about EUR 1.5 million in bilateral rule-of-law and human-rights aid to Ukraine (a fraction of a euro per citizen), that these are grants, and that the EU's EUR 11 billion package is being discussed separately with the Dutch share around 5%.
Because these funds serve a different purpose: contributing to strengthening the rule of law and protecting human rights in a neighbouring country of the European Union.
Omdat deze middelen een ander doel dienen: bijdragen aan de versterking van de rechtsstaat en de bescherming van de mensenrechten in een buurland van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over de benoeming van de Venezolaanse Consul in Aruba

Two PVV MPs asked whether Venezuela appointed a consul in Aruba who is suspected of drug trafficking linked to a terrorist organisation, whether he is on US watch lists, whether an international arrest request applies, and whether this was raised during a Dutch delegation visit. The minister answered that no request for a new Venezuelan consul-general in Aruba has been received, that the person is publicly listed on the US Treasury SDN list since 2008, that the Justice Minister will not comment on non-public lists or arrest requests, and that the delegation visit did not raise the appointment.
The Minister of Security and Justice does not comment on non-public lists of the United States or on international arrest and detention requests.
De Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie doet geen uitspraken over niet-openbare lijsten van de Verenigde Staten of internationale opsporings- en aanhoudingsverzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en De Roon over subsidies voor anti-Israëlische hulpclubs

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and De Roon asked whether Dutch government subsidies to Oxfam Novib, which funds the Coalition of Women for Peace (said to back an Israel boycott), should stop, and how much money flowed to such groups. The minister confirmed Oxfam Novib funds a project from its own resources rather than government money, declined to comment on a Canadian minister's remarks, and refused to end subsidies.
Since 2013 Oxfam Novib provides funds from its own resources to the Coalition of Women for Peace.
Oxfam Novib verstrekt sinds 2013 fondsen uit eigen middelen aan de organisatie Coalition of Women for Peace .

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de berichten dat Sri Lanka, Thailand en het Hoge Commissariaat voor de Vluchtelingen van de Verenigde Naties (UNHCR) wanhopige christenen aan hun lot over laten

The MP De Roon asks the Foreign Minister how the government views reports that Sri Lanka, Thailand and UNHCR leave desperate Pakistani Christians without protection, and whether the government will press these countries and Pakistan on asylum and the blasphemy law. The minister answers that UNHCR handles asylum claims individually, that Sri Lanka tolerates applicants pending decisions, that Thailand is not a refugee convention party, and that the Netherlands follows UNHCR policy and raises minority rights with Pakistan in bilateral and multilateral contacts.
Thailand is not a party to the refugee convention. UNHCR is present and has recognised about 200 Pakistani refugees.
Thailand is geen partij bij het vluchtelingenverdrag. UNHCR is wel aanwezig en heeft circa 200 Pakistaanse vluchtelingen erkend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener, De Roon en Wilders over het bericht 'PGGM haalt beleggingen uit Israëlische banken'

MPs Madlener, De Roon and Wilders asked whether the government considers PGGM's divestment from Israeli banks a boycott, how much PGGM invests in Israel and the Palestinian territories, and what the government will do against investor withdrawal and anti-Israel sentiment. The minister answered that PGGM's decision is its own, that PGGM still invests in Israeli companies (over EUR 60 million in several dozen firms), that the government does not track investments and does not intervene in company decisions, and that it is working to deepen economic ties with Israel.
The government does not keep track of PGGM's investments.
Het kabinet houdt de investeringen van PGGM niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de blokkade door UNESCO van een tentoonstelling over het Joodse volk

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether UNESCO blocked an exhibition on Jewish ties to the Land of Israel under Arab pressure, and how the government views this. The minister answered that the exhibition was postponed to June rather than blocked, partly due to concerns from Arab states and incomplete agreement on content, and that the government welcomes its going ahead, while hosting it in the Netherlands is up to the organiser.
The exhibition "The People, the Book, the Land – 3,500 years of ties between the Jewish People and the Holy Land" was not prevented but postponed until June of this year.
1 Antwoord 1 De tentoonstelling «The People, the Book, the Land – 3,500 years of ties between the Jewish People and the Holy Land» is niet verhinderd, maar uitgesteld tot juni van dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Roon en Madlener over belastinggeld voor Palestijnse ambtenaren

PVV MPs asked how many Palestinian officials and pensioners funded by EU and Dutch money are former prisoners convicted of terrorism, asked why aid to the Palestinian Authority is rising, and whether it should be halted and reclaimed. The minister said Pegase salary payments exclude sanctioned persons, could not confirm the $50,000 figure, and that the government sees no reason to change the policy.
The cabinet sees no reason to change this policy, as also stated in the Coalition Agreement.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om dit beleid, zoals tevens verwoord in het Regeerakkoord, te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Roon en Wilders over Nederlands belastinggeld voor anti-Israëlische propaganda

PVV MPs asked whether Dutch aid money funded a youth NGO's broadcast calling Israelis 'crows and rats' and whether aid to the NDC and Palestinian Authority should stop. The minister condemned the rhetoric, denied NDC funds went to the producer PYALARA, and declined to halt aid.
The cabinet condemns this kind of incitement.
Het kabinet veroordeelt dergelijk opruiend taalgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en De Roon over de jihadcoalitie

MPs Van Klaveren and De Roon asked about a reported jihadist coalition in Syria, the number of Dutch jihadists involved, and whether participation should be criminalised with citizenship revocation and expulsion. The minister answered that the coalition groups are not designated terrorist groups and are distinct from ISIL and JaN, that about a hundred Dutch nationals are fighting there, and that participation is already punishable under article 134a Sr with citizenship revocation possible under conditions.
Participating in jihadist fighting or following training abroad is punishable under article 134a of the Dutch Criminal Code.
Het deelnemen aan de jihadistische strijd of training volgen in het buitenland is strafbaar op grond van artikel 134a Wetboek van Strafrecht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon, Voordewind over het gegeven dat waterbedrijf Vitens zijn samenwerkingsverband met het Israëlische waterbedrijf Mekorot heeft beëindigd 'om neutraal' te

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government was involved in Vitens ending its cooperation with Israel's Mekorot, whether this harms innovation and the peace process, and whether it fits the water top-sector policy. The minister answered that the government does not interfere in individual companies' decisions, that the ministry only explained Dutch non-encouragement policy when consulted, and that companies decide their own economic relations.
The government does not intervene in the decisions of individual companies.
De regering treedt niet in de besluiten van individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Klaveren over een jihadistische ex-militair

Two MPs asked the Defence and Justice ministers whether a former Dutch soldier who served in 2009-2010 is now fighting as a jihadist in Syria, whether others have done so, and whether participating in jihad should mean loss of Dutch nationality. The minister confirmed the report is likely accurate, said two other ex-soldiers are possibly fighting, and explained that nationality can be revoked only after a final conviction for a terrorist offence, only if the person holds another nationality, and only for offences committed after 1 October 2010.
For every person returning from Syria, it is examined whether criminal action is necessary and possible.
Van elke persoon die terugkeert uit Syrië wordt gekeken of strafrechtelijk optreden noodzakelijk en mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de uitvaart van Nelson Mandela

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether the government would request the arrest and extradition of Suriname's president Desi Bouterse, convicted to 11 years for cocaine trafficking, and whether it was improper for the King to attend a ceremony with him. The minister answered that Netherlands values attendance at the Mandela memorial, that the conviction stands but cannot be enforced while Bouterse enjoys head-of-state immunity.
The court's judgment convicting Bouterse remains in force, but cannot be enforced as long as he enjoys international immunity as head of state of Suriname.

De uitspraak van de rechtbank waarbij Bouterse is veroordeeld blijft van kracht, maar kan niet tot uitvoering worden gebracht, zolang hij als staatshoofd van Suriname internationaal immuniteit geniet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Roon over journalist van PowNews / Angolese ambassade

MPs Helder and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about an Angolan embassy employee who assaulted a PowNews journalist, and whether diplomats committing offences should be expelled. The minister said the matter went to police and the public prosecutor, outlined diplomatic tools such as protest, requests to lift immunity and persona non grata status, and promised a letter on tackling offences by privileged persons.
During the budget debate of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, a letter was promised to the House on tackling offences committed by privileged persons.

Tijdens de behandeling van de begroting van het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is aan de Kamer een brief toegezegd over de aanpak van de problematiek rondom overtredingen en/of misdrijven door geprivilegieerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en De Roon over de verwoesting van het Syrische christelijke dorp Sadad

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about reports of mass killings and destruction in the Christian Syrian village of Sadad, the background, international responses, and possible action. The minister said SOHR reported 45 civilian deaths but no destruction of the village, that no further information was available, and that the Netherlands would press for respect for minorities and referral of Syria to the International Criminal Court.
No information is available about the background of these killings.
Over de achtergronden van deze moorden is geen informatie beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Wilders over het bericht “Geen strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar uitspraken over Volkel”

PVV MPs asked whether criminal investigation of former ministers Lubbers and Van Agt over their statements on nuclear weapons at Volkel is blocked by the government withholding information, and whether the state secrecy and official secrecy provisions have become empty. The minister answered that no complaint was filed, the Public Prosecution Service cannot assess a state secret breach without government statements, NATO agreements exclude discussing nuclear weapon numbers and locations, and the provisions are still used in practice.
Within NATO it has been agreed that agreements relating to the numbers and locations of nuclear weapons present on allied territory are not discussed.
In NAVO-verband is overeengekomen dat niet wordt ingegaan op afspraken die verband houden met aantallen en locaties van op bondgenootschappelijk grondgebied aanwezige kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de grotendeels onbestrafte islamitische jihad tegen Kopten in Egypte

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister about alleged unpunished jihadist violence against Egyptian Copts, including whether Muslim Brotherhood support, police neglect and partisan investigations were involved. The minister answered that Nederland rejects jihad calls, denies supporting the Muslim Brotherhood, condemns the August 2013 attacks, and urges independent investigations without yet reporting concrete results.
The cabinet urges independent investigation into all incidents and prosecution of the perpetrators.
Het kabinet dringt aan op onafhankelijk onderzoek naar alle incidenten en vervolging van de daders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de Turkse steun aan jihadisten in Syrië

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about alleged Turkish state support for jihadist groups in Syria, the Dutch Patriot deployment in Turkey, and whether an international criminal investigation or diplomatic action was warranted. The minister replied that the Netherlands knows of media reports but has no confirmed evidence of Turkish support, that Turkey denies it, and that cooperation on foreign fighters has been pursued, while rejecting an investigation and leaving Turkish responses to Turkey.
The Netherlands is aware of media reports of alleged Turkish support for jihadist groups in Syria, but is not aware of actual Turkish support for such groups.
Nederland kent de mediaberichten over vermeende Turkse steun aan jihadistische groeperingen in Syrië, maar is niet bekend met daadwerkelijke steun van Turkije aan dergelijke groepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Riyad

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of an ambassador's tweet calling Hajj a showcase of Islam as a religion of peace, asked him to explain that claim, and asked whether the ambassador should be recalled. The minister confirmed awareness of the tweet, said the cabinet does not share the MPs' view of Islam, and refused to recall the ambassador.
Question 4: Will you immediately recall this ambassador, who evidently knows nothing of all these matters or behaves like a dhimmi?
Vraag 4 Wilt u deze ambassadeur, die van al die zaken kennelijk geen weet heeft oftewel zich als een dhimmi gedraagt, onmiddellijk terugroepen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de schorsing van Sabra over een hernieuwd MIVD- onderzoek

An MP asked the Defence Minister how a convert to Islam with a partner linked to a convicted Hofstad group member could work for the Royal Marechaussee in sensitive posts without a timely MIVD security check, and whether such vacancies persist. The minister replied that a valid clearance existed, a renewed check was started in 2011 and closed in 2013 leading to an intended withdrawal, and that backlogs have been cleared, without disclosing the substantive reasons.
No public statements are made about the substantive reasons and considerations that led to the intention to withdraw the VGB.
Over de inhoudelijke redenen en afwegingen die geleid hebben tot het voornemen tot intrekking van de VGB worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de boycot van Israëlische producten door een aantal supermarkten

MP De Roon (PVV) asked ministers whether planned labelling of settlement products and supermarket boycotts harm Palestinian livelihoods and whether the government would tell retailers that specific labelling is unnecessary.
