The government replied that labelling advice is not a boycott, that no specific settlement labelling has been decided, that EU origin rules apply to all imports, and that it will inform the retail association of the state of play.
There is no question of a decision on specific labelling of products from settlements.
Er is geen sprake van een besluit tot specifieke etikettering van producten uit nederzettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het bericht "Israël verbolgen over richtlijnen EU"

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister why the EU Commission issued guidelines barring EU agreements with Israel from applying to territories occupied since 1967, and whether he would stop them. The minister replied that these are non-binding Commission guidelines consistent with long-standing EU and Dutch policy, that he cannot prevent them, and rejected the calls to cut the EU bureaucrats involved.
No. The Commission can independently adopt guidelines.
Nee. De Commissie kan zelfstandig richtsnoeren vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Roon en Wilders over "de islamitische inmenging van Koeweit in Nederland"

MPs Van Klaveren, De Roon and Wilders asked whether Kuwaiti state involvement in the Blue Mosque in Amsterdam, including funding and board links, should be tolerated, and whether the mosque should be closed and the Kuwaiti ambassador expelled. The minister said the state cannot intervene in mosque boards or funding absent national security concerns, asked the mosque board for openness on financing, and rejected closure and expulsion.
I do not have information on Kuwait's funding of mosques and/or their administrators.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de bekostiging door Koeweit van moskeeën en/of de bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het niet ingrijpen van het Egyptische leger bij moslimgeweld tegen Koptische christenen

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the Egyptian army's passivity during attacks on Coptic Christians makes them unprotected, and whether the government will press Egypt's authorities on discrimination and state protection of Christians. The minister acknowledged inadequate protection and lax local authorities, said the government is concerned and raised the issue with Egyptian leaders and in EU Council conclusions, without committing to a specific new step.
It is regrettable that the Egyptian security sector insufficiently prevents violence against Christians.
Het is betreurenswaardig dat de Egyptische veiligheidssector het geweld tegen christenen onvoldoende voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over Christenen die in Nigeria als beesten worden afgeslacht

Two MPs from the PVV asked the foreign minister about reports of Christians being forced to convert and killed in Nigeria, and about alleged Iranian support for militants there. The minister condemned rights abuses, said the Boko Haram attacks also target non-Christians, and said the government has no reliable information confirming Iranian involvement.
The Cabinet does not have reliable information that confirms this assumption.
Het Kabinet beschikt niet over betrouwbare informatie die deze veronderstelling bevestigt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon over "besmet verklaren" van bezoek aan Australië

MPs Wilders and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about an embassy email in Australia telling diplomatic staff, and honorary consuls, not to attend meetings during Wilders' visit, and whether consular assistance was restricted. The minister replied that the request was to avoid the impression of an official visit, that consular help is available to all Dutch citizens, and that no change to consular guidelines is considered necessary.
There was no prohibition on attending as a private person or interested citizen, but on doing so as official representatives of the Netherlands.
Er was geen sprake van een verbod om als privépersoon of geïnteresseerde burger aanwezig te zijn, maar om het feit dat ze niet als officiële vertegenwoordiger van Nederland zouden deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over Erdogan’s heksenjacht op dissidenten en uitsluiting van niet-moslims

An MP from the PVV asks the government about Erdogan's crackdown on dissidents, arrests of protesters and journalists, exclusion of non-Muslims, and whether a planned Dutch economic mission to Turkey should be cancelled. The minister confirms about 3,600 detentions (most released within 48 hours), says the government will keep a critical rule-of-law dialogue within accession talks, and does not cancel the economic relationship.
In response to recent events, the cabinet, as set out in my letter of 25 June, chooses a credible accession process that adheres to strict accession conditions.
In reactie op de recente gebeurtenissen kiest het kabinet, zoals uiteengezet in mijn brief van 25 juni, voor een geloofwaardig toetredingsproces dat vasthoudt aan strenge toetredingsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord vragen De Roon over het bericht dat Europese rechters de sancties tegen Iran ondergraven

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether EU courts undermining Iran sanctions by requiring disclosure of secret information is acceptable, whether some member states enforce sanctions less actively, and whether sanctioning entire sectors would avoid the problem. The minister answered that confidential information may be shared with an independent court without necessarily breaching confidentiality, that he has no reason to think member states fail to enforce sanctions, and that sanctions are chosen for effectiveness.
In my view, sharing information with an independent judge does not necessarily mean that the confidentiality of the information is breached.
Het delen van informatie met een onafhankelijke rechter betekent in mijn ogen niet noodzakelijkerwijs dat de vertrouwelijkheid van de informatie wordt geschonden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, de Roon, Madlener en van Klaveren over de samenwerking tussen de EU en de Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC)

Four PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about EU cooperation with the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation, including its observer status, its stance on criticism of Islam and whether the EU should end contacts. The minister rejected most premises, affirmed continued support for free expression and religious freedom, and declined to end the observer status.
No. However, the OIC has for some time paid considerable attention to combating religious intolerance.
Nee. Wel heeft de OIC al geruime tijd veel aandacht voor het tegengaan van religieuze intolerantie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Ojik, Omtzigt en Van Bommel over de nieuwe NGO-wet in Egypte

Six MPs asked the foreign minister whether Egypt's draft NGO law, despite amendments, still violates freedoms of expression and assembly, threatens human rights work and civil society, and whether the Netherlands has raised objections. The minister agreed the draft appears to conflict with Egypt's international obligations, said the Netherlands and the EU have raised concerns bilaterally and in multilateral fora, and noted the law is not yet adopted, with the EU to raise it if adopted.
Should a restrictive proposal nonetheless become law, I will raise it as soon as possible within the EU framework.
Mocht een restrictief voorstel toch wet worden dan zal ik dat zo spoedig mogelijk in EU-verband aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Wilders en De Roon over de belachelijke militaire multiculti-oefening in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked the Defence minister about a military exercise in Amsterdam neighbourhoods, questioning its purpose, whether soldiers should be taught about Islam, and whether mosque construction is facilitated abroad. The minister replied that contact with local populations is standard training, that cultural customs are respected where needed, and that soldiers do not interfere in local opinions, though infrastructure reconstruction may occur on missions.
Soldiers train daily for all possible deployments and missions of the armed forces within their legal tasks at home and abroad.
Militairen oefenen dagelijks voor alle mogelijke inzet en missies van de krijgsmacht in het kader van de wettelijke taken in binnen- en buitenland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over een Brits inreisverbod voor Islamcritici

An MP asked the foreign minister about a UK entry ban on US commentators Pamela Geller and Robert Spencer and whether the Netherlands should press the UK over it. The minister said free speech matters but that UK authorities must weigh each case, and saw no reason to doubt the UK Home Office considered free speech.
I share your view that safeguarding freedom of expression is an important task of the government.
Ik deel uw mening dat het waarborgen van de vrijheid van meningsuiting een belangrijke taak van de overheid is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over het (voorbarig publiceren van het) advies omtrent etikettering van producten uit Joodse nederzettingen

The MP De Roon asks why the draft advice on labelling products from Israeli settlements was published prematurely, whether labelling is a politically motivated and discriminatory measure, and whether it breaches WTO rules. The minister replies that the advice concerns technical guidance to businesses on correct origin labelling under existing EU rules, that a draft was posted by mistake and then removed, and that no trade sanction or special labelling is involved.
AgentschapNL unintentionally placed a draft advice on the website, while consultations within the EU and national decision-making were not yet concluded.
AgentschapNL heeft onbedoeld een concept advies op de website geplaatst, terwijl consultaties binnen de EU en nationale besluitvorming nog niet waren afgerond.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Bonis en Ten Broeke over de detentie van Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi-Arabië

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister whether the four-month detention of human rights activist Abdulkareem Yousef al-Khoder in Saudi Arabia was justified, whether the government agrees with Amnesty International that he is a prisoner of conscience, and whether it will urge Saudi Arabia to release him. The minister answered that the EU is investigating the background of the arrest with Saudi bodies, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands generally raises human rights defender issues with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome of the investigation, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Ten Broeke, De Roon en Van Bommel over de benoeming van Iran tot voorzitter van de VN-Ontwapeningsconferentie

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister whether Iran's rotating chairmanship of the UN Conference on Disarmament, and the US boycott of it, undermines disarmament progress and whether the Netherlands should follow a boycott. The minister replied that the chair rotates alphabetically rather than being elected, that the Netherlands will attend but leave if the Durban criteria are violated, and that a policy letter is forthcoming.
The Netherlands is a strong supporter of (nuclear) disarmament and non-proliferation, with the ultimate goal of a world without nuclear weapons.
Nederland is een groot voorstander van (nucleaire) ontwapening en non-proliferatie, waarbij het uiteindelijke doel is een wereld zonder kernwapens.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over de financiering van Syrische rebellen met drugsgeld

Party MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether the government had evidence for a Russian claim that 15,000 to 20,000 Syrian rebels were funded by drug money, including any Saudi link, and whether it would seek information from Russia, UNODC and Europol. The minister replied that the claim came without argument or evidence, so it could not be assessed and gave insufficient grounds for further inquiry.
The claim in the report you mention is not accompanied by any argumentation or evidence.
De bewering in het door u genoemde bericht gaat niet vergezeld van argumentatie of bewijsvoering.
Antwoord vragen De Roon en De Graaf over radarproblemen door windturbines

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister whether wind turbines can disrupt military radar and create false alarms in the Netherlands, and whether Defence is informed or consulted about turbine plans. The minister confirmed turbines can disturb radar, described the Rarro 75 km radar disturbance zones and model-based testing with possible refusal or modification of projects, and reported nine false radar alarms since 2010 without fighter scrambles.
Around every military radar there is a so-called radar disturbance zone with a radius of 75 kilometres.
Rond elke militaire radar ligt een zogeheten radarverstoringsgebied met een straal van 75 kilometer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over de reactie van de VN Speciaal Rapporteur voor de zgn. Palestijnse gebieden op de Boston-aanslagen

The PVV MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about UN Special Rapporteur Richard Falk's commentary linking the Boston bombings to US support for Israel, and whether the Netherlands would declare him no longer impartial and seek his removal. The minister rejected any justification of terrorism, called the characterisation of Netanyahu as warmongering inappropriate, and said the Netherlands would raise how Special Rapporteurs should fulfil their mandate in the regular EU dialogue with Falk, without committing to a call for his removal.
As previously promised to your House, the Netherlands will raise, in the EU context and in the regular dialogue with Mr Falk, the manner in which Special Rapporteurs should fulfil their mandate.
Zoals reeds toegezegd aan uw Kamer, zal Nederland in EU-verband in de reguliere dialoog met de heer Falk de manier waarop Speciaal Rapporteurs hun mandaat dienen in te vullen aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Bontes over afgebroken 100 procentcontrole op harddrugs op Schiphol

PVV MPs De Roon and Bontes asked whether a 100 percent drug control on a Paramaribo flight was stopped because passengers threatened to run amok, why it was not completed, what the usual seized weights are, and what guidelines apply to resistance. The minister refers to earlier answers on the same matter, gives 2012 seizure figures of 339 kilograms of net cocaine from couriers plus 128 kilograms in cargo, and states that the Customs service calls in the Royal Marechaussee in case of violence or threats.
In case of resistance with violence or threat of violence, Customs calls in the Royal Marechaussee.
In geval van verzet met geweld of dreiging met geweld schakelt de Douane de Koninklijke Marechaussee in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Klever over Iraanse gasexport naar Nederland

MPs De Roon and Klever asked whether the government would investigate Iranian claims of gas exports to the Netherlands in 2012 despite sanctions, and how it assessed existing Iran sanctions. The minister replied that the sanctions are effective, that the EU gas import ban only took effect on 21 December 2012 so no violation occurred for earlier exports, and that EU sanctions have territorial reach, so no international investigation is pursued, though the EU lobbies third countries to join.
As a result, there is no violation of sanctions if gas was exported to the Netherlands before that date.
Hierdoor is er geen sprake van overtreding van sancties indien voor die datum gas naar Nederland is geëxporteerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over de oproep van de Liberalen om de Syrische oppositie te bewapenen

An MP from the PVV asks the foreign minister how he views the Liberal International call to arm the Syrian opposition, including concerns about Islamist and jihadist fighters and arms proliferation. The minister replies that the Netherlands favours a comprehensive UN arms embargo, that the majority of member states fear arming the opposition would spread weapons and instability, and that the current embargo should be maintained while EU discussions continue.
The Netherlands is in favour of a comprehensive UN arms embargo.
Nederland is voorstander van een alomvattend VN-wapenembargo.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over het propageren van mensenoffers en kannibalisme in Egypte

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that Egypt's Al-Azhar university promotes human sacrifice and cannibalism against apostates, and whether the Netherlands funds or cooperates with it. The minister said the material reflects historical theoretical views, that Al-Azhar receives no direct or indirect Dutch or EU funding but takes part in a Dutch-financed interfaith dialogue, and that the government sees no consequences for its policy toward Islamic states.
There is no direct or indirect subsidy of this university by the Netherlands or the European Union.
Er is geen directe of indirecte subsidiëring van deze universiteit door Nederland of de Europese Unie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon en Ten Broeke over de aanval op een christelijke wijk in de Pakistaanse stad Lahore

Four MPs (Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Ten Broeke) asked the foreign minister about a mob attack on a Christian neighbourhood in Lahore over alleged blasphemy, Pakistan's government response, the misuse of blasphemy law and what the Netherlands will do to press Pakistan. The minister answered that Punjab ordered a judicial inquiry and compensation was paid, that the blasphemy law is open to abuse, and that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally, multilaterally and in GSP+ assessment, but gave no concrete new commitments beyond existing channels.
I do not have confirmed figures on the number of people imprisoned on charges under this law.
Ik beschik niet over geconfirmeerde cijfers over het aantal personen dat gevangen zit vanwege een beschuldiging op grond van deze wet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over Turkse vluchtelingenkampen

The MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkish refugee camps for Syrians are being used by jihadist group Jabhat al-Nusra to recruit fighters, whether Dutch funding should stop, and about the treatment of Syrian Christians in Turkey. The minister replied that no confirmed information shows recruitment in the camps, saw no reason to raise it, and said UNHCR found no evidence of sectarian violence against Christians there, while noting the Christians often choose to live outside the camps.
There is no confirmed information available about refugees in Turkish refugee camps being recruited by the terrorist organisation Jabhat al-Nusra.
Er is geen bevestigde informatie beschikbaar over vluchtelingen in Turkse vluchtelingenkampen die gerekruteerd worden door de terreurorganisatie Jahbat al Nusra.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Madlener over kwalificering van zionisme en islamkritiek als “misdaad tegen de menselijkheid”

MPs De Roon and Madlener asked the Foreign Minister how he judged Turkish Prime Minister Erdogan's calls to treat Islamophobia and Zionism as crimes against humanity, whether dialogue with such leaders was worthless, what the government had done about his hostile statements, whether Turkey was therefore an enemy of free speech, and when Turkish EU accession would be abandoned. The minister disassociated the government from Erdogan's remarks, reaffirmed support for Turkey-Israel normalisation and Turkish EU membership perspective subject to conditions, and gave only brief answers to the other questions.
I expressly distance myself from the statement of Prime Minister Erdogan.
Ik neem uitdrukkelijk afstand van de uitspraak van premier Erdoğan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Helder over Turkije‘s oorlogstaal en de Nederlandse Patriotmissie

Two PVV MPs asked whether Turkey's accusation that Israel commits state terrorism, and Turkish minister Davutoglu's remarks urging Syria toward war, warrant summoning the Turkish ambassador and withdrawing Dutch Patriot missiles from Turkey. The government replied that Turkey said its remarks were criticism of Assad rather than an incitement to attack Israel, that the Netherlands will keep pressing for steps toward rapprochement, and that it has no information linking a Netherlands-based figure to the Ankara bombing; it rejected withdrawing the Patriots.
The Netherlands will continue to urge Turkey and Israel to take steps that make rapprochement possible.
Nederland zal verder bij Turkije en Israël blijven aandringen op stappen die toenadering mogelijk maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Maij en Van Bommel over de marginalisatie van de Papua's in sociaal en economisch opzicht

Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister whether Papuans are marginalised in the exploitation of natural resources, whether large development programmes bring in immigrants, who benefits, how their land is legally protected, and how the Netherlands can help. The minister acknowledged the reports, said development is aimed at the whole population, admitted the Special Autonomy Law's consultation duty and local regulation are not consistently implemented or completed, and committed to pressing Indonesia for transparency and NGO access.
This consultation obligation is not always complied with in practice.
Deze consultatieplicht wordt in de praktijk niet altijd nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Agema over de absurde Turkse inmenging in aangelegenheden van pleegzorg in Nederland

PVV MPs De Roon and Agema asked whether Turkey may interfere in placement of Turkish foster children in the Netherlands and whether Bureau Jeugdzorg should stop contact with a Turkish inquiry commission. The state secretary answered that Dutch law already sets careful placement rules, that Turkey has no authority over Turkish-national foster children here, and that the Netherlands will explain its procedures if Turkish authorities ask.
The Turkish government has no authority over foster children in the Netherlands who have Turkish nationality.
De Turkse regering heeft geen zeggenschap over pleegkinderen in Nederland met de Turkse nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over opmerkingen van VN Speciaal Rapporteur Falk

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the foreign minister to respond to UN Special Rapporteur Richard Falk's comparison of Hamas actions with Dutch WWII resistance, and whether he should be dismissed. The minister called the comparisons inappropriate and unacceptable, said Falk's statements are his own responsibility, and stated Nederland will raise the matter in EU context but will keep contact with special rapporteurs.
A Special Rapporteur is appointed by the Human Rights Council.
Een Speciaal Rapporteur wordt aangesteld door de Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord op een aanvullende vraag van de leden De Roon en Wilders over opmerkingen van VN Speciaal Rapporteur Falk

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether he shared criticism of UN Special Rapporteur Richard Falk over alleged antisemitic remarks and whether this strengthened the case for removing him and avoiding contact. The minister answered that he was aware of these reactions and referred to his earlier answers on the same matter.
Yes, I have taken note of these reactions.
Ja, ik heb kennis genomen van deze reacties.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over een toespraak van de leider van de Palestijnse Autoriteit, Mahmoud Abbas

An MP from the PVV asked the foreign ministers whether a speech by Mahmoud Abbas glorifying early Fatah terror attacks, broadcast on the Palestinian Authority's official TV, is incitement, and whether the government will stop funding the PA under a parliamentary motion. Minister Timmermans said he is aware of the speech, that the background of the persons praised is insufficiently known, that he will continue efforts against incitement via the trilateral commission, and that PA support aims at a viable Palestinian state.
In line with the letter to parliament of 12 December 2012, I will continue to work to end incitement and calls for violence.
Conform de Kamerbrief (d.d. 12 december 2012) zal ik mij blijven inspannen voor een einde aan opruiing en aan oproepen tot geweld
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Madlener over de huisvestingskosten voor EDEO-vertegenwoordigers

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about the high residence costs of EU diplomats in Hong Kong and Moscow, EU diplomat pay and perks, an internal audit showing weak financial management, and whether the Netherlands should run its own diplomacy. The minister confirmed the rent figures, defended market-based selection and cost-benefit weighing, said Dutch pressure for austerity and budget neutrality continues, noted that EU financial rules are overseen by the Commission and the European Court of Auditors, and said he was not aware of misconduct, promising to raise it if found.
The cabinet is not aware of any misconduct. Where that is the case, the cabinet will raise it.
Het kabinet is niet bekend met misstanden. Waar dat wel het geval is, zal het kabinet dat aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over moslimextremisten in de krijgsmacht

An MP from the PVV asked the Defence Minister whether Dutch military personnel with Islamist extremist views are infiltrating the armed forces, how many are monitored, and whether they can be dismissed as Belgium reportedly cannot. The minister answered that the MIVD contributes to security, that operational details cannot be disclosed publicly, that security clearances can be withdrawn leading usually to dismissal, and that there are currently no indications requiring measures against Belgian cooperation.
No public statements can be made about the operational affairs of the MIVD.
Over operationele aangelegenheden van de MIVD kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, de Roon en Wilders over Malinese jihadisten die profiteren van Nederlands belastinggeld

PVV MPs asked whether Dutch aid to Mali, including via subsidised NGOs, benefits jihadists and should be stopped or recovered. The minister confirmed aid to the Malian government was suspended after the 2012 coup, said stopping other aid is not at issue and no grounds exist to reclaim funds, and rejected the personal accusation in question 4.
Following the coup in Mali of 22 March 2012, the Netherlands decided in April 2012 to stop aid to the Malian government.
Naar aanleiding van de staatsgreep in Mali van 22 maart 2012 besloot Nederland in april 2012 tot stopzetten van de hulp aan de Malinese overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over bericht inzake politiegeweld in Papua in december 2012

An MP asked whether the minister would review a report on police violence in Papua in December 2012, urge Indonesian authorities to allow independent foreign investigation, and have Dutch diplomats investigate and report on the incidents. The minister confirmed reading the report, said investigation is primarily Indonesia's responsibility (with the national human rights commission Komnasham), and that the Netherlands raises the issue and advocates wider access, but declined to have diplomats investigate on the ground.
Investigation of alleged human rights violations is in the first instance the responsibility of the competent Indonesian authorities.
Onderzoek naar vermeende mensenrechtenschendingen is in eerste instantie de verantwoordelijkheid van de bevoegde Indonesische autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon, Van Vliet en Wilders over het protest van Marokko tegen het korten van Nederlandse uitkeringen voor Marokkanen

PVV MPs asked whether the Dutch ambassador was summoned by Morocco over cuts to Dutch benefits paid to Moroccans, whether the ambassador was told to stay out of Dutch legislation, and whether new benefits to return migrants could be frozen. The minister replied that the ambassador met the Moroccan minister at Dutch request on a previously scheduled matter, that no summoning took place, and that freezing new benefits requires a treaty amendment, pointing to the residence-country principle and planned ending of child benefit export.
No. The Dutch ambassador met with the Moroccan Minister of Employment and Vocational Training on 9 January.
Nee. De Nederlandse ambassadeur heeft op 9 januari jl. gesproken met de Marokkaanse minister van Werkgelegenheid en Beroepsopleidingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de arrestatie van een Saudische journalist

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister how he judges the arrest of a Saudi journalist for criticizing Islam, whether he agrees the journalist should be free to say Muhammad's faith must be corrected, and whether he will press for the journalist's immediate release. The minister answered that the grounds for detention are unknown, that EU partners are investigating in Riyadh, that EU action will depend on the outcome, and that the Netherlands raises freedom of expression with Saudi authorities.
Depending on the outcome, the EU will consider whether, and if so what, action is effective and desirable.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten daarvan zal in EU-verband worden bezien of, en zo ja welke, actie effectief en wenselijk is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over dreigende deportatie van een islam-kritische filmmaker

MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether Spain is deporting Pakistani-born anti-Islam filmmaker Imran Firasat on national security grounds, whether the Netherlands will protest given possible blasphemy prosecution at home, and whether his film can be published in the Netherlands. The minister replied that Spain must assess the security threat, that Dutch intervention is not warranted, that free expression carries responsibilities for courts to judge, and that the film is already online.
It is for the Spanish authorities to assess whether this person residing in Spain poses a threat to national security.
Het is aan de Spaanse autoriteiten om te beoordelen of deze in Spanje verblijvende persoon wel of niet een bedreiging vormt voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de Islamitische kersttraditie in Nigeria.

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether Christmas-night attacks on churches in northern Nigeria reflect Islamic intolerance, whether the OIC acted against them, and whether OIC states that signed the Cairo Declaration should be excluded from the UN. The minister answered that the violence has political, socio-economic, ethnic and religious dimensions, that the OIC condemned the attacks, and that the Cairo Declaration is outdated and no reason for UN exclusion.
The violence in Nigeria has political, socio-economic, ethnic and religious dimensions.
Het geweld in Nigeria heeft politieke, sociaaleconomische, etnische en religieuze dimensies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over doodstraffen opgelegd in Egypte

An MP asked the foreign minister about death sentences in Egypt, including one for people allegedly involved in an anti-Islam film, and whether the ambassador should be expelled or recalled. The minister confirmed awareness of the sentences and the 2011 figures, stated the Netherlands opposes the death penalty and called on Egypt to uphold free expression, but rejected expelling or recalling diplomats.
That is not on the agenda.
Dat is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Madlener over de gevolgen van de forse verhoging van de Franse bieraccijns

PVV MPs asked whether France's proposed sharp increase in the beer excise, which leaves wine excise largely unchanged, would harm Dutch beer exports and whether the government would respond with countermeasures. The minister answered that Dutch beer exports to France are about 5% of total exports, that the measure does not discriminate against foreign brewers, that it is in line with EU law, and that the government sees no reason for countermeasures.
If the measure were to turn out to have a discriminatory effect indirectly, in its implementation, we will consider that.
Indien de maatregel indirect, in de uitwerking, een discriminatoir effect zou blijken te hebben, zullen wij ons daarover beraden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon, Helder en Fritsma over het overbrengen van piraten naar Nederland

PVV MPs asked whether the foreign minister is involved in deciding to transfer captured Somali pirates to the Netherlands for prosecution, why transfer to the region or flag state was not chosen, whether pirates could be tried under Dutch law in the region and serve sentences there, and whether they could obtain asylum or stay in the Netherlands. The minister answered that prosecution is reserved to the Public Prosecution Service coordinated with the foreign and defence ministers, that a clear Dutch interest (attempted murder of Dutch marines) justified prosecution here, that trial under Dutch law in the region is not possible and sentence execution in Somalia is currently not possible though capacity-building is supported, and that asylum is expected to be refused under Article 1F and sentences of 24 months or more.
Instituting criminal prosecution in the Dutch criminal justice system is reserved to the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Het instellen van strafrechtelijke vervolging is in het Nederlandse strafrechtelijke stelsel voorbehouden aan het Openbaar Ministerie (OM).
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over Nederlands geld voor een onderzoek naar kinderarbeid in de hazelnootpluk in Turkije

The MP De Roon asks why the Netherlands funds research into child labour in Turkish hazelnut picking, given Turkey's economic strength, and whether Turkey could pay itself. Minister Ploumen answers that the Turkish government is primarily responsible, that the Dutch-funded ILO project supports it, and that combating child labour also serves a level playing field for Dutch firms.
The Turkish government is primarily responsible for combating child labour in Turkey and is therefore the primary point of contact for policy.
De Turkse overheid is primair verantwoordelijk voor het tegengaan van kinderarbeid in Turkije en dus primair aanspreekpunt voor beleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over de Amerikaanse oproep om de Syrische oppositie te hervormen

An MP from the PVV asks the Foreign Minister whether the government, like the US, no longer considers the Syrian National Council worthy of Dutch support, and how it views reports of jihadist strength among rebels. The minister answers that the SNC has reorganised into a more inclusive coalition that he welcomes, acknowledges that the growing number of jihadist fighters is worrying, and pledges continued support for a credible alternative to the Syrian regime.
The Netherlands will, with its allies and through its contacts in opposition circles, provide the necessary support to build a credible alternative to the Syrian regime.
Nederland zal met haar bondgenoten en via haar contacten in oppositiekringen de nodige ondersteuning bieden om een geloofwaardig alternatief voor het Syrische regime op te bouwen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over Inbreuken op de mensenrechten in Turkije en een economische regeringsmissie

De Roon (PVV) asks the foreign minister about the conviction of 330 Turkish officers, press freedom and jailed journalists, Erdogan's push for an international ban on Islam defamation, Turkish anti-hate legislation, Islamisation, and an economic mission to Turkey despite its FATF blacklisting. Minister Timmermans answers that Turkey's rule of law, press freedom and minority protections need improvement, that Nederland rejects equating Islam defamation with crimes against humanity, and that the mission fits the ongoing political dialogue with Turkey.
Freedom of expression and press and media freedom need to be better anchored in Turkey.
De vrijheid van meningsuiting en pers- en mediavrijheid dienen beter verankerd te worden in Turkije.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en De Roon over de bloedige onderdrukking van Papoea’s in Indonesië

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about reports of lethal force against Papuan demonstrators in Indonesia, whether the government would condemn it, summon the ambassador, support a free press there, and send independent observers. The minister said the 23 October clashes in Manokwari are still under investigation, denied that repression is structural, noted limits on foreign journalists' access, and said the Netherlands will keep raising human rights through bilateral contacts and the EU dialogue, but rejected observers and sanctions-style steps.
The Netherlands will continue to raise the human rights situation in Papua and West Papua in bilateral contacts and through the EU human rights dialogue.
Nederland zal in bilaterale contacten en via de EU-mensenrechten dialoog aandacht blijven vragen voor de mensenrechtensituatie in Papua en West-Papua.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over het gebrek aan toezicht op de naleving van EU sancties tegen Iran

De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister why EU Iran sanctions compliance by member states is not supervised, whether Egypt blends Iranian oil, and how Turkey and Switzerland undermine the sanctions, among other questions. Minister Rosenthal answered that enforcement is a national responsibility, that Dutch supervision is assigned to several ministries and agencies, and that the government raises the matter with third countries and within the EU.
Implementation of sanctions, including granting licences and exemptions, enforcement, and communication with third parties about sanctions policy, is a national matter.
Uitvoering van sancties, inclusief het verlenen van vergunningen en ontheffingen, handhaving, en de communicatie met derden over het sanctiebeleid, is een nationale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over herziening van de diplomatieke betrekkingen met Iran

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would follow Canada in suspending diplomatic relations with Iran, citing Iran's support for terrorist groups, nuclear programme, Israel rhetoric and human rights record. The minister answered that the government shares concerns and keeps diplomacy and sanctions as the main tools, a communication channel open, and that suspending relations is not the moment to speculate about, though it does not rule options out.
The cabinet considers it important to keep a communication channel open with the Iranian government.
Het kabinet acht het belangrijk om een communicatiekanaal met de Iraanse regering open te houden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over herziening van de diplomatieke betrekkingen met Iran

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether the Netherlands should follow Canada in suspending diplomatic relations with Iran over its nuclear programme, human rights record, support for Syria and Hezbollah. The minister replied that the Netherlands shares concern, keeps a communication channel open, and applies pressure via diplomacy and sanctions, declining to rule out other options.
The cabinet considers it important to keep a communication channel open with the Iranian government.
Het kabinet acht het belangrijk om een communicatiekanaal met de Iraanse regering open te houden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over de hulpverlening door Nederlandse diplomaten aan Nederlanders in nood in het buitenland

An MP asked the foreign minister about complaints over how Dutch diplomats treat Dutch nationals in distress abroad, the number and handling of such complaints since 2011, safeguards for humane treatment, and whether mystery guests are used. The minister reported 1305 complaints in 2011 (mostly visa-related, and only 48 on assistance to Dutch nationals), said consular services are reviewed periodically with a client-satisfaction measure planned for 2013, and said the use of mystery guests is being considered.
The use of mystery guests is being considered.
De inzet van «mystery guests» wordt overwogen.
Antwoord vragen De Roon over de inzet van private beveiligers door Nederlandse reders

MP De Roon asks whether the Dutch shipping sector's use of armed private security guards aboard vessels, absent a legal basis, is acceptable, and whether the government will guarantee affordable, flexible naval protection or legislate for certified private guards. The minister answers that the government prioritises naval Vessel Protection Detachments, will keep monitoring level-playing-field effects and may consider further measures, while stating that the current demand for VPDs is below capacity and that Defence does not compete commercially with private firms.
The cabinet will examine whether, and if so which, additional measures, such as a further reduction of the shipowners' contribution, are needed.
Het kabinet zal bezien of, en zo ja, welke aanvullende maatregelen, zoals een verdere verlaging van de bijdrage van de reders, nodig zijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over een dodelijke aanval door piraten op een schip bij Nigeria

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about a deadly pirate attack on a ship off Nigeria that resulted in four kidnappings, and how such an attack could happen despite navy protection. The government said it has no information on the Nigerian navy's role, does not see a need for Dutch naval protection of merchant ships, and points to industry self-protection measures.
Regarding the circumstances and how it happened, the Nigerian authorities have so far made no statements.
Over de toedracht en de omstandigheden hebben de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten tot dusver geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over de beslissing van de EU om de Israëlische stad Modiin uit te sluiten van het EU Associatieakkoord

MP De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU's exclusion of Modiin from the EU-Israel Association Agreement was counterproductive and a breach of contract, and whether the government would oppose it. Minister Rosenthal answered that the agreement does not cover settlement products beyond the Green Line, that there is no breach, and that the Netherlands does not support trade sanctions as a tool in the Middle East peace process.
Products from the settlements fall outside the territorial scope of the agreement.
Producten uit de nederzettingen vallen buiten de territoriale werkingssfeer van het akkoord.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over straffeloosheid van sleutelfiguren in de Somalische piraterij

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Somali and Puntland authorities shield Somali piracy kingpins, why the UK blocked UN Security Council sanctions on pirate leaders, and the status of a regional anti-piracy prosecution centre. The minister found the reports worrying, said Somali authorities must respond to the UN Monitoring Group findings, noted international debate on whether sanctions would criminalise ransom payments, and reported that the RAPPICC centre is being set up with a Dutch commitment of EUR 300,000 and two experts, expected to be operational in early 2013.
I find these reports worrying. The Somali authorities must provide an account and explanation of the findings of the UN Monitoring Group.
Ik vind deze berichten zorgwekkend. De Somalische autoriteiten moeten tekst en uitleg geven over de bevindingen van de UN Monitoring Group.
Antwoord vragen De Roon over terroristische aanslag op Israëlische toeristen in Bulgarije

An MP asked the foreign minister whether the bombing of Israeli tourists in Bulgaria was condemned as terrorism and whether the UN Secretary-General, High Commissioner and Human Rights Council failed in their duty, and whether Dutch participation in the Council should end. The minister confirmed strong condemnation, noted UN condemnation, expressed concern about disproportionate criticism of Israel in the Council, and said the Netherlands would stay engaged to balance its work.
No, the Netherlands actively works for more balance in the work of the Human Rights Council.
Nee, Nederland zet zich actief in voor meer balans in het werk van de Mensenrechtenraad.
Antwoord vragen De Roon en Wilders over de weigering van de EU om Hezbollah als terroristische organisatie aan te merken

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked why the EU refuses to list Hezbollah as a terrorist organisation, whether EU representatives should negotiate with it, and what steps the government will take. The minister answered that EU member states lack consensus, that the Netherlands already treats Hezbollah as terrorist and has no contacts with it, that Dutch policy has not changed, and that the Netherlands will keep raising its position in EU fora.
I cannot make any further concrete public statements about this cooperation.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen verdere, concrete mededelingen doen over deze samenwerking.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Timmermans, De Roon, Ormel, Voordewind en El Fassed over het zwijgen van het Westen over de strafkampen in Noord-Korea

Six MPs asked the foreign minister why the West is silent about North Korea's prison camps, citing the HRNK report and asking about international action and China's refoulement of refugees. The minister acknowledged the report, described UN and bilateral efforts (UN resolutions, UPR, raising the issue at the UNGA, funding a Korean NGO) and said North Korea denies the camps, making dialogue difficult.
The Netherlands will again call on North Korea at the 2012 UN General Assembly to improve the human rights situation in the country, referring to the HRNK report.
Dit zal Nederland niet weerhouden tijdens de AVVN 2012 Noord-Korea opnieuw op te roepen de mensenrechtensituatie in het land te verbeteren met verwijzing naar het rapport van HNRK.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink, De Roon, Van der Staaij en Ormel over het belang van het herdenken van aanslagen

MPs from several parties asked whether the minister would use her influence to persuade the NOC*NSF and the IOC to hold a minute's silence at the London Olympic opening ceremony for the 1972 Munich attack. The minister acknowledged the tragedy but declined to intervene, saying the IOC is autonomous and it is not the government's responsibility to influence its protocols.
No. I do not consider it my responsibility to point this out to the IOC.
Neen. Ik acht het niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid het IOC hierop te wijzen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over internetcensuur door de Palestijnse autoriteit

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Palestinian Authority internet censorship, the arrests of a journalist and two bloggers, and whether Dutch aid should be cut. The minister said President Abbas ordered unblocking of websites, one journalist was released on bail, and the government sees no reason to halt cooperation, relying on dialogue and support for civil society.
The Dutch Representative in Ramallah conveyed the Dutch concerns about arrests and interrogations of journalists to the Palestinian Authority.
De Nederlandse Vertegenwoordiger in Ramallah heeft de Nederlandse zorgen over arrestaties en ondervragingen van journalisten aan de Palestijnse Autoriteit overgebracht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de door het Koeweits parlement aangenomen doodstraf voor blasfemie

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister how he views Kuwait's parliament adopting a death penalty for blasphemy and whether the Netherlands will protest, press for release of those detained, coordinate sanctions, and cut ties with OIC states. The minister answered that the Emir had sent the bill back to parliament, that the Netherlands opposes the death penalty and is raising the matter with the EU, and that it opposes stripping UN membership or minimising relations with those states.
The embassy is following this issue closely and it is being discussed at EU level at the Dutch request.
De ambassade volgt deze kwestie op de voet en deze wordt op Nederlands verzoek in EU-verband besproken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Roon over Qatar als een van de grootste grootaandeelhouders in Shell

An MP from the PVV asked the government about reports that Qatar had become a major shareholder in Shell, including the size of its stake, any other Dutch energy holdings, other Islamic investors, and the government's view of a Sunni dictatorship gaining influence. The minister said Shell does not disclose stakes below 3%, Qatar holds no known other Dutch energy stakes, the annual report does not show other investors, and that the government welcomes foreign investment within existing law.
The size of the stake has not been disclosed by Shell.
De grootte van het aandeel is door Shell niet bekendgemaakt.
Antwoord vragen De Roon over mogelijke gesprekken tussen Hamas en enkele EU-lidstaten waaronder Nederland

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands or the EU had talked with Hamas, and how this fits with Parliament's motions forbidding contact. The minister answered that contacts remain conditional on Hamas accepting the Quartet principles, that Hamas has not yet done so, and that the government implements the motions.
The government fully implements Chamber motions that make contacts with Hamas conditional on Hamas accepting the Quartet principles.
De regering geeft onverkort uitvoering aan Kamermoties die contacten met Hamas afhankelijk stellen van aanvaarding door Hamas van de Kwartetbeginselen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over het Turkse NAVO-lidmaatschap

An MP asked the foreign minister whether Turkey's blocking of NATO-Israel partnership projects is unacceptable, whether some allies oppose closer cooperation with Israel, whether Turkey sabotages Active Endeavour, and whether the answers will precede the 15 May debate. The minister confirmed the press report, said Turkey has blocked a limited number of projects involving Israel, that Netherlands and allies urged a quick resolution, and that Israel's offer to expand Active Endeavour is under consideration.
Several NATO allies, including the Netherlands, have expressed regret that this bilateral dispute affects NATO matters and have underlined the principle of non-discrimination toward partners.

Verschillende NAVO-bondgenoten, waaronder Nederland, hebben aangegeven te betreuren dat dit bilaterale geschilpunt gevolgen heeft voor NAVO-aangelegenheden en hebben het principe van non-discriminatie ten aanzien van partners onderstreept.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon, Van Bommel, Ormel, Ten Broeke en El Fassed over vrouwenrechten in Egypte

MPs from several parties asked the minister of Foreign Affairs about reports of abductions and forced conversions of Coptic girls in Egypt, the link to Salafism, and whether the government would raise women's rights with Egyptian and EU counterparts. The minister said reliable crime statistics are lacking, pointed to Egypt's wider human rights concerns, noted that Dutch government cooperation under Matra-Zuid was suspended, and listed women's rights projects being funded.
The Netherlands stresses, both in bilateral contacts with Egyptian authorities and within the EU, the importance of applying and implementing the rule of law and of countering impunity.

Nederland onderstreept zowel in bilaterale contacten met Egyptische autoriteiten, als in EU-verband, het belang van de toepassing en uitvoering van rechtsstatelijkheid en het belang om straffeloosheid tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen De Roon en Bontes over de VN-mensenrechtenraad

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister why the UN Human Rights Council adopted a report praising Qaddafi's Libya despite global criticism, why EU members on the Council agreed, and whether those states would be challenged. The minister replied that the report only records the Council's discussion of Libya's 2010 review, that Netherlands asked critical questions, and that adopting the report does not mean endorsing every statement in it.
Agreeing to the report therefore certainly does not automatically mean agreeing with everything other UN member states have put forward.
Instemming met het verslag betekent dus zeker niet per definitie instemming met al hetgeen door andere VN-lidstaten naar voren is gebracht.
Antwoord vragen De Roon, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de VN-Mensenrechtenraad

MPs De Roon, Voordewind and Van der Staaij asked the minister of Foreign Affairs whether the UN Human Rights Council's adoption of several resolutions critical of Israel, and a fact-finding mission, was disproportionate compared with its one resolution on Syria, and what the government would do about it. The minister agreed the number and character of the Israel resolutions were disproportionate, said the Netherlands argues for proportionality and has raised the concern within the EU and the UN, and answered all questions.
I consider the number of Israel resolutions and their character to be disproportionate.
Ik acht het aantal Israël-resoluties en het karakter ervan disproportioneel.
Antwoord vragen Van der Staaij, De Roon, Ormel en Voordewind over 'de sluiting van een christelijke kerk door de Palestijnse Autoriteit'

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Palestinian Authority intends to force the First Baptist Church in Bethlehem to close, and what the background is. The minister answered that the PA says it has no plan to close the church, that the church issued marriage and birth certificates without authorisation and was asked to stop or meet legal requirements, and that Christians enjoy religious freedom in the Palestinian territories.
As previously indicated, there is no intention to close the Baptist congregation in Bethlehem.
Zoals al eerder aangegeven is er geen voornemen de Baptistengemeente in Bethlehem te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de verdediging van de Palestijnse haatmoefti door de Palestijnse Autoriteit

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister why the Palestinian Authority defended a mufti whose speech incited violence, and whether Dutch funding should be cut. The minister condemned the mufti's words, said there was no evidence the PA defended them, and refused to cut funding, citing the priority of restarting peace talks and a commitment to trilateral talks against incitement.
Punishing the PA will not contribute to restarting the peace talks at this time.
Bestraffing van de PA zal op dit moment niet bijdragen aan de herstart van de vredesbesprekingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij en De Roon over de bevindingen van het boek Deception

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister about the book 'Deception' documenting Palestinian Authority incitement and glorification of terrorism, and whether Dutch aid should be conditioned on tackling it. The minister acknowledged the statements as unacceptable but argued the PA cannot be held responsible for every media statement, referred the matter to revived trilateral talks and EU channels, and rejected monthly conditional aid payments as counterproductive to peace talks.
In all its contacts with the PA, the government points to the need to counter incitement and glorification of violence.
Het kabinet wijst in al zijn contacten met de PA op de noodzaak haatzaaien en geweldverheerlijking tegen te gaan.
Antwoord vragen Helder en De Roon over het bericht ‘Ruim helft diplomaten betaalt boetes niet’

MPs Helder and De Roon asked whether foreign diplomats fail to pay over half of traffic fines and what the government does about it. The minister confirmed non-payment rates, explained that diplomatic immunity limits enforcement, and described diplomatic pressure and a planned annual reminder operation with CJIB and RDW.
That is not really possible for the period mentioned.
Dat is voor de genoemde periode niet goed mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen De Roon, Kortenoeven en Bontes over kandidaturen van Pakistan en Venezuela voor de VN Mensenrechtenraad

Three PVV MPs asked whether Pakistan and Venezuela are the only candidates for vacant UN Human Rights Council seats, whether their poor human rights records should bar them, and what the government will do to block them. The minister replied that other candidates exist under clean-slate arrangements, that human rights records weigh heavily but Netherlands does not state voting preferences, and that election of these two countries is unlikely to be prevented.
However, the Netherlands does not make statements about voting preferences in elections for UN bodies.
Nederland doet echter geen uitspraken over stemvoorkeuren bij verkiezingen voor VN-organen.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over berechting van burgers door militaire rechtbanken in Egypte (ingezonden 20 december 2011).

An MP asks the foreign minister about civilians, including Coptic cyberactivist Maikel Nabil, being tried and jailed by Egyptian military courts, whether this is intimidation, and whether Egypt will face consequences such as aid cuts. The minister confirms Nabil's sentence was reduced and he was released after amnesty, says the Netherlands has raised the issue bilaterally and multilaterally, and says aid is being wound down but frozen funds would mainly hurt the Egyptian population.
I share the view that it is undesirable for civilians to be tried by military courts.
Ik deel de mening dat het onwenselijk is dat burgers door militaire rechtbanken worden berecht.
Antwoord vragen Bontes en Wilders over de Nederlandse ambassadeur in Pretoria

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Dutch ambassador in Pretoria, who had 'liked' a Facebook page opposing a government supported by the PVV, should be disqualified and what measures would be taken. The minister confirmed the ambassador should have refrained from publicly expressing such a political view, that he has been addressed on it, and that he has since unliked the page.
Mr Haspels has been addressed on this and has in the meantime unliked the relevant Facebook page.
De heer Haspels is hierop aangesproken en heeft de betreffende Facebook-pagina inmiddels «ge-unliked».

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon (PVV), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over de arrestatie van twee leiders van de op te richten christendemocratische part

Four MPs asked the foreign minister about the arrest of two leaders of an intended Christian Democratic party in Belarus, whether it was linked to the party's founding, and what the government would do. The minister answered that the two were detained to prevent them attending a party congress, condemned the ongoing repression, and said Netherlands and the EU would continue to raise the matter bilaterally, in the OSCE and at the UN, and through expanded EU sanctions criteria.
I strongly condemn the ongoing repression.
Ik veroordeel de voortdurende repressie scherp.
Antwoord vragen De Roon en Kortenoeven over de boycot van Iraanse olie

MPs De Roon and Kortenoeven asked the Foreign Minister about Greek objections to an EU boycott of Iranian oil, possible compensation arrangements, costs, Turkey's exemption request and the Halkbank position. The minister replied that EU talks on compensating supply and modalities are ongoing, that a ban is not expected to cause direct extra costs but may briefly raise oil prices, that Turkey is not covered by an EU ban, and that EU sanctions apply to Halkbank's European branches.
At this moment, discussions are taking place at EU level about a ban on the import of Iranian oil into the EU.
Op dit moment wordt in EU-verband gesproken over een verbod op de import van Iraanse olie in de EU.
Antwoord vragen De Roon over invallen bij mensenrechtenorganisaties in Egypte

MP De Roon asked whether the Egyptian government's raids on human rights NGOs were brutal and whether Dutch funds to Egypt should be frozen. Minister Rosenthal expressed serious concern about the raids, noted the EU High Representative had also raised concern, and said bilateral development aid is being phased out while the remaining funds, channelled through NGOs supporting the transition, should not be frozen.
Freedom of assembly and freedom of expression are essential in a democratic constitutional state.
Vrijheid van samenscholing en vrijheid van meningsuiting zijn essentieel in een democratische rechtsstaat.
Antwoord vragen De Roon en Wilders over de houding van de Nederlandse regering ten tijde van de Holocaust

Two PVV MPs asked the prime minister whether he would apologise, as Borst and Zalm had suggested, for the Dutch government's passive stance in London during the persecution of Jews in WWII. Rutte answered that the 2000 advisory reports contained nothing significant on that stance and that no broad-based advice or objective information warranted a new government position, so he would not apologise.
The cabinet does not have a broadly supported advice from those involved or objective information that warrants a cabinet position like that of 21 March 2000.
Het kabinet beschikt terzake niet over een breed gedragen advies uit de kring van betrokkenen of geobjectiveerde informatie die noopt tot een kabinetsstandpunt als dat van 21 maart 2000.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over moslim-aanval op christenen in Egypte (ingezonden 5 december 2011).

De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister about reports of mob attacks on Coptic Christians in El Ghorayzat, Egypt, including late arrival of security forces, and urged the government to take a harder diplomatic stance such as summoning the Egyptian ambassador. Minister Rosenthal answered that the incident stemmed from a neighbourhood dispute, that Egyptian authorities could not prevent deaths, and that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised Coptic protection bilaterally, including after the visa refusal for De Roon.
The Dutch concern about the situation of Copts in Egypt has been raised several times and at various levels in bilateral contacts.
De Nederlandse zorg over de situatie van Kopten in Egypte is, meerdere keren en op verschillende niveaus in bilaterale contacten aan de orde gesteld.
Vragen van de leden De Roon en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over systematische foltering onder de Libische Overgangsraad (ingezonden 17 oktober 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether, given the Amnesty report on torture by Libya's Transitional Council, Dutch aid would be cut under the 'more for more, less for less' principle. The minister answered that the new authorities have assured him abuses will not be tolerated, that he will keep monitoring, and that he will raise it with the transitional government and take measures if abuses continue.
If it appears that the abuses continue to take place on the part of the government, I will address the new transitional government on this and take appropriate measures where necessary.
Als blijkt dat de misstanden van overheidswege blijven plaatsvinden, zal ik de nieuwe overgangsregering daarop aanspreken en indien nodig gepaste maatregelen treffen.

Vragen van de leden Driessen en De Roon (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat UNESCO het zogenaamde «Palestina» heeft geaccepteerd als volw

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would cut or reduce its UNESCO funding after UNESCO admitted Palestine as a full member, following the US decision to stop its UNESCO funding. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, gave Dutch contribution figures (about 4.6 million euro mandatory in 2011, around 20 million total per year), and rejected any financial sanction as the Palestinian request is no reason to punish UNESCO.
No, the Palestinian application for full membership of UNESCO is no reason to punish UNESCO as an organisation.
Nee, de Palestijnse aanvraag voor volledig lidmaatschap van de UNESCO is geen reden om de UNESCO als organisatie te straffen.

Vragen van de leden Çörüz en Omtzigt (beiden CDA), Timmermans (PvdA), De Roon (PVV), Van Bommel (SP), Schouw (D66), Voordewind (CU), Thieme (PvdD) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het a

MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that the UK had secretly banned Russian officials linked to the death of lawyer Magnitsky from entering, whether Russian investigations could still be trusted, and whether the Netherlands would ban the same officials. The minister replied that no visa ban was introduced by the UK or US, that Russia has continued prosecuting doctors, and that the Netherlands would raise the matter as it has before, without committing to a new measure.
The government has repeatedly expressed its concern about the death of Mr Magnitsky and the circumstances under which he died.
De regering heeft herhaaldelijk haar zorg uitgesproken over de dood van de heer Magnitsky en over de omstandigheden waaronder hij is overleden

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het verheerlijken van terrorisme door de Palestijnse Autoriteit (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and De Roon asked the foreign minister whether the Palestinian Authority glorifies terrorism through statements by Abbas's adviser, street naming, and prisoner and family payments, and how this squares with earlier answers and the adopted motion to cut aid. The minister answered that the statements cannot be confirmed in context, the government rejects glorification of terror, the issue is raised in EU human rights dialogue, prisoner aid is a standard welfare practice, and there is no structural PA policy of glorifying terrorism, so no aid cut is warranted.
In light of the above answers, I currently see no reason to end bilateral or EU development cooperation with the PA.
In het licht van bovenstaande antwoorden zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding om de bilaterale of de EU-ontwikkelingssamenwerking met de PA te beëindigen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon en Kortenoeven (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verheerlijking van gew

Opposition MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP and PVV asked the Foreign Minister why the Palestinian Authority glorifies terrorism and pays salaries and prisoner allowances to terrorists, despite Dutch funding, and whether Dutch aid should be cut. The minister acknowledged sympathy for terrorism among part of the population, said PA leaders distance themselves from terrorism, rejected that the aid funded terrorist payments, and saw no reason to halt the payments or the Dutch contribution.
I see no reason to call on the PA to revise this arrangement.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de PA op te roepen deze regeling te herzien.
Vragen van de leden De Roon en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een Jihad-oproep in Polen (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether a call to violent jihad displayed by Polish football fans is unacceptable and antisemitic, and what Poland should do to prevent it. The minister called the banner inappropriate, said it could be seen as antisemitic, and noted that Polish prosecutors and UEFA are acting, which he considers an adequate response.
The Polish Public Prosecution Service is investigating whether a criminal offence has occurred and will decide on further steps based on the results.
Het Poolse Openbaar Ministerie onderzoekt of er sprake is van een strafbaar feit en zal naar aanleiding van de resultaten een besluit nemen over verdere stappen
Vragen van de leden De Roon, Bontes en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over nog meer Europees geld voor de Palestijnse Autoriteit (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether Europe should stop sending hundreds of millions of euros to the Palestinian Authority, which they called corrupt and tolerant of terrorist attacks, and what the government could do to oppose the subsidy. The minister answered that EU aid supports the Israeli-Palestinian peace process, that the PA cooperates with Israel against terrorism, and that the funding follows Dutch policy, without committing to any new action.
This funding is in line with the policy of the Netherlands.
Deze financiering ligt in het verlengde van het beleid van Nederland.

Vragen namens de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en De Roon (PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het terugdraaien van het besluit om de tegoeden van IHH-N

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP and PVV asked whether the government would appeal a court ruling that suspended the freezing of IHH-Nederland's assets over alleged Hamas links, and how it could guarantee funds do not reach Hamas, including via IHH-Germany. The minister answered that the government argued in court for keeping the freeze, that the ruling is only a provisional measure with no appeal possible, that the objection has now been rejected so IHH-Nederland can take the matter to the administrative court, and that German authorities supervise IHH-Germany's finances so no separate information request is planned.
However, no appeal is possible against the ruling of the provisional relief judge.
Tegen de uitspraak van de voorlopige voorzieningenrechter is echter geen beroep mogelijk.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon (PVV) en Ormel (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verwijzing naar de islamitische wetgeving in de «routekaart» van de Transit

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, PVV and CDA asked the foreign minister about the TNC Libya roadmap's reference to Islam as state religion and sharia as main legislative source, and whether this affects recognition of the TNC. The minister answered that the draft charter guarantees religious freedom and non-discrimination, that the NTC does not aim for a strict Islamic regime, and that Libya itself decides on a state religion while being bound by the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
It is up to (the 'new') Libya to determine whether it wants a state religion, and if so which one.
Het is aan (het «nieuwe») Libië om te bepalen of het een staatsgodsdienst wil, en zo ja welke.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon (PVV) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over steun van de gemeente Vlaardingen aan ini

MPs asked the ministers whether the municipality of Vlaardingen and its mayor, through subsidies and participation in a Palestinian event, supported the Gaza flotilla and anti-Israel activity, and whether this fits the law and the government's Middle East policy. The minister answered that the mayor attended in a civic capacity, that the municipality had no subsidy relationship with the organisations named, and that the government would intervene if a local authority supported antisemitic or terrorist organisations.
The government therefore does not consider the conduct of the municipality of Vlaardingen and of the mayor in this matter to be targeted support for the Gaza flotilla.
Het optreden van de gemeente Vlaardingen en van de burgemeester in onderliggende kwestie beschouwt de regering derhalve niet als gerichte ondersteuning van de Gaza-vloot.
Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven en De Roon (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse zaken over de Iraanse rol bij het geweld tegen burgers in Syrië (ingezonden 18 augustus 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether reported Iranian snipers in Syria are true, how Iranian involvement should be classified, what consequences apply to officials, and whether the Netherlands will lead on prosecuting external accomplices of the Syrian regime. The minister said he cannot verify the report, condemned Iranian involvement, noted EU sanctions on Revolutionary Guard commanders and the Al-Quds unit, and reported no indications of other external parties.
I cannot assess whether this specific report is true.
Ik kan niet beoordelen of dit specifieke bericht op waarheid berust.
Vragen van de leden De Roon, Bontes en Helder (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over «Betalen om aangifte te mogen doen» (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

Three PVV MPs asked whether victims in Greece must now pay 100 euros before filing a police report, and whether the Dutch embassy would advance the fee to stranded Dutch citizens. The government answered that the fee applies only to minor offences such as insult, slander, family theft and minor injury, that serious crimes are free, and that the consulate has received no complaints.
For offences such as robbery, mugging, theft or serious bodily injury no fee is payable.
Voor misdrijven zoals overval, beroving, diefstal of ernstig lichamelijk letsel is geen bijdrage verschuldigd.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over niet aflatend islamitisch geweld tegen christenen in Egypte (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

PVV MP De Roon asks the foreign minister whether recent violence against Christians in Egypt killed eight and wounded over a hundred, whether it reflects structural Islamist attacks, and whether relations should be cut if the Muslim Brotherhood gains government power. The minister confirms 15 dead and 242 injured in the Imbaba clashes, says sectarian tensions have risen and that Egypt's authorities were pressed to protect all citizens, and states the government supports democratic transition while assessing parties on democratic and rule-of-law principles.

The cabinet will assess political parties participating in the political process in the Arab region on the extent to which they meet democratic and rule-of-law principles and make these conditions for cooperation.

Het kabinet zal politieke partijen die deelnemen aan het politieke proces in de Arabische regio beoordelen op de mate waarin zij voldoen aan democratische en rechtsstatelijke beginselen en deze als voorwaarden stellen voor samenwerking.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over nalatigheid VN bij grens Israël-Syrië (ingezonden 8 juni 2011).

De Roon asks the foreign minister whether UNDOF was absent from the Israel-Syria border zone on 15 May and 5 June 2011 and whether the UN took steps to prevent protesters entering, and whether the secretary-general's statement was known. Minister Rosenthal confirms knowledge of the statement, says UNDOF was present and in contact with Syrian and Israeli forces, and that the demonstrations were under Syrian control.
The report of the UN Secretary-General (S/2011/359) shows that UNDOF was present in the border zone on 15 May and 5 June.
Uit het verslag van de secretaris-generaal van de Verenigde Naties (S/2011/359) blijkt dat de United Nations Disengagement Observer Force aanwezig was in de grenszone op 15 mei en 5 juni

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Ten Broeke (VVD), De Roon (PVV) een Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de nieuwe Gaza-flottielje (ingezonden 21

MPs from four parties asked the foreign and justice ministers whether a Dutch charity (ISRAA) collected 100,000 euro for a new Gaza flotilla, whether an Italian partner and the Union of Good are linked, and whether this warrants reviewing participating organisations or stopping the flotilla. The government answered that Greece has banned the ships from sailing, that it cannot confirm the donation figure or the Union of Good links, and that it cannot prevent private persons or organisations from participating despite discouraging it.
I cannot make any statements about possible links with the Union of Good.
Ik kan geen mededelingen doen over mogelijke banden met de Union of Good.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mogelijke schending van het Libisch wapenembargo (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether reported French arms drops to Libyan rebels violated the UN arms embargo, and what steps the government would take. The minister confirmed the drop of light weapons and ammunition, said the embargo applies to all states, and noted France acted bilaterally to protect civilians without commenting on any breach or planned diplomatic follow-up.
France supplied the light weapons and ammunition on a bilateral basis to protect civilians in the area concerned
Frankrijk heeft de lichte wapens en munitie op bilaterale titel geleverd ter bescherming van de burgers in het betreffende gebied
Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), De Roon (PVV) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de groeiende crisis tussen Hamas en Israël (ingezonden 13 april 2011).

MPs Voordewind, De Roon and Van der Staaij asked the foreign minister about the Hamas-Israel crisis, including the EU High Representative's statement on violence, the Arab League's call for a no-fly zone over Gaza, and whether the Arab League had condemned rocket fire. The minister answered that the EU statement does not equate both sides, opposed a no-fly zone, and said the Arab League had not issued the condemnation, a difference to be discussed in regular meetings.
Such a condemnation has not been issued by the Arab League.
Een dergelijke veroordeling is niet door de Arabische Liga uitgebracht.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het onthaal van terroriste Leila Khaled in Zweden (ingezonden 7 juni 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether Leila Khaled, a PFLP figure, should have been given access and public platforms in Sweden, and whether the Swedish ambassador should be questioned. The minister replied that each EU state decides admission independently under existing rules, that Sweden was not involved in her public appearances, and that there was no ground to raise it with the ambassador.
I therefore have no grounds to raise this with the Swedish ambassador.
Ik heb daarom geen grond om de Zweedse ambassadeur hierop aan te spreken.
Vragen van de leden De Roon en De Jong (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over een Israelische spoorlijn (ingezonden 12 mei 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign and infrastructure ministers whether the Netherlands should offer to help complete a Tel Aviv–Jerusalem rail line after Deutsche Bahn withdrew under pressure from activists. Minister Rosenthal said the government knows of the withdrawal but sees no role for the Dutch state in building rail lines in highly developed countries like Israel absent a clear Dutch economic interest.

The government sees no general task for the Dutch government to assist in building rail lines in highly developed countries such as Israel, unless there is a demonstrable economic interest for the Netherlands or Dutch market parties.
