De regering ziet in het algemeen geen taak voor de Nederlandse overheid om behulpzaam te zijn bij de aanleg van spoorlijnen in landen met een hoge economische ontwikkeling zoals Israël, tenzij er een aanwijsbaar economisch belang voor Nederland of voor Nederlandse marktpartijen is.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over verzoening tussen Hamas en Fatah (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

An MP from the PVV asks the foreign minister how the government views Hamas-Fatah reconciliation, whether it would doom peace talks, whether aid to the Palestinian Authority should stop if Hamas joins a unity government, and whether the government will oppose unilateral recognition of a Palestinian state. The minister answers that the Hamas-Fatah deal must be tested against the Quartet principles, that indirect Hamas financing is excluded, and that the government already opposes unilateral recognition.
The government continues to make contact with Hamas dependent on acceptance of the Quartet principles.
De regering blijft contact met Hamas afhankelijk stellen van aanvaarding van de kwartetbeginselen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en De Roon (PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en Veiligheid en Justitie over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij de nieuwe Gaza-flottielje (ingezon

MPs Voordewind, Van der Staaij and De Roon asked whether the government would act against Dutch involvement in a new Gaza flotilla, including links between organisers and Hamas, a possible terrorism past of the Dutch organiser, and whether the Public Prosecution Service is investigating related organisations and whether the flotilla should be banned. The government answered that existing information does not justify action against the individuals, declined to comment on criminal records or any ongoing investigation for investigative reasons, and said it cannot prevent departures but strongly discourages participation.

As far as the question concerns whether criminal investigation is taking place or not, no statement can be made about this, because it may undermine investigative interests, not even on whether such an investigation is or is not ongoing.

Voor zover de vraag betrekking heeft op het al dan niet plaatsvinden van strafrechtelijk onderzoek, kan hierover, vanwege het mogelijk doorkruisen van opsporingsbelangen, geen enkele mededeling worden gedaan, ook niet ten aanzien van de vraag of dergelijk onderzoek wel of niet loopt.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over erkenning van Palestijnse staat als pressiemiddel (ingezonden 28 april 2011).

An MP asks the foreign minister whether recognising a Palestinian state is a bad pressure tool in the Middle East peace process and whether the minister will persuade European partners against premature recognition. The minister answers that the Netherlands favours a comprehensive two-state agreement, that unilateral steps do not help, and that the Dutch position is conveyed to partners including at the upcoming Foreign Affairs Council.
Unilateral steps do not contribute to the process.
Unilaterale stappen dragen niet bij aan het proces.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over verstoring van de dodenherdenking door Gretta Duisenberg (ingezonden 11 mei 2011).

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether Gretta Duisenberg still holds a Dutch diplomatic passport after her behaviour during the national remembrance ceremony, and whether it should be revoked. The minister answered that she no longer holds such a passport, so the remaining questions did not apply.
No. Mrs Duisenberg has not held a Dutch diplomatic passport for some time.
Neen. Mevrouw Duisenberg beschikt al geruime tijd niet meer over een Nederlands diplomatiek paspoort.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over transitiegesprekken in Egypte (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would press Egypt against giving the Muslim Brotherhood a role in its transition and threaten to end the EU-Egypt association agreement if it gains influence. The minister answered that Egyptians must decide who governs, that the Brotherhood could gain influence depending on elections, and that the government will judge parties on democratic and rule-of-law principles.
In that, it is up to the Egyptian people to determine who governs Egypt.
Daarin is het aan het Egyptische volk om te bepalen wie Egypte regeert.

Vragen van de leden De Roon en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de band van de Venezolaanse minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Justitie met Hezbollah (ingezonden 15 februari 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reported ties between Venezuela's interior minister and Hezbollah, including whether Venezuelan passport holders should be screened and whether the minister's sister, newly appointed ambassador to the Netherlands, is acceptable. The minister denied knowledge of supporting facts, said Venezuelan passport holders already undergo standard checks, and explained that agrément is granted absent grounds such as human rights violations, terrorism or espionage, none of which applied.
Because none of this applies in the case of Ms Aissami, she received agrément in the usual way.
Omdat hiervan in het geval van mevrouw Aissami geen sprake is, heeft zij op de gebruikelijke wijze agrément ontvangen.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Iraanse wapenleveranties aan Hezbollah (Libanon) via Gambia (ingezonden 29 maart 2011).

Mr De Roon (PVV) asked the Foreign Minister whether Iranian weapons shipped via Nigeria to Gambia were meant for Hezbollah, whether the UN is investigating, and whether the House will be kept informed of a Nigerian prosecution. The minister said the government has no information confirming a Hezbollah destination, the UN investigation is ongoing with the final destination not yet established, and the House will be informed after a Nigerian court ruling.
The Dutch government will inform the House of Representatives, after a ruling by the Nigerian court, about the outcome of this criminal trial.
De Nederlandse regering zal de Tweede Kamer, na een uitspraak van de Nigeriaanse rechter, informeren over de uitkomsten van dit strafproces.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over uitbuiting van onder andere Saoedi-Arabische diplomatenpersoneel in Nederland (ingezonden 29 maart 2011).

De Roon asks whether Saudi diplomatic staff are exploited and held against their will, requests a register of complaints since 2005 by country, and asks whether passport confiscation and periodic checks should be prohibited or introduced. The minister says Dutch inspectorates lack powers over foreign embassies under the Vienna Convention, lists four complaints since 2005 with no deprivation of liberty found, cannot disclose employers' nationality for privacy reasons, and states that passport confiscation is never allowed and that periodic checks already exist via in-person ID collection.
Due to the privacy of those involved, I am legally not permitted to provide information on the nationality of the employer or employee.
In verband met de privacy van de betrokkenen is het mij wettelijk niet toegestaan informatie te geven over de nationaliteit van werkgever of werknemer.
Vragen van de leden De Roon en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over aanvallen van moslims op christenen in Ethiopië (ingezonden 8 maart 2011).

PVV MPs De Roon and Bontes asked the foreign minister about attacks by Muslims on Christians in Ethiopia and whether the Netherlands would raise this internationally and with the Ethiopian government. The minister confirmed the Jimma-zone attacks, described Dutch efforts on religious freedom at the EU and UN Human Rights Council, and said Ethiopian authorities had responded adequately so no further pressure was needed.
I therefore currently see no need to press the Ethiopian government for additional protection.
Ik zie derhalve op dit moment geen noodzaak om bij de Ethiopische regering aan te dringen op extra bescherming.
Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), De Roon (PVV) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over uitspraken van de Britse premier Cameron (ingezonden 15 maart 2011).

Three MPs asked the foreign minister about UK Prime Minister Cameron's statement that Israel may search ships bound for Gaza, and about a planned new Gaza flotilla and a preparatory meeting in Amsterdam. The minister confirmed Israel's inspection powers under the Oslo accords and naval blockade law, said no EU support drive was needed, opposed unfacilitated flotilla participation, and declined to ban the Amsterdam meeting.
As for measures to prohibit meetings such as the one in Amsterdam, I currently see neither the possibilities nor the reason to do so.
Voor maatregelen om bijeenkomsten zoals die in Amsterdam te verbieden, zie ik op dit moment mogelijkheden noch aanleiding.
Vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het recente geweld tegen Koptische christenen in Egypte (ingezonden 15 maart 2011)

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports of violence against Coptic Christians in Egypt in March 2011, including the Helwan and Mokattam clashes, and whether Egypt's Muslim Brotherhood influence and the EU association agreement should be used as leverage. The minister confirmed the events in outline, disputed some casualty figures, said the Dutch embassy had raised the issue with Egyptian authorities and that the EU had raised it at the UN Human Rights Council, and stated that further EU measures would be considered if the situation worsened.
In the EU context, the Netherlands advocates swift implementation of concrete measures following the February Council conclusions on freedom of religion.
Nederland pleit in EU-verband voor snelle uitvoering van concrete maatregelen naar aanleiding van de raadsconclusies over godsdienstvrijheid van de Raad van februari jl.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over verering van een zelfmoordterroriste door UNRWA (ingezonden 9 maart 2011).

De Roon (PVV) asked whether UNRWA honours a Palestinian female suicide bomber by naming a football tournament after her, whether the Palestinian Authority glorifies her, and whether the government will press UNRWA and the PA to stop. The minister replied that the report is incorrect, UNRWA has not run youth centres in the West Bank for over a decade, the logo was used without authorisation and UNRWA has asked for its removal, and the PA condemns terrorism, so no further action is needed.

Vragen van de leden De Roon en Bontes (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het uitroepen van dag van staatsgreep door Bouterse als Surinaamse nationale feestdag (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would condemn Surinamese president Bouterse's declaration of the 1980 coup anniversary as a national holiday, boycott the celebration, lower flags at the embassy, and urge other missions to do the same. The minister answered that the Netherlands rejects seizing power undemocratically, that Surinam decides its own holidays, that the Netherlands will not take part in the celebration, and that the embassy will open normally with no special flag protocol.
However, it is for the Surinamese government to determine which days are designated as national holidays.
Het is evenwel aan de Surinaamse overheid om te bepalen welke dagen als nationale feestdag worden aangemerkt.
Vragen van de leden De Roon, Kortenoeven, Bontes en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een rapport van «EU-diplomaten» over Jeruzalem (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

Four PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether he would distance the Netherlands from an EU diplomats' report suggesting East Jerusalem be treated as a Palestinian capital, and whether Dutch diplomats contributed to it and whether the report should be discarded. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports a two-state solution with Jerusalem's final status left to negotiation, that the report was largely factual with options the Netherlands endorsed only where they maintained existing policy, and that Dutch contributions followed government policy and distanced the Netherlands from calls contrary to it.
Options that anticipate the outcomes of the final status negotiations have not been supported by the Netherlands.
Opties die vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van de finalestatusonderhandelingen zijn niet door Nederland ondersteund.
Vragen van de leden De Roon, Kortenoeven en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een bomaanslag op Egyptische christenen (ingezonden 4 januari 2011).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about a New Year's bombing of a Coptic church in Alexandria, including whether Egyptian security withdrew shortly before the attack and whether the ambassador should be summoned to demand better protection of Christians. The minister said the reports of security presence conflict, the prosecutor is investigating, extra security had been ordered after warnings, and he had asked Egypt in a condolence letter to protect religious minorities.
The investigation into the bombing in Alexandria is led by the public prosecutor-general.
Het onderzoek naar de bomaanslag in Alexandrië wordt geleid door de openbaar hoofdaanklager.

Vragen van de leden Ormel (CDA), De Roon (PVV), Voordewind (CU), Van der Staaij (SGP) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een ten dood veroordeling in Pakistan (ingezonden 11 november 2010).

MPs from several parties asked the foreign minister about the death sentence imposed on Asia Bibi in Pakistan for blasphemy, whether it increases threats to Christians, how many others are detained on similar charges, where Pakistan's blasphemy and Hudud laws conflict with the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, and whether the Netherlands will protest. The minister condemned the sentence, noted an appeal is possible, said blasphemy laws are misused and fall hardest on religious minorities, and reported that the Netherlands and the EU have repeatedly raised concerns with Pakistani authorities, including a planned joint letter to the prime minister.
The Netherlands has repeatedly expressed its concerns about the blasphemy legislation to the Pakistani authorities over the past year.
Nederland heeft in het afgelopen jaar herhaaldelijk zijn zorgen over de blasfemiewetgeving aan de Pakistaanse autoriteiten kenbaar gemaakt.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Ormel (CDA), Van der Staaij (SGP), Nicolaï (VVD) en De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over acht Iraanse functionarissen op een zwarte lijst van de VS (ing

Five MPs from ChristenUnie, CDA, SGP, VVD and PVV asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would bar eight Iranian officials on a US blacklist (for the 2009 crackdown) from entry and freeze their assets, and whether EU sanctions could target other Iranian human-rights abusers. The minister confirmed the US list, said no Dutch or EU legal basis exists for such entry bans or asset freezes on human-rights grounds, promised to explore EU options with partners, and noted the EU Iran sanctions regime targets the nuclear programme.
The government will contact European partners as soon as possible to examine the possibilities for enabling EU sanctions against Iranian human-rights violators.
De regering zal zo spoedig mogelijk in contact treden met Europese partners om te onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om EU-sancties tegen Iraanse mensenrechtenschenders mogelijk te maken.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP) en De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het artikel in NRC-H waarin de directeur van de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG)

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP and PVV asked the foreign minister whether the Tel Aviv embassy and ministry contacted the VNG to warn against a visit by Israeli mayors from settlements, and whether such contacts are consistent with the illegality of settlements. The minister confirmed reading the article, said the ministry contacted the VNG and explained government policy, stated that contacts with settlers are not illegal, and said government contacts with settlement authorities in principle do not take place.
The department contacted the VNG and in the subsequent conversation informed the VNG about the policy lines the central government follows.
Het departement heeft contact opgenomen met de VNG en in het daaropvolgende gesprek heeft het departement de VNG geïnformeerd over de beleidslijnen die de Rijksoverheid hanteert.

Vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over sterke toename van de raket- en mortierbeschietingen uit de Gazastrook op Israëlische burgers (ingezonden 11 oktober 2010).

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the foreign minister about a sharp rise in rocket and mortar attacks from Gaza on Israeli civilians, whether these aim to derail peace talks, and whether Israel may use all means against Hamas. The minister answered that the attacks are harmful to the peace process, that Netherlands does not talk with Hamas absent the Quartet conditions, and that Israel has the right to protect itself within international law, which the Netherlands supports.
The Netherlands does not talk with Hamas as long as Hamas does not unambiguously accept the well-known Quartet conditions.
Met Hamas wordt door Nederland niet gepraat zolang Hamas de bekende kwartetvoorwaarden niet ondubbelzinnig aanvaardt.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Justitie over verlies van vertrouwelijke stukken door een lid van de Hoge Raad (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a Supreme Court justice acted carelessly by losing confidential case files on a train, what the consequences were, whether the court's security rules apply, and whether disciplinary rules for judges exist. The minister confirmed the incident, said the files were reconstructable from scanned electronic records, said the Supreme Court has its own responsibility and only reminded staff internally of the risks, and stated that conduct of Supreme Court members is reserved to the Court itself.
Assessing the conduct of members of the Supreme Court is reserved to the Supreme Court itself.
Het beoordelen van gedragingen van leden van de Hoge Raad is voorbehouden aan de Hoge Raad zelf.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over handhavingsbeleid snelheidsovertredingen op autosnelwegen (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether, pending the coalition agreement's planned rise of the motorway speed limit from 120 to 130 km/h, fines for speeding up to 11 km/h over the current limit should stop and fines already issued be withdrawn. The minister refused, stating that enforcing 130 km/h is only possible once the rules are amended, and said the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment would report in early next year.
No. Enforcing a maximum speed of 130 km/h is only possible after the rules on this have been amended.
Nee. Het handhaven van een maximaal snelheid van 130 km /u is pas mogelijk nadat de regels dienaangaande zijn aangepast.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken naar aanleiding van de veroordeling van Israël door de VN Mensenrechtenraad (ingezonden 24 september 2010)

An MP from the PVV asks the foreign minister whether the UN Human Rights Council is biased against Israel after its condemnation over the Gaza flotilla raid, and whether Israel may reject the findings. The minister answers that the Council is a political body with some objectivity limits, that Israel's own and UN inquiries are still running, and that the government will make its final assessment once all reports are published.
The government intends to make its final assessment once all investigations have been published.
De regering is voornemens haar finale afweging te maken zodra alle onderzoeken zijn gepubliceerd.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over verkrachtingen van vredesactivistes door Palestijnen in Judea en Samaria (ingezonden 24 september 2010).

MP De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether female peace activists in Judea and Samaria are systematically raped or harassed by Palestinians, whether this is concealed, and whether investigation is warranted. The minister answered that combating sexual violence against women is a Dutch policy pillar, that no information on the phenomenon or Dutch victims is known, and that no reason for further investigation is seen.
I have no information about the phenomenon you describe, nor about possible Dutch victims.
Mij is geen informatie bekend over het fenomeen dat u beschrijft, ook niet over mogelijke Nederlandse slachtoffers.
Vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een werkbezoek van Israëlische burgemeesters (ingezonden 21 september 2010).

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether the government or the VNG objected to a study visit by Israeli mayors from settlements and whether the government legitimises their office. The minister answered that the government does not maintain contacts with settlement authorities, considers the settlements illegal under international law, but does not prevent other organisations such as the VNG from deciding independently on contacts.
However, this does not mean that the government prevents others from maintaining contacts with them.
Dit betekent echter niet dat de regering anderen verhindert om contacten met hen te onderhouden.

Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de ministers van Justitie, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat de politie en de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (A

An MP asked the ministers whether police and the AIVD ignored threats against a Dutch entrepreneur who refused to supply dangerous chemicals to Iranians, and how businesses are warned. The minister answered that the AIVD found no reason for further investigation but advised the entrepreneur to go to police, that police have invited him to file a complaint, and that customs is also examining the case, while declining to discuss protection measures for individuals.
After carrying out the investigation, the AIVD advised the Dutch entrepreneur to turn to the police regarding the threat.
De AIVD heeft na uitvoering van het onderzoek de Nederlandse ondernemer aangeraden zich voor wat betreft de bedreiging te wenden tot de politie.

Vragen van de leden De Roon, Kortenoeven en Wilders (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de militaire opbouw in Zuid-Libanon, van de met Iran samenspannende islamitische terreur- en jihadbeweging Hezbo

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about Hezbollah's military buildup in southern Lebanon, alleged arms stockpiles, and whether the arms embargo and UNIFIL had failed under Resolution 1701. The minister answered that concern exists, that UNIFIL has no mandate to verify Hezbollah's capacity, that the embargo did not fail, and that disarmament must be pursued through the Lebanese political process.
The UN has no mandate to verify the exact capacity itself.
De VN heeft geen mandaat om de exacte capaciteit zelf te kunnen verifiëren.

Vragen van de leden Bontes en De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat Spanje haar zorgen heeft geuit over het uitzetten van christenen uit Marokko (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister whether about 130 Christians have been expelled from Morocco since March 2010, how many hold Dutch nationality, and whether the government shares Spain's concern and will raise it with Morocco. The minister confirmed roughly 130 expulsions on proselytism grounds (exact number unknown), seven Dutch Christians expelled and two residence permits withdrawn, shared the concern, summoned the Moroccan ambassador on 9 March, and pledged to keep raising religious freedom with Morocco.
On 9 March I summoned the Moroccan ambassador to protest the expulsion of Dutch Christians.
Op 9 maart j.l. heb ik de Marokkaanse ambassadeur nog ontboden om tegen de uitzetting van Nederlandse christenen te protesteren

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Wilders, Bontes en De Roon (allen PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de positie van oliemaatschappij Koninklijke Nederlandse Shell onder het (aan te scherpen) sanctieregime

PVV MPs asked the foreign minister about reports that Shell had halted or resumed gasoline sales to Iran, and whether Shell would receive an exemption under tightened EU sanctions. The government said Shell reported no gasoline sales since October 2009 and that a later report was based on an erroneous port inspection, and it declined to discuss individual companies in the EU Foreign Affairs Council.
The Council will not speak about individual companies.
De Raad zal niet over individuele bedrijven spreken.

Vragen van de leden Kortenoeven, Wilders, De Roon en Van Vliet (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de positie van oliemaatschappij Koninklijke Nederlandse Shell onder het (aa

PVV MPs asked whether the government knows of a July 2010 letter from 22 US Congress members urging Shell to end its Iran activities and disclose them to US authorities, and whether it will urge Shell to disclose its Iran activities in the Netherlands too. The ministers answered that they know the letter, that it fits efforts for strict Iran sanctions, that Shell must answer it itself, and that Shell must account transparently to its shareholders while the government supervises compliance with EU and UN sanctions.
Shell is bound by the regulations arising from the relevant UN and European sanctions measures against Iran; it is the government's task to monitor compliance with them.
Shell is gebonden aan de regelgeving die voortvloeit uit de relevante VNVR- en Europese sanctiemaatregelen jegens Iran; het is de taak van de overheid toe te zien op naleving daarvan.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en De Roon (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over moslim-oorlog tegen christenen in Indonesië (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

PVV MPs Wilders and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether he would summon Indonesia's ambassador, freeze cooperation and the ratification bill with Indonesia, over mosque calls for a war against Christianization and insecurity for Christians. The minister rejected the claim that the Indonesian state tolerates such acts, said he has confidence in EU dialogue on religious freedom, and declined to freeze the agreement.
I do not share your view that the Indonesian government tolerates such actions.
Ik ben niet met u van mening dat de Indonesische overheid dergelijke acties gedoogt.

Vragen van de leden De Roon en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht «Eenderde aangiften blijft op de plank» (ingezonden 4 juni 2010).

PVV MPs De Roon and Brinkman asked the Justice and Interior ministers whether roughly a third of serious police complaints (aangiften) are left unaddressed due to capacity shortages, and what will be done for victims and to simplify the reporting procedure. The minister said he takes the signal seriously, has asked the Public Prosecution Service and police chiefs for a report before deciding on measures, and pointed to prioritisation rules and crime declines while noting the procedure may be simplified.
I have asked the Public Prosecution Service and the Police Chiefs' Council to report to me to substantiate the numbers cited, so that I can consider whether and what measures are needed.

Ik heb het Openbaar Ministerie en het Korpsbeheerdersberaad gevraagd om mij bericht uit te brengen ter onderbouwing van de genoemde aantallen, zodat ik mij kan beraden over de vraag of en welke maatregelen nodig zijn.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over politieke vervolging van Iraanse dissidenten buiten Iran (ingezonden 19 mei 2010).

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Iran uses Interpol arrest requests against political dissidents abroad and whether the Netherlands would refuse to act on them or extradite such persons. The government answered that Interpol requests often do not show whether the person is a dissident, that no extradition treaty with Iran exists so no requests are followed, and that the KLPD neither searches for nor informs wanted persons.
Extradition to Iran by the Netherlands is not an issue.
Uitlevering aan Iran door Nederland is niet aan de orde.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Justitie over een tbs’er die tijdens verlof een vrouw neerstak (ingezonden 21 april 2010).

De Roon (PVV) asks the Justice Minister how an untreatable long-stay tbs patient was granted leave that allowed him to stab a woman, and whether such leave should be banned, whether compensation will be offered, and whether tbs should be abolished in favour of long prison sentences. The minister confirms the facts, has suspended all leave at the clinic, is still considering generic measures, points victims to the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven, and rejects abolishing tbs, citing lower reoffending and falling escape numbers.
Following the incident in Uden, all leave for tbs patients at the clinic concerned has been suspended.
Naar aanleiding van het incident in Uden zijn alle verloven voor de tbs-gestelden van de betreffende kliniek opgeschort.
Vragen van het lid De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Justitie over een meervoudig moordenaar die onder een flink deel van zijn gevangenisstraf uit probeert te komen (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a multiple murderer seeking early release under the Fokkens scheme, whether victims lack a right to speak in Raad voor Strafrechtstoepassing proceedings, and whether tbs should be abolished. The minister said the Fokkens scheme revision is with the Raad van State with entry into force possible by Q4 2010, that victims' speaking rights apply only to criminal trials not enforcement, that victims' interests will be weighed in leave decisions and a study is expected, and rejected abolishing tbs.
I am of the view that in decisions on leave and conditional release the interests of victims must be weighed.
Ik ben van mening dat bij beslissingen over verlof en invrijheidstelling de slachtofferbelangen moeten worden meegewogen

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Pechtold (D66), Nicolaï (VVD), Van der Staaij (SGP) en De Roon (PVV) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Iraanse toetreding tot de Mensenrechtenraad van de VN (in

MPs asked the foreign minister whether the Netherlands would oppose Iran's candidacy for the UN Human Rights Council given its human rights record, and what that would mean for the Council's credibility. The minister replied that Iran withdrew its candidacy and that the Netherlands had actively lobbied against it, and that it will continue to keep notorious rights violators out of the Council.
In the future too, the Netherlands will continue to work unabatedly to keep notorious human rights violators out of the Council.
Ook in de toekomst zal Nederland zich onverminderd blijven inzetten om notoire mensenrechtenschenders buiten de Raad te houden.
Vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Justitie over het detentieverlof voor een misdadiger (ingezonden 29 april 2010).

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked the Justice Minister why loverboy suspect Murat O. was granted leave from detention, whether the public prosecutor objected, and whether a bill would be introduced to stop judges weighing personal circumstances. The minister said the public prosecutor opposed the request, no appeal lies against the court's decision, and a bill transferring leave decisions from judges to the minister is in preparation and will go to the Raad van State.

I have, as you know, a bill in preparation providing that decisions on temporarily leaving an institution due to personal circumstances during pre-trial detention are taken by the Minister of Justice and no longer by the judge.

Ik heb – zoals u bekend is – een wetsvoorstel in voorbereiding dat regelt dat de besluitvorming omtrent het tijdelijk verlaten van een inrichting vanwege persoonlijke omstandigheden tijdens de tenuitvoerlegging van de voorlopige hechtenis door de minister van Justitie en niet langer door de rechter plaatsvindt.
qn: Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Van der Staaij (SGP), De Roon (PVV) en Van Bommel (SP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de Armeense genocide (ingezonden 15 augustus 2011).

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether the 1915 Armenian events constitute genocide under the 1948 Convention, why the government does not use that term, and whether its letter departs from the Rouvoet motion calling for recognition in EU talks with Turkey. The minister answered that the 1948 Convention does not apply retroactively, pointed to joint archive access and mixed commissions, and said recognition is not a Copenhagen criterion while continuing to press Turkey on free expression and the Zurich protocols.
To that end I will continue to use my contacts with my Turkish and Armenian counterparts.
Ik zal daartoe de contacten met mijn Turkse en Armeense counterparts blijven aanwenden.

m: Motie van de leden Veldman en Van den Berg over analyseren wat nodig is om het project Regie op registers te versnellen
Asks the government to analyse quickly what is needed to speed up the Regie op Registers project and to inform the House by early 2021.

to analyse in the short term what is needed to speed up the Regie op Registers project so that the registry landscape can contribute to appropriate use of medicines, and to inform the House about this in early 2021

om op korte termijn te analyseren wat er nodig is om het project Regie op Registers te versnellen zodat het registerlandschap kan gaan bijdragen aan gepast gebruik van geneesmiddelen, en de Kamer hierover begin 2021 te informeren
