Amendment requiring the AMvB for experiments to set how experiment evaluation is carried out and how often interim monitoring occurs.
how the evaluation of the experiment is carried out and how often interim monitoring takes place with a view to the objectives referred to in the second paragraph
hoe de evaluatie van het experiment wordt uitgevoerd en hoe vaak tussentijds wordt gemonitord met het oog op de doelen, bedoeld in het tweede lid
Amendement van de leden Albert de Vries en Veldman dat de afstemming tussen bestuursorganen bij de uitoefening van hun taken en bevoegheden expliciet in de wet vastlegt
Writes into the Omgevingswet an explicit duty for administrative bodies to coordinate with other bodies when exercising their tasks.
In article 2.2, first paragraph, after 'other administrative bodies' is inserted: and where necessary coordinates with these other administrative bodies.
In artikel 2.2, eerste lid, wordt na «andere bestuursorganen» ingevoegd: en stemt zonodig met deze andere bestuursorganen af.

Amendement van de leden Albert de Vries en Veldman dat regelt dat een bestuursorgaan bij de uitoefening van zijn taken en bevoegdheden slechts treedt in de taken en bevoegdheden van een ander bestuurs
Adds a principle that an administrative body may enter the powers of another body only where necessary for its own tasks, protecting decentralised authorities from national intervention.
An administrative body may only enter the tasks and powers of another administrative body when and insofar as this is necessary for carrying out its own tasks and powers.
Een bestuursorgaan treedt bij de uitoefening van zijn taken en bevoegdheden slechts in de taken en bevoegdheden van een ander bestuursorgaan voor zover dat nodig is
Motie van het lid Veldman c.s. over afdekken van het renterisico
Asks the government, with Muiden, Bussum, Naarden and the province, to cover the interest-rate risk of the municipality of Muiden under its article 12 status.
calls on the government, in consultation with Muiden, Bussum, Naarden and the province of Noord-Holland, to cover this interest rate risk
roept de regering op, in overleg met Muiden, Bussum, Naarden en de provincie Noord-Holland dit renterisico af te dekken
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Aartsen over het bericht 'Coronavirus bereikt onze winkels: producten worden duurder'

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports of higher retail prices during the early coronavirus pandemic, including whether price regulation was applied, the causes of price rises, and shortages affecting medicines and medical supplies. The state secretary answered that no overviews of price-regulating firms are known, that no concrete signs of serious consumer harm have emerged, and pointed to general economic support packages and letters on medicine supply and stockpiling.
No overviews are known to me of businesses and shops that may have applied price regulation at the start of the coronavirus pandemic.
Mijn zijn geen overzichten bekend van bedrijven en winkels die mogelijkerwijs prijsregulering hebben toegepast aan het begin van de coronapandemie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Thuis testen of je besmet bent met corona, nu nog als experiment’

An MP asked the health minister about a report on home COVID-19 antigen self-tests, including when results would be known, whether supervision and a legal basis are needed, and how this fits with voluntariness and on-site testing rules. The minister answered that a temporary exemption route for manufacturers is open, that the IGJ will supervise sellers, that self-tests are unsuitable for high-risk groups and access testing, and that a legal basis for a test certificate is being prepared.
From 5 March, manufacturers can submit an application.
Vanaf 5 maart jl. kunnen fabrikanten een aanvraag indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht 'Afhandeling aanvragen farmaceutische vergunningen ernstig vertraagd'

An MP asked the health minister about serious delays in IGJ and CIBG/Farmatec handling pharmaceutical licence applications, the impact on GMP facility investment, and remedies. The minister acknowledges a backlog of about 25 overdue applications, attributes it to COVID-related inspection priorities, and outlines measures such as recruitment and a streamlined inspection programme, without a firm completion date.
At the end of 2020 the backlog in answering advice requests rose to about 25 pending applications whose 90-day deadline had been exceeded.
Eind 2020 liep de achterstand in beantwoording van adviesaanvragen op tot ongeveer 25 lopende aanvragen waarvan de termijn van 90 dagen was overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Pas vanaf 18 jaar een coronavaccin: chronisch zieke Milan (16) zit al sinds maart thuis, maar wordt niet ingeënt’

An MP asked the health minister why chronically ill 16-year-olds cannot yet receive a COVID-19 vaccine and what research and advice is underway for under-18s. The minister replied that trials in children are ongoing, that the Health Council was asked for advice on vaccinating medically at-risk minors, and that a decision will follow that advice.
On 2 March I asked the Health Council to advise on the possibility of also vaccinating persons under 18.
Op 2 maart jl. heb ik de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd om advies uit te brengen over de mogelijkheid ook personen jonger dan 18 jaar te vaccineren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Pas de vaccinatiestrategie aan, zeggen deskundigen: niet 2 prikken, maar 1’

An MP asked the health minister about expert calls to give one COVID-19 vaccine dose instead of two, plus related questions on research and a risk algorithm. The minister answered that the Health Council advised against a single-dose schedule, so the two-dose strategy stays, and that further advice and research are being sought.
Based on this advice, I have decided not to change the vaccination strategy on this point.
Op basis van dit advies heb ik besloten de vaccinatiestrategie op dit punt niet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Aukje de Vries en Veldman over de problematiek rondom bemanningswisselingen en vaccinatie van zeevarenden

MPs from the VVD asked about crew changes and vaccination of seafarers, including test requirements at foreign airports, the feasibility of arrival testing, vaccine rollout delays such as in the Philippines, and private vaccination options. The minister acknowledged the difficulties, extended the antigen test validity to 24 hours, and said the RIVM is examining how seafarers can access existing vaccination routes, without committing to new parliamentary reporting.
I will inform your House when there are new developments regarding the points above.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren op het moment dat er met betrekking tot bovenstaande punten nieuwe ontwikkelingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht 'Commissie neemt belangrijke maatregelen voor een verenigd front tegen COVID-19'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the EU call for at least 5-10% genome sequencing of positive COVID-19 tests, why the Netherlands does not reach that share, and how RIVM plans to scale up national variant surveillance. The minister answered that RIVM follows the ECDC norm of roughly 500 random samples per week, currently performs 600-900 sequences weekly plus 300-400 at Erasmus MC, is scaling up to 1,200-1,500 samples per week with a target of end April 2021, and is coordinating a wider laboratory network.
Achieving the European Commission's target of sequencing capacity of at least 5% of positive test results is not a goal in itself within Dutch policy.

Het behalen van de door de Europese Commissie gestelde doelstelling van een sequentie-analysecapaciteit van ten minste 5% van de positieve testresultaten is geen doel op zich binnen het Nederlands beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Horizon’s Tepezza supply dwindles as manufacturer Catalent pivots to Warp Speed Vaccines’

MP Veldman asked the Minister for Medical Care whether non-COVID medicine supply is being delayed or cancelled because production capacity is shifted to COVID-19 vaccines, and what risks, measures and patient safeguards apply. The Minister answered that no shortage reports attribute delays to vaccine prioritisation, that the Meldpunt monitors notifications and manufacturers are legally required to report expected shortages, and that alternatives are usually found for affected patients.
The Meldpunt for medicine shortages and defects has received no reports of expected supply problems with the reason being a change in the prioritisation of production capacity for vaccines.
Bij het Meldpunt geneesmiddelentekorten en -defecten zijn geen meldingen van verwachte leveringsproblemen met als reden verandering in prioritering van productiecapaciteit ten behoeve van vaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht 'ISKO Vital B.V. ontvangt als eerste het NEN-keurmerk voor mondkapjes voor publiek gebruik'

MP Veldman asked the health minister about a NEN quality mark for public face masks, including how many suppliers are being tested, whether testing covers virus mutations, whether the OMT will be asked for new advice, the production capacity, and the minister's view of such a mark. The minister answered substantively on all six questions, noting two certificates issued and three applications pending, that no new OMT advice is needed, and that the mark is a useful tool supported by the ministry.
There are currently two certificates issued and there are currently three applications being processed.
Er zijn momenteel twee certificaten uitgegeven en er zijn momenteel drie aanvragen in behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis, Paternotte en Veldman over de handhaving van de negatieve PCR-testuitslag en verklaring voor inreizen of transit in Nederland

MPs Schonis, Paternotte and Veldman asked how compliance with the mandatory negative PCR test requirement for travellers entering the Netherlands is enforced, including spot checks, bus and train stations, testing on arrival, and exemptions for vaccinated travellers. The minister answered that carriers must check 100% of passengers with sanctions available, veiligheidsregio's perform spot checks, arrival testing and vaccination exemptions were not adopted, and enforcement is via fines and orders under administrative coercion.
The safety regions carry out spot checks among arriving passengers to see whether the airline and ferry companies comply sufficiently.
De veiligheidsregio's doen steekproeven onder aankomende passagiers om te zien of de naleving door de luchtvaart- en ferrymaatschappijen voldoende is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over de beschikbaarheid van hulpmiddelen en basismateriaal bij de levering ten behoeve van, en uitvoering van de vaccinatiestrategie

An MP asked the health minister whether Pfizer's vaccine output per vial and the supply of basic materials such as vials, stoppers and caps could constrain the vaccination strategy, and what the government would do about shortages and export restrictions. The minister answered that Pfizer's product information now specifies six doses per vial, that supply is contracted per dose, that shortages of basic materials are not currently the limiting factor, and that the government would examine support for producers if needed.
I have no insight into lead times for basic materials in the filling process.
Ik heb geen inzicht in levertijden van basismaterialen bij het afvulproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het voorkomen en bestrijden van genitale verminking

MPs Becker and Veldman (VVD) asked the ministers about preventing and combating female genital mutilation (FGM), including prevalence data, the role of GPs and the care chain, Veilig Thuis reporting, reconstructive surgery coverage, integration course content, Schiphol controls and a reporting obligation. The state secretary answered that preventive and chain policy exists and is being evaluated, that data are limited or not monitored, that some measures (Schiphol controls) have no fixed timeline, and that a mandatory reporting duty is under study with Raad van State reservations.
The number of women who report to their GP because they are victims of FGM is not monitored.
Het aantal vrouwen dat zich meldt bij de huisarts omdat zij slachtoffer zijn van VGV wordt niet gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over ‘Niet bewoners maar personeel van verpleeghuizen als eerste gevaccineerd’

An MP asked the Health Minister about reports that nursing home staff rather than residents would be vaccinated first, and about the effect on the vaccination strategy, the vaccine rollout, communication, and the registration system. The minister said the centralized BioNTech/Pfizer rollout and the Health Council advice shaped the priorities, answered most questions on substance, and declined to confirm a RIVM-led meeting, reporting only a ministerial stakeholder meeting instead.
Inquiries with the RIVM show that such a meeting did not take place.
Navraag bij het RIVM leert dat een dergelijk overleg niet heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht 'Brabants ziekenhuis merkte jarenlang datalekken niet op'

An MP asked the health minister about a Brabant hospital that failed for years to detect staff misuse of medical records, and how oversight, patient access to logs and sanctions work. The minister said the hospital detected misuse in 2018, took labour-law measures, reported to the data protection authority and is strengthening security, while logging duties and patient portals are the responsibility of providers and the regulator.
Given the privacy of those involved, Bravis hospital provides no further details about the incident described by NRC.
Het Bravis ziekenhuis geeft, gezien de privacy van betrokkenen, geen verdere details over de gebeurtenis waar de NRC over schrijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over de mededeling dat er 4 januari 2021 gestart kan worden met vaccineren

An MP from the VVD asked the Health Minister on what basis he announced vaccinations could start on 4 January 2021, and raised concerns from LHV, Actiz and CNV about readiness, protocols, staffing, materials and ICT. The minister answered that the timing rested on EMA expectations and intensive consultation with implementing parties, that guidance and implementation agreements are being issued, and that staffing and materials are being arranged, while declining to answer the questions separately before the next debate.
On that basis, and on the basis of intensive consultation with implementing parties, I expressed the expectation that, if all goes well, we could start the first vaccination in the week of 4 January.
Op basis daarvan en op basis van intensief overleg met uitvoerende partijen heb ik de verwachting uitgesproken om -als alles meezit- in de week van 4 januari te kunnen starten met de eerste prik.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Veldman en De Groot over het bericht ‘SARS-CoV-2 mink-associated variant strain – Denmark’

MPs Veldman and De Groot asked how the Netherlands responded to reports of a mink-associated SARS-CoV-2 variant in Denmark, what steps follow, whether the WHO call for sequencing and data sharing was followed, whether Dutch capacity exists, and whether further mutations are expected. The minister answered that RIVM contacted Danish researchers, advice went to the ministries, sequencing already occurs in the Netherlands and data are shared, capacity exists, and mutations are a natural phenomenon detected by sequencing.
Sequencing of the virus already takes place in the Netherlands, both for virus strains found in humans and in mink.
Sequencen van het virus gebeurt al in Nederland, zowel bij virusstammen gevonden bij mensen als bij nertsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Sluiting huisartsenpost Venray een flinke stap dichterbij’

An MP asked the minister about a planned closure of the Venray out-of-hours GP post in Limburg, its effects on response times and quality of acute care, and whether it fits regional plans. The minister answered that the decision rests with the local GPs and cooperative Cohesie, that a RIVM analysis shows 99.9% of residents can reach another post within 30 minutes, and that the minister has no insight into specific agreements between GPs.
It is up to them to reach agreement together in good consultation.
Het is aan hen om hier samen in goed overleg uit te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het bericht 'Twee asielzoekers in azc Ter Apel besmet met Corona'

MPs Becker and Veldman asked about reports of COVID-19 infections at the Ter Apel reception centre, including the applicable protocol, quarantine of contacts and arrivals from high-risk areas, and protection of staff and vulnerable asylum seekers. The State Secretary answered that no Ter Apel-specific protocol exists, describes the general COA/GGD/GZA protocol, and sets out quarantine, testing and staff protection measures, while several answers note capacity constraints.
There is no protocol specifically for the Ter Apel reception centre. Therefore I cannot provide it to you.
Er is geen protocol voor specifiek het aanmeldcentrum ter Apel. Derhalve kan ik u dat niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Van den Bosch en Veldman over het toestaan en mogelijk maken van winterterrassen als reddingsboei voor horecaondernemers

VVD MPs asked whether winter terraces with covers and heaters could serve as a lifeline for hospitality businesses, whether municipalities should be encouraged to allow them, and what rules apply to tents and canopies under Covid measures. The government agreed terraces help and that municipalities should weigh allowing them, said it is a local decision, and explained that open-sided terraces count as outdoor locations, though it keeps no overview of municipal decisions.
Such an overview is not kept.
Een dergelijk overzicht wordt niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Veldman over het bericht 'Grote ov-campagne moet reiziger weer in de trein en bus krijgen'

MPs Ziengs and Veldman asked whether the government supports a public transport campaign aiming to restore 80% of pre-corona ridership, given rising infection numbers and advice to work from home. The state secretary answered that the campaign was run by transport operators, was halted on 25 September, and that the government now asks people to limit travel as far as possible.
As indicated, the campaign has been halted and, with the 28 September call to limit travel movements, the 80% target is no longer realistic or desirable.
Zoals aangegeven is de campagne stilgelegd en met de oproep van 28 september om de reisbewegingen te beperken is de 80% niet meer reëel en wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Dreigend tekort voor laboratoria die coronatests moeten onderzoeken’

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about a reported shortage facing labs that process COVID tests, including accreditation requirements, contracting timelines, and the end of coronavirus envoy Feike Sijbesma's role. The minister answered that the labs meet RIVM quality requirements, contracts take a few weeks, Sijbesma's work was largely complete with no successor named, and no lab failed the quality check.
The RIVM has drawn up a list of laboratories eligible to carry out COVID-19 diagnostics.
Het RIVM heeft een lijst opgemaakt van laboratoria die in aanmerking komen voor het uitvoeren van COVID-19 diagnostiek
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht 'VWS en GGD’en roepen op: 'Testen: graag! Maar alleen bij klachten'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the government's call to test only people with symptoms, testing without symptoms, testing capacity and stock levels. The minister said mandatory testing is not possible under the Public Health Act, outlined ongoing studies of asymptomatic testing, and described capacity expansion and reserves, promising 50,000 tests a day by late September and 70,000 by late October.
Testing cannot be made mandatory under the Public Health Act.
Testen kan via de Wet publieke gezondheid niet verplicht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Veldman over de registratieplicht in de horeca en de mogelijkheid om mensen te weigeren die niet mee werken aan de registratieplicht

MPs Aartsen and Veldman asked whether hospitality operators may refuse guests who do not cooperate with the COVID-19 contact-registration obligation, and about how details of that obligation were communicated and whether operators were involved. The state secretary answered that guests cannot be refused for withholding contact data because consent must be voluntary under the GDPR, while refusal is allowed for breaches of safety rules such as the 1.5-metre distance, and that operators were not involved in drafting the obligation but were informed in advance.
It is very important that hospitality operators can ensure the measures to combat infections are properly implemented.
Het is heel belangrijk dat horecaondernemers ervoor kunnen zorgen dat de maatregelen om besmettingen tegen te gaan, goed uitgevoerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Diertens over het bericht ‘RIVM-site Infectieradar pas na zomer weer operationeel’

MPs Veldman and Diertens asked the Minister of Health about reports that the RIVM Infectieradar website would not be operational until after summer, including which software partner replaces Formdesk, contact with the Grote Griepmeting developers, funding, and when it will be reliable. The minister answered that development runs via the EU-funded EpiPose project with ISI-Foundation and Coneno, that talks with the Grote Griepmeting stalled over financial expectations, and that operation is targeted for September 2020 with security and privacy approvals.

The RIVM states its aim is to have the planned Infectieradar operational in September 2020, with all aspects (technical, information security, privacy) guaranteed and approved within the RIVM and VWS.

Het RIVM geeft aan als doel te hebben om in september 2020 de voorgenomen Infectieradar operationeel te hebben, waarbij alle aspecten (technisch, informatiebeveiliging, privacy) gewaarborgd en goedgekeurd zijn binnen het RIVM en VWS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Minister legt lek infectieradar bij ontwikkelaar, bedrijf reageert verbaasd’

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about the Infectieradar data leak, including other security risks, the vendor's knowledge of the flaw, notification of affected participants, and effects on trust and organ donor registration. The minister answered that RIVM identified several security risks, that the flaw was missed in the initial analysis, that 49 forms were viewed by a journalist and a security expert, and that RIVM now requires an external pentest before releasing such environments.
To prevent such a situation in the future, the RIVM Formdesk environments will only be released once an additional pentest has been carried out by an external party.
Om een dergelijke situatie in de toekomst te voorkomen worden de RIVM Formdesk omgevingen pas vrijgegeven als er een extra pentest is uitgevoerd door een externe partij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Foute huisarts die nooit meer spreekuur mag houden, toch weer aan het werk’

An MP asked whether the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) supervises struck-off healthcare professionals who return to practice, and whether it can search past cases and check databases. The minister answered that the IGJ investigates reports, that employers must screen applicants via the public BIG register and other registers, and that retrospective investigation is not considered useful.
The IGJ will always investigate when it receives a report that a suspended healthcare professional is performing reserved acts or wrongly uses a professional title.
De IGJ zal altijd onderzoek doen als zij een melding ontvangt dat een geschorste zorgverlener voorbehouden handelingen uitvoert of ten onrechte een beroepstitel voert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Veldman over het bericht 'Maximumsnelheid ook voor hulpdiensten omlaag: ‘Dit kan mensenlevens kosten’'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the lower daytime speed limit on motorways (100 km/h) would also apply to emergency services and, if so, how this affects response times and the OGS 2009 rules. The minister replied that emergency vehicles may still exceed the limit by up to 40 km/h, that effects on response times are expected to be negligible, that no amendment is planned, and that the effects will be monitored with the ambulance sector and the knowledge centre, with a promise to inform parliament if problems arise.
The exact effects of the speed reduction between 06:00 and 19:00 on the response times of emergency services are currently not known.
De exacte effecten van de snelheidsverlaging tussen 06.00 en 19.00 uur op de aanrijtijden van de hulpdiensten zijn op dit moment niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Stel dat mijn kind ziek wordt, en de stamcellen zijn kwijt...’

An MP asks the minister about commercial stem cell bank Cryo-Save: how patients encounter such banks, how the inspectorate supervises them, the transfer of stored material to a Polish company, and how lost material can be traced. The minister says the inspectorate supervises under the Wvkl, that Cryo-Save's recognition lapsed in 2019, that donors were notified of the transfer, and that he has no control over material stored abroad.
I have no control over stem cell materials stored abroad.
Ik heb geen zeggenschap over stamcelmaterialen die in het buitenland zijn opgeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Hackpoging ziekenhuis Leeuwarden, NCSC vreest aanvallers in meer systemen'

An MP asked the ministers about a hacking attempt at Medisch Centrum Leeuwarden, whether the hospital should have acted on NCSC warnings about Citrix servers, and how the new data-exchange law and other hospitals are affected. The minister answered that hospitals are primarily responsible for their own ICT, supported by Z-CERT, that the MCL did not timely implement mitigating measures and is investigating, and that the law will allow information-security requirements, while declining to say how many hospitals use vulnerable servers.
Healthcare institutions are themselves responsible for their own ICT and which systems and/or servers they use.
Zorginstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen ICT en welke systemen en/of servers zij gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans en Veldman over het artikel ‘Nieuwe Wuhan-virus overdraagbaar van mens op mens’

MPs Hermans and Veldman asked the Minister of Health about a news report that the new Wuhan coronavirus spreads person to person, covering monitoring, travel advice, airport measures and preparedness. The minister answered that the RIVM monitors the situation, that airport screening is not advised, that travel to neighbouring countries need not be discouraged, and that public information and hospital isolation protocols are in place.
I have kept your House informed about the outbreak of the new coronavirus in Wuhan and elsewhere through several letters to parliament.
Ik heb uw Kamer over de uitbraak van het nieuwe coronavirus in Wuhan en elders op de hoogte gehouden middels verschillende Kamerbrieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Becker over de collectieve zorgverzekering van Zilveren Kruis met Milli Görüs

MPs Veldman and Becker (VVD) asked whether the Zilveren Kruis collective health insurance with Milli Görüs, which they link to Erdogan's AK party and Turkish diaspora politics, is appropriate and what care-related benefit it offers. The minister answers that the government has no evidence of unwanted foreign interference, that insurers may make collective agreements, and that the collective is under review for genuine care-related added value.
The cabinet has no information showing that the choice of this collective insurance discount involves any form of unwanted foreign interference.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie die aantoont dat er via de keuze voor deze collectiviteitskorting van de zorgverzekering sprake is van een vorm van ongewenste buitenlandse inmenging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Veldman en Weverling over de berichten ‘Iedereen wil internet, niemand wil datacenters’ en 'Hoe Nederland zichzelf economisch in de voet schiet'

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary how the temporary building freeze on new data centres in Amsterdam and Haarlemmermeer fits with national digitalisation and spatial strategies, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary acknowledges the freeze is driven by energy demand and land shortages, points to a national data centre table and regional alternatives, and says the government is willing to play a facilitating role.
Yes, I am willing to play a facilitating role in this.
Ja ik ben bereid een faciliterende rol hierin te spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Veldman over het bericht ‘Banken weigeren bedrijven die met blockchain in de weer zijn’

MPs Wörsdörfer and Veldman asked whether banks refuse accounts to blockchain companies after a newspaper report. The minister says no structural refusal signals exist, notes crypto-service firms may face higher AML risk, and promises talks with banks.
Nevertheless, I will enter into discussion with the banks on whether there is indeed a refusal of parties that do something with blockchain.
Desalniettemin zal ik met de banken in gesprek gaan of er inderdaad sprake is van het weigeren van partijen die iets met blockchain doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht 'Anti-vaccinatiecampagne aangevoerd door homeopaten'

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of an anti-vaccination campaign led by homeopaths, the progress of the vaccination alliance's work against misinformation, and why a mandatory warning text on homeopathic products cannot be added. The government describes voluntary actions by an alliance counter-misinformation group, a website visibility improvement, and says Dutch law cannot unilaterally require such text because EU medicines directive rules are binding.
The Netherlands cannot unilaterally deviate from the directive.
Nederland kan niet eenzijdig van de richtlijn afwijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘RIVM: vaccinatiegraad gestabiliseerd, maar nog niet terug op ‘veilige’ 95 procent’

An MP asked the state secretary about falling childhood vaccination coverage, regional gaps, cross-border vaccination records, municipal measures, and a timeline to return to 95 percent. The secretary answered that it is too early to evaluate the measures, outlined municipal initiatives and a Nivel study, and said he aims for 95 percent as soon as possible without giving a firm date.
Besides the measures I have already taken, I want to clarify whether other options are possible and necessary, so that I can intensify them if needed.
Naast de maatregelen die ik al heb ingezet, wil ik helder krijgen of er nog andere opties mogelijk en noodzakelijk zijn, zodat ik zo nodig kan intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Veldman en Wiersma over het aantrekken van personeel door startups

MPs Wörsdörfer, Veldman and Wiersma asked whether startups face barriers in recruiting foreign talent, including income requirements, the partner labour market access and BTW registration for foreign entrepreneurs. The government answered that a pilot residence scheme for essential startup staff with a lower salary threshold will be created, that partner labour market access is being arranged, and that foreign entrepreneurs do not need to register physically at the tax office.
It was chosen to create a separate residence scheme in the form of a pilot rather than to adjust the knowledge migrant scheme.
Er is gekozen voor een aparte verblijfsregeling in de vorm van een pilot en niet voor aanpassing van de kennismigrantenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Kinder- en Jeugdartsen: Onbegrijpelijk dat ‘nepnieuws’ over homeopathische vaccinatie niet wordt aangepakt’

An MP asked why the health inspectorate (IGJ) is not acting against homeopathic alternatives to vaccination, about the limits of its enforcement powers, whether mandatory warning text on such products will be introduced, and the status of an expert task force. The State Secretary answers that the IGJ will act on misleading medical claims by providers and manufacturers, has limited powers against private individuals, rejects a mandatory warning text under current law, and reports that the expert group met in April with another meeting planned.
The IGJ will meet the Dutch Association for Paediatrics in July about its concerns regarding homeopathic prophylaxis as an alternative to vaccinations.
De IGJ gaat in juli in gesprek met de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Kindergeneeskunde over haar zorgen ten aanzien van homeopathische profylaxe als alternatief voor vaccinaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht dat de Europese staalfusie Tata Steel en Thyssen-Krupp niet doorgaat

Rep. Veldman (VVD) asked the minister about reports that the Tata Steel and Thyssen-Krupp steel merger would not proceed, the Commission's reasons, the claimed long-term benefits, and whether EU competition law should be revised. The state secretary explained the Commission's merger review and remedies process, noted Franco-German calls to loosen fusion rules, and said the cabinet favours strengthening the internal market while not wanting to weaken competition, with a stated willingness to explore revisions.
The discussions between the Commission and the parties are confidential, but based on what the parties have made public, it can be inferred
De gesprekken tussen de Commissie en partijen zijn vertrouwelijk, maar op basis van wat door partijen hierover naar buiten is gebracht, valt af te leiden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ’10 academische startups winnen deelname aan GES en een reis naar Silicon Valley’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the academic startup competition, the share of academic startups in the Netherlands, additional support measures, a possible valorisation pact with universities, the use of extra education and research funds, and whether the competition will recur. The State Secretary answers that no unambiguous figures exist (estimated 13% of startups are academic), lists existing and planned measures such as the TTT scheme and extra startup funding, says a valorisation meeting is aimed for 2020, and supports a recurring competition led by VSNU, TechLeap.NL and AcTI.
There are no unambiguous figures available on the number of academic startups and spin-offs in the Netherlands.
2 Er zijn geen eenduidige cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal van academische startups 3 en spin-offs 4 in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het bericht dat er op basisschool de Stelaertshoeve in Tilburg door de GGD voorlichting wordt gegeven over de ramadan

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Health about GGD health education on Ramadan given at a Tilburg primary school, including its purpose, whether it is GGD policy, how widespread it is, and whether other religious practices get similar attention. The State Secretary answered that the GGD advises schools on request within the Healthy School approach, that the Ramadan advice was tailored to exam or CITO test periods and given to a school and some parents, and that no other religious-holiday requests have been received.
For the whole of the Netherlands this question cannot be answered. No registration takes place.
Voor geheel Nederland kan deze vraag niet beantwoord worden. Er vindt geen registratie plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Wörsdörfer over het bericht dat Europarlementariërs de Europese Commissie waarschuwen niet de plannen voor een nieuw ruimtevaartprogramma te blokkeren

MPs Veldman and Wörsdörfer asked whether the European Commission intended to withdraw the new EU space programme after a provisional deal had been reached, and what the consequences would be for the Dutch space sector and EU competitiveness. The State Secretary replied that the Commission has not withdrawn the programme, that Council, Parliament and Commission reached a partial agreement at first reading, and that open points such as budgets will be settled later in the MFF negotiations.
It is now clear that the European Commission has not withdrawn the space programme.
Inmiddels is duidelijk dat de Europese Commissie het ruimtevaartprogramma niet heeft teruggetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Wörsdörfer over ‘orange carpet’ initiatieven en barrières bij het aantrekken van startups en scale-ups naar Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about barriers to attracting foreign startups and scale-ups to the Netherlands and about 'orange carpet' initiatives. The state secretary answered that Dutch rankings are good, that some barriers exist (bank accounts, partner labour market access, waiting times), and listed existing and planned measures with commitments to inform parliament later in 2019.
Parliament will be informed further about this in the second half of 2019.
Hierover wordt uw Kamer in de tweede helft van 2019 nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht in de Staatscourant dat het budget voor het Innovatiekrediet voor 2019 op 60 miljoen euro is vastgesteld

An MP asked why the 2019 Innovatiekrediet budget was set at 60 million euros when the budget was 70 million structurally, and where the remaining 10 million goes. The state secretary explained that 30 million is set aside for each of the clinical and technical categories, with an additional 10 million expected later in the year, and that the government will examine options for the oversubscribed clinical budget and report in the second half of 2019.
A recent letter on the financing monitor and evaluation of financing instruments has been published.
Recent is de brief Financieringsmonitor en evaluatie financieringsinstrumenten verschenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Veldman over het bericht ‘Daar gaan de miljarden’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether neighbouring countries are attracting more foreign investment because of Dutch climate policy, and how carbon-leakage and competitiveness risks would be prevented. The Minister replied that Dutch investment performance is above average in Europe, that INEOS cited pipeline connections rather than climate policy, and that a level-playing-field test and PBL/CPB analysis of the draft Climate Agreement are pending.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het feit dat er in Frankrijk een verbod is op reclame voor apotheken

An MP asked the government about France's ban on advertising by pharmacies and whether it creates a barrier to the EU internal market, and whether the Netherlands will submit input to a pending Court of Justice case and examine other internal-market barriers. The government said it will submit written observations to the Court because of the broader interest in a complete digital internal market, and committed to pursuing better enforcement of internal-market rules.
Because of the broader interest in ensuring a complete internal (digital) market, the Dutch government will submit written observations.
Vanwege het bredere belang van het verzekeren van een volledige interne (digitale) markt zal de Nederlandse regering schriftelijke opmerkingen indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Veldman over de aangekondigde bouw van een scale-up staalfabriek in India door Tata Steel

MPs Yesilgöz-Zegerius and Veldman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why Tata Steel is building a scale-up steel plant in India rather than IJmuiden, and what this means for jobs, the climate agreement and carbon leakage. The minister answered that the India plant is a necessary step for the HIsarna technology, that no commitment to build it in the Netherlands existed, and that there are no job or leakage effects.
No commitment was made that the HIsarna scale-up plant would be built in the Netherlands.
Er is geen toezegging gedaan dat de scale-up fabriek voor HIsarna in Nederland gebouwd zou worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over de berichtgeving waarin kinderartsen oproepen op te treden tegen een homeopathisch alternatief voor vaccineren

An MP asked the state secretary about media reports of paediatricians urging action against homeopathic alternatives to vaccination, the reliance on misinformation from sites like NVKP, labelling rules, and whether the IGJ has enough enforcement tools. The state secretary said he shares the concern, pointed to new RIVM information, JGZ consultation time, an expert team to rebut misconceptions, labelling rules already banning unproven claims, and that he will consult the IGJ on whether it needs more tools.
As I indicated in my letter of 19 November 2018, I will consult with the IGJ on whether it needs more tools to address incorrect information about vaccination.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 19 november 2018 heb aangegeven ga ik met de IGJ overleggen of zij meer handvatten nodig heeft om onjuiste informatie over vaccineren aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht 'Rijk wist in 2016 al van meningokok-gevaar'

An MP asked the state secretary whether the government knew of a rising meningococcal W threat as early as 2016, why vaccination decisions came only a year later, what risk analyses and decision frameworks apply, and whether enough vaccine supply is secured. The state secretary answered that the rise was initially small and unpredictable, that measures followed in 2017 as the increase continued, that advice from RIVM was consistent, and that vaccine supply is contracted for the planned campaign.
On 25 September 2017 the House was informed about the increase in meningococcal W and the measures taken.
Op 25 september 2017 is de Kamer geïnformeerd over de toename van meningokokken W en de maatregelen die zijn genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Veldman over het bericht 'Veel bewoners van sociale huurwoningen verdienen te veel'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about a newspaper report on high-income social housing tenants in the Rivierenland and Maasland regions, and about the effects of monitoring data, rent rules, selling dear social rentals and possible action. The Minister answered in detail with regional statistics, explained the income-based rent rules, and said she will assess the expected rent agreement and report to parliament, if it is not reached she will consider whether current policy suffices.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Veldman over de langere betalingstermijn aan Mkb'ers

MPs Wörsdörfer and Veldman asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about supermarkets paying suppliers later and whether SMEs are harmed by late payment, including government payment times. The state secretary answered that payment behaviour is improving, that no cases of SMEs in financial trouble from this trend are known, and that the government is monitoring payment times and has the 60-day payment law and the Betaalme.nu initiative in place.
The number of cases in which payment deviated from the 30 or 60 days is not available; these data are not on hand.
Het aantal gevallen waarbij er werd afgeweken van de 30 of 60 dagen is niet inzichtelijk, deze gegevens zijn niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het voorbereiden van de Rotterdamse haven op de Brexit

MPs Becker and Veldman asked how the government is preparing the Rotterdam port and business for a hard Brexit, and what the government is doing about it. The government answers that it shares concerns, is informing business and mapping consequences and measures with stakeholders, but leaves primary preparation responsibility with business.
The cabinet has begun informing governments, citizens and businesses about these changes.
Het kabinet is begonnen met het voorlichten van overheden, burgers en bedrijven over deze veranderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Veldman over het omzeilen van de Wet markt en overheid

VVD MPs Wörsdörfer and Veldman asked whether a municipal loan to Focus Filmtheater, and the 'Horeca BV' structure that may let commercial hospitality bypass the Wet markt en overheid, creates unfair competition and what rules apply. The state secretary answered that state-aid and WMO rules apply, that enforcement lies primarily with the municipality, the Commission, courts and the ACM, and that subsidy conditions can address unfair competition, without committing to a new investigation or legislative change.
Whether there is state aid in the present situation is primarily for the municipality to assess.
Of er in onderhavige situatie sprake is van staatssteun, is in de eerste plaats aan de gemeente om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Veldman en Weverling over het bericht ‘Maakbedrijven trekken naar India wegens groeiend gebrek aan Nederlandse ingenieurs’

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Education about a newspaper report that manufacturing firms are moving to India due to a shortage of Dutch engineers, including expected shortages, number of firms leaving, and how other countries respond. The state secretary and minister answered that a shortage of technical talent is a growing constraint, that no integrated data exist on firms leaving or on the number of jobs lost, and that the government's Techniekpact is a model cited by other countries.
Statistics Netherlands does not keep data on the number of firms leaving the Netherlands.
Er worden (door het CBS) geen gegevens bijgehouden over aantallen bedrijven die uit Nederland vertrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Veldman over het bericht ‘Nieuw innovatiebox-besluit stelt teleur’

MPs Lodders and Veldman asked the State Secretary of Finance about a critical press report on the new innovation box (innovatiebox) decision, including whether the scheme is accessible to entrepreneurs and which open questions remain. The State Secretary answered that entrepreneurs' experiences are largely positive, pointed to the evaluation, the flat-rate option, helpdesks and policy decisions, and acknowledged that some aspects such as aggregation level and IP access criteria are still being clarified, with a supplementary policy decision expected this year.
I therefore expect to supplement the policy decision on the new innovation box this year.
Ik verwacht het beleidsbesluit over de nieuwe innovatiebox dan ook dit jaar nog aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Potters en Veldman over de A73

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the A73 motorway, including accident figures, traffic congestion, the German truck toll, and whether extending the A77 would help. The Minister said accident risk on most of the A73 is below average, but the Cuijk–Boxmeer stretch is above average, so Rijkswaterstaat was asked for an analysis; she also gave congestion and maintenance details and said extending the A77 is not foreseen.
That is why I have asked Rijkswaterstaat to carry out an analysis of this stretch in the short term, to establish the causes of the accidents
Daarom heb ik Rijkswaterstaat gevraagd op korte termijn een analyse uit te voeren op dit weggedeelte, om na te gaan wat de oorzaken zijn van de ongevallen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Veldman inzake het bericht Technieklokaal Winterswijk bang voor sluiting door te weinig geld

MPs Straus and Veldman asked whether the government would close the funding gap threatening the Winterswijk technology classroom, which faces closure without it. The state secretary said schools decide how to spend funds, that the classroom can continue under school choice through 2020, and that the national government does not give individual grants to support organisations.
The national government does not give individual contributions to supporting organisations; this runs via the schools themselves.
De rijksoverheid geeft geen individuele bijdragen aan ondersteunende organisaties, dit loopt via scholen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Arno Rutte over het bericht dat de gemeente Heerhugowaard gedeeld eigenaar van een ziekenhuis wil worden

MPs Veldman and Rutte asked whether Heerhugowaard may co-own a hospital under the Fido Act, how the province supervises the financial risk, and whether a municipality could have an incentive to weaken WMO care to fill beds. The minister answered that the municipal council must judge whether co-ownership serves the public interest, that the province exercises only repressive supervision and cannot block the investment in advance, and that the WMO concern is not realistic.
Heerhugowaard is currently subject to repressive supervision, so its structural and real budgetary balance is assessed only afterwards.
Voor de gemeente Heerhugowaard geldt momenteel het repressieve toezicht, waardoor het structurele en reële begrotingsevenwicht alleen achteraf wordt beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht “Een op de vijf gemeenten archiveert website niet”

MP Veldman asked the Minister of Interior Affairs whether he was alarmed that one in five municipalities does not archive its website as legally required, and whether he would act to ensure compliance. The minister acknowledged the concern, said municipalities are responsible for their own information under the Archiefwet and that enforcement falls under interbestuurlijk toezicht, and pointed to broader advice on information management rather than announcing concrete new steps.
Every government is responsible for managing its own information and for applying the Archiefwet.
Iedere overheid is verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van zijn eigen informatie en voor de toepassing van de Archiefwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Veldman over vleermuizen die bouwprojecten belemmeren

MPs Van der Linde and Veldman asked about bats (vleermuizen) blocking construction projects and housing for migrants under the Flora and Fauna Act, and whether the upcoming Environment Act could prevent delays. The minister answered that the government commissioned research into the economic effects and will respond, that about 250 exemptions were granted in 2014-2015 without data on stoppages, and that integrated planning, provincial responsibility under the Nature Conservation Act and standardised project approaches can prevent delays.
I have commissioned research into the problem and its economic consequences.
Ik heb onderzoek laten doen naar de problematiek en de economische gevolgen daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Lodders en Veldman over de berichtgeving over de Nijkerkerbrug

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the one-year delay in renovating the Nijkerkerbrug, why the experimental tender approach was kept despite an agreement to revert to the classic method, the safety and economic consequences, and whether the renovation will be sped up. The Minister attributes the delay to technical and procedural risks and the new market-oriented tender approach, says the temporary safety and weight-limit measures are in place, and promises to explore partial recovery of the delay when the contract is awarded in spring 2017.
I have chosen to put the Nijkerkerbrug on the market in a different way, in a form suited to the recently presented Market Vision.
Ik heb ervoor gekozen om de Nijkerkerbrug op een andere manier op de markt te zetten, in een vorm passend bij de onlangs gepresenteerde Marktvisie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over veranderingen ten aanzien van het Besluit Gegevensverstrekking Gemeentelijke Belastingheffing

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether the decree on data provision for municipal taxation will be amended to require modern online booking intermediaries to supply landlord and tenant data for tourist and residence taxes, and what the effects on foreign-based platforms would be. The Minister confirms the amendment is being investigated, that it would extend reporting duties to such intermediaries if adopted, and that he acknowledges the risk of platforms relocating abroad but gives no firm commitment and needs more time.
This will be taken into account in the mentioned investigation into the need for an amendment.
Bij het genoemde onderzoek naar de noodzaak van een wijziging zal dit worden meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen en Veldman over het artikel ‘Financiële zorgen Fort Pannerden vanwege monumentstatus’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the proposed expansion of the monument status of Fort Pannerden, which the municipality of Lingewaard says could hinder sustainable exploitation, was necessary and whether it could be scaled back. The Minister defended the expansion as needed for the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie's UNESCO nomination, rejected the municipality's concerns, but said she would consider a smaller historical boundary and decide in June 2016.
In response to this advice, I want to consider adjusting the current proposal so that the proposed historical boundary of the fort is brought in line with the current situation.
Naar aanleiding van dit advies wil ik een aanpassing van het huidige voorstel overwegen om de voorgestelde historische begrenzing van het fort in lijn te brengen met de actuele situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Neder-Betuwe wil geld zien voor stroomkabels’

An MP asked whether the municipality of Neder-Betuwe may levy precario tax retroactively on power cables and whether the minister would act against it. The minister answered that the council motion was not being pursued, that the 2014 ordinance already contained the basis so no retroactivity arises, and that no action is needed.
There are no actual intentions to carry out this motion.
Er zijn geen daadwerkelijke voornemens om deze motie ook uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Overheden nog niet klaar voor Wet hergebruik overheidsinformatie’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Dutch authorities are ready for the Open Government Information Reuse Act, after a report that most bodies postpone reuse requests and rarely register open data on the national portal. The minister answered that responsibility lies with authorities, cites a handbook and information sessions, and says it is too early to draw conclusions, with evaluation after three years.
As for the conclusion that they would not yet be ready, as the Open State Foundation sample would suggest, I think it is too early.
Voor de conclusie dat zij daar nog niet klaar voor zouden zijn, zoals dat uit de steekproef van de Open State Foundation zou blijken, vind ik het te vroeg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman, De Caluwé en Oosenbrug over het bericht “beveiliging tientallen gemeentesites lek: persoonsgegevens niet veilig”

MPs Veldman, De Caluwé and Oosenbrug asked the Minister of Interior about a reported security flaw (DROWN/SSL) exposing dozens of municipal websites and whether municipalities protect personal data, and what sanctions and oversight apply. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for their own information security under the BIG framework, that the Dutch DPA can impose instructions, fines or penalties, and that the government is preparing legislation on digital government services.
Information security of municipalities is a local responsibility.
Informatiebeveiliging van gemeenten is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Ozb stijgt nog harder dan gedacht met 2,5 procent’

The MP Veldman asks the Minister of the Interior whether he is shocked that homeowners face a 2.5% rise in the local property tax (OZB) and whether he will act now that municipalities have exceeded the agreed macro norm for five years running. The Minister says the COELO figures show a 2.32% total OZB increase, that the norm is adjusted downward after overshoots by agreement, that he will discuss it with the VNG, and that setting rates is a municipal council responsibility he will not interfere with.
The proactive role in setting OZB rates, for both homes and non-residential property, lies with the municipal councils.
De proactieve rol bij het vaststellen van de OZB tarieven, voor zowel woningen als niet-woningen, ligt bij de gemeenteraden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Raad vaak buitenspel bij opvanglocaties vluchtelingen’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether councils are being excluded from decisions by municipal executives on refugee reception locations, and what effect this has on public support. The minister said most councillors were informed in time, that councils may have delegated authority or lacked time in emergencies, and that a support-team handbook for municipalities on decision-making involving councils was due in February 2016.
I do offer municipalities support in reaching a careful decision-making process.
Ik biedt gemeenten hierbij wel ondersteuning om te komen tot een zorgvuldig besluitvormingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Overbetuwenaar betaalde jarenlang teveel rioolbelasting’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a court ruling that the municipality of Overbetuwe improperly moved sewer-tax reserves into general funds, and whether this is lawful and what the government will do. The Minister answered that the court ruling is not yet final, that the national government does not track such reserve transfers, that citizens may legitimately appeal to courts, and that he has no direct role since the courts decide and municipalities are autonomous.
I have no role in this, as the court judges as an independent power.
Ik heb geen rol in deze, daar de rechter als onafhankelijke macht oordeelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht «Herstelwet niet langer deugdelijk»

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about a Raad van State ruling that partly annulled the implementing decree of the Crisis- and Recovery Act, making the 'bestemmingsplan met verbrede reikwijdte' experiment temporarily unusable. The minister acknowledged the omission, explained the legal defect, and committed to repairing the decree via the 13th tranche with retroactive effect.
In the Division's view, this last condition has not been met.
Naar het oordeel van de Afdeling is niet aan deze laatste voorwaarde voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht dat 900 gemeentelijke verordeningen niet rechtsgeldig zijn

An MP asked the Interior Minister about a report that about 900 municipal ordinances, including tax ordinances, were not validly published, with 163 municipalities affected. The minister acknowledged three shortcomings, said the report was self-initiated and not formally shared, noted that oversight is a municipal matter with no interbestuurlijk toezicht possible, and promised a bill requiring centralized electronic publication plus renewed contact with the VNG.
It is for the court to judge whether a shortcoming in a publication is such that the provisions concerned are therefore not binding.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen of een tekortkoming in een bekendmaking zodanig is dat de betreffende bepalingen daardoor niet verbindend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Gemeenten verdienen grif aan ‘spookleges’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities unlawfully charge leges (fees) for permits where the underlying zoning plan is outdated, and whether unlawfully obtained fees must be refunded. The minister agreed it is undesirable, but said municipalities and their councils are responsible, promised only to raise the issue with the VNG, and left refunds to the municipalities.
However, it is the municipalities that are responsible for the leges assessments they impose, and it is up to the relevant municipal councils to act against this.
Het zijn echter de gemeenten die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de legesaanslagen die zij opleggen en het is aan de betreffende gemeenteraden om hier tegen op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Veldman over het conflict tussen de gemeente Nijmegen en Rijkswaterstaat over het gebruik van de nevengeul van de Waal

MPs Hachchi and Veldman asked the minister about a dispute between Nijmegen municipality and Rijkswaterstaat over use of the Waal side channel and the Veur-Lent island, including whether Rijkswaterstaat is backtracking on earlier agreements. The minister replied that Rijkswaterstaat is working constructively with the municipality, will draw up a joint plan for the area, and indicated where a boathouse and seasonal catering may be located.
Rijkswaterstaat will, in consultation with the municipality, draw up a plan for how this area is to be used.
Rijkswaterstaat zal in afstemming met de gemeente een plan opstellen voor de invulling van dit gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en De Boer over het bericht “Krimpbeleid Oost-Groningen zorgwekkend”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the 2.24 million euro population-decline grant for East Groningen carries conditions, and whether regional rather than Gemeentefonds-based approaches should lead on shrinkage policy. The government answered that the funds are unconditional Gemeentefonds money, favours an integrated cross-municipal approach encouraged by designating one centre municipality per shrinkage region, and says it already works with the province and region on shrinkage policy.
The funds are part of the municipal fund and are therefore not tied to any conditions.
De middelen zijn onderdeel van het gemeentefonds en daarmee niet aan voorwaarden gebonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het door de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie afgewezen verzoek van YAZULA om de berichtgeving van NL Alert als open data ontsloten te krijgen

Rep. Veldman (VVD) asks why the Ministry of Security and Justice rejected app developer YAZULA's request to receive NL Alert messages as open data under the reuse of public sector information act, whether any statutory exception applies, and what will be done to ensure departments comply. Minister Plasterk answers that the request is assessed on its merits by the ministry, that the applicant need not have a stated interest, that implementation support such as information sessions and guidance is being provided, but does not explain the specific rejection.
In principle, every institution entrusted with a public task is responsible for the correct application of this act.
In beginsel is iedere met een publieke taak belaste instelling verantwoordelijk voor een juiste toepassing van deze wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Veldman over het bericht dat de NS spitstreinen elders in het land schrapt ter bevordering van SAIL in Amsterdam

MPs De Boer and Veldman asked whether NS cutting off-peak local train services to free capacity for Sail Amsterdam was acceptable, how often this happens, its effect on punctuality targets and on reserve rolling stock and maintenance. The State Secretary answered that the local, limited cuts were a considered choice for passengers, that this had not happened before for large events, that cancellations under 48 hours count toward punctuality, and that reserve stock and deferred maintenance were used.
It has not previously happened that NS had to systematically cancel train services during large events.
Het is niet eerder voorgekomen dat NS planmatig treindiensten heeft moeten schrappen tijdens grote evenementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over gebiedsaanwijzing op de Noordzee

An MP asked the minister about when and how wind-at-sea zones between 10 and 12 nautical miles will be designated, how stakeholders are involved, which studies and cumulative-effects analyses underpin the decision, and why an extension beyond 12 miles is not pursued. The minister answered that the strips will be designated around mid-2016 after an MER and draft structural vision, that stakeholders have been consulted, that cumulative effects will be assessed under the MER, and that extension beyond 12 miles is not feasible.
Before the areas between 10 and 12 miles are designated, an environmental impact assessment (MER) will be carried out.
Voordat wordt overgegaan tot aanwijzing van gebieden tussen de 10 en 12 mijl wordt een milieueffectrapportage (MER) uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en De Caluwé over digitale dossier- en archiefvorming

MPs Veldman and De Caluwé asked the Minister of Interior about a warning letter from local officials on poor digital record-keeping and its consequences for openness of government, and what steps follow. The minister says the warning is taken seriously, points to existing archiving standards, metadata schemas and projects such as AIDO and Archief 2020, and notes that all government documents fall under the Wob regardless of medium.
Every document held by the government in principle falls under the Wob (Freedom of Information Act).
Elk document dat bij de overheid berust, valt in principe onder de Wob.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Leegte en Veldman over de gevolgen van windenergiegebieden op zee voor de visserij

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the economic damage to fishing from the Borssele offshore wind zones, including detours, fishing-ground loss, and passage for vessels up to 42 metres.
