verzoekt de regering om, tot meer overzichtelijke, eenduidige en heldere kwaliteitsinzichten voor cliënten en zorgaanbieders te komen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Kerstens over het bericht dat miljoenen euro’s in zakken van zorgdirecteuren verdwijnen

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked the government about reports that millions of euros of public care funds flow to care directors as dividends, and how this is permitted and controlled. The State Secretary answered that the WTZi bans profit distribution in institutional care but allows it in some outpatient care, that internal supervisors, insurers and municipalities oversee this, and that existing rules are sufficient, while promising to fight abuse via the governance code and inspections.
In the first instance, it is up to the supervisory body of the care provider concerned to assess whether paying out dividends is in the interest of the provider's continuity and patient care.

Het is in eerste instantie aan het toezichthoudend orgaan van de betreffende zorgaanbieder om te beoordelen of het uitkeren van dividend in het belang is van de continuïteit van de aanbieder en de zorgverlening aan patiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Wolbert over een gemeente die geen nieuwe zorginstelling binnen zijn grenzen wil

MPs Van Dijk and Wolbert asked whether the municipality of Aa en Hunze's refusal to host a 24-place assisted-living facility over budget concerns, and the risk of shifting clients between municipalities, is acceptable. The State Secretary says regional need is already met, explains that cost exposure depends on the care actually provided and contracts, and points to a regional plan and a 2020 objective funding model rather than new cross-municipal payment arrangements.
For the distribution of funds for sheltered housing there is currently a historical distribution.
Voor de verdeling van de middelen behorend bij beschermd wonen is momenteel sprake van een historische verdeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Leijten over de handelswijze van bestuurders bij Alliade Zorggroep

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked the state secretary about conflict of interest at Alliade Zorggroep, where two directors earned money through subcontracting companies, and whether the supervisory board, accountants, IGZ and NZa failed in their oversight. The state secretary answered that IGZ and NZa investigated, found no unlawful use of care funds, and that Alliade has committed to measures such as tighter internal rules and disclosure, with the IGZ to monitor compliance.
I share with IGZ and NZa that any appearance of conflict of interest must be avoided and I agree with their judgment that Alliade must remedy this.
Ik deel met IGZ en NZa dat iedere schijn van belangenverstrengeling moet worden vermeden en deel hun oordeel dat Alliade dit moet herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over huishoudelijke hulpen die vaker zwart werken

MPs Kerstens and Van Dijk asked whether domestic helpers increasingly work informally and why the RDaH scheme has little uptake and weaker legal protection for short-hours workers. The minister said informal work is not known, described an information campaign on RDaH, defended the scheme's differentiated rules, and noted municipal use of the Huishoudelijke Hulptoelage.
Whether there is undeclared work involved is not known to us.
Of hierbij sprake is van zwart werk, is ons niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over de topinkomens in de zorg

Two PvdA MPs asked whether it is troubling that healthcare executives earn above the minister's salary, and whether executives should voluntarily forgo pay above the WNT norm, and whether they are paid in line with the WNT. The minister answered that pay limits are set by the WNT, that institutions and supervisors make a societal assessment within those limits, that pay is a recurring topic with employer organisations, and that CIBG supervises WNT compliance and enforces where needed.
CIBG, the supervisory body in healthcare, monitors compliance with the WNT and enforces it where necessary.
Het CIBG, de toezichthouder in de zorg, ziet toe op de naleving van de WNT en treedt, indien nodig, handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over de interne crisis in zorginstelling De Gelderhorst

An MP asks the minister about the prolonged internal conflict between the supervisory board and the rest of care institution De Gelderhorst, including threats to care continuity, poor communication and mediation. The state secretary says the situation is undesirable, that the IGZ is investigating including the role of the board parties, and that no current signs show care continuity is at risk, while leaving resolution largely to the parties themselves.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) is investigating the current situation at De Gelderhorst and is also looking at the role of the governing parties.
De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) onderzoekt de actuele situatie bij De Gelderhorst en kijkt daarin ook naar de rol van de bestuurlijke partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Otwin van Dijk inzake de toegankelijkheid van hoger onderwijs voor dove 30+ studenten

MPs Mohandis and Van Dijk asked whether the ministry's age-30 cutoff for sign-language interpreters in higher education leaves deaf students over 30 unequally treated, and how this fits the UN disability convention. The minister replied that responsibility shifts to the individual after 30, that no unequal situation exists, that UWV or municipalities may fund an interpreter under conditions, and pointed to earlier answers for further options.
From the age limit of 30 years, responsibility for education rests with the individual and no longer with the Ministry of OCW.
Vanaf de leeftijdsgrens van 30 jaar komt de verantwoordelijkheid voor onderwijs bij de persoon te liggen en niet meer bij het Ministerie van OCW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het artikel ‘Minder uren, meer zelf doen en meer alfahulpen’

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked the State Secretary for Health about a municipality's preference for 'alfahulpen' (publicly funded assistants in home care) and the continued use of this arrangement despite the planned ban. The State Secretary answered that the arrangement is undesirable, that the municipality has been advised against continuing it, that a bill banning alfahulpen in the general provision is forthcoming, and that municipalities are responsible for continuity of care.
The number of municipalities providing home support with the help of alfahulpen is not registered nationally.
Het aantal gemeenten dat thuisondersteuning verleent met behulp van alfahulpen wordt landelijk niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug, Otwin van Dijk en Fokke over de belemmeringen voor personen met een visuele beperking om als raadslid te kunnen functioneren

MPs Oosenbrug, Van Dijk and Fokke asked whether visually impaired councillors are forced to resign because of inadequate support, and what support exists and whether digital democracy is accessible. The Minister says the government is reviewing barriers via a stakeholder inventory and the Dijkstal law evaluation, notes existing financial support for structural impairments, and says digitalisation can help while accessibility is an ongoing process.
The Ministry of the Interior does not keep track of how many political office holders have a visual or other impairment or have had to resign for that reason.
Het Ministerie van BZK houdt niet bij hoeveel politieke ambtsdragers een visuele of andersoortige beperking hebben dan wel om die reden hebben moeten aftreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin van Dijk over de privacyschending door ziekenhuizen

MPs Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked the ministers whether hospitals' outsourcing of scanning patient files to Belgian prisoners, and the resulting privacy breaches reported by Omroep Max, were acceptable and what action would be taken. Minister Schippers answered that the situation is undesirable, that a national investigation into hospital data-security practice will be reported by end 2016, and that the Dutch Data Protection Authority is investigating, while stressing its independence and enforcement priorities.
As indicated, I find the situation undesirable and not discreetly handling patient data unacceptable.
Zoals aangegeven vind ik de situatie onwenselijk en het niet discreet omgaan met patiëntgegevens niet acceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Tanamal over thuiszorgtaken voor mantelzorgers

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary whether it is acceptable that a home-care organisation expects family members, including those living far away, to carry out personal care tasks such as fetching medication and helping clients in bed, and whether it uses a standard task list for relatives. The secretary agreed that tasks cannot simply be shifted to informal carers, that care must be tailored per client, and that a standard list does not fit the Wmo 2015, but said he has no national picture of how many organisations use such lists and will raise the issue with the VNG and industry bodies.
I do not have a national picture of how many home-care organisations use such a standard list.
Ik heb geen landelijk beeld van hoeveel thuiszorgorganisaties een dergelijke standaardlijst hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Otwin van Dijk over de stand van zaken rondom projecten waarbij medicijnresten uit het water worden gezuiverd

MPs Jacobi and Otwin van Dijk asked about the halting of a pilot medicine-residue water treatment installation at Isala hospital, its cost-effectiveness, and related Pharmafilter projects. The state secretary answered that the Isala installation was a time-limited research facility now stopped due to high operating costs, that treatment is being explored in a broader chain approach, and that no specific new commitments were made beyond further reviews.
The installation was stopped because there are currently no new research questions related to it and its operating costs are considerable.
De installatie is stopgezet omdat er op dit moment geen nieuwe onderzoeksvragen in relatie tot deze installatie zijn en de exploitatiekosten van de installatie aanzienlijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin van Dijk over de toegankelijkheid van Mijnoverheid.nl en apps van de overheid

MPs Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked the Minister of Interior whether MijnOverheid.nl and government apps are accessible to people with disabilities, and what steps will be taken to guarantee this. The minister acknowledged complaints, said the portal meets WCAG 2.0 level and that accessibility is a priority, but noted that existing web standards do not fully cover native apps and that a new European standard is being explored.
Once the standard for non-web-based apps is established at international or European level, I will be able to take measures to make this standard mandatory for the Dutch government as well.

Zodra de standaard voor niet webgebaseerde apps in internationaal dan wel Europees verband is vastgesteld, zal ik maatregelen kunnen nemen om deze standaard ook voor de Nederlandse overheid verplicht te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Otwin van Dijk over de levering van cannabisolie aan patiënten buiten Nederland

MPs Volp and Otwin van Dijk asked the Minister of Health about a The Hague pharmacy supplying THC-free cannabis oil to young patients and patients abroad, the research on cannabidiol for epilepsy, the legal risks for families travelling with it, and how many pharmacies supply it and who reimburses it. The Minister confirmed awareness, pointed to published research and the BMC's support for research, blamed foreign national policy for the travel problem, and said she has no view on insurers' reimbursement policy.
I have no insight into insurers' reimbursement policy for cannabis oil.
Ik heb geen zicht op het vergoedingsbeleid van zorgverzekeraars op cannabisolie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Kerstens over minder plek voor rolstoelgebruikers in bussen in Arnhem

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Kerstens asked why newly purchased Arnhem trolleybuses offer less space for large electric wheelchairs despite accessible stops, and whether EU rules were responsible. The state secretary answered that the bus operator is testing a new layout with wheelchair users, that the EU vehicle rules apply but the EU accessibility act is not yet law, and that no further European review is currently planned.

Given the efforts of the transport company and the concession holder to reach a solution, I currently see no reason to review with my colleague of infrastructure and environment the European guidelines on safety in public transport.

Gelet op de inspanningen van het vervoerbedrijf en de concessiehouder teneinde tot een oplossing te komen, heb ik op dit moment geen aanleiding om met mijn collega van infrastructuur en milieu de richtlijnen uit Europa te bekijken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Otwin van Dijk over het vonnis van de rechtbank Amsterdam in de zaak van de HIV-patiënt die zijn eigen hennep moet telen

MPs Volp and Van Dijk asked the minister about a court ruling acquitting an HIV patient who grew his own cannabis for medical reasons, and about access to medicinal cannabis, its varieties, reimbursement and research. The minister declined to comment on the ruling, argued the current pharmacy supply is largely sufficient, rejected rules for home cultivation or group cultivation, and listed ongoing research and reimbursement practices.
Developing (policy) rules for exceptional situations is not an option in my view.
Het ontwikkelen van (beleids)regels voor uitzonderingssituaties vind ik geen optie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht "Zilveren kruis smeert verstandelijk beperkten wurgcontract aan"

MPs from nine parties asked the State Secretary about a Zilveren Kruis settlement agreement offered to persoonsgebonden budget holders, and whether it should be withdrawn and whether the motion to halt recovery was being implemented. The State Secretary answered that the zorgkantoren act on agreements made with them, that the settlement need no longer be signed pending a good-faith assessment, that recovery of alleged improperly paid budgets is suspended until good faith is assessed by 1 May 2016, and that other zorgkantoren operate under the same agreements.
By 1 May 2016 or as soon as possible, zorgkantoren will have assessed in all currently open individual cases whether the budget holder acted in good faith.
Uiterlijk 1 mei 2016 of zoveel eerder als mogelijk, hebben zorgkantoren in alle op dit moment openstaande individuele casuïstiek beoordeeld of de budgethouder te goeder trouw heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel, Bouwmeester en Otwin van Dijk over het onderzoek ‘Geldzaken in de praktijk 2015’ van het Nibud

MPs Yücel, Bouwmeester and Otwin van Dijk asked about Nibud findings on debt arrears driven by health costs, low public awareness of financial aid, the role of municipalities and integrated financial desks, and how health-cost compensation is made known and used. The government answered that it monitors low incomes, that municipalities are responsible for debt assistance and receive extra funding, and that it is running information campaigns on the deductible and health-cost compensation.
In response to this motion I visited the Geldloket in Amersfoort.
In reactie op deze motie ben ik op bezoek geweest bij het Geldloket in Amersfoort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht dat bij veel zelfzorggeneesmiddelen noodzakelijke informatie ontbreekt

MPs Bruins Slot and Van Dijk asked whether many over-the-counter medicines lack information on shelf life after opening, and whether the CBG and government enforce the duty to test and label it. The minister answered that since 2001 manufacturers must test and label post-opening shelf life, that the CBG checks this at licensing, and that the CBG is negotiating with industry to label it on all multi-use products.
This obligation is checked by the CBG when granting a marketing authorisation, at which point the product information is also approved.
Deze verplichting controleert het CBG bij het verlenen van een handelsvergunning, waarbij ook de productinformatie wordt goedgekeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Owtin van Dijk en Tanamal over het bericht ‘Zorgadviseur” strijkt 68.000 euro op’

MPs Kerstens, Owtin van Dijk and Tanamal asked whether a former board chair of care institution Reinier van Arkel received about 368,000 euro as an adviser after leaving in 2013, whether this complied with the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT), and whether the arrangement amounted to a disguised continuation of the top role. The minister confirmed the pay figures in the annual accounts, said the WNT does not cap pay of former top officials, referred the case to the regulator CIBG for routine supervision, and stated no sham arrangement had been established.
The WNT regulator for the care sector, the CIBG, will examine this case within the regular supervision of the WNT.
De toezichthouder van de WNT voor de zorgsector, het CIBG, zal deze casus in het kader van het reguliere toezicht op de WNT onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Otwin van Dijk en Monasch over het bericht “Salaris bobo's Friese thuiszorg verdubbeld”

MPs asked the government about reports that supervisory board pay at home-care organisation Patyna had doubled and whether this complies with the Wet Normering Topinkomens. The minister answered that the board pay was reversed, stays at prior levels, falls within WNT limits as far as applicable, and that setting pay and consulting staff are the organisation's own responsibility.
Within the limits set by law, in particular the WNT, it is for the institution and the top official to determine what constitutes appropriate remuneration.
Binnen de grenzen die de wet, in het bijzonder de WNT, stelt is het aan de instelling en de topfunctionaris om te bepalen wat een passende beloning is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Wolbert over herindicatie van cliënten met een persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) voor wijkverpleging

MPs Van Dijk and Wolbert asked why insurers use differing forms when re-assessing personal-budget (pgb) clients receiving community nursing and what can reduce the administrative burden. The Secretary of State answered that insurers are adopting a uniform application form from 1 January 2016, developed with nursing bodies, and that ministry, insurers and providers will screen forms for necessity while monitoring progress.
I will keep a close eye on this.
Ik zal dit in de gaten blijven houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Hoogland over de aanvraag van een OV-begeleiderskaart

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Hoogland asked why applying for an OV-begeleiderskaart requires a five-page questionnaire and an IQ test on top of a CIZ indication, and whether these burdens could be dropped when a valid CIZ indication exists. The State Secretary agreed partly: a CIZ indication suffices as proof in one specific case (IQ test no longer required for those with an AWBZ/Wlz 24-hour care indication), reviews of the questionnaire are planned for early next year, but data exchange with CIZ is not straightforwardly permitted under privacy law.

I also want to explore with the indication body for the OV-begeleiderskaart whether the questionnaire can be made more concrete regarding required evidence, so that one piece of evidence per criterion suffices.

Ik wil daarnaast met de indicatiesteller voor de OV-begeleiderskaart bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om de vragenlijst op het punt van de benodigde bewijsstukken zodanig te concretiseren dat er met één bewijsstuk per criterium volstaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over het herindiceren van cliënten met een persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) op basis van de Zorgverzekeringswet

MP Otwin van Dijk asked the state secretary about Menzis giving clients with a personal budget (pgb) under the Zorgverzekeringswet only about three weeks to submit a new application, and whether that deadline was reasonable and why clients were informed so late. The state secretary said Menzis has adjusted its communication, allowing extensions for force majeure, and that he will keep asking insurers for good communication, while not judging whether short deadlines are generally adequate.
I find it unfortunate to hear that this happened, and I do not think it is right that a pgb should be stopped if an insured person cannot meet the set deadline for legitimate reasons.
Ik vind het vervelend om te horen dat dat gebeurd is en ik vind het niet juist dat een pgb zou worden stopgezet, als een verzekerde om legitieme redenen niet aan de gestelde termijn kan voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over winstuitkeringen aan bestuurder/eigenaar van een thuiszorginstelling

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked whether dividend payouts to the owner of a home-care provider (Breederzorg) comply with the WNT pay-cap and other rules, and whether tighter rules are needed on owner-managers and profit distributions in publicly funded care. The state secretary replied that dividends are not governed by the WNT, that CIBG will examine the case under routine supervision, and that existing law and the governance code provide sufficient safeguards.
CIBG will, as the responsible supervisor, examine this further within regular WNT supervision of the institution.
Het CIBG zal dit als verantwoordelijk toezichthouder nader onderzoeken in het kader van het reguliere WNT-toezicht op de instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin van Dijk over voortdurende onbereikbaarheid van 112 voor doven en slechthorenden

MPs Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked why 112 emergency access for deaf and hard-of-hearing people remained unreliable, citing Signaal's finding that over half of test calls got no text reply, and asked about timelines, adoption of the REACH112 recommendations and release of technical reports. Minister van der Steur answered that a software upgrade caused the problem, that it was fixed on 23 October 2015, that an independent TNO study is pending, and that selected technical reports are attached.
I have made a selection of the technical reports on the reachability and reliability of 112 for deaf and hard-of-hearing people that are relevant to you.
Ik heb een selectie gemaakt van voor u relevante rapportages van de technische onderzoeken naar de bereikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid van 112 voor doven en slechthorenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over declaratieproblemen tolken gebarentaal

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked why UWV introduced a new centralised invoicing system for sign-language interpreters, leaving deaf users and interpreters without timely payment, and how future communication will be improved. The state secretary acknowledges the late and incomplete notification, admits about 2400 misrouted invoices were paid, restores the old process temporarily, and promises a review with the Dovenschap, though she gives no figures on September declarations.
Up to and including 9 October, 2400 invoices that had ended up in the wrong place were traced.
Tot en met 9 oktober zijn er 2400 facturen achterhaald die verkeerd terecht waren gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Potters over het controleren van zorgdeclaraties door bewindvoerders

MPs Van Dijk and Potters asked whether fraud with personal budgets (PGB) remains possible because court-appointed administrators do not check care declarations, and who is responsible for care quality when administrators lack the expertise. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, said administrators are responsible only for finances and administration, and promised work with Per Saldo and care offices on what safeguards 'gewaarborgde hulp' requires, to be addressed in a forthcoming PGB policy agenda.
With Per Saldo and care offices I am working out which safeguards are needed for guaranteed assistance.
Met Per Saldo en zorgkantoren werk ik uit welke waarborgen nodig zijn voor gewaarborgde hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Bouwmeester over de hogere tarieven na sluitingstijd van apothekers in dunbevolkte gebieden

MPs Van Dijk and Bouwmeester asked whether higher after-hours pharmacy tariffs in sparsely populated areas, sometimes up to €70 more, are acceptable and whether patients delay collecting urgent medication to avoid them. The minister acknowledged the regional tariff differences and the risk of a negative spiral, and said the problem would be resolved from 2016 after talks with the NZa and sector parties, though she defended tariff differences as part of how care is financed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over knelpunten rond het persoonlijk assistentiebudget in de (Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz)

An MP asks how the Wlz personal assistance budget accounts for partners living together, overlapping care, assistant training and whether the budget may be used by clients without independent housing. The Secretary of State says partner-cohabiting budgets are set lower on purpose, individual case-by-case flexibility is being explored with care offices, and the scheme will be evaluated after two years.
After I receive the response of the care offices on this point, I will consider on that basis whether the necessary tailoring can indeed be provided.
Nadat ik de reactie van de zorgkantoren op dit punt heb ontvangen, zal ik mede op basis daarvan bezien of het benodigde maatwerk inderdaad geleverd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Wolbert over het project ‘Samen Oud’ in Groningen en Drenthe

MPs Van Dijk and Wolbert asked the State Secretary about the 'Samen Oud' project in Groningen and Drenthe, which faces discontinuation by insurer Achmea, and about whether insurers use the experiment article and Van Dijk's amendment to require municipal-insurer cooperation. The State Secretary said the project is not being stopped, that the communication problem with Achmea is resolved, and that insurers may take different approaches, with ongoing trajectories on innovation; the final question was not answered.
As stated in my answer to question 4, there is no question of stopping the 'Samen Oud' project.
Zoals gezegd in mijn antwoord op vraag 4, is er geen sprake van het stopzetten van het project «Samen Oud».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over het bericht dat één derde van de medewerkers in de gehandicaptenzorg zich onveilig voelt

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that a third of disability-care staff feel unsafe, rising violence reports, pressure to stay silent, understaffing, and training and support after incidents. The State Secretary answered that the government disapproves of silence, supports the Veilig Werken in de Zorg action plan, places primary responsibility for staffing and safety on managers and social partners, and will inform parliament on lessons learned.
I will shortly inform your House about the lessons learned in addressing the causes of aggression in care across 27 institutions participating in the programme.
Ik zal uw Kamer binnenkort informeren over de geleerde lessen met de aanpak van veroorzakers van agressie in de zorg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer en Otwin van Dijk over de zware belasting van de mantelzorger

MPs Keijzer and Van Dijk asked the State Secretary about the heavy burden on informal carers caused by overlapping laws and bureaucracy, citing a case broadcast on De Wachtkamer. The State Secretary said the 'one family, one plan' principle is built into the new system, that signals are discussed with stakeholders and obstacles will be removed where needed, and pointed to a pilot for an integrated PGB and the experiment clause in the Wlz.
When obstacles in laws and regulations are experienced, I am willing to look at them and remove them where necessary.
Wanneer er belemmeringen in wet- en regelgeving worden ervaren, ben ik bereid daarnaar te kijken en deze waar nodig weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over PGB’s onder de Zorgverzekeringswet

MP Otwin van Dijk asked whether insurer Univé Zorgzaam deducted 10% administrative costs from personal budgets (PGB), whether maximum tariffs apply, and what happens to unspent PGB money. The Secretary of State answered that the 10% cut was a choice to meet a budget reduction for personal care, not an administrative fee, that insurers set tariffs within NZa maximums and inform policyholders, and that unspent budgets stay with insurers.
It is the responsibility of health insurers to determine the level of tariffs for reimbursing non-contracted care.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgverzekeraars om de hoogte van de tarieven voor de vergoeding van niet-gecontracteerde zorg te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over de mogelijkheid van het tijdelijk opschorten van het Persoonsgebonden Budget (PGB) tijdens revalidatie

MP Otwin van Dijk asked whether a PGB under the Wlz is stopped during temporary rehabilitation in a clinic, causing extra administrative burden, and whether it could be suspended instead of ended. The State Secretary replied that Article 5.20 Rlz ends a PGB after two months of institutional stay, but Article 5.7 allows a PGB to be re-granted without full reapplication, and he will clarify this with care offices.
To prevent unnecessary administrative burden, the second paragraph of Article 5.7 suspends all conditions that normally apply to a PGB application.
Om onnodige administratieve lasten te voorkomen stelt het tweede lid van artikel 5.7 vervolgens alle voorwaarden die normaal van toepassing zijn op een pgb-aanvraag buiten werking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Albert de Vries over een afgewezen zorgindicatie en de bezwaarprocedure bij het Centrum Indicatiestelling Zorg (CIZ)

MPs Van Dijk and De Vries asked about a rejected care indication for an MS patient in Walcheren, the patient's forced double move, the CIZ's failure to involve family, and the 21-week objection period. The State Secretary said the objection was reconsidered and access granted, that moving patients back and forth is undesirable, that the 21-week period is statutory with a 10.5-week actual duration here, and committed to asking the CIZ to review objection processing times.
I will ask the CIZ to examine the processing time of objection procedures further and to inform you about this in a next progress report HLZ.
Ik zal het CIZ vragen de doorlooptijd van bezwaarprocedures nader te bezien en u ter gelegenheid van een volgende voortgangsrapportage HLZ daarover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over het weigeren van een blindengeleidehond door de Hema

An MP asked the state secretary whether a Hema store in Amsterdam refused entry to a person with a guide dog, whether guide dogs must always be admitted, and what law and awareness efforts apply. The secretary confirmed the refusal, said Hema apologised and that its house rules allow guide dogs, and said extending the equal-treatment law to goods and services will make refusal largely unlawful.
As part of the bill implementing the UN convention, the field of goods and services will be brought within the scope of the Equal Treatment Act on Grounds of Disability or Chronic Illness.
In het kader van het wetsvoorstel tot uitvoering van het VN-verdrag wordt het terrein van goederen en diensten onder de reikwijdte van de Wgbh/cz gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Dik-Faber over maatwerkprofielen en herindicering in de Wet langdurige zorg (Wlz) voor ernstig meervoudig gehandicapte kinderen

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Dik-Faber asked about CIZ requests for extensive, short-deadline information from families of severely multiple-disabled children being reassessed for the Wlz, and about timing of tailored care profiles and the extra-care scheme. The state secretary said CIZ will ask only targeted questions, plans to extend the transitional period by one year and consider a four-week deadline, but gave no firm date for tailored profiles and did not answer the last question in time.
I am consulting with the CIZ and the parties involved about this. A period of four weeks seems reasonable.
Ik ben hierover in overleg met het CIZ en betrokken partijen. Een periode van vier weken lijkt redelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over "gedwongen zzp-erschap bij Sensire"

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked the ministers about reports that care provider Sensire wanted to dismiss 600 home-care workers and rehire them as self-employed, questioning whether this amounts to disguised self-employment and whether unions should be involved. Minister Asscher answered that pressuring employees into self-employment is undesirable, that UWV and courts assess individual cases, that UWV refuses dismissal permits where the aim is to avoid employee status, and pointed to the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies and the 2013 action plan.
In general terms, it is for the courts to assess the facts and circumstances of the individual case and rule on them.
In algemene zin is het aan de rechter om de feiten en omstandigheden van het individuele geval te beoordelen en daar een uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over de uitvoering van het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) in de Zorgverzekeringswet (Zvw) voor intensieve kindzorg

MP Otwin van Dijk asked the State Secretary about problems with the Zvw personal budget (pgb) for intensive child care, including minute-based declarations, the non-professional tariff, budget cuts and late SVB payments. The State Secretary acknowledged the signals, described steps taken with insurers (adjusted declaration methods, review of the tariff in evaluation, a practical solution pending new funding rules) and outlined the changes in administration for beneficiaries.
I have no insight into whether this means that in no single situation has a reduction been applied to intensive child care anymore.
Ik heb geen inzicht in of dit betekent dat er in geen enkele situatie meer een korting is toegepast bij intensieve kindzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Otwin van Dijk over onduidelijkheid scheiding onderwijs- en zorgbudget voor ernstig gehandicapte kinderen

MPs Ypma and Otwin van Dijk asked how care and education budgets for severely disabled children during school hours are divided, and what happens when schools, municipalities and insurers cannot agree on funding. The state secretary answered that the boundary is individual, care can be agreed in the child's Wlz care plan, a consultation guide and support are offered, and a regulation will redirect about EUR 6-8 million of previously compensated funds to special schools from 2015-2016.
I am aware that there are signals of unclarity about the provision of care and support during school hours for children with severe multiple disabilities.
Het is mij bekend dat er signalen zijn over onduidelijkheden rondom de invulling van zorg en ondersteuning tijdens schooltijd voor kinderen met een ernstige meervoudige beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over feit dat geneesmiddelenfabrikanten de prijzen van geneesmiddelen hebben opgedreven, en de kosten voor geneesmiddelen hebben verhoogd

MP Otwin van Dijk asked the Health Minister about manufacturers raising drug prices, including hospital discounts versus higher outpatient prices, evergreening, and the ACM report, and whether reference pricing, the GVS reimbursement system, or prescriber behaviour should change. Minister Schippers largely defended existing policy, pointed to pending GVS recalculation and ongoing agreements with prescribers, and promised a broader approach with proposals in the autumn.
I will take the ACM's recommendations into account in the broader approach I referred to in my answer to questions 5 and 6.
Ik zal de aanbevelingen van ACM betrekken bij de bredere aanpak waar ik in mijn antwoord op vragen 5 en 6 naar verwees.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het plotseling niet meer vergoeden van een aantal geneesmiddelen

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Bouwmeester ask why health insurers suddenly stopped reimbursing about 300-400 compounded medicines from 1 March 2015, how the IGZ supervises compounded supplies, and whether the Zorginstituut should rule on them. Minister Schippers admits the insurers' communication was poor and promises to raise it with them, says the IGZ checks compounding dossiers by sampling, and states that disputed cases will go to talks and possibly the Zorginstituut.
I have addressed Zorgverzekeraars Nederland on this.
Ik heb Zorgverzekeraars Nederland hierop aangesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht ‘Tilburg dreigt zorgbedrijven met topinkomens’

Two MPs asked whether Tilburg will stop subsidising care institutions with staff paid above a minister's salary from 2016, and what central government is doing to support local pay caps. The minister confirmed Tilburg's plan, said the WNT norm of 178,000 euro is decent, and reported an interbureaucratic network with VNG and IPO preparing model approaches due by 1 June 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over de kwaliteit van zorg in een Haags verpleeghuis

An MP asks the State Secretary about care quality at a Hague nursing home, including a spouse covering shifts due to staff shortages, medication and hygiene concerns, and unheeded client council warnings. The State Secretary says the IGZ inspectorate is responsible for judging care quality, reports voluntary-level findings of staffing, expertise and medication safety improvement points, and points to a forthcoming improvement programme.
The judgement on whether responsible care is being provided is a responsibility of the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ).
Het oordeel op de vraag of er verantwoorde zorg wordt geleverd, is een verantwoordelijkheid van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht «Salariseis bestuurder verboden in aanbesteding»

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked whether municipalities may impose salary limits in Wmo tenders, and how this relates to a parliamentary amendment and a motion on local top-income norms. The minister replied that salary demands must meet the proportionality principle under the Aanbestedingswet, that the WNT maxima apply in any case, and that talks with VNG and IPO on local top-income norms are ongoing.
Imposing salary requirements as such does not appear to meet this.
Het stellen van salariseisen als zodanig lijkt hier niet aan te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over het feit dat de toegezegde pilot met het persoonlijk assistentiebudget nog niet van start is gegaan

An MP asked why the promised pilot with a personal assistance budget (persoonlijk assistentiebudget) for severely disabled clients had not started, and whether it should be secured in the Wlz before it takes effect. The Secretary of State replied that no legal barriers exist, that existing ZZP-meerzorg pgb rules can be used, that a tailored procedure via Vilans is planned for early October, and that no new pilot or legislative change is needed.
There are therefore no obstacles in laws and regulations to start with personal assistance.
Er zijn dus geen belemmeringen in de wet- en regelgeving om een start te maken met persoonlijke assistentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Wolbert over de ontruiming van een gedeelte van het centrum van Amsterdam naar aanleiding van de bommelding op 25 juni 2014

MPs Van Dijk and Wolbert asked about the evacuation of central Amsterdam after a bomb threat, including whether Hotel Krasnapolsky should have been evacuated and whether disabled people face delays in evacuations. The minister said the hotel was not ordered evacuated, that police only advised, and that no evidence shows disabled evacuations are delayed, while declining to collect data on building accessibility and pointing to planned rule changes.
I do not have that data and I do not consider it necessary to collect that data after all.
Ik beschik niet over die gegevens en vind het ook niet nodig om die gegevens alsnog te verzamelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin Van Dijk over het leegstaan van een nieuwbouwlocatie voor kinderen met een verstandelijke beperking, en inkoopbeleid van een zorgkantoor

An MP asked the state secretary why a newly built care location in Hengelo for children with intellectual disabilities has stood empty since autumn 2013 because the care office refused in-kind placement, and what the government will do about the care office's purchasing policy. The state secretary called the situation unfortunate, said a practical solution via a personal budget was found with the families, and pointed to multi-year purchasing contracts and planned rules under the Wlz to limit regional purchasing discretion.
The care office's task is to purchase care that matches clients' preferences, both as regards the way care is delivered (in-kind, vpt or pgb) and the location.

Het zorgkantoor heeft tot taak om zorg in te kopen die aansluit bij de voorkeuren van cliënten, zowel ten aanzien van de wijze waarop de zorg wordt geleverd (zorg in natura, vpt of pgb) als de locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Otwin van Dijk en Fokke over het bericht «Venlo eist salarisverlaging top Zorggroep»

MPs Kerstens, Van Dijk and Fokke asked about a 5% salary increase for the chair of the Zorggroep Noord- en Midden-Limburg board, its link to the Venlo council's demand for a salary cut, and whether the government would back the executive's stance and coordinate with VNG and IPO on local pay norms. Minister Plasterk answered that the increase was lawful under the WNT transitional rules, that voluntary pay cuts are encouraged, and that the case will be raised with VNG and IPO, which are still in talks.
I will include the case in the consultation with VNG and IPO.
Ik zal de casus betrekken bij het overleg met VNG en IPO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Hoogland over negatieve ervaringen en klachten van rolstoelgebruikers met betrekking tot het openbaar busvervoer

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Hoogland asked about complaints from wheelchair users refused on buses, including broken wheelchair ramps, and whether the government will engage with users and operators. The government agreed accessible public transport matters, said the Human Rights Board ruling shows non-working ramps breach rules, noted operator Veolia is taking measures, and said the IenM state secretary will urge the sector to clarify rights for electric wheelchair users.
A recent ruling (no. 2014-50) of the Human Rights Board makes clear that a non-working wheelchair ramp is inconsistent with the Dutch rules on accessibility for wheelchair users.

Uit een recent oordeel (nr. 2014–50) van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens komt duidelijk naar voren dat een niet-werkende rolstoelplank zich niet verhoudt met de regels die in Nederland gelden voor toegankelijkheid van mensen met een rolstoel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Dik Faber over fraude met het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb)

MPs asked whether the Public Prosecution Service's decision not to investigate suspected PGB fraud in Houten (about 1.6 million euros not spent on care), and reportedly about 200 unprocessed fraud complaints at the national office, was acceptable given the stated lack of priority and capacity. The government replied that fraud is a high priority, that the prosecution service selects cases by modus operandi and motivated its decision, that it could not confirm the 200 figure and referred to earlier letters, and that a package of measures to tighten PGB access is being implemented.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it cannot confirm the stated number of 200 PGB fraud complaints.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij meegedeeld het genoemde aantal van 200 aangiften van pgb-fraude niet te kunnen bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over stijging van de inkomens van zorgbestuurders

MPs Kerstens and Van Dijk asked whether top executive pay in elderly care rose 19% in 2013, whether the WNT transitional rules allow this, and how to prevent further rises during the reform. The government said it cannot yet confirm the figure, that no accountant has reported a WNT breach, that it agrees top pay should not outpace sector wages, and that it will act through supervision and reclaim undue payments if needed.
Moreover, I have not received any reports from the accountants that the WNT has been breached.
Overigens heb ik op dit moment geen meldingen binnen gekregen van de accountants dat de Wnt zou zijn overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht «Meer regeldruk dreigt door transitieplannen»

MPs Ypma and Otwin van Dijk asked the State Secretary for Health about Actal's warning that transition plans for youth and long-term care risk increasing red tape, and whether concrete agreements to reduce it are made. The State Secretary answered that the decentralisations are expected to cut regulatory burden by about EUR 20 million, that agreements to remove rules and standardise data requests are included, and that a monitoring commitment with municipalities will follow from 2015, while not adopting all of Actal's recommendations as such.
Question 4: Are you willing to follow the four recommendations of Actal, including concrete agreements that should be made to reduce regulatory burden and bureaucracy?
Vraag 4 Bent u bereid de vier aanbevelingen van Actal op te volgen, waaronder concrete afspraken die gemaakt dienen te worden om regeldruk en bureaucratie te verminderen?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Otwin van Dijk over het oordeel van het College voor de Rechten van Mens over het door Veolia gemaakte onderscheid op basis van handicap of chronische ziekte

MPs Hoogland and Van Dijk asked the State Secretary about a College for Human Rights ruling that transport operator Veolia discriminated against a wheelchair user by not providing temporary assistance. The State Secretary said the ruling reinforces the need for broader accessibility measures, that the province as concession grantor is responsible and has held talks, and that he will bring the ruling to the attention of the concession-granting bodies' associations.
I will also bring this to the attention of the province of Limburg, which manages the concession, by letter.
Ik zal dit ook per brief onder de aandacht brengen van de provincie Limburg die de concessie beheert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin van Dijk over het gebruik van open standaarden bij de doventolkdienst KPN Teletolk

MPs Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked whether new providers of Total Conversation software have entered the Dutch market for KPN Teletolk and whether KPN complies with open standards and the Telecommunications Act. The minister replied that no new providers have entered yet, that KPN is still resolving interoperability issues with some vendors, and that complaints can be brought to the regulator ACM, with a resolution expected within six months.
KPN thereby complies with the requirements set by the Telecommunications Act.
KPN voldoet daarmee aan de eisen die de Telecommunicatiewet stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Otwin Van Dijk over moeizame samenwerking tussen 26 Utrechtse gemeenten en Achmea

MPs Dik-Faber and Van Dijk asked whether cooperation between 26 Utrecht municipalities and insurer Achmea is difficult and what the government will do to improve it. The State Secretary acknowledged mixed experiences, described Achmea's cooperation strategy and regional talks, and committed to actively supporting the agreements between municipalities and insurers, including in Utrecht.
I will actively support the establishment of these agreements in the regions, including in the Utrecht region where necessary, and closely monitor progress together with ZN and the VNG.
Ik zal de totstandkoming van deze afspraken in de regio, waaronder in de regio Utrecht, waar dat nodig is actief ondersteunen en de voortgang samen met ZN en de VNG nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin Van Dijk over het inkoopbeleid van zorgkantoren

An MP asked the state secretary about Actiz's survey showing that one-year budget agreements and budget-control rules by care insurers (zorgkantoren) hinder renewal of long-term care, and whether multi-year purchasing is needed. The state secretary agreed renewal is needed, said multi-year agreements are being pursued in talks with the sector for 2015, and promised to inform parliament by spring.
As I have informed you, I am taking up the improvement proposals in the talks with the sector organisations and care offices on purchasing intramural long-term care for 2015 and subsequent years.

Zoals ik u heb laten weten, neem ik de verbetervoorstellen ter hand in het kader van de besprekingen met de brancheorganisaties en zorgkantoren over de inkoop van intramurale langdurige zorg voor het jaar 2015 en volgende jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin Van Dijk over het korten van topinkomens in de zorg

MPs Kerstens and Van Dijk asked whether the government supports Rotterdam's plan to cap top salaries at care providers through subsidy conditions, and how municipalities can be encouraged to do so. Minister Plasterk answered that excessive pay is undesirable, that the WNT does not prevent stricter subsidy conditions but may conflict with transitional law, and that he will consult the VNG to align central and local policy and report on the model subsidy regulation.
Although I do not wish to restrict the freedom of local government to make its own choices, it seems sensible to align the policies of central and local government.
Hoewel ik niet de vrijheid van het lokaal bestuur wil beperken om eigen keuzes te maken, lijkt het mij verstandig om het beleid van de centrale en de decentrale overheden op elkaar af te stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin Van Dijk over de nieuwe telefoonbemiddelingsdienst voor doven

MPs Van Laar, Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked whether the new relay service for deaf users, which requires Total Conversation software from a single provider, leaves analogue text-phone users without access and whether insurers cover the costs. The minister answered that TC is an open standard, insurers cover the software licence and equipment, and access is adequate, while acknowledging a small group may briefly lose service.
All insured persons known to have received a text phone in the past have received a letter from their health insurer.
Alle verzekerden van wie bekend is dat men in het verleden een teksttelefoon heeft gekregen, hebben van hun zorgverzekeraar een brief ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Otwin van Dijk over het experiment regelarme zorg

MP Otwin van Dijk asks why care provider Careyn is leaving the regulation-light care experiment and whether administrative burden is really being reduced. The State Secretary cites Careyn's reasons (timing with the reform, need for AWBZ data for decentralisation, and costly alignment with regular registration), acknowledges some rules became more complex, and says administrative burden is largely cultural and will be tackled via standardised data exchange.
I am of the view that administrative burdens in long-term care should be limited to the minimum.
Ik ben van mening dat de administratieve lasten in de langdurige zorg tot het minimale beperkt moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht ‘Zorgconsultant Humanitas kreeg ton voor maand werk’

MPs Kerstens and Otwin asked whether a care consultant hired by Humanitas DMH who declared about 95,000 euro for one month's work, and an assistant declaring over 35,000 euro per month, could be curbed under the Wet normering topinkomens (Wnt), and whether rules on consultant rates should follow. The minister answered that the case will be enforced under the Wnt, that the consultant's excessive remuneration is not justified, and that a separate bill extending the pay cap to all staff is planned, but declined to set rate limits or provide a registry of such contracts now.
In this case, enforcement will take place in accordance with the law.
In deze casus zal conform de wet worden gehandhaafd.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Kerstens over het advies van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens aan het kabinet om mensen met een beperking meer kansen te geven in onderwijs, werk en maatschappelijk l

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Kerstens asked whether the government agrees that the draft laws for ratifying the UN disability convention give too few guarantees for an inclusive society, whether other laws should contain such guarantees, and whether a national action plan should be drawn up. The state secretary agreed to consult stakeholders on a plan of action, said the Participation Act and social support bill will be considered against the convention, and deferred final judgement to parliament.
In that context I intend to soon consult these parties to consider how to give shape to the implementation of the convention.
In dat kader wil ik binnenkort met deze partijen in overleg treden om te bezien hoe vorm kan worden gegeven aan de tenuitvoerlegging van het verdrag.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Otwin vanDijk (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over nulurencontracten in de zorg (ingezonden 27

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Health about zero-hour contracts in care, including variants, whether workers should get contracts reflecting average hours, and how the government will hold care employers to the care accord. The minister answered that he is in talks with social partners on implementing the Social Accord and expects parties to honour the Care Accord, without committing to a specific step.
I assume that the parties will abide by the agreements in the care accord.
Ik ga er van uit dat partijen zich aan de afspraken uit het zorgakkoord houden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hamer en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht dat het UWV een ontslagvergunning heeft verleend aan thuiszorgorganisatie Sensire om 1.100 thuiszorgmedewerkers te ontslaan

PvdA MPs asked the government about UWV granting a dismissal permit to home-care organisation Sensire to lay off 1,100 workers, including whether more care providers would seek preventive dismissals and whether a convenant with the sector was planned. The state secretary replied that talks with municipalities and stakeholders took place, that UWV does not grant preventive dismissal permits while tendering is uncertain, and that a convenant has little added value; instead municipalities will be informed about timely tendering.
In that case the policy line, under current regulations, is that UWV does not grant a dismissal permit because there is no certainty about the structural loss of jobs.
In dat geval is de beleidslijn, op basis van de huidige regelgeving, dat UWV geen ontslagvergunning verleent omdat er geen zekerheid bestaat over het structureel vervallen van arbeidsplaatsen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over de toegenomen exitpremies van zorgbestuurders

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked about rising severance payments to healthcare executives and whether pay rose before the WNT pay-cap law took effect, and whether the government would act faster or retroactively. The minister answered that 2012 pay data will come in the December 2013 report, that the WNT transition period is kept as adopted, and that retroactive changes are undesirable given property rights and legal certainty.
For the public and semi-public sectors it will not be possible to answer this question and similar questions on actual developments in top incomes for the year 2012.
Voor de publieke en semipublieke sectoren zal het niet mogelijk zijn over het jaar 2012 deze vraag en vergelijkbare vragen over feitelijke ontwikkelingen in verband met topinkomens te beantwoorden.
Antwoord vragen Hamer en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht dat het UWV een ontslagvergunning heeft verleend aan thuiszorgorganisatie Sensire om 1.100 thuiszorgmedewerkers te ontslaan

Two PvdA MPs asked why UWV granted Sensire permission to dismiss 1,100 home-care workers despite the care accord and whether the works council and unions were overruled. The minister said UWV applied the dismissal rules on business-economic grounds, that the decision is for UWV and the municipalities, and that the state secretary will contact the parties shortly.
UWV acted in application of the dismissal and policy rules.
UWV heeft gehandeld met toepassing van de ontslag- en beleidsregels.
Antwoord vragen Otwin van Dijk over passende zorg voor mensen met gespecialiseerde begeleiding met minder dan 10 uur zorg per week

MP Otwin van Dijk asked whether people needing specialised support of under 10 hours a week, who will lose their PGB from 1 January 2014, can find appropriate care, after a Per Saldo survey found most could not. The State Secretary called the survey non-representative but took the signal seriously, committed to consulting Per Saldo and care offices on alternatives, and promised to inform the House in early July.

I am consulting, as I indicated during the recent debate on the Reform of Long-Term Care, with Per Saldo, care offices and sector organisations for small providers on how the 10-hour measure can be elaborated and whether there are alternatives within the available budget.

Ik overleg, zoals ik heb aangegeven tijdens het nota-overleg van afgelopen week over de Hervorming van de Langdurige Zorg, momenteel met Per Saldo, zorgkantoren en brancheorganisaties voor kleine aanbieders hoe de 10 uursmaatregel uitgewerkt kan worden en of er alternatieven zijn die passen binnen het beschikbare budgettaire kader.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Heijnen over de vertrekregelingen van enkele bestuurders in de gezondheidszorg

MPs Van Dijk and Heijnen (PvdA) asked about severance arrangements for hospital executives, including a VUmc executive's pay and whether the WNT top-income cap and transitional rules allow loopholes such as special leave, advisory roles and salary top-ups. The minister replied that the reported figures were incorrect, that the supervisory board is the employer and no rules were judged broken, that the EUR 75,000 cap applies with a four-year transitional regime for pre-2013 agreements, and that top-ups depend on circumstances while paid special leave without work is not allowed.
Articles 2.10 and 3.7 of the WNT prohibit employers in the public and semi-public sector from agreeing a severance arrangement with a top official exceeding EUR 75,000.
In artikel 2.10 en 3.7 Wnt wordt het werkgevers in de publieke en semipublieke sector verboden een vertrekregeling met een topfunctionaris overeen te komen die hoger is dan € 75.000.
Antwoord vragen Otwin Van Dijk en Wolbert over het bericht “Megaclaims ziekenhuizen bij overheid”

Two Labour MPs asked the health minister about hospital claims for transition payments worth around 300 million euros against roughly 90 million in reported debts, and about the effect on 2014 premiums, possible fraud and the follow-up to a report on transition-model abuse. The minister said no formal applications had yet been submitted so no overview exists, that insurers' central team is assessing applications and will replace estimates with verifiable figures, and that a first insight is expected by year-end.
I therefore have no overview available and cannot anticipate the outcomes of this process.
Ik heb dus geen overzicht beschikbaar en ik kan niet vooruit lopen op de uitkomsten van dit proces.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Heijnen en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht ‘Ophef over vergoeding zorgdirecteur’

MPs Heijnen and Van Dijk asked whether a former Cordaan director received a 300,000 euro severance payment despite already having a new job, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that the contractual severance (about 3 million, rounded) was legally binding, that the director has agreed to repay just over two months' salary, and that no legal basis exists to reclaim the full amount since the WNT did not apply at the time; the full scheme will not be disclosed.
This arrangement is an arrangement between employer and employee and as such is not public, not even for VWS.
Deze regeling is een regeling tussen werkgever en werknemer en als zodanig niet openbaar, ook niet voor VWS.
Antwoord vragen Otwin Van Dijk over het bericht dat er nog steeds weinig gegevens zijn over dwang en drang in de verstandelijk gehandicaptenzorg

An MP asked the state secretary about the lack of data on coercion in intellectual disability care, late calls for external expertise, staff continuity and knowledge sharing. The secretary acknowledged the problems, pointed to the Zorg en dwang bill, an action programme based on the Denktank complexe zorg, and further research, while stating that few incident reports reach the Inspectorate and that the number of affected institutions is unknown.
The Inspectorate has also received no signals about institutions no longer daring to accept clients.
Ook de Inspectie heeft geen signalen ontvangen over het niet meer aan durven nemen van cliënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch, Albert De Vries Albert en Otwin Van Dijk over mantelzorgwoningen en groepswonen

MPs asked about the savings potential of care annexes (mantelzorgwoningen) and group housing for elderly care, the status of housing experiments, deregulation under the BOR, the risk that temporary housing becomes permanent, and a barrier inventory for care providers. The government answered that savings cannot be quantified, experiments have ended and a new programme is being discussed, deregulation is planned via the BOR, enforcement remains with municipalities, and a municipal guidance note is expected after the summer.
On the subject of care annexes, a guidance note for municipalities is being prepared.
Op het terrein van mantelzorgwoningen is een handreiking voor gemeenten in de maak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht «Achterhoek is spoorproblemen spuugzat»

MPs Hoogland and Otwin van Dijk asked the state secretary about reported rail problems on the Arnhem–Winterswijk line and whether he would talk with the province and municipalities. The state secretary attributed the disruption mainly to new rolling stock and single-track vulnerability rather than train sharing, gave punctuality figures, and said the responsibility for train operations is decentralised and he is willing to discuss infrastructure issues if asked.
The responsibility of the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment in principle concerns only the rail infrastructure.
De verantwoordelijkheid van het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu betreft in principe alleen de spoorweginfrastructuur.
Antwoord vragen Mohandis en Otwin van Dijk over de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs voor studenten met een beperking

MPs Mohandis and Van Dijk asked the education minister about accessibility of higher education for students with disabilities, citing a report that rated it poorly and asking why vocational institutions score lower and what target to set. The minister answered that satisfaction (3.3 of 5) is sufficient and improving, that she will await the longitudinal study due in spring 2013 and will consult partners if warranted, but declined to set a numerical target.
I consider the accessibility of higher education for this group of students very important.
Ik vind de toegankelijkheid van het hoger onderwijs voor deze groep studenten heel belangrijk.

m: Motie van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van Eijk over de instrumenten en de sturingsmogelijkheden in kaart brengen die gemeenten hebben om de kosten te beperken

Asks the government to inventory the instruments and steering options municipalities already have to limit costs in youth care and other policy areas, with best-practice examples, and to inform the House before summer 2025.
requests the government to map what instruments and steering options municipalities already have to limit costs
verzoekt de regering in kaart te brengen wat gemeenten nu al aan instrumenten en sturingsmogelijkheden hebben om de kosten te beperken

Lowers the threshold for the exception to the bank bonus cap for groups with mostly foreign staff from 75% to 50%.
In article I, part D, in article 1:121, fifth paragraph, 75% is replaced by 50%.
In artikel I, onderdeel D, wordt in artikel 1:121, vijfde lid, «75%» vervangen door: 50%.

Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van Hijum ter vervanging van nr. 22 waarmee een evaluatiebepaling in de wet wordt opgenomen, inhoudende dat de minister binnen drie jaar na de inwer
Requires the Minister of Finance to send Parliament an evaluation of the effectiveness and effects of the law within three years of entry into force.
Our Minister of Finance sends to the States General within three years of the law's entry into force a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice.
Onze Minister van Financiën zendt binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.

Amendement van het lid Aukje de Vries dat regelt dat niet langer een opcent op de bankenbelasting van 5% wordt geheven indien een of meer bestuurders een variabele beloning uitgekeerd krijgen van meer
Amendment removes the 5% surcharge on the bank tax when bank executives receive variable pay above 25% of fixed pay.
In Article 10 of the Bank Tax Act the second paragraph is deleted
In artikel 10 van de Wet bankenbelasting vervalt het tweede lid

Requires financial firms with a controlled pay policy to report in their annual report how many staff earn one million euros or more a year and in which business unit they mainly work.

In de beschrijving neemt de onderneming eveneens op hoeveel onder haar verantwoordelijkheid werkzame natuurlijke personen een totale jaarlijkse beloning van 1 miljoen euro of meer ontvangen

Amendement van de leden Aukje de Vries en Koolmees dat regelt dat financiële ondernemingen met een zetel in Nederland en de aan het hoofd van een groep staande groepsmaatschappijen met een zetel in Ne
Amendment exempting Dutch-seated financial groups from ensuring compliance with remuneration rules at foreign-seated subsidiaries.
To have a level playing field and fair competition, Dutch subsidiaries abroad must be able to compete on the same legal basis
Voor het hebben van een gelijk speelveld en eerlijke concurrentie moeten Nederlandse dochters in het buitenland op dezelfde wettelijke basis kunnen concurreren

Amendement van het lid Aukje de Vries dat regelt dat een financiële onderneming met zetel in Nederland een vertrekvergoeding kan uitkeren aan een natuurlijk persoon indien sprake is van voortijdige be
Amends the financial supervision act so that a financial firm may pay a departure allowance when the employee initiates early termination.
provides that a financial undertaking with its seat in the Netherlands may pay a severance payment to a natural person
regelt dat een financiële onderneming met zetel in Nederland een vertrekvergoeding kan uitkeren aan een natuurlijk persoon

Amendement van het lid Aukje de Vries dat regelt dat een deel van de zogenaamde clawback-regeling in artikel 2:135, lid 7, van het Burgerlijk Wetboek vervalt per 1 januari 2015 in plaats van per 1 jan
Moves forward the expiry of part of the clawback rule on bonuses of financial sector executives from 2017 to 1 January 2015.
This amendment provides that part of the so-called clawback rule in article 2:135(7) of the Civil Code lapses on 1 January 2015
Dit amendement regelt dat een deel van de zogenaamde clawback-regeling in artikel 2:135, lid 7, van het Burgerlijk Wetboek vervalt per 1 januari 2015
Amendement van het lid Aukje de Vries dat beoogt  te waarborgen dat kosten voor financieel toezicht niet onevenredig hard stijgen.

Amendment capping the costs of financial supervision by DNB and AFM at inflation-adjusted levels, excluding European supervision costs, with ministers able to deviate in special circumstances and inform parliament.
In special circumstances our ministers may deviate from what this article provides and inform both chambers of the States General in good time.
Onze Ministers kunnen in bijzondere omstandigheden afwijken van hetgeen in dit artikel is bepaald en informeren de beide kamers der Staten-Generaal hier tijdig over.
Motie van het lid Aukje De Vries c.s. over ontzien van kleinere partijen
Asks the government to spare smaller firms more when setting higher fee rates in the ministerial regulation and to inform the House about it.
requests the government to ensure smaller firms are spared more in the ministerial regulation when setting the new, higher rates
verzoekt de regering, ervoor te zorgen dat kleinere partijen bij de uitwerking in de ministeriële regeling meer worden ontzien bij het vaststellen van de nieuwe, hogere tarieven

Amendement van het lid Aukje de Vries dat regelt dat de wijzigingen die met de derde nota van wijziging zijn aangebracht om de reikwijdte van de eed of belofte voor bankmedewerkers uit te breiden naar
Proposes reversing the extension of the banker's oath to all bank employees, restricting it to staff with high risk profiles or client contact.
Legally anchoring that all bank employees are subject to the banker's oath goes much further than the original bill
Het wettelijk verankeren dat alle bankmedewerkers zijn onderworpen aan de bankierseed gaat veel verder dan het oorspronkelijke wetsvoorstel
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Aukje de Vries c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 over de uitzonderingsmogelijkheid in de horizonbepaling voor subsidies.
Allows subsidy schemes to run longer than five years up to ten years in exceptional cases, subject to a voorhang before the Tweede Kamer and an evaluation report.
The exception must be submitted to the Tweede Kamer through a voorhang procedure.
De uitzondering moet via een voorhangprocedure worden voorgelegd aan de Tweede Kamer.
Amendement van het lid Aukje de Vries over het schrappen van de uitzonderingsmogelijkheid in de horizonbepaling voor subsidies.
Removes the exception that allowed subsidy schemes to run longer than five years if the draft was submitted to the House, so all subsidy schemes face the five-year horizon.
The fifth paragraph lapses; in the sixth paragraph the phrase unless the draft subsidy scheme has been submitted to the House with a longer validity period lapses.

In het zesde lid vervalt de zinsnede «, tenzij het ontwerp van een subsidieregeling daartoe met overeenkomstige toepassing van het vijfde lid met een langere geldingsduur aan de Tweede Kamer is overgelegd».
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Aukje de Vries ter vervanging van nr. 9 dat het voorstel schrapt om gebruik te maken van de mogelijkheid om een systeemrisicobuffer te introduceren
Deletes the proposal to let the Netherlands introduce a national systemic risk buffer beyond EU rules, pending a study of regulatory stacking.
This amendment deletes the proposal to use the option of introducing a systemic risk buffer.
Dit amendement schrapt het voorstel om gebruik te maken van de mogelijkheid om een systeemrisicobuffer te introduceren.
Motie van het lid Nijboer c.s. over een systeem waarbij de risico's op staatsobligaties in de kapitaalseisen worden meegewogen
Motion asks the government to push in Europe for bank capital rules that weigh the risk of sovereign bonds instead of giving them zero weight.
requests the government to advocate for this in European context
verzoekt de regering, zich hiervoor sterk te maken in Europees verband
Amendement van het lid Aukje de Vries dat het voorstel schrapt om gebruik te maken van de mogelijkheid om een systeemrisicobuffer te introduceren
Deletes the proposed option to introduce a systemic risk buffer beyond the EU regulation.
This amendment deletes the proposal to use the option of introducing a systemic risk buffer.
Dit amendement schrapt het voorstel om gebruik te maken van de mogelijkheid om een systeemrisicobuffer te introduceren.
Motie van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van Hijum over ingrijpen bij negatieve groei van kredietverlening aan het mkb
Asks the government to intervene and ease the burden on bank lending to SMEs if SME credit growth is negative for several quarters or contracts sharply, in light of the resolution levy.
requests the government to intervene to reduce the burden on lending if SME credit growth is negative for several consecutive quarters
verzoekt de regering, in te grijpen om de kredietverlening minder te belasten als de groei van de kredietverlening aan het mkb enkele opeenvolgende kwartalen negatief is
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Aukje de Vries en Koolmees ter vervanging van nr. 9 over inkadering van de mogelijkheden tot handhaving van de AFM in het kader van de generieke zorgplicht
Limits the AFM's enforcement under the generic duty of care to evident abuses and requires a ministerial evaluation report within three years.
The AFM applies article 1:75 with regard to the first and second paragraph only in cases of evident abuses
De Autoriteit Financiële Markten geeft met betrekking tot het eerste en tweede lid slechts toepassing aan artikel 1:75 bij evidente misstanden
Amendement van de leden De Vries en Koolmees over inkadering van de mogelijkheden tot handhaving van de AFM in het kader van de generieke zorgplicht.
Limits the AFM's use of the generic duty-of-care enforcement power to evident, unforeseen situations where an general administrative order cannot await, so that parliamentary control applies.
No parliamentary control applies to this interpretation.
Op deze invulling is geen parlementaire controle van toepassing.
Motie van het lid Aukje de Vries over een Europese vergelijking met het oog op de concurrentiepositie van Nederlandse instellingen
Asks the government to produce an international comparison of EU countries on the competitive position of Dutch financial institutions before the debate on the cabinet's financial sector vision.
requests the government to make an international comparison between EU countries with a view to the competitive position of Dutch institutions
verzoekt de regering om, een internationale vergelijking te maken tussen EU-landen met het oog op de concurrentiepositie van Nederlandse instellingen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de herbeoordeling van F-35-export Israël

Teunissen (PvdD) asked whether the re-assessment of F-35 parts exports to Israel applied the EU Common Position criteria, why the Israel exclusion under AV009 is maintained, why a six-month re-review was set, and whether F-35 parts transferred via the Netherlands to other partners must also be withheld from Israel. The government answered that the EU criteria were applied, that the detailed assessment is not shared beyond standard reporting because it contains sensitive information, that a re-review within six months was chosen given the evolving situation, and that the Supreme Court order does not cover onward transfers to other F-35 partners.
In addition, the re-assessment contains sensitive information that could be harmful to the Netherlands' bilateral relations.
Daarnaast omvat de herbeoordeling gevoelige informatie die schadelijk kan zijn voor bilaterale relaties van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de Nederlandse klimaatfinanciering aan ontwikkelingslanden

An MP asked whether Dutch climate finance to developing countries includes projects not primarily aimed at climate, how the climate share is set, how much is grants versus loans, and whether Dutch contributions are additional and comparatively low. The Secretary of State confirmed that broad programmes are counted using OECD Rio markers and estimates, reported 2024 totals of EUR 1.07 billion mostly grants, rejected the claim that the Netherlands lags other donors, and pointed to an online climate dashboard instead of a separate overview.
I am happy to refer you to the online climate dashboard.
Ik verwijs u graag naar het online klimaatdashboard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en Teunissen over de exportkredietverzekeringen voor een LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs Hirsch, Van der Lee and Teunissen asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about export credit insurance for the Mozambique LNG project, including resumed dredging by Van Oord, security risks in Cabo Delgado, monitoring of harms and whether the state's obligations are fulfilled. Minister Heinen answered that the state is bound by the issued policies under Dutch insurance law, that the dredging was Total's own decision, that the government sees no breach of environmental and social standards, and that Total has since dropped the Dutch-insured financing so no reassessment remains.

As previously set out in answers to parliamentary questions of 1 and 29 September 2025 and in my letter of 11 November 2025, it is correct that Van Oord, on behalf of Total and anticipating a project restart, carried out preparatory dredging works.

Zoals eerder uiteengezet in de beantwoording van Kamervragen op 1 en 29 september 2025 en in mijn brief van 11 november 2025 klopt het dat Van Oord in opdracht van Total, anticiperend op een herstart van het project, voorbereidende baggerwerkzaamheden heeft uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Bamenga over de situatie in Soedan

Two D66 MPs asked the government about the situation in Sudan, El Fasher, RSF genocide designation, sanctions, arms exports via the UAE, fact-finding, journalist support and humanitarian aid. The government answered that it shares concern, applies a high bar for genocide qualification, pursues sanctions and engagement with the UAE, supports the fact-finding mission and humanitarian aid, and reviews export licences case by case.
The cabinet assesses all export licence applications for military goods case by case and carefully under the EU Common Position on arms export control.
Het kabinet toetst alle vergunningaanvragen voor de uitvoer van militaire goederen per geval en zorgvuldig conform het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt inzake wapenexportcontrole
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Koekkoek over de Israëlische aanval op de Global Sumud Flotilla

MPs Teunissen and Koekkoek asked the government about reported drone attacks on the Global Sumud Flotilla, the treatment of Dutch participants, and whether to condemn Israel, press for EU/UN action, or seek sanctions.
