The Foreign Minister says the government abhors violence against peaceful activists, cannot confirm Dutch citizens were aboard the attacked ships, has asked Israel for a legal justification and is awaiting it, and has pressed for safe passage and humanitarian access without committing to sanctions or a formal condemnation.
The cabinet rejects any form of violence against peaceful activists.
Het kabinet keurt elke vorm van geweld tegen vreedzame actievoerders af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de laatste stand van zaken aangaande de Nederlandse inzet op de humanitaire crisis in Soedan

The MP Teunissen asked the government about steps taken on documentation of humanitarian law violations in Sudan, humanitarian access, peace process support and periodic reporting to parliament. The minister answered that Nederland supports the Fact Finding Mission's mandate, pushes for humanitarian access and EU diplomacy, and commits to inform parliament periodically, including a forthcoming letter on El Fasher.
On major developments regarding the humanitarian situation in Sudan and humanitarian aid and diplomatic efforts, the cabinet will inform the House.
Bij grote ontwikkelingen rondom de humanitaire situatie in Soedan en humanitaire hulp en diplomatieke inspanningen zal het kabinet uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de humanitaire situatie van de Druzen in Syrië

An MP asked the government about reported mass violence against Druze communities in Suwayda, Syria, including sieges, alleged sexual violence and possible ethnic cleansing, and asked what the Netherlands would do about international law, investigations and humanitarian aid. The minister condemned the violence, pointed to the UN Commission of Inquiry and a Syrian national commission, reported 46 aid convoys reaching Suwayda, and said the Netherlands will keep pressing for independent investigation and unhindered access.
The Netherlands continues to press for the publication of the outcomes of this investigation.
Nederland blijft aandringen op het belang van openbaarmaking van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Stultiens over het bedrijf Pluspetrol

MPs Hirsch and Stultiens asked the state secretaries about the OECD NCP final statement on Pluspetrol, including trade support, tax transparency and OECD Guidelines uptake. The government answered that Pluspetrol cannot claim trade-instrument support under fossil-fuel phase-out agreements, that tax secrecy prevents disclosing individual firms' tax data beyond new country-by-country reporting, and that the 2023 target of 90% OECD Guidelines endorsement was missed at 41%.
The cabinet does not see the possibility for the government to make more information public about the tax position of individual taxpayers given the fiscal secrecy obligation.
Het kabinet ziet niet de mogelijkheid om vanuit de overheid meer informatie openbaar te maken over de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen gelet op de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Kröger over het artikel 'Door creatief boekhouden hoeven we voorlopig geen euro extra te betalen voor klimaatschade in arme landen'

MPs Hirsch and Kröger asked the ministers about a Follow the Money article claiming the Netherlands pushed for a low, vague climate finance target at COP29 to avoid paying extra. The government denied this characterization, stated its position was a broad target with a public core, rejected the idea of a burden-sharing key, and said it will consider the questions in its legal analysis of the ICJ advisory opinion.
This is not a correct representation of the Dutch position.
Dit is geen juiste weergave van de Nederlandse inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bezoek van de Indonesische president aan Nederland en mensenrechtenschendingen in West-Papoea

An MP asked whether the Prime Minister would meet the Indonesian president during his visit, whether the Netherlands bears a duty of care toward West Papua, and how Indonesia is pressed on human rights abuses there. The minister denied a meeting with the Prime Minister, described the human rights situation as worrying, and listed bilateral, EU and multilateral channels, while declining to say whether the King would raise the issue because such talks are confidential.
The Royal Couple received the president at Huis ten Bosch Palace; it is customary that conversations the Royal Couple holds at the Palace are confidential.
Het Koninklijk Paar heeft de president ontvangen op Paleis Huis ten Bosch; het is een goed gebruik dat de gesprekken die het Koninklijk Paar op het Paleis voert vertrouwelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Flach over de door China opgelegde importheffingen voor varkensvlees

MPs Stoffer and Flach asked about Chinese provisional anti-dumping duties of 20% to 62.4% on EU pork, their effect on Dutch exporters, the WTO legitimacy of the Chinese claims, and whether the government would seek a delay. The state secretary answers that effects are still unclear but that Dutch exports to China (about 374 million euro in 2024) are at risk, that the Commission is assessing WTO conformity, and that the ministries have submitted written objections and remain in close contact with the sector.
The European Commission is currently further analysing the investigation and the provisional measures for conformity with World Trade Organization (WTO) rules.
De Europese Commissie analyseert het onderzoek en de voorlopige maatregelen momenteel nader op conformiteit met regels van de Wereldhandelsorganisatie (WTO)
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Van der Lee en over exportkredietverstrekking aan LNG-project Cabo Delgado, Mozambique

MPs Hirsch, Van der Lee and Teunissen asked why an export credit insurance policy for Van Oord covers preparatory dredging work at the Cabo Delgado LNG project while the government has said the project is on hold pending a re-assessment and an independent study. The minister replies that the Van Oord exporter policy is legally separate from the frozen financing policy, that it remains in force and cannot be cancelled absent fraud or negligence, and that the independent study is a condition for the re-assessment of the financing policy.
On the investigation or the decision-making process of the British UKEF, I cannot make any statements, as previously indicated.
Over het onderzoek of het besluitvormingsproces van het Britse UKEF kan ik, zoals eerder aangegeven, geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘accountantsbestuur NBA wendt revolte onder leden af’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the NBA's revised accountancy professional profile and its effects on SME access to audits, supply of accountants, and prices. The minister answered that the profile is the NBA's responsibility, expects the change to widen the supply of certified accountants, and commits to continued dialogue with the sector.
The new professional profile gives the accountant the choice whether to be authorised to perform statutory audits.
Het nieuwe beroepsprofiel geeft de keuze aan de accountant of deze certificeringsbevoegd wil zijn voor de uitvoering van de wettelijke controle.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Boskalis ziet geen toekomst meer in Nederland: “We moeten niet verzwakt worden door doorgeschoten milieueisen”

Two VVD MPs asked the government how it views Boskalis considering leaving the Netherlands over strict environmental rules, and about the effects of CSRD, CSDDD, WAMCA, EU procurement and export credit policy on Dutch competitiveness. The government answered that it regrets any departure, is working on a business climate pact, supports raising the CSRD threshold but not abolishing it, is awaiting the WAMCA evaluation, and defends Dutch export credit policy as broadly in line with peers.
I aim to have this Pact ready for signing by mid-June.
Ik streef ernaar dit Pact medio juni gereed te hebben voor ondertekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over een ongekend kritisch rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over het coronaherstelfonds

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the European Court of Auditors' critical publication on the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility, covering performance orientation, accountability, cost opacity, output-focused milestones, weak control and recovery mechanisms, overlap with other funds, and debt repayment pressure. The minister responds at length that the publication summarises earlier reports, defends the milestone-based design and the Commission's stance, acknowledges some points (recovery limits, transparency of assessment), is open to results-based budgeting in future, and makes no concrete new commitment beyond taking lessons into account.
The cabinet attaches importance to the controlling role of the ECA and its oversight of the lawful spending of European funds.
Het kabinet hecht belang aan de controlerende rol van de ERK en haar toezien op de rechtmatige besteding van Europese middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht dat loyale klanten meer betalen voor een verzekering

An MP asked the Minister of Finance about an AFM study finding that loyal customers pay higher premiums at nearly half of insurers without verifiable risk differences, and about possible rule breaches, supervisory powers, the UK and Irish approaches, and affected customers. The minister answered that the AFM is responsible for supervision and enforcement, that it has sufficient powers, that the ministry sees no additional role for now, and that the AFM is in dialogue with insurers and will assess compliance.
The AFM report does not go into this.
Het rapport van de AFM gaat hier niet op in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over nieuwe onnodige regels voor ondernemers

An MP asks the Finance Minister why a draft decree requiring financial firms to register and contract outsourced work conflicts with the coalition goal of fewer rules for businesses, and questions the cost and necessity of the rules and the move away from WOZ-based mortgage valuation. The minister defends the outsourcing rules on AFM findings (11% of firms lacked signed contracts), acknowledges around EUR 421,000 in compliance costs and promises to review feasibility after consultation, and says mortgage valuation changes are not aimed at loan size.
Following the consultation responses, I will examine whether the rules are feasible, and if not, whether alternative options exist.
Naar aanleiding van de consultatiereacties zal ik bezien of de regels uitvoerbaar zijn, en zo niet, of er alternatieve mogelijkheden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Aukje de Vries, Soepboer en Pierik over de gesloten brug bij Uitwellingerga

Four MPs asked the minister why temporary solutions for the closed Uitwellingerga bridge are not feasible, what the impact is on residents and businesses, and whether bridge inspections were adequate. The minister explains that only a temporary fixed bridge deck option is being pursued for August 2025, that the bridge cannot be repaired, that about 1,500 people in surrounding villages are affected, and that inspection procedures are being evaluated.
Rijkswaterstaat regularly evaluates the inspection procedures; the experiences at Uitwellingerga are also being taken into account.
Rijkswaterstaat evalueert de inspectieprocedures regelmatig; ook de ervaringen van Uitwellingerga worden hierin meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Toezichthouders vragen versoepeling Europese bankenregels’

MP Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister how he views calls from European bank supervisors for simplifying EU banking rules, the EU-US banking rule comparison, and related issues. The minister welcomed attention to regulatory burden, deferred concrete steps to sector input, Commission analysis and a forthcoming expert study, and committed to discussing the issue with Dutch supervisors and informing parliament.
I am willing to discuss this with the supervisors and to share my insights from those conversations with your House.
Ik ben bereid om hierover met de toezichthouders in gesprek te gaan en mijn opgedane inzichten naar aanleiding van deze gesprekken met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Euronext wil populaire handel in ETF’s naar Amsterdam halen’

An MP asks the Finance Minister about Euronext's plan to attract ETF trading to Amsterdam, including market competitiveness, index inclusion of closed-end funds and capital-market integration. The minister answers largely that these are matters for Euronext and the market, that the government considers capital-market conditions and will send a letter on the Capital Markets Union later this quarter, and that a national regulatory overview will follow.

This may be a possible effect whose logic I can follow in theory, although I have no insight into the precise competitive position of Euronext Amsterdam relative to exchanges in other European countries.

Dit kan een mogelijk effect zijn waarvan ik de logica in theorie kan volgen, al heb ik geen zicht op de precieze concurrentiepositie van Euronext Amsterdam ten opzichte van beurzen in andere Europese landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘’Nederlandse lobby om fintech te lokken na brexit ging nooit vliegen”, naar aanleiding van een artikel in het FD van 2 februari 2025

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Dutch lobby to attract fintech firms after Brexit failed, how many firms settled because of Brexit, why firms may have avoided the Netherlands, whether DNB's supervision and speed of licensing were too strict, and what became of the regulatory sandbox. The minister answered that 56 of 115 facilitated fintech firms are linked to Brexit, that Dutch licensing is generally faster than the European average, that automatic licences were not considered, and that the InnovationHub is being reformed and supervisors will be engaged on the issue.
It is difficult to give a good estimate of the number of fintech companies that settled in the Netherlands after Brexit.
Het is moeilijk om een goede inschatting te geven van het aantal fintech-bedrijven dat zich na de brexit in Nederland heeft gevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en Aukje de Vries over het bericht «Minister scheldt FINEB-schulden Bonaire kwijt»

MPs Martens-America and Aukje de Vries asked why the minister forgave outstanding FINEB student debts owed by Bonaire students, why this was not in the recent letter on student finance, and about the loan terms and total amounts. The minister answered fully: he forgave 373 remaining debts totaling $4.378 million from 1 January 2025, citing outdated loan terms, and acknowledged the forgiveness was decided separately from the pending review of the WSF BES and WSF 2000 student finance schemes.
I have decided to forgive the still outstanding FINEB student debts as of 1 January 2025, because the way FINEB student loans were provided is outdated and no longer fits the current era.

Ik heb het besluit genomen om de nog openstaande FINEB-studieschulden per 1 januari 2025 kwijt te schelden, omdat de wijze waarop FINEB-studieleningen zijn verstrekt verouderd is en niet meer bij deze tijd past.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de publicatie 'Rapport onderzoek Jaarrekening Land Aruba 2019'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations about the Aruban Audit Office report on the 2019 Aruba annual accounts, which found delays and weak financial management, and about the status of the Aruba financial supervision law. The State Secretary largely disagreed that Aruba gives no priority to the accounts, pointed to an ongoing catch-up effort under the Landspakket, and said the law is still being negotiated with a IMF advice awaited.
I therefore expect Aruba to proceed quickly to adopt the annual accounts and the 2025 budget.
Ik verwacht daarom van Aruba dat het land snel tot vaststelling van de jaarrekeningen en begroting 2025 zal overgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kisteman, Van Eijk en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Achteraf betalen kan binnenkort ook in fysieke winkels dankzij nieuwe samenwerking'

Three VVD MPs asked the government about news that buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) would extend to physical shops, and about its effects on young people and indebted consumers. The minister answered that BNPL-in-shops offers minimal social added value with large risks, pointed to the coming CCDII directive, age verification and a sector code, and said a temporary ban is not feasible.
The government therefore finds the announcement to extend BNPL services to physical shops very undesirable.
De aankondiging om BNPL-diensten uit te breiden naar fysieke winkels vindt het kabinet dan ook zeer onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de berichten 'OM: Curaçaos Statenlid verdacht van drugshandel' en 'Achterstand innen belastingen op Curaçao loopt snel op'

MP Aukje de Vries asked about reports that a Curaçao Statenlid is suspected of drug trafficking and about rising unpaid tax arrears on Curaçao, and how this fits with the Landspakket good-governance and finance commitments. The State Secretary answered that corruption is unacceptable, that integrity monitoring and a good-governance agenda will follow in spring 2025, and that tax arrears fluctuate during reform while the Belastingdienst reform is on schedule.
Preventing integrity issues concerning individual politicians falls outside the scope of the Landspakket.
Het voorkomen van integriteitskwesties ten aanzien van individuele politici valt buiten de grenzen van het landspakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Michon–Derkzen over het bericht 'Drugscriminelen in hele land actief met hypotheekfraude'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Michon-Derkzen asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports that drug criminals are committing mortgage fraud nationwide, housing Bulgarian migrant workers. The government confirms police reports of roughly 8,000 affected homes, describes enforcement, information-sharing and planned reviews (including Belastingdienst income checks and Kamer van Koophandel measures), but declines to give municipalities a direct role in informing mortgage lenders.

The Minister of Justice and Security will, together with the State Secretary for Fiscal Affairs and the Tax Authority, further explore the effectiveness, efficiency and feasibility of this and then inform the House of the conclusion.

De Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zal samen met de Staatssecretaris van Fiscaliteit & Belastingdienst de doeltreffendheid, doelmatigheid en uitvoerbaarheid hiervan nader verkennen en vervolgens uw Kamer informeren over de conclusie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Aukje de vries en Erkens over de financiering van kernenergieprojecten

MPs Aukje de Vries and Erkens asked about international banks' pledge to support nuclear energy, how the government will engage banks and COP29 for financing new Dutch nuclear plants, and how to keep gas extraction in the North Sea financed. Minister Hermans answered that a market consultation is ongoing with results to follow, that the government will engage the financial sector including via the climate commitment, and that the sector must make its own financing decisions while a sector agreement on North Sea investment is being prepared.
Within a few weeks the cabinet will inform the House about the results of the market consultation, a cabinet appraisal of them and the follow-up process.
Binnen een aantal weken zal het kabinet de Kamer informeren over de resultaten van de marktconsultatie, een kabinetsappreciatie daarvan en het vervolgproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Peter de Groot en Van Eijk (allen VVD) over het artikel 'Enorme ozb-verhoging Amsterdam ’Middenklasse maximaal uitgekleed”

VVD MPs asked the government about a steep property tax (OZB) increase proposed by Amsterdam, its effect on household costs, parking charges and erfpacht, and whether the government would engage Amsterdam to cap OZB rises. The minister declined to comment on Amsterdam's local tax decision as a matter for the municipal council, provided cost data, and committed to talks with municipalities on capping OZB increases.
It is up to the municipal councils to make choices here, weighing among other things the tax burden, service levels and other matters.
Het is aan de gemeenteraden hierin keuzes te maken, waarbij onder meer belastingdruk, voorzieningenniveau en andere zaken tegen elkaar worden afgewogen.
Antwoord op vragen  van de leden Peter de Groot en Aukje de Vries over het bericht «Brug Uitwellingerga niet meer bediend voor de scheepvaart»

MPs Peter de Groot and Aukje de Vries asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the Uitwellingerga bridge no longer being operated for shipping, its maintenance history, expected duration, economic effects and compensation. The minister answered all eleven questions on substance, stating the closure duration is not yet known, that the bridge deteriorated faster than expected, and that a general hardship compensation scheme applies while no separate scheme was opened.
Before the start of the sailing season (April 2025), Rijkswaterstaat will provide more clarity.
Voor de start van het vaarseizoen (april 2025) zal Rijkswaterstaat meer duidelijkheid te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de haven van Saba

MP Aukje de Vries asks why the Tweede Kamer was not informed by 15 June 2024 as the Michon-Derkzen motion requested, what financing options for the Saba port were explored, and why the project has been delayed since 2018. The state secretary answers that Parliament was informed in time via a letter, that 30 million euro in 2025 and 10 million in 2026 will be provided through a special grant after a loan was considered, and that the delays stem from limited capacity and extended permit procedures.
Your House was informed in time before 15 June by means of a collective letter.
Uw Kamer is tijdig voor 15 juni geïnformeerd middels een verzamelbrief
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de kosten van betaalrekeningen en rente op spaarrekeningen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about rising bank account fees and low savings interest rates, and whether banks are justified in raising prices. The minister replied that fees are set by banks through market competition, that deposit rates lag policy rates, and that he will address switching barriers and transparency in the savings market with banks and in the MOB.
I am committed to lowering switching barriers for consumers and making the savings market more transparent and accessible.
Ik zet mij in om de overstapdrempels voor consumenten te verlagen en de spaarmarkt transparanter en toegankelijker te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Topman Franse centrale bank slaat alarm: 'Zeer negatieve schok''

An MP asked the Finance Minister how Dutch government should respond to the French central bank chief's warning of a very negative shock from high French deficits and debt, and how the EU fiscal rules will enforce consolidation. The minister shared concern, pointed to the revised EU fiscal rules and enforcement mechanisms, and outlined the Dutch budget path while noting the two countries' finances are not directly comparable.
The cabinet will work for a sound implementation of the revised European budget rules.
Het kabinet zal zich inzetten voor een gedegen implementatie van de herziene Europese begrotingsregels.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Weigermigranten buiten corona uit: 'Dit blijft een grote frustratie'' en 'GGD’s mogen binnenkort vaccinatiebewijzen afgeven aan mensen zonder BS

MPs Valstar and Aukje de Vries asked about asylum seekers refusing COVID tests, vaccination coverage in reception centres, and GGD-issued vaccination certificates for undocumented people. The government answered that all arrivals are tested but refusal has no sanction, that roughly half of centre residents are recorded as vaccinated, and that deportations were cancelled for test refusals, with the government exploring legal options for compulsory testing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de beschikbaarheid van locaties testen voor toegang op de Waddeneilanden en dunbevolkte gebieden

An MP asked the Health Minister whether COVID test-for-access locations on the Wadden islands and sparsely populated areas remain reliably available, and what the government will do about closures and the cost model. The minister acknowledged the problem, said 99.9% of the Netherlands can reach a test site within 30 minutes, and pointed to a structural solution for the Wadden islands via Stichting Open Nederland without giving specifics.
At this moment, again 99.9% of the Netherlands can get tested at Testen voor Toegang within 30 minutes, including all people on the Wadden islands.
Op dit moment kan opnieuw 99,9% van Nederland zich binnen 30 minuten bij Testen voor Toegang laten testen, waaronder alle mensen op de Waddeneilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Veerdienst Saba/Statia gestrand door blunderende ministeries'

An MP asked the State Secretary and ministers why the Saba/Sint Eustatius ferry service failed to start on 1 November 2021, whether customs and Marechaussee were unprepared, and about affordability and remaining obstacles. The government answered that the start slipped to 14 November due to tender extensions and missing safety certificates, that the ferry started on 1 December 2021, and that ministries coordinated with the island authorities.
Due to the extension of the tender period at the request of the participating parties, the target start date had to be adjusted to 14 November 2021.
Door verlenging van de aanbestedingstermijn op verzoek van de deelnemende partijen moest de streefdatum van de start echter worden bijgesteld naar 14 november 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘De Jonge: Nederlander op tijd geboosterd voor reisbewijs’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Health about whether all Dutch citizens would receive boosters in time to keep their EU travel certificates valid, covering slot availability, staffing, travel rules and the scope of the COVID pass. The minister's answer is a referral: the questions were answered in a separate letter, the 'Stand van zaken covid-19' (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 1638), so no substance is given in this document.

The written questions from MP Aukje de Vries to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the report 'De Jonge: Dutch citizens boosted in time for travel pass' (2021Z22995) have been answered by letter 'Stand van zaken covid-19' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 1638).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «De Jonge: Nederlander op tijd geboosterd voor reisbewijs» ( 2021Z22995 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «Stand van zaken covid-19» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 1638 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Nederland gedraaid over geldigheid coronapas EU’

An MP asked the Health Minister whether the Netherlands had reversed its position on the EU COVID certificate validity period (proposed at nine months) and why the Chamber had not been consulted before the EU Health Council. The minister confirmed the cabinet supports the nine-month proposal for EU coordination, explained the position was set out in an appreciation sent to the Chamber on 3 December, and said the Chamber could discuss it with the cabinet if it wished.

The cabinet considers the proposed nine months (six months for the booster interval plus three months for member states to organise implementation) sufficiently substantiated and an safe and effective way to promote EU coordination of rules and keep travel in Europe possible, and therefore supports this proposal.

Het kabinet denkt dat de voorgestelde 9 maanden (zes maanden t.b.v. de interval plus drie maanden voor lidstaten om de uitvoering te organiseren) voldoende onderbouwd is en een veilige en doeltreffende manier is om EU-coördinatie van regels te bevorderen en reizen in Europa mogelijk te maken en houden, en steunt daarom dit voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Testafspraak maken (bijna) onmogelijk bij GGD: 'De rek is eruit''

MP Aukje de Vries asked the health minister about reports that booking COVID tests at the GGD had become nearly impossible, and what capacity, personnel and advice measures exist. The minister answered that capacity was scaled up sharply, explained booking bottlenecks, and described plans and the new testing advice, though further capacity depends on recruiting staff.
When I have received the new roadmap, I will share it with your House.
Wanneer ik de nieuwe roadmap heb ontvangen, zal ik deze met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kuiken en Aukje de Vries over de uitvoering van de boostervaccinatiecampagne

MPs Paternotte, Kuiken and Aukje de Vries asked the health minister about booster vaccination rollout: uptake numbers, speeding up the campaign, whether relatives can book appointments for elderly people, consent procedures for residents in care homes, eligibility of partners, and vaccinating the wider population. The minister answered that booster figures were provided, that relatives may book only with the person's own consent by phone, that consent practices are workable in care homes, and that the campaign follows age-based priorities per Health Council advice, with a December offensive being prepared.
I will receive the plan for this offensive at the end of this week.
Het plan voor dit offensief ontvang ik aan het eind van deze week.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Grenzen van baggeren in Waddenzee nabij’

MPs De Vries and Heerema asked the minister about the limits of dredging in the Wadden Sea, the risk that the Natura 2000 dredging volume is exceeded around 2023, and the accessibility of Wadden islands and ports. The minister answered that the Natura 2000 plan caps dredging, monitoring anticipates possible exceedance, and alternative access solutions and a Ameland decision around 2023 are being studied, with a Boontjes evaluation pending.
It is established that the task regarding accessibility is to make mobility sustainable and to continue guaranteeing accessibility in the long term.
Vastgelegd is dat de opgave met betrekking tot bereikbaarheid is om de mobiliteit te verduurzamen en de bereikbaarheid ook op de lange termijn te blijven garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Aukje de Vries, Van den Berg, Kuiken en Bikker over de afschaling van reguliere zorg en de extra wachttijdproblematiek

MPs asked the Minister of Health about the renewed scaling-down of regular hospital care, uneven burden across hospitals, underuse of independent clinics, digital care, cross-border treatment, and publication of waiting-time data. The minister answered that national allocation agreements apply, that NZa and IGJ monitor compliance, that planned care in all hospitals has been halted under phase 2d, and that waiting-time information is being updated more often, while declining to commit to specific structural changes beyond existing frameworks.
The Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) and the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) monitor that the agreements are being complied with.
De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) en de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) zien er op toe dat de afspraken worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Besmet, maar de QR-code blijft geldig'

An MP asks the Health Minister whether it is acceptable that people who test positive for COVID-19 can still use their QR-code (coronatoegangsbewijs) for access, and why these codes cannot be temporarily blocked as is done for fraudulent codes. The minister answers that personal responsibility and isolation rules apply, that technically revoking codes would conflict with strict privacy design, that advice on the matter will follow after a motion, and that the advisory committee is being consulted.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Hulp aan duikslachtoffers in gevaar: behandelcentrum in Goes heeft geld nodig’

MPs Van den Hil and Aukje de Vries asked about a diving-victim treatment centre in Goes facing financial pressure and its role in navy and offshore work. The minister replied that the centre has no financial problems per the NZa, that a 24/7 funding question remains open between the centre and insurers, and that insurers bear the duty of care.
It is therefore not for me to form an opinion on the future of care for diving casualties or the position of the treatment centre in Goes.
Het is dus niet aan mij om een mening te vormen over de toekomst van de zorg voor duikslachtoffers of de positie van het behandelcentrum in Goes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Aukje de Vries over de beschikbaarheid van testcapaciteit buiten de randstad

MPs Paternotte and Aukje de Vries asked the health minister why COVID test locations outside the Randstad had closed and whether accessibility within 30 minutes' travel was guaranteed, as coronavirus access passes expanded. Minister De Jonge answered that coverage had reached 99.9%, that the new per-test payment system had tripled locations, that the government would monitor and prepare for new gaps, and that pharmacies could join the scheme.
Stichting Open Nederland, however, can no longer require that a test provider establish itself at a particular location.
Stichting Open Nederland kan echter niet meer eisen dat een testaanbieder zich op een bepaalde plek vestigt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de vaccinatie van Nederlanders in het buitenland

An MP asked the health minister whether Dutch nationals abroad are being left out of COVID-19 vaccination programmes, how France runs its own vaccination campaigns for citizens abroad, and what the government is doing to simplify access. The minister replied that Dutch expatriates generally participate in local programmes, outlined diplomatic and COVAX efforts, described simplified options for vaccination in the Netherlands, and explained how vaccination certificates for those vaccinated abroad will be handled.
The cabinet currently has no indications that Dutch nationals are systematically disadvantaged compared with the local population in other countries' vaccination programmes.
Het kabinet heeft op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat Nederlanders stelselmatig worden achtergesteld ten opzichte van de lokale bevolking in de vaccinatieprogramma's van andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Aukje de Vries en Kuiken over internationale ontwikkelingen rond boostervaccinaties en vaccinatie van kwetsbaren

MPs Paternotte, Aukje de Vries and Kuiken asked the Minister of Health about EU and German decisions on booster vaccinations, Janssen and AstraZeneca booster eligibility, booster age groups, children aged 5-11 and off-label use for vulnerable children, and school absence due to COVID risk. The Minister answered that the Gezondheidsraad was asked for additional advice by 2 November on boosters and on Pfizer for children, and that the Dutch child-vaccination and school-absence questions are being monitored or left to advisory and EMA processes.
I asked the Health Council on 15 October to provide additional advice on using mRNA vaccines as a booster
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad op 15 oktober jl. is gevraagd een aanvullend advies te geven over het inzetten van mRNA-vaccins als booster
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Fraudeurs houden toch groen vinkje’

MP Aukje de Vries asked whether fraudulent vaccination-based COVID certificates (groene vinkje) in the CoronaCheck app could be revoked and whether the app should be changed to remove the green tick for vaccinated people who become infected. Minister De Jonge answered that privacy-by-design choices mean issued Dutch QR codes cannot be revoked remotely, that GGD will void proven fraudulent certificates from its own records, and that no change to remove the green tick for infected persons is planned.
The coronavirus access certificate contains too little information to actually be able to do this.
Het coronatoegangsbewijs bevat namelijk te weinig informatie om dit daadwerkelijk te kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Aukje de Vries, Kuiken en Van den Berg over doelgroepen die aanzienlijke moeite hebben met het verkrijgen van een coronatoegangsbewijs

MPs from D66, VVD, PvdA and CDA asked the health minister which groups struggle to obtain a COVID certificate, including people vaccinated abroad, people without a BSN, and those medically unable to test, and about waiting times and access at GGD Utrecht. The minister answered that the Utrecht service is limited to non-EU vaccinees resident in the Netherlands or Dutch nationals, that solutions for other groups are being explored, and that additional locations (such as Groningen) are being prepared.
It is currently being explored whether people from this group who can make it plausible that they live in the Netherlands and do not yet have a BSN can also be helped.
Er wordt momenteel verkend of mensen uit deze groep die aannemelijk kunnen maken dat zij woonachtig zijn in Nederland en nog geen BSN hebben, ook geholpen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Aukje de Vries en Grinwis over het bericht op NOS.nl getiteld ‘Spoorbrug over Van Harinxmakanaal bij Leeuwarden nog wekenlang defect’

MPs Heerema, De Vries and Grinwis asked the minister about a defect that left the Leeuwarden railway bridge over the Van Harinxmakanaal unable to open for shipping for weeks, its causes, repair timeline, communication, inspection frequency, and whether a replacement study is needed. The minister and state secretary answered that the bridge was repaired and reopened in early October, that ProRail sees no need for early replacement or a quickscan, and that inspections and repair costs were addressed.
ProRail did its utmost to restore the functioning of the railway bridge as quickly as possible and was in constant contact with the ministry, the province and the municipality.
ProRail heeft haar uiterste best gedaan de werking van de spoorbrug zo spoedig mogelijk te herstellen en heeft daarbij voortdurend in contact gestaan met het ministerie, de provincie en de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van den Hil over het bericht 'Druk op de geboortezorg: met moeite bemannen we de bedden'

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about strain on maternity care, the regional capacity shortages, causes such as staff shortages and a birth peak, and what the government will do. The minister answered that shortages exist in several regions, pointed to regional cooperation and a NICU bed-tracking initiative, referred to a planned intensification of measures and the labour-market programme, and agreed to answer before the labour-market debate.
An up-to-date overall overview does not exist.
Een actueel totaaloverzicht is er niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Spoedeisende hulp ook in Friesland vaker even op slot vanwege tekort aan personeel

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports that emergency departments in Friesland, Groningen and Drenthe increasingly close temporarily ('time-outs') due to staff shortages, asking about hours, patient effects, rules, and solutions. The minister answered that time-outs do not mean closure, that life-threatening cases are always accepted, that the NZa sees no harm to patients, and that regional measures and workforce initiatives are underway.
The NZa has informed me that it is not aware of any signals of adverse consequences or negative health effects for patients as a result of time-outs.
De NZa heeft mij laten weten geen signalen te kennen over nadelige gevolgen of negatieve gezondheidseffecten voor patiënten als gevolg van time-outs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Erkens over het artikel 'Nederland blijft achter met gasboringen op zee, bedrijven willen aan de slag'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister why exploration drilling for gas in the Dutch North Sea is lagging, whether domestic gas is preferable to imports, and how the tax investment deduction and supply security affect the outlook. The minister replied that two exploration wells were drilled in 2020, that the shortfall is too early to call structural, that domestic gas is preferable to imports while it is still needed, and that a round table and EU risk assessments will follow.

I am closely monitoring the current developments and am therefore organising a round table discussion with experts from the gas sector in the short term to discuss the developments and their possible consequences.

Ik houd de huidige ontwikkelingen scherp in de gaten en organiseer dan ook op korte termijn een ronde tafel overleg met deskundigen uit de gassector om de ontwikkelingen en de mogelijke gevolgen daarvan te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte en Aukje de Vries over de CoronaCheck voor toeristen en andere buitenlanders of Nederlanders die in het buitenland hun vaccinatie hebben gehaald

MPs Paternotte and Aukje de Vries asked how non-EU vaccinated travellers and Dutch citizens vaccinated abroad can obtain a Dutch CoronaCheck, given that in-person identification in Utrecht is required. The minister answered that GGD Utrecht issues digital certificates after in-person identification, that other locations and an online solution are being explored, and that Dutch residents without a certificate are being looked into.
I am in discussion with GGD GHOR Nederland to see whether this service can also be offered at a number of other GGD locations.
Ik ben met GGD GHOR Nederland in gesprek om te kijken of het mogelijk is om deze service ook op een aantal andere GGD-locaties te kunnen bieden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Van der Woude en Aukje de Vries over het artikel 'Noodkreet: tandarts gezocht voor Rotterdam, laat meer studenten toe' en de beantwoording van de Minister voor Medische Zorg o

MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a newspaper report on a shortage of dentists in the Rotterdam and Zeeland region and whether more dentistry training places would be created. The government answered that funding for 100 extra places (EUR 26.3 million structurally) is not in the budget, so the decision is left to a new cabinet.
Expanding by 100 training places requires a structural amount of EUR 26.3 million. No funding for this amount has been found in the OCW budget.
Voor een uitbreiding met 100 opleidingsplaatsen is een structureel bedrag noodzakelijk van € 26,3 mln. Op de begroting van OCW is geen dekking voor dit bedrag gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van den Berg over de uitvoering van de motie jaarverantwoordingsplicht (Kamerstuk 35 830 XVI, nr. 14)

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van den Berg asked the minister how the motion on annual public accountability for primary care providers is being implemented, including whether the government will reconsider the regulation, share the SIRA cost calculation and ATR opinions, and justify the CBS questionnaire. The state secretary answers that the compromise regulation stays, that alternatives proposed by the Eerstelijnscoalitie do not fit the law's purpose, that the regulatory burden for small providers fell 91% to under two hours a year, and that the ATR advice was addressed by shortening the questionnaire and adding a digital decision tree.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Aukje de Vries over het incident Testcoronanu BV en de ernstige tekortkoming in de informatiebeveiliging

MPs Rajkowski and Aukje de Vries asked the ministers about the Testcoronanu BV data breach, affected travellers, the audit of the provider's security and the vetting of test providers before connection to CoronaCheck. Minister De Jonge answered that 17,638 people had appointments, that the provider is investigating whether others accessed the database, and that the ministry checks pentest reports before connection, but declined to share the providers' DPIAs and pentest reports.
However, I cannot commit to also sharing with your House the DPIAs and pentest reports submitted by the test provider.
Ik kan echter niet toezeggen dat ook de door de testaanbieder aangeleverde DPIA’s en pentestrapportages met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Dit ging mis met NL-Alerts bij de brand in Noordbergum: opnieuw was de computer met een update bezig’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Aukje de Vries asked about a NL-Alert failure during a fire in Noardburgum, including whether a system update caused false alerts and how the alert system is protected against outages. The minister denied an update caused it, attributed it to a fault in a control link, explained fallback arrangements and a planned system renewal around 2022, and deferred the future of siren alarms to the next cabinet.
In addition, the control facilities at the control rooms will be checked more thoroughly.
Daarnaast zullen de aansturingsvoorzieningen op de meldkamers extra gecontroleerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Winair bungelt aan randje faillissement'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Rudmer Heerema asked the ministers about the risks of a Winair bankruptcy for connectivity to Saba and Sint Eustatius, the financial exposure of the Netherlands, support requests, and the governance of the state shareholding. The minister answered that Winair is the only scheduled carrier to those islands, that the Netherlands has only a hypothecary loan secured on the hangar, that a steunverzoek is under review with the primary responsibility resting with Sint Maarten, and that the shareholding is being evaluated with a letter promised later this year.
As soon as more is known about this, I will inform your House.
Zodra daarover meer bekend is, zal ik uw Kamer informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Onderwijsinspectie op bezoek bij Tjalling Koopmans College vanwege hevige onrust, SVPO blijft knokken tegen publicatie rapporten’

MPs Paul and Aukje de Vries asked the minister about inspection findings of very weak quality at SVPO schools, the inspectorate's handling of them, and SVPO's court action to delay publication of the reports. The minister confirmed the very weak ratings, described the recovery orders, financial-oversight measures and a specific financial investigation, explained that publication is suspended pending a court ruling, and promised to inform parliament on the inspection's findings.
Article 21 of the Education Supervision Act provides that the inspectorate publishes reports in the fifth week after they are established.
Uit artikel 21 van de Wet op het onderwijstoezicht volgt dat de inspectie rapporten in de vijfde week na vaststelling openbaar maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Paternotte en Van der Werf over het incident bij de corona-vaccinatielocatie Amsterdam

Four MPs asked the health and justice ministers about reported harassment of people queuing for COVID vaccination at a vaccination site in Amsterdam during a demonstration march, asking about police response, arrests, GGD instructions, reporting, and safety guarantees. The minister answered that police found no confirmed intimidation, no complaints or reports were registered, police urged victims to file complaints, and vaccination site safety is a decentralised responsibility under existing protocols and support networks.
The police are aware of a social media report that people were harassed. The police were visibly present but could not confirm this.
De politie is op de hoogte van een bericht op social media dat mensen zijn lastiggevallen. De politie was zichtbaar aanwezig, maar heeft dit niet kunnen constateren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over berichtgeving in de media over het ingediende winningsplan Tietjerk voor gaswinning

An MP asks the minister about media reports that the state mines supervisor SodM advised negatively on a large gas extraction plan near Burgum, and whether that advice will be published and when a decision will be taken. The minister confirms the negative advice, refuses to publish it early because the law fixes publication alongside the draft decision, and says the decision will follow advice from other bodies and a public inspection period after the summer.
No, I am not willing to make the advice public prematurely.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid om het advies voortijdig openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het Uitvoeringsprogramma Waddengebied en de impactanalyse

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked the ministers about the Wadden Sea implementation programme, the impact analysis, and several related projects and stakeholder involvement. The minister answered that economic sectors are secured in the agenda, the impact analysis will be broader than socio-economic effects, and the programme and impact analysis will be discussed with Parliament before the summer and in the October debate.
On the outcome of that discussion I will inform your House by letter.
Over de uitkomst van de bespreking hiervan zal ik uw Kamer per brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Aartsen over de steunmaatregelen voor de bruine vloot

MPs Aukje de Vries and Aartsen (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about support measures for the historic sailing vessel ('bruine vloot') sector, including what was meant by statements at a March 2021 symposium, the delayed opening of the scheme, sector losses, EU state aid talks, consultations and reopening conditions. The State Secretary answered that the scheme would open around end of June 2021 after EU state aid talks led to using the de minimis regulation, that the sector lost about 77% of turnover in 2020, and that reopening steps are set out in the phased plan.
I understand the impatience of entrepreneurs and am glad that in my letter of 27 May 2021 I could indicate that the scheme is expected to open at the end of June.
Ik snap het ongeduld van ondernemers en ben blij dat ik in mijn brief van 27 mei 2021 hebben kunnen aangeven dat de regeling naar verwachting eind juni open kan worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Aukje de Vries over de berichten 'Overvol stroomnet doet pijn in Leeuwarden' en 'Problemen op elektrisiteitsnet: gjin stroom foar nije skoallen yn Ljouwert'

MPs Erkens and Aukje de Vries asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid capacity shortages in Leeuwarden that block housing, schools and businesses. The minister confirmed the shortages, explained the timelines for a new substation (2026-2027), and pointed to measures and the Energy Act, without committing to a fast fix.
Expanding the infrastructure takes time, partly due to the scarcity of technical personnel and lengthy planning procedures.
Het uitbreiden van de infrastructuur kost tijd, mede door de schaarste van technisch personeel en door lange planologische procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Aukje de Vries over het bericht dat Denemarken stopt met het Janssen-vaccin in hun vaccinatieprogramma

MPs Paternotte and Aukje de Vries asked the health minister how he views Denmark dropping the Janssen vaccine from its programme, what Denmark plans for surplus Janssen and AstraZeneca doses, and what EU rules govern redistributing or exporting surplus vaccines. The minister said the Netherlands will await the new data and EMA advice, that Denmark is still deciding, that EU rules on surplus are still under discussion, and that he would buy surplus doses if offered.
I think it is important to first carefully find out on the basis of what new data Denmark reached this decision.
Ik vind het belangrijk om eerst goed uit te zoeken op basis van welke nieuwe gegevens Denemarken tot dit besluit komt.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kuiken, Paternotte, Aukje de Vries, Bikker en Westerveld over AstraZeneca en een nieuw advies van de Gezondheidsraad

Five MPs asked the Health Minister about EMA and other countries' age-limit decisions for AstraZeneca, vaccination gaps among vulnerable groups, and a RIVM official's remarks about surplus doses. The minister answered that the Health Council was asked urgently to reconsider, that outreach to vulnerable groups is ongoing, and that the remarks were unfortunately worded, but did not answer the final question on submitting answers by 29 April.
I asked the Health Council on 26 April to urgently advise whether the new EMA information leads to a reconsideration of the use of the AstraZeneca vaccine.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad op 26 april jl., gevraagd met spoed te adviseren of de nieuwe informatie van het EMA tot een heroverweging van de inzet van het AstraZeneca-vaccin leidt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de bereikbaarheid van GGD-GHOR voor afspraken van vaccinaties

MP Aukje de Vries asks the minister why the GGD-GHOR appointment phone line and website were hard to reach on 15 April 2021, how this squares with the GGD's own social media posts, and for call-centre performance figures for March and April. Minister De Jonge attributes the 15 April problems to overload of the 088 line used for obesity and Down syndrome groups, says the line will become a 0800 number, and reports call-abandonment, waiting time and answer-speed figures showing improvement.
It has now been decided that the 088 number will be converted to a 0800 number, so that problems can be absorbed in such exceptional circumstances as well.
Inmiddels is besloten dat het 088-nummer zal worden omgezet naar een 0800-nummer, zodat ook bij dit soort bijzondere omstandigheden problemen opgevangen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Aukje de Vries over het verplicht moeten tonen van een negatief testbewijs bij de grens tussen Nederland en Duitsland

Two VVD MPs asked the Dutch government about the German requirement to show a negative test when crossing the border, including for cross-border workers and pupils, and whether the government would raise the problem with Germany. The State Secretary answered that a Dutch test facility is being set up, that Germany has relaxed some rules for cross-border commuters, and that the government has been in ongoing contact with German authorities.
The cabinet shares this view and therefore wants to create a testing facility for these specific groups.
Het kabinet deelt deze mening, en wil voor deze specifieke groepen daarom een testvoorziening creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Aartsen over de steunmaatregelen voor de bruine vloot

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why a EUR 15 million support scheme for the historic 'bruine vloot' sailing charter fleet had not yet been opened, and when entrepreneurs would receive funds. The State Secretary answered that a supplementary scheme is still being developed, requires EU state-aid approval, and is expected to open by end of Q2 2021, while existing COVID support measures are also available to these entrepreneurs.
I am in discussion with the European Commission on whether this scheme fits within the state-aid frameworks for culture and preservation of heritage.
Ik ben met de Europese Commissie in gesprek of deze regeling past binnen de steunkaders voor cultuur en instandhouding van het erfgoed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Aartsen over de steunmaatregelen voor de bruine vloot

MPs Aukje de Vries and Aartsen asked the State Secretary about delays in the support scheme for the historic 'bruine vloot' sailing ships, mooring fees, and whether existing aid is sufficient. The State Secretary answered that a targeted scheme is being developed subject to European Commission approval, that existing TVL/TOGS aid already reaches many operators, and that some questions are deferred or fall to municipalities.

After a positive opinion from the Commission, the scheme can be further elaborated and published, and the House will be informed, after which the scheme, as announced in my letter of 17 February, can open at the end of the second quarter.

Na een positief advies van de commissie kan de regeling nader worden uitgewerkt, gepubliceerd en zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd, waarna de regeling, zoals aangekondigd in mijn brief van 17 februari jl., eind tweede kwartaal kan worden opengesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Groningers in bevingsgebied moeten nog langer wachten op smartengeld'

An MP asked why the Groningen compensation scheme for immaterial (emotional) damage from earthquakes is delayed, what the new timetable is, and how the Chamber was informed. The minister explains the scheme is new and complex, the IMG plans a phased start at end of Q2 2021 with 100 households, and the Chamber was informed proactively via the IMG website and regular updates.
I will also proactively inform your Chamber about developments regarding the procedure for compensation of immaterial damage.
Ik zal uw Kamer ook proactief informeren over de ontwikkelingen omtrent de werkwijze voor de vergoeding van immateriële schade.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries, Von Martels, De Groot en Dik Faber over het signaal dat de NVWA niet overgaat tot het aanwijzen van verschillende havens als ‘dedicated landing port third countrie

MPs asked why the NVWA has not designated additional Dutch ports, such as Den Helder, as dedicated landing ports for third-country fishing vessels, which hurts shipyards once British vessels lose access after Brexit. The minister explains the EU IUU-regulation limits such designations, reports lost turnover and an intention to allow maintenance-only calls by UK vessels in specified ports, and declines to reconsider the broader landing-port designations.
I have received a confidential overview from the sector of the estimated turnover losses per shipyard.
Ik heb van de sector vertrouwelijk een overzicht gekregen van de geschatte omzetverliezen per werf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde, Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Banken draaien duimschroeven mkb’er strakker aan in tweede lockdown'

MPs Van der Linde, Lodders and Aukje de Vries (VVD) asked whether banks are becoming less willing to finance SMEs during the second lockdown, what this means for post-crisis credit, and what the government is doing to improve bank lending and use of guarantee schemes. The minister answered that banks report limited additional credit demand, that prudential rules are not seen as blocking lending, that ministries and banks meet regularly and agreed joint action, and that guarantee uptake lags initial forecasts for some schemes while the government promises further steps such as a fiscal review of equity versus debt financing.
No formally adopted minutes are drawn up of the administrative consultation with the banks, which is chaired by EZK.
Van het bestuurlijk overleg met de banken, dat wordt voorgezeten door EZK, worden geen formeel vastgestelde verslagen opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het artikel 'Ik wil niet meer alleen maar over de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) praten'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked the ministers why a permit for replacing a damaged manure cellar in Groningen has taken eighteen months, and what can speed up gas-damage procedures. The minister explains that permitting lies with municipalities and the province, that the Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen is still reviewing sector responses to its expert advice on manure-cellar damage, and points to the Versterken bill and coordination efforts to speed up procedures.
The permitting process for building a manure basin falls under the authority of the municipality and province.
Het vergunningsproces voor de bouw van een mestbassin valt onder het gezag van gemeente en provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over de funderingsproblematiek

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about foundation damage in cities and rural areas, including costs to homeowners, the Fonds Duurzaam Funderingsherstel, the role of KCAF and RVO, and innovation for bacterial decay of wooden piles. The government answered that the problem is poorly quantified and complex, that the loan fund has issued only 34 loans, that KCAF declined cooperation, and that the Rijksprogramma Aanpak Funderingsproblematiek will be developed further in 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Aukje de Vries en Veldman over de problematiek rondom bemanningswisselingen en vaccinatie van zeevarenden

MPs from the VVD asked about crew changes and vaccination of seafarers, including test requirements at foreign airports, the feasibility of arrival testing, vaccine rollout delays such as in the Philippines, and private vaccination options. The minister acknowledged the difficulties, extended the antigen test validity to 24 hours, and said the RIVM is examining how seafarers can access existing vaccination routes, without committing to new parliamentary reporting.
I will inform your House when there are new developments regarding the points above.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren op het moment dat er met betrekking tot bovenstaande punten nieuwe ontwikkelingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht "Bruine vloot op de waakvlam – verdeling van 15 miljoen euro ingewikkeld en tijdrovend"

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers why the EUR 15 million support scheme for the historic 'bruine vloot' sailing charter fleet is complex and slow, and when shipowners will get clarity. The government answered that generic COVID support has been extended and that a separate subsidy for unique maintenance and operating costs of historic ships is being developed, with timing to be set with RVO.nl.
I will inform your House about this.
Hierover zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde, Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het rapport ‘Basel III Reforms: Updated Impact Study’ van de Europese Bankenautoriteit

Three VVD MPs asked the Finance and Agriculture ministers about the EBA's Basel III updated impact study, including the claimed 21% capital increase for Dutch banks, the effect on agricultural and mortgage lending, and whether the impact is unfairly borne by farm credit. The minister answered that the impact depends on the EU implementation proposal expected in H1 2021, that interministerial talks with banks continue, and that a Commission impact analysis will follow.
Once the Commission presents a legislative proposal, the cabinet will inform the House of its position via the usual BNC fiche procedure.
Zodra de CIE met een wetgevend voorstel komt, zal het kabinet uw Kamer informeren over haar inzet volgens de gebruikelijke weg van een BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over de brief 'Agenda voor het Waddengebied 2050' d.d. 11 december 2020

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked ministers about the Waddenagenda 2050, including how the VVD/CDA motion on protecting economic sectors (agriculture, potato seed sector, fisheries, harbours, tourism) is reflected, the impact analysis, the signing of the declaration of agreement, consultation outcomes, and the balance between ecology and economy. The ministers answered that the impact analysis will run parallel to the implementation programme, sectors will be involved via the Omgevingsberaad, consultation led to a strengthened landbouw section, and a site visit is desired but not yet scheduled.

As indicated in the letter of 11 December 2020, in line with this motion, a broad impact analysis will be started in parallel with drafting the Implementation Programme so that effects on ecology and economy can be weighed in balance.

Zoals aangegeven in de Kamerbrief van 11 december 2020 1 wordt, in lijn met deze motie 2 , parallel aan het opstellen van het Uitvoeringsprogramma Waddengebied 2021–2026 (Uitvoeringsprogramma) gestart met een brede impactanalyse om zo de effecten op ecologie en economie in balans met elkaar te kunnen afwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'ECB veroorzaakt twijfel over 'groen' en 'bruin' schuldpapier'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that the ECB may exclude bonds from polluting issuers, asking about green and brown bond definitions, the legal mandate, market neutrality and whether such choices should be made by democratically elected bodies. The minister answered that the ECB's monetary strategy review is ongoing, that EU taxonomy work is underway, that the ECB has a mandate with policy discretion, and that he will forward the ECB review report when available.
I do not want to anticipate the outcomes of the review.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van de herziening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht 'Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net'

Three VVD MPs asked why their earlier questions on the EUR 15 million aid scheme for the charter 'brown fleet' shipping operators remain unanswered, why the scheme is delayed, and when operators will receive funds. The item is a notice that the questions were answered during the 26 January 2021 model question hour, with the answers not reproduced in this text.

The written questions from MPs Aukje de Vries, Aartsen and El Yassini (all VVD) on the report 'Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net' were answered during the model question hour of 26 January 2021.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini (allen VVD) over het bericht «Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net' zijn beantwoord tijdens het modelinge vragenuur van 26 januari 2021

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Vries, Weverling en Lodders over de berichten ‘Onrust bij pachters van buitendijks land achter Waddenzeedijk’ en ‘Rijkscommissie: Waddengebied moet Nationaal Landschapspark worden’

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about unrest among tenant farmers over the Wadden Sea dike plans and a national committee's proposal to make the Wadden region a National Landscape Park, including consultation with stakeholders and the absence of an impact analysis. The minister answered that dike reinforcement is being planned with stakeholders in phases, that the committee's advice is still being discussed with the parties concerned, and that a broad impact analysis will be started in parallel with the Wadden implementation programme.
In parallel with drafting the implementation programme, a broad impact analysis will be started, in line with the Dijkstra and Geurts motion, to weigh the effects on economy and ecology in balance.

Antwoord 14 Parallel aan het opstellen van het Uitvoeringsprogramma zal, in lijn met de motie Dijkstra en Geurts 8 , worden gestart met een brede impactanalyse om zo de effecten op economie en ecologie in balans met elkaar te kunnen afwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het bericht 'Vergoeding lekke mestkelder ‘lachertje’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked ministers about reports that compensation for leaking manure cellars damaged by Groningen earthquakes would be based on economic rather than actual damage, and about timelines and the IMG's approach. The government answered that the IMG will publish its method for manure cellar damage in early 2021, that the expert panel advised repair costs unless they exceed 1.25 times capitalised business damage, and that the IMG's independence limits pre-empting its decision.
It is not appropriate for me to anticipate this, also given the independence of the IMG.
Het past mij niet, ook gelet op de onafhankelijkheid van IMG, hier nu al op vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het proefschrift ‘Public funding of failing banks in the European Union

The MP Aukje de Vries asks the Finance Minister about Marije Louisse's dissertation on public funding of failing EU banks, including gaps between state aid rules and the resolution framework, the Monte dei Paschi case, and concrete steps to strengthen the banking sector. The minister welcomes the dissertation's relevance, agrees the frameworks should be better aligned, outlines Dutch proposals and the planned Commission review, and declines to back some of Louisse's more far-reaching recommendations.

I am less convinced of the desirability of Louisse's proposals, for example to give the SRB a large role in winding down banks in (national) bankruptcy or to create a harmonised insolvency mechanism for banks alongside the resolution framework.

Ik ben minder overtuigd van de wenselijkheid van voorstellen van Louisse om bijvoorbeeld de SRB een grote rol te geven bij het afwikkelen van banken in (nationaal) faillissement of om naast het resolutie-raamwerk een geharmoniseerd insolventiemechanisme voor banken in het leven te roepen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de berichten ‘Italië wil dat de ECB staatsschuld kwijtscheldt, maar Frankfurt peinst er niet over’, ‘Gratis geld, het blijft een aantrekkelijk idee’ en ‘Italië pleit voo

An MP asked the Finance Minister about press reports that Italy and France want the ECB to cancel COVID-era government debt, and about ECB emergency bond purchases, debt sustainability and the EU fiscal rules. The minister answered that ECB debt cancellation would breach Article 123 TFEU, that the ECB's PEPP flexibility is its own monetary policy choice, and that debt reduction is the responsibility of member states, with no commitment beyond a forthcoming broader note on the Stability and Growth Pact.
Debt cancellation by the European Central Bank would constitute a breach of Article 123 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU).
Het kwijtschelden van schulden door de Europese Centrale bank zou een schending van artikel 123 het Verdrag betreffende de werking van de Europese Unie (VWEU) betekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Renovatie Afsluitdijk duurt door fout zeker 3 jaar langer, valt duurder uit'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked about a reported error in the Afsluitdijk renovation that delays the project by about three years and raises its cost, including the cause, traffic impacts, mitigation and extra funding. The minister explained that a combination of low water levels with high waves was omitted from the design inputs, said traffic and cycling disruption will last longer, and said the extra budget is still under negotiation with the contractor, with details expected in spring.
I expect to be able to give you more clarity on this next spring.
Naar verwachting kan ik u hierover komend voorjaar meer duidelijkheid geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de speech van ESM-directeur Klaus Regling 'The response to the Covid-19 crisis and remaining vulnerabilities in EMU'

An MP asks the Finance Minister about ESM director Klaus Regling's call for a permanent Recovery and Resilience Facility and the EMU integration agenda, and whether the government will oppose a permanent facility. The minister answers that the government opposes a permanent RRF or any permanent stabilisation mechanism, will raise this in meetings, and sees member states' own budget buffers and the banking and capital markets unions as the right tools.
The cabinet sees the RRF as a one-off and temporary instrument.
Het kabinet ziet de RRF als een eenmalig en tijdelijk instrument.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Uitbaggeren van het Westgat is weer nodig’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the Westgat channel near Lauwersoog needs dredging, whether it was last dredged in 2018, how maintenance is planned, and whether the Wadden accessibility motion requires action. The minister answers that the 2018 dredging was a one-off pilot paid for by regional parties rather than Rijkswaterstaat, that there is no regular dredging, that sand from the Westgat cannot serve coastal nourishment, and that the economic effects will be assessed in a final evaluation in 2021.
There is no question of regular dredging of the Westgat.
Er is geen sprake van regulier baggeren van het Westgat.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Paris opposé au retour des règles budgétaires européennes d’avant-crise (ministre à l’AFP)’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that France opposes returning to pre-crisis EU budget rules and whether this threatens the eurozone after COVID-19. The minister answered that the Stability and Growth Pact should be revised for effectiveness, the general escape clause should be withdrawn once the recession ends, and a broader reflection letter will follow by year-end.
During the General Consultation on the Eurogroup and Ecofin Council on 9 September I committed to send a broad reflection on the SGP before the end of the year.
Tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Eurogroep en Ecofinraad op 9 september jl. heb ik toegezegd om voor het einde van het jaar een brede bespiegeling ten aanzien van het SGP te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘ECB to consider allowing inflation to exceed target, Lagarde says’

An MP asked the Finance Minister how he assesses the ECB's possible move to a higher or more symmetric inflation target, whether it is consistent with the price stability mandate, and related risks and effects. The minister answered that the ECB has independent policy freedom within the treaty framework, that its strategy review is ongoing with stakeholder consultation, and that the government will not comment on substance.
The ECB has policy freedom to give content to the price stability mandate within the treaty framework.
De ECB beschikt over beleidsvrijheid om invulling te geven aan het mandaat van prijsstabiliteit binnen de verdragsrechtelijke kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het bericht 'Flinke weerstand akkerbouw tegen Waddenagenda'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked ministers about farmers' and arable growers' opposition to the draft Wadden Agenda 2050, including their involvement, consequences for arable farming, and Natura 2000 links. The minister answers that LTO and nature groups were involved, that the agenda sets no land-use changes, and that talks with the agricultural sector and a Waddenbrief before the 5 November debate will follow.
The Ministries of IenW and LNV will enter into talks with the land and arable farming sector about the sector's position in the Agenda.
Het Ministerie van IenW en van LNV gaan in gesprek gaan met de land- en akkerbouwsector over de positie van de sector in de Agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Brussels plans attack on low tax member states'

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the European Commission was considering using Article 116 TFEU to attack low-tax member states, and whether this threatens national tax competence. The State Secretary answered that the proposal is still at an exploratory stage, that the Netherlands has taken many anti-avoidance measures, and that the Chamber will be informed via a BNC fiche once a concrete proposal is published, but did not address the Commission's inconsistent legal-basis position.
At this moment there is therefore no proposal yet and it is, in my view, too premature to respond to this subject.
Op dit moment ligt er dus nog geen voorstel en is het, naar mijn mening, te prematuur om op dit onderwerp te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het bericht ‘Brussels ready to clamp down on sweetheart corporate tax deals’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Minister and State Secretary of Finance about a Financial Times report that Brussels is ready to clamp down on sweetheart corporate tax deals, including whether the Commission will use Article 116 TFEU to remove member-state vetoes on tax. The State Secretary answered that he supports Commission efforts against tax avoidance, that the Article 116 proposal has not yet been published, and that he will uphold parliamentary motions opposing giving up the Dutch veto on tax.
I have no intention other than to respect these motions in my position in the EU.
Ik heb geen ander voornemen dan deze moties bij mijn inzet in de EU te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over het bericht 'De Koegelwieck fan Doeksen alwer oan de kant fanwegen technyske problemen'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Ziengs asked about repeated technical failures of the fast ferry Koegelwieck on the Harlingen–Vlieland and Harlingen–Terschelling routes, its effects on islanders and tourists, contractual rules, and consultation with the municipality and advisory boards. The State Secretary explained the engine problems, that replacement vessels were being arranged, the passenger-rights rules, the concession's quality requirements, and that the concession holder consults stakeholders and that the minister will raise the issue in periodic meetings with the operator.
As concession grantor I monitor compliance and will act toward the concession holder where necessary.
Als concessieverlener monitor ik de naleving en treed ik richting de concessiehouder op als dat nodig mocht zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de berichten 'La Bce vuole dal Tesoro 700 milioni di fondi per Mps' en 'ECB tells Monte dei Paschi to boost capital for bad loan deal'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that the ECB wants Italy to inject 700 million euros into Monte dei Paschi and whether state aid rules and banking union rules would be respected, and about Italy's NPL reduction and exit from its stake in MPS. The minister answered that no state aid approval has been given, that the rules remain fully in force and are for supervisors and the Commission to enforce, and gave an overview of Italian bank indicators and the commitment to exit the stake by end 2021 without knowing concrete steps.
It is for the supervisors, resolution authorities and the European Commission to apply and enforce the banking union rules.
Het is aan de toezichthouders, de resolutieautoriteiten en de Europese Commissie om de regels van de bankenunie toe te passen en te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over 'Bocht in geul naar Ameland blijft om natuur'
