Three VVD MPs asked why the Reegeul-Oost bend cut to shorten the Ameland ferry route was abandoned, what alternatives were weighed, and what is being done to reduce ferry delays. The minister answers that a Nature Conservation Act permit cannot be granted because the works would permanently damage the priority habitat 'permanently submerged sandbanks', that the Vloedgeul cut was lawful because it followed a natural channel course, and that other Open Plan Process measures are implemented and monitored, with a longer-term study starting this autumn.

This means that realising the Reegeul-Oost bend cut is not feasible under nature legislation, because the conservation status of this habitat type is at stake and a permit under the Nature Conservation Act therefore cannot be issued.

Dit betekent dat de realisatie van de bochtafsnijding Reegeul-Oost vanuit natuurwetgeving niet haalbaar is omdat de staat van instandhouding van dit habitattype in het geding komt en een vergunning in het kader van de Wet Natuurbescherming daarom niet kan worden afgegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Winkels van Waddeneilanden willen dat de bootcapaciteit stijgt naar 60 procent: ‘Dit is een noodkreet’’ in de Leeuwarder Courant

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about ferry capacity limits to the Wadden islands, which hurt local businesses under COVID measures, and whether capacity should be raised. The state secretary said that since 1 July seats and designated standing places are available again, that ferry capacity is a matter of safe, responsible use and tourist spreading handled with regional authorities, and gave no commitment to new capacity measures.
I cannot assess whether there is a certain percentage at which ferry capacity is no longer a limiting factor for the economy of the Wadden islands.
Ik kan niet beoordelen of er een bepaald percentage is waarbij de capaciteit van de veerdiensten geen beperkende factor is voor de economie van Waddeneilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Onderzoeksinstituut Wetsus in Leeuwarden gehackt, hacker betaald in bitcoins”

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about a ransomware attack on research institute Wetsus, whether minimum cybersecurity requirements apply to publicly funded institutes, and how the government will prevent recurrence, including ransom payment and Chinese knowledge theft. The state secretary answered that cybersecurity is primarily the institutes' own responsibility (defence-related research excepted), that the government is talking with TO2 institutes about improving resilience without new mandatory requirements, that the ransom was paid from own funds, and that Wetsus's funding after 2021 is being explored with an expert group.
Ensuring (cyber)security is primarily the responsibility of the research institutes themselves, subject to the relevant laws and regulations.
Het borgen van de (cyber)veiligheid is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van onderzoeksinstituten zelf, uiteraard met inachtneming van de relevante wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over een werkbezoek aan het bedrijf HZPC in Joure en het artikel ‘HZPC verplaatst aardappelonderzoek naar Canada’

Two VVD MPs asked the agriculture minister about HZPC moving potato research to Canada and the strict GMO and crop protection rules that may drive such moves. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to an EU review of GMO rules due by April 2021, innovation programmes, and NVWA capacity, while answering most questions on substance.
As agreed in the coalition agreement, the cabinet is working to revise the European GMO regulation.
Zoals in het regeerakkoord is afgesproken, zet het kabinet zich in voor herziening van de Europese ggo-regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Aukje de Vries en Moorlag over het bericht over watercrassula op Terschelling en de bestrijding van invasieve exoten

MPs Weverling, Aukje de Vries and Moorlag asked the minister about the spread of water crassula on Terschelling, its financial and legal responsibilities, control methods, and coordination among authorities. The minister confirmed the threat to protected dune habitat, described provincial spending of about 4.3 million euros, noted the difficulty of control, and rejected a central knowledge platform while promising an evaluation and a meeting on this case.
For this specific problem I will organise a consultation.
Ik zal voor deze specifieke problematiek een overleg organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'NCG levert in afgelopen drie maanden elf versterkte huizen op'

MP Aukje de Vries asked the Minister of the Interior why only eleven houses were reinforced in Groningen in three months, questioning the pace, causes and COVID-19 impact. The minister confirmed the figure, attributed delays to complex projects and the pandemic, and listed measures such as alternative inspections and extra resident support, while declining to give a multi-year reinforcement planning.
To say anything about the number of buildings that will need reinforcing, it must first become clear from an assessment whether a building meets the safety standard.
Om iets te kunnen zeggen over het aantal gebouwen dat zal moeten worden versterkt zal uit een beoordeling duidelijk moeten worden of een gebouw aan de veiligheidsnorm voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht «Nederland dankzij Belgen al twee jaar niet vertegenwoordigd in EIB-top»

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the Benelux vice-presidency of the European Investment Bank being vacant for two years, its consequences for Dutch projects and what the government will do to fill it. The minister says the vacancy is undesirable, that Nederland keeps pressing Belgium for a quick nomination, that the nomination process cannot be accelerated beyond the statutes, and that the Netherlands will keep raising the issue bilaterally.

For the Benelux, and therefore for the Netherlands, the absence of a vice-president is undesirable, and that is why the cabinet has for some time been urging Belgium to make a nomination as soon as possible.

Voor de Benelux, dus ook voor Nederland, is het uitblijven van een vicepresident niet wenselijk en daarom dringt het kabinet er al enige tijd bij België op aan dat er zo snel mogelijk een voordracht wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Provincie wil steenmarter breed bestrijden’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the Fryslân pilot on controlling stone martens, which coincided with more hatched lapwing and black-tailed godwit chicks, is successful, and whether the province's request to list the stone marten on the national exemption list will be granted. The minister finds the pilot promising but insists the province already has sufficient powers, declines the national listing, promises a broader national study and a discussion with Fryslân, and says no national damage data exists.
Control of damage and nuisance caused by the stone marten is a competence of the provinces.
Bestrijding van schade en overlast van de steenmarter is een bevoegdheid van de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘European Banking Authority plans overhaul of EU bank stress test'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about EBA proposals to restructure the EU bank stress test, including a bank-run component with more room for banks' own models, and whether this weakens supervision. The minister explained the two-component idea, said the supervisory leg remains the starting point for capital requirements, stressed that the proposal is only a consultation, and said the new approach would apply from 2022 at the earliest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Europe braces for new fiscal battles'

MP Aukje de Vries asks the Finance Minister about proposals reported by the Financial Times to make EU fiscal rules more symmetrical and to exempt green spending, and about enforcement and reform of the Stability and Growth Pact. The minister answers that the Commission has made no concrete proposals yet, that the government questions a green golden rule, and that it will not accept any change to the Pact before it is submitted to parliament, with an appraisal promised once the Commission's evaluation is published.
If not, why not? The cabinet is of the view that a number of member states have done too little to strengthen public finances in both good and bad times.
Het kabinet is van mening dat een aantal lidstaten zowel in goede als in slechte tijden onvoldoende heeft gedaan om de overheidsfinanciën te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de aangekondigde evaluatie van het monetaire beleid

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the ECB's announced evaluation of its monetary policy strategy, including its consequences, the role of Dutch bodies and Eurogroup/Ecofin, whether the government would contribute, the effects on Dutch pension funds, housing and savings rates, and whether the ECB's mandate is being stretched (e.g. climate). The minister answered that the evaluation concerns how the mandate is implemented, not the mandate itself, that the ECB is independent and the government will not contribute input, and that the role of other bodies and their input is still unclear.
The cabinet will therefore not contribute any input to the evaluation.
Het kabinet zal dan ook geen inbreng leveren op de evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “European Taxpayers Once Again Are Bailing Out Bankers”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Bloomberg article on taxpayers bailing out banks, including the EU approval of state support for NordLB and several other bank rescues. The minister answered that bail-in by shareholders and creditors comes first, explained how bail-in rules were applied in each case, and said the banking union framework is being reviewed and the 2013 banking communication may be updated.
In the first place, it is always up to the shareholders and creditors of a bank to absorb losses through bail-in.
Het is in de eerste plaats altijd aan de aandeelhouders en schuldeisers van een bank om door middel van bail-in verliezen te incasseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de berichten ‘Italian banks rush to profit from ECB negative rates’ en ‘Italiaanse banken lenen extra miljarden uit noordelijke landen’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Finance about reports that Italian banks exploit an ECB tiering arbitrage to lend surplus reserves while northern banks are at their exemption limit, asking about effects, risks and whether the government will act. The Minister answers that banks must set their own funding mix within prudential rules, that the ECB independently chooses its policy instruments, that the arbitrage effect was small and quickly eliminated, and that no further steps are needed.
It is up to the ECB to determine whether the effects of tiering are disproportionate and whether adjustment of the tiering system is necessary.
Het is aan de ECB om te bepalen of de gevolgen van tiering disproportioneel zijn en of aanpassing van het tieringstelsel nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘MSC Zoe: nog 2 containers en een regeling te gaan’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the shipping company MSC has paid only part of the cleanup and damage costs from the MSC Zoe container loss, nearly eleven months later, and when legal instruments would be used. The minister answered that roughly 2.86 million euros in claims has been filed, about 0.93 million has been paid, negotiations continue, no end date is committed to, and legal action is not yet warranted.
I think some time is still needed for this and I do not want to commit to an end date.
Ik denk dat hier nog enige tijd voor nodig is en wil mij niet vastleggen op een einddatum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Italiaans begrotingstekort groeit in 2020'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about Italy's rising 2020 budget deficit, debt trajectory and compliance with the Stability and Growth Pact, and whether the Commission should act. The minister answered that the Commission will assess Italy's draft budget in its autumn forecast, that Italy's growth forecast is in line with international institutions, and that the government remains committed to strict enforcement of EU fiscal rules.
At present the European Commission is calculating the plans that euro area countries have included in their draft budgets and is incorporating them into the autumn forecast.
Op dit moment rekent de Europese Commissie de plannen door die Eurolanden hebben opgenomen in hun ontwerpbegrotingen en verwerkt deze in de herfstraming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Deutscher Widerstand gegen Europäische Einlagensicherung bröckelt'

An MP asks the Finance Minister about reports of waning German resistance to a European deposit insurance scheme (EDIS), the risk-reduction measures still pending (such as zero-weighting of sovereign bonds), and the timing of EDIS. The minister answers that EDIS should only follow once sovereign bond treatment and bank health checks are improved, and sets out the status of the banking package and the High Level Working Group.
The Netherlands therefore continues to press, at European level, for better treatment of sovereign bonds on bank balance sheets and for testing bank health through asset quality reviews (AQRs).

Nederland blijft daarom in Europees verband inzetten op een betere behandeling van staatsobligaties op bankbalansen en het toetsen van de gezondheid van banken door middel van asset quality reviews (AQRs).
Antwoord opvragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Remco  Dijkstra over het bericht 'Natuurorganisaties willen weten: waar blijft de schadevergoeding voor de aangespoelde containers?’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Remco Dijkstra asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why shipping company MSC has been slow to pay damages for the containers lost from the MSC Zoe and the cleanup costs, nine months after the loss. The minister answers that MSC must fully compensate the damage, that about 1.93 million euro in claims remain open, that negotiations are ongoing toward a settlement, and that legal instruments are the fallback if talks fail.
My preference still is to reach an amicable agreement with MSC.
Mijn voorkeur gaat nog steeds uit om er langs minnelijke weg met MSC uit te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht dat de EU mogelijk de fiscale regels wil versoepelen vanwege uitblijven van de groei

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the EU intends to loosen fiscal rules due to lack of growth, and whether a document on this exists and can be shared. The minister answered that the document is a Finnish presidency issues note facilitating discussion, not a proposal to loosen rules, that it has already been shared with parliament, and that his position is unchanged.
It is not aimed at loosening rules, but gives a broad overview of the issues at play in discussing the budget rules.
Het is niet gericht op het versoepelen van regels, maar geeft een breed overzicht van de vraagstukken die spelen bij het bespreken van de begrotingsregels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries hebben vragen gesteld over het bericht “Oefenen voor een no deal Brexit”

MPs Dijkstra and De Vries asked about a report on no-deal Brexit preparations, the lack of a Border Inspection Point on the north bank of the Nieuwe Waterweg in Rotterdam, its consequences, responsibility, financing and EU approval. The minister answered by referring to earlier letters and briefings, said talks on an inspection post for live animals are ongoing, and mentioned a possible subsidy and guarantee under strict state aid conditions.
For a detailed explanation and answer to your questions, I refer you to several relevant letters.
Voor een uitgebreide toelichting en antwoord op uw vragen verwijs ik u naar enkele relevante brieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘soepelere begrotingsregels Europese Unie’

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the EU is considering loosening budget rules (the Stability and Growth Pact) after a press report, and how the government would respond. The minister answers that there is no concrete proposal, only a routine Commission evaluation, and that the Netherlands opposes loosening and favours tighter enforcement and less flexibility.
In general terms, the Netherlands believes that poor compliance and the inability of member states to reform can never be a reason to loosen the SGP.
In algemene zin is Nederland van mening dat een gebrekkige naleving en het onvermogen van lidstaten om te hervormen nooit een reden kan zijn om het SGP te versoepelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Steenmarters teisteren auto’s bij Tjongerschans’

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about stone marten damage to cars and other harms, and what the government will do about it. The minister answered that no national damage data exist, that particulars are responsible for prevention, that provinces can act, and that the species will not be placed on the national hunting exemption list for now.
As a result, there is no national overview of the damage and nuisance caused by stone martens.
Daardoor is er geen landelijk overzicht van de schade en de overlast die steenmarters veroorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Aukje de Vries over een bericht op facebook

MPs Nijkerken-de Haan and Aukje de Vries asked the State Secretary about a Wajong recipient whose 12.5-year work anniversary bonus was deducted from his benefit by UWV. The State Secretary said UWV is independently responsible for individual cases, explained the income-offset rules, and committed to exploring with UWV whether a limited list of bonuses could be exempted, while stating broader exemptions are not currently feasible.
UWV is an independent administrative body with its own responsibility for implementing, among other things, the Wajong. I therefore cannot respond to individual cases.
Het UWV is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan met eigen verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van onder meer de Wajong. Ik kan daarom niet reageren op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Ziengs en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Nieuwe’ geul klaar maar werkt nog niet’

MPs asked about the newly dredged Vloedgeul channel on the Holwerd-Ameland ferry route, which was finished but still showed delays, asking about expected travel-time gains, monitoring, further measures and a second cut-off. The minister answered that the expected saving is 4 to 6 minutes but cannot yet be verified, that weekly soundings and a planned measurement campaign will monitor the channel, that quarterly punctuality data will be provided and reviewed in the 2020 transport plan, and that a second bend cut-off and a long-term vision are in preparation.
The information requested by your House is not available in time for the General Consultation on the Wadden of 26 June 2019.
De door uw Kamer gevraagde informatie is niet tijdig beschikbaar voor het Algemeen Overleg Wadden van 26 juni 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Eurozone budget likely to play stabilizing role: Moscovici'

An MP asks the Finance Minister about a Reuters report that a eurozone stabilisation function is likely and that Dutch officials privately agree it is needed, and asks whether the Netherlands will challenge Commissioner Moscovici. The Minister replies that the Netherlands opposes a stabilisation function, that the eurozone budget should focus only on convergence and competitiveness within the MFF, and that he will raise the issue in the Eurogroup.
The cabinet is not in favour of a stabilisation function for the eurozone, as it has stated several times in earlier letters to the House.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander van een stabilisatiefunctie voor de eurozone, zoals ook meermaals is aangegeven in eerdere brieven aan uw kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Italy raises deficit target, risking fresh conflict with the EU’

An MP asks the Finance Minister about Italy's raised deficit forecast, its growth projections over the past year, whether Italy still complies with the Stability and Growth Pact, and whether the Commission should open an excessive deficit procedure sooner. The minister says the Italian forecasts were endorsed by an independent fiscal body, that the Commission will assess compliance in June, that a procedure now is not warranted, and that he will keep pressing for strict enforcement at Ecofin/Eurogroup.
As I have also done in recent times, I will continue to work at European level for strict compliance with and consistent enforcement of the SGP.
Zoals ik ook de afgelopen tijd heb gedaan, zal ik mij in Europees verband blijven inzetten voor een strikte naleving en consequente handhaving van het SGP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Betsjinning brêgen en sluzen Ofslútdyk ûnbetrouber'

MPs Dijkstra and De Vries asked why defects in the Afsluitdijk bridge and lock control systems were only investigated in 2018, what safety risks arose, and whether the cost and liability for the faulty installation would be pursued against the contractor. The minister answered that 15 related incidents occurred without accidents, extra staff and cameras were deployed, costs are about EUR 0.5 million, and Rijkswaterstaat will report on liability before summer.
Rijkswaterstaat will prepare a factual account before summer to determine the degree of liability and take a position on it.
Rijkswaterstaat maakt voor de zomer een feitenrelaas om de mate van aansprakelijkheid te bepalen en daar een positie over in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'EBRD overweegt opnieuw miljoenenlening MHP'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the EBRD's proposed EUR 100 million loan to Ukrainian poultry producer MHP for acquiring a Slovenian poultry integrator raises concerns about unfair competition, state aid and lower production standards, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that the loan is not state aid, that EBRD rules require additionality, that the Netherlands abstained and objected to earlier MHP loans on environmental and animal welfare grounds, and that the EU is seeking to curb duty-free poultry imports from Ukraine through the Association Agreement.
Because it concerns an acquisition, the EBRD is bound by rules on handling market-sensitive information.
Omdat het een overname betreft is de EBRD gebonden aan regels ten aanzien van de omgang met marktgevoelige informatie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het opiniestuk van eurocommissaris Moscovici in de Financial Times

An MP asked the Finance Minister about an op-ed by Commissioner Moscovici arguing the Commission is political, and about how the Commission applied the Stability and Growth Pact to Italy and France. The minister said the Pact allows limited discretion but must be applied strictly, called the Italy case a clear breach, and said France's case is still open pending the spring forecast, while supporting a more independent enforcement body.
The cabinet is of the view that less flexibility, stricter enforcement of the rules and greater predictability in applying them can increase the effectiveness of the SGP.

Het kabinet is van mening dat minder flexibiliteit, een striktere handhaving van de regels en het vergroten van de voorspelbaarheid bij de uitvoering van de regels, de effectiviteit van het SGP kan vergroten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Italy’s recession strains EU to make the budget numbers add up’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about downward revisions to Italy's 2019 growth forecast (from 1.2% to 0.2% by the Commission) and the implications for Italy's compliance with EU fiscal rules and the timing of Commission assessment. The minister said the revision will likely worsen Italy's fiscal position, that the Commission will reassess in its spring forecast, and that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged strict application of the Stability and Growth Pact.
It is not for the Netherlands to make its own estimate of Italy's budgetary situation.
Het is niet aan Nederland om zelf een raming te maken van de Italiaanse budgettaire situatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over een werkbezoek aan de vissers Lauwersoog d.d. 6 januari 2019 en diverse berichten in de media over de overboord geslagen zeecontainers van

MPs from the VVD asked about the MSC Zoe container loss off the Wadden islands, its risks for fisheries and shipping, liability, recovery timelines, and container securing rules. The minister answered that the shipowner is held liable and must recover containers within a two-month expected timeframe, that investigations by the OM and OvV are underway, and that securing rules were tightened in 2016, but gave no exact compliance percentage.
At present no exact percentage is known of ships where cargo has been properly secured.
Op dit moment is geen exact percentage bekend van schepen waar op de juiste wijze lading vastgezet is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het artikel 'Macron laat teugels Frankrijk vieren’

An MP asks the Finance Minister about France's new measures after the gilets jaunes protests, their cost, the effect on France's deficit and EU fiscal rules (SGP), and Italy's budget. The minister answers that the measures cost about 0.4% of GDP, that France's 2019 deficit would reach about 3.2%, and that the Commission will assess this in the spring forecast, while he has consistently pressed for strict SGP enforcement.

I have always advocated strict compliance with and enforcement of the Stability and Growth Pact, both in bilateral talks with my European colleagues and in plenary meetings of the Eurogroup and Ecofin Council.

Ik heb altijd gepleit voor een strikte naleving en handhaving van het Stabiliteits- en Groei Pact zowel tijdens bilaterale gesprekken met mijn Europese collega’s als tijdens de plenaire vergadering van de Eurogroep en de Ecofinraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de berichten 'Ingreep ECB bij probleembank Carige is een oplossing ‘all’italiana’' en 'Italian populists dodge first big banking test'

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the ECB's early-intervention action at Banca Carige, and the possible Italian support route, complies with EU banking recovery and resolution rules, given concerns about bail-in and a possible deviation from BRRD. The minister answered that the ECB intervention is not a solution in itself, that the rules are being applied as agreed, that Carige does not currently meet the failing-or-likely-to-fail test, and that no concrete parliamentary action is planned beyond raising framework improvements in European meetings.
I have no reason to assume that the BRRD rules are being deviated from.
Ik heb geen reden om aan te nemen dat wordt afgeweken van de BRRD-regels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht 'Stresstest voor banken moet veel effectiever'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister whether EU bank stress tests are effective enough, following EBA chair Enria's criticism, and about Italian banks and possible gaming. The minister agreed there is room to improve methodology, defended the bottom-up EU approach and the disclosure of results, noted the EBA cannot impose capital requirements itself, and said that further changes are for supervisors and the Council, with the Netherlands pushing for balance-sheet reviews.
I cannot go into the results of individual banks in stress tests.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de resultaten van individuele banken in stresstesten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Langer 100 km/u op A32 bij Heerenveen’

MPs Dijkstra and De Vries asked whether a Heerenveen newspaper report about keeping 100 km/h on the A32 implied noise-norm breaches, and whether speed limits should be lowered without noise, environmental or safety grounds. The minister replied that no noise norms are exceeded on the stretch, that the municipality may fund extra noise measures but has not announced any, and that speed limits will be reviewed periodically and published in a draft traffic decree.
The 2016 noise production ceiling compliance report shows that on this road section there is no exceedance or imminent exceedance of the established noise production ceilings.
Uit het nalevingsverslag Geluidproductieplafonds 2016 blijkt dat er op dit wegvak geen overschrijding of dreigende overschrijding plaatsvindt van de vastgestelde geluidproductieplafonds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘bij crisis helpt Italië banken’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about Italian Finance Minister Tria's remark that government intervention in troubled banks is not strange, and whether this undermines the banking union rules and future risk-sharing. The minister replied that no Italian state aid to banks is currently at issue, that EU rules remain in force, that the Commission assesses state aid, and that Dutch negotiating positions are unchanged, but declined to answer the last question by the deadline.
It is for the European Commission to assess whether any measures for the banking sector involve state aid and, if so, whether it is permissible aid.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie om te beoordelen of er bij eventuele maatregelen voor de bankensector sprake is van staatssteun en zo ja of het geoorloofde steun is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Italy’s government agrees sharply higher public spending plan'

MP Aukje de Vries asks the Finance Minister about Italy's 2019 draft budget with sharply higher spending and a 2.4% deficit, questioning its credibility, the SGP compliance, and the eurozone implications. The minister answers that the draft raises spending and worsens the deficit, that the Commission has sent it back for revision, and that Netherlands has raised concerns in the Eurogroup while stressing the need to respect the SGP rules.
I therefore find it worrying that the Italian draft budget does not comply with the budgetary obligations.
Ik vind het dan ook zorgelijk dat de Italiaanse ontwerpbegroting niet aan de budgettaire verplichtingen voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Begrotingscomité laakt te grote Europese toegeeflijkheid tegenover Italië'

MP Aukje de Vries asks Finance Minister Hoekstra how to respond to the European Fiscal Board's criticism that the European Commission was too lenient toward SGP violators such as Italy, and how the SGP can be simplified and made enforceable. The minister agrees the Commission was too lenient, supports strengthening the EFB and reducing SGP flexibility, notes that the reform outlook is uncertain, and stresses that enforcement depends on political will.
I have already pressed for the EFB to have its own financial resources, and I will continue to do so.
Ik heb eerder al aangedrongen op eigen financiële middelen voor de EFB, en zal dit blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht 'Ernstige zorgen over Brussels gemorrel aan boekhoudregels'

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports that the European Commission wants to change international accounting rules (IFRS). The minister answered that the Commission is running a broad public consultation on corporate reporting, that Dutch government supports consistent IFRS application for international comparability, and that no formal proposal exists yet.
I cannot answer questions about French positions, since I cannot disclose positions that other member states take in EU meetings.
Vragen over Franse standpunten kan ik niet beantwoorden, aangezien ik standpunten die andere lidstaten in EU-vergaderingen innemen, niet naar buiten kan brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van den Berg over het bericht ‘Tarieven zorg nog altijd geheim’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van den Berg asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports that healthcare tariffs remain secret, arguing patients should be able to choose providers on price, especially where the own risk applies. The minister answered that patients should have insight into costs, outlined existing disclosure obligations enforced by the NZa, and said the NZa is working with the sector on greater price transparency, initially in medical-specialist care, while declining for now to impose a statutory obligation.
I have called on the parties to take this seriously and asked the NZa to report on this point and to consider obligations if progress lags in 2019.
Ik heb partijen opgeroepen dit serieus op te pakken en heb de NZa gevraagd op dit punt te rapporteren en verplichtingen te overwegen indien de voortgang in 2019 achterblijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Griekenland wil af van pensioenafspraken met Europa’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Omtzigt asked the Finance Minister about Greece's reported wish to revise pension cuts agreed with Europe, including what the measures are, Greece's fiscal room, the post-programme surveillance procedure and the timing of the next review. The minister confirmed the 2019 pension recalibration and inflation-indexation suspension, said Greece has made no formal request to revise commitments, and described enhanced surveillance with quarterly reporting by the Commission.
At this moment Greece has not made any formal proposal to amend any agreement as agreed for the post-programme period.
Op dit moment heeft Griekenland geen formeel voorstel gedaan tot aanpassing van enige afspraak zoals overeengekomen voor de post-programma periode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Levensgevaarlijk chloormiddel nog steeds te koop als ‘medicijn’’

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked why the NVWA took years to act against Miracle Mineral Solution, a chlorine-based product sold as a medicine, despite early warnings and health reports. The minister explained the NVWA needed an independent risk assessment, enforcement began in 2018 after the March report, and it had issued warnings and fines in earlier years.
The bureau can ask the Front Office Food and Product Safety of the RIVM and RIKILT to carry out a risk assessment.
Bureau kan het Front Office Voedsel- en Productveiligheid van het RIVM en het RIKILT vragen een risicobeoordeling uit te voeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Tielen en De Lange over het bericht 'Húsdokter yn oplieding wol graach nei Fryslân, mar mei net'('Huisarts in opleiding wil graag naar Fryslân, maar mag niet')

Three VVD MPs asked why medical faculties restrict GP trainees to stages within their own university region, despite shortages in regions like Friesland, and asked about criteria, overviews and possible talks with HON. Minister Bruins replied that the uniform national allocation procedure already considers shortage regions, that HON is evaluating allowing transfers to shortage areas by Q3 2018, that no study delays were found, and that a LHV-linked study on GP location motives is being set up.
One of the recommendations from that evaluation is to allow transfers to shortage areas under conditions.
Een van de aanbevelingen uit die evaluatie is om overplaatsing naar krimpgebieden onder voorwaarden toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht Veel onduidelijkheden rond halen VIPP-deadlines

An MP asks the health minister whether hospitals will meet the VIPP digitisation deadlines and what the consequences of missing them are for data exchange. The minister says the module-B1 deadline was postponed from 1 July to 1 December 2018 after hospitals reported difficulty, that the NVZ has signalled no missed A1 deadlines, and that VWS will help where obstacles lie outside hospitals' control.
Following this, consultation was held and it was decided to amend the deadline in the regulation from 1 July 2018 to 1 December 2018.
Naar aanleiding hiervan is overleg gevoerd en besloten om de deadline in de regeling aan te passen van 1 juli 2018 naar 1 december 2018.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden De Lange en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Ramp voor de patiëntjes'

MPs De Lange and Aukje de Vries asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of a shortage of paediatric staff at VUmc, and whether shortages elsewhere and the Werken in de Zorg programme would address them. The minister replied that there is no national shortage of paediatricians, that the shortage concerns paediatric IC nurses, that patients are still treated and planned operations are rerouted to other hospitals, and that longer-term measures and a study on regional imbalances are underway.
To clarify to what extent there are national, regional and local imbalances in the need for and availability of medical specialist functions and their causes, I will commission a study.

Om inzichtelijk te maken in hoeverre er landelijk, regionaal en lokaal sprake is van onevenwichtigheden in de behoefte aan en de beschikbaarheid van medisch specialistische functies en wat daarvan oorzaken zijn, laat ik een onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'LNV overrompelt schapenboeren: zeedijk telt maar half voor Mestwet'

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked the minister about reports that a manure-policy change caught sheep farmers off guard, whether enforcement and reporting of manure fraud work properly, and how many fraud reports came in. The minister denied any tightening of the manure law, explained the court rulings on sea dikes and a suspended policy rule, and reported about 30 suspected manure-fraud signals in the past 12 months.
Following these rulings, after consultation with LTO, Wetterskip Fryslân and the Union of Water Boards, a policy rule was drawn up.
Naar aanleiding van deze uitspraken is, na overleg met LTO, Wetterskip Fryslân en Unie van Waterschappen, een beleidsregel opgesteld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Veel huisartsen nog onbekend met declaratiemogelijkheden e-mailconsult'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about awareness among GPs of how to declare e-mail consultations, and about how to promote them and other remote care. The minister answered that many GPs lack knowledge, that 62 percent offer e-mail consultations, that a handbook and NZa guidance are being issued, and that remote care will be promoted, but no parliamentary oversight of the executive is at stake.
I certainly see the e-mail consultation as an added value, for both the GP and the care user, in daily practice.
Ik zie het e-mailconsult zeker als een meerwaarde, voor zowel huisarts als zorggebruiker, in de dagelijkse praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Thuismedicatie in ziekenhuis scheelt kosten en fouten’

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a report on continuing patients' home medication in hospitals, its cost savings, implementation barriers, IT and financing obstacles, and extension to other care sectors. The Minister agreed waste should be curbed, pointed to a forthcoming consultation with stakeholders and NZa clarification of financing rules, and said the 15 million euro savings figure is only a rough extrapolation.
I will soon be meeting with, among others, pharmacists, prescribers and health insurers.
Ik ga binnenkort in gesprek met onder andere apothekers, voorschrijvers en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Versnelde toelating medicijnen nauwelijks beter'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a report that expedited drug approval yields little time gain, and about EU and Dutch options to speed access, the conditional marketing authorisation's use and results, US-EU differences, and member-state procedures. The Minister says initiatives like PRIME and joint scientific advice are being used, that the time gain is modest but real, and that new system changes will be considered only if current options prove insufficient.
I want the current possibilities for accelerated approval within the legal frameworks to be fully used first.
Ik wil dat de huidige mogelijkheden voor versnelde toelating binnen de wettelijke kaders eerst maximaal worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Willekeur bij publicatie voedselveiligheidswaarschuwingen”

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked the ministers why food safety warnings were published late or not at all by the NVWA, and how consumers could find them in one place. The minister replied that companies must issue public warnings themselves, that the NVWA can only require companies to publish, not to report to it, and that the NVWA will tighten its internal procedures and urge companies to notify faster.
In the TV broadcast the NVWA promised it would tighten its internal procedures so that public warnings are published faster.
In de Tv-uitzending heeft de NVWA toegezegd dat ze haar interne werkwijze gaat aanscherpen zodat publiekswaarschuwingen sneller worden gepubliceerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Heerenveen wil stil asfalt op snelweg A32'

MPs Dijkstra and De Vries asked about residents' noise complaints near the A32 motorway at Heerenveen and whether noise ceilings were being respected. The minister answered that noise levels remain below the applicable production ceilings, outlined planned works and mitigation measures, and said she is already consulting the municipality.
Based on the most recent compliance report on noise production ceilings for 2016, the noise level along the A32 at Heerenveen is below the applicable noise production ceilings.
Op basis van het meest recente nalevingsverslag Geluidproductieplafonds 2016, ligt het geluidsniveau langs de A32 ter hoogte van Heerenveen onder de geldende geluidproductieplafonds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Hermans over de berichten 'Honderdduizenden ouderen houden dure ziekenhuisbedden bezet' en 'Veel 65-plussers liggen onnodig in ziekenhuis'

VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that hundreds of thousands of elderly patients occupy costly hospital beds without medical need and that about 1.4 billion euro is spent on unnecessary care. The ministers acknowledge the problem, describe alternative options such as short-stay facilities and regional coordination points, but say most figures from the ActiZ-commissioned study cannot be verified.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Hermans en De Lange over het bericht 'Wachttijden onacceptabel'

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the causes of waiting times across healthcare sectors, whether insurers and providers have agreed to reduce them, and what the NZa can enforce. The minister answered that the NZa has an action plan, that insurers can be sanctioned under their duty of care, and that concrete follow-up such as reports to the House is planned.
Health insurers must make efforts to ensure that their insured persons receive good quality, accessible and timely care.
Zorgverzekeraars moeten zich inspannen om ervoor te zorgen dat hun verzekerden kwalitatief goede, bereikbare en tijdige zorg ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Ambulance laat Lies (91) uren lijden”

MP Aukje de Vries asked the Minister for Medical Care how a 91-year-old woman with a broken hip could wait five hours for non-urgent ambulance transport, whether the situation could have been prevented, how often such cases occur, and whether the same wait would have applied after a fall in public space. The minister expressed regret, explained the case was classed as B-urgency due to ambulance staff shortages, said such delays are not systematically tracked, and committed to discussing response times with the regional acute care chairs.
No nationally binding time standards apply to B-transport.
Voor B-vervoer gelden geen landelijk bindende tijdsnormen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Lange over tekorten aan huisartsen in de regio

MPs Aukje de Vries and De Lange asked the minister about shortages of GPs in regions such as Friesland and Zeeland, monitoring of supply, and measures to address them. The minister replied that there is no national GP shortage, that regions must solve local problems with insurers' help, and that the government will send an action plan in spring 2018.
At present I am not holding consultations with the Landelijke Huisartsenvereniging (LHV) and health insurers specifically to solve the GP shortages in the regions.
Op dit moment voer ik geen overleg met de Landelijke Huisartsenvereniging (LHV) en zorgverzekeraars om specifiek het tekort aan huisartsen in de regio’s op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over weigering van de dienstverlening aan US persons in relatie tot de Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA)

An MP asked whether Dutch banks and insurers refuse services to US persons even when they hold a social security number, and what agreements exist with financial institutions. The State Secretary answered that some banks still refuse some US persons, that banks have no acceptance obligation, that most banks accept US persons with an SSN, that no agreements were made with institutions, and that US persons can turn to the NVB for banks that will serve them.
I regret this, but banks have no obligation to accept customers.
Dit vind ik spijtig maar banken hebben geen acceptatieplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Keuzevrijheid is in het geding’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Arno Rutte asked whether limited competition and entry barriers in the health insurance market threaten consumer choice, and whether the government will commission further study or reconsider regulation and a proposed profit ban. The minister agrees competition matters, cites the ACM report on entry barriers, finds current regulation proportionate, and declines additional research as the ACM study already covers the issue.
Additional research therefore currently has no added value.
Aanvullend onderzoek heeft daarom op dit moment geen meerwaarde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Schadeherstel in derivatendossier loopt zoveelste vertraging op’.

MPs Ronnes and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about reported delays in compensating SMEs harmed by interest rate derivatives, and whether the AFM, banks and external file assessors are blocking progress. The minister acknowledged delays due to automation and data problems, denied a deadlock, and said banks are offering advances to vulnerable clients and he will keep pressure on them.
I remain in discussion with the AFM about this and will raise attention to it in my (introductory) meetings with banks in the coming period.
Ik blijf hierover met de AFM in gesprek en zal in mijn (kennismakings)gesprekken met banken de komende tijd hier ook aandacht voor vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Consumentenbond bezorgd over groot aantal ‘kloonpolissen’’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the Consumentenbond's concern over many near-identical 'clone policies' sold within the same insurance groups, and whether transparency and NZa enforcement are adequate. The minister acknowledged the importance of transparency, described new NZa rules from November 2017 requiring clear disclosure, said the NZa is monitoring the 2018 switching season and will report in early 2018, and agreed to talk with the NZa about holding insurers to their transparency duties.
The NZa maintains supervision of the regulation throughout the entire switching season.
De NZa houdt gedurende het gehele overstapseizoen toezicht op de regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “DNB haalt streep door Bovag-garantie”

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether DNB had reversed its position on the BOVAG warranty and treated it as insurance, and asked about the difference between statutory, extra-statutory and insurance-type guarantees. The minister replied that the press report was incorrect, DNB had made no policy change, and the website was only being clarified and the disputed phrase removed.
It should be noted that DNB has not implemented any policy change regarding the scope of insurance.
Opgemerkt wordt dat DNB geen beleidswijziging heeft doorgevoerd over de reikwijdte van verzekeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'DNB verliest rechtszaak om bijdrage aan kosten toezicht'

MP Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about a court ruling that DNB lost a case over charging supervision costs to payment institutions, including whether tariffs were proportionate and what the consequences are. The minister said both parties appealed, declined to comment on the merits pending appeal, noted limited tariff effects for EU passport holders, and stated the highest tariff imposed was 13.2% of relevant revenue.
I am currently awaiting the appeal ruling. Until then, it is not for me to respond substantively to the case.
Ik wacht op dit moment de uitspraak in hoger beroep af. Tot die tijd is het niet aan mij inhoudelijk op de zaak te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Middendorp over het bericht “NS ziet af van verkoop AH to go en Julia’s op stations”

MPs Aukje de Vries and Middendorp asked why NS (Dutch Railways) decided to keep AH to go and Julia's shops in stations under its own management, despite its 2016 strategy to divest retail, and whether the shareholder was consulted. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that NS's 2016 strategy remains in force, that retail formulas are being put out to concession gradually, that the shareholder was consulted as required, and that the government reviews the strategy with NS on a regular basis.
In accordance with statutory provisions, NS consulted the State as shareholder before the strategy was adopted by NS.
Conform statutaire bepalingen heeft NS de Staat als aandeelhouder geraadpleegd voordat de strategie door NS is vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ronnes, Visser en Aukje de Vries over de samenwerking tussen KLM en Air France

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the government about the KLM-Air France relationship, including a cultural report, centralisation, the Joon/Boost subsidiary, governance and Dutch representation on the holding's executive committee. The state secretary said the cooperation is a private company matter, that the 2016 agreements still stand, that Joon will not hinder KLM's growth, and that the two-tier model is valued, while declining to comment on the report and refusing to take a position on board composition.
I did not discuss the report with the KLM management because I consider the cooperation a responsibility of the company Air France KLM and of the two airlines KLM and Air France themselves.

Ik heb over het rapport niet met de KLM-directie gesproken omdat ik de samenwerking een verantwoordelijkheid van de onderneming Air France KLM en de twee luchtvaartmaatschappijen KLM en Air France zelf vind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over fraude op Schiphol

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister and Infrastructure State Secretary about fraud, cost control, investment and building-quality problems at Schiphol Group, following a NRC article. The government answered that Schiphol is primarily responsible for its own integrity and asset management, that an external review and KPMG study found procurement market-conform, and that existing building issues, including the Hilton case, were addressed with the competent authorities.
Schiphol is primarily responsible for its own business operations and integrity policy.
Schiphol is primair verantwoordelijk voor de eigen bedrijfsvoering en het integriteitsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over de zeehondentochten op de Wadden

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked about proposed closures of sandbanks in the Wadden Sea to seal tour operators, the basis for those proposals, stakeholder consultation and enforcement. The minister replied that the proposals are preliminary, follow a set consultation procedure with a decision planned for spring 2018, and that closures are based on monitoring and enforced, while seal populations are stable.
The closed area is also not enlarged under the current proposals in the starting document, but rather reduced.
Het gesloten gebied wordt ook met de huidige voorstellen in het startdocument niet vergroot, maar juist verkleind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over 'Onderling Verzekerd!'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the Platform Onderlinge Verzekeraars' recommendations for proportionate insurance regulation for small mutual insurers, and whether the government will act on them. The minister responded that the Solvency II-related recommendations will be taken up in the upcoming EU evaluation and the national Basic-regime evaluation, that DNB has already provided guidance, and that the ministry will consult the platforms once the Basic-regime evaluation starts.

Once the evaluation of the national regime for insurers with limited risk scope is taken up, the ministry is willing to consult with the Platform Onderlinge Verzekeraars and the Platform Kleine en Middelgrote Verzekeraars

Zodra de evaluatie van het nationale regime voor verzekeraars met beperkte risico-omvang ter hand wordt genomen, is het ministerie graag bereid met het Platform Onderlinge Verzekeraars en Platform Kleine en Middelgrote Verzekeraars in overleg te treden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Visser en Van der Molen over het bericht “IFKS: comedy met Europese regels” in de Leeuwarder Courant

MPs Aukje de Vries, Visser and Van der Molen asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about EU certification (CvO) and AIS obligations affecting race skûtsjes reported in the Leeuwarder Courant. The minister says a clear transitional regime exists, enforcement only starts after 1 January 2019, and no legal basis exists for exemptions from the AIS or CvO obligations.
However, I am convinced that a clear and workable transitional arrangement exists for the vessels concerned.
Ik ben er echter van overtuigd dat er voor de betrokken schepen een heldere en werkbare overgangsregeling bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Bosman over het modelcontract voor de energiemarkt

MPs Aukje de Vries and Bosman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the model energy contract is confusing, sometimes not actually available, and not offered by four of 26 suppliers. The minister said he had no further signals beyond the report, passed the concerns to the ACM regulator, and noted the model contract has not been formally evaluated.
I have therefore passed the signal about the model contract on to the ACM.
Het signaal over het modelcontract heb ik dan ook aan de ACM doorgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie van 19 april 2016, Dansk Industri/Karsten Eigil Rasmussen

Two MPs asked the state secretaries whether the 2013 and 2016 European Court of Justice rulings (Experian, Dansk Industri/Rasmussen) show that the age exception in the Dutch equal treatment law and the Staffelbesluit age-based premium scales are incompatible with EU law, and what consequences this has for pension schemes. The government acknowledged the age exception in the Wgbl is likely not a correct implementation of the directive and promised to examine amendments, but maintained that the Staffelbesluit itself can be objectively justified and needs no withdrawal.

From both rulings of the European Court of Justice it can be inferred that the exception to the prohibition of age discrimination laid down in Article 8(3) of the Dutch Equal Treatment on Grounds of Age in Employment Act (Wgbl) is, on closer examination, not a correct implementation of the above Directive.

Uit de beide uitspraken van het Europese Hof van Justitie kan worden afgeleid dat de uitzondering op het verbod van leeftijdonderscheid, die is vastgelegd in artikel 8, derde lid, van de Wet gelijke behandeling op grond van leeftijd bij de arbeid (Wgbl), bij nader inzien geen juiste implementatie van de bovengenoemde Richtlijn is.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Genoeg van Faalsluitdijk”

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about press reports on repeated breakdowns of the Afsluitdijk bridges, their causes, stand-by staffing, repair plans and economic damage. The minister explained the heat-related failures, announced continuous cooling and a bridge superstructure replacement in 2023-2025, but declined to quantify economic damage since it is not recorded.
Should the situation change, I will consider which measures are needed.
Mocht de situatie wijzigen dan bekijk ik welke maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Aukje de Vries over de resolutie van de Banco Popular Español

MPs Harbers and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about the resolution of Banco Popular Español, its takeover by Santander, compliance with BRRD and banking union rules, the state of the Spanish banking sector, and the handling of Italian banks. The minister answered that the case was a resolution with bail-in under the BRRD/SRM framework, that no taxpayer money was used, that Spanish banks have strengthened since 2012, and that Member States may still choose preventive recapitalisation within EU rules.
The chosen solution for Banco Popular Español did use a bail-in, consisting of writing down capital instruments and converting subordinated debt.
Bij de gekozen oplossing voor Banco Popular Español is juist wel gebruik gemaakt van een bail in, bestaande uit het afschrijven van kapitaalinstrumenten en het omzetten van achtergestelde schulden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Belastingdienst in de knoop met renteheffing”

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the tax authority pays little interest on overpaid tax while charging much more on unpaid tax, and whether this is fair. The State Secretary explains that since 2012 interest is generally not refunded on overpayments, provides yearly figures on interest received and refunded, and acknowledges an asymmetry but declines to change the system citing budgetary cost.
I can well imagine that there are taxpayers who find the interest arrangement unjust.
Ik kan mij goed voorstellen dat er belastingplichtigen zijn die de regeling belastingrente onrechtvaardig vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Aanpak van derivatendossier loopt nog meer vertraging op'

MP Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister why the handling of interest rate derivatives compensation for SME clients is delayed beyond mid-2017, and what is causing it. The minister answers that the framework is complex, banks expect to need 2017 and some clients may only receive offers in 2018, and he will receive an AFM progress report in June.
In the first progress report that I expect from the AFM in June this year, more insight will be given into the planning and progress.
In de eerste voortgangsrapportage die ik in juni dit jaar van de AFM verwacht, zal meer inzicht worden gegeven in de planning en de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Een op drie ondernemers niet bewust van uitfasering PEB”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that a third of entrepreneurs are unaware of the phase-out of pension in own management (PEB), and about deadlines, communication and possible extensions. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Authority communicates widely, that the existing grace period is sufficient, and that a longer period or later transfers are not desirable.
I consider it important that all director-major shareholders (dga's) with a PEB are well informed of the changed legislation, by which the PEB is phased out.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat alle directeur-grootaandeelhouders (hierna: dga's) met een PEB goed op de hoogte zijn van de veranderde wetgeving, waardoor het PEB wordt uitgefaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Koerhuis over hypotheken, echtscheiding en maatwerk

Two VVD MPs asked whether mortgage lenders can and do provide case-by-case flexibility (maatwerk) after divorce or relationship breakdown, and how NHG, AFM rules and debt release work in such cases. The minister answers that the Platform Maatwerk has found no new bottlenecks, that the rules already allow justified deviations, that lenders vary in practice, and promises to inform the House before summer.
I will inform you before the summer about the outcomes of this.
Ik zal u voor de zomer informeren over de uitkomsten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over aangifte schenkbelasting

An MP asked why the inheritance and gift tax return forms were only published in April and May 2017 despite rules applying from 1 January, and whether late forms could cause interest problems for taxpayers. The State Secretary explained the delay by capacity constraints from form adjustments and stated that the statutory deadlines mean no interest or deadline problems will arise.
Given the applicable filing deadline for inheritance tax (the return must be filed within 8 months of death), no problems with timely filing arise from the later availability of the return forms.

Gelet op de geldende aangiftetermijn voor erfbelasting (de aangifte moet binnen 8 maanden na overlijden worden gedaan) ontstaan geen problemen met het tijdig doen van aangifte als gevolg van het later beschikbaar komen van de aangifteformulieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Visser en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Letselschade-uitkering verkeersslachtoffer moet belastingvrij'

MPs from the VVD asked whether personal injury compensation for road accident victims should be exempt from the asset income surcharge that affects Wlz and Wmo co-payments, following a call by insurers and victim groups. The government answered that the surcharge applies in principle, that only compensation for non-material damage and claims fixed before 11 October 2010 are excluded under the hardship clause, and that it is consulting stakeholders with findings promised before summer.
I expect to be able to inform your House before the summer about the outcomes of these consultations.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer voor de zomer te kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten van deze overleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over de doorverkoop van de Fyra’s aan een andere vervoerder

MPs Aukje de Vries and De Boer asked whether reported resale of the Fyra trains to Trenitalia was accurate, whether AnsaldoBreda had contacted the minister, and what compensation NS and the state would receive. The minister replied that no sale has yet occurred, that NS is not party to any resale contract, and that NS would receive up to EUR 3.5 million per train if resale succeeds, with the proceeds going to NS profit rather than the state.
If there is an actual sale, NS will be informed of it by AnsaldoBreda/Finmeccanica under this agreement, and NS will inform me of it.
Ingeval er sprake is van een daadwerkelijke verkoop, zal NS hierover conform deze overeenkomst door AnsaldoBreda/Finmeccanica op de hoogte worden gesteld en zal NS mij hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Harbers en Van der Linde over het bericht 'Brusselse eis zet Rotterdamse haven in financiële klem”

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the Rotterdam port's financial squeeze after the European Commission ended the corporate tax exemption for ports, and about the level playing field across EU ports. The minister replied that port investment room is not currently under pressure, that the Commission's state aid procedures against Belgium and France and the port regulation are on track, and that the Netherlands continues to press for fair competition.
At present the investment room of HbR is not under pressure and the port company is able to carry out the planned investments.
Op dit moment staat de investeringsruimte van HbR niet onder druk en is het Havenbedrijf in staat de geplande investeringen uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte, Lodders en Aukje de Vries over de problemen van agrarische ondernemers in de Oudebildtdijk

MPs Rutte, Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked whether designating the Oude and Nieuwe Bildtdijken as a protected village landscape (beschermd dorpsgezicht), including about 2,500 hectares of farmland, would restrict farmers' operations, and whether the farmland should be excluded. Minister Bussemaker replied that the designation is based on cultural-historical values, does not aim to block farming, leaves the existing zoning plan in force, and that she sees no reason to reconsider or exclude farmland, while offering a protocol with the municipality and province and awaiting a pending Council of State appeal.

I have already indicated to the municipality of Het Bildt and the province of Fryslân that I am willing to draw up, together with them and the agricultural sector, a protocol on agricultural business operations in relation to the status of the protected village landscape.

Ik heb de gemeente Het Bildt en de provincie Fryslân al aangegeven bereid te zijn om samen met hen en de agrarische sector een protocol op te stellen over de agrarische bedrijfsvoering in relatie tot de status van het beschermd dorpsgezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Europese banken luiden noodklok over nieuwe regels”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a report that European banks object to new Basel capital rules, including whether the rules reflect real risks, their impact on mortgage and agricultural lending, and when EU implementation will be clear. The minister answered that the Basel talks were postponed, EU implementation is not yet decided and Dutch implementation will be used to flag disproportionate effects on Dutch banks.
The Basel Committee carried out an impact assessment of the various proposals. Its outcomes have not been made public, because this concerns supervisory-confidential information.

Het Bazelse Comité heeft een impact assessment uitgevoerd om de impact van de verschillende voorstellen in kaart te brengen. De uitkomsten hiervan zijn niet openbaar gemaakt, omdat dit toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over een tweede intercity van en naar Fryslân

MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries asked why the promised second intercity between Fryslân and the Randstad was not running and whether it can be realised, and what the obstacles are. The State Secretary answers that power supply limitations led ProRail to declare the infrastructure overloaded, that NS, ProRail and Fryslân agreed in November 2016 to start the service around end 2017, and that ProRail is installing an extra substation and other upgrades.
On 16 November 2016, NS, Fryslân and ProRail agreed that the second intercity is expected to run on the Leeuwarden–Zwolle route from the end of 2017.
Op 16 november 2016 hebben NS, Fryslân en ProRail afgesproken dat de tweede intercity naar verwachting eind 2017 gaat rijden op het traject Leeuwarden – Zwolle.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Middenbedrijf weet kapitaalmarkt onvoldoende te vinden’

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports that medium-sized businesses struggle to access capital markets, and about measures such as SME growth markets, prospectus rules, FinTech and alternative financing. The ministers answered that existing financing instruments, the action plan on SME financing and EU capital markets union measures address the problem, and that the prospectus exemption threshold will be raised and further FinTech steps reported before year-end.
The cabinet considers it of great importance that sufficient financing is available for enterprises with a sound business plan.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat er voldoende financiering beschikbaar is voor ondernemingen met een gezond bedrijfsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht "Woonbootbewoners tussen wal en schip"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked about ING ceasing mortgages for houseboats, leaving only one provider, and whether banks should be able to offer tailored products. The minister says the market is commercially unattractive due to complexity and low volume, sees no regulatory obstacles in financial rules, notes a forthcoming houseboat mooring-tenancy law, and will monitor developments.
I have actively followed developments in recent months and will continue to do so in the coming period.
Ik heb de ontwikkelingen de afgelopen maanden actief gevolgd en zal dit de komende periode ook blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht “Bank straft trouwe klant”

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked whether banks refuse bridging loans to retirees who no longer need a mortgage, and whether regulation causes this, plus solutions and whether NVB claims regulation hinders tailored service to seniors. The minister says no standard bridging loan exists without a mortgage, regulation does not block it, some banks offer it case by case, and a study and a maatwerk platform will examine the practice.
As far as I am aware, no lender offers a bridging loan as a standard product when no mortgage product is attached.
Voor zover mij bekend biedt geen enkele kredietverstrekker standaard de mogelijkheid om een overbruggingskrediet af te sluiten indien er geen hypotheekproduct aan is verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de conceptbeleidsregel “Veilig stellen geldmiddelen betaalinstellingen en elektronische geldinstellingen”

The MP asks the Finance Minister about DNB's draft policy rule on safeguarding funds of payment and e-money institutions, including FinTech criticism, competition, costs, and alternatives such as a quality account. The Minister answers that DNB is independent, the rule clarifies existing practice without blocking alternatives, and the final version will incorporate consultation input.
A policy rule is not a generally binding regulation, but elaborates a statutory power and binds the administrative body itself.
Een beleidsregel is geen algemeen verbindend voorschrift, maar werkt een wettelijke bevoegdheid uit en bindt het bestuursorgaan zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Bosman over de aangekondigde sluiting van de Windward Island Bank (WIB) op Saba

MPs Aukje de Vries and Bosman asked whether the Windward Island Bank will close its Saba branch, what the consequences are, and whether the resulting single-bank situation and the stricter BES financial regulation are justified. The minister confirmed the closure, said the remaining bank RBC would hold a de facto monopoly that may be undesirable, attributed the decision mainly to poor financial results rather than regulation, and committed to ongoing consultation with the island government and supervisors to keep ATMs and at least one bank operating.
I am considering, in consultation with the parties involved, whether there are options to keep this ATM operational next year as well.
Ik bezie, in overleg met betrokken partijen, of er mogelijkheden bestaan om deze geldautomaat ook volgend jaar operationeel te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over de definitie van staatssteun inzake investeringen in havens in een richtlijn

MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries (VVD) asked whether the government had raised the port state-aid issue with the European Commission and about the timing of EU guidance on subsidies to seaports. The minister answered that the Netherlands urged the Commission to publish state-aid guidance for seaports and to speed up revision of the block exemption, that the Commission has no current plans for such guidance, and that the Dutch corporate tax exemption for ports was ended while similar exemptions in Belgium and France are under formal investigation.
Together with the EP rapporteur for the new port regulation, Mr Fleckenstein, I sent a letter in June to EU Competition Commissioner Ms Vestager.
Samen met de EP rapporteur voor de nieuwe havenverordening, dhr. Fleckenstein, heb ik in juni jl. een brief gestuurd aan de EU Commissaris voor mededinging, mw. Vestager.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Bosman over de berichten “Antilliaanse verzekeraar leeg getrokken”, “Balletje-balletje op de Antillen met reserves van verzekeraar Ennia” en “Spin in het Antilliaanse web

MPs Aukje de Vries and Bosman asked the Finance and Interior Ministers about press reports on insurer Ennia on Curaçao, supervision by the Dutch and local central banks, and Dutch liability for failing Caribbean financial institutions. The ministers answered that prudential supervision of Ennia lies with the Curaçao central bank, that DNB's powers over BES branches are limited, that DNB's 2015 report is confidential so details cannot be given, and that the Dutch state is not guarantor for Caribbean financial institutions.

Because of, among other things, DNB's duty of confidentiality, which aims to limit possible harmful consequences for the institution concerned, and because of my systemic responsibility as Minister, under which in principle I do not receive information on individual supervised institutions from DNB, it is not possible for me to answer the questions about the content of the report and about any earlier warnings and actions.

Vanwege onder meer deze geheimhoudingsplicht van DNB – die als doel heeft om eventuele schadelijke gevolgen voor de betrokken instelling te beperken – en vanwege mijn systeemverantwoordelijkheid als Minister – waarbij geldt dat ik in principe geen informatie over individuele onder toezicht staande instellingen van DNB ontvang – is het voor mij niet mogelijk om de vragen over de inhoud van het rapport en over eventuele eerdere waarschuwingen en acties te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over brugstoringen in Friesland

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked about repeated breakdowns of the Skarster Rien bridges in Friesland, including their causes, prevention, whether traffic jams increased, and maintenance plans. The minister answered that there is no increase in breakdowns or traffic jams, explained the July 2016 pump failure and the inspection and maintenance regime, and noted major maintenance is scheduled for 2024.
No, there is no question of that.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus, Aukje de Vries en Moors inzake vmbo-leerlingen die aangeven onvoldoende kennis van geldzaken te hebben

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Education and the Minister of Finance about a survey showing vmbo pupils feel insufficiently informed about money matters, and what schools, the curriculum and the Wijzer in Geldzaken programme do about it. The government answers that money management is embedded in existing curriculum goals and subjects, that monitoring of school practice is not done centrally, and that prevention is preferred to municipal debt write-offs.
However, it is not monitored nationally in what way and with what intensity schools pay attention to societal themes such as managing money, nor why they do so.
Er wordt echter niet landelijk gemonitord op welke wijze en met welke intensiteit scholen aandacht besteden aan maatschappelijke thema's zoals omgaan met geld, en ook niet waarom zij dat zo doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over de berichten “France airs fears over London Stock Exchange merger with Deutsche Börse” en “French concerned about risks of Deutsche Börse, LSE Merger”

An MP asked the Finance Minister how he views the proposed merger of the London Stock Exchange and Deutsche Börse, including effects on Dutch finance, Euronext, and comments from French officials. The minister answered that the European Commission will assess competition effects, that Dutch supervisors lack competence over the non-Dutch merging firms, and that no timeline can yet be given.
The European Commission will investigate whether, and to what extent, there will be reduced competition as a result of the announced merger
De Europese Commissie zal gaan onderzoeken of, en in welke mate, sprake zal zijn van verminderde concurrentie als gevolg van de aangekondigde fusie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over de veerdiensten naar de Waddeneilanden

Two MPs (De Boer and Aukje de Vries, VVD) asked the state secretary about price agreements under the Wadden island ferry concessions, the consultation on tariff increases, freight tariffs from Harlingen, and the structure of the concessions. The state secretary answered that tariffs have not risen since the concession became final, that the concessionaire must consult on its ferry timetable plan and that the concession authority approves it, and that freight is a free market outside the concessions.
It is up to the concession authority whether or not to approve (parts of) this transport plan, including the proposed tariffs for the next timetable year.
Het is aan de concessieverlener om al dan niet in te stemmen met (onderdelen van) dit vervoerplan, waaronder de voorgestelde tarieven voor het volgende dienstregelingsjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Aukje de Vries over de berichten ‘Politiek neemt zzp'ers niet serieus’ en ‘Zzp'er in de war door wet tegen schijnzelfstandigheid’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about uncertainty among freelancers and clients over the Dutch DBA law on false self-employment and model contracts, and whether the Tax Authority is cooperative. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Authority is cooperative and that the DBA law stays in its current form, citing ongoing information campaigns, model contracts and branch-specific account teams.
The Tax Authority has a cooperative attitude towards the submitters of contracts.
De Belastingdienst heeft een coöperatieve houding naar de indieners van overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Aukje de Vries en Visser over de uitgave van Dagblad van het Noorden 2016

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the navigability of the Westgat channel serving the port of Lauwersoog, whether vessels are diverting, and whether dredging or other action is justified.
