The minister acknowledged limited depth and possible future deepening, but argued that the situation is not urgent, that the port remains reachable, and that dredging would be costly with a low chance of payback, while offering to discuss the issue with the region.
I do not share your view that there is an urgent situation requiring action in the short term.
Ik deel uw mening niet dat hier sprake is van een urgente situatie welke noopt tot actie op korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over files bij de Afsluitdijk

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked about repeated closures of the Afsluitdijk bridges, their cause, the repair measures taken and a planned event closing the road. The minister reports 17 unplanned closures in the first half of 2016 versus 8 in 2015, explains the causes and additional measures, and confirms the event has been moved to 4 September with the road closed from 2:00 to 12:00.
In this period there were a total of 17 closures outside the planned obstructions.
In deze periode zijn er in totaal 17 afsluitingen buiten de geplande stremmingen geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Duisenberg en Aukje de Vries over de uitgave van de Skûtsjekrant 2016

Three VVD MPs asked the minister whether the Binnenvaartbesluit and Binnenvaartregeling apply to historic sailing vessels, the bruine vloot and skûtsjes, what the effects are, whether there was consultation with the sector, and whether any fines have been issued. The minister answered that the rules have existed since 2009 with no known unclarity, that skûtsjes are exempted in key respects after sector consultation, that fines cannot be traced by vessel type, and that only the 31 December 2018 certificate obligation is new.
Fines issued in inland navigation since 2009 cannot be traced back to vessel type.
Boetes die in de binnenvaart sinds 2009 zijn afgegeven zijn niet naar type schip te herleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Zzp’er verwacht schade door nieuwe wetgeving”

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that freelancers expect harm from the new Wet DBA and about unclear enforcement, sector support, boetes and administrative burden. The government answered that the Belastingdienst will not enforce repressively until 1 May 2017 except in three named situations, that it will publish questions and answers and a summary of inquiries, and that it monitors implementation through consultations and stakeholder channels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “TenneT vraagt kabinet geld voor windparken”

MP Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about TenneT's request for extra state capital for offshore grid investments, including how much is needed, the funding source, the timing and parliamentary involvement, and why TenneT cannot raise financing privately. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the state is considering a request for EUR 1 billion in extra equity, to be decided on the basis of an external second opinion and reflected in the 2017 budget, with the Chamber informed separately if a decision is made.
In advance of this, I will also inform the Chamber by separate letter if the cabinet intends to proceed with the injection of additional capital.
Vooruitlopend hierop zal ik uw Kamer ook via een separate brief informeren indien het kabinet voornemens is om tot storting van additioneel kapitaal over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Aukje de Vries over het op te richten Italiaanse noodfonds

MPs Harbers and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about a proposed Italian private rescue fund for weak banks, its governance, state aid and bail-in implications, and whether it circumvents the BRRD. The minister answered that information is limited to public reports, that state aid compatibility is for the European Commission to judge, and that a private fund on market terms would fall outside the bail-in rules.
My information about such a fund is limited to public reporting.
Mijn informatie over een dergelijk fonds is beperkt tot openbare berichtgeving
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over het bericht “Schrap het verpandingsverbod”

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the proposal to lift the ban on pledging claims (verpandingsverbod) to ease SME credit. The minister answered that the problem lies in contractual clauses rather than statute, that a statutory change would be a restriction on freedom of contract, that talks with the banks and factoring association are ongoing, and that a decision will follow after stakeholder consultation.
On this basis, the final decision on the proposal made will take place.
Op basis hiervan zal de definitieve besluitvorming over het gedane voorstel plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht dat vliegreizen stilletjes duurder worden

An MP asked the economics minister about reports that flight prices are rising through hidden fees, including baggage charges, and whether the market regulator ACM is acting against non-transparent pricing. The minister answered that ACM enforces price transparency rules, can fine airlines up to 450,000 euro, has already fined several carriers, but sees no reason to talk with the airline sector and treats baggage fees as avoidable optional costs.
The ACM supervises article 23 of the Air Transport Regulation and the Unfair Commercial Practices Act.
De ACM houdt toezicht op artikel 23 van de Luchtvaartverordening en de Wet oneerlijke handelspraktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht «ING stopt met watervilla hypotheken»

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about ING ending houseboat mortgages, the market consequences, and how to attract new providers. The minister confirmed ING is the largest player, that Rabobank will remain the only provider, and that the government will consult the Dutch banking association on new entrants.
Consultation will be held with the Dutch Banking Association and it will be asked what ideas they have to ensure more providers of houseboat mortgages can enter the market.

Er zal overleg worden gevoerd met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken en gevraagd worden welke ideeën zij hebben om ervoor te zorgen dat er meer aanbieders van woonboothypotheken op de markt kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Aukje de Vries over stremmingen op de Afsluitdijk

MPs Jacobi and Aukje de Vries asked the minister about repeated breakdowns and closures of the Afsluitdijk bridges, their causes, prevention and whether postponed maintenance is involved. The minister answered that storm-related disruptions stem mainly from ageing control systems being replaced in 2016, that emergency response and repair times are being shortened, and that maintenance is not postponed for the Afsluitdijk project.
In anticipation of the planned major maintenance, Rijkswaterstaat has started additional inspections of critical components to prevent breakdowns.
Vooruitlopend op het geplande groot onderhoud is Rijkswaterstaat gestart met extra inspecties van kritische onderdelen, om storingen te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Te hoge hypotheken verstrekt door verwarring over regels’

MPs Van der Linde and Aukje de Vries asked whether lenders wrongly granted NHG mortgages up to 106% LTV based on minimal energy-saving measures, whether homeowners are harmed, and how rules and oversight should respond. The minister confirmed some lenders breached the rules, attributed partial confusion to WEW guidance, said homeowners face no tax loss, and that WEW clarified its norms and the AFM will inventory the problem.
It is correct that a number of institutions granted mortgages with an LTV of 106% without the full additional financing room being spent on energy-saving measures.
Het klopt dat een aantal instellingen hypotheken hebben verstrekt met een LTV van 106% zonder dat de volledige extra financieringsruimte is besteed aan energiebesparende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over de Radar-uitzending over arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen

MPs Aukje de Vries and Ziengs asked the Finance Minister about a Radar broadcast alleging that disability insurers refuse payouts over unreported, unconscious omissions made at application, and whether applicants should be screened in advance. The minister replied that the duty to disclose and the Protocol Verzekeringskeuringen apply, insurers may refuse only where non-disclosed facts matter, an industry form revision is underway, and the AFM has examined advice quality and is considering fines.
The AFM has in the past investigated how disability insurance works in practice, including the aspects raised in the Radar broadcast of 18 January.
De AFM heeft in het verleden onderzoek gedaan naar de werking van arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen, ook naar de aspecten die in de Radar-uitzending op 18 januari jl aan de orde kwamen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Aukje de Vries over de reddingsactie van de Portugese overheid bij de Banco Novo

MPs Harbers and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister about Portugal's rescue of Banco Novo, whether it followed EU state aid and BRRD rules, whether it was timed to avoid the new BRRD, and about a similar Italian bad bank deal. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the state aid approval, BRRD and state aid rules were followed, that the ECB had no role in the Portuguese resolution decision, and that he cannot judge investor claims.
I have no indication that the measures at Novo Banco violate the European state aid rules or the applicable BRRD rules.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de maatregelen bij Novo Banco in strijd zijn met de Europese staatssteunregels of de geldende regels uit de BRRD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over FinTech betaaldiensten

An MP asked the Finance Minister about divergent Dutch and EU interpretations of rules on payment institutions holding client funds, whether bitcoin-related firms can obtain bank accounts, and other obstacles for FinTech payment services. The minister answered that the core rule (Article 16(2) PSD) applies uniformly, that banks individually assess high-risk clients such as bitcoin exchanges, and that the revised PSD will improve indirect access for payment institutions.
Finally, I note that I am not aware of any signals of a trend in which Dutch payment institutions move to other member states where payment regulation is much more favourable.
Tot slot merk ik nog op dat mij geen signalen bekend zijn van een tendens waarbij Nederlandse betaalinstellingen uitwijken naar andere lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht: Hagel Verzekering Maatschappij bezwijkt onder druk DNB

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether DNB's supervision made it impossible for a small mutual hail insurer to survive, and how the rules and the fit-and-proper tests burden small insurers. The minister answered that DNB applies the proportionate Solvency II Basic regime to small insurers, that individual cases are not his to judge, and that proportionality has been reviewed with DNB, with an evaluation planned for 2018.
As Minister of Finance I have no insight into individual background circumstances.
Als Minister van Financien heb ik geen inzicht in individuele achtergronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Garnalenvisser in clinch met overheid’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that a shrimp fisher faces restrictions because his environmentally friendly catch method conflicts with current rules, and what the government will do to help him. The State Secretary said the company's exemption request was incomplete and is being assessed, that innovation will be accommodated where possible, but that an exemption requires careful analysis and may be limited by directly applicable EU rules.
Of course I want to offer room for meaningful innovations. We are studying the request and will give room for it where possible.
Uiteraard wil ik zinvolle innovaties ruimte bieden. We bestuderen het verzoek en zullen als het mogelijk is daartoe ruimte geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht: ‘Geen voordeel verzekeraar meer bij NHG-lening’

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Solvency II rules that deny insurers the risk-reducing effect of the NHG mortgage guarantee, and the late communication of this, will raise NHG mortgage rates and distort competition. The minister confirmed the problem, said DNB rightly sees no legal room to recognise NHG under the current standard formula, pledged to work with DNB to fix it in the 2018 review, and argued the effect on rates and competition would be small.

Once the European Commission starts the evaluation of the delegated acts, expected to be completed in 2018, the Ministry of Finance will work together with DNB to resolve this omission in the Solvency II framework recently identified by DNB.

Zodra de Europese Commissie de evaluatie van de gedelegeerde handelingen opstart, waarvan de afronding is voorzien in 2018, zal het Ministerie van Financiën zich gezamenlijk met DNB inzetten om deze onlangs door DNB geconstateerde omissie in het Solvabiliteit II kader op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Tellegen over het bericht "Financiële sector let te weinig op terrorisme, zegt DNB"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Tellegen asked the Finance and Justice Ministers about DNB's finding that the financial sector pays too little attention to terrorism financing, and about the effectiveness of the Wwft, its gaps and EU/international plans. The Minister said the effectiveness of the measures cannot be quantified, acknowledged DNB's concerns, pointed to ongoing supervision, the FEC project and EU/FATF discussions, but gave no firm new legislative commitments.
Because it concerns sensitive information, this information will probably not be made publicly available.
Omdat het gevoelige informatie betreft, zal deze informatie waarschijnlijk niet publiek ter beschikking worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Drama’s na IBAN-fout onopgelost”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about erroneous IBAN transfers, agreements with the Betaalvereniging and Consumentenbond, possible remedies, the number of misdirected transfers and the recovery problems, the charity-number waiver and remaining SEPA/IBAN issues. The minister said talks with the Consumentenbond have not yet produced satisfactory results, that the Betaalvereniging will inventory the problem from 1 January, and that the recovery procedure returns over 80% of misdirected payments, while committing only to monitoring and to support DNB's approach on the charity waiver.
The Betaalvereniging has committed to inventorying this from 1 January.
De Betaalvereniging heeft toegezegd om vanaf 1 januari a.s. dit te inventariseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Aukje de Vries over het artikel “Eumedion vreest uitbuiting kleine aandeelhouders”

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Aukje de Vries asked whether the government sees risks in the concentration of control by majority shareholders at Dutch listed companies and whether minority shareholders should be better protected, following an Eumedion position paper. The minister disputes the doubling figure, finds it impossible to judge whether control has concentrated, sees existing Dutch company and securities law as adequate, and is cautious about new procedural rules while committing to consider the position paper and to evaluate the Wet bestuur en toezicht in 2016.

Dutch company law aims both to give entrepreneurs a legal infrastructure enabling them to fully pursue their activities and to give those involved in the company, including shareholders and creditors, sufficient protection against abuse of power.

Het Nederlandse vennootschapsrecht strekt er enerzijds toe om ondernemers een juridische infrastructuur te bieden die hen in staat stelt hun activiteiten ten volle te ontplooien en anderzijds om de bij de vennootschap betrokkenen, waaronder aandeelhouders en crediteuren, voldoende bescherming te bieden tegen (machts)misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries inzake Franse verhuizing Transavia

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked whether Transavia Nederland would sell its 40% stake in Transavia France and whether governance changes would weaken KLM's independence and Schiphol's hub role. The government answered that talks between the companies are ongoing, that no formal Dutch or French government role exists, and that it stressed KLM's independent position and Schiphol's network quality.
No definitive answer can yet be given on changes to Transavia Nederland's governance structure, because these talks are still ongoing.
Over wijzigingen in de governancestructuur van Transavia Nederland is nog geen uitsluitsel te geven, omdat deze gesprekken nog lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over overlast onderhoud Afsluitdijk

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about traffic nuisance, accidents and queues caused by maintenance on the Afsluitdijk, including the coordination of bridge and lock operations. The minister answered in detail, describing the works, the accident audit and extra signage, and the information given to road and shipping users, but did not concede that the works had caused a clear rise in accidents or offer structural changes.
Based on current insights, I note that on the carriageway from Den Oever to Kornwerderzand, from 3 km before the works up to the works on the bridge, the number of accidents has increased.

Op basis van de huidige inzichten constateer ik dat op de rijbaan van Den Oever naar Kornwerderzand van 3 km voor de werkzaamheden tot aan de werkzaamheden op de brug het aantal ongevallen is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over de berichten “Werkgroep: “Haven Lauwersoog is gedoemd te verdwijnen” en “Haven Lauwerseach ferdwynt as polityk neat docht”

MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries asked the minister about reports that the Lauwersoog harbour is doomed, the state of the Westgat shipping channel and its economic effects, responsibilities for dredging, and an ongoing study. The minister disputes the doom conclusion, describes the silting and Rijkswaterstaat's responsibilities and planned studies, and promises to inform the House when the studies are finished.
I will inform you of the outcomes afterwards.
Ik zal u daarna over de uitkomsten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het artikel “AFM en DNB beletten innovatie in de financiële sector”

Opposition MP Aukje de Vries (VVD) asks whether the AFM and DNB impose extra conditions on Dutch financial firms beyond EU and Dutch rules, creating an uneven playing field for crowdfunding, investment firms and payment providers. Minister Dijsselbloem answers that supervisors may attach conditions to licences where justified and proportionate, notes ongoing crowdfunding rule changes and a planned relaxation of investment limits, and states he sees no unjustified distortion of the level playing field.
I have no indications that the AFM and DNB go further in these areas than strictly necessary and I therefore see no distortion of the level playing field.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de AFM en DNB op deze terreinen verder gaan dan strikt noodzakelijk en zie dan ook geen verstoring van het gelijke speelveld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht «Commissarissen zijn grote bemoeienis Dijsselbloem zat»

An MP asks the Finance Minister about reports that supervisory board members of state holdings resent the state's active shareholder role, and about related conflicts, the board's role, appointments and aviation expertise at Schiphol. The minister denies any real conflict, says the state's active shareholding is intended and that boards must weigh public interest, and gives general answers on appointments without giving detailed case figures.
We remain in discussion about how the cooperation with the supervisory boards is shaped.
Over de vormgeving van de samenwerking met de RvC's blijven we in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van 't Wout en Aukje de Vries over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over aanhoudende problemen bij EU-aanbesteden

MPs Van 't Wout and Aukje de Vries asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Finance about the European Court of Auditors' report on persistent EU public procurement problems, including errors in about 40% of audited projects and possible suspension of payments. The minister answered that the government shares the recommendations, pushes for stricter Commission enforcement, notes new EU procurement directives and REFIT simplification efforts, and is still exploring whether regional and local procurement rules can be excluded for EFRO and ESF projects.

The cabinet shares the recommendations of the European Court of Auditors and believes the European Commission should strictly and uniformly supervise compliance by member state authorities when spending EU funds.

Het kabinet deelt genoemde aanbevelingen van de Europese Rekenkamer en is van mening dat de Europese Commissie bij besteding van EU fondsen op strikte en uniforme wijze moet toezien op naleving door autoriteiten in lidstaten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Aukje de Vries over de verplichte roulatie van accountants en een mogelijke tegenstrijdigheid tussen de Europese Verordening EU/537/2014 en het wetsvoorstel Wijzigingswet financ

Omtzigt and Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister whether the Dutch Wijzigingswet financiële markten 2016 lacks transitional rules for audit firm rotation that the EU Regulation 537/2014 provides, and whether this creates a conflict with EU law and what consequences follow. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the EU Regulation applies directly, the Dutch rotation provision will not enter into force by royal decree, the AFM has a limited extension power in exceptional cases, and a separate letter will be sent to the House.

By royal decree it will be determined that article 23, part c, of the Wta, as well as the amendment to it in the Wijzigingswet Financiële Markten 2016, will not enter into force, so that for office rotation only the EU Regulation provisions apply.
Door middel van een koninklijk besluit zal worden bepaald dat artikel 23, onderdeel c, van de Wta, evenals de wijziging daarop in de Wijzigingswet Financiële Markten 2016, niet in werking zal treden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht “Huizenbezitters betalen te veel rente voor hun spaarhypotheek"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Van der Linde asked whether banks charging a risk surcharge on savings mortgages despite substantial savings balances overcharge homeowners, whether banks are transparent about this, and whether the AFM has investigated. The minister replied that the effect depends on savings balance and tax rate, that consumer information rules apply, and that the AFM has not studied risk surcharges structurally but has challenged a few providers on signals and will continue to hold providers to account where needed.
The AFM will also hold mortgage providers to account on this in the future, where necessary.
De AFM zal hypotheekverstrekkers hier – waar nodig – ook in de toekomst op aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het artikel “Laat kleine onderlinge verzekeraar niet verdwijnen”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a newspaper report that small mutual insurers face unsustainable regulation under Solvency II and Basic, and about the consequences for their survival and new entry. The minister acknowledged cost burdens, described the simplifications for small insurers, and explained why full reinsurance does not qualify for exemption while promising to inform parliament about the exemption regulation.
In my view, applying all requirements of Solvency II to all insurers can indeed be considered disproportionate and burdensome.
Naar mijn oordeel kan toepassing van alle eisen uit de richtlijn solvabiliteit II op alle verzekeraars inderdaad als niet proportioneel en knellend worden beschouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'OM hoeft Rabobank niet te vervolgen om Libor-fraude'

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether prosecutors could not pursue Rabobank staff in the LIBOR case because evidence gathering did not meet criminal procedure rules, and whether a new benchmark-manipulation offence would have enabled prosecution. The minister said the court's ruling in an individual case cannot be second-guessed, that prosecution of current staff was rightly dropped, that benchmark manipulation became punishable on 1 January 2015, and that the earlier lack of such an offence did not affect the outcome.
The cabinet cannot intervene in a judge's assessment in an individual case.
Het kabinet kan niet treden in het oordeel van een rechter in een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Schut-Welkzijn en Ziengs over het bericht “Negen manieren om je als zzp-er goedkoper te verzekeren”

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the disability insurance market for self-employed workers offers enough cheaper 'adapted' policies, whether rules or advice obligations block them, and whether the 13-week registration deadline for voluntary insurance should be extended. Minister Asscher replied that many options exist, that no legal barriers are known, that the AFM sees room for better advice, and that extending the deadline is not favoured because of adverse selection, promising to return to the issue after the IBO zzp.
In the context of the IBO zzp and the Weyenberg motion, I will return to the insurability of the disability risk.
In het kader van het IBO zzp en de motie Weyenberg 3 , zal ik terugkomen op de verzekerbaarheid van het arbeidsongeschiktheidsrisico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over het onderzoek naar het reilen en zeilen van de NS

VVD MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries asked whether law firm De Brauw, which investigated irregularities in the NS Limburg tender while also advising NS on challenging the ACM's findings, has a conflict of interest, and whether an independent body should take over the investigation. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that he sees no reason to doubt De Brauw's integrity, but agreed with the supervisory board that a second opinion on the Limburg investigation will be commissioned and that another firm will investigate the other tenders NS or its subsidiaries bid for.

To avoid any appearance of partiality and to rule out any doubt about the soundness of the investigations, I have agreed with the NS supervisory board that a researcher will be asked to give a second opinion

Om elke schijn van partijdigheid te vermijden en iedere twijfel over de gedegenheid van de onderzoeken uit te sluiten, heb ik met de raad van commissarissen van de NS afgesproken dat een onderzoeker wordt gevraagd een second opinion te geven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Van der Linde en Anne Mulder over bericht “proef flexwerkershypotheek uitgebreid”

VVD MPs asked whether the perspective-statement pilot for flexworkers and self-employed mortgage applicants should be broadened and made permanent, and whether mortgage rules should change. The Minister replied that the pilot falls within existing rules (Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet), that current rules already allow tailored assessments, and that no regulatory change is planned.
The approach taken with the perspective statement falls within the current possibilities of the Temporary Regulation on Mortgage Credit.
De gevolgde werkwijze met de perspectiefverklaring valt binnen de huidige mogelijkheden van de Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over het artikel “Stop met vissen in de Waddenzee”

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about a newspaper article calling for an end to fishing in the Wadden Sea, including whether that view fits the Rijke Waddenzee programme. The state secretary answered that fish stock trends show decline since the 1980s with causes still unclear, that sustainable fishing fits the Wadden Sea, and that fishers can add value, with measures being pursued via a fisheries strategy and existing agreements.
Through the development of a fisheries strategy, more insight should be gained into the necessary (trilateral) studies to fill the knowledge gaps.
Via de ontwikkeling van een visstrategie moet er meer zicht komen op de benodigde (trilaterale) onderzoeken om de kennislacunes op te vullen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Mei Li Vos, Visser en Aukje de Vries over de situatie bij Air France-KLM

MPs from the PvdA and VVD asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about the French state's increase of its stake in Air France-KLM, its double voting rights, possible break-up or sale of KLM, governance changes and Qatar landing rights. The minister replied that the French stake increase is not a fundamental shift, no agreement exists on joint share purchases, no break-up is on the agenda, and the reports of a 'plan B' sale are unsubstantiated speculation.
I have no indication whatsoever that such a plan B is on the agenda.
Ik heb geen enkele indicatie dat een dergelijk plan B aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht "Kleine verzekeraars vechten om voortbestaan"

An MP asked the Finance Minister about small insurers struggling to survive, including their cost burden, exits from the market, and whether supervision favours consolidation. The minister answered that Solvency II includes proportionate easing for small insurers, that exits are partly due to consolidation and portfolio transfers, and that small insurers remain valuable in a competitive market.
To limit supervisory costs as much as possible, easings have been introduced in the supervisory regime for small insurers, without endangering the enforcement of good supervision.

Teneinde de toezichtkosten zo veel mogelijk te beperken, zijn versoepelingen aangebracht in het toezichtregime voor kleine verzekeraars, overigens zonder de handhaving van goed toezicht in gevaar te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Aukje de Vries aover het artikel “Verzekeraar kansloos in concurrentie met het UWV”

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Aukje de Vries asked whether the unequal playing field between the UWV and private insurers under the WGA hybrid system, and the UWV's reassessment and independence practices, were acceptable. Minister Asscher answered that the government monitors the system, is analysing premium adjustments, and will inform parliament before the summer recess, but declined to answer nine questions in time for the scheduled debate.
At present I am examining whether and how the premium setting at the UWV can be adjusted to improve the balance in the hybrid market.
Op dit moment onderzoek ik of en op welke manier de premiestelling bij het UWV aangepast kan worden om zo het evenwicht op de hybride markt te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “AFM wil vaker namen kunnen noemen”

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether he supports the AFM's wish to name firms more often and to publish office-specific audit findings, and what powers the AFM wants. The minister agreed in principle to more transparency, noted the AFM already can publish findings, described planned legal changes (performance disclosure for pre-2013 investment insurance, sharing findings with audit clients, a 2017 amendment), and flagged confidentiality limits.
It is up to the supervisor to weigh, case by case, whether a confidentiality obligation or one of the aforementioned interests opposes the interest served by disclosure.

Het is aan de toezichthouder om van geval tot geval de afweging te maken of een geheimhoudingsverplichting of een van voornoemde belangen zich verzet tegen het belang dat met openbaarmaking is gediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht "Geschiktheidstoets accountantscommissaris pas in 2016"

Ms de Vries asked why suitability tests for supervisory board members of accountancy firms cannot take place before 2016, and whether this hinders the sector's voluntary quality improvements. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the AFM can only test trustworthiness now, that suitability criteria will be consulted before summer, and that establishing a supervisory body does not depend on the suitability test.
It is correct that members of already established supervisory boards have not been tested for suitability.
Het klopt dat leden van reeds ingestelde Raden van Commissarissen niet zijn getoetst op geschiktheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over regeldrift

MPs asked whether the government finds it acceptable that insurers demand extensive documents from employers before advising on pension schemes, given the aim to cut administrative burden. The minister says the Wft uses open norms, the AFM guidelines are not a checklist, the burden is hard to estimate and is not tracked, and the Actal study on financial-sector regulation will examine similar cases.
Because there are various ways to gather information from the client, the administrative burden arising from this cannot be reliably estimated.
Vanwege de verschillende mogelijkheden om informatie bij de klant in te winnen zijn de administratieve lasten die hieruit voortkomen niet goed in te schatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over het winnen van de aanbesteding in Limburg door Abellio

MPs De Vries and De Boer asked whether NS's subsidiary Abellio could bid in the Limburg public transport tender without being cross-subsidised and on a level playing field with commercial rivals, and how its return and finances fit NS's required return. The minister answers that the bid was discussed with the shareholder, meets NS's investment criteria, is market-conform in financing, and that NS does not report subsidiary-level returns publicly.
Providing insight into the return per business unit, subsidiary and participation could lead to a deterioration of NS's competitive and negotiating position.
Inzicht geven in het rendement per bedrijfsonderdeel, dochteronderneming en deelnemingen kan leiden tot een verslechtering van de concurrentie- en onderhandelingspositie van de NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht "ABN AMRO CFO: Nieuwe kapitaalbodems kunnen buffer hard raken"

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Finance Minister about a report that international supervisors plan capital floors per loan type that could hit Dutch banks' capital buffers, and about effects on mortgages, SME lending and securitisation. The minister answered that the Basel Committee is consulting on a new floor based on the standardised approach and a revised standardised approach, that effects depend on final design and are likely to raise risk-weighted assets for large Dutch banks, that the government will watch for disproportionate impacts, and that existing EU securitisation rules remain in force.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Aukje De Vries over het bericht dat justitiebanen verdwijnen in Leeuwarden en dat uitholling dreigt voor het Leeuwarder Gerechtshof

MPs Van Oosten and Aukje de Vries asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reports that justice jobs and services will leave Leeuwarden, weakening the Arnhem-Leeuwarden Court of Appeal, are accurate, and whether they would consult the Council for the Judiciary. The minister answered that he understands local concerns, but no decision has yet been made on the court's future accommodation, and the Council for the Judiciary will inform him soon.
However, there is currently no decision-making regarding the future accommodation needs of the court's organisational units.
Er is echter op dit moment geen sprake van besluitvorming over de toekomstige huisvestingsbehoefte van de organisatieonderdelen van het gerechtshof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over het bericht 'NS wil af van winkelvastgoed'

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about a report that NS (the state railway) wants to divest property and non-core retail, and about its consequences for the state's role as shareholder and concession grantor. The ministers answered that the divestments are gradual and market-driven, that they favour keeping station management in public hands with a regulatory role, and that the concession is unaffected, leaving much of the shareholder assessment to the shareholder itself.
It is mainly up to the shareholder to assess whether the strategy of the entire NS group is in line with the public interests of the railway.
Het is met name aan de aandeelhouder om te beoordelen of de strategie van het gehele NS-concern in lijn is met de publieke belangen van het spoor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over “Scheurtjes Kerncentrale Doel groter”

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether cracks in the reactor vessels of Belgian plants Doel 3 and Tihange 2 were larger than before, whether the Borssele plant had been checked with equally sensitive equipment, and whether Dutch regions had been informed. The minister confirmed larger hydrogen flakes were found after more sensitive testing, stated Borssele's 2013 tests used qualified equipment and that nuclear safety is a national responsibility, and said the plants are shut down so no new Dutch safety implications arise.
Nevertheless, the ANVS will continue to closely monitor developments in Belgium and other countries regarding hydrogen flakes.
Desondanks blijft de ANVS de ontwikkelingen in België en in andere landen omtrent waterstofvlokken nauwkeurig volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht «Dure bootpolis verrast ex-klanten Friesland Bank»

An MP asked the Finance Minister about consumers who were moved from Friesland Bank boat policies to more expensive Interpolis policies after the takeover, and whether they could switch immediately. The minister said about 80% of transferred policies became more expensive, that customers could terminate within 30 days or cancel at any time with one month's notice, and that stepping up premiums should not surprise clients.
In situations like this, customers must be clearly and timely informed in writing about increases in policy costs and about their options to switch.
Klanten moeten in dit soort situaties helder en tijdig schriftelijk worden geïnformeerd over stijgingen van de kosten van een polis en over hun mogelijkheden om over te stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de Aukje de Vries en Lodders over bankfinanciering in relatie tot muizenschade in Fryslân

MPs asked whether Deutsche Bank takes a stricter line than Rabobank toward farmers suffering vole damage in Fryslân, and whether the minister would raise this with Deutsche Bank and survey other banks' financing problems. The government answered that Deutsche Bank's affected client base is too small to show a specific policy, that complaints unrelated to its strategic reorientation must be filed by clients themselves, and that the State Secretary is consulting banks and regions and examining a guarantee scheme for residual hardship cases.

As I indicated in my letter of 29 January and as agreed with your House, I will continue to bring complaints that are the direct result of Deutsche Bank Nederland's strategic reorientation directly to the attention of its Management Board.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 29 januari jl. heb aangegeven en ook met uw Kamer heb afgesproken, zal ik klachten die het directe gevolg zijn van de strategische heroriëntatie van Deutsche Bank Nederland rechtstreeks onder de aandacht blijven brengen van de Raad van Bestuur van Deutsche Bank Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Afsluitdijk gaat dicht”

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked the minister why the Afsluitdijk must be closed for ten weekends, what alternatives were considered, what the impact on transport and public transport is, and how communication will be handled. The minister confirmed the closures are needed for heavy hoisting work on sluice complexes, that alternatives with more disruption were rejected, that public transport will not be affected, and that stakeholders will be consulted and informed in advance, though costs are unknown and the contractor selection is still pending.
It is not known what additional costs this will entail for motorists and the transport sector.
Het is niet bekend tot welke extra kosten dit leidt voor automobilisten en de transportsector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries, Geurts en De Rouwe over de toename, omvang en gevolgen van muizenschade in Friesland

MPs asked the state secretary about the growth and damage of mouse plagues in Friesland, the ban on ploughing grassland, the risk to dykes, and possible derogations from the Nitrates Directive action programme. The state secretary referred to earlier letters on most questions, said the ploughing ban rests on both environmental and agronomic considerations, and noted that nitrate levels in the affected area are well below the norm.
For the answer to these questions I refer you to my letter of 27 January 2015
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar mijn brief van 27 januari 2015
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Waddenfonds: versterking economie in Waddengebied blijft achter”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment why economic investment from the Wadden Fund lags behind, and how the 50% economy allocation agreed in the decentralisation accord is monitored and enforced. The minister answered that recent figures show economic allocations developing well, that the allocation split for 2012-2014 was 47/53 ecology/economy in ceilings and 56/44 in awards, that the provinces hold autonomous competence, and that no further action is planned.
The Wadden Fund was decentralised to the Wadden provinces in 2012. This means the Wadden provinces have been given the autonomous competence to spend the funds.
Het Waddenfonds is in 2012 gedecentraliseerd naar de Waddenprovincies. Dat betekent dat de Waddenprovincies de autonome bevoegdheid hebben gekregen om de middelen te besteden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over het bericht "Gebrek aan MKB-krediet remt groei Nederland"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Ziengs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about OECD and ECB findings that limited SME credit is slowing Dutch growth and about the effects of bank capital rules. The ministers answered that weakened SME finances and lower domestic demand explain falling credit, that DNB finds banks can meet the new rules under the baseline scenario, and that further measures will be reported.
The cabinet will inform the House shortly about the effects of the accumulation of regulation on the banking sector and credit provision.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer op korte termijn informeren over de effecten van de stapeling van regelgeving op de bancaire sector en de kredietverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje De Vries over het bericht over overboord geslagen containers boven Ameland

MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries asked about ten containers lost overboard near Ameland, their recovery, liability, follow-up on a 2010 inspection report on container lashing, and the frequency of losses. The minister answered that recovery is the owner's responsibility under Rijkswaterstaat supervision, that lashing enforcement continues within regular inspections, and that IMO work on container mass is nearing completion.
It is not customary to publicize details about the ship widely, so as to avoid negatively affecting the further cooperation of those involved.
Het is niet gebruikelijk gegevens over het schip breed bekend te maken om te voorkomen dat nadere medewerking van betrokkenen negatief kan worden beïnvloed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Vries en Van der Linde over het bericht ‘Eis Haagse politiek ontmoedigt vervroegd aflossen hypotheek’

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the planned 4% leverage ratio for systemically important banks would discourage early mortgage repayment by narrowing risk-based rate differences and raising mortgage rates. The minister rejected that premise, arguing the leverage ratio is designed alongside risk-weighted requirements, and said he does not expect banks to make early repayment less attractive or to cause substantial unwanted behaviour effects.
The cabinet's vision for the Dutch banking sector explicitly states that it pursues a higher leverage ratio of at least 4% in conjunction with the increase in risk-weighted capital requirements.

In de Kabinetsvisie Nederlandse bankensector is echter expliciet aangegeven dat het kabinet een hogere leverage ratio van minimaal 4% nastreeft in samenhang met de stijging van de risicogewogen kapitaaleisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Verheijen over het bericht “Controles op EU-subsidies moeten slimmer”

MPs Aukje de Vries and Verheijen asked the Finance Minister about the European Court of Auditors' call for mandatory Member State declarations and related calls for smarter EU subsidy controls. The Minister replied that Nederland supports a national declaration and will keep pushing for transparent accountability, noting an EU working group's final document, but gave no new binding commitments.
The Netherlands continues to work unremittingly towards good accountability for the European budget and supports a National Declaration.
Nederland blijft zich onverminderd inzetten om te komen tot een goede verantwoording over de Europese begroting en is voorstander van een Nationale Verklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het artikel ‘Banken vrezen ECB-toezicht’

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the ECB taking over bank supervision will raise risk weights on Dutch mortgages, forcing banks to hold billions more capital, and whether the ECB will properly weigh NHG and mortgage interest deduction. The minister replies that there are no signs the ECB intends to change risk weights, that DNB will stay closely involved, and that he sees no reason to take action.
There are currently no indications that the ECB would want to change the risk weighting of Dutch mortgages.
Er zijn op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat de ECB de risicoweging van Nederlandse hypotheken zou willen aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over uitzondering provisieverbod

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the proposed exception to the commission ban for mortgage clients in payment difficulties risks abuse, how terms like 'payment arrears' are defined, what conditions apply, whether double payment and AFM enforcement are addressed, and when the ban will be evaluated. The minister defends the open norm, states safeguards (inducement norm, transparency, AFM enforcement), and commits to evaluating the ban around 2017.
The commission ban was introduced to bring about a shift from product-driven sales to client-oriented advice.
Het provisieverbod is ingevoerd om een beweging te bewerkstelligen van productgedreven verkoop naar klantgerichte advisering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas en Aukje de Vries over crowdfunding

MPs Lucas and Aukje de Vries asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about crowdfunding: the platforms licensed or exempted by the AFM, the difference between licences and exemptions, legal certainty, barriers, EU rules, investor caps and the scope for equity crowdfunding. The minister answered at length, describing the AFM regime, the planned review of the supervisory framework, and monitoring, while stating that current caps and rules stay in place for now.
I intend, together with the AFM, DNB and EZ, to re-examine the current supervisory framework for crowdfunding and to investigate whether the current regulation can be better tailored to crowdfunding.

Ik ben daarnaast voornemens om, in samenwerking met de AFM, DNB en EZ, het huidige toezichtkader voor crowdfunding opnieuw onder de loep te nemen en te onderzoeken of de huidige regelgeving nog beter op crowdfunding kan worden toegesneden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van Oosten over het bericht "ING geeft adverteerder inzicht in klantgedrag

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about ING's plan to give advertisers insight into customers' payment behaviour and whether it fits privacy rules and the Dutch banks' data code. The minister answered that consent and purpose-limitation rules apply, that the plan's scope is unclear and banks must demonstrate compliance, and that the privacy regulator may investigate but no ruling was given.
It is not for me, nor for the State Secretary of Security and Justice, to rule on compatibility with the Code of Conduct or the Wbp.
Het is niet aan mij noch aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie om een uitspraak te doen over de verenigbaarheid met de Gedragscode of de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over extra eisen Nederlandse banken

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Netherlands can set a national leverage ratio above the EU baseline for Dutch banks, how this fits with the planned Single Rulebook and ECB supervision, and over what timeframe such a rise should occur. The minister answered that member states may set stricter leverage ratios until an EU-wide rule applies from 2018, that the government aims for at least 4% for systemically relevant banks by 2018, and that DNB will assess the banks' multi-year capital plans.
The starting point is that the Dutch systemic banks must have brought the leverage ratio to at least 4% by 2018 at the latest.
Het uitgangspunt is dat de Nederlandse systeembanken uiterlijk in 2018 de leverage ratio naar minimaal 4% hebben gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Aukje de Vries en Mei Li Vos over premieverhogingen van arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen voor ZZP’ers

MPs Ziengs, Aukje de Vries and Mei Li Vos asked about insurers raising disability insurance premiums for self-employed workers via en-bloc clauses, including questions on legal limits, complaint routes, switching options and AFM oversight. The minister answered that insurers must apply such clauses reasonably and sparingly, that the AFM and DNB oversee communication and solvency, and that the AFM will explore the product's cost-efficiency and en-bloc use.
The AFM will, from its product oversight and product development process supervision, start an exploration into the use of the en bloc clause in disability insurance.

In het licht hiervan zal de AFM vanuit het toezicht op producten – en productontwikkelingsproces (PPP) een verkenning starten naar het gebruik van de en bloc clausule bij arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rutte en Aukje de Vries over de monumentenstatus Bildtdijken

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the Bildtdijken should be designated a protected village view, whether the municipal council's opinion should be decisive, and whether protection would harm local businesses and employment. The minister said the decision awaits renewed consultation with the province and municipality, that the municipality already manages the area well, and that protection would not necessarily hinder the economy.
I am awaiting this consultation before I make a decision on the nomination.
Ik wacht dit overleg af alvorens ik een besluit neem over de voordracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas, Aukje de Vries, Jacobi en De Rouwe over het behoud van de monumentenstatus molen “Windlust”

MPs asked whether the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed had advised against keeping the monument status of the Windlust windmill in Burum after a 2012 fire, on what criteria, and why it differs from the Schultehuis in Meppel. The minister answered that the agency started a delisting procedure because 95% of the mill was destroyed, that the municipality advised retaining status, and that a final decision awaits the Raad voor Cultuur's advice.
I will make a final decision on the monument status after receiving both advices.
Ik neem een definitief besluit over de monumentenstatus nadat ik beide adviezen heb ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Aukje de Vries over het bericht over de visie van natuurclubs op het Waddengebied in relatie tot de Natuurwet

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about natuurclubs' call to prioritise nature over economy in the Wadden area and whether tourism and harbour development should remain possible there. The government replied that the Structuurvisie allows economic development within the nature-protection aim, that the Wadden area is already well protected, and that it will present a new Natuurwet proposal balancing economy and ecology.
I will soon present my proposals for the new Natuurwet.
Ik kom binnenkort met mijn voorstellen voor de nieuwe Natuurwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Neppérus en Aukje de Vries over de mogelijke dubbele bankenbelasting voor Nederlandse banken

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance what steps had been taken to prevent double bank taxation for Dutch banks, the progress of treaty talks with Germany, Belgium, Hungary, Slovakia and South Korea, and the practical results of the August 2012 amendment to the double taxation decree. The State Secretary answered that only the UK treaty had been concluded, that the other countries showed little or no interest in a bilateral arrangement, and that the unilateral relief in the decree had been used in practice only in relation to the UK.
Only in relation to the United Kingdom has the Decree been applied to avoid double bank taxation.
Alleen in relatie tot het Verenigd Koninkrijk is het Besluit toegepast om dubbele bankenbelasting te vermijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries (over het bericht tienduizenden huizen nog altijd onverkoopbaar door erfpacht

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked about reports that tens of thousands of homes on leasehold land remain unsaleable because banks refuse financing. The minister defends the banking guideline agreed between the notaries and the banks as self-regulation, says he will consult stakeholders shortly, and rules out bringing leasehold contracts under financial supervision or declaring the guideline generally binding.
I will shortly consult with the parties involved about the outcomes of this evaluation.
Ik zal op korte termijn in overleg treden met betrokken partijen over de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vries over het bericht bedrijven krijgen meer tijd voor overgang naar SEPA en goede doelen vrezen daling giften door langere IBAN-nummers

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that the SEPA migration deadline might be extended to 1 August 2014 and that charities fear fewer donations due to longer IBAN numbers. The minister answered that charities and banks are addressing the issue through the NFS working group, that the government will not use the member-state option to delay consumer migration, and that conversion services are only permitted until the deadline.
In my view, it is therefore not a given that the number of donations to charities will fall due to the longer 555 account number.
Mijns inziens is het daarom geen gegeven dat het aantal giften voor goededoelenorganisaties zal dalen door het langere 555 rekeningnummer.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde, Bosman en Aukje De Vries over het bericht dat de aanleg van glasvezel in Caribisch Nederland twee keer duurder is dan begroot en volledig door de Nederlandse belastingbetaler wo

MPs from the VVD asked why the Caribbean Netherlands submarine fibre cable cost roughly double its budget, why the state took on extra costs, and why it became a shareholding in SSCS B.V. without prior parliamentary approval. The minister replied that costs exceeded the original estimate by about EUR 8.9 million (not a doubling), that the extra funds covered redundancy and protection, that the shareholding was a transitional choice under the Comptabiliteitswet, and that the company is non-profit with cost-based tariffs.
With my letter of 9 December I aimed to align as closely as possible, albeit retrospectively, with the normal procedure of Article 34.
Met mijn brief van 9 december jl. heb ik beoogd zoveel mogelijk, zij het achteraf, aan te sluiten bij de normale procedure van artikel 34.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht "Europese accountantsregels wijken af van de Nederlandse wet"

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Finance how the Dutch audit rules on mandatory firm rotation and separation of audit and advisory differ from the EU accountancy agreement reached in December 2013. The minister explained the EU deal, noted the Dutch rules largely fit within it except the cooling-off period, and committed to report to parliament before the 2016 rotation deadline.
Once the European rules are definitively established, we will have to adopt national legislation to implement them.
Zodra de Europese regels definitief vaststaan, zullen we nationale regelgeving moeten vaststellen om deze te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over werelderfgoed Wadden

MPs Aukje de Vries and Ziengs asked the ministers about a Waddenvereniging report on opportunities from Wadden Sea World Heritage status, including tourism limits, whether the status added restrictions, and the tourism strategy. State Secretary Dijksma answered that the status adds no extra restrictions beyond existing law, pointed to promotion and a trilateral tourism strategy due at the February 2014 conference, and said the status did not itself impose new limits.
The World Heritage status in itself does not impose any additional restrictions or rules.
De werelderfgoedstatus op zich levert géén extra beperkingen of regels op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over toezicht en regels verzekeraars

MP Aukje de Vries asked the Finance Minister whether insurers' complaint that DNB supervision is too strict is valid, whether Dutch rules are the strictest in Europe, whether the Netherlands is ahead of Solvency II, whether DNB is stricter on the discount rate, and what the effects on investment and competitiveness are. The minister denied that Dutch rules are the strictest or that the Netherlands is alone in anticipating Solvency II, explained the planned tightening (a theoretical solvency criterion limiting dividends of life insurers) as giving DNB more tools, and said insurers will not invest less due to buffers.
With the theoretical solvency criterion, DNB will namely receive more tools to block dividend payments by life insurers if this should prove necessary.
Met het theoretische solvabiliteitscriterium krijgt DNB namelijk meer handvatten om dividenduitkeringen van levensverzekeraars tegen te houden indien dit nodig mocht zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over de inkrimping dienstregeling veerdienst Vlieland en Terschelling

MPs Aukje de Vries and De Boer asked about the planned winter reduction of ferry and fast-ferry sailings to Vlieland and Terschelling, the island councils' protest letter, and the transparency of Doeksen's finances. The state secretary said he is taking the matter seriously, will explore options with the island authorities, and has commissioned an external review whose conclusions are not yet final, while refusing to disclose the review's results and deferring to the independent Commissie Bootdiensten.
We will come back to this later this summer.
Later deze zomer zullen wij hierop terugkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Aukje de Vries over het artikel «Politiek verslikt zich in bezuinigingsoperatie auditfuncties»

MPs Van der Linde and Aukje de Vries asked the government whether a newspaper article about cuts to internal audit functions, including centralisation into the Auditdienst Rijk and reliance on external hiring, was accurate and how it fits the goal of efficiency. The minister rejected the claims of a duplication and monopoly, said the Auditdienst Rijk remains each department's internal audit function, and explained that framework contracts reduce external hiring costs while no new action is planned.
The Auditdienst Rijk is and remains the internal audit function of the individual departments.
De Auditdienst Rijk is en blijft de interne auditfunctie van de afzonderlijke departementen.
Antwoord vragen Aukje de Vries en Van der Steur over het bericht ‘Plan voor verkoop pingegevens winkels in ijskast na golf van kritiek’

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister and Justice State Secretary about Equens' plan to sell ping (debit card) payment data to shops, which was shelved after public criticism. The minister confirmed banks adhere to the data-processing code, that Equens acts as a processor bound by it, that the CBP supervises compliance, and that Equens has halted activities pending broad societal support.
Equens has indicated that the way it makes analyses and planned reports from the data it uses as processor amounts to processing data that are not, or no longer, personal data.

Equens heeft aangegeven dat de wijze waarop zij analyses en voorgenomen rapportages maakt van de door haar als bewerker gebruikte gegevens neerkomt op het verwerken van gegevens die niet of niet langer zijn aan te merken als persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over de veerbotenoorlog

MPs De Vries and De Boer asked about the ferry dispute between EVT and Doeksen on the Wadden islands routes, its long duration, the timing of the CBb court case, effects on service, the winter timetable and Doeksen's compensation request. The state secretary said the concession is not yet final so the ODC applies and competition is allowed, that a request for expedited court handling must come from the CBb, that a winter timetable proposal is under review with municipalities, and that compensation is premature.
That is why I have asked the CBb whether it wishes to submit a request to the European Court for expedited handling of the case.
Daarom heb ik het CBb gevraagd of zij een verzoek willen indienen bij het Europese Hof voor versnelde behandeling van de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Houwers, Bosman, Litjens, De Boer, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over ruimtelijke ordening op zee

VVD MPs asked the government for an overview of all plans, visions and directives touching on spatial planning at sea, their relationships, their national or EU origin, and the timing of answers before a committee debate. The minister answered that the National Water Plan and the North Sea policy note with the Integraal Beheerplan Noordzee form the integrated framework, described how EU directives are implemented nationally, and provided a schematic overview and a commitment to update the spatial framework in 2015.
The cabinet intends to adopt spatial protection measures for the seabed of the Friese Front and Centrale Oestergronden, to be reflected in the National Water Plan in 2015.
Het kabinet heeft het voornemen om ruimtelijke beschermingsmaatregelen te nemen voor de bodem van het Friese Front en Centrale Oestergronden, die neerslaan in het Nationaal Waterplan in 2015.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over verplichte roulatie voor accountants

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the Netherlands' domestic rules on mandatory audit-firm rotation and separation of audit and advisory services are consistent with the European Parliament legal committee's vote, and whether the evaluation should be brought forward. The minister answers that EU negotiations are ongoing, the Dutch measures already reflect the Commission proposal, and the Dutch rules will be adjusted if they conflict with EU rules, with a progress letter promised before summer recess.
I have indicated that if a conflict arose between Dutch and European regulation, we would of course have to adjust the relevant legislation.
Daarbij heb ik aangegeven, dat wanneer er strijdigheid zou ontstaan tussen de Nederlandse en de Europese regelgeving we de betreffende wetgeving uiteraard zullen moeten aanpassen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosman, Litjens, en Aukje de Vries over mosselkweek en natuur op de Waddenzee

MPs Bosman, Litjens and Aukje de Vries asked about the Produs research on mussel farming and Wadden Sea nature, including the withdrawn press release and whether mussel seed fishing should continue until harm is proven. The state secretary said the findings will feed into the convenant evaluation due spring 2014, that the government will not prejudge policy decisions, and that a spring fishing permit was granted on 7 May.
I want to give the covenant parties the room to reach agreements based on the evaluation.
Ik wil de convenantspartijen de ruimte geven om op basis van de evaluatie tot afspraken te komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht “ING-top: salarissen moeten omhoog”

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that ING's board wanted higher pay for its top executives and that fixed salaries for staff rose 9% after bonuses were abolished under the state-aid bonus ban. The minister answered that Dutch executive pay is below the European median but that pay should not rise given sector challenges, that ING's board proposed no raise for current executives, and that a fixed-pay increase is legally allowed under the bonus ban.
This does not mean, however, that pay in the Netherlands should go up.
Dit betekent echter niet dat de beloningen in Nederland omhoog zouden moeten.
Antwoord vragen Dijkhoff en Aukje de Vries over het bericht banken te laks met de aanpak van cybercrime

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Finance about a report that banks were too lax in tackling cybercrime, questioning the banks' cooperation and the value of a working group. The ministers replied that cooperation is good, fraud fell 60% in late 2012, banks will place a liaison at the NCSC, and a mandatory breach-notification law is being prepared.
Given the seriousness of the cybercrime threat, a still greater effort than is already being made must be delivered across the board, including by the banking sector.
Gezien de ernst van de dreiging van cybercrime moet evenwel over de hele linie een nog grotere inspanning dan nu al het geval is worden geleverd, ook door de bancaire sector.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Klant nog geen koning met het provisieverbod'

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the 2013 commission ban has really benefited consumers, given reports of costly service subscriptions and unclear charges on annuities, and whether the ban is being implemented in line with its purpose. The minister rejected the conclusion that consumers have gained little, pointed to greater cost transparency, promised a standardised service document from July 2013, and said the AFM monitors implementation closely.
That is why I am closely monitoring developments, and the AFM is intensively monitoring the implementation of the commission ban.
Daarom houd ik de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet in de gaten en monitort de AFM de uitvoering van het provisieverbod intensief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Visser over het bericht «Huiseigenaren richten hun woede op bankdirecteuren»

MPs De Vries and Visser asked whether banks are earning excess profits on mortgages, why Dutch mortgage rates exceed those in neighbouring countries, and whether more competition or transparency is needed. The minister says he awaits the NMa's update on mortgage margins, notes structural differences that make cross-country comparison difficult, and points to transparency measures and lifting ING's price-leadership ban as steps toward more competition.
I do not have this insight, so I cannot give you this explanation.
Dit inzicht heb ik niet, waardoor ik u deze toelichting niet kan geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Jacobi en Van der Steur en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Openbaar Ministerie verlaat Leeuwarden’

MPs asked whether the Public Prosecution Service (OM) is leaving Leeuwarden for Groningen, what that means for Leeuwarden as a justice city, and whether Friesland was promised anything to protect jobs. The minister answered that Leeuwarden remains a full justice city with OM workplaces, that the regional ZSM and local cooperation are secured, and that no specific commitments were made to Leeuwarden or Friesland beyond attention to employment effects.
No commitments have been made to Leeuwarden and Friesland.
Er zijn geen toezeggingen gedaan aan Leeuwarden en Friesland.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Flach over het bericht: ‘Servische regering treitert buitenlandse supermarkten, Ahold Delhaize gaat winkels sluiten’

SGP MPs Stoffer and Flach asked whether Ahold Delhaize closed 25 stores in Serbia due to a retail margin cap, whether the measure breaches the internal market and the Stabilisation and Association Agreement, and what the government will do. The Staatssecretaris answered that the Netherlands has raised concerns repeatedly with Serbian ministers, judges the measure market-distorting and at odds with EU accession criteria, and has asked the Commission to raise it, but did not commit to any formal sanction.
The cabinet considers the measure market-distorting and believes it is at odds with the economic criteria for EU accession.
Het kabinet acht de maatregel marktverstorend en is van mening dat deze op gespannen voet staat met de economische criteria bij EU-toetreding
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over levering militair materieel aan Indonesische marine

An MP asked the State Secretary whether arms exports to the Indonesian navy, which reportedly played a role in human rights abuses in West Papua, should be reconsidered, and raised questions on drones and dual-use licences. The government answered that no clear risk of use for serious human rights violations was found for the licences granted, that existing export policy suffices, and that it does not intend to reassess current licences.

To arrive at a negative assessment there must be a clear risk that the specific item to be exported will be used by the end user to commit serious violations of human rights or international humanitarian law.

Om te komen tot een negatieve toetsing moet sprake zijn van een duidelijk risico dat specifiek het uit te voeren goed door de eindgebruiker gebruikt wordt voor het begaan van ernstige schendingen van de mensenrechten of van het humanitair oorlogsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het Commissiedebat Raad Buitenlandse Zaken Handel van 19 november

An MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs to reconsider refusing compensation for the Dutch pig sector hit by Chinese anti-dumping duties, and to list sectors where compensation was similarly withheld. The government replied that it will not compensate affected firms, cites EU trade-defence tools and WTO routes, and says it will keep raising the issue with China and the Commission.
This does not change that the cabinet will not proceed with compensatory measures for this or other sectors affected by anti-dumping or anti-subsidy duties.
Dit laat onverlet dat het kabinet niet overgaat tot compenserende maatregelen voor deze of andere sectoren die te maken krijgen met antidumping of antisubsidie heffingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het artikel ‘Nederlandse mijnbouwer verzweeg miljardenomzet voor Congolese staat’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs whether a criminal investigation exists into Dutch subsidiaries of ERG over possible bribery or sanctions violations, whether the government has discussed the matter with Kazakhstan, and how supervisors, FIOD/OM capacity, Congo mining transparency and conflict-mineral rules are configured. The government declined to comment on individual cases or criminal investigations, referred to existing supervisory, capacity and anti-corruption measures, and promised no specific new action.
The cabinet does not comment on individual cases or the content of any criminal investigations.
Het kabinet gaat niet in op individuele gevallen of de inhoud van eventuele strafrechtelijke onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de herziening van het beleid voor het klachtenmechanisme van FMO

The MP asks the State Secretary about the revision of FMO's independent complaints mechanism policy, its purpose, and the role of the expert panel. The State Secretary answers that FMO is responsible for the revision, the aim is to strengthen the mechanism in line with best practice, and the panel's views were taken into account while the policy is not yet finalised.
FMO is at arm's length from the State and, together with DEG and Proparco, is itself responsible for the independent complaints mechanism and its revision.
FMO staat op afstand van de Staat en is, samen met DEG en Proparco, zelf verantwoordelijk voor het onafhankelijke klachtenmechanisme en de herziening hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over polariserende advertenties van Oxfam Novib

Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Foreign Affairs state secretary whether a government-subsidised organisation should label six parliamentary parties as racists or fascists in an Oxfam Novib advertisement, and how the ministry ensures subsidies are not used for partisan or polarising purposes. The state secretary said such language is not constructive but that civil society may criticise policy, that the campaign was crowdfunded and separate from subsidised projects, and that the ministry monitors projects and would reclaim any subsidy used for unagreed purposes.
The ministry actively monitors the implementation of projects throughout their duration.
Het ministerie monitort de uitvoering van projecten actief gedurende de looptijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Dobbe over het artikel 'De schade van Schoof, Nederlands geld voor bijna 3.200 ontwikkelingsprojecten stopt dit jaar'

MPs Hirsch and Dobbe asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about an Investico report that about 3,200 development projects face funding cuts after the Versterking Maatschappelijk Middenveld framework ends in December 2025, including child labour projects and delays in access to the new Focus framework. The State Secretary rejects the claim that projects are being stopped, says the new framework starts in the first half of 2026 with EUR 600 million available, and states no extension with extra budget will be provided, while noting the government will not implement a motion for a transitional scheme.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dijk over signalen dat een grote groep mensen ten onrechte een brief heeft ontvangen van de IND waarin wordt aangegeven dat zij geen rechtmatig verblijf zouden hebben in Nede

MPs Van Nispen and Dijk asked why Dienst Toeslagen sent letters stopping allowances based on IND residence codes, causing distress and wrongful loss of benefits for some EU citizens, and asked about compensation, legal aid and prevention. The government admits a system design error, says about 800 letters were sent with 180 later reinstated, and defends the approach while promising to reinstate and not claw back benefits where residence is confirmed.
The cabinet finds it highly undesirable that persons who are not lawfully residing in the Netherlands and therefore have no entitlement to allowances receive them.
Het kabinet vindt het zeer onwenselijk dat personen niet rechtmatig in Nederland verblijven en dus geen recht hebben op toeslagen deze ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over ombouwen van onzelfstandige studentenkamers

The MP asks whether private landlords are converting shared student rooms into studios, whether studio rents are lower net of rent allowance, and why rent allowance is unavailable for shared rooms, plus related questions on welfare and eligibility. The minister acknowledges signals of conversion but lacks national data, says shared rooms should be preserved for welfare and cost reasons, and explains that rent allowance for shared rooms is blocked by missing BAG registration and budget costs, with an ongoing study of a rental register and a promised letter on new shared-room housing.
I am of the view that shared (non-self-contained) units must be realised and preserved.
Ik ben van mening dat onzelfstandige eenheden moeten worden gerealiseerd en behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stultiens en Inge van Dijk over het artikel ‘Herstel toeslagenaffaire dreigt ongekende strop te worden: nog 5 miljard extra’

MPs Stultiens and Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about a report that the childcare benefits scandal recovery could cost an extra 5 billion euros, requesting a breakdown of costs, funding and the reasons for higher compensation under one recovery route. The State Secretary largely deferred answers to a forthcoming letter and evaluation of the new damage route pilot, saying the 5 billion figure is not fixed and that the precise answers could not yet be given.
As previously reported to the House of Representatives, a cabinet decision will soon be taken based on an evaluation of the pilot of this new damage route.
Zoals eerder gemeld aan de Tweede Kamer zal op basis van een evaluatie van de pilot van deze nieuwe schaderoute binnenkort een kabinetsbesluit worden genomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over de berichten '5G knokt om bandbreedte met levensreddend satellietstation voor schepen' en 'Reders bezorgd over ontmantelen Burum'

MPs Weverling, Remco Dijkstra and Aukje de Vries asked about reports on 5G interference with Inmarsat's Burum satellite station used for maritime emergency communications and on the station's possible dismantling, asking about consultations, alternatives, and timelines. The minister answered that an October 2023 agreement with Inmarsat to migrate emergency-traffic services to Greece secures maritime safety, while noting delays in answering and that no consultation with the province or municipality occurred.

Due to the agreement with Inmarsat, emergency, urgency and safety traffic is secured and there are no longer doubts about whether the Netherlands can sufficiently fulfil its obligations for maritime safety under international treaties.

Door de overeenstemming met Inmarsat is het nood-, spoed- en veiligheidsverkeer geborgd en zijn er geen twijfels meer over de vraag of Nederland de verplichtingen voor de veiligheid op zee onder de internationale verdragen voldoende kan uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dijk over barrières voor sociaal advocaten om toeslagenouders juridisch bij te staan
