SP MPs asked the government why the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand reverted the temporary 0.5 unit weighting for childcare-benefit (toeslagen) cases, lowering the number of parents each lawyer can help, and raised concerns about information withholding, procedural obstacles and the position of children in the restoration scheme. The State Secretary answered that the reversion restores standard policy now that the restoration workload has started, that information sharing has been improved, and that no new independent route for children before the Commissie Werkelijke Schade is planned.
It is not desirable that a different quality standard is applied to the assistance of affected parents than to regular cases.
Het is niet wenselijk dat er voor de bijstand van gedupeerde ouders een andere kwaliteitsstandaard wordt gehanteerd dan voor reguliere zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Brekelmans en Van Eijk over het bericht ‘Kabinet moet alerter zijn op spionage met Chinese scanners bij douane’

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government should reconsider using Nuctech scanners at Dutch customs given espionage risks, and why Nuctech has not been excluded as other countries did. The state secretary answered that a TNO-led study found current use does not endanger national security, that a retest is underway because of planned algorithm integration, and that the government will share results around summer recess.
The conclusions of the TNO-led study were submitted to the House of Representatives on a confidential basis.
De conclusies van het onderzoek onder regie van TNO zijn vertrouwelijk aangeboden aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Dijk over het bericht 'Schadeproces toeslagenaffaire volledig op de schop: 'Het is bij de wilde konijnen af''

MPs Inge van Dijk (CDA) and Dijk (SP) asked whether the Commission Werkelijke Schade is reinventing its damage-assessment process for Toeslagenaffaire victims, whether closed cases will be reviewed, and why this was not raised in the parliamentary debate, and asked for a letter within a week. The State Secretary says CWS was asked for a plan on capacity, treatment of parents and backlogs, that CWS denies reviewing closed cases, and that he will inform the House on the final plan as soon as possible after discussing it with CWS, though not within the week.
I will discuss this plan with CWS. Any additional actions that follow from it I will share with your House at the same time as the plan.
Dit plan bespreek ik met CWS. Eventuele aanvullende acties die hieruit volgen, deel ik gelijktijdig met het plan met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Jimmy Dijk over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Amsterdam, nr. AMS 23/2601 van 5 februari 2024

MPs Inge van Dijk (CDA) and Jimmy Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Rotterdam... no: an Amsterdam district court ruling that waived the notarial deed requirement for an informal debt of a childcare-benefit victim, and whether the government will appeal and change the law. The State Secretary answered that the ruling is exceptional, that the court's evidence of overdue amounts is not in line with the Wht, that no appeal will be lodged for this case, and that no legislative change is needed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga, Palmen-Schlangen en Omtzigt over een advies van de landsadvocaat

MPs Idsinga, Palmen-Schlangen and Omtzigt asked why the landsadvocaat's advice on the childcare benefits affair was released late, what changed between two versions of the letter, and how the 'Heidi' logging system worked, when it breached GDPR and how it linked to the Fraud Signalling Facility. The State Secretaries answered that the version was not final, explained Heidi's purpose and its suspension in 2017 and December 2023, and promised a further letter within three weeks on wider Tax Authority use of Heidi.
Your House will be informed within 3 weeks at the latest about how other parts of the Tax and Customs Administration used Heidi, for what purposes and which data were processed.
Uw Kamer wordt uiterlijk over 3 weken geïnformeerd over hoe andere onderdelen van de Belastingdienst gebruik hebben gemaakt van Heidi, voor welke doeleinde en welke gegevens hierbij verwerkt werden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Belastingdienst blijft wet overtreden met mogelijk discriminerende fraude-algoritmen'

The MP asks why the Tax Authority kept using fraud risk models (OBCF, ABN, OB Negatief) that may breach the GDPR, whether they discriminate, and how public trust can be restored. The State Secretary replies that the models were reactivated after a risk assessment, that some were modified and will get impact assessments and transparency registration, and that discrimination checks and monitoring are in place, but gives no firm date or stop for OB Negatief.
The OB Negatief model will be given a data protection impact assessment, and the models are to be entered in the Tax Authority's algorithm register to promote transparency.
Het model OB Negatief wordt voorzien van een GEB en van de modellen wordt voorzien dat zij in het algoritmeregister van de Belastingdienst worden opgenomen ter bevordering van de transparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palmen en Idsinga over het artikel 'Aantal huishoudens met schulden door toeslagen in vijf jaar verdubbeld'

Two MPs asked the government about a news report that the number of households with problematic debts from childcare and other benefit allowances (toeslagen) doubled in five years, and about the causes, support for affected households, and the future of the allowance system. The State Secretary answered that the rise is mainly due to the pause in toeslag debt collection during COVID and to rising allowance payments, outlined support measures and the upcoming final report on the future of the system, and declined to give a firm timetable for quick fixes.
The cabinet has announced that from 2025 the 27-year age limit for first-degree blood relatives in the allowance partnership will be abolished.
Het kabinet heeft aangekondigd om per 2025 de 27-jaarsgrens voor eerstegraadsbloedverwanten in het toeslagpartnerschap af te schaffen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de brief van 13 december 2023 over uitvoering van de motie Inge van Dijk c.s. over met het oog op herstel, rust, stabiliteit, voortgang en een vertrouwd gezicht waarborge

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether a cabinet collapse threatens continuity in the childcare benefits scandal recovery operation, and why the government relies on steering delivery rather than structural guarantees, given complaints about delays and ouders going to court. The government answers that cabinet changes cause no delay, that the parents' committee and IBTD serve as signalling continuity guardians, and that it is exploring strengthening the chair's role, without yet committing to concrete measures.
As indicated, the cabinet sees it as a fruitful option to talk with the chair of the parents' committee about strengthening his role.
Zoals aangegeven ziet het kabinet het als een vruchtbare optie om met de voorzitter van de oudercommissie in gesprek te gaan over het versterken van zijn rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over deafhandeling van het toeslagenschandaal

MP Temmink (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the handling of the childcare benefits scandal, including implementation of two adopted motions, the 31 December 2023 registration deadline, DUO debts of children, compensation practices, and municipal support tasks. The State Secretary answered that letters on the motions were sent alongside the answers, gave figures on ex-gratia and integral assessment participation, explained the municipal support framework, and said compensation is fully paid for wrongly reclaimed amounts while the 30% amount for strict-liability/intent qualifications is a compensation for indirect harm rather than mitigation.
At the same time as answering these questions, a letter was sent to your House addressing this.
Tegelijkertijd met de beantwoording van deze vragen is een brief aan uw Kamer verstuurd waarin hierop wordt ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de kinderopvangtoeslag

MP Van Haga asks whether the CBS's new energy-price method distorts inflation figures, making childcare allowances inadequate, and whether rising personnel costs and wage-price spirals in childcare are addressed. Minister Van Gennip replies that the method change has negligible effect on the 2024 maximum hourly rates, that the indexation system deliberately avoids a wage-price spiral, and that childcare tariffs and use are monitored.
The picture that the childcare allowance is therefore inadequate for parents with children in childcare is not one I share.
Het beeld dat de kinderopvangtoeslag voor ouders met kinderen op de kinderopvang daardoor ontoereikend is, deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Paulusma over het bericht '4 op de 10 mensen met laag inkomen verwachten problemen met betalen van zorgverzekering

MPs Kat and Paulusma asked the government about reports that many low-income people expect trouble paying health insurance premiums, rising premiums, unused healthcare allowance, and access to municipal collective health insurance. The minister acknowledged the concerns, gave premium and take-up figures, and listed existing and planned measures, without committing to new structural steps beyond monitoring and ongoing policy.
I will keep a close eye on the situation.
Ik blijf vinger aan de pols houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over meldingen van gedupeerden in het toeslagenschandaal

MP Temmink asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that some municipalities ask children of victims of the childcare benefits scandal to account for their compensation money, refuse broad support to parents who do not enter debt assistance, and reject applications for co-residing persons. The State Secretary answers that no such accountability is required, that broad support has no preconditions though advice to seek debt help may be given, that municipalities bear responsibility for case-by-case design and SPUK accountability, and that the VNG offers support to municipalities.
There is no obligation for victimised parents or children to account to municipalities for how they spent compensation money as a condition for access to broad support.
Er is geen verplichting voor gedupeerde ouders of kinderen om verantwoording aan gemeenten af te leggen over besteding van compensatiegeld als voorwaarde voor de toegang tot brede ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over mogelijke spionage via Chinese röntgencamera’s voor de douane

Two MPs asked whether Chinese X-ray scanners from Nuctech used by Dutch customs pose espionage risks, citing a Belgian ruling allowing exclusion of the supplier and US/Canadian warnings. The state secretary answered that Dutch procurement law does not allow excluding an EU-established supplier that meets requirements, that national security tools and stricter security requirements are applied, and that the government will explore reducing dependence on a single supplier and coordinate with European customs.
Under the Public Procurement Act 2012 it is not possible to exclude a supplier established in the European Union that meets the stated requirements and conditions.
Op basis van de Aanbestedingswet 2012 is het niet mogelijk om een (in de Europese Unie gevestigde) leverancier, die wel aan de gestelde eisen en voorwaarden voldoet, uit te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski, Gündoğan en Brekelmans over het bericht 'België verbiedt aankoop van Chinese röntgencamera’s voor de douane, Nederland (nog) niet'

MPs Rajkowski, Gündoğan and Brekelmans asked whether Dutch customs should stop using Chinese Nuctech scanners after Belgium's Council of State upheld exclusion of Nuctech from a tender, and whether this and EU and intelligence warnings should prompt a rethink. The state secretary answered that about 70 of roughly 100 customs scanners are Nuctech, that national security is not currently endangered under a TNO study, that procurement law limits exclusion of EU suppliers, and that stricter security requirements, a supplier-diversification effort and further research are underway.

The first part of the study indicated that national security is currently not endangered if the confidentiality, integrity or availability of the customs scan and detection processes is not compromised.

In het eerste deel van het onderzoek is aangegeven dat de nationale veiligheid op dit moment niet in gevaar komt als de vertrouwelijkheid, integriteit of beschikbaarheid van scan- en detectieprocessen van de Douane worden aangetast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sahla over kinderopvang voor kinderen van ouders met een ernstige ziekte

An MP asks the minister why childcare support for children of parents with serious illness such as cancer differs between municipalities, and whether a national minimum should apply. The minister answers that municipalities have policy freedom under the SMI scheme, that differences will be discussed with the VNG, and that a future cabinet should decide on wider childcare reform.
Municipalities are responsible for implementing SMI and have policy freedom in doing so.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van SMI en hebben daarbij beleidsvrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over de aankomende alternatieve behandeling van werkelijke schade in het toeslagenschandaal

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the forthcoming alternative route for actual damages in the childcare benefits scandal, including whether forfait amounts risk undercompensation, the Council of State's warnings on outsourcing, and the role of external parties. The State Secretary answered that a pilot starts this autumn with results due in a progress report, that forfait amounts are validated by experts with the option of individual assessment by the CWS, and that outsourcing has proven workable.
This autumn a pilot for this route will be started.
Dit najaar wordt gestart met een proef voor deze route.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over opnieuw een rechtszaak van een gedupeerde vanwege uitblijvende beslissing van de herstelorganisatie UHT van de Belastingdienst

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Finance why the Belastingdienst's childcare benefits restoration body (UHT) only engaged with a parent after a lawsuit was filed, why the state's lawyer was used, and what the restoration costs are including mediation, penalty payments and legal fees. The government answers that it does not comment on pending lawsuits, says parents' lawsuits are regrettable, gives partial cost figures (penalty payments over 25 million euros, mediation about 38.5 million euros over three years, legal representation about 300,000 euros) and states that not all costs can be separated out.
Before answering this question and the following ones, it is noted that the policy is not to comment on individual pending lawsuits.
Voorafgaand aan de beantwoording van deze vraag en de volgende vragen wordt opgemerkt dat het beleid is om niet in te gaan op individuele lopende rechtszaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het niet juist vaststellen van partnerschap door de Dienst Toeslagen, naar aanleiding van WOO-verzoek 2022.14

The MP asks how often invalids in the TVS system occurred, why they are rising, how they lead to reclaims, what the government did to warn citizens and inform parliament, and how it works to reduce them. The State Secretary explains invalids stem from technical processing errors due to system volume and complexity, that reclaims can follow, that detailed figures on affected citizens are not available, and that a team works on reducing them.
Specifically about the technical details of invalids, your House has not been informed.
Specifiek over de technische details van invalids is uw Kamer niet geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Den Haan over deelname aan het arbeidsproces wordt in sommige gevallen moeilijk gemaakt voor gepensioneerden c.q. AOW-gerechtigden

An MP asks whether working should pay for pensioners who want to keep working and whether the five-year administrative expiry rule for chained temporary contracts should be relaxed for them. The minister says work should pay, that information campaigns will start, that a structural fix is being sought for a benefit overlap affecting breadwinners rather than pensioners, and that no separate exemption or further study is planned beyond the existing SEO evaluation.
The cabinet believes that work must pay, including for AOW recipients.
Het kabinet vindt dat werken moet lonen, zo ook voor AOW-gerechtigden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over drugs per post

An MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers about drugs sent by post, including a joint police-customs team, cooperation with post and courier firms, an e-learning and a barrier model, and possible liability for companies. The government reports a new joint team (HARP), no registration of seized hard drugs per company, a barrier model ready, no need now for corporate criminal liability, and country data on seizures.
No, that is not known because no registration takes place per courier company.
Nee, dat is niet bekend omdat er geen registratie plaatsvindt per koeriersbedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder het niveau van een bijstandsuitkering omdat de regelingen niet op elkaar aansluiten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the government about thousands of households living below the social assistance level because income schemes do not align, asking for structural fixes, the effects of the double general tax credit reduction, and compensation options. The ministers answered that a structural solution is urgently needed, that options are being explored with a report due before June 2023, and that the answers include detailed budget and income calculations for example households.
As promised in the letter of 29 March, we will inform the House before June 2023 about progress in searching for solution directions.
Zoals toegezegd in de brief van 29 maart 1 zullen wij de Kamer vóór juni 2023 informeren over de vorderingen van het zoeken naar oplossingsrichtingen.

Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uitspraak op 14 april 2023 van de Rechtbank Midden-Nederland waarin een nadere beslistermijn voor alle zaken bij de Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen (UHT) tot juli

An MP asks the State Secretary for Finance and the Minister for Legal Protection whether a court ruling postponing UHT's decision deadline to July 2024 undermines access to justice and rule of law under the Constitution and ECHR, and about the state's appeal, dossier delays and court–government consultation. The government replies that legal protection remains available, that the ruling does not block access to court, that it has appealed the ruling, and that a delayed UHT decision is not a constitutional violation; it declines to give some detail on dossiers and says it will share consultation minutes.
Parents retain unchanged the right to file an appeal for failure to decide in time.
Ouders hebben onveranderd het recht een beroep niet-tijdig beslissen in te dienen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de berichten 'Stel uit Nijverdal krijgt gelijk van rechter: Staat handelde onrechtmatig jegens slachtoffers toeslagenaffaire' en 'Na de klap in Almelo krijgt belastingdie

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about two civil court rulings finding the State acted unlawfully toward parents in the childcare benefits scandal, and about their consequences for compensation. The government confirmed the rulings, said it will acknowledge unlawful conduct in similar pending cases, and stated the rulings do not change the Hersteloperatie compensation framework, while promising continued review of faster supplementary compensation.
The State will therefore, for these and similar future cases, acknowledge the unlawfulness of the decision.
De Staat zal voor deze en soortgelijke toekomstige zaken dan ook de onrechtmatigheid van het besluit erkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de recente rechterlijke uitspraken aangaande het toeslagenschandaal en het verzoek niet in hoger beroep te gaan

MP Leijten asked the State Secretary of Finance about court rulings finding the state liable in the childcare benefits scandal, the decision not to appeal, the Landsadvocaat's arguments, and delays in the restoration operation. The State Secretary accepts liability following the Rotterdam ruling, does not appeal the Overijssel ruling (but will contest it in future cases outside the compensated years), and says efforts to speed up compensation continue.
The State agrees with the ruling of the Rotterdam court and thereby acknowledges liability for decisions for which the UHT has provided compensation.
De Staat verenigt zich met het oordeel van de rechtbank Rotterdam en erkent daarmee de aansprakelijkheid voor besluiten waarvoor de UHT compensatie heeft geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over uitspraken van de rechter over de hersteloperatie en het feit dat de rechter vastgesteld heeft dat de staat onrechtmatig gehandeld heeft

MP Omtzigt asks why the cabinet has not acted on the 2019 motion recognising unlawful conduct in the childcare benefits affair, and how court rulings finding the state liable affect compensation. The State secretary says compensation does not require establishing unlawfulness, the State will not contest individual liability in these cases, and it will pursue fuller compensation while appeals on deadlines continue.
It has always been the intention to compensate these and other affected parents.
Het is altijd de intentie geweest om deze en ook andere gedupeerde ouders schadeloos te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Rechtszaak over trage besluitvorming herstel toeslagenaffaire'

CDA MP Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about pending lawsuits against the Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen over slow decision-making on compensation for childcare-benefit scandal victims, and whether the court's ruling would lead to process or legislative changes. The State Secretary reported 35 substantive appeals and 1,118 non-decision appeals, said a government reaction would follow in the next progress report, and said any changes would depend on the ruling.
I find it valuable that the court gave the opportunity during the hearing to clarify the dilemmas involved in not being able to decide on applications and objections on time.

Ik vind het waardevol dat de rechtbank de gelegenheid heeft geboden om ter zitting de dilemma's toe te lichten die verbonden zijn aan het niet tijdig kunnen beslissen op aanvragen en bezwaarschriften.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Marijnissen Grinwis, Palland, Kathmann, Teunissen, Pouw-Verweij, Stoffer, Van der Plas, Van Haga en Den Haan over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder h

MPs asked the government how couples on social assistance and single-earner households with disability benefits can end up with less net income plus allowances than a benefit couple, and what will be done after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the undesirable outcome and roughly 10,000 affected households, but offered no finished fix, only options under study and no compensation decision yet.
We want to do everything we can to find a solution to this.
We willen er alles aan doen om hier een oplossing voor te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving over de Uitvoeringsorganisatie hersteloperatie toeslagen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen risks stalling, including questions on process failures, an alleged fear culture, staffing, compensation for delays and possible sanctions. The government answered that the work is complex but progressing with acceleration measures, that staff can report concerns through established channels, that it sees no grounds for sanctions or replacing leadership, and that it will not bring in external experts or offer compensation for delay at this stage.
The status of the Tax Administration and Childcare Benefits Service, as well as of other implementing organisations, is reported regularly in the annual plans and annual reports.
Over de stand van zaken binnen de Belastingdienst en Toeslagen, maar ook binnen andere uitvoeringsorganisaties, wordt regulier gerapporteerd in de Jaarplannen en Jaarverslagen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Compensatie ouders toeslagenaffaire kan zomaar tot 2030 duren’ en het bericht ‘Rutte bestrijdt vrees trage afhandeling toeslagenaffaire’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that compensation for parents in the childcare benefits scandal could last until 2030, and about the Prime Minister's claim that it would not. The State Secretary answered that the government is working to speed up the recovery operation, that there is no single solution, that the ministerial committee meets when needed, and that 90% of assessments are expected to be completed by early 2025.
The aim is to complete the recovery operation as quickly as possible and to ensure that parents and children can take up their lives again.
De inzet is erop gericht om de hersteloperatie zo snel als mogelijk af te ronden en ervoor te zorgen dat ouders en kinderen hun leven weer kunnen oppakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Alkaya en Omtzigt over de marktconsultatie voor de schaderegeling voor ex-partners

MPs Leijten, Alkaya and Omtzigt asked why the government ran a market consultation on outsourcing the ex-partner compensation scheme to a commercial party, when it was decided and whether the UHT agency's own view was tested. The State Secretary answered that UHT and CWS lack capacity, the consultation tests market interest and feasibility before a tender, the Ministry of Finance would be the client, and the government regrets the delay but considers the consultation essential.
The market consultation is used to sound out whether market parties are interested in and able to carry out the compensation scheme.
Met de marktconsultatie wordt gepolst of marktpartijen geïnteresseerd en in staat zijn om de schaderegeling uit te voeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de LSI (Landelijke Stuurgroep Interventieteams) en vele tot nu toe onuitgevoerde toezeggingen over privacy, risicoscores van heel veel burgers, onuitgevoerd onderzoek, niet opg

MP Omtzigt asks about the LSI joint intervention-team data sharing, including DPIAs, promised but unpublished documents, a planned external review of risk scores, an advisory analytics committee that is still not set up, and possible GDPR violations. The government answers that DPIAs and a privacy protocol are being prepared, that LSI risk scores were stopped in July 2020, that the advisory committee is still being recruited, and that the requested documents are attached or promised later.
Once the DPIA of the LSI cooperation has been completed, it will be sent to the House.
Zodra de DPIA van de LSI-samenwerking is opgeleverd zal deze aan de Kamer worden toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over werkinstructies over de compensatie O/GS en non-response

MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the State Secretary of Finance about new work instructions for the O/GS compensation and non-response cases, including why compensation is now calculated on the amount actually repaid and why the changes apply only to new decisions. The State Secretary replied that the calculation was adjusted to match the legislator's intent, that compensation still covers the full recovered amount, that past decisions are not reopened, and that the non-response instruction now relies more on the parent's account.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Ook poging schadeafhandeling ouders toeslagenaffaire te versnellen vertraagd’

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance why the pilot with settlement agreements (vaststellingsovereenkomsten) for 15 childcare-benefit affair parents is delayed beyond the promised 8 to 10 weeks, and whether parents must prove their damages. The government answers that the pilot values parental control and needs more time, that 3 draft damage overviews have been submitted, that the process is being evaluated, and that parents are not required to fully prove damages with documents.
Parents are not asked to prove their complete damage conclusively by means of supporting documents.
Aan de ouders wordt niet gevraagd om de complete schade onomstotelijk te bewijzen door middel van bewijsstukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘Megafraude toeslagen, ouders harkten ’kinderlijk eenvoudig’ zes ton binnen’

An MP asked the State Secretary about a reported childcare-allowance fraud case and whether fraudsters could receive compensation under the restoration operation. The State Secretary answered that convicted parents are assessed integrally with criminal-file information, that 17 convicted parents have received compensation of at least 30,000 euro in other periods, and that intensive fraud supervision was halted in 2020 and is being restarted in phases.
People previously convicted for childcare-allowance fraud, or fined by Toeslagen, are immediately assessed in full within the restoration operation.

Zo worden mensen die in het verleden strafrechtelijk vanwege toeslagfraude zijn veroordeeld of een vergrijpboete opgelegd hebben gekregen door Toeslagen binnen de hersteloperatie direct integraal beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rechtsbescherming van gedupeerden van het kinderopvangtoeslagenschandaal

The SP MP Van Nispen asked why childcare benefit scandal victims must go to court to enforce statutory decision deadlines and obtain access to their files, and what the government will do about it. The government acknowledges that many decisions are overdue (41,335 applications past the one-year deadline as of 30 September 2022), points to capacity constraints, prioritisation and ongoing improvement measures, and says it will report in the 12th progress report.
Unfortunately, it is not succeeding in giving parents a decision within the statutory deadlines for the integral assessment and objections.
Het lukt helaas niet om ouders binnen de wettelijke termijnen uitsluitsel te geven bij de integrale beoordeling en bezwaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over dat de Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen pas in actie komt na een rechterlijke uitspraak

An SP MP asks why the Dutch tax authority's Herstel Toeslagen unit only acts on childcare-benefit victims' files after court rulings, and how this squares with the law and costs. The government answers that files are handled in order of registration with priority for urgent cases, that late-decision appeals are a consequence of the system rather than deliberate policy, and that it will report further in the next progress report.
As a result, late-decision appeals cut across the processing order based on date of registration.
Hierdoor doorkruisen de beroepen niet tijdig de behandelvolgorde op basis van volgorde van aanmelding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Ombudsman: financiële hulp regelen vaak te moeilijk voor ouderen'

Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the State Secretary of Finance about an Ombudsman report finding that financial support is often too hard for older people to apply for, and about the Inspectorate's similar signal. The State Secretary acknowledged non-take-up of benefits (about 10% for care and rent allowances), outlined outreach campaigns and intermediary networks, and said an evaluation with further data would follow.
Under the Grinwis motion, the ongoing evaluation of the Awir and Toeslagen service delivery will update knowledge on non-take-up of allowances.
5 wordt in de lopende evaluatie van de Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen (Awir), uitvoering en dienstverlening Toeslagen, kennis over het niet-gebruik van toeslagen geactualiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Paul over het bericht 'Ook personeelstekorten bij uitvoeringsorganisaties als UWV, fiscus en IND'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretaries of Finance about reported staff shortages at the Tax Authority and Customs, including long Belastingtelefoon waiting times, staffing for the box 3 ruling and childcare benefits aftermath, sick leave and pension outflow. The government answered that waiting times averaged about 17-20 minutes, listed measures to keep access, explained recruitment difficulties and prioritisation trade-offs that reduce supervision capacity, and projected extra staffing needs, promising further information in the autumn.
In the stand-of-affairs letter 2 I, State Secretary of Finance – Fiscal Affairs & Tax Authority, stated that I will inform you further in the autumn about the level of supervision.
In de stand-van-zakenbrief 2 heb ik, Staatssecretaris van Financiën – Fiscaliteit & Belastingdienst, opgenomen dat ik u in het najaar nader zal informeren over het niveau van toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel Onafhankelijk onderzoek naar uithuisplaatsing kinderen toeslagenouders tegengehouden

MP Omtzigt asked the government why it did not inform parliament earlier about an independent RUG study into child removals in the childcare benefits affair, and whether the study should be commissioned. The Minister answered that the government had no involvement, that the judiciary decided not to cooperate, that CBS data rules do not allow the requested linkage, and that no new study is currently planned because an inspection and an independent commission are underway.
I have always informed your House about how independent research would take place, namely by the Inspectorate of Justice and Security (IJenV) and additionally by an investigative commission.

Ik heb uw Kamer steeds geïnformeerd over de manier waarop onafhankelijk onderzoek zou plaatsvinden, namelijk door de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid (IJenV) en aanvullend door een onderzoekscommissie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de berichten 'Meeste toeslagenouders hebben migratieachtergrond, vaak met schulden', nieuwe data van het CBS: 'Kenmerken van gedupeerde gezinnen toeslagenaffaire' en 'Belasting

An MP (Azarkan, DENK) asked the State Secretaries of Finance about CBS data showing that most families harmed by the childcare benefits scandal have a migration background and often debts, and about reports that the Tax Service knew of ethnic profiling already in 2019. The government acknowledged the findings as painful, denied that Toeslagen collected ethnicity data or actively selected on nationality, admitted that the risk model disadvantaged certain groups without a valid basis, and pointed to reforms, a screening team clarification, and ongoing restitution efforts, but did not concede the 2019 knowledge claim.
It is not the case, and the DPA has not established either, that the handlers selected on the basis of second nationality.
Het is niet zo, en ook niet door de AP vastgesteld, dat de behandelaren in dit verband geselecteerd hebben op tweede nationaliteit.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Marijnissen over kinderen die uit huis geplaatst zijn, het toeslagenschandaal en de schadevergoeding die zij krijgen uitgekeerd, terwijl ze nog uit huis geplaatst zijn

MPs Omtzigt and Marijnissen asked the government about children placed out of home in the childcare benefits scandal, compensation payments to those children, who controls the money, and whether expert analyses and rights protections are available. The minister answered that a support team has worked with 202 parents and 429 children, that a child compensation scheme exists with parents or guardians controlling minors' money under the civil code, and that contra-analyses and family-analysis instruments face waiting lists and are being piloted.
The investigation by the Inspectorate of Justice and Security and the independent inquiry committee should provide more insight into this.
Het onderzoek van de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid en van de onafhankelijke onderzoekscommissie moet hier meer inzicht in bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over het bericht 'Meeste toeslagenouders hebben migratieachtergrond, vaak met schulden'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Surinamese and Caribbean parents were most often victims of the childcare benefits scandal, and whether ethnic profiling, colonial legacy and anti-Black racism explain this, and what the government will do. The State Secretary answered that Toeslagen holds no ethnicity data and did not select on origin, acknowledged institutional racism in past risk classification, pointed to existing anti-discrimination measures and the forthcoming response on the slavery past, and declined to analyse or confirm the causes of the overrepresentation.
It is important to emphasise that Toeslagen does not hold information on citizens' ethnicity and origin, and Toeslagen therefore did not actively select on this basis.
Het is van belang om te benadrukken dat Toeslagen niet beschikt over informatie over etniciteit en afkomst van burgers en Toeslagen heeft hier dan ook niet actief op geselecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de Fiscale Monitor

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretaries of Finance about questions and statements in the Fiscale Monitor, including statements on childcare benefit fraud and whether the survey asks about the Tax Authority's harshness and courtesy. The government answered that the survey measures tax and benefit morale, that it is not designed to question people's honesty, that wording will be reviewed, and that an external review is planned.
The wording of the statements used to measure morale will be evaluated and adjusted where necessary.
De bewoordingen van de gebruikte stellingen waarmee moraal wordt gemeten, zullen worden geëvalueerd en waar nodig worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het rapport Drugs de Baas d.d. 23 juni 2022, Denktank: drugsmisdaad wel te bestrijden, reguleer xtc en onderschep de coke d.d. 22 juni 2022

An MP (Sneller, D66) asked the Justice, Health and Finance ministers about the DenkWerk report 'Drugs de baas', covering the cocaine interception rate, the profitability of Dutch drug wholesale, regulation of ecstasy and MDMA, and port-focused enforcement. The Minister answered that the government did not commission the report, that ecstasy and MDMA cannot be legalised due to international treaties, that the interception percentage is not tracked while seizures in kilos are, and that a plan of action on logistics hubs will be sent to the Chamber by end 2022.
Customs further indicates that its reports are based on established data and recorded facts.
De Douane geeft daarnaast aan dat zij in de rapportages uitgaat van vaststaande gegevens en geconstateerde feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het strafrechtelijk onderzoek van de FIOD naar medische specialisten

An MP asked the health minister about a FIOD criminal investigation into medical specialists allegedly paid by a medical devices supplier for preferential treatment, including how many were involved, the sums, and measures to prevent such practices. The minister declined to answer case-specific questions citing the ongoing criminal investigation and pointed to existing and planned measures (Wibz bill, expanded NZa oversight, annual reporting for medical specialist companies) and to a pending private member's bill on a transparency register.
Because the Public Prosecution Service does not provide information on (ongoing) criminal investigations, I have no further information on this.
Omdat het OM geen informatie verstrekt over (lopende) strafrechtelijke onderzoeken, heb ik hier geen nadere informatie over.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Havens in Noord-Nederland moeten 'beducht zijn' voor snellere toename drugscriminelen, als Rotterdam overstapt op zwaardere controles’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg (CDA) asked the Justice and Security Minister and the Finance State Secretary about a report that northern Dutch ports are poorly controlled and vulnerable to drug smuggling if Rotterdam tightens checks, and about whether 100% controls, displacement risks and the 24 million euro package would address this. The government replies that customs, Marechaussee and police have a good information position, that smuggling volumes in northern ports are relatively stable, that it monitors displacement and will not adopt 100% checks on specific goods, and that the structural funds focus on five major hubs with regional funds available for other hubs.

The Politie en Wetenschap research is however a reason to examine, both separately and jointly, what options exist to further strengthen the information position on possible dubious practices in the northern seaports.

Het onderzoek van Politie en Wetenschap is echter wel een aanleiding om, zowel afzonderlijk als in gezamenlijkheid, te onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om de informatiepositie over de mogelijke malafide praktijken in de Noordelijke zeehavens verder te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over fraude met compensatieregeling toeslagenaffaire

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about suspected fraud and misuse of the compensation scheme for the childcare benefits affair, including the limited enforcement and recovery of overpaid sums. The government answered that fraud signals are being investigated and handled, that no confirmed fraud cases have yet been established, that a complaint was passed to the consumer authority about an intermediary, and that recovery applies only to the person who misused the scheme.
A handling framework and work process are currently being set up to collect these reports centrally and investigate them.
Op dit moment wordt er een behandelkader en werkproces opgezet om deze meldingen centraal te verzamelen en te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het breder toepassen van het discriminerende risico-selectiemodel door Toeslagen

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance how the discriminatory risk-selection model used by Toeslagen (childcare and housing benefits) was applied more widely, which teams used it, when it was used, and when an external investigation would start. The government answered that the model's risk scores were used beyond manual-review selection, that nationality and other indicators were part of the model, and that an external investigation would start in summer 2022 with a report expected early the following year.
Therefore an external investigation will be carried out.
Daarom zal een extern onderzoek worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Azarkan en Omtzigt over recente nihilstellingen in de kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Leijten, Azarkan and Omtzigt asked about recent nihilstellingen (zeroing-out of childcare allowance) for 2020/2021, including how the process, notification, reasons, objection and repayment are handled after the Ongekend Onrecht report. The State Secretary answered that about 4,500 2020 cases were zeroed out, described new procedural safeguards, admitted decisions do not yet state reasons in the formal beschikking, and promised improvements without firm dates.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de toeslagenaffaire

An MP asks the State Secretary about delays in the childcare allowance scandal compensation law, support for affected children and ex-partners, backlogs in objections, and alleged bullying and unlawful conduct by the Tax Administration. The government answers that the restoration bill will go to the Council of State for urgent advice and aims to submit it before the summer recess, that children's compensation and flanking support are being prepared, that the ex-partner scheme needs more time, and that the objection backlog and past misconduct are acknowledged and addressed.
The cabinet aims to submit the Wet hersteloperatie Toeslagen bill to the House before the summer recess.
Het kabinet streeft ernaar om het wetsvoorstel Wet hersteloperatie Toeslagen voor het zomerreces aan uw Kamer aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Kent en Alkaya over de compensatie voor de gestegen energie- en brandstofprijzen

SP MPs asked why the 120% of social minimum income test for the one-off energy allowance counts the single-parent supplement of the child-related budget as income while excluding the child budget itself, and questioned how income is defined and applied across municipalities. The minister explained that the child budget including the single-parent supplement is excluded from income under the Participatiewet, acknowledged that the concept of income is hard for citizens to grasp, and said municipalities have discretion in specialist assistance while the wage increase was not feasible in time.
For social assistance benefits, a supplement under the child-related budget is a benefit within the meaning of the General Act on Income-Dependent Schemes.
Voor bijstandsuitkeringen geldt dat een toeslag in het kader van het kindgebonden budget een tegemoetkoming is in de zin van de Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over knelpunten en drempels bij de boostercampagne

An MP asked the health minister about bottlenecks in the COVID booster campaign, including GGD refusing help from GPs and pharmacists, temporary staff contracts, and long waits for older people. The minister answered that no national rule blocked outside help, that GGDs managed staffing and booster scheduling, and that evaluation and further scenario planning were underway.
There is no national regulation that has obstructed the deployment of these professionals.
Er is geen landelijke regelgeving die de inzet van deze professionals in de weg heeft gezeten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht 'In achterkamertje van beautysalon verdienen ze aan leed van toeslagenouders: 'Schandalig''

An MP asked whether paid intermediaries offering to help people claim compensation for childcare benefit problems are acceptable and what the government will do about them. The state secretary answered that such help is not required, that the government will improve information on free legal aid and municipal support, will refer suspected criminal conduct to police and possibly the consumer authority, but cannot yet judge misuse.
Following this case, the VNG and UHT are taking another look at the information provision and services for these citizens.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus kijken de VNG en UHT opnieuw naar de informatievoorziening aan en dienstverlening richting deze burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Aukje de Vries en Kuiken over boostervaccinaties voor Nederlanders die met AstraZeneca of Janssen gevaccineerd zijn

MPs Paternotte, Aukje de Vries and Kuiken asked why booster vaccination for people vaccinated with AstraZeneca or Janssen was not prioritised, and whether the Health Council and EMA positions justify delay. The minister answered that the Health Council found no medical grounds for prioritising by vaccine type, that mRNA boosters are preferred, and that the booster campaign is being accelerated, while several questions about Europe-wide certificate validity were answered only in outline.
The RIVM does not have data on people belonging to a risk group and recipients of a 'waste-bin vaccine' and their vaccination status at the time of a positive test.
Het RIVM beschikt niet over data van personen die behoren tot een risicogroep en ontvangers van een «prullenbakvaccin» en de vaccinatiestatus op het moment van een positieve test.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Studenten hekelen ‘prikkel’ om maatregelen niet na te leven rond tentamens’

MPs Van der Woude and Aukje de Vries asked whether students who miss exams due to illness or quarantine lose a test opportunity under standard resit policy, and how the government will ensure they are not penalised for following COVID rules. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that institutions must offer tailored solutions in consultation with students, as set out in new service documents, but acknowledged that alternatives may not be immediate and that students must actively report missed exams.
It is up to the institution to offer tailored solutions when a test opportunity is missed.
Het is aan de instelling om bij het missen van een toetsmoment maatwerk te bieden.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Spies en Paulus Jansen ter vervanging van nr. 23 over openbare verslaglegging
Requires gas and electricity grid operators to publish annually a separate account report and proof of sound financial management.
A grid operator publishes annually in a suitable way a report of the separate accounts
Een netbeheerder publiceert jaarlijks op geschikte wijze een verslag van de afzonderlijke boekhouding
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen c.s. over het beperken van de bevoegdheid van de netbeheerder bij congestie

Narrows the grid operator's discretion to deviate from priority for renewable and CHP electricity in congestion, replacing the 'not reasonable and proportionate' test with a narrower safety and reliability test.
unless the grid operator cannot, by applying this, ensure in the most efficient way the safety and reliability of the grids and electricity transport
tenzij de netbeheerder met het toepassen hiervan de veiligheid en betrouwbaarheid van de netten en van het transport van elektriciteit over de netten niet op de meest doelmatige wijze kan waarborgen
Motie Spies en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over een evaluatie van de maatregelen die betrekking hebben op de gasmarkt
Asks the government to evaluate the effects of the gas market and priority-for-sustainable-electricity measures one year after they become operational and report to the House.
requests the government to evaluate the operation of the gas market measures one year after becoming operational and to report to the House
verzoekt de regering de werking van de maatregelen met betrekking tot de gasmarkt en «voorrang voor duurzaam» een jaar na het operationeel worden te evalueren en de Kamer daarover te berichten
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Paulus Jansen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 30 over het beperken van de bevoegdheid van de netbeheerder bij congestie
Replaces the broad 'not reasonable and proportionate' limit on priority for sustainable electricity with a narrower reference to the grid operator's task of ensuring safety and reliability.
the phrase 'unless the consequences of applying it are not reasonable and proportionate' is replaced by 'with due regard to the task referred to in article 16(1)(b)'.
wordt de zinsnede «, tenzij de gevolgen van het toepassen hiervan niet redelijk en proportioneel zijn» vervangen door:, met inachtneming van de taak, bedoeld in artikel 16, eerste lid, onder b.
Amendement van het lid Spies c.s. over een adviserende rol van de Nma bij investeringen die niet zijn opgenomen in een structuurvisie
Has the competition authority advise the minister on investments by grid operators not in a spatial plan, and gives parliament a pre-decision veto period (voorhang) of two weeks.
This amendment also ensures that parliament, through a voorhang procedure, has the last word on the minister's decision
Dit wijzigingsvoorstel bewerkstelligt tevens dat het parlement door middel van een voorhangprocedure het laatste woord heeft over het besluit van de minister
Amendement van de leden Spies en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink inzake een verheldering van de betrouwbaarheidsnorm
Clarifies in the Gas and Electricity Acts that high-voltage grids of 110 kV and above must keep single-fault reserve, including during maintenance, with limited exceptions for 110 to 220 kV.
grids with a voltage level of 110 kV or higher are designed and operating such that transport of electricity is assured even if a single fault occurs
netten met een spanningsniveau van 110 kV of hoger zodanig zijn ontworpen en in werking zijn dat het transport van elektriciteit, ook indien zich een enkelvoudige storing voordoet, verzekerd is
Amendement van het lid Cramer c.s. betreffende de bijtelling en ontrekking voor nulemmisseauto's
Extends the 25% reduction in the addition to income and withdrawal for zero-emission company cars to 2012 to 2014, with budget costs offset from a motor vehicle tax change.
This amendment ensures that the addition and withdrawal for zero-emission company cars is also reduced by 25% of the car's value in 2012, 2013 and 2014.
Met dit amendement wordt bewerkstelligd dat de bijtelling en onttrekking voor nulemissieauto’s van de zaak ook in de jaren 2012, 2013 en 2014 met 25% van de waarde van de auto verminderd wordt.
Motie Samsom c.s. over geen definitieve stappen tot er meer duidelijkheid is over het splitsingsplan
Asks the government to urge shareholders of Essent not to take definitive steps until there is clarity on the splitting plan.
requests the government to contact the shareholders of Essent and ask them not to take definitive steps
verzoekt de regering in contact te treden met de aandeelhouders van Essent en hen te verzoeken geen definitieve stappen te zetten
Amendement van het lid Spekman c.s. ter vervanging van de nrs. 16 en 17 om schuldhulpverlening een extra inpuls te geven, als onderdeel van buurtdiensten
Shifts a small budget amount within the social affairs budget to fund debt-relief pilots as part of neighbourhood services; a budget reallocation with no change to executive checks.
With this amendment an amount is set aside for pilots
Met dit amendement wordt een bedrag vrijgemaakt voor pilots
Motie Spies c.s. over begeleiding van jonge mensen met complexe problemen
Asks the government to ensure young people with complex problems are reached and guided through a coordinated care chain.
requests the government to reach agreements with all relevant bodies so that these young people are reached
verzoekt de regering om in overleg met alle betrokken instanties te komen tot afspraken die ertoe leiden dat deze jonge mensen wel worden bereikt
Motie Spies c.s. over pilots in de sociale werkvoorziening
Motion asks the government to propose by 1 April 2009 one or more pilots implementing elements of the De Vries advice on sheltered employment.
requests the government to make a proposal for one or more pilots by 1 April 2009
verzoekt de regering om uiterlijk 1 april 2009 een voorstel voor een of enkele pilots te doen
Motie Spies c.s. over het aansluiten van de criteria voor duurzaam inkopen bij gangbare keurmerken
Asks the government to inform the House before sustainable procurement criteria are finalised, on their content and progress, and to explain how they can align with market labels.
requests the government to inform the House, no later than the first quarter of 2009 and before the criteria are finalised, about the content and progress of the process
verzoekt de regering om uiterlijk in het eerste kwartaal van 2009 en voordat de criteria definitief worden de Kamer over de inhoud en de voortgang van het proces te informeren
Motie vermeij c.s. over het expliciet opnemen van schoolpleinen in het Activiteitenbesluit
Asks the government to explicitly include school playgrounds in the Activiteitenbesluit noise rules.
requests the government to explicitly include school playgrounds in the Activiteitenbesluit
verzoekt de regering schoolpleinen expliciet in het Activiteitenbesluit op te nemen
Motie Spies c.s. over een budget voor ondersteuning van de expeditie Himalaya Alert
Asks the government to make a budget available within the housing and environment ministry budget to support the Himalaya Alert climate expedition.
requests the government to make a budget available within article 3 of the VROM budget to support the Himalaya Alert expedition
verzoekt de regering om binnen artikel 3 van de VROM-begroting een budget beschikbaar te stellen ter ondersteuning van de expeditie Himalya Alert
Motie Spies c.s. over fundamentele herbezinning op het geluidbeleid
Asks the government to fundamentally rethink noise policy, prioritising source-oriented measures over effect-oriented ones, with results in the 2010 budget.
requests the government to carry out a fundamental rethink of noise policy
verzoekt de regering een fundamentele herbezinning op het geluidbeleid uit te voeren
Motie Spies c.s. over een nieuwe bestemming voor het budget voor de subsidie voor roetfilters
Asks the government not to provide subsidies for soot filters once they can be made mandatory, and to reallocate the remaining budget within air quality and transport.
requests the government not to make subsidies available for soot filters at the moment they can also be made mandatory
verzoekt de regering om geen subsidies beschikbaar te stellen voor roetfilters op het moment dat deze ook verplicht gesteld kunnen worden
Motie Spies c.s. over afspraken met de branche over stille banden
Asks the government to agree with the tyre industry that silent tyres become the standard.
requests the government to reach agreements with the industry that lead to silent tyres becoming standard
verzoekt de regering in overleg met de branche te komen tot afspraken die ertoe leiden dat stille banden standaard worden
Motie Spies / Spekman over 50 mln. uit het educatiebudget voor taal en rekenen in het mbo
Motion asking government to work out a proposal moving 50 million from the adult education budget to language and arithmetic in vocational education.
requests the government to work out a proposal in which 50 million from the education budget is deployed for language and arithmetic in mbo
verzoekt de regering een voorstel uit te werken waarin 50 mln. uit het educatiebudget wordt ingezet ten gunste van taal en rekenen in het mbo
Amendement van het lid Spies c.s. over een volledige ontschotting van de middelen voor re-integratie, educatie en inburgering, alsmede het vervallen van de verplichte aanbesteding bij ROC’s

Amendment to fully remove earmarking of reintegration, education and integration funds and to exempt the related payments from the General Administrative Law Act titles 4.1 and 4.2, weakening legal protection for affected recipients.
Titles 4.1 and 4.2 of the General Administrative Law Act do not apply.
De titels 4.1 en 4.2 van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht zijn niet van toepassing.

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Karabulut c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 15 over het inzetten van het participatiebudget voor jongeren van 16 of 17 jaaroud die dreigen uit te vallen uit school, maar mid
Allows municipalities to use the participation budget for support costs of learn-work trajectories for 16- and 17-year-olds at risk of dropping out of school.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Spekman c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het kunnen uitvoeren van experimenten om de doelen educatie, inburgering en re-integratie te realiseren
Amendment adds a power to run three-year experiments deviating from the Participation Budget Act, with a report to both Houses six months before the end.
The Minister of Social Affairs sends at least six months before the end of an experiment a report on its effectiveness and practical effects to both Houses of the States General.

Onze Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid zendt uiterlijk zes maanden voor de beëindiging van een experiment als bedoeld in het eerste lid een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten in de praktijk van het experiment aan beide kamers der Staten-Generaal.

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Spies c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 18 over een volledige ontschotting van de middelen voor re-integratie, educatie en inburgering, alsmede het vervallen van de verplich

Amendment asks for full de-siloing of re-integration, education and integration funds from 2010, removes mandatory tendering for ROCs, and removes general administrative-law (Awb) title 4.1/4.2 application to certain payments to vocational colleges, replacing it with contracts.

Amendement van het lid Karabulut c.s. ter vervanging van de nrs 11 en 13 over het inzetten van het participatiebudget voor jongeren van 16 of 17 jaaroud die dreigen uit te vallen uit school, maar midd
Amends the Participatiebudget law so municipalities can fund support costs for 16- and 17-year-olds subject to compulsory qualification who need a learn-work pathway.
the college may offer re-integration provisions to persons aged 16 or 17 who are still subject to compulsory education or qualification obligations
het college re-integratievoorzieningen aanbieden aan personen van 16 of 17 jaar oud waarvoor de leerplicht of kwalificatieplicht nog geldt
Amendement van het lid Spekman c.s. over het kunnen uitvoeren van experimenten om de doelen educatie, inburgering en re-integratie te realiseren

Adds an article letting the government, by general administrative order, deviate for three years from core participation-law articles in experiments, with a report to parliament six months before the end.
By general administrative order, experiments may deviate for three years from the articles of this law to achieve the goals of education, integration and reintegration

Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kan bij wijze van experiment, met het oog op het doeltreffender uitvoeren van deze wet teneinde de doelen van educatie, inburgering en re-integratie te realiseren, voor een periode van drie jaar worden afgeweken

Amendement van het lid Spekman c.s. over het inzetten van het participatiebudget voor jongeren van 16 of 17 jaaroud die dreigen uit te vallen uit school, maar middels een leer/werktraject alsnog een s
Allows municipalities to use the participation budget to fund support costs for 16- and 17-year-olds at risk of dropping out of school who are in a learning-work track.
the college may offer re-integration facilities to persons aged 16 or 17 who are still subject to compulsory education or qualification obligation
het college re-integratievoorzieningen aanbieden aan personen van 16 of 17 jaar oud waarvoor de leerplicht of kwalificatieplicht nog geldt
Motie Van Gent c.s. over het niet maken van onderscheid tussen het oude en nieuwe bestand van alleenstaande ouders in de bijstand
Asks the government not to distinguish between old and new caseloads of single parents on welfare and to ensure all get a work, training or combined offer within six months.
requests the government not to distinguish between the old and new caseload
verzoekt de regering geen onderscheid te maken tussen het «oude» en het «nieuwe» bestand
Amendement van het lid Spekman c.s. ter vervanging van nr.10 om de alleenstaande ouder beroepsopleidende leerweg te laten afronden in de periode waarin deze ontheven kan worden van de arbeidsplicht

Replaces an earlier amendment so that a lone parent with a starting qualification can finish a vocational training course, with the municipality obliged to fund it unless the parent lacks the ability.
At the request of the lone parent who has a starting qualification and has been granted an exemption, the college fills in the provision with a training course

Op verzoek van de alleenstaande ouder die beschikt over een startkwalificatie en aan wie een ontheffing is verleend als bedoeld in het eerste lid, vult het college de voorziening, bedoeld in artikel 9, eerste lid, onderdeel b, in met een opleiding
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Spies c.s. ter vervanging van nr.8 over aanpassing criteria langdurigheidstoeslag
Removes the criterion of lack of labour market prospects from the conditions for the long-term allowance under the Participation Act, keeping only long-term duration and low income.
The criterion 'lack of labour market prospects' has no added value.
Het criterium «gebrek aan arbeidsmarktperspectief» heeft geen meerwaarde.
Amendement van het lid Spies c.s. over aanpassing criteria langdurigheidstoeslag
Amends the social assistance bill to decentralise the long-term-need allowance and drop the criterion of lack of labour market prospects.
that it is desirable to decentralise the long-term-need allowance.
dat het wenselijk is de langdurigheidstoeslag te decentraliseren.
qa: Antwoord vragen Mei Li Vos en Recourt over identiteitsfraude door slecht bewaarde paspoortkopieën

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked about identity fraud risks from copies of passports that self-employed contractors must give each client and clients must keep for seven years. The minister replied that the retention duty is legally required, that the government lacks data on fraud involving such copies, suggested contractors write purpose and date on copies, and said the VAR web module will not change the identification requirement.
The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will start a campaign at the end of this year to point people to this option.
Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties start eind dit jaar een campagne om mensen op deze mogelijkheid te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt inzake derivatenposities van publieke en semi-publieke instellingen

An MP asks the government for an overview of derivative positions across public and semi-public institutions and for details on municipal, provincial and Groningen Seaports exposures. The minister answers that the central government lacks data on local authorities' derivatives, that horizontal supervision applies, that Groningen Seaports is still being assessed, and that an overview is being prepared.
Insight into derivative positions of decentralised governments is not available at national government level.
Inzicht in derivatenposities van decentrale overheden is op Rijksniveau niet voorhanden.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Nieuwenhuizen–Wijbenga en Hennis–Plasschaert over de automatische registratie van de Turkse nationaliteit in de Gemeentelijke basisadministratie persoonsgegevens (GBA)

MPs Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether children of Turkish parents are wrongly registered with dual nationality in the GBA, whether that is undesirable, and what the status is of the Basisregistratie personen amendment limiting registration of foreign nationality. The minister answered that GBA registration is declaratory, that the Turkish authorities have not yet responded to a request for clarification, and that the planned amendment concerns registration of foreign nationality rather than its determination.
As soon as I have received the Turkish response, I will inform you about it.
Zodra ik de Turkse reactie heb ontvangen, zal ik u hierover informeren.
