Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Visser over de uitspraak van de voorzieningenrechter te Groningen inzake de strafrechtelijke ontruiming van krakers op grond van art. 551a Sv.

MPs Van der Steur and Visser asked the ministers about a Groningen interim judge's refusal to allow criminal eviction of squatters under art. 551a Sv, and how this affects enforcement of the squatting ban. The minister said the case is under appeal so he will not judge it, that enforcement is not undermined since other courts allowed evictions, and gave statistics showing most court challenges to criminal evictions succeeded for the state.
As long as the case is before the court, I refrain from passing judgment.
Zolang de zaak onder de rechter is, onthoud ik me van een oordeel.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Spies (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer, van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Financiën over E85 (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

MPs Omtzigt and Spies asked the ministers about E85 and other high-blend biofuels, including tax correction, traceability, the Platform Duurzame Mobiliteit, and comparison with other European countries. The government answered that tax compensation for sustainable E85 applies since April 2010, that a temporary tax arrangement may be considered for new blends, and that traceability and infrastructure subsidies are being pursued, while leaving some matters to future reports.

If a company has concrete plans to introduce a new higher blend to the market and wants to test the product first, it will be examined whether a temporary excise compensation can be granted for a limited test period under strict conditions, analogous to the E85 arrangement.

Als een bedrijf concrete plannen heeft voor de marktintroductie van een nieuwe hogere blend en dit nieuwe product eerst wil testen, zal worden bezien of voor een gelimiteerde testperiode onder strikte voorwaarden een tijdelijke accijnscompensatie kan worden verleend analoog aan de regeling voor E85.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Spies (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over mogelijke windfall profits in de energie-intensieve industrie al

MPs Omtzigt and Spies asked whether a CE Delft study showing windfall profits in energy-intensive industry from free ETS allowances warrants policy changes, and what it means for the EU carbon leakage list and emissions trading design. The minister acknowledged the study, said pass-through of allowance value is plausible, noted allocation to 2012 is fixed, reaffirmed a preference for auctioning and strict carbon leakage criteria, and promised further research while stating the NEa does not monitor windfall profits.
I am of the view that it is good to conduct further research into carbon leakage, so that we are better able to determine which sectors are affected by it.
Ik ben van mening dat het goed is om verder onderzoek te doen naar carbon leakage, opdat we beter in staat zijn vast te stellen welke sectoren hiermee te maken hebben.
Vragen van het lid Spies (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over stroomstoringen op Goeree-Overflakkee (ingezonden 12 april 2010).

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about frequent power outages on Goeree-Overflakkee, the network's condition, investment timing, compensation for customers and whether grid operator Stedin meets the N-1 reliability standard. The minister answered that the area's outage minutes are high but the network is maintained, that the NMa supervises grid quality, that existing compensation rules suffice, and that Stedin meets N-1 on the high-voltage grid but not in sparsely populated areas like Goeree-Overflakkee.
As part of this supervision, the NMa imposed a binding instruction on Stedin in December 2009
In het kader van dit toezicht heeft de NMa aan Stedin een bindende aanwijzing opgelegd in december 2009

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Spies (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Financiën over duurzame bio-ethanol (E85) (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked whether government fleet cars can run on E85 bio-ethanol, whether M85 biomethanol producers can get excise compensation for lower energy content, and which other sustainable fuels could qualify. The government answered that only 17 state fleet cars can use E85, that suppliers mainly blend biofuels, that an E85 excise refund was introduced from 1 April 2010 for demonstrably sustainable ethanol, and that M85 compensation is not currently relevant, while noting possible EU-level changes to excise tariffs.
Furthermore, M85 is more corrosive than E85, so the car industry withdraws the warranty when M85 is used.
Voorts is M85 meer corrosief dan E85, waardoor de auto-industrie bij gebruik van M85 de garantie laat vervallen.
Vragen van de leden Van Bochove, Spies en Jager (allen CDA) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over de aangescherpte energieprestatienorm (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

CDA MPs asked the housing minister about the status of the Northern Netherlands energy agreement and the draft experiment decree allowing a tighter energy performance norm (EPC 0.5) for new homes, and whether preconditions such as market and municipal support were met. The minister answered that the Council of State raised no objections, that the decree is notified to the European Commission, that some market parties still seek clarity on calculation methods, and that the decree will enter into force on 1 October 2010 with informing parliament at publication.
I intend to inform your House upon publication of the decree.
Ik ben voornemens om uw kamer te informeren bij de publicatie van het besluit.
qn: Antwoord vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht over het buitenspel zetten van makelaars bij tijdelijke verhuur

An MP asked whether banks, including ABN AMRO, effectively exclude commercial estate agents from temporary letting by requiring owners to use a few selected intermediaries, and whether this is proportionate and should be regulated. The minister answered that banks may set conditions for consent, that a duty to use specific intermediaries is undesirable, and that banks should be encouraged to create a competitive market and objective criteria, while no change to the Leegstandwet is needed.
I will consult with the banks concerned on this.
Ik zal hierover in overleg treden met de betreffende banken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over DigiD-gegevens die terecht zijn gekomen bij een reclamebureau en mensen die geen DigiD-code hebben

An MP asked the Interior Minister about a advertising agency holding thousands of DigiD login details, whether citizens' data is protected, the consequences of DigiD misuse, and whether the 1.6 million people without DigiD are being left behind. The minister could not confirm the numbers, said data protection cannot be guaranteed, announced steps to have the agency delete stored data and change its website, and said the government will keep promoting digital services while keeping alternatives for those without DigiD.
I will therefore ask the agency to set up its system in future so that the data of people who are not its customers are no longer stored.
Ik zal het bureau daarom vragen haar systeem naar de toekomst toe zodanig in te richten dat de gegevens van mensen die geen klant van haar zijn niet meer worden opgeslagen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over het artikel ‘Overleg over regeling interlandelijk verkeer blijkt nooit te zijn begonnen’

Mr. Bosman (VVD) asked whether the Koninkrijk working group on inter-island movement of persons and goods, agreed at the 2011 conference, has ever met, and how Curaçao and Sint Maarten's refusal to participate should be handled. The minister replied that only Aruba responded to repeated invitations, that Curaçao and Sint Maarten gave no reason, and that the matter is left to the incoming cabinet.
So far, only Aruba has responded to the invitations.
Tot nu toe heeft alleen Aruba op de uitnodigingen gereageerd.
Antwoord vragen Fritsma en De Graaf over het bericht dat 60.000 euro aan subsidiegeld voor de Antilliaanse belangenvereniging MAAPP is “verdwenen”

Two PVV MPs asked the minister whether 60,000 euro of subsidy to the Antillean association MAAPP was lost to fraud, how ministry oversight failed, and whether the money and future subsidies are secured. The minister answered that the former chair withdrew funds unseen by the board, that the ministry will recover the undisbursed amount via a bailiff and the police are investigating, but that more oversight could not have prevented it and no new subsidies are planned.
The Ministry will recover the improperly spent funds from MAAPP.
Het Ministerie zal de niet juist bestede middelen terugvorderen bij MAAPP.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink over kinderrechten op Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked about children's rights on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including whether differential treatment and the lack of a coordinating minister meet the UN Convention and the Constitution. The State Secretary answered that the islands receive tailored policy, that ministries coordinate via departmental coordinators, and that more action is planned, but declined to pre-judge the forthcoming UNICEF report.

I do not yet wish to anticipate the possible content of this report, its recommendations, and the possible action I may or may not take, in cooperation with other responsible ministries and government services.

Ik wil nu nog niet vooruitlopen op de mogelijke inhoud van dit rapport, de aanbevelingen en de mogelijke actie die ik al dan niet in samenwerking met andere verantwoordelijke ministeries en overheidsdiensten zal nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gent over het verdwijnen van de koraalriffen in de Cariben

An MP from GroenLinks asked the government about reports that four-fifths of Caribbean coral reefs have disappeared and whether it would take stronger action in response to the IUCN analysis. The state secretary answered that reef protection is the responsibility of the four Kingdom countries and the public bodies, that protection within the Kingdom is more advanced, and that no additional measures are being considered.
In response to the IUCN report, I am not considering additional measures.
Naar aanleiding van het rapport van de IUCN overweeg ik geen aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Karabulut en Paulus Jansen over de voorgenomen sloop van woningen in de Van der Pekbuurt in Amsterdam door woningcorporatie Ymere

MPs Karabulut and Jansen (SP) asked the Minister of the Interior whether a housing corporation may demolish homes in the Van der Pek neighbourhood under the revised Building Decree, which requires only a notification, and whether demolition should halt while heritage protection as a townscape is being initiated. The minister answered that the demolition notification and permit concern nuisance and safety only, that protection of townscapes is the municipality's task, and that the cultural-historical concerns are being raised in consultation with the municipality and the corporation.
It is primarily the task of the municipality of Amsterdam to carefully weigh and protect the heritage values in Amsterdam.
Het is primair de taak van de gemeente Amsterdam om de erfgoedwaarden in Amsterdam zorgvuldig af te wegen en te beschermen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over de verplichte afname van vingerafdrukken voor de identiteitskaart en het paspoort

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the mandatory fingerprinting for ID cards and passports, the Raad van State's referral of questions to the EU Court of Justice, and the obstacles faced by people refusing fingerprints. The Minister confirmed the referral, said a bill will drop fingerprinting for ID cards, rejected issuing emergency documents to refusers, and said the government cannot speed up the Court's ruling.

The bill amending the Passport Act, approved by the Council of Ministers on 28 September 2012 and submitted to parliament, indeed provides that fingerprints will no longer be taken when applying for a Dutch identity card.

Het voorstel tot wijziging van de Paspoortwet waar de Rijksministerraad op 28 september 2012 mee heeft ingestemd en dat door Hare Majesteit de Koningin aan het parlement is aangeboden voorziet er inderdaad in dat bij de aanvraag van een Nederlandse identiteitskaart niet langer vingerafdrukken worden opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Monasch over de plannen van Vestia in de gemeente Pijnacker-Nootdorp

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether Vestia's plan to sell about half its social rental stock in Pijnacker-Nootdorp breaches earlier promises to protect tenants, and whether such sales should be prevented. The Minister disputes that reading, says sales are unavoidable for Vestia's debt repayment, and says it is too early to judge while the municipality analyses housing needs.
My department regularly consults with Vestia on the state of affairs regarding the sale of homes.
Mijn departement heeft regelmatig overleg met Vestia over de stand van zaken rondom de verkoop van woningen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de geplande islamitische betogingen voor het Amerikaanse consulaat

An MP asked the ministers whether they knew of planned Islamic demonstrations near the US consulate in Amsterdam, which organisations were behind them, whether AIVD monitors those involved, and whether violence would be met with firm action. The minister confirmed awareness, named the two organising groups, declined to say whether the AIVD monitors anyone, and declined to pre-announce how police would act, saying only that any response would be effective and proportionate.
I cannot publicly disclose anything about groups or individuals who are or are not under investigation by the AIVD.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over groepen/individuen die al dan niet in onderzoek zijn bij de AIVD.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over de vervolging door het Hof van Justitie van de Bonairiaanse gedeputeerde El Hage en de oud-bestuurder Booi voor hypotheekfraude en valsheid in geschrifte

An MP asked the minister whether the prosecution of Bonaire's deputy El Hage and former official Booi for mortgage fraud and forgery should lead to his suspension, whether corruption exists elsewhere on Bonaire, and what the status is of strengthening local government. The minister confirmed awareness of the case, declined to judge on suspension (leaving it to the island council), said he knows of no other OM investigations into Bonaire's administration, and described training and support initiatives including the Rijksvertegenwoordiger's general duty for good governance.
It is not appropriate for me as minister of BZK to pass judgment on this. That judgment rests with the island council, and with him as well.
Het past mij niet als minister van BZK hierover een oordeel te vellen. Dat oordeel is aan de eilandsraad, alsook aan hemzelf.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over nieuwe berichten over «middeleeuwse belastingheffing»

MP Heijnen asked ministers about reports that municipalities such as Woerden may face the medieval 'dertiende penning' land levy, including whether it can be imposed at any time and on what legal basis. The government answered that Woerden had not yet received an assessment, that the right persists until 2015 under a 1984 law, that the state's own position is being examined with a commitment to inform parliament, and that the levy rests on a surviving medieval property right.
The position of the State is currently being mapped and it is being examined whether it is opportune for the State to exercise its rights, and if so how.
Momenteel wordt de positie van de Staat in kaart gebracht en wordt onderzocht of het opportuun is dat de Staat haar rechten zal effectueren
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Boer en Ziengs over de rijksgebouwen in Veenhuizen

MPs De Boer and Ziengs asked the Minister of Interior about federal buildings in Veenhuizen, including who is responsible for their use and whether a vocational school initiative (Metzelaar PraktijkGilde) could be housed there at comparable rents. The minister answered that responsibility depends on ownership (state assets managed by RVOB and Rijksgebouwendienst), that a market-rate lease offer was made but not agreed, and that the state cannot give targeted incentives without risking unlawful state aid.
There is no need to investigate this, since in April 2012 a lease offer at market-conform terms was made to Metzelaar PraktijkGilde for the building at Hospitaallaan 1.
Het is niet nodig om dit te onderzoeken aangezien er in april 2012 een huuraanbieding is gedaan aan Metzelaar PraktijkGilde tegen marktconforme voorwaarden voor het pand aan de Hospitaallaan 1.
Antwoord vragen Van Dam over onrechtmatigheden bij de verkiezingen op Curaçao

An MP asked the minister about reports of vote-buying in the 2012 Curaçao elections, the oversight of election legitimacy, and implementation of party-financing recommendations. The minister answered that election organisation and party financing are the responsibility of the autonomous Curaçao government, that the Kingdom has no role, and that international observers are now being considered.
The countries are autonomous and themselves responsible for safeguarding the democratic legal order and ensuring that elections are orderly and lawful.
De landen zijn autonoom en zelf verantwoordelijk voor het waarborgen van de democratische rechtsorde en er voor zorg te dragen dat verkiezingen ordelijk en rechtmatig verlopen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Monasch over exploderende huren in Amsterdam vanwege de ‘Donnerpunten’

MP Monasch asked the minister whether, after reports of social rents in Amsterdam rising above the liberalisation limit due to extra WWS points, he still considered rent increases acceptable, and whether the extra points unacceptably reduce rental supply. Minister Spies replied that no unacceptable rent rises had been shown, pointed to the forthcoming annual rent-trends report, and said the extra points do not unacceptably reduce supply since corporations are bound by local agreements and no signal of non-compliance is known to him.
This report will be available this autumn, after which it will be sent to the House of Representatives.
Dit rapport komt dit najaar beschikbaar waarna deze aan de Tweede Kamer zal worden toegezonden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht dat gemeenten woonwagenkampen mijden

An MP asked whether municipalities avoid enforcing law on caravan (woonwagen) sites, whether residents or staff face disproportionate aggression, and about victim support and training; the minister said 44 municipalities may face 'vrijplaats' problems, police do not record residence on caravan sites so no data exist, and referred to handbooks, anonymous reporting options and the Veilige Publieke Taak programme, with no concrete new commitment.
Police registration systems do not record whether a person lives on a caravan site.
In de registratiesystemen van de politie wordt niet vastgelegd of een persoon woont op een woonwagenlocatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over budget voor wijkenaanpak voor de wijk Kalsdonk in Roosendaal

An MP asked whether national funds were given to Roosendaal for the Kalsdonk neighbourhood, what they aim at, and how residents' concerns about youth nuisance, drug dealing and benefit fraud were being handled. The minister confirmed EUR 1 million for a socio-economic programme plus EUR 100,000 for resident budgets, said monitoring is primarily by the municipal council with yearly progress reports to parliament, and said the municipality is responsible and no further national involvement is planned.
Tackling the problems is primarily a responsibility of the municipality.
De aanpak van de problematiek is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Karabulut over de leegstand van woningen

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about reported vacancy of 77,000 social rental homes and 110,000 private rental homes and what action would be taken. The Minister found the 3% social rental vacancy acceptable, attributed it mainly to normal turnover and market reasons, could not provide a breakdown or regional data, and saw no reason for action.
As indicated in answer 2, the vast majority of vacancy at housing corporations is not related to their policy but is caused by regular turnover vacancy and vacancy for market reasons.

Zoals bij vraag 2 aangegeven is het overgrote deel van de leegstand bij woningcorporaties niet gerelateerd aan het door hen gevoerde beleid, maar wordt deze veroorzaakt door reguliere mutatieleegstand en door leegstand om marktredenen.
Antwoord vragen Voortman en Van Gent over het ontslag van klokkenluider bij VU Medisch Centrum

MPs Voortman and Van Gent asked whether the VU Medical Centre dismissed pulmonologist Postmus for raising patient safety concerns, and how whistleblowers in healthcare are protected. The minister says Postmus was placed on non-active status for an employment matter, not dismissed, promises intensified inspection and points to reporting channels and the new Adviespunt Klokkenluiders, but declines a separate inquiry into the case.
This concerns an employment-law matter whose content is not known to me.
Het gaat hier om een arbeidsrechtelijke zaak waarvan de inhoud mij niet bekend is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme inzake aanpak van brandveiligheid in stallen

An MP asked the state secretary and the interior minister about fire safety in livestock barns after pig deaths, and why a parliamentary motion requiring fire-safety rules by 1 January 2013 had not been implemented. The government answered that an Action Plan on barn fires has been drawn up, that research on current requirements is underway, and that advice on possible regulatory changes will follow by end 2012, without committing to new rules by the deadline.
The Action Plan provides for research into the adequacy of the current requirements and into how animals in practice can be better protected against fire through more effective regulation.

Het Actieplan voorziet in de uitvoering van een onderzoek naar de toereikendheid van de huidige eisen alsmede naar de wijze waarop dieren in de praktijk door effectievere regelgeving beter tegen brand beschermd kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Karabulut over bezoldiging van corporatiebestuurders en de algemene bedrijfslasten van woningcorporaties

Two SP MPs asked the minister about executive pay at housing corporations, the 2012 press-reported pay research, and a central public register of board and supervisory roles. The minister said pay disclosure is left to the sector code, a uniform reporting duty will follow under the WNT, nevenfuncties will be disclosed in annual reports, and no binding pay cap exists yet.
When the WNT is introduced a transitional regime will apply, through which remuneration will gradually be reduced to the applicable norms.
Bij invoering van de WNT gaat een overgangsrecht gelden, waarmee de beloningen geleidelijk naar de toepasselijke normen zullen worden teruggebracht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Boer over hoge beloningen van bestuurders van woningcorporaties

An MP asked the minister whether a third of housing corporation directors earned above the Balkenende norm, whether any such excess is acceptable, and whether the minister will get them to cut salaries. The minister said the data cover only 231 of 381 corporations and full 2011 figures are pending, that no statutory cap exists yet but the sector code applies and the forthcoming WNT will give enforcement powers, and that existing contracts will be phased down under transitional rules.
This data is currently being collected. As soon as the data is complete I will inform your House, as happens every year.
Momenteel worden deze gegevens verzameld. Zodra deze gegevens compleet zijn zal ik uw Kamer, zoals dit elk jaar gebeurt, hierover berichten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Verzekeraar wil luxe afkickresorts niet vergoeden’

An MP asked ministers whether the Jellinek Curaçao addiction retreat, subsidised with €600,000 under the Dutch Antilles programme, is too expensive, serves only wealthy patients, transferred expertise to local staff, and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The minister replied that local Curaçaos can apply on the same terms, the subsidy's job-creation and expertise goals were largely met, and no conditions on treating local addicts were attached to the subsidy.
No conditions were attached to the PSNA subsidy regarding the treatment of local addicts.
Vanuit de PSNA-subsidie zijn geen voorwaarden gesteld met betrekking tot het behandelen van lokale verslaafden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak over corruptie van politici op Bonaire

MP Van Raak asked whether a corruption probe on Bonaire, triggered by 2007 information from a governance foundation, was stalled and whether the Bonaire state reform or political pressure played a role in ending it, and what the minister would do to ensure independence. The minister answered that the investigation was halted by the investigating judge's decision and resumption ordered by the Court, that he has confidence in judicial independence and sees no sign of political interference, and referred to earlier answers for the timing questions.
I have firm confidence in judicial independence, and have no indication that the decisions mentioned are the result of political pressure or interference.
Ik heb vast vertrouwen in de rechterlijke onafhankelijkheid, en heb geen enkele aanwijzing dat de genoemde beslissingen het gevolg zijn van politieke druk of inmenging.
Antwoord vragen Ortega-Martijn en Schouten over corruptie van politici op Bonaire

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Schouten asked why the government did not act on long-standing corruption rumours on Bonaire, why the international corruption investigation was halted, and how public integrity will be strengthened. The minister replied that the Public Prosecution Service is pursuing criminal investigations, that earlier reports were forwarded to prosecutors, that the case was dismissed in 2011 but partly revived by a court in 2012, and that integrity is primarily the responsibility of the local administration with ministry-set preconditions.

On 13 September 2012 the Court declared the complaint well-founded for two dossiers forming part of the total investigation and instructed the Public Prosecution Service to prosecute the suspects for those offences.

Het Hof heeft deze klacht op 13 september 2012 gegrond verklaard voor twee dossiers die deel uitmaakten van het totale onderzoek, en het OM opgedragen de verdachten alsnog voor die feiten te vervolgen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de voortgang van het onderzoek naar de rechtsbescherming van woonbootbewoners

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about who will carry out the independent study on improving legal protection for houseboat residents, the study's research questions, whether residents should sit on the steering committee, and whether the study should be awaited before a pending rent-review procedure. The minister said the tender is not yet concluded and the client will be announced later, described the research questions and steering committee composition, declined to add a resident representative, and said the study will not judge the pending liggeld procedure.
I will inform you of who will carry out the study once the tender is concluded.
Ik zal u na afronding van de aanbesteding informeren wie het onderzoek gaat uitvoeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over de aanpak van derivatengebruik bij woningcorporaties

MPs Monasch and Groot asked whether a ban on speculative derivative positions should extend beyond formally approved housing associations to non-profit housing bodies, and how the planned AMvB listing permitted banks would be designed. The minister answered that the new rules apply only to toegelaten instellingen, that extension to other NWIs is not intended, and that the AMvB will be sent to parliament once drafted, with supervision and sound finance considered.
When the relevant AMvB (draft) is ready, I will send it to your House for discussion.
Als de betreffende AMvB (in concept) gereed is zal ik deze ter bespreking aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over het bericht dat een computervirus bij zeker 20 instellingen heeft toegeslagen

Rep. Heijnen asked about reports that the Dorifel computer virus hit around 20 institutions, including municipalities, companies and universities, and asked about its consequences, the NCSC response, costs, service impact, prevention, underreporting and the status of a breach-notification duty. The minister answered that the virus encrypts data without destroying it, that at least 30 institutions were hit, that the NCSC issued warnings and disrupted the botnet, that costs were modest and service disruption temporary, and that the breach-notification law is still being drafted.
Since there is not yet a notification duty, a complete picture cannot be given.
Aangezien er nog geen meldplicht bestaat kan geen compleet beeld worden gegeven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bemmel over het bericht “Amsterdam wil publiek geld inzetten voor sloop”

An MP from the PVV asks whether public money should be used to demolish vacant offices in Amsterdam and whether the government will object to this plan and inform the VNG. The minister answers that office owners are primarily responsible, points to the national convenant on vacant offices, says the Amsterdam regional fund is a municipal autonomy matter, and declines to intervene or inform the VNG.
In my view this is a clear case of municipal autonomy.
Mijns inziens betreft het hier een duidelijk geval van gemeentelijke autonomie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Knops over het bericht ‘Anderhalf keer Balkenende-norm voor fusiedirecteur’

An MP from the CDA asks whether the reported salary of about €275,000 for the director-board member of the merging housing corporations in Landgraaf and Kerkrade, and the failure of supervisory boards to set it in line with sector codes, is acceptable, and what means the minister has to enforce compliance. The minister replies that the merger is still under way and no salary has been set, that enforcement of sector codes lies with the branch itself, and that he will press for compliance at the merger decision and rely on the Woningwet/WNT powers once in force.
I do not have the formal legal means to enforce application of the sector codes.
Ik beschik niet over de formele wettelijke middelen om de toepassing van de sectorcodes af te dwingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Monasch over overvragende woningcorporaties en toereikende financiële buffers bij woningbouwcorporaties

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about Amsterdam housing corporations charging very high rents, a 37m2 unit liberalised above the rent-control threshold, the drop in affordable rentals after the WWS point increases, and whether corporations have sufficient financial buffers to support Vestia and invest. The minister replied that corporations may set rents within legal limits, that no failure to honour the Amsterdam agreements is known, and that the sector as a whole is financially capable of its investments, while not ruling out undisclosed financial problems at individual corporations.
I am not aware of any signal that the corporations are not honouring their agreements in this regard.
Mij is geen signaal bekend dat de corporaties hun afspraken in deze niet nakomen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent en Hachchi over de verwoestende olievervuiling op de kusten van Curaçao

Two MPs asked whether PdVSA delayed acting on an oil leak at Bullenbaai, Curaçao, what the scale was, whether it was deliberate, and whether the Kingdom government should intervene given PdVSA's record. The minister answered that the government cannot judge the cause and that the Curaçao prime minister's investigation may clarify it, that the situation is an incident rather than irreversible, and that Curaçao as an autonomous country must lead the response and prevent recurrence.
Curaçao is an autonomous country within the Kingdom. It is therefore up to the government of Curaçao to lead the further containment of the pollution and the clean-up operations.
Curaçao is een autonoom land binnen het Koninkrijk. Het is daarom aan de regering van Curaçao om leiding te geven aan verdere indamming van de vervuiling en de opruimwerkzaamheden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gent over mogelijke malversaties in het verkiezingsproces op Bonaire

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that people on Bonaire were urged not to vote in the 2012 Tweede Kamer election and pressured to surrender their voting passes, and what the government had done to counter this. The minister confirmed that groups opposed to the constitutional reforms were calling for abstention and that the government ran an information campaign, notified the prosecutor, and issued a joint statement warning that forced surrender of voting passes may be a criminal offence, while stating that no other incidents were known and that adequate action had been taken.
The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations was informed on Tuesday 11 September about the actions on Bonaire to collect voting passes.
Het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties is op dinsdag 11 september geïnformeerd over de acties op Bonaire om stempassen in te zamelen.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Heijnen over de behandeling van mensen in Nederlandse en Nederlands-Indische overheidsdienst die indertijd hebben geweigerd mee te doen aan de politionele acties

MPs Timmermans and Heijnen asked ministers about rehabilitation and treatment of Dutch and Dutch East Indies civil servants and military personnel who refused to take part in the police actions, including how many were punished and whether they will be rehabilitated. The government answered that the numbers of refusers among civil servants and colonial staff are unknown, declined to discuss an individual case, and said it will not reassess past individual conduct against today's norms.

Recognising that the period in question is now viewed in a different light, I do not consider it careful to reassess the conduct of individual persons in general terms against today's norms and with present-day knowledge.

In het besef dat de desbetreffende periode nu in een ander licht wordt gezien, acht ik het niet zorgvuldig de toetsing van het gedrag van individuele personen in algemene zin te herbeoordelen aan de hand van de hedendaagse normen en met de wetenschap van nu.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Recourt en Heijnen over de kritiek van de Nationale Ombudsman op de benoemingsprocedure van de vice-president van de Raad van State

MPs Recourt and Heijnen asked why the government will not implement a motion giving parliament a role in appointing the Raad van State vice-president, and whether the appointment procedure lacked transparency as the Ombudsman found. The ministers answered that appointments are a government power, that a constitutional change would be needed for a parliamentary role, and that the procedure was transparent, with the speculation not proving coordinated conduct.
Giving the Tweede Kamer a statutory role in the appointment procedure, for example in the form of a nomination right, is therefore only possible if the Constitution is amended in this respect.

Het toekennen van een wettelijke rol aan de Tweede Kamer in de benoemingsprocedure, bijvoorbeeld in de vorm van een voordrachtsrecht, is daarom slechts mogelijk als de Grondwet in deze zin wordt gewijzigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over vele kiesgerechtigden die mogelijk op 12 september niet kunnen stemmen

An MP asks whether voters who moved to another municipality after the 31 July cutoff can still vote, and how many are affected. The minister confirms voters keep their old municipality's pass, can request a voting pass or proxy by 29 August, and proposes extending the deadlines in pending Kieswet amendments.
For your information, the pending proposal to amend the Kieswet in the House of Representatives extends the deadline for applying for a voting pass or a written proxy.

Voor uw informatie geldt dat in het voorstel tot wijziging van de Kieswet die in de Tweede Kamer ligt, de termijn om een kiezerspas respectievelijk een schriftelijke volmacht aan te vragen wordt verlengd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gent over de enorme stijging van de elektriciteitsprijzen op Bonaire

MP Van Gent asked the ministers about a reported 50 percent electricity price rise on Bonaire after an arbitration ruling in the WEB-Ecopower dispute, its causes, renewable energy investment and whether the increase will be blocked. The minister confirmed the arbitration obligations, said the prices were not adjusted since 2010, that a tariff decision lies with the Bonaire public body, and that the government plans legal rules requiring efficient, cost-covering tariffs with supervision and is discussing temporary limits on the increase.
The Public Body of Bonaire is responsible for deciding on the level of the new tariffs.
Het Openbaar Lichaam Bonaire is verantwoordelijk om over de hoogte van de nieuwe tarieven een besluit te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosman en Leegte over het bericht ‘Desastreuze stroomprijs Bonaire’?

Two VVD MPs asked ministers whether WEB on Bonaire had deliberately underpaid Ecopower for electricity, whether the island government shares responsibility, and how tariffs, transparency and cross-subsidies work. Minister Verhagen answered that the dispute was settled via arbitration, that the island executive council sets tariffs and has not adjusted them since July 2010, and that an audit and a new tariff proposal are pending.
Under the Electricity Concessions BES Act, the island executive council is authorised to set tariffs for the supply of electricity.
Het bestuurscollege is op grond van de wet Elektriciteitsconcessies BES bevoegd om de tarieven voor de levering van elektriciteit vast te stellen.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over het rapport meldpunt Donnerhuren

Karabulut (SP) asked the minister of Interior about a report on rent increases caused by 'Donnerpunten' (extra WWS points for renovated homes), including a 20% jump in social rents, rents for forced movers, and whether the measure should be scrapped. Minister Spies answered that rent increases for sitting tenants are limited to indexation and the annual maximum, that movers keep a choice, and that it is too early to draw conclusions, so the measure will not be scrapped.
Drawing conclusions about the effects of this measure now is not possible in my view.
Nu al conclusies trekken over de effecten van deze maatregel acht ik niet mogelijk.
Vragen van het lid Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de exploderende huren in Amsterdam door de Donnerpunten (ingezonden 21 augustus 2012).

The MP asks the minister how rent increases in Amsterdam's social rental sector from the extra rent points for scarcity areas ('Donnerpunten') should be explained, whether the predecessor's expectation of limited effects still holds, whether corporations should stop charging maximum rents, and whether the higher rents for new tenants should be reconsidered. The minister disputes the 'exploding rents' framing, relies on a selective complaint-based report, declines to halt corporation practice, and defends the policy as a balance between market conformity and tenant protection, promising only an annual report later.

This report therefore offers only limited opportunities to gain insight into rent developments in the social rental sector in Amsterdam and other scarcity areas as a result of the maximum 25 additional WWS points.

Dit rapport biedt daardoor slechts beperkte mogelijkheden om inzicht te verkrijgen in de huurprijsontwikkeling in de sociale huursector in Amsterdam en andere schaarstegebieden als gevolg van de maximaal 25 extra WWS-punten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Heijnen en Van Dam over de vele dienstreizen van Nederlandse ambtenaren naar de BES-eilanden

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior about the large number of civil servant business trips to the Caribbean Netherlands islands, asking for per-department figures, how trips are assessed, whether limits should be set, and whether trips should be reduced. The minister gave figures only for his own ministry (189 trips, purpose not recorded), said each department decides on necessity, pointed to video-conferencing and twice-yearly meetings to reduce travel, and agreed in principle that trips could be reduced while leaving implementation to each department.
No, I can only provide you with an overview of the number of business trips for my own department.
Nee, ik kan u enkel voor mijn eigen departement een overzicht van het aantal dienstreizen geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de kosten voor reizen van ambtenaren naar Saba, St. Eustatius en Bonaire

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about the travel costs of civil servants to Saba, Statia and Bonaire, including a Commissariaat voor de Media visit to Saba despite no TV media there, and whether such trips are unnecessary. The minister said only BZK's total of €580,588 (2010 to August 2012) could be provided, defended the trips as necessary for new rules and oversight, and rejected the claim that they are wasteful.
I cannot provide you with an overview of the total travel costs of all departments. This falls under the responsibility of each individual department.
Ik kan u geen overzicht van de totale reiskosten van alle departementen verschaffen. Dit valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van elk afzonderlijk departement.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kortenoeven over het gevaar van de islamitische Libanese terreurorganisatie Hezbollah voor de veiligheid in Europa

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Interior whether the US assessment that Hezbollah may strike in Europe is endorsed, and why Hezbollah is not fully listed on the EU terrorist list. The minister answered that Hezbollah is a terrorist organisation, that Dutch services see no current heightened threat, and that the Netherlands has long favoured full EU listing and will raise the matter again in the EU.
The Netherlands advocates full listing of Hezbollah on the EU terrorism list.
Nederland pleit voor integrale plaatsing van Hezbollah op de EU-terrorismelijst.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bochove over het besluit van de voorzitter van de Staten van Curaçao om de openbare vergaderingen van de Staten van Curaçao voor onbepaalde tijd te schorsen

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the Curaçao Staten chair's indefinite suspension of plenary sessions, reportedly until after elections, complies with the Staten's wishes and the rules, and what it means for democracy and Kingdom relations. The minister confirmed no plenary sessions had been held, said the suspension conflicts with the Staten's Rules of Procedure and has no basis in other ordinances, called it a worrying democratic situation, but said the matter is primarily for Curaçao to resolve and the Netherlands is waiting.
Suspending Staten sessions indefinitely is contrary to the Staten of Curaçao's Rules of Procedure and, as far as I can determine, has no basis in any other national ordinance.

Het voor onbepaalde tijd opschorten van Statenvergaderingen is in strijd met het Reglement van Orde van de Staten van Curaçao en vindt, voor zover ik kan nagaan, ook geen basis in enige andere landsverordening.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over het artikel ‘Geld gratis onderwijs is ‘lening’ RdK' (Refineria di Kòrsou)

An MP asked whether Curaçao is funding free education through a dividend advance from a state-owned company, and whether this undermines public finances and Dutch-financed debt relief. The minister answered that the Cft has asked the Curaçao government for information three times without response, that the arrangement would appear to breach the Rijkswet and national rules, and that the Cft did not advise on it because it falls outside its legal scope.

The Cft itself indicates that the financial position of state-owned companies, and perhaps even more pressingly of the social funds, gives it reason to take these institutions into account more explicitly when assessing the countries' budgets.

Het Cft zelf geeft aan dat de financiële positie van overheidsvennootschappen, maar misschien nog wel actueler, van de sociale fondsen, voor het Cft aanleiding zijn om bij het beoordelen van de begrotingen van de landen deze instellingen nog nadrukkelijker mee te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over het bericht dat het demissionaire kabinet het openbaar bestuur minder openbaar wil maken

MP Heijnen asked the Minister of Interior whether the government plans to restrict the Dutch Freedom of Information Act (Wob) and why, and whether a independent commissioner should rule on disputes over disclosure. The minister says openness remains the starting point, a draft amendment targets abusive and disproportionately large requests rather than restricting access, and an independent commissioner is rejected in favour of informal contact.
Openness of government information is and remains, as far as this cabinet is concerned, the starting point of the Wob.
Openbaarheid van overheidsinformatie is en dat blijft, als het aan dit kabinet ligt, ook het uitgangspunt van de Wob.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over de situatie rond het asbest in woningen in de Utrechtse wijk Kanaleneiland

An MP asked about the implementation of a motion requiring agreements with housing associations to inform tenants of asbestos, whether Mitros knew of asbestos in its homes in Kanaleneiland, and whether residents can be warned in advance of renovations. The minister points to a Handboek Asbest produced with Aedes, says Mitros's own inventory showed asbestos and that the question of what it should have known awaits further investigation, and states that no list of asbestos buildings exists while mandatory inventories apply to pre-1994 buildings before work.
Whether Mitros should reasonably have known this, and how it handled the asbestos find during the work, will have to emerge from the promised further investigation.
Of Mitros dit redelijkerwijs had moeten weten en hoe met deze vondst van het asbest tijdens de werkzaamheden is omgegaan zal uit het toegezegde nader onderzoek moeten blijken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over problemen met stemmen voor blinden en slechtzienden

An MP asked why the 2010 tactile voting template for blind and partially sighted voters was not continued, and whether every polling station will have such an aid and whether voters can vote secretly and unassisted. The minister said the template was too large and complex and that work continues on a simpler ballot model, while assisted voting and proxy voting must remain available.
Therefore the cabinet is working on developing a new model ballot with which blind and partially sighted people can cast their vote independently, using a template.
Daarom werkt het kabinet aan de ontwikkeling van een nieuw model stembiljet waarmee blinden en slechtzienden zelfstandig, met behulp van een mal, hun stem kunnen uitbrengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over het gebruik van Yammer door Nederlandse overheidsinstanties en de onbeperkte toegang van Amerikaanse autoriteiten tot die gegevens

MP El Fassed asked whether US authorities have unrestricted access to Dutch government data via Yammer, why it is used, whether risks were assessed, and what measures will close the alleged leak. Minister Spies replied that there is no unrestricted access, that interdepartmental guidelines apply, that confidential information may not be shared, and that no leak is seen so no additional measures are planned.
There is no unrestricted and uncontrolled access for the American authorities.
Er is geen sprake van een onbeperkte en ongecontroleerde toegang voor de Amerikaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Boer over het Amsterdamse ‘convenant tegen verhuur aan criminelen’

Rep. De Boer (VVD) asked the Minister of the Interior about the Amsterdam covenant against renting homes and business premises to criminals, asking about its scale, national relevance, enforcement, and whether the government would support it. The minister answered that such misuse occurs, that enforcement is integrated across police, municipality, tax authority and prosecutors, and that the Wwft obligations for estate agents apply, without committing to a new concrete action.
Although it must be assumed that this also occurs outside this region, there is no complete picture of this.
Hoewel moet worden aangenomen dat dit over buiten deze regio voorkomt, bestaat daardaarover geen volledig beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de vervanging van volksvertegenwoordigers die door een ongeval in coma zijn geraakt

An MP asked whether a legal mechanism can be created to temporarily replace a municipal councillor who is in a coma after an accident, as in Schouwen-Duiveland. The minister explained the existing leave rules, said a scheme modelled on the one for aldermen could be considered but has limits, and declined to commit to a bill because a permanent solution would require a constitutional amendment.
For a scheme, article X 10 of the Kieswet would have to be amended.
Voor een regeling zou artikel X 10 van de Kieswet moeten worden aangepast.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Omtzigt en van Bochove over het bericht dat het aantal mensen met een betalingsachterstand op de hypotheek de afgelopen vier jaar verdubbeld is

Two CDA MPs asked the government about the doubling of mortgage payment arrears, whether homeowners can rent out part of their home given bank consent and tenancy protection, whether students will face delays finding rooms, and whether a quick short-lease option could be introduced. The minister confirmed the arrears figure, explained that banks must be asked for consent and that the hospitality rule and the tax room-rental exemption already apply, and pointed to the national student housing action plan, without proposing new legislation.
In view of the above, I am of the opinion that measures are already in place, both on tenancy protection and tax legislation, that facilitate the renting of rooms.
Gezien het bovenstaande ben ik van mening dat al voorzien is in maatregelen zowel qua huurbescherming als qua belastingwetgeving die het verhuren van kamers faciliteren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Brinkman over het bericht “Verkiezingsdebat: gemeente eist exclusiviteit in Brabants Dagblad”

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a Tilburg municipal subsidy for an election debate, conditional on exclusivity from the Brabants Dagblad and limited to certain parties, misuses public funds and violates press freedom. The minister replied that municipal subsidy policy is the municipality's responsibility, that no statutory rules are needed, and that the exclusivity condition does not violate press freedom since the newspaper may freely decline it.
Municipal subsidy policy is a competence and responsibility of the municipalities.
Het gemeentelijk subsidiebeleid is een bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat in de gemeente Opmeer (Noord-Holland) burgers/vrijwilligers geen stembureaus meer mogen bemannen

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the municipality of Opmeer's decision to staff polling stations only with officials and councillors, excluding volunteers, was justified and whether it is common, and what is being done about counting errors. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible for appointing polling station members, that the decision was based on evaluations of counting differences, that the government values volunteers but respects the municipality's choice, and that the municipality will evaluate the upcoming election.
Appointing polling station members is the responsibility of the college of mayor and aldermen.
Het benoemen van stembureauleden is de verantwoordelijkheid van het college van burgemeester en wethouders.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Elissen over de nieuw paspoorten die grote beveiligingsproblemen kennen

An MP from the PVV asked the Interior Minister whether he recognises serious security vulnerabilities in the new Dutch passports (chip can be remotely activated and data copied) and what measures will be taken against identity fraud and terrorism. The minister acknowledges the issues were already known and reported to parliament in 2005 and 2008, points to the Extended Access Control protection added in 2009, and stresses that fraud detection depends on proper document checks, without announcing new concrete measures.
I recall that your House has been informed about both aspects.
Ik memoreer dat over beide aspecten uw Kamer geïnformeerd is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het vrouwenstandpunt van de SGP

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the ECHR ruling on the SGP's exclusion of women from passive voting rights, and what measures would end it before upcoming elections. The minister said the SGP is being asked to consult on consequences, the government is considering measures if the SGP does not act, and that candidate lists for the coming Tweede Kamer elections are already final.
I will inform the House of Representatives by letter of further decision-making on this matter.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer middels een brief op de hoogte stellen van nadere besluitvorming hieromtrent.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over verlies SGP van vrouwenzaak bij Europees Hof

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the government will force the SGP to stop excluding women from its candidate lists following the European Court of Human Rights ruling and the 2010 Dutch Supreme Court judgment. The minister said the SGP must first find a way to allow women, that he has asked the SGP leadership for its response and will consult it shortly, and that he will inform parliament by letter about further measures.
I have asked the SGP leadership in writing which consequences it intends to attach to the European Court of Human Rights decision and to consult with me on this.

Ik heb het hoofdbestuur van de SGP schriftelijk gevraagd welke consequenties het voornemens is te verbinden aan de beslissing van het Europees Hof voor de Mensenrechten (EHRM) en om hierover met mij in overleg te treden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Brinkman over het bericht dat de afkoopsom van de bestuurder van het Maasstad Ziekenhuis

MP Brinkman asks the minister whether it is objectionable that severance payments for hospital board members have risen sharply while the government cuts spending, and whether board members causing proven mismanagement should be prosecuted and excluded from such payments. The minister points to the pending bill capping executive pay and severance at EUR 75,000, and says boards can be held liable and that severance depends on contract terms and the supervisory board, which must take the initiative.
Whether a severance premium is paid depends on the contractual agreements (between the board member and the Supervisory Board).
Het al dan niet betalen van een vertrekpremie hangt af van de contractuele afspraken erover (tussen de bestuurder en de Raad van Toezicht)
Antwoord vragen Thieme over Bonaire die wilde ezels als lastdier naar Haïti wil sturen

An MP asked whether Bonaire's plan to capture wild donkeys and ship them to Haiti as pack animals is supported by the Dutch government, and asked for humane alternatives. The state secretary replied that the Dutch government has no role in the plan, that Bonaire's public body is primarily responsible for stock management and is still studying options, and that the government will await the proposal and is willing to discuss it if Bonaire asks.
The primary responsibility for initiating, shaping and implementing stock management of these donkeys lies with the public body of Bonaire.
Het is de primaire verantwoordelijkheid van het openbaar lichaam Bonaire bestandsbeheer t.a.v. deze ezels te initiëren, dit vorm en inhoud te geven en vervolgens te implementeren.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over het mogelijk op straat belanden van gezinnen uit de Furmerusflat in Sneek

MP Karabulut asked whether families from the Furmerusflat in Sneek face homelessness when their temporary tenancies end on 23 August, and whether housing corporation Accolade should be held to account and a fair transition arranged. Minister Donner replied that the residents hold loan contracts with leegstandsbeheerder Carex, not leases, that most have found new housing, that Accolade has no legal relationship with them, that the corporation will not be called to account, and that no means are seen to prevent the end of the temporary occupancy.
Housing corporation Accolade has no legal relationship with the residents of the Furmerusflat.
Woningcorporatie Accolade heeft geen juridische relatie met de bewoners van de Furmerusflat.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaveren en Wilders over de komst van een moskee na administratief geblunder van de gemeente

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether a mosque replacing a church after a municipal administrative error should be opposed and how the municipality of Utrecht could be made to reverse the decision. The minister answered that religious freedom applies to all faiths, that the municipality corrected its error by excluding the church plan, and that the minister would not comment on local matters.
It does not befit me as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to comment on local matters.
Het past mij als minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties niet om mij uit te laten over lokale aangelegenheden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi over het adviseurschap van het instituut Dar-al-‘Ilm

MP Dibi asked whether the government takes advice from the Dar-al-'Ilm institute, which hosts the controversial preacher Haitham al-Haddad, and whether it is transparent about external advisers. The minister said he rejects al-Haddad's views, will not use the institute's services himself, cannot confirm which bodies have used it, and that full transparency on external advisers across government is not feasible.

From my position and from the position of the minister of BZK, it is however not possible to have a complete overview of the external hiring of advisers across the whole government and all Dutch institutions.

Vanuit mijn positie en vanuit de positie van de minister van BZK is het echter niet mogelijk om een volledig overzicht te hebben van de externe inhuur van adviseurs bij de gehele overheid en bij alle Nederlandse instellingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over islamitische sekseongelijkheid bij de naturalisatieceremonie

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a naturalisation is valid when a Muslim woman did not personally take the oath, what the consequences are, and whether immigrants who reject gender equality should be barred from citizenship or face expulsion under an assimilation contract. The minister replied that the woman did in fact take the oath alongside her husband, that integration courses cover gender equality, and that assimilation is not an aim of integration, though demands that a husband take the oath for his wife would not be accepted.
Contrary to what the question states, the woman did take the declaration of allegiance.
Anders dan de vraag stelt, heeft de vrouw de verklaring van verbondenheid wel afgelegd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Elissen over bizarre stijging parkeertarieven

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior whether the government would cap or unify municipal parking tariffs nationwide after a reported 15% rise in street parking prices, and whether a national parking law should be introduced. The Minister replied that parking tariffs fall under municipal autonomy, that councils are best placed to set them, and that he will not set limits or change policy on this basis.
The height of parking tariffs is part of municipal autonomy.
De hoogte van de parkeertarieven is onderdeel van de gemeentelijke autonomie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Monasch over de bijgestelde verkoopplannen van het ouderencomplex 55 plus door woningcorporatie Stichting Ouderenhuisvesting Rotterdam

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior about the prolonged, repeatedly delayed sale of the Prinsehof 55+ elderly complex by housing corporation SOR, including neglected maintenance, residents left uncertain, and whether new advice rounds and parliamentary consultation should precede irreversible steps. The minister confirms the delays, states the corporation will provide clarity around September with a sale-leaseback arrangement, agrees a new advice round is needed for a possible sale, but declines to consult parliament before irreversible steps, citing his own competence.
I have independent authority to take decisions subject to review against the regulations.
Ik heb eigenstandige bevoegdheid tot het nemen van besluiten onder toetsing aan de regelgeving.
Antwoord vragen Timmermans en Heijnen en Taverne over problemen bij het stemmen in het buitenland

MPs Timmermans, Heijnen and Taverne asked whether Dutch citizens abroad calling the DUTCHHELP line were given incorrect information, including that they could vote online, and why election information was not on all Dutch missions' websites and at counters. The minister answered that no online voting was mentioned, only registration (which can partly be done online), that election links were provided on embassy and consulate sites, and that posts promoted registration and displayed the website at counters.
No. There is no mention of casting a vote via the internet; however, information is provided on how and where one can register.
Neen. Er wordt niet gesproken over het uitbrengen van de stem via internet; wel wordt informatie verstrekt over hoe en waar men zich kan registreren.
Antwoord vragen Sterk en Hachchi over Nederlands-Pakistaanse vrouw die in huwelijkse gevangenschap in Pakistan verkeert

MPs Sterk and Hachchi asked about a Dutch-Pakistani woman held in a forced marriage in Pakistan, what the embassy had done, and whether the government would act on religious divorce and women's rights. The minister said he could not comment on the individual case for privacy reasons, that the embassy assists consular cases on request, and that he would raise the issue in EU settings.
To protect the identity of the person concerned, I cannot make a substantive statement about the case.
Ter bescherming van de identiteit van betrokkene, kan ik over de zaak geen inhoudelijke uitspraak doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Boer over erfpacht in Amsterdam

Mr De Boer (VVD) asked the minister of Interior about municipalities changing their leasehold (erfpacht) policies in Amsterdam and elsewhere, including which municipalities still use leasehold, the number of contracts and revenues, and whether an evaluation would be done. The minister said there is no integral overview, listed changes in several cities, said Amsterdam keeps leasehold, and agreed to commission an inventory of municipal experiences and inform parliament around the new year.
I am willing to have an inventory made of the experiences of municipalities that now offer existing leaseholders the option to acquire full ownership
Ik ben bereid een inventarisatie te laten doen van de ervaringen bij gemeenten die inmiddels de mogelijkheid bieden voor bestaande erfpachters ook de volledige eigendom te verwerven
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen en Ulenbelt over de toepassing van PUR-schuim bij de isolatie van begane grondvloeren

MPs Paulus Jansen and Ulenbelt asked about health complaints from PUR foam insulation under ground-floor slabs, inspection oversight, municipal building control, and isocyanate risks. The minister answered that inspectorates have no view of complaint scale, that private certification (BRL 1332) is considered sufficient without extra public checks, and that no evidence yet shows unacceptable risks, though further fire-safety research will be reported later.
To supplement this with random public inspection, I see no reason.
Voor aanvulling daarvan met steekproefsgewijze publieke controle zie ik geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn over de brief van Own Your Own Home Foundation te Saba

An MP asked the minister about a letter from Own Your Own Home Foundation on Saba, which says it lacks funds for housing maintenance and asks for rent subsidies or compensation. The minister answered that the foundation is not a regulated housing association so there is no financial oversight, rent subsidies will not be introduced because they do not fit the Caribbean tax system, and the funding gap was addressed through the spring budget.
I have no insight into the financial situation of OYOHF because OYOHF is not a recognised institution to which the Social Rental Sector Management Decree applies.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de financiële situatie van OYOHF daar de OYOHF geen toegelaten instelling waarop het Besluit beheer sociale huursector (Bbsh) van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans en Heijnen over Nederlanders in het buitenland die op 12 september 2012 willen stemmen

MPs Timmermans and Heijnen asked whether Dutch citizens abroad can register and vote in the 12 September 2012 election, given registration backlogs, staffing, and slow postal delivery of ballots. Minister Donner replied that registration is running normally at about 30,000 requests with roughly 2% rejected, that 36 temporary staff are handling it with capacity expandable if needed, and that ballots will be sent once candidate lists are final, with embassy drop-off points and proxy voting as fallbacks.
If necessary, capacity will be expanded.
Indien nodig zal de capaciteit worden uitgebreid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bochove en Monasch over de ontwikkeling van Lelystad

MPs Van Bochove and Monasch asked about the development of Lelystad, including the Lelystadtafel commitments, fragmented housing ownership from the Centrada sale obligations, and the lack of private renovation funds. The minister responded that the municipality received funds and an extra annual contribution, that responsibility for the sales lies with the corporation and owners, and that a round-table with relevant parties will be organised to seek solutions.
It is important that with fragmented ownership the approach to corporation and private homes is aligned.
Het is belangrijk dat bij versnipperd bezit de aanpak van de woningen van corporaties en particulieren wordt afgestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over netneutraliteit

An SGP MP asked ministers about the Dutch net neutrality law, including criticism from EU Commissioner Kroes and OPTA, and whether the ban on ideologically motivated internet filtering by providers conflicts with the constitution and ECHR. The minister rejects these criticisms, defends the law as protecting freedom of expression and consumer choice, and declines an OPTA review for now because the law has not yet taken effect.
I do not see the value of such a study at this moment, because the law has just been adopted by the States General.
Ik zie het nut van zo’n onderzoek op dit moment niet in, omdat de wet net door de Staten-Generaal is aangenomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Verhoeven over verkoop van goederen via een webwinkel op een perceel met bestemming "bedrijfslocatie"

An MP asks ministers whether municipal zoning rules that treat webshops like physical retail, and a court ruling allowing municipalities to exclude webshops from certain zones, create uncertainty and economic harm, and whether national rules should be updated. The state secretary answers that there is no national rule on webshop locations, that zoning is a municipal and provincial matter, and that no national steps are planned.
I therefore see no reason to take further steps at national level here.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om van rijkswege hier nadere stappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over de uitreiking van de huisjesmelkerprijs 2012 door ROOD

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about a landlord award given by ROOD, the alleged neglect of rental homes, unlawful service charges and intimidation, and whether a licensing system for landlords would be introduced, plus a related student housing question. The Minister said tenants can use the rental commission and courts and police, declined a general landlord licensing scheme as bureaucratic, and promised new proposals for serious cases of landlord abuse, expected in spring 2013.
There are good legal possibilities for tenants to assert their rights.
Er bestaan goede wettelijke mogelijkheden voor huurders om hun recht te halen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lucassen over het bericht dat banken geen kredieten meer verlenen aan woningcorporaties

An MP asked whether commercial banks are ceasing to lend to housing corporations and what the consequences would be for their finances, construction output and rating of the guarantee fund WSW. The minister answered that banks are only more critical, mainly on non-DAEB activities, that BNG and Waterschapsbank remain available, and that the WSW rating is unchanged, while promising no concrete new action.
As already indicated in the answer to question 2, it still has to be seen to what extent there will actually be more limited credit provision to housing corporations.
Zoals in de beantwoording van vraag 2 reeds is aangegeven, zal nog moeten blijken in hoeverre er daadwerkelijk sprake zal zijn van een beperktere kredietverlening aan woningcorporaties.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over het bericht dat in Amsterdam meer woningen worden gesplitst dan is toegestaan

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the 25 extra rent-points rule, which allows higher rents in sought-after areas, is behind unlawful flat-splitting and rent rises in Amsterdam, and whether it will be reversed. The minister replied that the rule does not affect sitting tenancies, that Amsterdam is responsible for enforcing splitting limits through its housing ordinance, and that there is no reason to reverse the measure.
Under the Housing Act, municipalities can steer on the splitting of dwellings at local level.
Op basis van de Huisvestingswet kan er op gemeentelijk niveau gestuurd worden op het splitsen van woningen.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over uitblijvende nieuwbouw en verbouwingsprojecten door de problemen bij Vestia

An SP MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether the Vestia financial crisis is halting housing construction and renovation projects in deprived Hague and Rotterdam neighbourhoods, whether the minister accepts responsibility, and what solutions exist for tenants. The minister acknowledges the halted investments, says he is consulting municipalities and Aedes on alternatives, accepts responsibility for the housing policy, and promises to inform the Chamber.
On both points, I therefore take my responsibility.
Op beide punten neem ik dus mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hachchi en Van Gent over aanhoudende ontevredenheid op de BES-eilanden

MPs Hachchi and Van Gent asked the minister about lasting dissatisfaction on the BES islands, including Bonaire, its causes, purchasing power research, constitutional anchoring of island status, and information gaps. The minister acknowledged pockets of discontent, denied riot threats, deferred to later policy notes, and argued the islands already have sufficient information channels, rejecting a liaison in The Hague.
I therefore do not believe that the island governments would be unable to have sufficient information.
Ik ben dan ook niet van mening dat de eilandbesturen niet in staat zouden zijn over voldoende informatie te beschikken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gent over de toekomstplannen van de ISLA raffinaderij te Curaçao

An MP asked the ministers of Interior and Kingdom Relations and of Infrastructure and Environment about Curaçao's plans for the ISLA refinery, including the basis for its choices, timelines, and whether it should cause no pollution after modernisation. The government replied that the matter is autonomous for Curaçao, the plan follows the Ecorys report, no timeline is given, and it will keep Parliament informed.
It is not appropriate for the Dutch government to have an opinion on this, because it is an autonomous matter for Curaçao.
Het past de Nederlandse regering niet hier een mening over te hebben, omdat dit een autonome aangelegenheid is van Curaçao.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bochove en Paulus Jansen over brandpreventie door middel van slimme gasmeters

MPs Van Bochove and Paulus Jansen asked whether a smart gas meter concept for gas leak detection and automatic shut-off, nominated for a fire safety innovation prize, could add fire safety, support rollout of smart meters, face legal barriers, and warrant a cost-benefit analysis. The minister answered that the concept may contribute to fire safety, that building and gas law do not hinder it, that a cost-benefit analysis is not appropriate since the idea is at an early stage, and that network operators are willing to examine feasibility with the developer.
A cost-benefit analysis is not something I consider appropriate.
Een kosten batenanalyse acht ik niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dibi naar aanleiding van het nieuwsbericht “Journalisten spioneerden voor de AIVD” in de Telegraaf van 15 juni 2012

An MP asked whether the AIVD paid journalists to gather intelligence during the 2008 Beijing Olympics and whether it should be restricted from using journalists as sources. The minister declined to confirm or deny the report in public, said AIVD staff follow a careful weighing process and internal instructions when approaching anyone, and rejected excluding journalists in principle.
I cannot make any public statement about whether the report is correct or incorrect.
Over de juistheid, dan wel de onjuistheid van het bericht kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Heijnen en Dijksma over de kosten van het onderzoek naar de toestanden bij het Centraal Orgaan Opvang Asielzoekers (COA)

Two PvdA MPs asked why the COA investigation into conditions at the asylum reception agency cost over €900,000 and questioned the procurement, staffing, consultancy and oversight of those costs. The minister defended the cost as necessary for thorough investigations, explained the expense items and procurement via a tender, and disclosed the COA lawyers' and legal support costs.
Het bedrag is zonder meer omvangrijk.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over het artikel ‘27 weken zwangere toeriste niet welkom’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a 27-week pregnant Dutch tourist was refused entry to Curaçao over fears of a birth burdening the island, whether Dutch citizens with valid passports are refused entry, and whether the Curaçao minister should be addressed. The minister said an individual immigration officer erred, the woman was then admitted, the incident is regrettable, no reason exists to address the Curaçao minister, and he lacks data on uninsured Curaçao users of Dutch healthcare.
Due to an error by an individual immigration officer at Hato Airport, a Dutch woman was not immediately granted access to Curaçao, although she held a valid passport.
Door een fout van een individuele immigratiefunctionaris op Hato Airport heeft een Nederlandse vrouw niet direct toegang gekregen tot Curaçao, terwijl zij wel in bezit was van een geldig paspoort.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Driessen over kenniscentrum E-Quality en de afscheidsreceptie van zijn directeur

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about subsidies to knowledge centre E-Quality, the costs of a farewell reception for its director, and whether future subsidies should be stopped. The minister listed the subsidy amounts from 2007 to 2012 and said the reception costs were not yet known, and declined to end subsidies, citing the emancipation subsidy scheme.
The costs of the event are not known at this moment; what costs were involved will become clear in the accountability report.
De kosten van de bijeenkomst zijn op dit moment niet bekend; welke kosten hiermee gemoeid waren zal blijken bij de verantwoording.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Boer over het gedwongen duurzaam maken van woningen in Amsterdam-West

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether Amsterdam-West's district council may compel homeowners to make homes more sustainable, and whether this breaches property rights and should be halted through consultation. The minister replied that compulsion is limited to exceptional cases under article 13 of the Woningwet, subject to motivation and court appeal, that no compulsory orders have yet been issued, and that no consultation is planned.

Under article 13 of the Housing Act, the competent authority may oblige an owner (or whoever is otherwise competent) to take measures that exceed the level for existing buildings under the Building Decree 2012

Op grond van artikel 13 van de Woningwet kan het bevoegd gezag een eigenaar (of degene die uit andere hoofde bevoegd is) verplichten voorzieningen te treffen die hoger liggen dan het niveau voor bestaande bouwwerken
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de meldingsplicht voor asbestsanering

MP Paulus Jansen (SP) asked whether asbestos removal firms must make four separate notifications before work starts, whether the Arbeidsinspectie portal could auto-forward them, and why the Bouwbesluit notification should not be dropped as duplicative. State Secretary Atsma replied that there is no Wet milieubeheer notification, that two notification moments apply (four weeks before for the municipality, two days before for inspectorates and certifiers), that the portal forwards automatically, and that the Bouwbesluit notification will be kept.
There is no notification under the Wet milieubeheer, but before asbestos removal in buildings, a notification/communication must be made at two moments.
Er is geen melding op grond van de Wet milieubeheer, maar voorafgaand aan een asbestsanering in gebouwen, moet op twee momenten een melding/mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Boer over huursubsidie aan hogere inkomens

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior whether a newspaper claim that a few thousand people earning above €54,367 still receive rent allowance is accurate, and what would be done if so. The minister answered that the figures come from preliminary CBS data reflecting provisional allowances, that excess allowances are reclaimed on final assessment, and that timing mismatches in household composition explain the apparent discrepancy, so the figures do not show wrongful receipt.
