If at final assessment it turns out that income in 2010 was too high to receive the allowance, the rent allowance received in excess is reclaimed.
Als bij de definitieve toekenning blijkt dat het inkomen in 2010 te hoog was voor het ontvangen van toeslag, wordt de te veel ontvangen huurtoeslag teruggevorderd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Plasterk over het bericht ‘Bank zet trouwe klant in de kou’

MPs Monasch and Plasterk asked whether banks have substantially reduced mortgage financing for existing clients with stable incomes, whether banks interpret tightened rules too strictly, and whether high mortgage rates are justified given banks' cheap funding. The minister replied that LTI norms were tightened by recalculated Nibud norms and the Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financieringen, that exceptions and room for tailoring remain, that banks face funding and risk pressures, and that the NMa found margins had fallen back to pre-crisis levels by early 2011.
The banks, the AFM and I myself remain in discussion about this.
De banken, de AFM en ikzelf blijven hierover in gesprek.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lucassen over het bericht dat het Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw heeft meegewerkt aan het gebruik van risicovolle financiële producten door woningcorporaties

MP Lucassen asks whether the Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw (WSW) failed to act against risky derivatives used by housing associations, including Vestia, and whether it had adequate information and any supervisory failure. Minister Spies replies that lessons must be learned by all parties, the Woningwet and derivative rules will be tightened, an external commission will advise, and that the WSW is a private guarantor without a public supervisory task, though it will be held to account for lessons learned.
However, the WSW has no supervisory task based on public law.
Het WSW heeft echter geen op publiekrecht gebaseerde toezichthoudende taak.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het vernietigen van een onrechtmatige vergunning voor de bouw van een geitenstal

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether a building permit for a large goat barn in Landerd, issued despite a provincial building stop after Q-fever cases, should be annulled, since the province considered it unlawful. The minister answered that the application predates the building stop, that only the Crown can annul, that no annulment request had been filed yet, and that annulment is a last resort.
Annulment of a decision by the Crown can take place if there is a conflict with the law or the general interest.
Vernietiging van een besluit door de Kroon kan plaats vinden indien er sprake is van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang.
Antwoord vragen Van Bochove over de afdeling Bevolking, Burgerlijke Stand en Verkiezingen (BBSV) op Curaçao

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the Curaçao civil registry and passport office (BBSV), including security of passport issuance, a sharp rent increase for a new building, and arrears owed to the Dutch state. The minister said the Governor remains responsible, that a new location must meet security requirements before mandated issuance can move, and that the Governor will press Curaçao for payment without committing to interest or further action.
The Governor is responsible for correct passport issuance in Curaçao, even when it happens under mandate.
De Gouverneur is verantwoordelijk voor een juiste paspoortuitgifte in Curaçao, ook als dat gebeurt in mandaat.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lucassen over het bericht dat de minister van Justitie van Curaçao persoonlijk ingrijpt in een lopende strafzaak

An MP asked whether the Curaçao Justice Minister personally asked the United States to lift seizure of a suspect's assets in a criminal case, and whether this raised suspicions of abuse of power. The minister confirmed the request, explained that the Procureur-generaal has long been the competent authority, said the Kingdom will raise the issue at the June 2012 ministers' meeting, and left judgement on abuse of power to the Curaçao parliament.
However, it is for the Staten of Curaçao to pronounce on whether this is the case here.
Het is evenwel aan de Staten van Curaçao om zich uit te spreken over de vraag of dit in het onderhavige geval aan de orde is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het verstrekken van biometrische gegevens aan de Verenigde Staten

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Interior whether biometric data for Dutch travel documents, held by Morpho in Haarlem, could be accessed by US authorities under the Patriot Act given its US affiliates. The minister confirmed the outsourcing and said US jurisdiction cannot be excluded, but that any US request would be tested against reciprocity, sovereignty and Dutch and European data protection rules, and that no US requests had been received.
Furthermore, Morpho is willing to investigate whether further measures can be taken to prevent this.
Voorts is Morpho bereid te onderzoeken of er verdergaande maatregelen genomen kunnen worden dat te voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het zoveelste onzinadvies van de RMO

An MP asks the minister about a Council for Social Development (RMO) advisory report recommending the government stop using the term 'allochtoon', questioning the RMO's stance on immigrant integration statistics and whether the council should be abolished. The minister says the RMO is free to advise, the cabinet will respond to the advice, and that the council's advice has added value, though he does not necessarily agree with its content.
As laid down in the Framework Act on advisory bodies, the cabinet will send both chambers a response to the advice.
Zoals vastgelegd in de Kaderwet adviescolleges zal het kabinet beide Kamers een reactie op het advies doen toekomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dam over de persvrijheid op Curaçao

An MP asks the Interior Minister how a Curaçao party leader's call to arrest and handcuff a newspaper editor for critical reporting fits press freedom, and what the Kingdom will do about intimidation of the press. The minister says Curaçao is primarily responsible, that press freedom is a fundamental right, and that the Curaçao prime minister has affirmed press freedom, while declining to specify consequences if the trend continues.
This concerns a dispute within the country of Curaçao. This dispute falls primarily under the responsibility of the government of Curaçao.
Het gaat hier om een dispuut binnen het land Curaçao. Dit dispuut valt primair onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de regering van Curaçao.
Antwoord vragen Taverne over kiesgerechtigde Nederlanders in het buitenland

An MP asked how many Dutch voters live abroad, how many voted in 2010, and how the government will promote turnout abroad for the 2012 elections, including briefstembureaus, ID rules and electronic registration. The minister answered that the number living abroad is unknown, gave 2010 turnout figures, and described outreach campaigns, a reduced list of 22 postal-vote offices, and the electronic registration option.
The cabinet considers it important that Dutch voters abroad can cast their vote and wishes to promote this as far as reasonably possible.
Het kabinet acht het van belang dat Nederlandse kiesgerechtigden in het buitenland hun stem kunnen uitbrengen en wil dat voor zover redelijkerwijs mogelijk bevorderen.
Antwoord vragen Heijnen over de versobering van het wachtgeld voor politici

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the planned cut to parliamentary severance pay (wachtgeld) would be tightened further, whether the age-55 extended entitlement should be raised to 60, and whether the change would take effect on 1 September 2012. The minister answered that the questions depend on a bill still awaiting cabinet decision after Council of State advice, which will contain the answers, and that the bill to amend the Appa is intended to reach parliament quickly.
The bill and the explanatory memorandum will contain the answer to the implementation questions raised.
Het wetsvoorstel en de memorie van toelichting bevatten het antwoord op de gestelde uitwerkingsvragen.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over de toegenomen woonsegregatie in Amsterdam

MP Karabulut asked the ministers whether the reported growth of residential segregation in Amsterdam is a problem and what action will be taken, including talks with the Amsterdam council, and how segregation has developed in the other large cities. Minister Leers answered that the cited study concerns housing preferences rather than actual segregation, that segregation in Amsterdam has fallen since 2006-2007, that no action or talks are planned, and that segregation fell in 27 of 32 large cities between 2001 and 2011.
Contrary to the tenor of the Het Parool article, I do not find, based on the O&S report, that there is any sign of increasing segregation.
In tegenstelling tot de teneur van het artikel in Het Parool constateer ik op basis van het rapport van O&S niet dat er spraken is van toenemende segregatie.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over de cao gemeenteambtenaren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior why she urged the VNG to keep a wage freeze for municipal employees, whether that was her role, and whether the agreed municipal CAO could be reversed. The minister said she called on the VNG to keep the nullijn for fiscal and signalling reasons, has no formal power to annul the CAO, and that it cannot be undone now barring compelling reasons.
At present I have no formal powers to reverse or annul an agreed CAO accord in the municipalities sector.
Op dit moment heb ik geen formele bevoegdheden om een overeengekomen CAO-akkoord in de sector Gemeenten terug te draaien of te vernietigen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Brinkman over het feit dat in atoomschuilkelders maandelijks voor duizenden euro’s eten wordt weggegooid

MP Brinkman asked whether food in atomic fallout shelters is discarded monthly at a cost of thousands of euros, and whether it should instead be donated to food banks before expiry. The minister replied that shelters are a municipal matter, that he knows of no such practice, that the VNG is unaware of it, and that any such local policy is accountable to the municipal council.
If this were the case in a certain municipality, I see no role for myself.
Indien dit in een bepaalde gemeente toch het geval zou zijn, zie ik voor mijzelf geen rol weggelegd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over dreigend woningtekort in de Metropoolregio Amsterdam

MP Karabulut asked the minister of Interior about a projected housing shortage in the Amsterdam metropolitan region, including the conclusion that 270,000 homes could not be built by 2040, that a catch-up to 12,500 homes per year is practically impossible, and the effect on students and starters. The minister called the conclusions premature, said the region sees room for 208,000 homes, committed to drawing up an implementation agenda with the region and to reviewing regulatory obstacles, while stressing housing supply is primarily a local and regional responsibility.
I guarantee, in cooperation with my colleagues of Infrastructure and Environment, that account will be taken of the spatial needs for functions of national importance.
Ik waarborg daarbij, in samenwerking met mijn collega's van Infrastructuur en Milieu, dat er rekening wordt gehouden met de ruimtebehoefte voor functies van nationaal belang
Antwoord vragen van het lid El Fassed over digitale onveiligheid van de site meermetminder.nl

An MP asked ministers whether the Meer Met Minder subsidy website collects sensitive data such as citizen service numbers and bank details, and what security protects them against identity fraud. The minister confirmed the data collection, described the security architecture (single sign-on, separate database, encrypted transfer to Agentschap NL), reported no unauthorised access so far, and referred to the Wabb and Wbp privacy rules.
The bank account number is needed to transfer the lawful subsidy amount.
Het bankrekeningnummer is nodig om het rechtmatige subsidiebedrag over te maken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gent over de ernstige vervuiling van het Gotomeer te Bonaire

An MP asked about contamination of the Gotomeer nature reserve on Bonaire after the 2010 BOPEC oil terminal fires, including prior preventive measures, the PFOS findings, and liability. The state secretary said the island authority was responsible for the terminal's rules and supervision, that further environmental research via RIVM is being considered, and declined immediate measures and liability action until the facts are established.
It was the competent authority (now the public body of Bonaire) that had to set rules and supervise compliance with them.
Het was aan het bevoegd gezag (nu openbaar lichaam Bonaire) om regels te stellen en toe te zien op de naleving daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brinkman en Çörüz over het artikel “Gemeente Haren verscheurde parkeerboetes van gezagsdragers”

MPs Brinkman and Çörüz asked the Minister of Interior about Haren municipality tearing up parking fines issued to public officials and councillors, asking how many cases there were, whether those responsible should pay, and whether the minister would start an integrity investigation. The minister answered that records only show plate numbers, time and place, so the number of official cases cannot be stated; that enforcement is a municipal responsibility; and that integrity is a local matter, with a municipal audit committee investigation already under way.
The parking ticket booklets record only the license plates of the cars and the time and place of the violation.
In die bonnenboekjes zijn uitsluitend de kentekens van de auto’s en het tijdstip en de plaats van de overtreding genoteerd.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de mogelijke schending van privacy door mormonen

An MP asked whether government archives cooperate with Mormons on digitising records containing deceased persons' data, whether this fits the public task and privacy protection, and whether derived religious baptism of deceased citizens should be prevented. The minister answered that archive cooperation is a facility for visitors and falls under the Archives Act, that data protection does not extend to deceased persons, that there is no full overview, and that no measures will be taken citing religious freedom.
There is no complete overview of which archive repositories and when Mormons made copies of these files and on what scale, nor of institutions.
Er is geen compleet overzicht van bij welke archiefbewaarplaatsen wanneer mormonen afschriften hebben gemaakt van deze bestanden en op welke schaal, noch van instellingen.
Antwoord vragen De Rouwe, Van der Werf en Bruins Slot over de erfpacht in Amsterdam

Three CDA MPs asked several ministers about municipal ground leasehold (erfpacht) in Amsterdam, including canon increases, the lack of a right to buy the land, the legal remedies available, the threat of fines, and whether the municipality meets banking-sector criteria. The minister answered that leasehold is a private-law matter for the landowner (the municipality), that objection is possible only via the civil courts, that the municipality is revising its terms, and that the fine clause is rarely used.
Because leasehold is a private-law figure, public-law objection and appeal are not open here; the route to the civil court must be followed.
Omdat erfpacht een privaatrechtelijke figuur is, staan publiekrechtelijk bezwaar en beroep hier niet open, maar moet de weg naar de burgerlijke rechter worden gevolgd.
Antwoord vragen van Dam over haar uitspraken over het tegengaan van dubbele nationaliteiten en het boerkaverbod

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether her remarks that bills on dual nationality and a face-covering ban are effectively off the table, and that she would not mind if the Chamber scrapped the face-covering ban, were accurate, and whether she would withdraw both bills. The minister confirmed the remarks, said the initiative to declare the bills controversial lies with the Chamber, and declined to withdraw them.
As I have previously stated, the initiative lies with the Chamber to declare the bills controversial or not.
Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven ligt het initiatief bij de Kamer om de wetsvoorstellen al dan niet controversieel te verklaren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn over de aanstaande Tweede Kamerverkiezingen op de openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the readiness of the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba for the upcoming Tweede Kamer elections, including training, voter information, responsibility, and funding. The minister replied that the islands are capable of organising the elections, announced a voter information campaign, and said funding and election costs are borne by the public bodies while a separate evaluation will follow.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over uitlatingen van een politiewoordvoerder in Den Haag

An SP MP asked why a police spokesperson publicly linked the arrests of two protesters carrying a coffin to a memorial in Lommel, and whether this was proper. The minister answers that the arrests were based on breaking agreements and not complying with police orders, that the spokesperson merely pointed out the coffin could be seen as inappropriate, and that no ban on the coffin existed.
There has explicitly been no ban on carrying a coffin.
Van een verbod tot het meevoeren van een lijkkist is nadrukkelijk geen sprake geweest.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over de verspreiding van korans in Duitsland

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the minister about salafists distributing millions of Qurans in Germany and whether such activity poses a threat in the Netherlands. The minister replied that salafist activity currently poses no national security threat, no plans are known, and distributing the Quran as such is not a threat to public order, while measures would be taken if disturbance were indicated.
Distributing a widely circulated religious text as such does not constitute a danger to public order.
Het verspreiden van een wijdverspreid religieus geschrift als zodanig vormt geen gevaar voor de openbare orde.
Antwoord vragen De Boer over het bericht ‘Tijdelijk verhuren strop huizenbezitters’

An MP asked the minister of Interior about reports that owners rent out their unsold second homes without the required vacancy permit, and about the cost and necessity of such permits. The minister replied that unpermitted regular rental is not illegal, that no registration exists, that banks show no signs of a rise, defended the permit requirement as protecting tenants and owners, and promised to remove the maximum rent requirement from the permit.
I do not share the view that applying for a permit is time-consuming; indeed, the permit is granted by operation of law if the municipality has not decided within eight weeks of the application.

Ik deel niet de opvatting dat het aanvragen van een vergunning tijdrovend is; het is zelfs zo dat de vergunning van rechtswege wordt verleend indien de gemeente niet binnen acht weken op de aanvraag heeft beslist.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Dikkers over de berichtgeving dat woningcorporaties geen prioriteit geven aan recycling

MPs Monasch and Dikkers asked whether housing associations are neglecting recycling of lamps and luminaires and whether the government should improve their recycling results. The state secretary acknowledged that only about half of discarded lamps are collected, called the missed opportunity a gap in the collection system, and promised to alert housing associations via their association and to examine collection options in implementing the revised EU WEEE directive.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Monasch over het ontstaan van no-go area’s in de grote steden

Two PvdA MPs asked whether neglected neighbourhoods in Rotterdam and Amsterdam risk becoming no-go areas, how the government supports municipalities and measures investment there, and how cuts to municipal safety and neighbourhood policy fit with that risk. The minister rejects the professor's conclusion, describes the monitoring instruments and the continued neighbourhood approach, and refers back to earlier answers without committing to new action.
The total investment in the neighbourhoods is not tracked at national level.
Het totaal aan investeringen in de wijken wordt niet op rijksniveau bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen Van Hijum, Koopmans en Koppejan over de inhuur van flexibele arbeidskrachten via de aanbestedingskalender

MPs Van Hijum, Koopmans and Koppejan (CDA) asked why central government spends over 45 million euro on temporary agency staff during spending cuts, whether this undoes departmental downsizing targets, and about the tender's lot structure, CAO application, SME access and an overview of framework contracts. The minister answered that the 10% external-hire norm applies, that agency staff are used for peaks and temporary tasks rather than replacing permanent staff, that the CAO Rijk does not apply to them but the inlenersbeloning does, and listed current framework contracts and their durations.
For years the House of Representatives has been informed about the scale of external hiring of personnel by central government, including temporary agency workers.
Sedert jaren wordt de Tweede Kamer geïnformeerd over de omvang van de externe inhuur van personeel bij het Rijk, waaronder uitzendkrachten.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over huiszoekingen in aanloop naar Koninginnedag

Dibi (GroenLinks) asked whether the Rhenen mayor could carry out house searches and arrests before Queen's Day 2012 when residents refused entry, and whether this breaches constitutional home protections. Minister Spies replied that no search was planned, entry without consent requires a legal basis and warrant under the Koninginnedag emergency ordinance and general bylaw, and proportionality is reviewable by courts, but declined to talk to the mayor.
Entry without the resident's consent is a restriction of the right to the home, as guaranteed in Article 12 of the Constitution.
Binnentreden zonder toestemming van de bewoner is een inperking van het huisrecht, zoals gegarandeerd in artikel 12 van de Grondwet.
Antwoord vragen Voortman en El Fassed over het bericht dat het UMC St. Radboud patiënten door middel van DigiD toegang geeft tot het patiëntendossier

MPs Voortman and El Fassed asked whether the Radboud UMC may give patients access to their medical records via DigiD, and what oversight prevents misuse and privacy breaches. The minister replied that DigiD level Midden plus a face-to-face identification at the hospital is used, that the hospital is bound by the Wbp under CBP oversight, and that DigiD only authenticates users and does not govern what data they may see.
The UMC St. Radboud is bound by the Personal Data Protection Act (WBP). The College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) supervises this.
Het UMC St. Radboud is gehouden aan de Wet Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (WBP). Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) houdt hier toezicht op.
Antwoord vragen Schouw en Berndsen over het afschaffen van de verplichting van het ‘gratis’ huwelijk

MPs Schouw and Berndsen asked whether the legal obligation for municipalities to offer free weddings should be abolished, given the claimed cost and misuse. Minister Spies replied that she sees no need to change the rule, that municipalities report no problems, and that no data on usage or lost revenue is available.
These figures are not known to me.
Deze cijfers zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Groot over het bericht in de Volkskrant over de vrije val van de huizenverkoop

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of the Interior and the State Secretary for Finance about a newspaper report of a sharp fall in home sales in February 2012 and why the Dutch housing market is weaker than neighbouring countries. The minister answered that the drop is partly overstated when compared with recent months, attributed the decline to market dynamics and the economic situation, and listed measures the cabinet has already taken to support the housing market.
This cabinet has taken various measures to give a targeted boost to confidence in the housing market and to remove obstacles to transactions.
Er zijn door dit kabinet verschillende maatregelen genomen om het vertrouwen op de woningmarkt een gerichte impuls te geven en belemmeringen voor transacties weg te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over de voedingsbodem voor extremisme gelet op de schokkende aanslagen op een joodse school in Toulouse, een moskee in Brussel en diepgewortelde islamofobie in Nederland

An MP asked ministers how intelligence services will stay alert to online jihadist mobilisation and Islamophobia after the Toulouse and Brussels attacks, and whether a dialogue with Jewish and Islamic organisations will be initiated. The ministers answered that the counterterrorism strategy prioritises jihadism and that the AIVD investigates jihadist networks online, while on Islamophobia and dialogue they pointed to existing contacts and monitoring without committing to new steps.
The cabinet is always vigilant regarding discrimination and/or extremism, regardless of the ideology underlying it.
Het kabinet is altijd waakzaam waar het gaat om discriminatie en/of extremisme, ongeacht welke ideologie daar aan ten grondslag ligt.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Plasschaert over het gratis toegankelijk maken van informatie uit basisregistraties ten behoeve van opsporing

MP Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether police and prosecutors are hampered by paying per query for Chamber of Commerce and cadastral register data, and whether free access should be restored as the Emergo report recommends. The government replied that budget financing since 1 January 2012 removed invoicing for police and prosecution, that free use of basic registers is the aim by 2015, and that a decision on the end-state is expected at the end of 2012.
The cabinet aims to remove as far as possible the financial barriers to using basic registers, not only within government but also outside it, and to increase their use.

Het kabinet streeft ernaar dat de financiële drempels voor het gebruik van basisregistraties, niet alleen binnen de overheid maar ook daarbuiten, zo veel mogelijk verdwijnen en dat het gebruik ervan toeneemt.
Antwoord vragen Monasch over de financiële situatie bij woningcorporaties

An MP asks the Minister of Interior Affairs about a Brinkgroep report and press coverage showing many housing corporations with weak interest coverage, high debt and high market risk, and whether supervision should be intensified. The minister answers that the figures are signals but do not by themselves show continuity risk, that supervision is already being strengthened in the short term, and that the regulator will pay more attention to liquidity risks in 2012.
For the short term, intensifications were already set in motion in 2011.
Voor de korte termijn zijn reeds in 2011 intensiveringen in gang gezet.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over de raffinaderij op Aruba

An SP MP asked the ministers of Interior and Economic Affairs about the possible closure of the Aruba refinery, Aruba's efforts to keep it open, and Dutch support for that effort. The government answered that Aruba is primarily responsible for its own economic policy, that the Netherlands supports it through diplomacy, trade missions and a 2011 cooperation protocol, and that further support was pledged.
As a country within the Kingdom, Aruba is primarily responsible for its own economic policy.
Als land binnen het Koninkrijk is Aruba primair verantwoordelijk voor haar eigen economisch beleid.
Antwoord vragen Heijnen over een landelijke beperking van draaideurconstructies voor voormalige ambtenaren

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a revolving-door arrangement, where a former civil servant was hired as a consultant at high hourly rates, is undesirable and whether national rules should be tightened. The minister answered that the case involved a subsidised organisation rather than a ministry, that a 1999 circular already prohibits revolving-door hiring for two years with narrow exceptions, and that no tightening is needed.
There is no reason to tighten the rules contained in the circular; they are very clear.
Er is geen aanleiding om de regels vervat in de circulaire aan te scherpen, ze zijn heel duidelijk.
Antwoord vragen Heijnen en Çelik over de Rapportage onderzoek uittreksel GBA 2012

MPs Heijnen and Çelik asked why about 81,000 pupils still risk buying an unnecessary GBA extract for secondary school enrolment, as half of municipalities still require one. The minister says the study's conclusion is premature since municipalities inform applicants the extract is not needed, that DUO and municipal bodies were informed, and that DUO will again be asked to inform school administrators.
Therefore I will again ask DUO to inform school administrators that a GBA extract is not necessary when pupils enrol in secondary education.
Daarom zal ik DUO opnieuw verzoeken schooladministrateurs op de hoogte te brengen van het feit dat bij inschrijving van leerlingen in het voortgezet onderwijs een GBA-uittreksel niet nodig is.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen en Jasper van Dijk, Peters over een volgende aanslag op het rijksmonument Sankt Ludwig in Vlodrop

Three MPs (Jansen, Van Dijk and Peters) asked whether the foundation Meru had again applied for demolition of the national monument Sankt Ludwig in Vlodrop, whether the municipality of Roerdalen had enforced repair, and whether the instruments were adequate. The state secretary confirmed the new permit application and said the municipality has used enforcement (an order under penalty, upheld by the Raad van State, with a deadline of 21 September 2012), that the minister has no power to force repair, and that no change in procedures is needed.
I have no legal means to enforce restoration.
Ik heb geen wettelijke mogelijkheden om herstel af te dwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucassen inzake het lekken van gegevens door de Veiligheidsdienst Curaçao

MP Lucassen asked the Interior Minister about reported leaks of data by the Curaçao security service and demanded an independent investigation into the Curaçao prime minister's role. The minister answered that the VDC is primarily a matter for Curaçao, that the AIVD and MIVD are making inquiries, that no leak of Dutch data has been established, and that data sharing is not suspended.
It is up to the country of Curaçao to take appropriate measures when confidential data leaks from the VDC.
Het is aan het land Curaçao om geëigende maatregelen te nemen wanneer er sprake is van lekken van vertrouwelijke gegevens uit de VDC.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over de dreigementen van de gevolmachtigd minister van Curaçao

MP Van Raak (SP) asked the Minister of the Interior whether the plenipotentiary minister of Curaçao's threatening remark about two former ministers criticising the government was meant as a threat and whether it was endorsed by the Council of Ministers, and how the former ministers and the practice would be protected. The minister replied that the intended meaning is unknown, that the remark falls under Curaçao's own government, that the plenipotentiary did not speak for the Rijksministerraad, and that it is an internal Curaçaose matter for Curaçao's government and parliament.
It is primarily up to the government and the States of Curaçao to determine whether statements by a member of this government call for measures.
Het is primair aan de regering en de Staten van Curaçao om te bepalen of uitlatingen van een lid van deze regering eventueel vragen om maatregelen.
Antwoord vragen De Boer over onderwerp het Nationaal Programma Herbestemming

An MP asked the minister whether she would loosen rules on temporary housing in vacant offices as proposed by the H-team and how this relates to existing temporary-lease rules. The minister is positive about extending temporary lease terms to 10 years but prefers doing so through an amendment to the Leegstandwet, which he plans to submit after the summer recess 2012.
The intention is to submit the bill amending the Leegstandwet to your House as soon as possible after the 2012 summer recess.
Het is de bedoeling het wetsvoorstel ter wijziging van de Leegstandwet zo spoedig mogelijk na het zomerreces 2012 aan uw Kamer voor te leggen.
Nader antwoord op vragen Van Gerven over een mogelijke financiele regeling bij vertrek van de directeur van het COA

An MP asked ministers whether the departing COA director was granted an unusually large severance package and whether such individual arrangements are normal in the semi-public sector. The minister referred to the Commission of Inquiry report, which records an 18-month severance instead of the usual 6 months, and said a return to COA is ruled out while the COA will consider all relevant circumstances.
The Commission of Inquiry COA report states in annex 5, on the dates 26 and 27 September 2011, that a severance payment deviating from the CAO Welfare and Social Services was agreed with Ms Albayrak.

In het rapport van de Commissie van onderzoek COA wordt in bijlage 5 bij de data 26 en 27 september 2011 aangegeven dat met mevrouw Albayrak een van de CAO Welzijn en Maatschappelijke Dienstverlening afwijkende ontslagvergoeding is overeengekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Driessen over gesubsidieerde spookcursussen in de gemeente Amsterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Amsterdam's subsidised courses, allegedly sometimes never held, and a related national subsidy to a board member's foundation were acceptable, and what measures would be taken. The minister replied that municipal subsidy decisions fall under local autonomy, that the municipal council handles accountability, and that the national government will not intervene.
It is not the task of the national government to interfere in this.
Het is niet de taak van het Rijk zich hierin te mengen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klijnsma over de aanpak van fraude met parkeerkaarten voor gehandicapten

An MP asked the Interior Minister about fraud with disabled parking permits, the low uptake of the national registration system by municipalities, and how to encourage wider use. The minister said national registration would help enforcement, reported 22 municipalities registering and 46 more organising the transition, and aimed for all municipalities to join by end 2013 without a binding deadline.
I have therefore financially supported the development of the national registration.
Ik heb daarom de ontwikkeling van de landelijke registratie financieel gesteund.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Recourt over de berichtgeving dat er vals spel wordt gespeeld op de huizenveiling

MPs Monasch and Recourt asked about reports of cheating at house auctions and the WEW's decision to stop auctioning NHG-guaranteed homes. The minister said the WEW works with financiers to avoid auctions, a bill on forced-sale procedures is planned, existing sanctions suffice against cartel conduct, and the WEW refused 25% of executive auction requests in 2011.
This proposal is expected to be submitted to your House this summer.
Dit voorstel wordt naar verwachting in de zomer van dit jaar bij uw Kamer ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Van der Staaij inzake de grote verschillen in leges die gemeenten berekenen voor grafrechten

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about large differences between municipalities in cemetery grave fees and whether a cost model has produced transparent cost structures. The Minister acknowledges the differences, says the VNG cost model supports transparency, that fees are set by municipal councils within cost-recovery limits, and that individuals can appeal to the courts.
Applying the cost-justification model leads to a clear justification of the costs the municipality recovers.
Het hanteren van het model van kostenonderbouwing leidt tot een duidelijke onderbouwing van de kosten die de gemeente verhaalt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ortega-Martijn over het bericht dat de vrije uitkering voor de openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba

An MP asked the minister whether the free allowance to the Caribbean public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba is structurally too low, the size of any shortfall, and whether the government will commit to correcting it per the reference-framework study. The minister replied that the cabinet will set out its position in the spring after consultation with the public bodies, and that the questions will be taken into account then.
I consider it desirable to first reach a cabinet position within the Cabinet and to send it to your House in the spring, after also discussing it with the public bodies.
Ik acht het wenselijk om nu eerst binnen het Kabinet te komen tot een kabinetsstandpunt en dat in het voorjaar – na ook bespreking met de openbare lichamen – aan uw Kamer te zenden.

Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de inspanningen van de rijksoverheid om re

MPs Heijnen and Hamer asked the ministers how central government will directly strengthen the labour market position of Wajong and WSW beneficiaries, including targets, quotas and social return in procurement. The minister answered that a 1% reserved-places quota applies, that a range of support measures and a 2012 study on bonus-malus incentives are underway, that no separate target exists for these groups, and that social return will be evaluated in 2013.
From 1 July 2011, social return is part of the central government procurement policy.
Vanaf 1 juli 2011 is social return onderdeel van het Rijksinkoopbeleid.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind, Van Klaveren, Van der Staaij en Sterk over de komst van een extremistische imam naar Nederland

MPs asked whether statements by an extremist imam, Al Haddad, that the minister called reprehensible, possibly including calls to violence, justified refusing his entry into the Netherlands, and how entry decisions are made. The minister answered that the statements may not be criminal in isolation, that without concrete indications of serious threat entry could not lawfully be refused, and that entry decisions for EU and non-EU nationals follow Schengen rules and case-by-case checks.
The law does not give me the room to refuse someone entry to the Netherlands solely on the basis of his statements, without concrete indications of imminent serious criminal offences.
De wet biedt mij niet de ruimte om zonder concrete aanwijzingen voor dreigende ernstige strafbare feiten iemand de toegang tot Nederland te ontzeggen louter op basis van zijn uitspraken.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren over de sprekers op het Nationaal Islam Congres 2012

An MP asked whether speakers at the 2012 Nationaal Islam Congres who had called for violence should be denied entry, and whether the government would refuse them. The minister answered that entry can be refused only where there is a demonstrable threat to public order or national security, assessed case by case, and that no such indications were found for the individual speakers.
In the information available to me I see no indications of such a danger to public order or national security.
In de mij beschikbare informatie zie ik geen aanwijzingen voor een dergelijk gevaar voor de openbare orde of nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent over de olieopslag te Sint Eustatius

An MP asked about a demonstration against NuStar oil storage expansion on Sint Eustatius, the role of the Dutch state versus the island authorities, the permit procedures, and whether irreversible steps could be avoided pending a decision. The government answered that the island executive is the competent authority, that Rijkswaterstaat and external experts provide project support, that the national government does not normally intervene in local decisions, and that it would act if unauthorised activities occurred.
If activities are established by me or on my behalf that are not permitted or are careless while no final decision has been taken by the executive board, I will notify the executive board of this.

Indien door mij of namens mij activiteiten worden vastgesteld die niet zijn toegestaan of onzorgvuldig zijn zolang er geen definitieve besluitvorming door het bestuurscollege heeft plaatsgevonden, zal ik het bestuurscollege hiervan melding maken.
Antwoord vragen Koser Kaya en Hachchi over de vroege pensioenleeftijd van het overheidspersoneel

Two D66 MPs asked why the public sector has a low average retirement age, what early-retirement schemes and age-related measures exist for civil servants, and what effects this has on wages and the wider labour market. Minister Spies answered that the low average is driven mainly by police and defence, that the general public-sector retirement age has risen, that remaining early-exit schemes are being phased out, and that no spillover effects to other sectors are expected.
The cabinet's policy is aimed at encouraging people to keep working longer.
Het beleid van het kabinet is er op gericht om het langer doorwerken te stimuleren.
Antwoord vragen Dibi over het bericht dat het kabinet af wil van de dubbele nationaliteit

An MP asks the Interior Minister why the government wants to abolish dual nationality, questioning its priority and the consistency of MPs holding two passports. The minister answers that a single nationality clarifies citizens' legal position, that the bill only applies to future cases, and that loss of Dutch nationality follows only voluntary acquisition of another nationality.
The bill will only apply to new cases, that is, to persons who change nationality in the future.
Het wetsvoorstel zal alleen betrekking hebben op nieuwe gevallen, dat wil zeggen, voor personen die in de toekomst van nationaliteit veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Elissen en Graus over het bericht dat de luchtvaart in rep en roer is door een nieuwe methode van drugssmokkel

PVV MPs Elissen and Graus asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about a reported case in which someone hid cocaine in an aircraft wing, asking about passenger risk, airport security measures, and the investigation. Minister Opstelten answered that the access itself is a serious security problem, that existing ICAO-based measures and 100% drug controls on flights from the overseas territories are considered adequate and will not be tightened, and that a joint investigation led by the Openbaar Ministerie is underway, though no further details can be given.
In the interest of the investigation, no further statements can be made about this.
In het belang van het onderzoek kunnen hierover geen nadere mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Lucassen over het bericht dat PvdA-prominenten zichzelf bevoordeelden in Amsterdams bouwproject

An MP asks whether former commissioner Roel de Wit and former minister Ed van Thijn, both PvdA, favoured themselves in a 1960s Amsterdam housing project. The minister answers that the project followed normal municipal procedures, that no preferential treatment or open allocation applied as now understood, and that no grounds for further investigation are seen.
On the basis of the above, I see no reason to conduct further investigation.
Ik zie op basis van het bovenstaande geen aanleiding tot het doen van nader onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Heijnen en Hamer over de effecten van het social return beleid

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the government would follow the long-term effects of social return policy independently, like Rotterdam, and how it applies case-specific tailoring and possible Rotterdam-style methods. The minister replied that central government reports annually and will evaluate social return in 2013, sees no added value in an extra independent monitor for now, and points to existing knowledge-sharing and case-by-case design of social return clauses.
In addition, the social return policy at central government will be evaluated in 2013 on its effects as well as the implementation costs for both the contracting authority and the contractor.
Daarnaast wordt het social return beleid bij het Rijk in 2013 geëvalueerd op de effecten alsmede de uitvoeringslasten voor zowel de opdrachtgever als de opdrachtnemer.
Antwoord vragen Van Bochove over lessen uit het faillissement van de Redema Groep

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about lessons from the Redema Groep bankruptcy for owners' associations (VvE), including whether funds can be recovered and whether a national public-law body should be created. The minister answered that accounts in the name of the VvE are outside the bankruptcy, that pooled 'inzake' accounts fall into the estate so members may recover only part, that a national body is not the most obvious solution, and that a study on VvE functioning will report in Q2 2012.
Nevertheless, I will ask VvE-belang among others to pay renewed attention to this in their communications in the coming period.
Ik zal desalniettemin onder meer VvE-belang vragen hier de komende tijd in hun communicatie- uitingen nogmaals aandacht aan te besteden.
Antwoord vragen Driessen over de besteding van provinciale subsidiegelden

Deputy Driessen (PVV) asked the ministers whether it is acceptable that four provinces spend about half their budgets on subsidies, that many subsidies are not evaluated or evaluated poorly, and whether the government will talk to the provinces about this. Minister Spies answered that provinces are autonomous and responsible for their own subsidies, that the provincial councils and local audit offices should hold the executive to account, and that the provinces will adopt the audit office's recommendations.
The provinces, as autonomous tiers of government, are themselves responsible for granting subsidies, and it is up to the local elected council to form a judgement on this.
De provincies zijn als autonome bestuurslaag zélf verantwoordelijk voor de verstrekking van subsidies en het is aan de lokale volksvertegenwoordiging om hier een oordeel over te vormen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak Het opnieuw lekken van informatie uit de geheime dienst van Curacao

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether leaked Curaçao intelligence data passed to third parties and Colombia, whether the Curaçao security service can still be trusted, and what protection a whistleblower will receive. The minister answered that Curaçao is primarily responsible, that the AIVD and MIVD are inquiring, that the third-party rule was not waived, and that they await further investigation by Curaçao's government.
The functioning of the Curaçao Security Service (VDC) is primarily a matter for the country of Curaçao and its government.
Het functioneren van de Veiligheidsdienst Curaçao (VDC) is primair een aangelegenheid van het land Curaçao en van zijn regering.

Vragen van het lid Lucassen (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat gegevens van de veiligheidsdienst van Curaçao zijn verstrekt aan derden (ingezonden 6 maart 2012).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that Curaçao's intelligence service leaked data to third parties, including possible Colombian involvement, and whether Dutch services will keep sharing sensitive information with it. The minister replied that the VDC is primarily Curaçao's responsibility, that Dutch services are inquiring into the matter, that the third-party rule was not waived, and that further investigation is awaited without a commitment to intervene.
The functioning of the Security Service of Curaçao (VDC) is primarily a matter for the country Curaçao and its government.
Het functioneren van de Veiligheidsdienst Curaçao (VDC) is primair een aangelegenheid van het land Curaçao en van zijn regering.
Antwoord vragen Van Hijum, Ormel, Omtzigt, Smilde en De Rouwe over de wens van gemeenten om het Nedersaksisch als streektaal te erkennen

CDA MPs asked whether the government still supports recognising Low Saxon under Part III of the European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages, given the long delay since the 2010 application. The minister confirmed the delay, said the government will not recognise Low Saxon under Part III because the inventory showed it would bring extra administrative and financial burdens, and that it stays under Part II.

In light of this, I consider it inopportune for the Netherlands to notify the Council of Europe that protection of Low Saxon will henceforth take place in accordance with at least 35 provisions of Part III of the European Charter.

Naar aanleiding hiervan acht ik het daarom niet opportuun dat Nederland bij de Raad van Europa kenbaar maakt dat bescherming van het Nedersaksisch voortaan plaatsvindt conform ten minste 35 bepalingen van Deel III van het Europees Handvest.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over de bescherming van privacygevoelige gegevens van Nederlandse burgers tegenover de overheid van de Verenigde Staten

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Dutch citizens' sensitive data held by cloud providers can be accessed by US authorities under the Patriot Act, and how the government will protect it. The state secretary answered that US law may compel US-headquartered firms to disclose data regardless of location, that the proposed EU Data Protection Regulation does not yet clarify the consequences, and that the Commission is primarily responsible; a letter on the state's own data would follow in about six weeks.

Specifically on the question of what consequences US legislation has for personal data belonging to the State, the Minister of the Interior will inform your House in more detail by letter in about six weeks.

Specifiek over de vraag welke consequenties de wetgeving van de Verenigde Staten heeft voor persoonsgegevens die aan de Staat toebehoren zal de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties uw Kamer over circa zes weken per brief nader informeren.
Antwoord vragen Hachi en Schouw over de risico’s van software voor het op afstand besturen van industriële processen

MPs Hachchi and Schouw asked about security risks of SCADA systems controlling industrial processes, including whether attacks require exceptionally advanced software, what security requirements and oversight apply, the risks of USB sticks and internet connections, and European activity. The minister answered that operators are themselves responsible, sectoral supervisors oversee SCADA safety, the NCSC advises, and that European initiatives exist.
Organisations within government and the commercial sector are themselves responsible for their SCADA systems.
Organisaties binnen de overheid en de commerciële sector zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun SCADA-systemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brinkman en Çörüz over het artikel ‘Gemeente Haren verscheurde parkeerboetes van gezagsdragers’

MPs Brinkman and Çörüz asked whether the municipality of Haren wrongly cancelled parking fines for officials and politicians, how many cases there were, and whether integrity investigations, repayment or punishment would follow. The minister answered that the cases were incidental, the practice was improper and has ended, but that the matter is local, so the municipality decides on integrity and sanctions.
This is a local matter. It is for the municipality to decide on this.
Het gaat hier om een lokale aangelegenheid. Het is aan de gemeente hierover te beslissen.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over het niet publiceren van verbeurde dwangsommen door overheden

An SP MP asked why ministries and lower governments do not publish how much they paid in penalty payments for missing decision deadlines, and asked for a breakdown by ministry plus commitments to yearly publication. The minister promised all ministries will publish their penalty payment figures online for 2010 and 2011 before summer 2012 and will report them yearly going forward, but said publication by lower governments is up to their own autonomy and is not required by law.
As for lower governments, I refer you to my answer to question 5.
Voor wat betreft de lagere overheden verwijs ik u naar mijn antwoord op vraag 5.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over de ongebruikelijke transacties van de minister-president van Curaçao

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about unusual financial transactions involving Curaçao's prime minister, including when the government knew and whether they should have blocked his appointment. The minister declined to give a view on the appointment as a matter for Curaçao's own bodies, said the screening raised no grounds for prosecution, and stated Curaçao is autonomous with intervention only a last resort.
It is for the States of Curaçao to assess whether the administrators made a sound judgment when appointing the prime minister.
Het is aan de Staten van Curaçao om te beoordelen of de bestuurders een goede afweging hebben gemaakt bij de benoeming van de minister-president.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over het sluiten van diverse belastingkantoren

An MP asked why the Tax Administration offices in Emmen, Helmond and Heerenveen are being closed, why this was not discussed with parliament first, and what the job losses and dismissal risks are. The minister replied that no final decisions on Emmen have been taken, the Helmond and Heerenveen leases were terminated for efficiency reasons, and the office location policy is indicative and will be worked out in provincial masterplans, with no forced dismissals intended.
It is not customary to share housing changes with the House first.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om huisvestingsveranderingen eerst met de Kamer te delen.
Antwoord vragen Elissen over het beleggen van “overtollig” geld van de provincie Noord-Holland

An MP asked whether the province of Noord-Holland invests surplus funds with private institutions and whether this breaches the schatkistbankieren (treasury banking) arrangement. The minister answered that the Nazorgfonds, a separate entity outside the arrangement, may invest under the Ruddo rules, that no agreement was breached, and that he will raise the topic with provincial associations.

The decision of the Gedeputeerde Staten of Noord-Holland to invest 70% of the Nazorgfonds N-H funds in fixed-income and 30% in equities falls within the legal framework, and therefore no agreement has been breached by Noord-Holland.

Het besluit van Gedeputeerde Staten van Noord-Holland om 70% van de middelen van het Nazorgfonds N-H te beleggen in vastrentende waarden en 30% in zakelijke waarden valt derhalve binnen de wettelijke kaders en er is derhalve geen afspraak door Noord-Holland geschonden.
Antwoord vragen de leden Taverne, Hennis-Plasschaert, Van der Steur en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over het bericht dat de wet zou wijken voor religieuze regels

Four VVD MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Justice whether a reported court ruling in The Hague, that religious obligations could take precedence over statutory duties such as showing identification, accurately reflects the judgment and whether it has been appealed. The minister confirmed the press report matches the oral ruling, that an appeal has been lodged, and referred the question of general principle to answers given to other MPs' questions.
The ruling itself provides no basis for those consequences.
Daarvoor biedt de uitspraak zelf geen grondslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Smilde over het vertrek van de belastingdienst uit Emmen

MPs Wolbert and Smilde asked whether the Tax Authority's departure from Emmen, costing about 300 jobs, had been weighed against regional employment and service to citizens. The minister replied that no decisions on relocation have been taken, that the regional impact will be assessed in the Drenthe office masterplan with the province, and that savings phase in through 2020.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over de vermogensgrenzen van de kwijtschelding van gemeentelijke belastingen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the expansion of asset limits for municipal tax remission is narrower than proposed, whether this was withheld from parliament, and whether a statutory expansion can be undone through lower regulations, and whether restricting asset limits would hurt elderly savers and recipients of special assistance. The minister said the executive rules are not yet adapted but a temporary arrangement exists, that the expansion is not currently being implemented for benefit recipients due to the poverty trap, and that the rules were recently amended to protect the existing remission level for AOW-only pensioners.
The letter I mention under answer 2 explains why the asset limits for remission of local taxes are not currently being expanded for individuals.
In de brief die ik noem onder antwoord 2 wordt uitgelegd waarom de vermogensgrenzen voor de kwijtschelding van decentrale belastingen nu niet worden verruimd voor particulieren.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over de verhoging van de pensioenpremie door het ABP

An MP asked the ministers whether the government had budgeted for the ABP pension premium increase costing the state over 300 million euros, how the costs would be absorbed and what it means for civil servants' pay, cuts and collective bargaining. The minister answered that the increase was partly foreseeable but not budgeted, that ministries must absorb it through personnel and material savings, that net pay falls about 0.4%, and that the pension agreement measures will be implemented in the ABP scheme.
The shortfall caused by the recovery surcharge on the pension premium does not come entirely unexpectedly.
De tegenvaller vanwege de herstelopslag op de pensioenpremie komt niet helemaal onverwacht.
Antwoord vragen De Boer over het artikel ‘Gemeente publiceert kraakkaart’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a municipal online map of vacant office buildings in Amsterdam, asking whether it encourages squatting and what role the neighbourhood support point plays. The minister replied that the map is public information on structurally vacant offices, that it aims at transparency and pressuring owners, that it does not incite squatting, and that the neighbourhood point is independent and only signals housing issues.
I do not share the view that this encourages squatters to squat.
Ik deel niet de opvatting dat hiermee krakers worden aangezet tot kraken.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over de WOZ-beschikking voor huurders

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether her claim that tenants can have a direct interest in WOZ valuations conflicts with the WOZ Act, and how municipalities will be made to provide WOZ decisions to tenants, plus costs and burdens of the new rent-points system. The minister answered that tenants are legally interested parties under the WOZ Act, that no amendment is needed, that municipalities will supply decisions on request, and that cost figures are largely already covered by existing state funding, while also noting partial limits on tenant appeals.
Tenants are in fact interested parties under articles 24(3)(b) and 26 of the WOZ Act, and can therefore receive a decision and, if necessary, object to it.
Huurders zijn namelijk belanghebbenden op grond van de artikelen 24, derde lid, onderdeel b, en 26 van de Wet WOZ, en kunnen daarom een beschikking ontvangen en zonodig bezwaar maken.
Antwoord vragen Lucassen over het bericht op elsevier.nl van 8 februari 2012 “Topman van Vestia bouwt een villa op Bonaire tussen BN’ers"

MP Lucassen asked the Minister of Interior whether the former Vestia executive was building a large villa on Bonaire, how much salary he earned, what exit arrangements applied, and whether he could be held liable and his assets seized. The minister confirmed the villa construction, disclosed annual pay of roughly EUR 450,000-500,000 and a EUR 3.5 million reserve released on departure, called this inappropriate, and said Vestia should pursue recovery of damage through civil or criminal channels.

I consider the level of the former executive's remuneration, as shown in the picture sketched in answer 3, as well as the scope of the other arrangements that emerge from the information provided by Vestia, to be inappropriate for a housing corporation, also given the timing.

Ik vind de hoogte van de beloning van de voormalig bestuurder zoals die blijkt uit het bij vraag 3 geschetste beeld, alsmede de omvang van de overige afspraken die uit bovenstaande informatie van Vestia blijkt, ongepast voor een woningcorporatie, ook gelet op de timing.
Antwoord vragen Paulus Jansen over energiebesparing door innovatieve automatische zonwering

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a TNO report on energy savings from automated exterior blinds (HR-zonwering) was accepted, whether such blinds are included in the energy label calculation and the Energie Investerings Aftrek, and how innovation could be promoted. The government agreed with the report, said blinds are already in the calculation for non-residential buildings but not yet for homes, and explained the two routes to EIA for non-residential buildings, while declining to pick specific technical innovation and pointing to general energy-quality incentives.
For non-residential buildings, HR blinds are already included in the standard calculation method and software for the EPC and energy label, for homes not yet, but I will promote this.
Voor utiliteitsgebouwen is HR-zonwering al opgenomen in de standaardberekeningsmethode en -software voor de EPC en het energielabel, voor woningen nog niet, maar ik zal dit bevorderen.
Antwoord vragen van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Overheden laten 30 procent energiebesparing liggen’

An MP asks the Minister of Interior whether the 15-30 percent energy savings claimed for energy managers and outsourced maintenance are accurate, what low-hanging fruit exists, and what is done on energy management in government buildings. The minister answers that savings of 15-30 percent need more than a manager, that typically 15-20 percent is achievable with cost-effective measures, points to existing legal obligations and the 2011 action plan, and promises to share experience with innovative contracts.
The Rijksgebouwendienst will share its experiences with (innovative) contracts with the market.
Rijksgebouwendienst zullen hun ervaringen met (innovatieve) contracten delen met de markt
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren over het onderwerp de uitlating van de Amsterdamse korpschef dat boerkadragers niet altijd beboet zullen gaan worden

An MP asks the ministers whether the Amsterdam police chief's remark that face-covering (boerka) wearers will not always be fined is acceptable, and whether he has taken note of the minister's pledge to enforce the ban loyally. The minister confirms awareness of the article, restates that police must always enforce the law, and states there is no doubt the police will enforce the ban once it takes effect.
The police must at all times enforce the law.
De politie dient te allen tijde de wet te handhaven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over de voortvarendheid waarmee de Belastingdienst huiseigenaren van dienst is bij het achterhalen van de hoogte van het inkomen van achteloze huurders

MPs Monasch and Groot asked whether the Tax Authority's web tool letting landlords check whether a household's income exceeds 43,000 euro is lawful and privacy-compliant, and what safeguards and enforcement exist against misuse. The minister answered that a temporary exemption from tax secrecy covers the tool, that landlords can only query their own properties and must accept usage terms, and that misuse is unlawful and subject to civil, data-protection and criminal sanctions.
Landlords may only request the information for that purpose.
Verhuurders mogen de informatie alleen maar voor dat doel opvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut over het verstrekken van privacygevoelige informatie aan verhuurders door de belastingdienst

An SP MP asks whether it is proper for the tax authority to provide tenants' income data to landlords before the rent-increase law amendment has been debated in parliament, and whether this should stop. The minister defends the early provision as based on current law (art. 67 AWR exemption) to enable timely income-based rent proposals, and refuses to stop it.
Antwoord vragen Schouw over het behoud van het dubbele paspoort

MP Schouw (D66) asked the Interior Minister about retaining dual nationality in light of international trends and press articles on the issue. Minister Spies replied that each state sets its own rules, that the bill will remove exceptions so that acquiring another nationality ends Dutch nationality, that no one is forced to renounce it, and that the bill is expected in March.
The fact that there are countries that expand the possibilities for multiple nationality does not lead this cabinet to a different assessment.
Het feit dat er landen zijn die de mogelijkheden voor meervoudige nationaliteit vergroten, leidt niet tot een andere afweging van dit kabinet.
Antwoord vragen Van Bochove en Paulus Jansen over Besluit uitvoering Crisis en herstelwet

MPs Van Bochove and Paulus Jansen asked whether the Almere exemption in the Crisis and Recovery Act implementing decree (art. 6e) applies only to new build and how it affects existing homes, resale and renovation. The minister answered that the exemption covers only listed new-build rules, existing homes must meet existing-building rules, and renovations must reach the acquired-rights level and the existing-building standards.
The articles containing the existing-building requirements are not mentioned in the decree and are therefore excluded from the experiment.
De artikelen waarin de voorschriften voor bestaande bouw zijn opgenomen worden niet genoemd in het besluit en zijn derhalve uitgesloten van het experiment.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over het onderwerp voortgang van het Nationaal Programma Kwaliteitssprong voor Rotterdam Zuid

MP Karabulut asks the minister about resident participation in the Rotterdam South development programme, including the promised follow-up after an earlier complaint, the role of residents' organisations, and the consequences of cutbacks. The minister replies that participation is being organised at district level, residents' organisations are being integrated with other resident groups from 2012, and the minister will monitor participation in consultation with the municipality.
Twice a year I hold administrative consultation with the municipality of Rotterdam. Resident participation will be a standing agenda item at these consultations.
Twee keer per jaar heb ik bestuurlijk overleg met de gemeente Rotterdam. De bewonersparticipatie zal een vast agendapunt van deze overleggen zijn.
Antwoord vragen Van Gent, Bosman, van Bochove, van Raak, Recourt, Ortega-Martijn en Hachchi over de ticketprijzen van vliegtarieven van en naar Nederland vanaf Caribische eilanden

MPs asked why airfares from Dutch Caribbean islands to the Netherlands differ despite similar distances, how taxes apply to flights within the Kingdom, and whether the minister would discuss fares with airlines. The government answered that airlines set fares commercially under the new Kingdom aviation protocol, that intra-Kingdom flights are not subject to turnover tax, and that the aviation authorities intervene only for extremely high or low fares.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Helder en Brinkman over de zoveelste gewelddadige straatroof in Utrecht

MPs Van Klaveren, Helder and Brinkman asked ministers about repeated violent street robberies in Utrecht, whether they still trusted Utrecht mayor Wolfsen, what measures would be taken against him, and whether heavy sentences and denaturalisation of dual nationals would largely solve the problem. The government replied that the municipal council judges mayoral performance, referred to earlier answers on youth groups, stated that repressive and preventive measures are both needed, left sentencing to judges, and said a bill is being prepared so that Dutch nationality lapses after a final conviction within five years for offences carrying twelve or more years.
It is primarily for the municipal council to judge the functioning of a mayor.
Het is primair aan de gemeenteraad om te oordelen over het functioneren van een burgemeester.
Antwoord vragen Ortega-Martijn en Schouten over gedetineerden uit Saba en St. Eustatius in Bonaire

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Schouten asked the Dutch government about prisoners from Saba and St. Eustatius being held and tried on Bonaire, covering defence-lawyer access, video-link problems, prison conditions, juvenile offenders, reintegration, family visits and the facility location. Minister Opstelten largely rejected the critiques, said conditions are equal to other prisons and improving, and promised a new prison on St. Eustatius by 2014 and an examination of weekly video contact for families.

Since 10 October 2010 a slightly different situation has arisen, namely that suspects detained longer than 18 days are now transferred to Bonaire instead of St. Maarten, but the suspect's detention rights have remained unchanged.

Sinds 10 oktober 2010 is weliswaar een iets andere situatie ontstaan dan daarvoor, namelijk dat verdachten die langer dan 18 dagen gedetineerd zijn nu naar Bonaire worden overgebracht in plaats van naar St. Maarten, maar de rechten van de verdachte in het kader van detentie zijn onveranderd gebleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Klaveren, Van der Staaij, Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en Ormel over de komst van een extremistische imam naar Nederland

MPs asked whether a British cleric known for antisemitic and misogynistic statements, invited to a VU symposium, should be barred from entering the Netherlands. The government answered that it had examined an entry ban but found the statements insufficient grounds under EU free-movement rules, which require a current, genuine and serious threat to public order.
The objectionable statements, however, are insufficient indication that such a danger exists.
De verwerpelijke uitspraken zijn echter onvoldoende aanwijzing dat een dergelijk gevaar aan de orde is.

Vagen van de leden Van Dekken, Jacobi en Van der Veen (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verdwijnen van spoedeisende hulp in het

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Health about the closure of three emergency and maternity departments at the Sionsberg hospital in Dokkum and the regional opposition to it. The government answered that regional access to acute care is secured within 45 minutes through extra ambulance capacity and a helicopter arrangement, that other hospitals can serve the region, and that a hospital availability allowance for 2012 is conditional on an adequate plan.
With these measures, the accessibility of acute care in the region within 45 minutes is secured.
Met deze maatregelen is de bereikbaarheid van de acute zorg in de regio binnen 45 minuten geborgd.

Antwoord vragen Van der Burg en De Boer over het bericht van het CBS dat in 2012 de opbrengst uit heffingen van lokale overheden met 3,2 procent stijgt en de Onroerende Zaakbelasting (OZB) de macronorm fors lijkt te over

Two VVD MPs asked whether CBS figures showing a 3.2 percent rise in local levies and a likely overshoot of the 3.75 percent OZB macro-norm for 2012 are reliable, and what the government will do. The minister answered that the figures are preliminary, that final CBS data are due in March, that a joint analysis with the VNG will follow, and that a proportional deduction from the Gemeentefonds is possible if the norm is exceeded.
When the final figures are known in March, we as fund managers, together with the VNG, will make an analysis of the development of the OZB in 2012.
Als de definitieve cijfers in maart bekend zijn zullen wij als fondsbeheerders, samen met de VNG, een analyse maken van de ontwikkeling van de OZB in 2012.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het bericht dat mevrouw Albayrak bij vertrek bij het Centraal Orgaan Opvang Asielzoekers tonnen kan claimen

MP Van Gerven asked whether COA director Albayrak could claim a large severance, whether individual agreements were already made, and whether an inventory of such arrangements across (semi-)public bodies could be made. The minister declined to comment on her individual employment position while an independent inquiry into COA is ongoing, and declined the inventory as disproportionate, suggesting waiting for the inquiry results.
It does not seem appropriate, in anticipation of the results of the inquiry, to already make statements that touch on the individual legal position of a COA employee.
Het lijkt mij niet opportuun, vooruitlopend op de resultaten van het onderzoek, reeds uitspraken te doen, die raken aan de individuele rechtspositie van een medewerker van het COA.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en Van Vliet over stijgende WOZ-waarderingen

Two PVV MPs asked why WOZ property valuations keep rising while house prices fall, whether this creates municipal arbitrariness, and what will be done to protect homeowners. The minister answered that valuations lag market prices by a year, that municipal arbitrariness is not evidenced and the Waarderingskamer supervises, and that a bill to make WOZ values public and informal objection channels are planned.
I have not found any evidence that there is municipal arbitrariness.
Mij is niet gebleken dat er sprake is van gemeentelijke willekeur.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Spekman over de berichtgeving over ernstige huurbetalingsproblemen in Breda

MPs Monasch and Spekman asked whether reports that one in five Breda tenants face serious rent payment problems, and the government's rent and housing-allowance measures, would worsen tenants' situation. The minister replied that the RIGO study measures housing cost ratios rather than actual payment arrears, that the measures are not expected to worsen payment problems, and that the housing-allowance cuts are necessary to cover budget shortfalls.
I am not willing to do so, since these cuts are necessary to cover shortfalls in the housing allowance budget.
Ik ben hiertoe niet bereid, aangezien deze bezuinigingen noodzakelijk zijn om tekorten op de huurtoeslagbegroting te dekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Van Vliet en Lucassen over het bericht dat banken weigeren om tweeverdieners met een modaal inkomen een hogere hypotheek te verstrekken

PVV MPs asked whether the AFM's objection to relaxed mortgage rules for dual-earner households with modal incomes, and its view on the limits of lending, was consistent with its supervisory role, and whether supervisors should refrain from commenting on the housing market. The minister replied that the AFM may state what it considers responsible lending under the open norm, and that the AFM and DNB, as independent supervisors, are free to comment on the housing market while respecting existing rules.
The AFM and DNB, as independent supervisors, are free to express views on the housing market.
Het staat de AFM en DNB als onafhankelijk toezichthouder vrij om zich uit te spreken over de woningmarkt.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Plasterk over de berichtgeving op 9 januari 2012 over de beperking van de hypotheekruimte voor tweeverdieners

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Interior whether major mortgage lenders are refusing to apply the looser Nibud borrowing norm for two-earner households and whether the AFM fines lenders who do so, and what the government will do for households earning up to 40,000. The minister replied that lenders signalled they will follow the AFM, that no fines can be assumed in advance, and that the existing borrowing capacity method is unchanged, with renting as an alternative.

The AFM has indicated that lenders cannot assume in advance that an expansion of borrowing capacity for consumers earning between average and one and a half times average income will be seen by the AFM as responsible lending.

De AFM heeft aangegeven dat de kredietverstrekkers er niet op voorhand vanuit kunnen gaan dat een verruiming van de leencapaciteit voor consumenten met een modaal tot anderhalf keer modaal inkomen door de AFM als verantwoorde kredietverlening wordt gezien.

Vragen van het lid Spekman (PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Immigratie en Asiel over de naturalisatie van vreemdelingen die een verblijfsvergunning hebben op grond van het gen

An MP asks whether former asylum seekers holding Ranov (generaal pardon) permits, who lacked identity and nationality documents, can still obtain Dutch citizenship, and whether an exception or looser proof-of-hardship regime should apply. The minister answers that documents remain required, that those with Ranov permits must try to obtain them via their home state, family or other channels, and that no special regime or exception will be created.
The IND's automated systems cannot show how many Ranov permit holders did not possess documents during their asylum procedure or when the permit was granted.

Uit de geautomatiseerde systemen van de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) is niet te herleiden hoeveel houders van een verblijfsvergunning onder de «Regeling afwikkeling nalatenschap oude Vreemdelingenwet» (Ranov) tijdens hun asielprocedure of ten tijde van de verlening van de Ranov-vergunning niet in het bezit waren van documenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over malafide praktijken onder makelaars

An MP from the VVD asked the minister about reports of fraudulent practices among estate agents, their scale, and whether existing rules should be enforced more strictly rather than new rules added. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, said no data on the scale is available, and stated that the approach should not involve more rules but refers back to earlier answers.
I do not have data on the scale of fraudulent practices and therefore cannot give an estimate.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens over de omvang van malafide praktijken en kan derhalve geen inschatting geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over malafide verhuurmakelaars

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they support a private certification mark for rental brokers, whether it should be made mandatory, and whether a national licensing requirement for rental brokers would help sanction malpractice. The minister supports voluntary quality measures but sees no reason to make a certificate mandatory, and rejects reinstating a state licensing requirement as it would conflict with the policy of a compact government; rental owners remain responsible for their own tenant selection and can hold brokers liable.
However, I see no reason to make a certificate mandatory, so that the certificate or one of the certificates becomes a establishment requirement for brokers.
Ik zie echter geen reden voor het verplicht stellen van een keurmerk, zodat het keurmerk of een van de keurmerken een vestigingsverplichting wordt voor makelaars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over vergoedingen aan de Commissaris der Koningin van de provincie Utrecht
