It must not be possible that someone responsible for abuses in care simply becomes active in care again.
Het moet niet kunnen dat iemand die verantwoordelijk is voor misstanden in de zorg, zomaar weer actief wordt in de zorg.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over signalen van problemen met woon-zorginitiatieven

An MP asked the Minister of Health about signals that care-home residents face rent increases, whether they are vulnerable because housing and care are contractually linked, and about rent protection, care-level changes and quality of care in care-home initiatives. The Minister answered that rent disputes go to the Huurcommissie, that existing rent rules apply, that residents in Wlz institutions pay no rent and so lack rent protection, and that the IGJ supervises care quality, while committing only to existing measures on PGB-financed initiatives.
The Ministry of VWS has no signals of problematic rent increases for clients in a care home.
Er zijn bij het Ministerie van VWS geen signalen bekend over problematische huurstijgingen bij cliënten in een zorgwoning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ‘Mevrouw Verheijden (88) moest halsoverkop weg uit verzorgingshuis’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about an 88-year-old resident who had to move suddenly from a care home run by Zuyderland after staff sick leave, questioning staffing, cuts and the risk of repeated moves. The government answered that the unit was temporarily closed due to combined sick leave, that residents will return by end of October, and that the budget decision is deferred to the 2025 budget.
I have not received any concrete signals about this.
Ik heb hierover geen concrete signalen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Crijns en Maeijer over het bericht dat 400.000 kinderen nooit buitenspelen

PVV MPs asked the state secretary about a report that 400,000 children never play outside and whether safe play spaces and social safety are declining. The state secretary acknowledged the problem as complex, said data on play spaces is incomplete, and promised a study and further consultation with Jantje Beton, but committed to no binding measures.
The lack of (complete) data overviews makes it difficult to properly investigate, evaluate or monitor policy on and the availability of sports and play spaces in Dutch municipalities.
Het gebrek aan (volledige) data-overzichten maakt het lastig om het beleid over en de beschikbaarheid van sport- en speelplekken in Nederlandse gemeenten goed te onderzoeken, evalueren of monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht 'Steeds meer kinderen zonder zwemdiploma vooral bij lage inkomens'

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport how children from lower-income families can be helped to obtain swimming diplomas, and why Dutch children still do not all achieve them. The minister answered that municipal schemes, the Jeugdfonds Sport en Cultuur and school swimming support access, that the backlog is being tackled with the sector, and that parent awareness is being raised through the national swimming safety plan.
I am in continuous discussion with the sector to devise solutions for how the backlogs can be made up.
Ik ben continu in gesprek met de branche om oplossingen te bedenken hoe de achterstanden ingelopen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Maeijer over het bericht dat het Erasmus MC vlees bant en snoepautomaten heeft verwijderd

MPs Agema and Maeijer asked the minister whether Erasmus MC's ban on meat and candy bars and removal of snack machines imposes a lifestyle on patients and whether the government should stop such dictation. The state secretary answered that hospitals are responsible for their own food offer, that choices remain available, and that the hospital is not banning anything.
Healthcare organisations are themselves responsible for the food offer in their institutions.
Zorgorganisaties zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het voedingsaanbod in hun instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over de politie-inzet bij uithuisplaatsingen van kinderen

An MP from PVV asked the government about police involvement in roughly 550 annual child removals from their homes and whether this was justified. The minister answered that police assist only when safety requires it, under an internal guideline agreed with the Public Prosecution Service and Jeugdzorg NL that emphasises de-escalation.
The starting point is that the police only assist when this is necessary to safeguard safety and the circumstances require it.
Het uitgangspunt is dat de politie alleen assisteert als dit nodig is ter waarborging van de veiligheid en als de omstandigheden daarom vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht 'Sportkantine drooggelegd: kabinet sleutelt aan nieuwe anti-drankplannen'

An MP from the PVV asks whether the government plans a 50% alcohol excise increase, a ban on selling wine and beer in supermarkets, and a ban on all alcoholic drinks in sports canteens, and why adults should not decide for themselves. The state secretary denies a cabinet decision exists, says the aim is no alcohol served during youth matches and no sales to under-18s at clubs, and says the RIVM inventory of measures is available.
There is no cabinet decision, nor a political wish list.
Er is geen sprake van een Kabinetsbesluit, ook niet van een politiek wensenlijstje.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Maeijer over het bericht dat “EU-bobo’s gesubsidieerd naar Straatsburg vliegen”

PVV MPs asked the government about the subsidised Amelia flights between Amsterdam and Strasbourg, EU travel costs, private jet use, the Strasbourg seat, the air passenger tax and the IBO climate report. The minister answered that the route is a Public Service Obligation, that EU travel rules favour the most cost-effective option, that the government has no say over MEP travel, and that private jets are largely covered by existing aviation climate policy.
Enquiries show that the current European Parliament rules for business travel are based on choosing the most cost-effective option.
Navraag leert dat de huidige regels van het Europees Parlement voor dienstreizen zijn gebaseerd op de keuze van de meest kosteneffectieve optie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Agema over het bericht dat het sterftecijfer voor kanker in Nederland hoger ligt dan het EU-gemiddelde

MPs Maeijer and Agema asked the Health Minister about reports that Dutch cancer mortality exceeds the EU average, and about cancer policy, screening, a national cancer plan and access to cancer medicines. The minister answered that incidence is high due to past smoking and screening, that mortality has fallen 11%, that a Nationaal Kanker Collectief is being set up, and that the sluis procedure for expensive medicines is maintained for cost control.
I have asked the Health Council to advise me on lung cancer screening, bearing in mind the relevant criteria for responsible screening.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd om mij te adviseren over een screening op longkanker, indachtig de relevante criteria voor verantwoorde screening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Kops over de dreigende sluiting van 200 zwembaden

PVV MPs Maeijer and Kops asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about reports that 200 public swimming pools face closure due to energy costs, including what the government will do and how sport stays affordable. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the figures cannot be substantiated, pointed to existing energy support schemes and a pending review of sport-sector needs, and promised a further update in November.
These figures cannot be substantiated concretely, but I do share the concerns about the impact of rising energy costs on public swimming pools.
Deze cijfers zijn niet concreet te onderbouwen, maar ik deel wel de zorgen omtrent de impact van de stijgende energiekosten voor openbare zwembaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het openen van een EU-attractie in Den Haag

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether he could stop the planned EU 'Europa Experience' exhibition in The Hague, and questioned the cost given the cost-of-living crisis. The minister replied that it is a European Parliament initiative in which the member state has no role, that costs are not yet known pending a public tender for a building, and that the Council urges restraint on EU administrative spending.
The member state concerned has no role in it, neither in approval or budget, nor in implementation.
De desbetreffende lidstaat heeft daar geen rol bij, noch in de accordering of begroting, noch in de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over stappen naar betere jeugdhulp

An MP asks the state secretary about the care and protection available to child and adult victims of sexual abuse, exploitation and violence, and about specialist national care and the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd. The secretary acknowledges gaps and points to ongoing studies, a national action plan, a reform agenda due this autumn, and consultation of care providers, without committing to a dedicated treatment title or a new national research project.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht dat een nieuw kankermedicijn niet meer gratis beschikbaar is voor patiënten in Nederland

An MP asked the health minister about a pharmaceutical company that stopped providing a new cancer drug free of charge in the Netherlands via a compassionate use programme, and about waiting times for reimbursement. The minister said the company's claims give a partial picture, that Dutch approval timelines are not out of line with Europe, that the company's decision is regrettable, and that he will talk with the industry association and publish a dashboard on reimbursement timelines later this year.
I intend to enter into discussion with the industry association for pharmaceutical companies about compassionate use.
Desondanks ben ik voornemens om in gesprek te gaan met de branchevereniging voor farmaceutische bedrijven over compassionate use.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over de spendeerdrift en baantjescaroussel van het Europees Parlement

An MP from the PVV asks the Foreign Minister about the European Parliament's proposed budget increases, staff numbers, and an alleged informal pact among EU institutions not to scrutinise each other's administrative spending. The minister answers with budget and staffing figures, explains the Council's critical position and call for restraint, and says the Netherlands will push for a prudent EU budget in line with the MFF agreement.
The European Parliament proposed a budget of 2,268 million euros in the Commission proposal for the 2023 budget.
Het Europees Parlement heeft in het Commissievoorstel voor de begroting van 2023 een budget voorgesteld van 2.268 miljoen euro.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Maeijer over het bericht 'Zonder onderzoek draaien we om hete brij'

MPs Markuszower and Maeijer asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether an independent inquiry is needed into the role of judges in out-of-home placements of children from the childcare benefits scandal, and how further placements due to debt problems will be prevented. The minister answered that an Inspectorate inquiry is underway, an independent inquiry commission is being prepared, the judiciary will review files itself, and no further inquiry is needed, while stating that debt alone is no ground for placement.

At this moment I see no reason for another inquiry because the inspectorate investigation is already underway, an inquiry commission is being prepared, the judiciary itself will conduct file research, and a reflection process of family and youth judges is ongoing.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding voor nog een onderzoek omdat het inspectieonderzoek al loopt, er een onderzoekscommissie in voorbereiding is, de Rechtspraak zelf dossieronderzoek zal gaan doen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over bericht dat medicijntekorten leiden tot agressie bij de apotheek

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a report that drug shortages cause aggression against pharmacy staff, and about causes of shortages, pricing under preferential purchasing, and domestic production. The minister acknowledged the report, pointed to employer responsibility and a sector approach against aggression, explained shortage causes and alternatives, and listed ongoing domestic production initiatives without committing to new binding measures.
Yes, I am aware of the report.
Ik ben bekend met het bericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht ‘Peuk peperduur; kabinet: prijsverhoging sigaretten tot 47 euro in 2040’

An MP from the PVV asks the state secretary for Health whether a planned large increase in cigarette excise up to 47 euro per pack by 2040 is justified, and whether it will push smokers abroad and fuel smuggling. The state secretary answers that excise increases are an effective prevention tool toward a smoke-free generation by 2040, cites RIVM evidence that cross-border buying rose only modestly, and points to EU traceability rules and the WHO protocol against illicit trade.
A further excise increase after 2024 is one of the measures I am including in my exploration because it is scientifically regarded as a very important measure to reduce the number of smokers.

Een verdergaande accijnsverhoging na 2024 is één van de maatregelen die ik meeneem in mijn verkenning omdat dit wetenschappelijk wordt gezien als een zeer belangrijke maatregel om het aantal rokers terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Maeijer en Wilders over het bericht dat Brussel van plan is een fonds op te richten voor de wederopbouw van Oekraïne

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU plans a reconstruction fund for Ukraine that Dutch taxpayers would largely fund, and under what conditions Ukraine could access it. The minister answered that the Commission has only outlined principles (a mix of grants and loans, linked to reform and anti-corruption), has named no amounts, and that the Dutch contribution is not yet clear.
To what extent and in what form the Netherlands will contribute is not yet clear at this time, and will depend partly on a joint assessment of needs.
In welke mate en vorm Nederland daaraan zal bijdragen is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk, en zal mede afhankelijk zijn van een gezamenlijke inventarisatie van de noden.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Maeijer over de noodoproep van een radeloze moeder

An MP asked whether the minister knows of a desperate mother's emergency appeal about her daughter with an eating disorder, whether the girl should get immediate specialist treatment, why some clinics set BMI floors, and how many young people are waiting. The state secretary declined to discuss the individual case for privacy reasons, pointed to regional responsibility and extra funding and initiatives, and said no central waiting-list overview exists but a regional wait-time analysis is being commissioned with a progress report promised.
For reasons of privacy for the mother and daughter, I cannot go into the individual case in parliamentary questions.
Met het oog op privacy van moeder en dochter kan ik in Kamervragen niet inhoudelijk ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Maeijer over de berichten dat Nederland miljarden minder ontvangt en meer mag betalen aan de EU

MPs Tony van Dijck and Maeijer asked whether Dutch receipts from the EU recovery fund (RRF) will fall and whether the Dutch EU contribution will rise through the Social Climate Fund and MFF revision, and whether the government will oppose higher contributions. The ministers answered that the RRF allocation will be finalised by the Commission by 30 June and the Dutch plan will then be fixed, provided tables of allocations and disbursements, and that the government is cautious about higher contributions but will assess the total package and aims for prudent EU budget development.
The cabinet is pursuing a prudent development of the EU budget, with more attention to policy areas that are a priority for the Netherlands.
Het kabinet zet in op een prudente ontwikkeling van de EU-begroting, met meer aandacht voor beleidsterreinen die voor Nederland prioritair zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het onderzoek 'Gesloten jeugdzorg beschadigt 86% van de kinderen'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a Het Vergeten Kind study claiming closed youth care harms 86% of children, including isolation cells and restraint. The State Secretary acknowledged harm and abuse risks, cited reduced placements and isolation cell phase-out, and promised a plan to end closed youth care in its current form, with alternatives to be developed with municipalities, providers and youths.
That is why it is good that in recent years the number of children placed in closed youth care has decreased sharply.
Het is daarom goed dat de afgelopen jaren het aantal kinderen dat in de gesloten jeugdhulp geplaatst wordt sterk verminderd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Maeijer over de Europese coronareispas

Opposition MPs Agema and Maeijer (PVV) asked the Minister of Health why the EU COVID digital certificate was limited to nine months after full vaccination, questioning the scientific basis, the consistency with earlier promises of free travel for fully vaccinated people, and the logic of requiring boosters while outbreaks occurred among triple-vaccinated staff. Minister Kuipers defended the nine-month validity as an EU-wide uniform rule based on waning protection against omicron, said boosters improve protection, and acknowledged that policy must sometimes be reconsidered as circumstances change.
The Netherlands agreed on 16 December 2021 to the maximum validity of the EU digital COVID certificate (DCC) of 9 months after full vaccination.
Nederland heeft op 16 december 2021 ingestemd met de maximale geldigheid van het digitale EU-covidcertificaat (DCC) van 9 maanden na volledige vaccinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Maeijer over het bericht dat de Minister van VWS de interne fitnessclub in het Erasmus MC openhield terwijl sportscholen gesloten zijn

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport why the internal gym at Erasmus MC stayed open while public gyms were closed under the lockdown, and whether all gyms would reopen. The minister answered that the gym is a closed indoor space for staff, permitted under the rules with group-size and distancing limits, and that gyms were reopened on 14 January.
As for the fitness room at Erasmus MC, it is a closed indoor space.
Voor wat betreft de fitnessruimte in het Erasmus MC is sprake van een besloten binnenruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Markuszower over het bericht 'Alarm jeugdrechters om crisis jeugdzorg: gebrekkige dossiers en niet passende beslissingen'

MPs Maeijer and Markuszower asked the government about reports that juvenile judges warn of a youth care crisis, with poor case files and inappropriate decisions, and about waiting times, closed placements and the quality of factual investigation in child protection. The minister acknowledges pressure on child protection, reports regional gaps and an action programme, but gives no national figures on children waiting or unnecessarily detained, and points to other bodies and ongoing reviews.
No national figures are available on how many children are currently waiting for the child protection measure imposed by the juvenile judge.
Er zijn op landelijk niveau geen cijfers beschikbaar hoeveel kinderen op dit moment wachten op de door de kinderrechter opgelegde jeugdbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht dat vergoeding van het medicijn Kaftrio tegen taaislijmziekte (CF) opnieuw is uitgesteld

An MP asked the State Secretary why reimbursement of the cystic fibrosis drug Kaftrio has been delayed again and why Dutch patients wait while other countries already reimburse it. The State Secretary answered that the Zorginstituut judged the price unjustifiably high, that price negotiations with the manufacturer are ongoing without agreement, and that he has asked the manufacturer to make the drug available during negotiations.
I am also, on condition, willing to take the costs of making the drug available into account in my negotiations with the manufacturer.
Ik ben, onder voorwaarde, ook bereid om de kosten voor de beschikbaarheidsstelling mee te wegen in mijn onderhandelingen met de fabrikant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht dat een cruciaal oogmedicijn tot 2022 niet beschikbaar is

An MP asked the minister about reports of a shortage of the eye medicine Visudyne until 2022, how many patients are at risk, why stock was lacking, and what can be done. The state secretary answered that harm to patients is likely, that imports and local compounding are not feasible, and that the government will work on EU supply security and inform parliament later.
It is not clear how many patients will actually suffer eye damage.
Het is niet duidelijk hoeveel patiënten daadwerkelijk oogschade zullen oplopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht 'Kind in nood wacht gemiddeld tien maanden op hulp'

The MP Maeijer asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that children in need wait on average 44 weeks for youth care, and how waiting lists would be curbed given expected COVID-related rises in youth mental health problems. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to €613 million in extra funds, a regulation for €50 million and a first waiting-time report due in November, and said municipalities are responsible for youth care provision.
I see the urgency and share the concerns. It is my intention to take appropriate measures as quickly as possible.
Ik zie de urgentie en deel de zorgen. Het is mijn intentie om zo snel mogelijk passende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Markuszower over kinderrechters die de noodklok luiden over de situatie van de jeugdzorg in Zeeland

PVV MPs asked whether judges' warnings that no youth care provider in Zeeland can take on court-ordered child protection cases, causing long waits, mean children are left without help, and what the government will do. The minister answers that new measures can still be assigned, but some children wait for a fixed case manager, with interim safety arrangements; a taskforce and a takeover of Intervence are underway, and the government says it will not take over regie.
Under the Youth Act, municipalities are responsible for implementing youth protection and youth probation.
Gemeenten zijn conform de Jeugdwet verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van jeugdbescherming en -reclassering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over de afwijzing van een nieuw medicijn tegen taaislijmziekte

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care why a new cystic fibrosis drug (Kaftrio) is not reimbursed in the Netherlands despite its benefits, its cost, the country comparison, the wait for patients, and whether societal benefits are weighed. The Minister replies that the Health Care Institute finds the cost-effectiveness very unfavourable at the asking price, that price negotiations are underway, that the manufacturer is partly responsible for the delay, and that societal benefits are included in the institute's analysis.
I will talk with the manufacturer about making Kaftrio available to patients during the negotiations.
Ik ga met de fabrikant in gesprek over het tijdens de onderhandelingen ter beschikking stellen van Kaftrio aan patiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Maeijer over mogelijke Chinese spionage bij Europese instellingen via de ambassade van Malta

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the Maltese embassy in Brussels was used by China for espionage against EU institutions, whether China paid for its renovation, and what the Netherlands does to prevent such practices. The minister confirmed awareness of the reports, cited Malta's statement that it paid for the renovation and that furniture was donated by China, and declined to comment on specific cases, stating that the government is alert to state actors' covert influence and runs an integrated approach.
The cabinet makes no public statements on case matters that affect the current knowledge level and modus operandi of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over casuïstiek die het actuele kennisniveau en de modus operandi van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Maeijer over het bericht dat Griekenland volgend jaar 100.000 migranten verwacht

Two PVV MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security how the Netherlands would prevent migrants expected in Greece from reaching Dutch soil, and about Dutch funding to Turkey under the EU-Turkey deal. The government answered that the EU-Turkey statement has reduced irregular flows, that the Dutch contribution is EUR 140 million to Syrian refugees in Turkey, and that border controls follow the Schengen acquis with shared EU responsibility.
This makes the Statement an effective instrument in countering illegal migration.
Dit maakt de Verklaring een effectief instrument in het tegengaan van illegale migratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat de EU-steun aan Marokko nauwelijks effect heeft

MPs Maeijer and Van Dijk asked whether EU aid to Morocco, criticised by the European Court of Auditors as ineffective, could be recovered, how much Dutch money had flowed there, and why funding should continue given Morocco's refusal to take back rejected nationals. The minister answered that the ECA found limited effectiveness but no evidence of misappropriation, gave the aid totals and Dutch share, and said migration cooperation is pursued through EU instruments while the NDICI negotiations are still ongoing.
The report contains no indications of misappropriation.
Het rapport bevat geen aanwijzingen voor malversaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Maeijer over Moldaviërs die naar Nederland worden gesmokkeld

MPs Emiel van Dijk and Maeijer asked about Moldovans being smuggled to the Netherlands, how many have applied for asylum since visa-free travel in 2014, whether medical and reception support should stop, whether visa-free travel causes illegal stay, and whether the emergency brake or visa reintroduction should be used. The government reported asylum and return figures, restricted medical care for the first two months of reception from 1 December 2019, said the emergency brake is not currently appropriate, and promised a letter on the asylum outcomes in Q1 2020.
Parliament will be informed in the first quarter of 2020 about how the asylum applications of the group of Moldovans who arrived from November are being handled.
Over de afhandeling van de asielaanvragen van de groep Moldaviërs die vanaf november zijn ingestroomd wordt uw Kamer in het eerste kwartaal 2020 geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Maeijer over migrantenschepen die mogen aanmeren in Italië

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government can guarantee that migrants from the Ocean Viking and Alan Kurdi, allowed to dock in Italy, will not be taken in by the Netherlands, and criticised the European Commission's role in redistributing them. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands will in principle no longer take part in ad hoc disembarkation arrangements without a structural solution, and that the Commission only coordinates relocation at a member state's request.

As stated in the letter to parliament of 14 January 2019, the Netherlands, without a concrete prospect of a structural solution, will no longer participate in ad hoc measures within the framework of disembarkation.

Zoals vermeld in de Kamerbrief van 14 januari 2019, zal Nederland, zonder een concreet perspectief op een structurele oplossing, niet meer deelnemen aan ad hoc maatregelen in het kader van ontscheping.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Van Aalst over 700 miljoen euro voor schaamteloze EU-propaganda

Two PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he shares the Commission's view on the DiscoverEU free-travel pilot and the reported 700 million euro EU promotion budget, and whether he will demand that Dutch taxpayer money not be spent on it. The minister said the Netherlands is critical of DiscoverEU in its current form, wants clarity on learning effects, selection and impact before judging, and will press for a financially sustainable MFK with cuts to existing policy.
The cabinet is critical of DiscoverEU in its current form as a pilot programme.
Het kabinet is kritisch over DiscoverEU in de huidige vorm van het pilotprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Maeijer over het bericht er een akkoord is bereikt over de financiering van de eurozonebegroting

PVV MPs Tony van Dijck and Maeijer asked whether the agreement on financing a eurozone budget (BICC) is a first step toward a separate eurozone budget and whether the Netherlands can veto spending or block new own resources. Minister Hoekstra answers that the instrument will be part of the regular EU budget under the MFF ceiling, that the Netherlands opposes new own resources, and that participation in any intergovernmental agreement is voluntary, while the detailed size and distribution remain unresolved.
It has been agreed that the discussion on the necessity, content, modalities and size of a desired intergovernmental agreement will continue in the preparatory working groups of the Eurogroup.
Afgesproken is dat de discussie over de noodzaak, inhoud, modaliteiten en omvang van een door een aantal lidstaten gewenste IGA zal doorgaan in ambtelijke voorportalen van de Eurogroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer, Wilders en Kops (allen PVV) over een nog hogere bijdrage van Nederland aan de Europese meerjarenbegroting

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he agreed with Commissioner-designate Timmermans that rich EU states like the Netherlands should pay more into the EU budget for a climate agenda, and how he would reduce Dutch contributions. The minister answered that the government supports the Green Deal and a Just Transition Fund to be financed within the MFF framework, rejected the claim that the nomination harms the Dutch negotiating position, and committed to pressing for budget savings and possible corrections on contributions.
Once the Commission proposal for the fund has been published, the cabinet will inform your House further.
Zodra het Commissievoorstel voor het fonds is gepubliceerd zal het kabinet uw Kamer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Maeijer en Wilders (allen PVV) over een door de Europese Unie gefinancierd Turks rapport over islamofobie

Three PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether the EU funded a Turkish think tank's report on Islamophobia that they say is government propaganda, how much money was involved, and whether Brussels will stop the funding. The minister confirmed the report was partly EU-funded through a civil society dialogue programme selected by Turkey's foreign ministry, said the EU does not endorse its content, and said the Netherlands has pushed to suspend pre-accession aid without sufficient support.
In this specific case, 90% of the total budget of € 126,951.81 for this SETA publication was financed by the CSD.
In dit specifieke geval is 90% van het totaalbudget van € 126,951.81 voor deze publicatie van SETA door CSD gefinancierd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Maeijer over de juridische werking van het Migratiepact van Marrakesh

PVV MPs asked the government to confirm the authenticity of a leaked European Commission legal note suggesting the UN Global Compact for Migration could have binding effects via EU law, and asked why ministers had said the Compact was not legally binding. The government answered that the Commission described the note as an unofficial document by an individual staff member, that the Compact remains legally non-binding and creates no enforceable rights, and that the earlier legal analysis stands.
The fact remains that the Compact is a legally non-binding document and does not generate enforceable rights.
Feit blijft dat het Compact een juridisch niet-bindend document is en geen afdwingbare rechten genereert.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven, Van der Graaf, Leijten, Van Ojik, Maeijer, Asscher, Van Rooijen, Van Raan, Bisschop, Azarkan en Baudet over de rechtsstatelijke aspecten van de machtigingsbepaling van

MPs from many parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers whether article X of the Brexit omnibus bill, which lets ministers issue temporary general rules that can depart from existing law, undermines legislative primacy and rule-of-law safeguards, and whether they would add safeguards by amendment. The ministers reject the criticism, argue the power is a narrow, one-year transitional measure justified by Brexit's unprecedented nature and that the Council of State endorsed it, and say they will consider an amendment based on Chamber feedback.
We will, based on the views of the Chamber and further reactions from society, benevolently consider whether an amendment note is appropriate.
Wij zullen op basis van de zienswijze van de Kamer en verdere reacties uit de samenleving welwillend bezien of een nota van wijziging aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en De Roon over de uitlatingen van een Nederlandse diplomaat over het opgeven van het veto op het gebied van buitenland beleid

PVV MPs Maeijer and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether he knew of a Dutch diplomat's remarks on giving up the EU foreign-policy veto and whether the government would reject any loss of vetoes. Minister Blok confirmed the quotes, said the government favours efficient EU decision-making with a positive attitude, and promised a BNC-fiche on the Commission communication, without clearly ruling out giving up vetoes.
The cabinet will inform the House of Representatives, by means of a BNC-fiche, of its position on the Communication of the European Commission.
Het kabinet zal de Tweede Kamer door middel van een BNC-fiche informeren over zijn standpunt ten aanzien van de Mededeling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Fritsma over het opheffen van de visumplicht voor Kosovo

PVV MPs Maeijer and Fritsma asked whether the Commission's finding that Kosovo meets visa liberalisation conditions is accepted, whether the government will consent, and why it is nonetheless pursued given past crime and security concerns. The Minister replied that the government will study the Commission report carefully before taking a position, that each country is assessed separately with flanking safeguards, and that visa liberalisation is conditional and monitored after adoption.
The cabinet will study this report carefully before taking a position. Your House will be informed about this.
Het kabinet zal dit rapport nauwgezet bestuderen alvorens een standpunt in te nemen. Uw Kamer zal hierover worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Van Aalst over het bericht dat de EU 15.000 Interrailpassen weggeeft

MPs Maeijer and Van Aalst asked whether the Netherlands supported the EU DiscoverEU free Interrail pass pilot and whether its expansion for 2021-2027 is EU propaganda paid by Dutch taxpayers. Minister Blok answered that DiscoverEU is a European Parliament pilot included in the 2018 EU budget and referred to the BNC-fiche on the proposed Erasmus+ programme for the expansion questions, without giving a cost figure or a position on the propaganda charge.
For the cabinet's appraisal of this proposal, I refer you to the BNC-fiche on Erasmus sent to your House on 10 July.
Voor de kabinetsappreciatie van dit voorstel verwijs ik u graag naar het op 10 juli jl. aan uw Kamer verzonden BNC-fiche over Erasmus
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Van Weerdenburg over meer dan 1 miljard euro voor het Europees solidariteitskorps

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about the EU European Solidarity Corps, its proposed expansion to 350,000 youth and over 1 billion euro, asking which organisations participate, how many Dutch youth joined, what it has cost, and whether the EU should fund it. The minister answered with figures on accredited organisations, registered Dutch participants, the 378 million euro budget under the current MFF, and said the Dutch appraisal of the new proposal will follow via a BNC-fiche.
There is no list available of organisations where young people currently participate or have participated.
Er is geen lijst beschikbaar van organisaties waar jongeren op dit moment aan deelnemen of aan deelgenomen hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Maeijer over ontoegankelijkheid van Amerikaanse nieuwssites door EU regels

PVV MPs asked the government about US news sites blocking EU users because of GDPR rules and what it would do to protect Dutch access to US news. The minister replied that GDPR applies to non-EU firms, that the blocking is a temporary transition problem, that compliant alternatives exist, and that no action is planned.
At this moment I therefore see no reason to take action on this.
Op dit moment zie ik dan ook geen aanleiding om hier actie op te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Maeijer en Wilders over de mededeling dat Nederland een deel van de migranten van het schip 'Lifeline' gaat opvangen

PVV MPs asked whether the government agreed to take in part of the migrants from the Lifeline ship, how many, and why it acted without parliamentary approval, and urged an asylum stop. The State Secretary confirmed Netherlands offered a one-off responsibility for up to 20 asylum seekers from Malta and referred the rest to a separate letter to parliament.
For the considerations on which and the terms under which this gesture is made, I refer you to the cover letter accompanying the annotated agenda.
Voor de overwegingen op grond waarvan en de modaliteiten waaronder deze geste wordt gedaan, verwijs ik u naar de aanbiedingsbrief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Maeijer en Wilders over de mededeling dat Nederland een deel van de migranten van het schip 'Lifeline' gaat opvangen

PVV MPs asked whether agreements to take in Lifeline migrants were already made at the 24 June 2018 meeting, and why the minister did not disclose this during the debate. The government answered that no agreement was made; Malta conditioned its acceptance on other states taking responsibility, and the Netherlands later agreed as a gesture to take up to 20 asylum seekers.
No, that is not the case.
Nee, dat is niet het geval.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Maeijer over het bericht van het kabinet dat het voornemens is om 77 Marechaussees ter beschikking te stellen aan de EU missie (EULEX genaamd) in Kosovo

MPs Van Dijk and Maeijer (PVV) asked the Defence Minister why 77 Dutch military police should be made available on call for a crowd and riot control platoon in the EU EULEX mission in Kosovo, and whether this plan would be scrapped. The minister answered that stability in Kosovo serves European and Dutch interests, that a study on the availability of the unit is ongoing, and that deployment would only follow if local capacity proved insufficient, with the Dutch Parliament to be informed of the findings.
In the letter on Dutch contributions to rapid reaction forces, the House will be informed of the findings of the study.
In de brief over de Nederlandse bijdragen aan snelle reactiemachten zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd over de bevindingen van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over 1,3 miljard euro belastinggeld voor de promotie van Europese waarden

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether he was aware of reports that the EU plans a 1.3 billion euro fund to promote European values, and whether he would oppose it and block Dutch funding. The minister replied that the Netherlands has an interest in a strong EU whose members uphold shared values, and that the new budget proposal is still under study, with the cabinet's appreciation to follow.
When values are under pressure in member states – for example the independence of the judiciary – this can affect the functioning of the Union
Wanneer in lidstaten die waarden onder druk staan – denk bijvoorbeeld aan de onafhankelijkheid van de rechtspraak – kan dit gevolgen hebben voor het functioneren van de Unie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Maeijer over virulent antisemitisme via Palestijns persbureau

Two Dutch MPs asked the foreign and development ministers about an antisemitic opinion piece by a former Hamas figure published on the Palestinian news agency Ma'an's website, and whether Dutch or EU funding to Ma'an should end. The ministers answered that the piece was removed and Ma'an publicly distanced itself from it, so the government does not intend to seek an end to EU cooperation.
In this case, the cabinet is of the view that Ma'an News Agency acted adequately by removing the opinion piece from its website and publicly distancing itself from its content.
In dit geval is het kabinet van oordeel dat Ma'an News Agency adequaat heeft opgetreden door het bewuste opiniestuk te verwijderen van diens website en openlijk afstand te nemen van de inhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over de euro’s die het raam uitvliegen voor het betalen van het luxeleven van Europarlementariërs

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister about European Parliament members' salaries and allowances, including a €4,342 office-cost allowance without accountability, and whether the Netherlands should push to cut these and even dissolve the Parliament. The minister answered that the European Parliament is responsible for its own transparency, that the Netherlands seeks administrative cost savings in the next EU budget, but rejected abolishing the Parliament for its role in democratic legitimacy.
The European Parliament is itself responsible for transparency and accountability regarding its expenditure.
Het Europees parlement is zelf verantwoordelijke voor transparantie en verantwoording over zijn uitgaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over een miljard euro belastinggeld voor Oekraïne

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister why the EU should give another 1 billion euro of taxpayers' money to Ukraine, whether the minister would oppose it at the Council, and how much evidence is needed before the Netherlands leaves the EU. The minister answered that the proposed macro-financial assistance is a loan paid in tranches under conditions in a Memorandum of Understanding, that the Netherlands will press for strict anti-corruption conditions, will not announce opposition in advance, and remains committed to EU membership.
The Netherlands is pressing Ukraine in bilateral talks and in multilateral forums for anti-corruption reforms and will insist on strict conditions on anti-corruption reforms in the MoU.

Nederland dringt in bilaterale gesprekken met Oekraïne en in multilaterale fora aan op anti-corruptiehervormingen en zal aandringen op strenge voorwaarden op het gebied van anti-corruptiehervormingen in het MoU.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer, De Roon en Fritsma over de schamele korting op de financiële steun van de Europese Unie (EU) aan Turkije en het vooruitzicht op visumvrij reizen van miljoenen Turken

PVV MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether a reported 100 million euro cut in EU pre-accession aid to Turkey is real, whether Dutch money should still flow to Turkey, for a detailed overview of EU funds, and whether visa-free travel for Turks can be prevented. The minister confirmed about 50% cuts to annual and about 30% to multi-year pre-accession programmes in 2017, said the Netherlands favours suspension but lacks majority support, referred to existing documentation for fund details, and stated Turkey does not yet meet all visa liberalisation benchmarks so no Dutch position is needed yet.
The Netherlands is awaiting the Commission's proposals for limiting and reallocating the funds.
Nederland wacht de voorstellen van de Commissie voor inperking en herschikking van de middelen af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en De Jong over het bericht 'Europees pensioenfonds op rand van de afgrond'

PVV MPs asked the government about a reported EUR 326 million deficit in the European Parliament's voluntary supplementary pension fund, its total EU pension liabilities, and whether the Dutch taxpayer will bear the cost. The minister answered that the fund concerns voluntary pensions accrued before 2009, that the EP itself is responsible for its sustainability, and that the cabinet expects the EP leadership to address it.
It is up to the EP to find a solution to this problem.
Het is aan het EP een oplossing voor deze problematiek te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Wilders over de uitspraken van de voorzitter van het Europees Parlement aangaande het budget van de Europese Unie

PVV MPs Maeijer and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister about the European Parliament president's call to double the EU budget and introduce an EU tax, and whether Dutch membership should be reconsidered. The minister rejected doubling the budget, stated the Dutch position favours a smaller, modernised budget, said direct taxation remains a member-state competence and the Netherlands opposes an EU tax, and rejected leaving the EU.
The cabinet does not agree with the need to double the EU's annual budget.
Het kabinet is het niet eens met de noodzaak van verdubbeling van het jaarlijkse budget van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders, Fritsma en Maeijer over toegang van terroristen tot het Europees Parlement

PVV MPs asked whether the government knew that Leila Khaled had been received in the European Parliament, whether it finds this absurd, how a convicted hijacker obtained a Schengen visa, and what will prevent recurrence. The minister confirmed awareness, declined to judge the Parliament's invitation decision, explained the SIS refusal mechanism in general terms without discussing the individual case, and stated no action on the invitation policy.
I see no reason to intervene in the assessment made by the European Parliament when inviting Ms Khaled.
Ik zie geen aanleiding te treden in de afweging die door het Europees parlement is gemaakt bij de uitnodiging aan mevrouw Khaled.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over de vermindering van het aantal zetels in het Europees Parlement na Brexit

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister whether the government would push, in the European Council, for cutting 73 European Parliament seats after Brexit, and questioned a proposal on seat allocation. The government replied that it has consistently argued for reducing the EP by 73 seats, that few member states share this, and that it will await the definitive Commission/EP seat proposal before taking a position.
The cabinet is awaiting the definitive proposal on the seat allocation of the European Parliament and will determine its position on that in due course.
Het kabinet wacht het definitieve voorstel voor de zetelverdeling van het Europees Parlement af en zal zijn standpunt daarop te zijner tijd bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma en Maeijer over door NGO's gefaciliteerde asielinvasie naar Europese Unie

Two PVV MPs asked whether NGO sea rescue operations facilitate people smuggling and whether Dutch public money funds such NGOs, and urged closing the borders. The government answered that no Dutch subsidies go to Mediterranean rescue operations, that Italian criminal investigations must be awaited, and that closing borders is not a realistic solution.

As also exchanged in previous answers and during various General Consultations, the Dutch government does not provide subsidies or other forms of financing to organisations for rescue operations in the Mediterranean Sea.

Zoals ook in eerdere beantwoording en tijdens verschillende Algemene Overleggen is gewisseld, verstrekt de Nederlandse overheid geen subsidies of andere vormen van financiering aan organisaties voor reddingsoperaties op de Middellandse Zee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Tony van Dijck over exorbitant reisgedrag van Eurocommissarissen

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Finance about the travel costs of EU Commissioners, including €492,249 spent in January–February 2016 and a €75,000 trip by High Representative Mogherini to Baku. The minister replied that the trips served Dutch interests, that EU travel is paid from the EU budget under oversight by the European Court of Auditors, the Council and the European Parliament, and that the Commission now publishes these costs; he declined to commit to any action.
Public control over these expenditures is the responsibility of the European Court of Auditors and the Council.
De publieke controle op deze uitgaven is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Europese Rekenkamer en de Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Maeijer en Wilders over het bericht dat Italië weer wordt overspoeld met migranten

Opposition MPs from the PVV asked the government about reports of large migrant arrivals in Italy via Libya, the role of NGOs and Dutch-flagged ships, IOM funding, and calls to close borders. The government answered that arrivals were only slightly up on last year, described EU and Italian measures, said NGO funding and flag-state links require further investigation, and rejected a national border closure as discriminatory and unrealistic.
As far as the cabinet is aware, only in the case of the Iuventa is it currently established that this is an NGO ship sailing under the Dutch flag between Libya and Italy.
Voor zover het kabinet bekend, staat op dit moment alleen ten aanzien van de «Iuventa» vast
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht dat de EU een peperduur kantoor in Parijs wil huren

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would press the European Parliament and Commission to stop a costly new lease for the House of Europe in Paris, arguing the money should go to citizens instead. The minister replied that the choice of location rests with the Commission and Parliament, that the budget fits the EU framework, and that the Netherlands favours efficient spending in the upcoming MFF negotiations.
The rental costs of this building fit within the budget frameworks of the European Parliament and European Commission budgets, as part of the EU budget.
De huurkosten van dit gebouw passen binnen de begrotingskaders van de begroting van het Europees parlement en de Europese Commissie, als onderdeel van de begroting van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Wilders over Brussel die de deur open zet voor EU- lidmaatschap van Oekraïne

MPs Maeijer and Wilders asked whether EU Council President Tusk's quote on Ukraine's European choice undermines the Dutch no vote and the referendum, and whether the government will ever accept Ukraine's EU accession. The minister replied that the Council decision of 15 December 2016 legally binds an interpretation of the Association Agreement excluding candidate status, that this addresses referendum concerns, and that no accession application has been filed.

The decision of the heads of state and government does not amend the Association Agreement nor constitute a reservation, but legally binds how the EU member states implement the Association Agreement on a number of specific points.

Het besluit van staatshoofden en regeringsleiders wijzigt de Associatieovereenkomst niet en vormt evenmin een voorbehoud, maar legt juridisch bindend vast hoe de lidstaten van de Europese Unie op een aantal specifieke punten uitvoering geven aan de Associatieovereenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Maeijer over de 22 miljard euro die door de EU uitgetrokken is voor de migratiecrisis

MPs Fritsma and Maeijer asked about the EU's 22 billion euro for the migration crisis, including whether the Turkey deal is included, which recipients receive funds and for what purpose, results achieved, and rescue and return numbers. The minister answered in detail on budget categories, funding instruments, Frontex and EASO, rescue figures, and IOM voluntary return numbers, while noting that the Commission does not break down the 22 billion figure and that return figures for the Netherlands will follow later.
However, the Commission does not give in detail how it arrived at these amounts in the factsheet.
De Commissie geeft in het factsheet echter niet in detail aan hoe men tot deze bedragen is gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Popken en Maeijer over het bericht dat Europese legers structureel gaan samenwerken

MPs Popken and Maeijer (PVV) asked the Defence Minister about reports that European armies will cooperate structurally, including Poland's concerns about duplication with NATO, EU defence fund spending, and EU Battlegroup costs and deployments. The minister answered that Netherlands supports stronger EU defence within a complementary NATO framework, outlined its EU Battlegroup contributions for 2018, and rejected any transfer of sovereignty.
Your House will receive a BNC fiche on the European Defence Fund setting out the Dutch position.
Uw Kamer ontvangt een BNC-fiche over het Europees Defensiefonds met daarin het Nederlandse standpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Wilders over het bericht dat de EU een nieuw peperduur parlementsgebouw wil

PVV MPs Maeijer and Wilders asked the Foreign Minister whether he knows of the EU Parliament's plan to demolish and rebuild its Brussels building for 430 million euros, and whether the government will block the use of Dutch taxpayers' money and reject the EU itself. The minister confirmed awareness, said the government will not anticipate the three options under study and favours restraint on EU administrative costs, and stated that the government opposes dissolving the EU because of Dutch economic and security interests.
The cabinet does not want to anticipate this.
Het kabinet wil hier niet op vooruit lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck, Maeijer en Wilders over het bericht dat Griekenland geld krijgt uit het noodfonds

MPs Van Dijck, Maeijer and Wilders asked the Finance Minister about reports that Greece would receive 8.5 billion euro from the bailout fund, what the Dutch share is, and why Dutch taxpayers should keep funding Greece. The minister confirmed the ESM proposal is subject to a Raad van Bewind decision, explained how ESM loans are funded and the Dutch capital contribution, and referred to earlier letters for the government's position.
You were recently informed of the cabinet's position in the Eurogroup report of 15 June and a letter to the House on the progress report of the second progress mission of the ESM programme.

U bent recent over het standpunt van het kabinet geïnformeerd in het verslag van de Eurogroep van 15 juni en een Kamerbrief over de voortgangsrapportage van de tweede voortgangsmissie van het ESM-programma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en De Roon over financiële steun van de EU aan Turkije

MPs Maeijer and De Roon asked the Foreign Minister whether EU financial aid to Turkey has been assessed for effectiveness, whether monitoring existed, and whether Turkey's accession talks should be terminated and pre-accession aid stopped and recovered. The minister said the European Court of Auditors is free to choose its audits, that IPA projects are monitored, and that accession talks are effectively stalled, with the Commission to report in 2018 on constitutional changes, while Netherlands keeps pressing to suspend pre-accession aid but lacks Council support.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Wilders over beschuldigingen van antisemitisme van vice-voorzitter van de Europese Commisie Frans Timmermans aan het adres van Hongarije

PVV MPs Maeijer and Wilders asked whether the government would condemn EU Commissioner Timmermans' remarks about antisemitism in Hungary and demand his resignation. The Foreign Minister replied that the Commission and Hungary should explain the statements, that the cabinet supports Timmermans' defence of EU values, and that attention should focus on Hungarian higher-education and NGO legislation.
The cabinet supports the efforts of First Vice-President Timmermans to defend fundamental EU values and sees no reason for the measures you propose.
Het kabinet steunt de inspanningen van eerste vicevoorzitter Timmermans om fundamentele waarden binnen de EU te verdedigen en ziet geen aanleiding voor de maatregelen die u voorstelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer, Beertema en Wilders over een plan van de Franse president en de Duitse bondskanselier inzake de toekomst van de Europese Unie

PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister whether the government is committed to a Franco-German roadmap for deeper EU integration (banking, defence, migration) and whether this conflicts with the 2005 Dutch referendum result, and whether the Netherlands should reject an EU superstate or pursue Nexit. The government replied that there is no Franco-German roadmap, that the Commission only issued reflection papers, that further integration in the single market and migration is needed, and that there is no EU superstate.
There is currently no Franco-German roadmap for deeper EU integration.
Er is thans geen sprake van een Frans-Duitse routekaart voor diepere EU-integratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over Nederlands belastinggeld voor pro-Oekraïne propaganda

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch taxpayer money funded the Ukraine Crisis Media Centre and whether EU money or Ukrainian oligarch-funded broadcasts were involved before the referendum-related vote on the association agreement. The minister confirmed two MATRA-fund projects worth about EUR 198,000 in total, denied EU funding, and rejected the claim that the government was involved in the broadcast.
The Dutch Embassy in Kiev financed two projects of the Ukraine Crisis Media Center from the MATRA fund.
De Nederlandse Ambassade in Kiev heeft een tweetal projecten van het Ukraine Crisis Media Center gefinancierd uit het MATRA-fonds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over het bericht dat de Europese Unie geld heeft gestoken in een Tsjechisch bordeel

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister whether EU structural funds paying for a Czech brothel shows the failure of the EU, how much similar opaque spending occurs, and whether the Netherlands should cut its contribution to zero. The minister answered that EU and national controls detected the misspending, the Czech authorities recovered the funds, and the cabinet stands by the Rome Declaration and its treaty obligations.
In this case, this control system revealed that there was undesirable spending.
In dit geval is door dit controlesysteem aan het licht gekomen dat er sprake is van ongewenste besteding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer, Fritsma en Wilders over EU watertaxi’s die 8500 migranten redden

PVV MPs asked about reports that 8,500 migrants were rescued off Libya over Easter weekend, including how many were picked up by Frontex, Italy, NGOs and merchant ships, where they were landed, whether they are held in closed centres, whether terrorists could be among them, whether EU policy creates a pull effect, and whether the Netherlands will close its borders. The government confirmed the figures, said it lacks detailed data on each rescue, described hotspot screening and Europol checks, rejected border closure as neither a complete solution nor clearly feasible, and pointed to a broader EU approach with Libya.
The cabinet does not have detailed information on all rescue operations carried out by various vessels over the Easter weekend.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over gedetailleerde informatie over alle reddingsoperaties die in het paasweekend door verschillende schepen zijn uitgevoerd.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulp aan mensen die niet volledig zelfredzaam zijn bij calamiteiten zoals stroomuitval

An MP asks how people who are not fully self-reliant, such as those dependent on electricity for life-sustaining medical equipment, can prepare for prolonged power outages, and what is done to identify and support them. The Secretary of State answers that a plan of action is being prepared, that the group is not yet a mandatory part of emergency plans, that addresses are not centrally registered for privacy and practical reasons, and rejects subsidising home backup generators, favouring emergency shelter at external locations.
For these people I want to draw up a plan of action for the scenario of prolonged power outage, as we recently saw in Spain.
Voor deze mensen wil ik een plan van aanpak opstellen voor het scenario van langdurige stroomuitval, zoals we recent in Spanje hebben gezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over het bericht 'Winstnorm kan niet voorkomen dat zorggeld naar Porsches en paarden gaat'

MPs Dijk and Dobbe asked the minister whether profit-making in healthcare should be legally limited, whether a total ban on profit distribution is the answer, and whether oversight and transparency of care providers should be improved. The minister rejects a blanket profit ban, points to the pending Wibz bill, a planned exploration of licensing for subcontractors and solo providers, a Wmo oversight improvement trajectory and expanded annual reporting, while promising further assessment rather than immediate new rules.
I therefore want to carry out an exploration of a licensing requirement for subcontractors and solo practitioners.
Ik wil daarom een verkenning uitvoeren naar een vergunningplicht voor onderaannemers en solisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over wachttijden binnen de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015 (Wmo) en de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz)

An MP asked the state secretaries about long waiting times in Wmo and mental health care (ggz) and how these relate to the Integraal Zorgakkoord and GALA targets. The government acknowledged long ggz waiting times, listed measures under the IZA and noted that effects are not yet visible, and said there is no national picture for Wmo waiting times.
For the Wmo there is no national picture of waiting times.
Voor de Wmo bestaat er geen landelijk beeld van wachttijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rikkers-Oosterkamp over de noodkreet van de fysiotherapie over het nieuwe VECOZO-systeem

An MP asked the minister about physiotherapists' complaints that the new VECOZO declaration system rejects whole batches over single errors, and about testing, evaluation, delays and patient access. The minister acknowledged the problems, said they were largely resolved, said the ministry is not involved in the Vektis-published standard, and saw no need for intervention.
The ministry is not involved in this.
Het ministerie is hier niet bij betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thiadens over de ernstige misstanden bij woonlocatie De Akker

An MP asked the Minister of Health about abuse of vulnerable residents at care location De Akker, filmed and shared online by staff, and whether controls and enforcement had failed. The minister condemned the abuse, said the IGJ is awaiting the provider's investigation, and noted the staff were dismissed and criminal complaint filed, but could not guarantee residents' safety and gave only general commitments.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) has taken up the report.
De Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) heeft de melding in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over de crisis in de ouderenzorg

Two MPs from the SP asked the State Secretary for Health about the crisis in elderly care, including staff problems, rising compulsory admissions, a lack of small-scale alternatives, staff shortages and the pay gap. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing programmes and a forthcoming Hoofdlijnenakkoord Ouderenzorg, and rejected extra pay funding beyond the annual wage-cost contribution due to fiscal constraints.
I am currently in talks with parties in the sector to reach a Hoofdlijnenakkoord Ouderenzorg (HLO).
Ik ben op dit moment met partijen in de sector in gesprek om tot een Hoofdlijnenakkoord Ouderenzorg (HLO) te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat hulp in het huishouden voor nieuwe Wmo-klanten in Den Bosch wordt teruggeschroefd naar eens per twee weken

Dobbe (SP) asked whether it is permissible for Den Bosch to cut home help for all new Wmo clients to once every two weeks without clear individual reasons, and how this fits the right to tailored support. The state secretary said the municipality is responsible for Wmo policy within legal bounds, that the municipality rations scarce hours to keep help available for those most in need, and that the state has no overview of similar measures elsewhere.
It is up to municipalities to shape Wmo policy and ensure appropriate support within the legal framework.
Het is aan gemeenten het Wmo-beleid vorm te geven en te zorgen voor passende ondersteuning binnen de kaders van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het vergoeden van een passende rolstoel

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health why a Wlz resident with a disability cannot obtain a well-fitting wheelchair, citing VN Disability Convention Article 20 and a crowdfunding campaign. The State Secretary acknowledges the right to suitable aids, says misunderstandings led to no application being filed, promises follow-up talks and a review of the procedure with care offices, and points to complaint routes such as the IGJ, the ombudsman and the courts.
Following these parliamentary questions, my ministry contacted this client and the relevant care office.
Naar aanleiding van deze Kamervragen is vanuit mijn ministerie contact opgenomen met deze cliënt en het betreffende zorgkantoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de toekomst van hospicezorg

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the state secretary for health about the imminent closure of the Rotterdam hospice De Vier Vogels, shortfalls in hospice capacity, non-cost-covering day tariffs for small hospices, and funding after 2026. The state secretary regretted the closure, pointed to multiple causes and ongoing talks with insurers, said capacity in Rotterdam is adequate for now, and deferred decisions on additional funding and on the subsidy scheme to the spring budget decision and a 2026 evaluation.
After the summer of 2025 an integral evaluation of the subsidy scheme will start, which will also include the funding system for the deployment of volunteers.
Na de zomer van 2025 start een integrale evaluatie van de subsidieregeling, waarin ook de bekostigingssystematiek voor de inzet van vrijwilligers wordt meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Crijns over de misstanden bij een Limburgse jeugdzorginstelling

An MP (PVV) asked the State Secretary for Health about reported abuses at a Limburg youth care institution, including drug use, coercion, violence, understaffing and the role of the inspectorate IGJ. The State Secretary declined to answer several questions citing ongoing investigations, said the youth was not placed there due to closure of closed youth care, and described past IGJ inspections and a new risk-based inspection.
The IGJ cannot, however, make any statements about this case at this time.
De IGJ kan echter nu geen mededelingen doen over deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thiadens over het bericht 'Tegen wil en dank fit: Hengelose ouderen moeten sporten voor thuishulp, maar Adje (88) protesteert'

An MP (PVV) asks the state secretary whether Wmo support for elderly people should be unconditional and not tied to joining the 'powerfull ageing' exercise programme, which municipalities reportedly make a quasi-obligation with long waits for home help. The state secretary agrees in principle that Wmo support must not depend on participation, calls the programme's use in some municipalities critical, and commits to talks with the VNG soon.
If it is the case that municipalities impose a disguised obligation on vulnerable elderly people that leads them not to use Wmo support, then I share the view that this is unacceptable.

Als het zo is dat gemeenten een verkapte verplichting opleggen aan kwetsbare ouderen die ertoe leidt dat ouderen geen gebruik maken van ondersteuning op grond van de Wmo, dan deel ik de mening dat dit onacceptabel is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Lahlah over de financiële achteruitgang van mensen met een beperking door kabinetsbeleid

MPs Westerveld and Lahlah asked the state secretaries about financial losses for people with disabilities, including higher Wlz own contributions and lower take-home pay for sheltered-work staff from tax changes and an expired CAO. The government says the Wlz increase follows from the minimum wage rise, that the tax changes cause losses of up to about 15 euro per month, and that it is talking with the VNG about financing sheltered work, but that it is not a party to the CAO negotiations.
The cabinet is not a party to the CAO negotiations for the group working at social development companies and therefore takes a cautious stance on the CAO Aan de slag.
Het kabinet is geen partij in de cao-onderhandelingen voor de doelgroep die werkt bij sociaal ontwikkelbedrijven en stelt zich daarom terughoudend op ten aanzien van de cao Aan de slag.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over het alarmerende boek 'Mijn Hoofd Doet Gek, over de relatie tussen ‘koppen’ en hersenschade in het Nederlandse voetbal' en n.a.v. het Eenvandaag-item over de schadelijke effect

An MP asked the State Secretary about research linking heading in football to brain damage and dementia, and whether youth heading should be restricted as in Flanders, Scotland, England and Northern Ireland. The State Secretary answered that the Health Council advice is due mid-2025 and the Sports Council will issue action perspectives, deferring any concrete measures until then.
I think it is too early now to discuss appropriate measures.
Ik vind het nu te vroeg om passende maatregelen te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Dijk en Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht ‘Zorgverzekeraars vinden thuis sterven vaak te duur’

MPs from four parties asked the state secretary for health about reports that insurers refuse to pay for home-based terminal palliative care because of budget caps, and about causes, insurer practices, and remedies. The state secretary disputes the specific case, says insurers report no such refusals, and points to agreements in the Aanvullend Zorg- en Welzijnsakkoord and the palliative care programme as the way forward.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de beperkte toegang tot palliatieve zorg door de opstelling van de zorgverzekeraars

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about insurers' efficiency rules and turnover caps limiting access to palliative care at home, citing a nurse's complaint and a Trouw report on a patient who died in hospital. The State Secretary answered that insurer-provider agreements do not block dying at home, that the VGZ case appears to be a miscommunication, and that the Aanvullend Zorg- en Welzijnsakkoord will address communication on turnover caps.
No, that is not correct. As I explained in my letter of 14 March 2025, the agreements between health insurers and care providers do not impede the possibilities to die at home.

Nee, dat klopt niet. Zoals ik heb toegelicht in mijn brief van d.d. 14 maart 2025 vormen de afspraken tussen zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders geen belemmering voor de mogelijkheden om thuis te sterven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rikkers-Oosterkamp over het bericht 'Patiënten moeten uren wachten tot taxi komt: 'Ziekenhuisafspraak gemist''

An MP asked the state secretary about patient transport delays and failures by ZCN in Brabant, the impact on care, low taxi tariffs, and oversight of ZCN. The minister answered that health insurers bear the duty of care and the NZa supervises it, that CZ reports the start-up problems are largely resolved, and that the government has no information on the contracts between insurers, providers and ZCN.

I have no information about the content of the contracts that health insurers conclude with care providers; they jointly make agreements in their contracts about the care to be delivered and under which conditions.

Ik heb geen informatie over de inhoud van de contracten die zorgverzekeraars met zorgaanbieders afsluiten; zij maken gezamenlijk in hun contracten afspraken over de zorg die geleverd gaat worden tegen welke voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Westerveld over de toegankelijkheid van het OV

MPs De Hoop and Westerveld asked the state secretaries about accessibility of public transport for people with disabilities, including lift and escalator outages, information provision and train design. The state secretary answered that full accessibility by 2030 is not feasible, that the 2040 target stands, and described ongoing measures with ProRail and operators, while committing to periodic reporting on lift functioning.
Achieving fully accessible public transport by 2030 is not feasible, but the sector has long been working to bring that goal closer.
Het verwezenlijken van volledig toegankelijk openbaar vervoer in 2030 is niet haalbaar, maar de sector spant zich al geruime tijd in om die doelstelling steeds dichter bij te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat voor patiënten met gedragsproblemen en verstandelijke handicap geen geld is in de opvang

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that care for people with behavioural problems and intellectual disability lacks funding, including calls for a tariff rise of at least 15 percent for VG7 care, the risks of clients being left without care, and whether planned long-term care cuts and the Wet zorg en dwang are compatible with current tariffs. The state secretary replied that a 6.2 percent VG7 tariff increase was implemented for 2025 based on NZa cost research, that current evidence does not justify 15 percent, that coercive care must not be driven by financial motives, and that the cuts remain justified while the ministry works with providers and care offices on placement problems.
The NZa cost research currently gives no reason for a 15% increase.
Het kostenonderzoek van de NZa geeft op dit moment geen aanleiding voor een verhoging van 15%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘Voor patiënten met gedragsproblemen en verstandelijke handicap is geen geld in de opvang’

MP Bikker (ChristenUnie) asks the State Secretary for Health about reports that care providers for people with intellectual disabilities and intensive care needs (VG7) are refusing clients and lack adequate funding, and about tariffs, waiting lists and alternative funding. The State Secretary acknowledges the problem, points to a 6.2% VG7 tariff increase for 2025 based on NZa cost research, says no 15% increase is warranted now, and promises joint work with sector parties, a possible split of the VG7 tariff, and progress reports.
I find it painful that when you have a very intensive care need (or someone in your family does), appropriate care and support are not available.
Ik vind het pijnlijk dat wanneer je een zeer intensieve zorgvraag hebt (of iemand uit je familie deze heeft), passende zorg en ondersteuning niet beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bevers over het bericht ‘Voor patiënten met gedragsproblemen en verstandelijke handicap is geen geld in de opvang’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that care providers refuse new clients with the highest-intensity care profile (VG7) because tariffs are not fully cost-covering, and about waiting lists. The state secretary acknowledged the signal, pointed to NZa cost research and a 2025 tariff increase, said 302 people with VG7 profiles abstain from care for unknown reasons, and referred to a letter for measures.
The data currently cannot show why these people abstain from care and therefore receive no care.
Uit de data is op dit moment niet te halen wat de reden is dat deze mensen afzien van zorg en dus geen zorg ontvangen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Becker over het bericht ‘Groot gebrek aan noodbedden voor vrouwen die vluchten voor gewelddadige partner: noodgedwongen opgevangen in hotels en vakantieparken’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the state secretaries about a reported shortage of emergency beds for women fleeing violent partners and how many beds are needed under the Istanbul Convention. The minister acknowledged the shortage but said no complete picture exists, pointed to a monitor due in spring 2025, and placed primary responsibility with municipalities, declining to re-index the grant specifically for the 35 centre municipalities.
There is currently no complete picture of the distribution of available emergency beds or of the shortage.
Er is op dit moment geen compleet beeld van verdeling van het aantal beschikbare noodbedden en over het tekort hieraan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over hulpmiddelen en voorzieningen voor mensen met een beperking

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about persistent delays in delivering and repairing assistive devices for people with disabilities, the adequacy of monitoring, compliance with the UN Disability Convention, legal deadlines, complaint routes and supervision. The government answered that delays are mainly structural (parts shortages, labour shortages), that no monitor will be set up but developments may be considered in the UN Convention follow-up, that it will not legislate deadlines, and that it will talk with industry and the VNG about compliance with the agreements, reporting before summer 2025.
I am not prepared to include agreements on statutory deadlines in the framework laws (Wmo, Zvw and Wlz).
Ik ben niet bereid om in de stelselwetten (Wmo, Zvw en Wlz) afspraken op te nemen over wettelijke termijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Amber (27) is hersteld maar ‘woont’ al maanden noodgedwongen in het ziekenhuis: ‘Erger dan dit kan het niet worden’'
