An SP MP asked the state secretary for health about a 27-year-old patient, recovered but kept in hospital for months because no suitable housing with care could be found, and about who is responsible, cost coverage and possible links to care cuts. The state secretary said the patient has since been discharged to her own home, gave no figures on how often this occurs, explained that municipalities are responsible for housing under the Wmo and that housing shortages are a bottleneck, and pointed to the pending housing-regulation bill as the remedy.
No exact figures are known about this.
Hier zijn geen exacte cijfers over bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'VN tikt Nederland op de vingers: de postcode van je woonplaats bepaalt hoe goed de zorg is'

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health about UN criticism that municipal postcode determines quality of care for people with disabilities, and about variation between municipalities in Wmo support, financing, and procedures, proposing a basic municipal package. The State Secretary defended local discretion and individual tailoring, declined a separate study of variation and a national basic package for now, and pointed to a broader sustainability study, standardisation of contracts and information exchange, and financing handled by the Finance and Interior ministries.
I am currently not willing to proceed to a municipal basic package.
Ik ben op dit moment niet bereid om over te gaan tot een gemeentelijk basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over ADL-hulp

The MP asks the State Secretary about reports of poor ADL assistance at Fokus, including understaffing, many rotating assistants, male staff for women with prior abuse, unsafe complaint routes, and tariffs. The State Secretary acknowledges concerns, points to IGJ supervision and planned tariff increases and guidelines, but makes no specific measurable commitments on staffing or team continuity.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thiadens over het bericht ‘Dramatisch meer valdoden onder ouderen: ‘Bont en blauw, pezen afgescheurd, maar ik kwam er nog goed vanaf’

An MP asked the state secretary about rising fall deaths among older people, including whether anticoagulant and midazolam use is recorded and whether medication evaluations and municipal fall-prevention programmes are adequate. The state secretary answered that medication use is only recorded when directly linked to the injury, that a 2024 study is being followed up with a progress letter promised before end-2024, and that municipalities have SPUK funds and support for fall prevention.
No. As explained in the answer to question 2, medication use is not routinely recorded in the emergency department registration unless there is a direct link to the injury diagnosis.
Nee. Zoals toegelicht bij het antwoord op vraag 2, wordt het medicatiegebruik niet standaard vermeld in de SEH-registratie, tenzij er een direct verband is met de letseldiagnose.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en De Hoop over bouwsubsidie voor ouderen, maar niet voor ouderen met een beperking

The State Secretary explained the 30% VV4-VV10 condition as part of the shift away from institutional care, said people with disabilities can still live in such homes, and rejected extending the scheme to the disability sector, citing its different institutional capacity situation.
I therefore see no reason to extend the scheme to the disability sector.
Ik zie daarmee geen reden om de regeling uit te breiden tot de gehandicaptensector.

Westerveld (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Health about press reports that former residents of care farm Aurora Borealis were again placed with a poorly vetted provider, Zorgpro, and why oversight and screening failed. The State Secretary acknowledged the failures, described the inspection, contracting and leersessies steps taken and promised tighter provider screening, pgb rules and closer monitoring of the former residents.
I have therefore asked the care offices to tighten their screening of care providers.
Ik heb zorgkantoren daarom verzocht hun screening van zorgaanbieders aan te scherpen.

The State Secretary acknowledged staff shortages, said the municipality and providers are doing their utmost, found no failure of the care duty, and pointed to planned labour-market and access measures without committing to a concrete new step.
I have received no signals that the municipality of Eindhoven is insufficiently fulfilling its care duty.
Ik heb geen signalen ontvangen dat gemeente Eindhoven haar zorgplicht onvoldoende naleeft.

The state secretary agrees the shortage is real, points to the raised tariff, a pilot allowing pgb teams to accompany clients in care locations, and a forthcoming regulatory change, but says pgb coverage of location costs cannot be realised before 1 July 2025.

Vanaf het jaar 2022 geldt een aanzienlijk hoger tarief voor logeeropvang van Wlz-cliënten met een ZEVMB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de kwaliteit van de langdurige zorg voor ouderen thuis volgens de IGJ nog vaak onder de maat is

Voor mij is het belangrijk dat de kwaliteit van Wlz-zorg thuis wordt vergroot op die plekken waar dit nog niet op orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de vergoeding van spraakcomputers voor mensen die zonder hulp niet of moeilijk kunnen communiceren

Westerveld asks the minister how many people were refused or granted speech computers, why the Kamer motion on full reimbursement including hardware is not being implemented, and whether this breaches the UN disability convention. Health insurers then assess on an individual basis whether an aid is reimbursed.
Zorgverzekeraars beoordelen vervolgens per individuele situatie of een hulpmiddel wordt vergoed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de toiletpas

Motie van het lid Heinen c.s. over in lijn met het advies van het Adviescollege toetsing regeldruk ondersteuning bieden aan het mkb
Motion asking the cabinet to support SMEs in jointly preparing subsidy applications for the National Growth Fund, in line with a regulatory-burden advisory body's advice.
requests the cabinet, in line with the advice of the regulatory burden advisory body, to provide support to SMEs
verzoekt het kabinet om in lijn met het advies van het adviescollege regeldruk ondersteuning te bieden aan midden- en kleinbedrijven
Motie van het lid Romke de Jong over het transparant maken van beslissingen en terugkoppelen over keuzes aan de indieners
Asks the government to make Nationaal Groeifonds decisions transparent and to explain its choices to applicants, especially when proposals are dropped early.
requests the government to make decisions transparent and to feed back the choices made to the applicants
verzoekt de regering om beslissingen transparant te maken en gemaakte keuzes terug te koppelen aan de indieners
Motie van het lid Romke de Jong over onderzoek naar knelpunten in de financiering van mkb-bedrijven
Asks the government to investigate financing bottlenecks for SMEs caused by shortening the statutory payment term to 30 days and available instruments to remedy them.
requests the government to investigate where the bottlenecks in SME financing lie
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken waar de knelpunten in de financiering van mkb-bedrijven zitten
Motie van het lid Romke de Jong c.s. over voorstellen voor het hervatten van de belastingheffing op vermogen
Asks the government to present proposals by 1 April on how the taxation of wealth (box 3) can be resumed after the Supreme Court ruling.
requests the government to come up with proposals by 1 April on how taxation of wealth can be resumed
verzoekt de regering om voor 1 april met voorstellen te komen voor hoe de belastingheffing op vermogen weer kan worden hervat
Motie van het lid Romke de Jong c.s. over onderzoeken of mkb'ers voldoende in staat worden gesteld om hun CO2-footprint in kaart te brengen
Asks the government to study whether SMEs are sufficiently enabled to map their CO2 footprint and to inform the House by mid-2022.
requests the government to investigate whether SMEs are sufficiently enabled to map their CO2 footprint
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken of mkb'ers voldoende in staat worden gesteld om hun CO 2 -footprint in kaart te brengen
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over een analyse van de effectiviteit van initiatieven om personeelstekorten in de technieksector op te lossen
Asks the government to analyse the effectiveness of initiatives addressing technical staff shortages and to report to the House, as a basis for an action plan.
to make an analysis of the effectiveness of these initiatives and to examine where additions are needed
een analyse te maken van de effectiviteit van deze initiatieven en te onderzoeken waar aanvullingen nodig zijn
Motie van het lid Van Strien c.s. over een gesprek met de campussen over de strategie-ecosystemen
Asks the government to engage actively with innovation campuses on how to speed up the strategy for innovation ecosystems and to inform the House of the outcome.
requests the government to actively enter into dialogue with the campuses to see how the handles from the strategy ecosystems can be realised faster
verzoekt de regering actief in gesprek te gaan met de campussen om te bezien hoe de handvatten uit de strategie-ecosystemen versneld kunnen worden gerealiseerd
Motie van het lid Van Strien c.s. over de financieringsinstrumenten bij de komende evaluaties in samenhang bezien
Asks the government to assess the financing instruments under upcoming evaluations in an integrated way and report to the House in early 2022.
and to inform the House about this in the first half of 2022
en daarover de Kamer in de eerste helft van 2022 te informeren
Motie van het lid Romke de Jong c.s. over onderzoek om het mkb te ondersteunen in hun zoektocht naar de beste verduurzamingsmaatregelen
Asks the government to research the use, satisfaction and effectiveness of instruments supporting SMEs in choosing sustainability measures and report to the House.
requests the government to research the use, satisfaction and effectiveness of instruments supporting SMEs
verzoekt de regering onderzoek te doen naar het gebruik, de tevredenheid en effectiviteit van de instrumenten om het mkb te ondersteunen
Motie van de leden Stoffer en Romke de Jong over verbetering van de toegankelijkheid van NEN-normcommissies voor kleine mkb-bedrijven
Motion asks the government to improve access to NEN standards committees for small businesses, including considering financial support.
requests the government to work toward further improving access to NEN standards committees for small businesses
verzoekt de regering zich in te zetten voor verdere verbetering van de toegankelijkheid van NEN-normcommissies voor kleine mkb-bedrijven
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over periodieke tussenevaluaties
Asks the government to carry out periodic interim evaluations of the Growth Fund, starting after the second round, and to discuss the growth letter and strategy with the House on that basis.
requests the government to carry out a periodic interim evaluation, starting after the second round, and on that basis to discuss the growth letter with the House
verzoekt de regering, periodiek een tussenevaluatie uit te voeren, te beginnen na de tweede ronde, en op basis daarvan met de Kamer in gesprek te gaan over de groeibrief
Motie van het lid Romke de Jong c.s. over aandachtspunten bij ingediende projectplannen breed delen
Asks the government with the advisory committee to share the points of attention for submitted project plans widely for later Growth Fund tranches.
requests the government, in cooperation with the advisory committee, to ensure that points of attention for submitted project plans are widely shared
verzoekt de regering, om in samenwerking met de adviescommissie er zorg voor te dragen dat aandachtspunten bij de ingediende projectplannen breed worden gedeeld
Motie van de leden Amhaouch en Romke de Jong over de betrokkenheid van regio's borgen
Asks the government, after the second round, to check whether regions are sufficiently involved in Growth Fund applications and whether extra outreach is needed.
requests the government, after the second round together with departments, to examine whether the involvement of the regions is sufficiently secured
verzoekt de regering, om na de tweede ronde samen met departementen te bezien of de betrokkenheid van de regio's voldoende is geborgd
Motie van het lid Heinen c.s. over aangeven hoe goedgekeurde projecten passen binnen de bredere groeistrategie
Asks the government to explain in future assessment rounds how approved Growth Fund projects fit the broader growth strategy.
to indicate in future assessment rounds also how approved projects fit within the broader growth strategy of the cabinet
om bij volgende beoordelingsrondes ook aan te geven hoe goedgekeurde projecten passen binnen de bredere groeistrategie van het kabinet
Motie van het lid Romke de Jong c.s. over wet- en regelgeving waarmee gekozen projecten kunnen worden ondersteund
Asks the government to map which laws and regulations could support projects selected for the Growth Fund and inform the House.
to map which laws and regulations the selected projects can be further supported with
in kaart te brengen met welke wet- en regelgeving de gekozen projecten verder kunnen worden ondersteund
Motie van de leden Amhaouch en Romke de Jong over aandacht voor het benutten van internationale kansen
Asks the government to consider international opportunities for consortia when allocating National Growth Fund projects.
requests the government to pay attention to exploiting such international opportunities and to pass this on to the assessment advisory committee of the National Growth Fund
verzoekt de regering, aandacht te hebben voor het benutten van dergelijke internationale kansen en dit aan de beoordelingsadviescommissie van het Nationaal Groeifonds mee te geven
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Warmerdam over cao’s met afspraken over zelfstandigen

Two D66 MPs asked the government about collective agreements (cao's) that set terms for self-employed workers (zzp'ers), including whether such terms restrict contractual freedom, how many workers and self-employed are affected, whether these agreements belong in cao's, and how member participation and enforcement against false self-employment work. The minister answers that the competition-law exception allows collective bargaining for vulnerable self-employed, that only a small number of cao's contain such provisions, that enforcement and a legal presumption against false self-employment are being pursued, and that the questions could not be answered by the requested deadline.
Exact numbers of self-employed workers in the sectors are not available.
Exacte aantallen van zelfstandigen in de branches zijn niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Romke de Jong (D66) over het bericht 'Afschaffing btw op groente en fruit dreigt te sneuvelen'

MPs Grinwis and Romke de Jong asked why the government doubts introducing a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables despite coalition support and the Prime Minister's remark that the tax service can implement it. The state secretaries answer that no decision has been taken, that the zero rate would invite endless legal challenges under the neutrality principle and cost 550-950 million euros, and that implementation on 1 January 2024 is not advisable.
No decision has yet been taken on whether to introduce a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables and/or alternative health measures.
Er heeft nog geen besluitvorming plaatsgevonden over het al dan niet invoeren van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit en/of alternatieve gezondheidsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op van de leden Warmerdam en Romke de Jong over het artikel 'Loonkloof tussen man en vrouw in Nederland is groter dan in veel andere EU-landen'

MPs Warmerdam and Romke de Jong asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the gender pay gap in the Netherlands compared with other EU countries, why the decline has stalled, the timing and scope of the EU pay transparency directive implementation, and related questions on company size thresholds and temp workers. The minister attributed the gap largely to part-time work and sector differences, acknowledged slow progress, committed to implementing the directive by mid-2024, and answered most questions, with consultation planned.
I see the introduction of this directive as an important step in promoting equality in the labour market.
Ik zie de invoering van deze richtlijn als een belangrijke stap in het bevorderen van gelijkheid op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Den Haag verwaarloost innovatief mkb in de regio'

MPs Romke de Jong and Amhaouch asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a newspaper report claiming The Hague neglects innovative SMEs in the regions, and whether regional development companies (ROMs) should play a bigger role and receive more funding. The minister acknowledges the potential, describes existing instruments and ROM funding, denies that ROMs received disproportionately little, and says a multi-year plan for the ROMs is being prepared with provinces, to be reported by end of Q4.
A multi-year plan for the ROMs is currently being prepared, precisely to examine where they can be structurally deployed and how the supra-regional system can be better used.
Op dit moment wordt gewerkt aan een meerjarenplan voor de ROM’s, juist om te kijken waar zij structureel ingezet kunnen worden en het bovenregionale stelsel beter benut kan worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Van Strien over het bericht 'Lightyear stopt productie eerste zonneauto: 'Focus op goedkopere model''

MPs Romke de Jong and Van Strien asked the minister about Lightyear halting production of its first solar car, the Lightyear 0, after bankruptcy of its production subsidiary, and about IP rights, public investments, and support for solar mobility. The minister regretted the situation, said the company is continuing in reduced form with an 8 million euro injection, that the public investors' IP and investments are secured through the restart, and promised a market study letter on solar mobility before summer.
With this restart, the public investments via, among others, Invest-NL, BOM and LIOF are also secured given the circumstances.
Met deze doorstart zijn de publieke investeringen via onder meer Invest-NL, BOM en LIOF gegeven de omstandigheden eveneens geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Romke de Jong over btw op menselijke geslachtscellen

Two D66 MPs asked why human sperm and egg cells used for reproductive donation are taxed at the 21% general VAT rate, higher than the 9% rate for animal sperm, and why they are not exempt like human organs, blood and breast milk, and whether costs for people with a fertility wish should be reduced. The government answered that the EU VAT Directive offers no room for a reduced or exempt rate for human germ cells, that exemptions must be interpreted strictly, that the Embryowet already caps fees charged by sperm and egg banks, and that an EU amendment is not foreseen.
However, the VAT Directive offers no scope to apply the reduced rate to germ cells supplied to humans for reproductive purposes, so the standard rate of 21% applies to them.

De Btw-richtlijn biedt echter geen ruimte om het verlaagde tarief toe te passen op geslachtscellen die voor reproductieve doeleinden bij mensen worden geleverd, waardoor hierop het algemene tarief van 21% van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over dreigende onbereikbaarheid van Omrop Fryslân

An MP asked about DAB+ coverage gaps for Omrop Fryslân and whether FM should stay available, citing Frisian language rights. The government says coverage is a licensing matter for the Ministry of Economic Affairs and the RDI, that FM and online remain available, and that no FM switch-off is planned before 2035.
Yes, I am aware of these statements.
Ja, ik ben bekend met deze uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Romke de Jong over het bericht 'Financieel gepuzzel toch weer terug bij Belastingdienst door verstoringen'

MPs Van Weyenberg and Romke de Jong asked why the automatic income-distribution calculator between fiscal partners was removed from the 2022 tax return despite an earlier promise, and when it would return. The State Secretary explained it was disabled due to incorrect values, that the 2021 promise could not be met due to other priorities, and that it will return in the next campaign after fixing existing returns.
The Tax Administration aims to correct the return based on the optimal distribution, without requiring citizens to submit a new return.
De Belastingdienst streeft ernaar de aangifte te herstellen op basis van de optimale verdeling, zonder dat de burger gevraagd wordt om een nieuwe aangifte in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over bezwaren box 3-heffing

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Finance why the Tax Register urges all box 3 taxpayers to object to their assessments, whether a substantial number of objections will be upheld, whether the Tax Authority has capacity to process them, and how the government will address the mass-objection problem and the transition to actual-return taxation. The State Secretary answered that the box 3 restitution is reasonable, that unfounded objections will be rejected, that capacity is under strain with a review planned in 2023, and that the mass-objection procedure is under study with a letter promised before spring, while giving a timetable for the transition to actual-return taxation from 2026.

I consider it undesirable that taxpayers feel compelled to object to every tax assessment because otherwise there is a risk of paying too much tax without compensation possibly being offered afterwards.

Ik acht het onwenselijk dat belastingplichtigen zich genoodzaakt voelen om tegen iedere belastingaanslag bezwaar te maken omdat anders de kans bestaat dat er te veel belasting betaald wordt zonder dat achteraf nog compensatie geboden kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Podt over het bericht ‘Joana Duarte wil Nederlander worden met een Friese eed (maar of dat mag, is de vraag)’

MPs Romke de Jong and Podt asked the Minister of Interior about a report that a candidate for Dutch citizenship wanted to take the oath in Frisian, and whether the Frisian Language Use Act allows this in all cases. The minister confirmed the Act permits swearing in Frisian, acknowledged implementation gaps, and committed to clarifying the rules to Frisian municipalities by letter.

Therefore I will, ahead of the new administrative agreement on Frisian language and culture, clarify in a letter to the Frisian municipalities in the short term how the Frisian Language Use Act applies to taking an oath, declaration or pledge.

Daarom zal ik, vooruitlopend op de nieuwe Bestuursafspraak Friese taal en cultuur, op korte termijn per brief aan de Friese gemeenten de toepassing van de Wet gebruik Friese taal bij het afleggen van een eed, verklaring of belofte verduidelijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong, Sneller en Kat over het bericht 'Gokbedrijven probeerden ondanks verbod via wk-pools nieuwe klanten te lokken'

MPs Romke de Jong, Sneller and Kat asked the government about reports that gambling firms, including state holding Nederlandse Loterij, advertised via World Cup pools despite a ban, and about the state's oversight as shareholder. The government answered that it was unaware of the World Cup pool ads, that the Gaming Authority fined Nederlandse Loterij for advertising aimed at young adults, that it has voiced concerns to the holdings, and that it is evaluating the shareholding while declining to disclose the number of young players.
This information is not known to me or to my colleague the Minister for Legal Protection because it concerns confidential business information.
Deze informatie is bij mij of mijn collega de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming niet bekend omdat dit vertrouwelijke bedrijfsinformatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over baby-bv

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance about 'baby-bv' constructions, where shares in a company are transferred to minors to shift future value, including whether such structures are undesirable, how common minority shareholdings are, and how to counter them. The government answered that the policy stance follows with the Prinsjesdag cabinet response to the IBO on wealth distribution, gave registry counts of minors as shareholders, explained gift tax and parental control rules, and pointed to the pending Wet excessief lenen bij eigen vennootschap for loans.
The desirability of the mentioned tax constructions will be addressed in the cabinet position on the IBO Wealth Distribution, which follows on Prinsjesdag.
Op de wenselijkheid van de genoemde belastingconstructies wordt ingegaan in het kabinetsstandpunt op het IBO Vermogensverdeling dat volgt met Prinsjesdag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over het artikel 'Hoge ambtenaren Belastingdienst schonden regels om Uber te bevoordelen'

MP Romke de Jong asked the State Secretary of Finance about a newspaper report that senior Tax Administration officials broke rules to favour Uber, and about how the tax authority handles foreign investors, information requests from other countries, and communication with multinationals. The State Secretary answered that an internal investigation is underway, that tax secrecy under article 67 AWR prevents disclosing individual case files and the investigation results, and offered a confidential briefing to parliament.
Because of the tax secrecy obligation in article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR), I have not been able to answer all questions and cannot make the results of the investigation public either.

Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) heb ik niet alle vragen kunnen beantwoorden en kan ik ook de resultaten van het onderzoek niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over de hoogte van de thuiswerkvergoeding

Romke de Jong (D66) asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the tax-free home-working allowance is still adequate given the Nibud's higher 2022 cost estimate and rising energy prices. The State Secretary answered that the allowance will be indexed by the tax table correction factor from 2023, that the Nibud figure will be reviewed in the WKR evaluation, and that hybrid working brings societal benefits.
The cabinet will include the evaluation of the home-working exemption in the evaluation of the WKR planned for 2023/2024.
Het kabinet zal de evaluatie van de thuiswerkvrijstelling meenemen in de evaluatie van de WKR die gepland staat voor 2023/2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Romke de Jong en Kröger over het bericht ‘Sociaal ondernemen groeit (te) langzaam naar volwassenheid’

Three MPs asked the economy minister about a news report saying social enterprises grow too slowly, covering macro-economic weight, financing, local government procurement, scale-up barriers and the planned social-enterprise company form (BVm). The minister answered that data on their economic contribution is limited, financing is generally available, PIANOo and the City Deal support local governments, and the BVm bill will likely go to consultation end 2022 or early 2023 and reach parliament during 2023.
This means the bill can only be sent to the House for consideration in the course of 2023 at the earliest.
Dit betekent dat niet eerder dan in de loop van 2023 het wetsvoorstel voor behandeling naar de Kamer zal kunnen worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Romke de Jong over een suikertaks

MPs Van der Laan and Romke de Jong asked whether the coalition's sugar tax, which raises the existing beverage excise, would also make bottled water more expensive and whether this fits prevention goals. The government confirmed that mineral water is temporarily included, plans to exempt it from 1 January 2024, and will study tariff differentiation by sugar content.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden vragen van de leden Sneller, Van Weyenberg en Romke de Jong over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

D66 MPs asked how the government's new framework contract for photography procurement affects photographers' administrative burden, costs, rates and market power, and whether the photographers were consulted. The government answered that a single agency will manage a pool of photographers with lower admin burdens for them, a hourly rate of 109 euros, a likely rise in costs for the state, and that the photographers were contacted in an earlier round.
The aim of this procurement is to contract a single agency that, in consultation with clients, selects a pool of photographers to carry out assignments under the framework agreement.
Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om één bureau te contracteren dat, in samenspraak met opdrachtgevers, een poule van fotografen selecteert om opdrachten binnen de raamovereenkomst uit te voeren.
Antwoord op het lid Romke de Jong over het bericht ‘Bedrijven doen te weinig aan maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen’

An MP from D66 asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate how to help businesses, especially the more than a quarter who feel their firm does too little on corporate social responsibility (MVO), take first steps, and how to strengthen CSR awareness, reduce its threshold, and support businesses' long-term viability. The minister answers by listing existing national and international CSR and due-diligence policies, information channels (RVO, MVO Nederland), transparency benchmarks, planned IMVO legislation and a planned IMVO support point, while stating that it is hard to say whether all businesses will have CSR targets within five years.
The cabinet wants all Dutch companies doing business at home and abroad to do so responsibly.
Het kabinet wil dat alle Nederlandse bedrijven die zakendoen in zowel binnen- als buitenland, dit verantwoord doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boulakjar en Romke de Jong over btw op zonnepanelen

MPs Boulakjar and Romke de Jong asked whether the planned zero VAT rate on solar panels should extend beyond homeowners to postcode-rose members, public and community buildings, and tenants. The state secretary answered that the zero rate covers panels on or near homes including for landlords and housing corporations, but not on public buildings (still under study) and not for rental of panels.
Further research must determine whether it is possible and desirable to facilitate solar panels on public and other buildings, and if so, whether a zero VAT rate is a sensible policy route for that.

Verder onderzoek moet plaatsvinden of het mogelijk en wenselijk is zonnepanelen op openbare en andere gebouwen te faciliteren, en zo ja, of een btw-nultarief daarvoor beleidsmatig een verstandige route is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over onduidelijke communicatie inzake meerdaagse (zakelijke) evenementen

An MP asked why multi-day business events such as trade fairs and congresses were believed to be cancelled until 1 September 2021 due to unclear government communication, and asked for clearer guidance. The minister acknowledged the confusion, said communications were adjusted and that multi-day business events without overnight stays could go ahead, and described economic support measures for the events sector.
Discussions with the sector showed that the wording sometimes caused confusion.
Uit gesprekken met de sector is gebleken dat de omschrijving soms voor verwarring zorgde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Romke de Jong over pensioenopbouw door zzp’ers

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Romke de Jong asked about pension accrual by self-employed workers (zzp'ers) during and after the coronavirus crisis, including the role of home equity as a pension provision, administrative burdens and withdrawal flexibility. Minister Schouten answered that the proposed Wetsvoorstel toekomst pensioenen raises the tax-facilitated savings room for the self-employed, that home equity is not designed as a pension provision and will not be promoted specifically, and that an experiment will ease access to second-pillar schemes.
The cabinet is of the view that pension accrual for self-employed workers will thereby be better facilitated.
Het kabinet is van mening dat pensioenopbouw voor zelfstandigen hierdoor beter wordt gefaciliteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Boulakjar over de kamerverhuurvrijstelling

MPs Romke de Jong and Boulakjar asked whether the room-rental tax exemption (kamerverhuurvrijstelling) should be raised to better use the housing stock, and about its rationale, budget and tax effects. The government answered that better use of existing housing can help, referred to the National Housing and Construction Agenda, explained the exemption's conditions and rationale, and argued that raising it would have negligible effects on the housing shortage and could push up rents.
Because the exempt amount per month is already higher than the average cost of a room with shared facilities, I consider the chosen level of the room-rental exemption defensible
Omdat het vrijgestelde bedrag per maand reeds hoger is dan de gemiddelde kostprijs voor een kamer met gedeelde voorzieningen vind ik de gekozen hoogte van de kamerverhuurvrijstelling verdedigbaar
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Romke de Jong over het bericht 'Aantal startende ondernemers 'nog steeds erg hoog''

MPs Kat and Romke de Jong asked how persons under debt restructuring, debt administration or guardianship can register as entrepreneurs at the Chamber of Commerce without consent, and how the Chamber checks this. The minister answers that unauthorised registration is not intended, that the Chamber checks authority and records only in doubtful cases, that no statistics are kept, and that the Chamber will update its information for vulnerable groups.
Such data are not kept, neither for the debt restructuring procedure nor for protective administration or guardianship.
Dergelijke gegevens worden niet bijgehouden, noch voor de schuldsaneringsprocedure, noch voor het beschermingsbewind of de curatele.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over de garantieregeling voor evenementen

MP Romke de Jong asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about compensation for events cancelled due to government restrictions, including the move from 100% to 80% guarantee cover, the timing of cancellation decisions, organisers' contracts with artists and suppliers, the economic viability of capacity limits, and accountant-protocol clarity. The minister answered that a phased own-risk share is being introduced (90% in Q1 2022, 80% in Q2 and Q3), that organisers may cancel from three weeks before an event during a ban, that contracts with suppliers are a private matter enforceable in court, that a suppletieregeling existed for 2021, and that a control protocol for accountants is now ready.
The cabinet regrets that it took a long time before there was clarity about the control protocol for the TRSEC.
Het kabinet betreurt dat het lang duurde voordat er duidelijkheid was omtrent het controleprotocol voor de TRSEC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Tjeerd de Groot over de aandacht voor de Friese taal bij de introductie van bewindspersonen

Two MPs asked why the introduction dossiers and CVs of new ministers are translated into English, French, German and Papiamento but not Frisian, and why the rijksoverheid.nl website lacks Frisian content. The minister replied that translation decisions are left to departments under the government translation policy, that Frisian-speaking residents are a designated target group, and that Frisian versions of some information exist, while agreeing that some key information should be available in recognised languages.
It is up to the individual departments to decide whether translations into other languages are desirable.
Het is aan de individuele departementen om de afweging te maken of vertalingen in andere talen wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Romke de Jong, Tielen en Aartsen over de signalen die zij ontvangen m.b.t. de steunmaatregelen voor zzp’ers

MPs asked whether municipalities impose wealth and viability tests on self-employed applicants for support beyond what the government intends, and about income losses and reskilling. The minister acknowledges reports of excessive information requests, says municipalities have decentralised responsibility and are being asked to limit requests to what is necessary, and largely defends the simplified Bbz scheme without reinstating the earlier TOZO.

Where signals reach the ministry that municipalities are requesting too much information, this is investigated, and if unnecessary information is indeed requested, the VNG is asked to contact the municipality concerned.

Daar waar bij het ministerie signalen binnenkomen dat gemeenten (te)veel informatie zouden uitvragen, wordt dit uitgezocht en als blijkt dat er inderdaad onnodige informatie wordt uitgevraagd, wordt de VNG verzocht contact hierover op te nemen met de betreffende gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Romke de Jong over het artikel 'Opeens is de machine of de fabriek veel minder waard'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister for Climate and Energy how fiscal depreciation and write-down rules work and whether the energy transition will force large write-downs of machines and factories. The government explained the depreciation and write-down rules in detail, said the impact of the energy transition varies case by case and cannot be quantified, and concluded that tax rules will not significantly affect the pace of the transition.
That cannot be said in general terms.
Dat is niet in algemene zin te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Bikker over het bericht 'Geen Friese tolken meer beschikbaar vanwege 'magere vergoeding''

MPs Romke de Jong and Bikker asked about reports that Frisian interpreters are no longer available due to low fees, and how the right to use Frisian in court (Wet gebruik Friese taal art. 11) is guaranteed. The minister answered that Frisian-speaking judges and prosecutors exist, interpreters can be used, new tariff and procurement arrangements are being introduced, and a baseline survey and future bestuursafspraken are planned.
It is for my successor to give these arrangements concrete form and record them.
Het is aan mijn ambtsopvolger deze afspraken concreet vorm te geven en vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Boucke over het bericht dat greenwashing bedrijven dreigt door de lage prijs voor CO2-compensatie

Two MPs from D66 asked the government about reports that cheap old carbon offset credits make greenwashing likely, and whether the voluntary offset market needs independent oversight. The State Secretary acknowledged surplus old credits and average prices below real abatement costs, but said the government does not regulate the voluntary market, referring consumer misleading-claims issues to the ACM and committing only to a letter to the European Commission.
Current average prices are not made public.
De actuele gemiddelde prijzen worden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sneller, Wuite, Romke de Jong en Van Weyenberg over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

D66 MPs asked whether the Ministry of General Affairs' tender for photography services, which bundles assignments with a large image bank, would exclude freelancers and SMEs and create a monopsony. The Prime Minister's answer says the tender is in preparation, that a pool of photographers will be selected via a single agency, that the image-bank and commissioned photography will be split into separate tenders, and that the approach honours the 2017 Vos/Mulder motion.
The Ministry of General Affairs has decided, after further consideration, that the commissioned photography and image-bank photography, initially bundled, will be decoupled in this tender.
Het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken heeft op basis van nadere afwegingen besloten dat de van aanvang gebundeld ingezette opdracht- en beeldbankfotografie in deze aanbesteding worden losgekoppeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Aartsen over "het rapport van de Nationale Ombudsman over ondernemers die in de knel komen als gevolg van corona"

MPs Romke de Jong and Aartsen asked the ministers about the Ombudsman's report on entrepreneurs in financial difficulty due to COVID support schemes, including TONK, SBI-code problems, debt relief and repayment. The State Secretary says the knelpunten are acknowledged, describes fixes (TONK budget doubled, SBI-code adjustments, second reference period, flexible repayment terms) and commits to assisting the Ombudsman.
I am always willing to assist the National Ombudsman in his investigation at his request.
Ik ben altijd bereid om de Nationale ombudsman op zijn verzoek bij te staan in zijn onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Aartsen over het bericht 'Winkelleegstand loopt snel op door corona'

MPs Romke de Jong and Aartsen asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about rising shop vacancy in big cities due to COVID-19, including the government's plans and support for municipalities. The State Secretary acknowledged the rising vacancy and negative effects, pointed to the Retailagenda platform, a G6 exploration with three ministries, and the 100 million euro Impulsaanpak Winkelgebieden, while offering no firm new commitments beyond ongoing work.
It is expected that the results of this will form the basis for a subsequent administrative process.
Naar verwachting zullen de resultaten hiervan de basis vormen voor een bestuurlijk vervolgtraject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Romke de Jong en Kat over de Tozo

MPs from D66 asked why the Tozo loan carries 2% interest while the Bbz credit carries 8%, and whether the gap is defensible for entrepreneurs. The minister answered that the Tozo is a temporary crisis scheme pegged to Qredits' rate, the Bbz is a structural last-resort scheme with market-rate interest, and he is not willing to lower the Bbz rate because a lower non-market rate would constitute state aid.
I attach importance to a market-conform interest rate being applied to interest-bearing loans under the regular Bbz.
Ik hecht eraan dat er in het kader van het reguliere Bbz een marktconforme rente wordt gehanteerd voor rentedragende leningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Romke de Jong over de TONK

MPs Van Weyenberg and Romke de Jong (D66) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the TONK emergency living-cost support, including its scope relative to the TOZO, uneven municipal implementation, low payouts and strict conditions, and requested a comparison table of municipal rules. The minister replied that TONK covers necessary costs after income loss, that municipalities are being urged to apply it generously and are loosening rules with the extra budget, and that a comparison table is attached as a snapshot.
I have held constructive discussions with municipalities on several occasions about the objectives of TONK and the wish of the House of Representatives and the cabinet to apply TONK generously.
Ik heb op meerdere momenten constructieve gesprekken met gemeenten gevoerd over de doelstellingen van TONK en de wens van Tweede Kamer en kabinet om ruimhartig met de TONK om te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Tjeerd de Groot over vertragingen bij de herbeoordeling van TVL-aanvragen

MPs Romke de Jong and Tjeerd de Groot asked about delays in re-assessing TVL aid objections caused by SBI-code problems, including progress, the Q4 2020 backlog, sailing-vessel skippers, and the application form. The State Secretary answered that 97.5% of re-assessments are done, the remainder will follow shortly, RVO has added capacity to prioritise these cases, and the system was adjusted so entrepreneurs see the correct SBI code.
The objections relating to the SBI problem are being handled with priority, also because of the effect on an application in the next application period.
De bezwaren die betrekking hebben op de SBI-problematiek worden met voorrang opgepakt, ook vanwege het effect op een aanvraag de volgende aanvraagperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Romke de Jong over de Duitse testplicht bij grenswerkers

Two D66 MPs asked why German COVID test requirements apply to cross-border workers living in the Netherlands, whether they were informed, who pays for tests, and whether the GGD can provide certificates. The State Secretary confirmed the test obligation applies to them, pointed to official information channels, declined to make GGD tests available for certificates, and said a free testing facility in the border region was being set up.
No. The GGDs test with the aim of combating infectious diseases; preventive testing and issuing test certificates are indeed not part of that.
Nee. De GGD'en testen met als doel om de infectieziektebestrijding tegen te gaan; het preventief testen en verstrekken van testbewijzen maken daar inderdaad geen onderdeel van uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong, Tjeerd de Groot en Wuite over de steunmaatregelen voor de bruine vloot

D66 MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about delayed and narrowly defined support for the historic sailing 'bruine vloot' affected by the COVID-19 crisis, including why advance payments are not possible and why ideal-purpose and other heritage vessels are excluded. The state secretary answered that existing TOGS/TVL schemes fit these entrepreneurs, that advances are legally barred, that the dedicated scheme targets commercial sailing ships aged 50+ under specific SBI codes, and that opening is still expected by end of the second quarter 2021 pending European Commission approval.
It is not possible to pay advances before a scheme is published because under the General Administrative Law Act subsidies may only be granted on the basis of a statutory provision.

Het is niet mogelijk voorschotten uit te betalen voorafgaand aan publicatie van een regeling omdat volgens de Algemene wet bestuursrecht subsidies alleen op grond van een wettelijk voorschrift mogen worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het feit dat sommige Europese landen niet voldoen aan de in 2010 aangenomen Europese Richtlijn die import van illegaal gekapt hout verbiedt

An MP asked whether four EU member states still failing to implement the 2010 EU timber regulation are letting illegally logged timber into the Netherlands, what pressure exists to make them comply, and why the EU forest action plan has yielded poor results. The State Secretary answered that Dutch imports from those countries are small (0.21% of sawn wood), that the Commission has started infringement proceedings against three of them, and referred to a separate letter for the broader question.
It is for the European Commission to deploy pressure instruments when member states do not comply with EU law and regulations.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie om drukmiddelen in te zetten wanneer lidstaten zich niet houden aan EU wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over het bericht dat gemeenten de geuroverlast van veehouderijen niet terug mogen dringen

MPs Van Dekken and Cegerek asked whether municipalities can tighten odour rules in overburdened areas, citing a reported Council of State ruling, and whether cumulative odour nuisance and resident perception should be reflected in the Wet geurhinder en veehouderij evaluation. The state secretary corrected the press report, said the evaluation working group will advise before any response, noted the Crisis- en herstelwet has not yet been used coercively, and confirmed the RIVM comparison and that these matters will be part of the evaluation.
Yes. At my request the RIVM carried out a comparative analysis in which the research methods and results of the Utrecht University and GGD study were compared with the 2001 PRA study.
Ja. Het RIVM heeft op mijn verzoek een duidingsonderzoek uitgevoerd waarin de onderzoeksmethodiek en resultaten van het onderzoek van de Universiteit Utrecht en de GGD
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over fraude met emissiesoftware door Volkswagen

The MP Smaling asked whether the Volkswagen emissions-software fraud undermines the national air quality programme (NOx) and the Programmatic Approach to Nitrogen (PAS) and AERIUS model, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that air quality policy need not be changed because it is already based on real-world emission measurements, that the latest data will be incorporated in the annual model update, and that extra measures for cities will be sent to parliament in November.
Air quality policy does not need to be adjusted as a result of the software fraud at Volkswagen.
Het luchtkwaliteitbeleid hoeft naar aanleiding van de softwarefraude bij Volkswagen niet te worden aangepast.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht ‘Mat ’64 kan tot 2017 in dienst blijven’

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Mat '64 trains could remain in service until 2017, how removing them fits the 'passenger first' principle, and why NS and the ILT gave conflicting accounts of withdrawing them. The state secretary answered that NS decides fleet deployment under the concession, that NS's safety system and parts shortages prevent longer use, and that the ILT only issued a non-binding signal, so the trains are no longer planned for service from 2016 except as emergency reserve.
Issuing such a signal gives the organisation concerned, in this case NS, an opportunity for improvement, but does not lead to a legally enforceable obligation.
Het afgeven van zo'n signaal biedt de betreffende organisatie, in dit geval NS, een kans voor verbetering, maar leidt niet tot een juridisch afdwingbare verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het uit de roulatie halen van treinen

The MP asks whether the government knew of the decision to withdraw the Mat'64 train type, why it was taken, how many seats are lost, and whether NS meets its concession obligations. The Secretary of State explains that NS withdrew the Mat'64 after a safety signal from the ILT, that extending service was rejected for safety, maintenance and capacity reasons, and that NS is bound by performance indicators and fines but the choice of rolling stock is NS's own.
I have confronted NS about the expected shortfall and asked it to pull out all the stops to achieve performance improvement.
Ik heb NS aangesproken op het door NS verwachte tekort en gevraagd alles uit de kast te halen om tot prestatieverbetering te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de herijking van de spoorbudgetten

Mr Van Helvert (CDA) asked the State Secretary about the rail budget reassessment (herijking), including which regional projects were funded, selection criteria, the PHS project's share of funds, and ProRail's cost norms and uncertainty margins. The State Secretary answered that the final package was decided after MIRT consultations, that remaining regional wishes will be pursued later, and gave detailed but largely indicative responses on costs and criteria.
Therefore, after the Nota Overleg MIRT, I will work together with the parties involved to seek financial room to take the desired additional steps.
Daarom zal ik ná het Nota Overleg MIRT samen met de betrokken partijen zoeken naar financiële ruimte om de geambieerde extra stappen te kunnen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de NS nachttrein naar Noord-Brabant schrapt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary why the NS night train to Noord-Brabant was cut, whether a €700,000 annual price is reasonable, and whether the government will mediate with NS and the province. The State Secretary replied that the concession sets late-train rules, that the cut night services were province-funded outside the concession, that NS and the province must agree financing, and that the province and municipalities can have the price independently reviewed.
This is a matter between the province and NS.
Dit is een zaak tussen de provincie en NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Mei Li Vos over het artikel “Air France-KLM topman komt Franse staat tegemoet”

MPs Monasch and Mei Li Vos asked whether Air France-KLM's leadership was backing away from reorganisation plans, whether this shifts losses onto KLM, and whether the Dutch state should take a larger shareholding. The government denies reversing the plans, says it is seeking alternative cost reductions, and declines to take up a larger stake for now while maintaining contact with French counterparts.
Should the Dutch state also acquire a stake at least equal to the French stake in Air France-KLM to strengthen the position of Dutch interests within the holding?
Vraag 7 Zou de Nederlandse staat ook een aandeel gelijk aan tenminste het Franse aandeel moeten krijgen in Air France-KLM om de positie van de Nederlandse belangen binnen de holding te versterken?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de mogelijke gevolgen van de productie van teflon in Dordrecht

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about health and environmental risks of PFOA from teflon production at DuPont (now Chemours) in Dordrecht, including the split of oversight among several bodies, whether authorities knew of the hazards, and whether an independent study would be done. The government answered that PFOA use stopped in 2012, that oversight is coordinated under the Brzo framework, and that it will ask RIVM to study what emissions could have meant for health, but it did not provide the answers in time for the debate.
Therefore I will ask the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) to prepare a study examining to what concentrations of PFOA in air and water the emissions could have led.

Daarom zal ik het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) vragen om een onderzoek voor te bereiden waarin uitgezocht wordt tot welke concentraties PFOA in lucht en water de emissie kan hebben geleid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Cegerek en Wolbert over het gebruik van de kankerverwekkende stof perfluoroctaanzuur (ook wel PFOA of C8) bij DuPont in Dordrecht

MPs Jacobi, Cegerek and Wolbert asked the government about PFOA (C8) use at DuPont in Dordrecht, including health risks, the company's blood-monitoring data not being shared with the inspectorate, and whether specific environmental health research was ever done. The government answered that the inspectorate lacks the data, that the environmental permits followed national guidelines, and that it will ask RIVM to prepare a study on possible health effects.
The company concerned has not shared the research data with the Inspectorate SZW.
Het betreffende bedrijf heeft de onderzoeksgegevens niet met Inspectie SZW gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de berichten dat er een beter plan moet komen voor asbestsanering

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about reports that a better plan is needed for asbestos removal, including whether removal is on schedule, whether subsidies of 75 million euro are adequate, and whether a national plan with partners is possible. The State Secretary answered that at current pace removal would take until 2044, so a stimulation scheme from January 2016 aims to speed it up, and agreed to examine a structured timeline with external partners.
Yes, the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment is willing to cooperate in such a study carried out by the named external parties.
Ja, het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu is bereid om mee te werken aan een dergelijk onderzoek dat wordt uitgevoerd door de genoemde externe partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Houwers over een bericht inzake aanbestedingen van spoorwerkzaamheden rond Schiphol

An MP asked the State Secretary whether ProRail was splitting rail contracts near Schiphol to avoid public tendering, and whether consequences should follow. The State Secretary answered that ministry staff had questioned ProRail and that the reported claim is not correct, referring to an earlier letter to parliament for the substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de bereikbaarheid per spoor van Dordrecht

An MP asked the state secretary whether NS plans to drop the Intercity between Dordrecht and Breda-Tilburg-Eindhoven, whether Dordrecht will remain well connected by rail, whether freight can use the HSL-Zuid, and whether he will convene the parties. The answer confirms NS plans to route the Den Haag-Eindhoven Intercity via the HSL, leaving Dordrecht without it, but says talks on keeping a Dordrecht-Breda link, including co-financing, are ongoing with a decision planned for spring 2016.
I will inform you of this decision.
Ik zal u over dit besluit informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Milieu ondergeschikt bij inkoop materialen door overheid’

An MP asked the government to respond to a Forest Stewardship Council report finding that much tropical timber used in public works cannot be shown to be sustainably sourced, and asked whether the government's sustainable procurement goals and measures are adequate. The state secretary largely defends existing policy (Green Deal, PIANOo support, monitoring), disputes some of the report's conclusions and promises a study of the causes with a government reaction later in the year.

Because of these signals, after signing the Green Deal in 2013 the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment commissioned a study into why it cannot in all cases be demonstrated that sustainable timber was supplied in central government projects.

Vanwege de genoemde signalen is na het ondertekenen van de Green Deal bevorderen duurzaam bosbeheer in 2013 opdracht gegeven door het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu voor een onderzoek naar de redenen waarom bij rijksoverheidsprojecten niet in alle gevallen aangetoond kan worden dat duurzaam hout is geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over de herijking van de spoorbudgetten en de gevolgen hiervan voor de regio’s en voor PHS

An ChristenUnie MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the re-assessment of rail budgets, the remaining free investment space (about 9 million euro), and consequences for the regions and the high-frequency rail programme PHS, including Gelderland's concerns. The State Secretary answered most questions by referring to the forthcoming MIRT decision process and the PHS progress report, offering only limited figures and no firm commitments on specific projects.
Answer 4: For the available amount, its origin and allocation, I refer you to the proposal that is still subject of discussion in the MIRT administrative consultations.
Voor het beschikbare bedrag, de herkomst en aanwending daarvan verwijs ik u naar het voorstel dat nog onderwerp is van gesprek aan de bestuurlijke overleggen MIRT (zie bijlage) 3 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de aanpak van luchtvervuiling door scooters

MP Dik-Faber asked the State Secretary about scooter air pollution, Euro 4/5 timing, local emission zones, registration of vehicle data, and a motion on ultrafine particles and type-approval controls. The State Secretary answered that Euro 4 applies from 2017, two-stroke scooters will be phased out by 2018, Euro 5 is delayed to 2020 after failed Dutch lobbying, and enforcement is largely a matter for manufacturers and type-approval authorities, with a letter promised on the Hoogland/Van Veldhoven motion.
It is up to the decentralised authorities to tackle the existing fleet where and how they consider it desirable.
Het is aan de decentrale overheden om de bestaande vloot aan te pakken waar en hoe zij dat wenselijk achten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Jan Vos over fossiele reserves die mogelijk zullen worden afgeschreven

MPs Nijboer and Jan Vos asked the Finance and Infrastructure and Environment ministers about 'stranded assets' from fossil fuel reserves, the Citigroup valuation, DNB and FSB work on climate risk, annual reporting of climate risk and Chevron dividends. The government answered that a Paris agreement's effects are premature to judge, that the carbon bubble concept is still debated, and promised to inform parliament on FSB results and to ask DNB for a broad climate-risk analysis by early next year.

During the AFB of 1 October it was also promised that DNB will be asked to look broadly at the risks of climate change for the financial sector in light of a recent speech by Mark Carney and the FSB's plans.

is tevens toegezegd dat DNB verzocht zal worden om in het licht van een recente speech van Mark Carney 5 en de plannen van de FSB, in brede zin te kijken naar de risico’s van klimaatverandering voor de financiële sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de Isla-raffinaderij

An MP asked whether ISLA refinery emissions on Curaçao are rising, exceed permit limits and WHO guidelines, and why the Dutch government has not acted to protect the population. The minister confirmed emissions rose over 2011-2014 but said exceedance is hard to establish because several installations contribute, and that responsibility for enforcement and action lies with Curaçao.
This concerns an autonomous responsibility of the country of Curaçao.
Het gaat hier om een autonome verantwoordelijkheid van land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Madlener over het bericht dat Volkswagen dieselauto’s uit de handel neemt

MP Madlener asked the state secretary whether Volkswagen may also have manipulated emissions software in the Netherlands, whether a Dutch investigation will be launched, whether other brands will be checked, and what sanctions will apply. The state secretary answered that type-approval enforcement lies with the German authority KBA, that the RDW is considering its own investigation into other brands, and that EU rules provide sanctions including withdrawal of type approval.
Enforcement of a vehicle's emissions is the responsibility of the type-approval authority of the country that issued the European type approval for the vehicles concerned.
Handhaving van de emissies van een voertuig is de verantwoordelijkheid van de typegoedkeuringsinstantie van het land dat de Europese typegoedkeuring voor de betreffende voertuigen heeft afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groot en Hoogland over de berichtgeving rondom de fraude met emissiesoftware door Volkswagen

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretaries of Finance and of Infrastructure and Environment how Volkswagen manipulated emissions tests, whether other brands or EU countries are affected, how US and EU testing differ, and what should be done to check Dutch and EU effects. The government referred several answers to earlier answers, confirmed NOx emissions in practice are much higher than the EU norm, said the RDW cannot yet determine vehicle numbers, and described that the German type-approval authority KBA has set Volkswagen a deadline for a remedy.
As soon as the necessary data are available, the RDW will determine the numbers.
Zodra de noodzakelijke gegevens beschikbaar zijn zal de RDW de aantallen achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leenders over het bericht dat low cost luchtvaartmaatschappijen vertraagde passagiers die om compensatie vragen afwimpelen

An MP asked the state secretary whether low-cost airlines rarely pay compensation to delayed passengers and whether the regulator has acted, including on jurisprudence and EU rules. The state secretary said the regulator (ILT) handles complaints, sees no verified sanctions needed because airlines pay when found due, provides complaint data, and notes EU rule revision is pending.
I am sending you, as annex 2 to these answers, the overview of the handling of complaints submitted to the ILT in 2014 and 2015.
Ik stuur u als bijlage 2 bij deze antwoorden het overzicht van de afhandeling van bij de ILT ingediende klachten in 2014 en 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het niet uitbetalen van compensatie voor vertraging door prijsvechters in de luchtvaart

An SP MP asks the state secretary whether low-cost airlines such as Ryanair and EasyJet are evading mandatory delay compensation, and why no fines have been imposed. The state secretary replies that the ILT finds airlines pay compensation when a complaint is upheld, that Ryanair and EasyJet have compliant processes, and that the ILT prefers warnings and talks over fines, while promising a new study and better passenger information.
The ILT only has data on its own activities, namely supervision in the form of complaint handling and inspections.
De ILT heeft alleen gegevens over haar eigen activiteiten, te weten het toezicht in de vorm van klachtbehandeling en inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht van een nieuwe financiële strop bij Utrecht Centraal Station

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about a reported new cost overrun of 53 million euros at Utrecht Centraal Station, including whether the figure was validated, why the Chamber was not informed earlier, the relation to the DSSU project, and the timing of ProRail's notifications. The State Secretary answers that the overrun was confirmed after a 2014 external review and an agreement on risk allocation with Utrecht municipality in July 2015, that the Chamber was informed during the committee meeting, and that an overview of other station projects will follow.
Incidentally, on Thursday 10 September during the ProRail committee meeting I informed your Chamber that a budget adjustment for this project was at issue.
Ik heb overigens donderdag 10 september tijdens het AO ProRail uw Kamer geïnformeerd over dat er een budgetaanpassing bij dit project aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het rapport van het PBL en ECN

An MP from the VVD asks the minister about a PBL/ECN quick scan of possible additional emission-reduction measures for the Urgenda climate case, including transport charges such as road pricing, an car-free Sunday and the 130 km/h motorway limit. The minister replies that the scan is a technical estimate without social cost or political feasibility analysis, that most measures are not government policy, that the cabinet does not choose road pricing, and that no further burden analysis is planned.
The PBL itself states in this quick scan that it did not take into account, among other things, (indirect) social costs of the measures, such as welfare loss.
Het PBL geeft zelf in deze quickscan aan geen rekening te hebben gehouden met o.a. (indirecte) maatschappelijke kosten van de maatregelen, zoals welvaartsverlies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Visser over “de manipulatie van modellen aangaande luchtkwaliteit”

VVD MPs Dijkstra and Visser asked the State Secretary whether Utrecht officials manipulating local air-quality traffic data, and the lack of local discretion over national models, undermine NSL air-quality reporting and measures such as milieuzones. The State Secretary answered that statutory models are fixed by the Regeling beoordeling luchtkwaliteit 2007 and managed by RIVM, that municipalities only supply traffic inputs which RIVM audits annually by sampling, and that no concerns about Utrecht's data were found.
To ensure the quality of the inputs, RIVM, on behalf of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment, annually checks the quality of the input data used in NSL monitoring on a sample basis.

Om de kwaliteit van de invoer te borgen controleert het RIVM, in opdracht van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu, jaarlijks steekproefsgewijs de kwaliteit van de invoergegevens die gebruikt worden in de NSL-monitoring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het gebruik van chroom-6 in treinen

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary about chromium-6 exposure among NedTrain rail workers, including when the risk became known, oversight by the Inspectie SZW, health consequences, support for affected staff and whether the substance is still permitted. The State Secretary answered that the historical exposure is still being investigated, that the risk was found in June 2015 in old paint layers, that the Inspectorate was informed and oversight continues, that six workers have registered for medical examination, and that an independent expert committee will review the measures, with EU phase-out rules applying to chromium-6 in professional use.
At this moment NS is investigating the extent of the historical exposure and whether, and to what degree, employees were exposed.
Op dit moment doet NS onderzoek naar de omvang van de historische blootstelling en of, en in welke mate, medewerkers zijn blootgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de aanhoudende problemen op het spoor in de Achterhoek

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment why rail disruptions continued on the Winterswijk–Arnhem line in the Achterhoek, whether the signalling systems are outdated, why replacement bus services by Arriva failed, and what measures will make the line more robust. The government attributes the disruptions partly to a possibly premature reopening after works, denies outdated signalling, explains the bus problems by a combination of circumstances while placing supervision of the concession with the province, and points to co-financed double-track works and planned studies on electrification and lightning protection.
Supervision of the implementation of the Arnhem–Winterswijk concession is the responsibility of the province of Gelderland.
Het toezicht op de uitvoering van de concessie voor Arnhem–Winterswijk is de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie Gelderland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht “Een jaar na MH17: nog steeds vliegen boven conflictgebieden”

An MP asked whether KLM and Air France fly over conflict zones such as Mali, South Sudan and the Sinai, whether the government could guarantee passenger safety and information, and whether conflict-zone overflight should be avoided altogether. The government answered that airlines are themselves responsible for risk assessment and route choice, that it does not actively monitor or steer their routes, and that it shares relevant threat information without intending to restrict routes.
Each airline is itself responsible for the safe execution of a flight.
Elke luchtvaartmaatschappij is zelf verantwoordelijk voor een veilige uitvoering van een vlucht.
Antwoord op van het lid Van Helvert inzake het vliegen over conflictgebieden

An MP from the CDA asked the government about airlines, notably KLM, flying over conflict zones, whether the government can prevent this, and what contacts and information-sharing exist. The ministers answered that airlines are responsible for their own risk assessment, that the law gives no clear power to ban flights over foreign airspace, and that an ICAO information system is being developed.
However, this law contains no explicit provision that makes it possible to impose a ban on Dutch companies for flying in foreign airspace.
Deze wet bevat echter geen expliciete bepaling die het mogelijk maakt een verbod aan Nederlandse maatschappijen op te leggen voor het vliegen in buitenlands luchtruim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de Quick Scan van het PBL en ECN

An MP asked the state secretary about a PBL/ECN quick scan of additional emission-reduction measures for the Urgenda climate case, including who commissioned it, whether indirect social costs were omitted, and what the government will do with it. The state secretary replied that PBL chose to publish the scan itself, that it gives no basis for conclusions on additional measures because it ignores public support and legal feasibility and gives only rough cost estimates, and that the government will await the IBO study and cite its cost methodology.
The cabinet will however take this PBL and ECN report into account in the ongoing studies.
Het kabinet zal dit rapport van het PBL en ECN wel betrekken bij de lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de vertraging bij het spoorproject Assen

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about a one-year delay to the Assen rail project caused by ProRail withdrawing a 2016 possession window due to a shortage of overhead-line technicians, and whether ProRail should have consulted first. The state secretary confirmed the delay, said ProRail informed the municipality promptly and is working jointly to limit consequences, and committed to seeking a completion before summer 2017 while declining to guarantee dates.
ProRail indicates that it will do everything it can to ensure the project is carried out before summer 2017.
ProRail heeft aangegeven dat het er alles aan zal doen om te zorgen dat het project wel vóór de zomer van 2017 wordt uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het nieuws dat de NS bezwaar maakt tegen Overijsselse lijnen

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary whether NS's formal objection to a Syntus regional rail concession could delay the 2017 start, why NS would object to lines it also bid for, and how high-frequency service on Enschede-Almelo would be achieved. The State Secretary answered that the province is responsible for the regional concession, that all parties should seek a swift solution, that the high-frequency programme does not cover Enschede-Almelo, and that she would intervene if no agreement is reached.
If no agreement is reached, they can turn to me. If necessary I will ensure that a decision is made.
Indien geen overeenstemming wordt bereikt, dan kunnen zij zich tot mij wenden. Als het nodig is zal ik ervoor zorgen dat er een besluit komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Veldman over het bericht dat de NS spitstreinen elders in het land schrapt ter bevordering van SAIL in Amsterdam

MPs De Boer and Veldman asked whether NS cutting off-peak local train services to free capacity for Sail Amsterdam was acceptable, how often this happens, its effect on punctuality targets and on reserve rolling stock and maintenance. The State Secretary answered that the local, limited cuts were a considered choice for passengers, that this had not happened before for large events, that cancellations under 48 hours count toward punctuality, and that reserve stock and deferred maintenance were used.
It has not previously happened that NS had to systematically cancel train services during large events.
Het is niet eerder voorgekomen dat NS planmatig treindiensten heeft moeten schrappen tijdens grote evenementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de opslag van vliegassen in zoutkoepels in Twente

An MP asked the ministers about a pilot to stabilise unstable salt caverns in Twente by filling them with residual materials such as fly ash, and about the safety risks, legal basis, and alternatives. The minister answered that the pilot is permitted under the national waste plan, that safety studies are required before permits are granted, and that the risks will be tested in the permit and storage plan process.
For granting the environmental permits and approving the storage plan, follow-up studies must be carried out on the specific caverns for which stabilisation is foreseen within the pilot project.

Voor het verlenen van de omgevingsvergunningen en het instemmen met het opslagplan dienen vervolgonderzoeken uitgevoerd te worden ten aanzien van de specifieke cavernes waarvoor stabilisatie binnen het proefproject is voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de miljoenenstrop die dreigt rond de verbouwing van station Utrecht

An MP asked the state secretary about a projected cost overrun of about EUR 29.5 million on the Utrecht station rebuild, why the ministry did not act earlier after ProRail's 2014 warning, and who would pay. The state secretary answered that the overrun is covered from the Infrastructure Fund, that an external investigation started in April 2015 and will report this autumn, and that the ministry's oversight was adequate.
I will inform the House of the outcomes of this investigation once it is completed.
Over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zal ik uw Kamer na afronding ervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht dat er een miljoenenstrop dreigt voor de verbouwing van station Utrecht

An MP asked about reports of a multi-million-euro cost overrun for the Utrecht station rebuild, its causes, the ministry's monitoring of ProRail and the reasons for late warning. The state secretary answered in detail, acknowledging a cost increase and delay driven by safety rules and design changes, pointing to an external review due in autumn 2015, but declining to judge ProRail's conduct before that review is complete.
On the outcomes of this review I will inform your House after its completion.
Over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zal ik uw Kamer na afronding ervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over externe veiligheid in Zuid-Nederland

An MP asked about safety at the Shell Moerdijk plant, the hazard-control record of the Moerdijk site, rail transport of dangerous goods in West-Brabant and the naphtha tank incident in Geleen. The state secretary promised to inform parliament before the hearing on the Shell investigations, gave inspection and incident data, and said the rail risks remain within legal limits while acknowledging local concern and committing to more transparent information.
I will inform you more fully about the investigations into the Shell Moerdijk incident before the External Safety committee hearing of 30 September 2015.
Ik zal u vóór het AO Externe Veiligheid van 30 september 2015 nader informeren over de onderzoeken naar het incident bij Shell Moerdijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over borden ter verduidelijking van de milieuzone

MPs Visser and Dijkstra asked whether Rijkswaterstaat would display milieuzone information on motorway matrix signs and who should bear the cost of signage for local low-emission zones. The minister answered that Rijkswaterstaat has no such plans, that informing drivers about local zones is a municipal task, and that the existing legal framework does not allow permanent signs on motorways, pointing instead to personalised navigation information.
Rijkswaterstaat will therefore inform the municipality of Utrecht that no fixed signs with milieuzone information may be placed along the motorways.
Rijkswaterstaat zal de gemeente Utrecht dan ook melden dat er geen vaste borden, met informatie over de milieuzone, langs de snelwegen geplaatst mogen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Knops inzake het bericht ‘Wintelre is overlast Eindhoven Airport zat’
