MPs Van Helvert and Knops (CDA) asked the State Secretary whether route optimisation 1B has increased noise and fine-particle nuisance in Wintelre, and about noise monitoring, route evaluation, and compensation for Eindhoven Airport. The government acknowledges increased complaints, reports no rise in fine particles, promises extra noise monitoring before 1 October 2015, an evaluation after one year, and a decision on a compensation fund in September.
I am aware that route optimisation 1B has led residents of Wintelre to report more nuisance from air traffic.
Ik ben er van op de hoogte dat de routeoptimalisatie 1B ertoe heeft geleid dat de inwoners van Wintelre aangeven meer overlast te ervaren van het vliegverkeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het spoorproject in Delft

An SP MP asks whether the government's refusal of interest-free deferral of 32 million euro and waiver of 5 million euro in extra costs on the Delft rail tunnel pushes the municipality toward an article 12 financial-emergency status, and asks about the government's role in the housing development and response to the 'Grond, geld en gemeenten' report. The Staatssecretaris replies that the refusal is not IenM's to assess, that the state has already contributed 552 million euro, that the municipality's 5 million euro obligation stands, and that the grondbeleid recommendations will be addressed in a forthcoming policy letter and BBV revision.
The municipality's desired interest-free deferral of payment and partial waiver of contributions owed to the rail tunnel project are not possible.
Het door de gemeente gewenste renteloze uitstel van betaling en gedeeltelijke kwijtschelding van door de gemeente verschuldigde bijdragen aan het spoortunnelproject zijn niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de langeafstandsbus en de verdere mogelijkheden in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about long-distance bus services, EU Regulation 1073/2009, and whether the Dutch market should be opened further, citing Germany and France. The state secretary answered that cross-border bus services are permitted, that domestic long-distance buses fall under provincial concessions unless exempted, and that no further liberalisation study was committed to.
However, deploying operators requires obtaining a concession or an exemption from it, or operating transport without a timetable, whether or not as part of an international bus service.

Wel vergt het inzet van de ondernemers om een concessie of een ontheffing hiervan te verkrijgen, dan wel vervoer zonder dienstregeling te exploiteren al dan niet als onderdeel van een internationale buslijndienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Merkies over de mogelijke verkoop van QBuzz door de Nederlandse Spoorwegen

MPs Smaling and Merkies asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about the NS plan to sell bus company Qbuzz, its reasons, effects on staff and the HTM joint venture, and whether a Dutch bus firm should go to a foreign state company. Minister Dijsselbloem replied that NS's strategic reorientation must finish first, so no comment on the sale is possible yet, while information is exchanged and the government will send an analysis this autumn.
I consider it important that this reorientation is first completed before decisions are taken.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat deze heroriëntatie eerst wordt afgerond alvorens er besluiten worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Hoogland over het bericht ‘Haven gaat zelf treinlijn opzetten’

Two MPs asked whether the Rotterdam port authority's plan to invest in rail lines raises questions about the government's role and public control over the tracks. The minister answered that the port invests in rail services through the 'rail incubator' programme rather than in infrastructure, that the ministry has no role in strategic port choices but supports initiatives within the Havenvisie 2030, and that the port operates as an independent company with public control limited to safety rules.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment has no role in strategic choices of the Port of Rotterdam Authority.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu heeft geen rol bij strategische keuzes van het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de erkenning van MTCS als een duurzaam certificeringssysteem voor hout in het Nederlands beleid voor duurzaam inkopen en de reactie hierop van inheemse volken

An MP asked the state secretaries whether the government's account of consultations with Malaysian indigenous peoples on the MTCS timber certification scheme is accurate, given objections from JOAS, and questioned the independence of the planned TPAC check. The government largely defended its findings, declined to verify its report with JOAS, said it cannot explain the discrepancies, and stated that the TPAC check will be limited to information from the last visit while its scope is still being considered.
For the TPAC check, independence, due care and speed must be ensured, also in light of the relevant European framework.
Voor de check door TPAC moeten de onafhankelijkheid, zorgvuldigheid en snelheid geborgd zijn, mede in het licht van het Europese kader terzake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de berichtgeving inzake de certificering van Maleisisch hout

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries about media reports questioning whether Malaysian timber certification (MTCS) meets Dutch procurement standards, the reliability of NGO motives, and an EU complaint against FSC-only municipal policies. The government replied that MTCS improvements are visible, that TPAC will be asked for a final check, and that the complaint concerns exclusion of other certification schemes rather than FSC purchasing itself.
To establish whether the previously identified points at MTCS have been resolved, the Timber Procurement Assessment Committee (TPAC) is being asked to carry out a final check.
Om vast te kunnen stellen of de eerder geïdentificeerde punten bij MTCS zijn opgelost wordt de Toetsingcommissie Inkoop Hout (TPAC) gevraagd een laatste check te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de drinkwaterinname uit de Maas is stopgezet

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that chemical substances from the Chemelot industrial site entered the Maas in July 2015, halting drinking water intake, and about overlapping responsibilities between national, provincial and water board authorities. The minister answered that responsibilities are clearly allocated, that cooperation led to an adequate approach, that a new incident approach was agreed with drinking water companies, and that no increase in incidents at Chemelot was found.
Together with the drinking water companies I have been working on drawing up an approach to respond more quickly to such incidents involving new substances.
Samen met de drinkwaterbedrijven ben ik bezig geweest een aanpak op te stellen waarmee sneller op dergelijke incidenten rond nieuwe stoffen kan worden ingespeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat sporters en scholieren zijn blootgesteld aan gifgrond

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that athletes and pupils were exposed to contaminated soil at a former dump in Ouderkerk, and why earlier 2008 reports and the GGD advice did not prevent use of the site. The State Secretary answered that the province and municipality are the competent authorities, that no risks existed for the passive use at the time, that the municipality has commissioned additional research and will publish its results, and that the responsibility allocation is set in law.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling inzake het bericht dat er asbest is vrijgekomen bij brand in een schoolgebouw

An SP MP asked the state secretary about asbestos released by a school fire in Rijswijk, the GGD's reassurance, and whether mandatory asbestos inventories and faster asbestos removal are needed. The state secretary answered that air measurements found no asbestos fibres, that the municipality handled the clean-up, that asbestos inventories are already required before renovation or demolition, and that risk-based policy is maintained without a mandatory school inventory.
An inventory obligation already applies when renovation or demolition is planned.
Er geldt reeds een inventarisatieplicht bij het voornemen tot verbouwen of sloop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Oosenbrug over het 06-bereik in de spoortunnel Delft

MPs Hoogland and Oosenbrug asked why no mobile coverage is planned in the new Delft rail tunnel, whether providers and ProRail have made concrete agreements, and whether the provider-initiated permit system is optimal. The Secretary of State confirms there is no coverage for now, says providers declined to invest on cost grounds, that ProRail offered to share costs and proactively approached providers, and that providers remain responsible for mobile infrastructure, which he does not consider a government responsibility.
In principle the providers remain responsible for the construction and investment in mobile infrastructure.
Ten principale blijven de providers verantwoordelijk voor de aanleg en investering in mobiele infrastructuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over onterecht afgegeven medische certificaten aan piloten

Members of parliament asked the state secretary how the aviation medical centre EAMC could issue 99 doubtful medical certificates to pilots, whether other certification bodies are affected, and why inspections of the remaining bodies would take the rest of 2015. The state secretary answered that the ILT has annulled 99 certificates, that criminal proceedings are ongoing, that extra inspections of all other bodies have been started and finished in November, and that no legislative change is currently needed.
On this basis, the ILT annulled 99 certificates and suspended 1 certificate.
Op basis hiervan heeft de ILT 99 certificaten nietig verklaard en 1 certificaat geschorst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over een smogplan voor hete zomers

An MP asked the state secretary whether a smog plan for hot summers should be drawn up to warn people with respiratory conditions in time, and how it compares with neighbouring countries' alarms. The state secretary answered that RIVM advised improving the smog warning (adding fine particulate matter, aligning with Belgium) and that the revised information service would be presented in September 2015.
In September 2015 the renewed information provision on air quality will be presented.
In september 2015 zal de vernieuwde informatievoorziening over de luchtkwaliteit worden gepresenteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Helvert over de onduidelijkheid over toeslagen op vliegtickets

MP Van Helvert (CDA) asked the State Secretary about unclear surcharges on airline tickets, including whether charges are controlled and how they are spent. The State Secretary answered that airlines set their own fares, that only Dutch government levies and the PRM levy are audited, and that existing EU transparency rules and ACM oversight are sufficient, declining to pursue new EU agreements or ACM advice.
It is not for the Netherlands to judge the desirability of another country's national levies.
Het is niet aan Nederland om een oordeel te geven over de wenselijkheid van de nationale heffingen van een ander land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over een nieuw benoemde executive vice president bij de holding Air France KLM

An MP asked whether the appointment of a new executive vice president at the Air France KLM holding in Paris conflicts with the minister's March 2015 assurance that KLM activities would not be further centralised there, and whether the minister would act against this 'salami tactics'. The minister replied that the appointment was agreed before March 2015, that no further centralisation is planned, that no action is needed, and that the agreements were documented in a signed conversation report placed before the House.
The agreements from the meeting with Mr De Juniac are recorded in a conversation report signed by the presidents-directors of Air France KLM and KLM and by myself.
De afspraken uit het overleg met de heer De Juniac zijn vastgelegd in een gespreksverslag dat is ondertekend door de president-directeuren van Air France KLM en KLM en door mijzelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het verschuiven van langeafstandsvluchten van Air France KLM van Schiphol naar Parijs Charles de Gaulle

An MP asked the state secretary whether Air France KLM is shifting long-haul flights from Schiphol to Paris Charles de Gaulle and how the balance between the two hubs is secured under state guarantees. The government answered that the data show Schiphol's network growing faster, that intercontinental flights from both hubs rose in 2014-2015, that future plans are confidential, and that the state could refer disputes to the State Assurances Committee, which has never been needed.
Such information is commercially confidential, and moreover the flight offering will be continually adjusted to concrete market developments and to the company Air France KLM.
Dergelijke informatie heeft een bedrijfsvertrouwelijk karakter en bovendien zal het vluchtaanbod voortdurend worden aangepast aan concrete ontwikkelingen in de markt en de onderneming Air France KLM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi inzake het vrijgekomen asbest bij een grote brand in Harlingen

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about asbestos released in a large fire in a Harlingen warehouse, including health risks, whether residents were warned via NL-Alert, and fire prevention. The secretary said the fire was probably arson, a certified firm found no asbestos spread by smoke, residents were advised to close windows, and existing building rules are considered sufficient, with no new measures promised.
Er is geen landelijk overzicht beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Van Helvert over onjuiste informatie over treinen met gevaarlijke stoffen

MPs Hoogland and Van Helvert asked the Infrastructure and Environment state secretary about inaccurate information on trains carrying dangerous goods, including inspection powers, ProRail's role, unregistered cargo and ghost/orphan wagons. The state secretary answered that the ILT's powers and resources are adequate, that ProRail is not a supervisor, that a legal duty to register non-dangerous goods is not currently warranted, and that improvement will be pursued with the sector.
The powers and enforcement options the ILT has at its disposal I consider sufficient, as are the resources available for them.
De bevoegdheden en handhavingmogelijkheden die de ILT voorhanden heeft, acht ik voldoende, evenals de daarvoor beschikbare middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Bashir over de gebrekkige informatie bij het vervoeren van gevaarlijke stoffen over het spoor

MPs Smaling and Bashir asked the state secretary about inadequate information on hazardous-substance rail transport, including the ILT's findings, a GPS track-and-trace proposal, emergency capacity on the Brabant route and the VeZA curve. The state secretary said the IGS information system has improved information, the ILT enforces registration duties, a 2.0 IGS and possibly GPS tracking are under study, no extra emergency capacity is currently needed, and the VeZA curve will not be reconsidered.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het nieuwsblad van de Metaal Recycling Federatie (MRF)

An MP asks the state secretary whether the WEEELABEX certification requirements for e-waste treatment, including a 5,000 kg batch test, are proportionate, whether certified recyclers may supervise uncertified partners, and whether enforcement can be postponed. The state secretary confirms the batch test is generally reasonable, rejects supervised subcontracting by uncertified firms, and says enforcement stays under the ILT's independent intervention framework without committing to a postponement.
No, processing or treating WEEE by a company not certified under WEEELABEX is not permitted.
Nee, het be- en verwerken van WEEE door een niet-WEEELABEX gecertificeerde onderneming is niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir inzake Ryanair

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether Ryanair's slot request at Schiphol fits the policy of moving leisure traffic to regional airports like Eindhoven and Lelystad, and what the effects are on other carriers and on Dutch workers' rights at Ryanair. The state secretary answered that the independent slot coordinator allocates slots under EU rules, that Lelystad is meant to take leisure traffic from Schiphol, and that labour enforcement for Ryanair lies primarily with the Irish supervisor.
Ryanair is already an important carrier at the regional airport of Eindhoven.
Ryanair is al een belangrijke maatschappij op de regionale luchthaven Eindhoven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de uitbetaalde bonus van de voormalig topman van de NS en de uitspraken van de minister van Financien over deze zaak

CDA MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked the Finance Minister how NS top executive Huges's bonus was paid out before the supervisory board and shareholder had approved it, and about the minister's earlier statements on the matter. The minister confirmed the earlier statements, said the board and shareholder had not authorised the payment, and explained the timeline of the bonus and the executive's departure.
The supervisory board has informed me that the supervisory board did not authorise the payment.
De raad van commissarissen heeft mij gemeld dat de raad van commissarissen de uitbetaling niet heeft geautoriseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leenders over mogelijke vakantievluchten vanaf vliegveld Seppe

An MP asked the state secretary whether commercial flights could move from Eindhoven Airport to Breda International Airport and whether Breda should become a national-interest or civil airport. The government answered that Breda is a regional airport under provincial competence, lacks the infrastructure for large commercial traffic, and that any change to its airport decree would be a provincial matter with no Rijk role.
Breda International Airport (Seppe) is an airport of regional significance, for which the province of North Brabant is the competent authority.
De luchthaven Breda International Airport (Seppe) is een luchthaven van regionale betekenis, waarvoor de provincie Noord-Brabant bevoegd gezag is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Veldhoven over de controle op illegaal hout

MPs Smaling and Van Veldhoven asked the State Secretary about NVWA enforcement against illegal timber under the EU Timber Regulation, including staffing, inspection numbers, the use of warnings rather than fines, and due diligence. The State Secretary answered that 3 FTE are deployed, 101 inspections and 29 written warnings have been issued, that enforcement is warning-first and has been effective, and that the NVWA follows EU-coordinated practice on due diligence and document verification.
The NVWA has 3 FTE available for combating illegal timber and this appears sufficient given the required deployment.
De NVWA heeft 3 fte beschikbaar voor het bestrijden van illegaal hout en dit blijkt gezien de benodigde inzet voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Excuses om weigeren vrouw met nikab in bus’

An MP asked whether a bus driver who refused a woman wearing a niqab was right, whether staff may refuse face-covering clothing before a ban exists, and whether the government will defend such staff. The government answered that a ban on face-covering clothing in education, care, government buildings and public transport is being prepared, that no legal ban exists yet, and that the driver breached company rules and the company apologised.
No, at this moment there is no legal ban on face-covering clothing, and under the carrier's company rules the niqab wearer should have been treated the same as all other passengers.

Nee, op dit moment is er geen wettelijk verbod op gezichtsbedekkende kleding en volgens de bedrijfsregels van de vervoerder had de niqaab draagster op dezelfde manier behandeld moeten worden als alle andere reizigers.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Houwers over de inzameling van verpakkingsmaterialen

An MP asked the state secretary whether he would discuss with the involved organisations the possibility of letting private individuals collect packaging materials. The state secretary replied that he first wants to await the plan of action due October 2015, that municipalities hold the lead and may decide whether to involve private persons, and that the plan will be shared with parliament.
The plan of action will be ready by October 2015 and will be shared with your House.
Het plan van aanpak is voor oktober 2015 gereed en zal met uw Kamer gedeeld worden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het verdwijnen van de ov-jaarkaart en de gevolgen hiervan voor grote gezinnen met kinderen die de vooropleiding volgen van ballet- en dansopleidingen en conservatoria

MP Dik-Faber asks whether the replacement of the OV Jaarkaart by OV Vrij raises costs sharply for large families with children in dance and music pre-training, and whether the government will act. The State Secretary answers that most families benefit, that NS will contact the roughly 405 multi-sibling-pass holders to advise them, that the concession was not breached, and that no evidence shows families abandoning training for cost reasons.
Reasonably, NS as an independent company cannot be expected to fully grant all wishes.
Redelijkerwijs kan niet van NS als zelfstandig bedrijf verwacht worden dat alle wensen onverkort gehonoreerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Cegerek over dubieuze transacties van investeringsfonds Waterland

MPs Nijboer and Cegerek asked whether private equity fund Waterland extracted more cash from Attero than it invested, whether this weakened the firm's landfill aftercare provisions and ability to pay future remediation costs, and what it means for staff. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that excess distributions are not per se improper, pointed to existing private equity asset-stripping rules and corporate law, said aftercare reserves and financial guarantees remain legally required, and said Waterland describes Attero as financially healthy while the staff impact cannot be assessed.
Dutch company law provides that the profit of a private or public limited company belongs to the shareholders, and sets limits on distributability.
Het Nederlandse vennootschapsrecht bepaalt dat de winst van een besloten of naamloze vennootschap toekomt aan de aandeelhouders, en stelt grenzen aan uitkeerbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het Convenant Bodem en Ondergrond

An MP asked the state secretary about soil contamination remaining after the priority-site cleanup under the soil covenant, including whether groundwater and drinking water sources are adequately protected and whether the drinking water sector should be involved. The state secretary answered that remaining sites are inventoried through area dossiers and cleanup is the responsibility of competent authorities, while largely referring to existing instruments and future Omgevingswet arrangements without committing to new concrete steps.
The figure of 200,000 is a rough estimate of locations where substance concentrations may exceed the background value.
Het aantal van 200.000 is een grove inschatting van locaties waar de concentratie van stoffen boven de achtergrondwaarde kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Tellegen en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “Verkeershufters worden minder vaak gepakt”

Three VVD MPs asked whether speed trajectory controls are justified for environmental goals (CO2, fine dust, noise) and how their boetes and effects are documented, given reports that traffic offenders are caught less often. The minister answered that the purpose of trajectory controls is compliance with the posted speed limit, that environmental and safety considerations shape the limits themselves, and gave a fine table for 2010–2014 and noise-cost figures.
The purpose of trajectory controls is compliance with the applicable speed limit.
Het doel van trajectcontroles is naleving van de geldende snelheidslimiet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over het bericht ‘Angstcultuur bij vervoersbedrijf Hermes’

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked about reports of a fear-based culture at bus operator Hermes, the government's responsibilities, and whether concession-holders can be selected on social criteria. The minister replied that the report is not yet published, that personnel policy is the operator's responsibility, that the province and Inspectie SZW can act if concession terms or labour law are breached, and that social aspects may be included in tenders within legal limits.
At this moment the report has not yet been published, so it is not yet known what the facts are regarding the corporate culture of bus operator Hermes.
Op dit moment is het rapport nog niet gepubliceerd en is het dus nog niet bekend wat de feiten zijn rondom de bedrijfscultuur van het vervoersbedrijf Hermes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling inzake de asbestbrand in Wateringen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether, given residents' lasting worry about the asbestos fire clean-up in Wateringen and differing insurance cover, he would use his influence on the province and municipality to ensure a thorough collective clean-up before summer. The State Secretary replied that the province has been told in writing that trust must be restored, and that the province has started an inter-governmental supervision inquiry that is still at the information-gathering stage and will be concluded as quickly as possible, with possible follow-up steps.
The province will conclude the inquiry as quickly as possible and then take any necessary follow-up steps.
De provincie zal het onderzoek zo snel mogelijk afronden en dan eventueel nodige vervolgstappen ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over sponsoring van de klimaattop Parijs door fossiele bedrijven

An SP MP asked the ministers whether sponsorship of the Paris climate summit by fossil fuel firms (EDF, Engie, Air France) undermines its credibility and whether they would demand a verifiable sustainability step from these companies. The state secretary answered that involving business strengthens the summit, that sponsorship fits UNFCCC guidelines, and that companies must contribute to the EU 40% CO2 reduction target by 2030.
The cabinet does not believe that the financial contribution of these companies to the Paris climate summit undermines its credibility.
Het kabinet vindt niet dat het leveren van een financiële bijdrage van genoemde bedrijven aan de klimaattop in Parijs de geloofwaardigheid ondergraaft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over het onderzoek naar het reilen en zeilen van de NS

VVD MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries asked whether law firm De Brauw, which investigated irregularities in the NS Limburg tender while also advising NS on challenging the ACM's findings, has a conflict of interest, and whether an independent body should take over the investigation. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that he sees no reason to doubt De Brauw's integrity, but agreed with the supervisory board that a second opinion on the Limburg investigation will be commissioned and that another firm will investigate the other tenders NS or its subsidiaries bid for.

To avoid any appearance of partiality and to rule out any doubt about the soundness of the investigations, I have agreed with the NS supervisory board that a researcher will be asked to give a second opinion

Om elke schijn van partijdigheid te vermijden en iedere twijfel over de gedegenheid van de onderzoeken uit te sluiten, heb ik met de raad van commissarissen van de NS afgesproken dat een onderzoeker wordt gevraagd een second opinion te geven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Visser en De Boer over het bericht «Ruim miljoen voor schone bussen»

Three VVD MPs asked why the hydrogen bus pilot in Amsterdam would not be repeated, what it contributed, how zero-emission buses fit climate policy, whether returning the buses after three years was a sound use of public money, and whether the project goals were SMART. The Secretary of State answered that the pilot served as an alpha test that led a bus manufacturer to invest in hydrogen buses, that the new subsidy projects continue in five regions, and that selection criteria and reporting obligations apply.
Na afloop wordt de regeling geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de berichtgeving over gasexplosies in Noord-Siberië die grote kraters veroorzaken en leiden tot grote methaanemissies

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports of gas explosions creating craters and methane emissions in Siberian permafrost, whether they could trigger feedback loops, and whether the issue could be raised at the Paris climate conference. The government answered that the IPCC AR5 does not discuss crater formation, estimated permafrost emissions as a feedback to be assessed in the next IPCC report, and said the issue would be weighed in UNFCCC talks if new findings emerge.
These and future publications on permafrost emissions will be assessed in the next (sixth) IPCC report.
Deze en toekomstige publicaties op het gebied van permafrostemissies zullen in het volgende (zesde) IPCC rapport worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over een rapport van PwC over ProRail

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a confidential PwC report, commissioned by ProRail's supervisory board, on possible procurement violations in maintenance contracts, and about whistleblower reports and board meetings. The State Secretary answered that the ministry knew of the commission but not the content until 12 June, sent a summary and a separate letter, and described the whistleblower misconduct and the board's compliance meetings.
The summary of the report dated 12 June was submitted to me on that date. That is why I could not inform your House about it earlier.
De samenvatting van het rapport met datum 12 juni jl. is op die datum mij aangeboden. Daarom kon ik uw Kamer hierover niet eerder informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het voorgenomen verbod op gratis plastic tassen

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about the planned ban on free plastic carrier bags, questioning whether it goes beyond EU rules, its effectiveness, enforcement, and effects on consumers and the environment. The state secretary answered that the EU directive allows measures for all bags regardless of thickness, that enforcement will be checked by the ILT, and that a legal ban is needed for a level playing field, while many questions on effects and figures were answered only with estimates or deferred.
The ban that takes effect in the Netherlands on 1 January 2016 will cover all types of plastic carrier bags, regardless of wall thickness.
Het verbod dat per 1 januari 2016 in Nederland in werking treedt, zal alle soorten plastic draagtassen betreffen, ongeacht de wanddikte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de onduidelijkheid van cijfers bij inzameling en verwerking van PET-flessen en Plastic Heroes

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Environment about conflicting figures on PET bottle collection, sorting, recyclate content and processing losses under the Plastic Heroes and deposit systems, and about whether bottlers meet the 25% recyclate norm. The State Secretary answered most questions by saying the data is unavailable, that the ILT only audited steps up to the recycler's weighbridge, or that the market is international, while confirming volumes, the 90/10 quality standard, and that the 2014 recyclate share was above the norm.
No research has been conducted into this stream. For that reason this information is not available.
Naar deze stroom is geen onderzoek gedaan. Om die reden is deze informatie niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het afschaffen van statiegeld en het opnieuw niet nakomen van gemaakte afspraken over het gebruik van PVC in verpakkingsmateriaal door de supermarktketens

An MP asked whether supermarket chains again failed to meet agreed conditions for abolishing deposit (statiegeld) and PVC packaging phase-out, and how that affects abolition. The state secretary replied that the ILT found the PVC performance guarantee was not met, the report is sent to parliament, and the research cited by Radar was commissioned by industry, with the decision based on the ILT findings.
The ILT's review showed that the performance guarantee for PVC was not met.
Uit de toetsing door de ILT bleek dat aan de prestatiegarantie voor PVC niet voldaan is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over nieuwe onderzoeken over de effectiviteit van statiegeld en het niet nakomen van afspraken uit de Raamovereenkomst verpakkingen

An MP asks the State Secretary about recent studies on the effectiveness of deposit schemes, supermarkets' failure to stop selling PVC packaging, the inspectorate's record on recycling norms, and the scope of the environmental analysis of abolishing deposits. The State Secretary answers that the inspectorate found recycling-norm breaches in some years, that the chain-closing approach and environmental analysis are underway or delivered, and declines to provide an uncertainty margin for reported recycling rates.
The ILT does not have information on the basis of which the uncertainty margin can be stated.
De ILT beschikt niet over informatie op basis waarvan de onzekerheidsmarge aangegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de voortgang van realisatie van open data in het openbaar vervoer

An MP asks the government about the slow progress in opening public transport data, including ridership figures, performance data, OV-chipkaart data and the NDOV rollout. The state secretary responds that open-data licences are being prepared, that NS withholds route-level data as confidential until all operators face the same obligation, and that OV-chipkaart data sharing awaits a CBP privacy opinion.
Figures on underlying sub-routes are provided by NS confidentially on request, to the extent a societal purpose is served.
Cijfers over onderliggende deeltrajecten verstrekt NS op verzoek vertrouwelijk voor zover hier een maatschappelijk doel mee gediend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over ZZP-piloten

An MP asked the state secretary how it can be concluded that freelance (ZZP) pilot contracts are not widely used by Dutch airlines when no exact data exist, and whether EASA should be asked to act on the safety and working-condition concerns. The state secretary said the conclusion rests on informal contacts with airlines and the pilots' association, that obtaining data would require weighing the burden on firms, that EASA has examined the risks and found no safety problem with ongoing monitoring, and that the ministry will discuss pilots' labour position with the social affairs ministry.
I do not have this data.
Over deze gegevens beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman over het bericht dat drugsafval het riool overspoelt

Two SP MPs asked the Justice and Environment ministers about drug waste dumped into sewers and on land, including incident counts, lab takedowns, enforcement capacity, prevention, BOA safety and who pays the cleanup costs. The government answered that no national dumping figures are kept, cited 24 lab takedowns and doubled LFO capacity, said the polluter should bear costs, and pointed to a one-million-euro amendment-funded contribution and a Brabant cleanup protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Weesboten steeds groter probleem’

MPs Hachchi and Van Veldhoven asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the growing problem of abandoned 'ghost boats', including a report projecting up to 35,000 by 2030, and whether central government, a national fund, or a national registration system should act. The State Secretary answered that the central government has no responsibility for abandoned boats on non-state land or water, that responsibility lies with producers, importers, branch organisations and the authorities managing the waterways, and that a new national registration system would add administrative burden without clear effectiveness.
The central government has no responsibility for abandoned ghost ships on or in land or waters that do not belong to the central government.
Het Rijk heeft geen verantwoordelijkheid voor achtergelaten spookschepen op of in gronden of wateren die niet van het Rijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over uitbreiding gemeentelijke milieuzones waaronder Amsterdam, Utrecht en Rotterdam en over het bericht dat Utrechtse lucht beter is

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary whether expanding municipal environmental zones (Amsterdam, Utrecht, Rotterdam) is justified given Utrecht's improved air quality, cost-effectiveness, and the Rijk's role in subsidies and a vehicle replacement scheme. The State Secretary answered that municipalities decide on and must demonstrate the cost-effectiveness of zones, the Rijk funds a subsidy scheme for van replacement in neighbouring municipalities, and an action plan is pending.
It is up to the municipalities to assess and demonstrate whether introducing an environmental zone for certain vehicle categories is a (cost-)effective measure.
Het is aan de gemeenten om in te schatten en aan te tonen of het invoeren van een milieuzone voor bepaalde categorieën voertuigen een (kosten)effectieve maatregel is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over de berichten ‘Met twintig camera's loeren op vieze auto's’, ‘Al bijna tweeduizend vieze auto's verwerkt tot schroot’ en ‘Cameratoezicht voor milieuzone Arnhem

MPs Visser and Dijkstra asked about camera enforcement of low-emission zones in Arnhem and Utrecht, the cost of cameras, privacy of plate data, and the higher fine. The state secretary answered that the zones and their justification are municipal responsibilities, that the fine follows standard Public Prosecution tariffs with a heavier sanction for the zone, and that a Utrecht NO2 exceedance is expected to be resolved by new calculations.
It is up to the municipalities to assess and demonstrate whether introducing an environmental zone is a (cost-)effective measure.
Het is aan de gemeenten om in te schatten en aan te tonen of het invoeren van een milieuzone een (kosten)effectieve maatregel is.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Schouw over een rapport van het Duitse Milieu Agentschap (UBA) inzake de belasting op het milieu door conventionele landbouw

An MP asked the government about a German Federal Environment Agency report on environmental pressures from conventional agriculture and whether its findings apply to the Netherlands. The state secretaries answered that the Dutch situation shares nutrient surplus and ammonia issues covered by existing rules, declined further PBL research as unnecessary, and said the report's knowledge would feed into existing policy tracks.
I am of the opinion that additional research by the PBL is not necessary.
Ik ben van mening dat extra onderzoek door het PBL niet nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over het dreigende gat in de begroting door de snel stijgende verkoop van o.a. de Volvo XC90

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked the State Secretary of Finance about the fiscal risk from rising sales of plug-in hybrids such as the Volvo XC90 T8, the low company-car tax base, the Algemene Rekenkamer's recommendations on tax incentives for efficient cars, and whether the bijtelling increase should be accelerated. The State Secretary answered most questions with figures on lost tax revenue and referred the test-method and actual-consumption questions to other sources, but declined to accelerate the measure, citing lack of support and practical objections, and deferred the rest to the Autobrief 2.0.
In autumn 2014 I informed the House of the need to include additional measures for 2016 in the car taxes.
Ik heb in het najaar van 2014 de Kamer geïnformeerd over de noodzaak om aanvullende maatregelen voor het jaar 2016 voor de autobelastingen op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer over het bericht “Stad is klaar met tunnelmalaise”

MPs Visser and De Boer asked about reports of frequent tunnel closures at the Coentunnel and Schipholtunnel caused by overheight trucks, fire alarms and power failures, and their economic cost. The minister confirms 25 to 30 weekly overheight stoppages at the Coentunnel, lists six Schiphol tunnel disruptions in Q1 2015, says no damage cost estimate exists, and promises intensified monitoring and further study.
For this reason I will intensify the monitoring of the closures at the Coentunnel.
Om deze reden zal ik de monitoring van de stremmingen bij de Coentunnel intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht over het bericht “Zorgen om zzp-piloten”

Parliamentary member Van Helvert asks whether the government considers it desirable that pilots in pay-to-fly and self-employed (zzp) arrangements carry responsibility in aircraft, and whether national measures should be taken. The state secretary replies that licensing ensures competence, EASA's analysis finds no proven urgent safety problem, Dutch use of such contracts is not known to be widespread, and no national intervention is currently deemed necessary, though EASA's management board will be pressed to act.
There is no exact data available on how many of these work at Dutch airlines.
Er zijn geen exacte gegevens beschikbaar hoeveel hiervan bij Nederlandse maatschappijen werkzaam zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Mei Li Vos, Visser en Aukje de Vries over de situatie bij Air France-KLM

MPs from the PvdA and VVD asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about the French state's increase of its stake in Air France-KLM, its double voting rights, possible break-up or sale of KLM, governance changes and Qatar landing rights. The minister replied that the French stake increase is not a fundamental shift, no agreement exists on joint share purchases, no break-up is on the agenda, and the reports of a 'plan B' sale are unsubstantiated speculation.
I have no indication whatsoever that such a plan B is on the agenda.
Ik heb geen enkele indicatie dat een dergelijk plan B aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Visser en Leenders over de berichtgeving inzake Qatar Airways

MPs Visser and Leenders asked the Staatssecretaris whether he knew of the Qatar Airways CEO's threat to block Dutch firms' contracts in Qatar over landing rights, whether the CEO contacted him, what he would do, and whether he shares EVO's concern that the landing-rights freeze harms the Netherlands as a distribution country. The Staatssecretaris answered that he was not approached, that Dutch policy does not specifically target Gulf carriers, that Qatar was informed, and that talks with EVO and a Seabury study on air cargo are ongoing, without committing to new legal changes.
I have not been approached by Mr Al Baker.
Ik ben niet benaderd door de heer Al Baker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht “Franse staat vergroot zeggenschap bij Air France-KLM”

An MP from the CDA asked whether the Dutch state should increase its stake in Air France-KLM after France raised its holding, and whether commitments by Air France-KLM's chief on KLM jobs and guarantees should be laid down in a new memorandum of understanding, along with questions on airport security cost models and Gulf carriers at Schiphol. The government replied that the French stake increase is not fundamental, that the Netherlands will not take a larger stake, that the 2010 MoU guarantees are already fixed while other commitments are being examined for formal recording, and that Gulf carriers are not being banned from Schiphol.
KLM and Air France KLM are currently considering whether and how these agreements can be recorded.
KLM en Air France KLM bezien thans of en hoe deze afspraken zijn vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat de gemeente Rotterdam een milieuzone gaat instellen

Madlener (PVV) asks the state secretary whether he agrees that Rotterdam's environmental zone harms entrepreneurship and accessibility, and asks for costs, benefits, the number of affected vans, and a ban on municipal environmental zones. The state secretary answers that municipalities must weigh and justify such measures themselves, sees no reason to ban them, and gives an estimate of about 1,300 non-compliant delivery vans.
It is up to the municipalities to estimate and demonstrate whether introducing an environmental zone for certain vehicle categories is a (cost-)effective measure.
Het is aan de gemeenten om in te schatten en aan te tonen of het invoeren van een milieuzone voor bepaalde categorieën voertuigen een (kosten)effectieve maatregel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het miljoenenverlies bij het Afval Energie Bedrijf in Amsterdam

An SP MP asked the state secretary about EUR 89 million in losses at Afval Energie Bedrijf Amsterdam, whether these were foreseeable before its privatisation, and about the balance between waste supply, incineration capacity, imports and energy use. The state secretary largely answered on waste-market policy, said the municipality's reasons and the loss question fall outside his remit, and affirmed that continued import of foreign waste is acceptable.
It is further not for me to explain the reasons that played a role at the municipal government, nor to pass judgment on whether the losses could have been prevented.

Het is verder niet aan mij om een toelichting te geven op de redenen die bij het gemeentebestuur speelden, noch om een oordeel uit te spreken over de vraag of de verliezen voorkomen hadden kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Visser over het bericht “Ruim miljoen voor schone bussen”

MPs Dijkstra and Visser (VVD) asked the State Secretary about subsidies of 4.25 million euro for hydrogen and hybrid buses, including a 1.3 million euro top-up for Rotterdam, and whether the subsidies are effective and technology-neutral. The government answered that the grants aim to gain practical experience with zero-emission buses for future procurement rather than to solve air quality problems directly, that the GVB pilot's buses have been returned, and that it has no plans to repeat the scheme while maintaining the zero-emission technology direction.

The aim of the contributions is to support decentralised governments responsible for public bus transport that are considering becoming launch customers for hydrogen buses in gaining practical experience in the short term.

Het doel van de bijdragen is om decentrale overheden die verantwoordelijk zijn voor het openbaar busvervoer en die overwegen launching customer te worden van waterstofbussen te ondersteunen bij het op korte termijn opdoen van praktijkervaring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de uitspraak van de rechter over de overweg Laantje van Alverna

An MP asked the State Secretary about a court ruling that the Laantje van Alverna level crossing has become public through prescription, and whether ProRail will reopen it, appeal, and inventory similar crossings. The State Secretary answered that Heemstede has issued an enforcement decision requiring reopening by 1 July 2015, that the ministry has no role in that request, that ProRail is appealing, and that a plan on unsecured recreational crossings will be sent to the House by 17 June.
Given the non-final nature of the court ruling, I am not yet drawing conclusions from it.
Gelet op het niet-onherroepelijk karakter van de rechterlijke uitspraak trek ik hier nog geen conclusies uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de privacy-schendingen door trajectcontroles

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether average-speed (trajectory) camera controls violate privacy, since all passing vehicles are recorded, and how long the data is kept. The minister answered that data of non-offenders is deleted automatically within 72 hours, that the system fits existing law, and that he has no plans to stop using trajectory controls, citing court rulings.
All data is automatically deleted from the trajectory control system after a maximum of 72 hours.
Alle gegevens worden na maximaal 72 uur automatisch in het trajectcontrolesysteem gewist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de ernstige last die mensen ondervinden van verkeerslawaai

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that traffic noise causes serious health harm and why decades of policy have not reduced it. The State Secretary answered that the health figures came from a CROW web compilation rather than a new study, that existing measures have reduced noise exposure relative to growth, and that noise production ceilings and a remediation scheme will be introduced through the Environment Act.
I provide a framework and instruments within which this is possible or can be enforced where necessary.
Ik voorzie in een raamwerk en instrumentarium waarbinnen dat mogelijk is of dat zo nodig kan worden afgedwongen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling inzake de impasse bij de asbestcalamiteit in Wateringen

An SP MP asks the State Secretary to respond to residents' claims that Wateringen remains contaminated with visible asbestos despite the municipality declaring the neighbourhood asbestos-free, and to treat the case as an example of municipal supervision. The State Secretary answers that an independent lab found no loose asbestos, that residents should contact the municipality, and that supervision of municipalities lies with the provinces, so he will not assess the municipality's conduct.
No, interadministrative supervision of municipalities is vested in the provinces.
Nee, het interbestuurlijk toezicht op gemeenten is neergelegd bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Hoogland over het bericht ‘Geen boete abonnementhouder zwartrijden’

MPs De Boer and Hoogland asked the state secretary about reports that passengers with subscriptions are fined for forgetting to check in when their travel right is already paid for, and about the Rover/Consumentenbond research and the number of disputes. The state secretary defended the mandatory check-in for uniformity and traveller benefits, said he asked carriers for a coulance policy, and that he lacks data on court appeals and on which subscriptions and carriers fine such travellers.
I have asked the carriers to come up with a joint coulance policy for this.
Ik heb de vervoerders gevraagd hiervoor gezamenlijk met een coulancebeleid te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Leenders over vertraging bij de aanleg van een centraal beveiligingssysteem op Schiphol

MPs Mei Li Vos and Leenders asked about delays in building a central security system at Schiphol, whether the 3 June deadline will be met, whether costs and complexity were underestimated, whether the Algemene Rekenkamer should audit Schiphol's tendering, and how the state's shareholder powers over state holdings could be strengthened. The minister answers that the 3 June switchover is still planned, Schiphol faces no financial problems if it slips, the state exercises shareholder oversight through informal contact and statutes, declines to ask the Rekenkamer for an audit, and says the Rekenkamer's access to subsidiaries requires a legal change for which the Council of State previously saw no need.
These concern operational matters for which Schiphol's management board and supervisory board are responsible and accountable.
Het betreft operationele aangelegenheden, waarvoor de directie en raad van commissarissen van Schiphol verantwoordelijk en aanspreekbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, De Boer en Dik-Faber over mobiliteitskaarten

MPs asked whether NS unilaterally terminated contracts with alternative mobility-card providers, whether this threatens an NS monopoly, and whether ACM is investigating. The state secretary answered that NS did not renew contracts on the same terms, agreed in principle with some providers, and that ACM has found no apparent infringement and is not starting an investigation.
ACM is currently not starting an investigation and for the time being is halting its official interventions.
ACM start op dit moment geen onderzoek en staakt vooralsnog de ambtelijke interventies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Dik-Faber over reizen met de trein door blinden en slechtzienden

Two MPs (De Boer, VVD, and Dik-Faber, ChristenUnie) asked the state secretary about blind and partially sighted train passengers not being clearly told which side of the train to alight on, and about the quality of on-board announcements. The secretary acknowledged the issue, said NS is examining the safety impact and passenger perception before deciding, and reported improvements to announcement equipment and a planned revision of the VIRM intercity announcement systems.
NS wants to first investigate the impact on safety of implementing this measure and how other travellers experience information about the exit side.
NS wil de impact op de veiligheid bij uitvoering van deze maatregel en de hoe andere reizigers informatie over de uitstapzijde ervaren eerst onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Merkies over “de megabonus voor de topman van Schiphol”

MPs Bashir and Merkies asked why the Schiphol CEO receives a bonus nearly equal to his base salary, whether this is consistent with the 20% cap, and whether the government has acted to get him to waive it. The minister explains the 2008 contract followed then-applicable policy, states that the new 2014 policy caps variable pay at 20%, says the shareholder sets directors' pay policy, and notes he has told Schiphol the CEO's variable pay should be brought into line with current policy.
In addition, I have informed Schiphol that I am of the view that the variable pay of Schiphol's CEO should be brought into line with the current remuneration policy.
Daarnaast heb ik aan Schiphol laten weten dat ik van mening ben dat de variabele beloning van de CEO van Schiphol in lijn moet worden gebracht met het vigerende beloningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het hacken van passagiersvliegtuigen van buitenaf

MP Hachchi (D66) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about a US GAO report warning of rising hacking risk to passenger aircraft, whether this applies to Dutch airspace, what measures have been taken, and about a German call to make aircraft remotely controllable. The State Secretary replied that the vulnerability is an expected future possibility rather than a demonstrated one, that certification and EU-level cybersecurity steps are the relevant safeguards, and that remote control of aircraft raises many practical and legal objections requiring further study.
The vulnerability mentioned is currently not a demonstrated vulnerability, but an expected possibility in the future given developments in aviation.
De genoemde kwetsbaarheid betreft op dit moment geen aangetoonde kwetsbaarheid, maar een op termijn verwachte mogelijkheid gezien de ontwikkelingen binnen de luchtvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Illegale autosloop blijkt onstuitbaar'

An MP asked the State Secretary about a report that illegal car dismantling is hard to stop, including 'fake export' cases, and about enforcement and environmental harm. The State Secretary answered that no quantitative data exist, enforcement lies with regional environmental services, and the RDW is working with the industry on solutions.
The RDW has no quantitative data on the number of cars that may be illegally dismantled.
De RDW heeft geen kwantitatieve gegevens over de hoeveelheid auto’s die mogelijk illegaal worden gesloopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de spoorovergangen in Deurne en de noodzaak om in ieder geval de Binderendreef aan te pakken

An MP asked the state secretary whether the level crossing on the Binderendreef in Deurne, which faces longer waiting times from increased freight traffic, is safe and whether it can be added to the national level-crossing improvement list. The state secretary answered that ProRail's analysis shows no safety risk and that the crossing is not on the priority list, but the ministry is willing to consider it with the region through the regional coordinator.
The ministry is willing to think along with the region on this.
Vanuit IenM bestaat de bereidheid om hierbij mee te denken met de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de aanwezigheid van asbestdeeltjes in de openbare ruimte

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the asbestos clean-up after the Wateringen fire was properly handled, who is responsible for residual asbestos, and whether the municipality acted lawfully and can recover costs. The State Secretary answered that a post-clean-up check found no loose asbestos, that the municipality acted correctly, and that cost recovery from the property owner is still being pursued without final cost figures.
That conclusion indicates that the municipality of Westland has acted correctly under the statutory rules.
Die conclusie geeft aan dat de gemeente Westland correct is omgegaan met de wettelijke regels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Veldhoven over het niet naleven van de meldplicht voor incidenten met gevaarlijke stoffen

MPs Smaling and Van Veldhoven asked whether the Inspectorate (ILT) fails to enforce the duty to report hazardous-substance incidents, whether reporting is too cumbersome, whether carriers are unaware of the duty, whether human error incidents rose, and whether hazard markings should be required for mixed small-package transports. The state secretary denied under-enforcement (eight enforcement actions in 2014, seven reports to prosecutors), described the single reporting desk and outreach, and rejected new marking rules as already covered by international rules.
No, this is not correct. All incidents involving hazardous substances must be reported immediately to the ILT.
Nee, dit is niet juist. Alle incidenten met gevaarlijke stoffen moeten direct worden gemeld bij de ILT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de incidenten met gevaarlijke stoffen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether companies fail to report hazardous-substance transport incidents out of fear of fines, whether carriers are unaware of the reporting duty, and whether the Inspectorate (ILT) actively enforces reporting. The State Secretary answered that non-reporting often stems from unfamiliarity with the duty, that the ILT informs firms and enforces where needed, and that seven official reports were drawn up in 2014.
If it turns out that companies do not report incidents with hazardous substances, the ILT takes enforcement action under criminal or administrative law.
Als blijkt dat bedrijven incidenten met gevaarlijke stoffen niet melden, treedt de ILT strafrechtelijk of bestuursrechtelijk handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het verbod op asbestdaken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the planned ban on asbestos roofs, enforcement structures, soil contamination costs and funding, and asbestos in earthquake-damaged Groningen homes. The State Secretary defended the 2024 ban and funding approach, said enforcement is being strengthened through pilots and shared tools, and said the soil contamination question awaits provincial reports.
For this I am awaiting the letter from the provinces that will explain these research reports.
Hiervoor wacht ik de brief van provincies af waarin duiding wordt gegeven aan deze onderzoeksrapporten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over de onderzoeken naar de MH17

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked about the authenticity and sharing of a leaked July 2014 Kiev briefing memo, ICAO and airspace warnings over Crimea, information sharing with airlines, Dutch–Ukrainian and Minsk arrangements for the crash site, and the state secrecy of MCCb MH17 minutes. The government largely refused to release the briefing memo and MCCb minutes on confidentiality grounds, while describing remedial steps such as the ICAO website pilot and planned consultations with airlines.
For the same reason, the cabinet will also not share the document with which the essence of the briefing was shared with other departments.
Om diezelfde reden zal het kabinet ook het document waarmee de essentie van de briefing is gedeeld met andere departementen niet delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over uitspraken van de heer Don, bestuurslid van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM), over verdere liberalisering van het spoor

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the ACM board member Don's call for studying the splitting and tendering of the Dutch main rail network was appropriate, given that the ACM is an independent regulator and the matter belongs to ministerial policy. The government answered that Don spoke as chair of IRG-Rail, that the Dutch position remains flexible and against splitting the main network, that the ACM may comment on policy only within agreed limits and did not address rail in its Signaal 2015, and that the ACM is not conducting its own study on splitting, only a required competition assessment.
The ACM is an independent administrative body within the meaning of the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies.
De ACM is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan in de zin van de Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Leenders over de verkoop van B.V. Schiphol Airport Retail

MPs Mei Li Vos and Leenders asked whether the sale of 60% of Schiphol Airport Retail B.V. was a privatisation requiring parliamentary approval, and why it was done. The government answered that Schiphol Group, not the state, sold the stake, that the sale needed no shareholder consent under the articles, and that Schiphol keeps control through the shareholder agreement and concession role.
There is no partial privatisation here because the state itself does not dispose of any shares.
Er is hier geen sprake van een deelprivatisering omdat de staat zelf geen aandelen vervreemdt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de inpassing van A13 en A16 bij Lansingerland

The MP asks whether the government took note of a residents' proposal to lower the N471 crossing near Lansingerland and why Rijkswaterstaat dropped it from the participation table, and how this fits the Participation Code. The minister answers that the variant fell outside the scope of the Standpunt, was examined anyway, costs about 36 million euro more, and was not pursued in the draft route decision, though it may play a role in regional measures.
The proposed variant for lowering the crossing with the N471 does not fit within the scope of the Standpunt, which is in principle reason not to consider this variant further.
De ingebrachte variant voor verlaging van de kruising met de N471 past niet binnen de scope van het Standpunt en dat is in principe reden om deze variant niet nader in beschouwing te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en De Boer over de verslechtering van de treinverbinding tussen Alkmaar en Den Haag/Rotterdam

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about the worsened rail connection between Alkmaar and The Hague/Rotterdam, including longer travel times, a Haarlem transfer and missed connections. The state secretary answered that NS prioritises the largest passenger flows, admits the Haarlem transfer is missed too often, and commits to faster Intercity services in the peak from the 2016 timetable.
I share the view that the transfer is too often not made and expect NS and ProRail to work to improve this.
Ik deel de mening dat de overstap te vaak niet wordt gehaald en verwacht dat NS en ProRail zich inzetten om dit te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht dat Duitsland de veiligheid in de luchtvaart onderzoekt na de vliegramp bij Germanwings

An MP asked whether the Netherlands would set up a dedicated working group on aviation safety after the Germanwings crash, mirroring Germany, and whether the minister would review Dutch aviation safety, cockpit technology, and pilot medical testing. The minister declined a separate Dutch working group, pointing to ICAO, EASA and existing EU safety systems, and promised to press EASA to continue and schedule the work and to inform the German counterpart.
This makes it unnecessary for the Netherlands to set up its own working group.
Dit maakt het niet nodig om als Nederland een eigen werkgroep in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over het winnen van de aanbesteding in Limburg door Abellio

MPs De Vries and De Boer asked whether NS's subsidiary Abellio could bid in the Limburg public transport tender without being cross-subsidised and on a level playing field with commercial rivals, and how its return and finances fit NS's required return. The minister answers that the bid was discussed with the shareholder, meets NS's investment criteria, is market-conform in financing, and that NS does not report subsidiary-level returns publicly.
Providing insight into the return per business unit, subsidiary and participation could lead to a deterioration of NS's competitive and negotiating position.
Inzicht geven in het rendement per bedrijfsonderdeel, dochteronderneming en deelnemingen kan leiden tot een verslechtering van de concurrentie- en onderhandelingspositie van de NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de gaswinningsplannen op Terschelling, Schiermonnikoog en bij Oppenhuizen

An MP asked the ministers about planned gas extraction near Terschelling, Schiermonnikoog and Oppenhuizen, including protection of the Wadden Sea, the powers of provinces and municipalities, and the energy transition. The ministers answered that permits are still in procedure, that no moratorium is needed, that local authorities have formal consultation rights, and that the Structuurvisie Ondergrond and Energierapport 2015 are in preparation.
The Provincial Executive of the province of Friesland advises me on the mining permit application submitted by Tulip Oil under the Mining Act.
Het College van gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Friesland adviseert mij inzake de door Tulip Oil ingediende winningsvergunningaanvraag op basis van de Mijnbouwwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de veiligheid op het spoor

MP Van Helvert asked the state secretary about rail safety after a passenger and freight train collided at Tilburg, including progress on safer routing of hazardous goods, use of the EUR 3 million noise budget, Betuweroute diversions, the absence of a buffer wagon, and a noise screen in Breda. The state secretary answered that the Basisnet law took effect on 1 April 2015 with risk ceilings, that EUR 15 million was allocated to Dordrecht, Zwijndrecht and Tilburg, that the noise budget is fully spent, and that the Breda screen question is the responsibility of the project developer; it also said hazardous-goods volumes through Brabant cannot be predicted.
How much hazardous material will ultimately be transported through the Brabant cities cannot be predicted.
Hoeveel gevaarlijke stoffen uiteindelijk door de Brabantse steden vervoerd zullen worden, laat zich niet voorspellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het Aeronautical Fixed Telecommunication Network (AFTN) van 3 maart 2015

An MP asked which Dutch parties connect to the AFTN network, whether ICAO and Dutch bodies received special alert messages about eastern Ukraine before the MH17 crash, and about the OVV investigation into route choice. The government answered that ICAO does not send messages over AFTN, that no such special alerts were known to the Dutch government, and that the OVV independently decides what it investigates.
The OVV is independent and itself determines which incidents it investigates.
De OVV is onafhankelijk en bepaalt zelf welke voorvallen hij onderzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de veiligheid van spoortunnels

MP Van Helvert (CDA) asked the state secretary about a press report that safety rules for rail tunnels might be relaxed, the causes of false fire alarms, which bodies shape tunnel safety policy, and whether tunnels meet safety requirements and training obligations. The state secretary answered that rules are not being loosened, that the update of the Derde Kadernota Railveiligheid is ongoing with a report to parliament by end 2015, and that tunnels meet requirements with minor shortcomings already fixed.
The outcomes of all discussions will be taken into account in the update of the Third Railway Safety Framework Memorandum, on which I will inform your House in more detail at the end of 2015.
De uitkomsten van alle gesprekken worden betrokken bij de actualisatie van de Derde Kadernota Railveiligheid waarover ik uw Kamer eind 2015 nader zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat er drie keer zoveel klachten zijn bij NS over volle treinen

An SP MP asked the state secretary how the government will respond to reports of overcrowded NS trains, including the Uitgeest–Amsterdam Sprinter, and what measures are planned for capacity. The state secretary acknowledged performance fell below agreed targets, pointed to a mandatory NS capacity improvement programme and monitoring under the concession, and promised further measures without firm new commitments.
The current performance level does not match the stated ambition.
Het huidige prestatieniveau past niet bij de gestelde ambitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en De Boer over de Zaanse spoorlijn

MPs Visser and De Boer asked the State Secretary about the high number of complaints (712) on the Zaan railway line, its structural lack of peak capacity, plans for more frequent Randstad services, and the role of the concession in enforcing improvements. The State Secretary answered that NS is under a concession obligation to improve capacity, the Zaandam-Amsterdam line is one of ten focus routes, train extensions and new rolling stock are planned, and the ministry is in ongoing discussion with NS, with sanctions possible if needed.
On the implementation of that programme my department is in discussion with NS and, if necessary, enforcement will follow under the concession.
Over de uitvoering van dat programma is mijn departement in gesprek met NS en zo nodig zal hierop conform de concessie worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over KLM en Air France

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether contracts and agreements between the state and Air France KLM and KLM since the merger should be sent to parliament, and whether a January 2015 press release showed that KLM's cash management had been centralised under the Air France KLM holding. The state secretary replied that no new agreements or contracts had been concluded since 2004 beyond a 2010 memorandum on state guarantees, and that the holding's president had confirmed KLM keeps autonomous financial management in Amstelveen.

Since the merger in 2004, no new agreements have been recorded or contracts concluded, apart from the memorandum of understanding of 25 May 2010 on extending part of the state guarantees, which was sent with the letter of 3 March.

Sinds de fusie in 2004 zijn er geen nieuwe afspraken vastgelegd of contracten gesloten, naast het met de genoemde brief van 3 maart jl. meegestuurde memorandum of understanding van 25 mei 2010 inzake verlenging van een deel van de staatsgaranties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het artikel ‘Ongekend amateurisme van treindienstleiding, Reiziger dupe van gestuntel ProRail'

The MP asks whether ProRail's train control mishandled a temporary speed restriction in the Delft tunnel, including wrong speed signs that led to cancelling two trains, and whether ProRail has the problems under control given recent rail incidents. The state secretary explains the speed limit was set to protect against pressure waves, notes the wrong signs were corrected and cancelling trains was an adequate response, and says the incidents are separate and that the Beter en Meer programme with NS addresses reliability.
The correct speed is now shown on the signs.
Inmiddels is de juiste snelheid op de borden aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en De Boer over cyberaanvallen op reisinformatiedienst 9292

Two VVD MPs asked whether the NCSC would assist travel information service 9292 against cyberattacks, arguing it has a statutory duty to inform travellers. The Minister replied that travel information providers are not a vital sector, so NCSC direct support is not provided, that 9292 has no statutory information duty, and that NCSC will consult 9292 on making its public knowledge available.
Incidentally, 9292 has no statutory duty to provide information to the traveller.
9292 heeft overigens geen wettelijke plicht tot informatievoorziening aan de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het winnen van de openbaarvervoerconcessie in Limburg door Abellio

The MP De Boer asks the government about the return requirements (normrendement) for NS and Abellio, and whether Abellio's winning bid for the Limburg rail concession fits the state's shareholder return policy. The Finance Minister answers that NS uses a 7% normrendement on equity, that the business case for Abellio is confidential, and provides NS's 2010-2014 return figures, but gives no forward-looking statements.
Because of commercial confidentiality, I cannot say anything about the business case underlying the bid.
Ik kan vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid geen uitspraken doen over de business case die ten grondslag ligt aan de bieding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over het bericht 'NS wil af van winkelvastgoed'

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about a report that NS (the state railway) wants to divest property and non-core retail, and about its consequences for the state's role as shareholder and concession grantor. The ministers answered that the divestments are gradual and market-driven, that they favour keeping station management in public hands with a regulatory role, and that the concession is unaffected, leaving much of the shareholder assessment to the shareholder itself.
It is mainly up to the shareholder to assess whether the strategy of the entire NS group is in line with the public interests of the railway.
Het is met name aan de aandeelhouder om te beoordelen of de strategie van het gehele NS-concern in lijn is met de publieke belangen van het spoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de bereikbaarheid van reisinformatiediensten

An MP asked the government whether the national cyber security centre should actively help public transport travel-information provider 9292 against DDoS attacks, whether it has designated a travel-information operator, and how to make vehicle data resilient and open. The minister answered that travel-information providers are not a vital sector so NCSC gives only online guidance, that no designation under the Passenger Transport Act is needed, and that data delivery and open-data work will be discussed in the national public transport consultation without firm dates.
Providers of travel information are not part of the established list of vital sectors.
Aanbieders van reisinformatie zijn geen onderdeel van de vastgestelde lijst van vitale sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Hoogland over de aanpak van gevaarlijke overwegen

MPs De Boer and Hoogland asked the state secretary about dangerous unguarded level crossings in the Netherlands, including the Voslaan crossing in Winsum, and whether a risk ranking, the Groningen study, LVO or ProRail funding, and innovative solutions could be provided. The state secretary answered that 154 publicly accessible unguarded crossings exist on the passenger network, promised an integrated approach and ranking to the Chamber in May, reserved 10 million euro from the LVO for Winsum with regional co-financing, and said innovative options are being explored.
As promised to your Chamber during the General Consultation on Rail Safety on 27 November, you will receive a proposal this spring for an integrated approach to non-actively secured level crossings.

Zoals aan uw Kamer toegezegd tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Spoorveiligheid op 27 november jongstleden ontvangt u dit voorjaar een voorstel voor de integrale aanpak van niet-actief beveiligde overwegen (nabo's).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het uitbreiden van nachtnet

An MP asked the State Secretary whether NS could be required, under the rail concession, to extend night train services in Brabant and Groningen, or to let regional operators do so cheaper. The State Secretary answered that NS decides how to meet its concession obligations, that regional governments may co-finance night trains, and that agreements have been reached with Groningen and Drenthe while talks with Noord-Brabant continue.
I am awaiting the outcomes of that and will inform you as soon as possible.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten daarvan af en zal u zo spoedig mogelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Fokke over nieuw onderzoek naar de IJzeren Rijn

PvdA MPs Hoogland and Fokke asked the State Secretary about a new Flemish-led study into reactivating the IJzeren Rijn rail line, including which routes are examined, whether Dutch government funds the study, and whether outcomes are agreed in advance. The State Secretary answered that three routes will be studied, Dutch co-funding is conditional and not fixed, no agreements on outcomes exist yet, and Limburg has now been informed.
Further agreements on the study have not yet been made; Flanders intends to organise a high level meeting with the five involved governments
Verdere afspraken over de studie zijn nog niet gemaakt; Vlaanderen is voornemens een «high level meeting» met de vijf betrokken overheden te organiseren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over een intercitystation in Harderwijk

An MP asked whether Harderwijk station should become an InterCity stop and whether the MIRT study into a Utrecht-Weesp-Harderwijk triangle could be accelerated. The state secretary answered that the timetable is NS's decision, that NS sees no plans to add InterCity stops given more travellers would be disadvantaged, and that the MIRT study's timing cannot be accelerated, with a decision expected in autumn 2015.
It is not possible to accelerate the decision-making on a possible MIRT exploration.
Het is niet mogelijk om de besluitvorming over een eventuele MIRT-verkenning te versnellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en De Boer over het ACM-besluit over de overtreding van de Spoorwegwet door NS
