Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about an ACM finding that NS breached Article 67 of the Spoorwegwet, whether NS blocked publication and threatened a damages claim over the Limburg tender, and whether ACM would publish its decision and correspondence before the Spoorwegwet debate. The State Secretary confirmed one article was breached, said NS sought interim relief and announced a possible damages claim, and declined to request publication or correspondence, citing ACM's independence and pending legal proceedings, while committing to send the answers to Parliament.
Given the independence of the ACM, it is for the ACM and possibly the court to decide on making this information public.
Gelet op de onafhankelijkheid van de ACM is het aan de ACM en eventueel de rechter om te beslissen over het openbaar maken van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Çegerek naar aanleiding van een nieuwsbericht  van Deltares over een onderzoek naar microplastics

An MP asked the State Secretary about a Deltares study on microplastics and their additives, litter control, washing-machine filters and further research. The government answered that measured concentrations are below risk limits, lists existing and planned measures, and commits to a research programme on microplastic effects.
I am following this research and will use its outcomes when developing measures to reduce microplastic emissions from land-based sources.
Ik volg dit onderzoek en zal de uitkomsten hiervan gebruiken bij het ontwikkelen van maatregelen om de emissies van microplastics vanuit landbronnen te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht dat Arriva,  Veolia en Connexxion samenspannen tegen NS

An MP asked whether secret agreements among public transport operators (Arriva, Veolia, Connexxion) coordinated legal action against NS, and what the government would do given possible Mededingingswet violations. The state secretary replied that the competition regulator ACM is responsible for assessing and investigating such conduct, that exclusion from tenders requires a final conviction, and that litigation costs are not known.
It is up to the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM), as an independent supervisor, to assess whether there is reason to start an investigation into a possible violation of the Competition Act.

Het is aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) om als onafhankelijke toezichthouder te beoordelen of er aanleiding is om een onderzoek te starten naar een mogelijke overtreding van de Mededingingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht ‘Aanhoudingen na dumpen afvalstoffen in brandstof’

An SP member asked the Ministers of Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about arrests after illegal mixing of hazardous waste into heating oil, whether this reflects structural enforcement, how long the practice persisted, and which company is involved. The Minister answered that a criminal investigation led to arrests of four managers of a West-Brabant waste firm, that the company name and details cannot be disclosed for investigative reasons, and that a blacklist of substances for heating oil and a related motion are being implemented.
I cannot make any statements about the name of the suspected company.
Over de naam van het verdachte bedrijf kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het winnen van de aanbesteding in Limburg door Abellio

An MP asked the state secretary about Abellio winning the Limburg public transport concession, Veolia's disqualification, possible cross-subsidy and guarantees from parent NS, station activities, and dividend and investment arrangements. The government answered that the province is the contracting authority and responsible for the award, that Veolia's bid was invalid for exceeding the permitted extra fee, that the Finance Ministry found no evidence of cross-subsidy, and that it lacks knowledge of bids and internal NS arrangements.
The province of Limburg is the contracting authority and therefore responsible for awarding this concession.
De provincie Limburg is de aanbestedende partij en daarmee verantwoordelijk voor het gunnen van deze concessie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het eigen vermogen van Air France KLM

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the declining equity of Air France-KLM from 2011 to 2014 and a press report that the French wanted to dismantle KLM. The State Secretary gave the equity figures, attributed the decline to losses, pension-rate effects and an accounting change, pointed to improving cash flows, and said he would discuss the matter with the French government and report to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het uitbannen van plastic tassen, naar aanleiding van de brief die zij heeft toegezegd tijdens het AO Grondstoffen en afval op 16 oktober jl.

An MP asks the State Secretary about the EU agreement on plastic bags, whether a ban is proportionate, the environmental impact, enforcement and the failed Green Deal. The State Secretary answers that a ban on free thin plastic bags at checkouts from 2016 is planned as part of a broader approach, with enforcement by the ILT and a promised letter to parliament.

There will be no ban on plastic bags. As part of the broad policy aimed at reducing the number of carrier bags, and in implementation of the forthcoming amendment of the packaging directive, a ban on free plastic bags will come.

Er komt geen verbod op plastic tasjes. Als onderdeel van het brede beleid gericht op het terugdringen van het aantal draagtassen en ter uitvoering van de op handen zijnde aanpassing van verpakkingsrichtlijn komt er een verbod op gratis plastic tassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de aanbesteding van openbaar vervoer in Limburg

An MP from the Labour Party asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the Limburg public transport tender, including whether the government will investigate it and whether the bidding is fair. The State Secretary answers that the province is the contracting authority responsible for the tender, that Veolia's bid was declared invalid, and that no investigation is planned because only the province can request one from the competition authority.

Since the Ministry of IenM is not the contracting authority for the Limburg concession, no answer can be given to questions on the accuracy of facts reported in the Volkskrant article as far as the tender is concerned.
Aangezien het Ministerie van IenM niet de aanbestedende partij is van de concessie in Limburg kan geen antwoord worden gegeven op de vragen die ingaan op de juistheid of onjuistheid van feiten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de chaos op het spoor op 2 februari 2015

An MP asked the state secretary why a computer failure at the Utrecht rail control post caused a nationwide disruption on 2 February 2015 and whether ProRail and NS can resolve such problems quickly. The state secretary explained a hardware failure and a staged, safety-driven restart, with ProRail to report by end of March, and noted the winter-weather letter had already been sent.
ProRail is expected to report to the ministry at the end of March on the investigation, the analyses and the measures.
ProRail rapporteert naar verwachting eind maart over het onderzoek, de analyses en maatregelen aan het ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de grote treinstoring rond Utrecht op 2 februari 2015

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the large train outage around Utrecht on 2 February 2015, including outdated systems, the lack of backup and rerouting options, and the handling of the failure. The state secretary answered that ProRail is investigating the causes, that systems are redundant and partly upgraded, and that rerouting to the new control centre takes about four hours, while committing to close monitoring of progress.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment will closely monitor progress.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu zal strak op de voortgang sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over de uitbreiding gemeentelijke milieuzones waaronder Amsterdam, Utrecht en Rotterdam

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about expanding municipal environmental zones (milieuzones) in Amsterdam, Utrecht and Rotterdam, questioning their proportionality, costs, cost-effectiveness analyses and the lack of a uniform access regime. The secretary answered that local municipalities decide on zones, a subsidy scheme for van replacement in border municipalities was set up with 4 million euro of NSL funds, no cost-benefit analysis of green deals is possible, and that a joint exploration with the G4 cities is underway.
The cost-effectiveness of the environmental zone is weighed in local decision-making on any expansion of the zone.
De kosteneffectiviteit van de milieuzone wordt bij de lokale besluitvorming over eventuele uitbreiding van de milieuzone meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht “Gratis reizen op de NS Jaartrajectkaart

An MP asked the State Secretary whether NS annual rail pass holders could travel free outside their purchased route, how much revenue was lost, and whether the minister would act or raise it with the national transport body. The State Secretary confirmed some holders travel beyond their route without being charged, said NS treats it as a business choice, and declined to intervene since the product is being phased out by 8 July 2015.
Since travellers have suffered no disadvantage, there is no reason for the ministry, as concession grantor, to take action on this.
Aangezien de reizigers geen nadeel hebben ondervonden is er voor het ministerie als concessieverlener geen aanleiding om hier actie op te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht “Gekke Gerrit mikt op 30 supermarkten”

An MP asked whether a supermarket chain selling Polish Coca-Cola without deposit would be stopped, and whether the deposit obligation on PET bottles stays in place after the Afvalfonds takes over. The Secretary of State said the chain ended its no-deposit promotion, and that StAV now charges members selling large bottles without deposit a much higher fee (about 0.25 euro per bottle), giving a strong incentive to join the deposit system.
No. As before, a situation can still arise in which a producer or importer, for example from Poland, imports soft drinks in 1.5 litre PET bottles and places them on the market without deposit.

Nee. Zoals voorheen, kan ook nu zich een situatie voordoen dat een producent of importeur uit bijvoorbeeld Polen frisdrank in PET-flessen van 1.5 liter importeert en deze zonder statiegeld op de markt brengt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het verkopen van statiegeldloze flessen van Coca Cola door de supermarkt Gekke Gerrit

An MP asked the state secretary about a discount shop selling Polish cola in non-deposit PET bottles, undermining the deposit system, and how compliance by non-members of the Afvalfonds is checked. The state secretary confirmed the concern, explained the StAV surcharge of EUR 0.25 per bottle for non-members above 50 tonnes, said enforcement of the old rules was via the Economische Controledienst, and declined to make deposit mandatory, pointing to the existing framework agreement.
I do not have exact figures on the quantities that fall outside the StAV system as a result.
Ik heb geen exacte cijfers over hoeveelheden die hierdoor buiten het systeem van StAV vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de busconcessie Groningen-Drenthe

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that a second extension of the Groningen-Drenthe bus concession was being challenged, and whether this conflicted with the government's focus on the traveller. The State Secretary answered that the extension is a disagreement between parties over applicable procurement law, that it could go to court, that service to travellers is not interrupted, and that the ministry has no instruments to lower tender costs.
The OV Bureau Groningen-Drenthe wants to extend this concession again by two years, to the end of 2019.
Het OV Bureau Groningen-Drenthe wil deze concessie nogmaals met twee jaar verlengen tot eind 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het station in Eijsden

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment why station Eijsden remains on the main rail network served by NS, why it was not transferred to the regional authority, and what barriers prevent another operator from serving it. The State Secretary answered that NS already serves the station via a cross-border Maastricht-Luik service, that transfer of the station is not legally possible, that technical and economic barriers exist but are solvable, and that dialogue with the province can continue through existing channels.
There is no reason to enter into consultation about transferring the train service to Eijsden to the decentralised authority.
Er is geen aanleiding om in overleg te treden over een overdracht van de treindienst naar Eijsden aan de decentrale overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Marcouch over het bericht “Bomalarm op station Leiden door misverstand”

MPs Hoogland and Marcouch asked about a bomb alarm at Leiden Central station caused by a camera rig hung there by a media agency's technician for ad-viewing measurement. The government described the sequence of events, said NS had been aware of the test but failed to communicate it internally, rejected that anyone acted knowingly, and found no criminal offence.
The incident must therefore be regarded as an unwise action combined with poor communication.
Het gebeurde moet dan ook beschouwd worden als een onverstandige actie in combinatie met gebrekkige communicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de NS-dienstregeling Amsterdam-Haarlem-Zandvoort

An MP asked the state secretary about a 10-minute wait at Haarlem that slows the Amsterdam-Zandvoort sprinter, whether freight paths cause it, and whether priority rules should allow ProRail to apply passenger priority without declaring the infrastructure overloaded. The government attributes the delay to a late NS timetable change, says the rules already allow ProRail to resolve conflicts, sees no need to amend the decree, and promises to press ProRail and NS to look for improvements before summer.
I have asked ProRail and NS, partly in response to this set of questions, to take another thorough look at the situation.
Ik heb ProRail en NS mede naar aanleiding van deze set vragen verzocht nog eens grondig naar de situatie te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat taxichauffeurs het heft zelf in hand willen nemen tegen Uber

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment how the government will respond to taxi drivers' plans to take matters into their own hands against UberPOP, including enforcement numbers, staffing, and why illegal drivers are not caught. The State Secretary rejects vigilante action, reports ten last-onder-dwangsom fines and fourteen enforcement actions in six months, and says enforcement continues with about 20 FTE capacity, though some answers refer to other responsible bodies or cannot provide data.
I therefore maintain the continuation of the enforcement already underway against UberPOP drivers and other unlicensed drivers.
Ik houd daarom vast aan voortzetting van de reeds ingezette handhaving tegen UberPOP chauffeurs en andere snorders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de voorstellen van het Letse EU-voorzitterschap met betrekking tot het Vierde Spoorwegpakket

An MP asked the State Secretary about the Latvian EU presidency's new proposal on the PSO regulation within the Fourth Railway Package, which removes direct award of public transport rail concessions and may conflict with Dutch and European Parliament positions. The State Secretary confirmed the proposal drops direct award, said it conflicts with the Dutch position, and pledged to keep arguing for member-state choice in Transport Council meetings and bilateral contacts.
This proposal is part of the political pillar – or market pillar – of the 4th railway package.
Dit voorstel is onderdeel van de politieke pijler – of marktpijler – van het 4 e spoorpakket.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de berichten ‘Oproep tot transparantie in ontwikkeling criteria voor biomassa’ en ‘Groen paspoort van FSC verlopen’

An MP asks whether FSC timber certification has fallen short of Dutch sustainable procurement criteria since 2012, why PEFC and MTCS are excluded, and whether TPAC's independence and added value are sound, given reported conflicts of interest in developing biomass criteria. The Secretary of State answers that TPAC re-assessment of FSC is still ongoing, that PEFC was approved in 2010, that the biomass criteria process is transparent, and that TPAC's funding and future depend on EU coordination which will be reported to parliament later.
After completion of the assessment, TPAC will publish the assessment results.
Na afronding van de beoordeling maakt TPAC de toetsingsresultaten bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Bommel, Bontes, De Roon, Thieme en Van Ojik over de tussenrapportages van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) onderzoeken

MPs asked whether the Safety Board (OVV) runs three MH17 investigations, whether interim reports were published, and under which ICAO Annex 13 reporting obligations. The minister confirmed three investigations, that only the cause investigation has a published preliminary report, and that the other two have no interim reports.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven de import van illegaal gekapt hout

An MP from D66 asked ministers about a report claiming 46% of wood imported into the Netherlands falls outside the EU Timber Regulation, and about steps to stop illegal wood in processed products. The state secretary disputed the 46% figure as a miscalculation (about 6% by weight, 16% by value), acknowledged a 16.8% gap for secondary products, and said the issue would be raised in the Commission's evaluation of the regulation.
In that context I will raise the problem of imports of processed products made from illegal wood, as mentioned in the Probos report, with the Commission.
Ik zal in dat kader de problematiek van de import van bewerkte producten van illegaal hout, zoals genoemd in het rapport van Probos, aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht "Noodverordening in Roermond om asbest na grote brand"

An MP asked the state secretary about a fire in Roermond that released asbestos, its cause, the health consequences, and whether locations with asbestos were inventoried. The state secretary said the police investigation is ongoing, the amount of released asbestos and health effects are not yet known, no complete national inventory of asbestos locations exists, and he intends to ban asbestos roofs from 2024 and points to regional and sector initiatives.
The police investigation into the fire is still ongoing and no statements can currently be made about it.
Het politieonderzoek naar de brand loopt nog en hierover kunnen op dit moment geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over de brand in Roermond van 16 december, waarbij asbest is vrijgekomen

MPs Smaling and Ulenbelt asked the state secretary about the Roermond fire that released asbestos, including responders' protective equipment, the lack of a dedicated asbestos disaster plan, and whether the Netherlands should systematically become asbestos-free. The state secretary replied that the safety region judged the response adequate, that evaluations are underway, that a 2006 asbestos fire plan is being updated, and that policy stays risk-based with a planned 2024 ban on asbestos roofs.
The plan of approach is currently being updated by the Institute for Physical Safety.
Het plan van aanpak wordt momenteel geactualiseerd door het Instituut Fysieke Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Jacobi over het gebruik van verboden bestrijdingsmiddelen op sierplanten

MP Jacobi asked the state secretaries about Greenpeace findings that ornamental plants sold in garden centres contained banned pesticide residues, and about how to stop illegal use. The government shares the concern, says residues may stem from illegal use, storage or imports, promises publication of NVWA compliance measurements, and announces extra enforcement, tougher sanctions and retail-chain certification.
I told your House during the committee meeting on crop protection agents on 4 December 2014 that I find the illegal use of crop protection agents completely unacceptable.
Ik heb uw Kamer tijdens het AO gewasbeschermingsmiddelen op 4 december 2014 aangegeven dat ik het illegaal gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen volstrekt onaanvaardbaar vind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over uitbreiding gemeentelijke milieuzones waaronder Amsterdam, Utrecht en Rotterdam

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about the proposed expansion of municipal environmental zones (milieuzones) in Amsterdam, Utrecht and Rotterdam, arguing for uniform national rules, the burden on businesses, and the effectiveness versus source-based policy. The State Secretary answered that municipalities decide on zones within a national framework, that zones remain needed for air quality hotspots, and that the national government supports source-based measures, innovation and uniform access regimes.
There is no overview available of all itemised expenditure related to specific measures in the NSL by national government, provinces and municipalities.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van alle uitgesplitste uitgaven in relatie tot specifieke maatregelen in het NSL door rijk, provincies en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht ‘NS-personeel steeds vaker fysiek belaagd’

An MP asked the state secretary what was being done to protect rail staff from physical assault, whether a union survey showed existing measures were insufficient, and whether four proposed measures (more conductors, a railway police force, tougher sentencing, closing ticket gates) would be adopted. The government answered that staff safety is primarily the employer's responsibility, listed existing measures such as the reisverbod and ticket gates, promised to raise the survey with rail company CEOs and unions, and rejected a railway police force and the other proposals while leaving staffing choices to NS.
I will therefore discuss these outcomes in the regular consultation I have with the CEOs of ProRail and NS, and ask them what action they will take in response to this survey.
Ik zal deze uitkomsten dan ook bespreken in het reguliere overleg dat ik heb met de CEO’s van ProRail en NS, en aan hen vragen welke actie zij ondernemen naar aanleiding van deze enquête.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over het bericht «Automobilist de klos in de Randstad»

PVV MPs asked whether higher municipal parking tariffs and more section controls on motorways are unfair extra burdens on motorists and whether the government will stop the big cities' plans. The state secretary answered that parking tariffs are a municipal matter, that section controls improve compliance rather than add costs, and that they do little for urban air quality, promising talks with the G7 cities.
Setting the height of parking tariffs is a responsibility of the municipalities and not of the national government.
Het vaststellen van de hoogte van parkeertarieven is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten en niet van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht dat de automobilist de klos is in de Randstad

MPs Visser and Dijkstra (VVD) asked the State Secretary whether the G4 cities' proposed air-quality measures, such as more lane-section controls, are symbolic, ineffective and costly for motorists. The State Secretary answered that the G4 letter will be discussed on 29 January, that the NSL approach has worked and was extended, that source policy is most effective, and that lane controls add little to urban air quality; costs were referred to the answer on question 2.
What the additional approach will look like I cannot say at this point.
Hoe de aanvullende aanpak er uit zal zien kan ik nu nog niet zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de kaspositie van KLM

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether KLM's roughly 1 billion euro cash position will stay under KLM's own management, whether KLM keeps control of its financial management, and whether the SAK foundations and MoU remain in force. State Secretary Mansveld answered that Air France KLM reported no plans to transfer KLM's surplus cash to the holding, that KLM will retain autonomy over its cash, banking and hedging, and that the foundations and MoU are maintained, though no final decision on financial management had yet been taken.

This means that KLM as an independent airline can continue to invest (such as in fleet financing) and remains responsible for its own cash flows, bank relations, management of its financial cash position and execution of its own hedging.

Dit betekent namelijk dat KLM als zelfstandige luchtvaartmaatschappij kan blijven investeren (zoals ten aanzien van vlootfinanciering) en verantwoordelijk blijft voor haar eigen kasstromen, bankrelaties, beheer van de financiële kaspositie en uitvoering van haar eigen «hedging».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat de chemiesector laks omgaat met regels

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that the chemical sector is lax in following safety and environmental rules, and about weak, fragmented supervision and public disclosure of risks. The government largely confirmed the picture from earlier investigations, pointed to the companies' primary responsibility and to BRZO+ cooperation and a national enforcement strategy, and promised to send an update before a committee meeting.
The cabinet also acknowledged that picture in its response to the OvV reports.
Het kabinet heeft dat beeld in de reactie op de rapporten van de OvV ook onderkend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over Uber

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries about Uber's UberPOP service continuing despite fines and a court ruling, its Dutch expansion, tax and criminal liability of drivers, and how the government will enforce the rules. The government replies that the ILT will keep enforcing the law and the court-ordered penalty, that the Belastingdienst applies VAT rules case by case, and that information for drivers will be expanded.
This means that Uber forfeits a penalty payment for each new violation the ILT establishes, up to a maximum of €100,000.
Dat betekent dat Uber bij elke nieuwe door de ILT geconstateerde overtreding een dwangsom verbeurt, tot een maximum van € 100.000,-.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de kosten voor een nieuwe OV-Chipkaart

An SP MP asks whether Trans Link Systems secretly raised the price of a personal OV-chipkaart by 3 euros as a processing fee, and why the government approved such an increase. The State Secretary answers that the fee is transparently communicated, that transport operators set the advisory price without government approval, and that online ordering avoids the extra charge.
The pricing of the card is determined by the transport operators; it is an advisory price and operators and governments may deviate from it.
De prijsstelling van de kaart wordt bepaald door de vervoerders, het betreft een adviesprijs en vervoerders en overheden kunnen afwijken van deze prijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jan Vos over de Maatlat Duurzame Veehouderij

MPs Van Dekken and Jan Vos asked whether the Maatlat Duurzame Veehouderij (sustainability scale for livestock farming) wrongly excludes energy-saving cooling systems like ECO200 that avoid high-GWP HFCs, and whether manufacturers are preparing for the 2020 HFC ban. The government answered that the scale does not exclude such systems but rates them by function, that ECO200 components were included in the energy theme, and that the new EU F-gas regulation provides sufficient incentive for innovation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over de regelgeving inzake onbemande luchtvaartuigen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about drone regulation: the rationale for hobbyists flying up to 25 kg without a permit while professional use requires one, support for initiatives like the Dutch Drone Academy, and a letter on the state of rules on privacy and safety. The government answered that a permit regime aligns with ICAO practice, that a framework for non-complex professional operations will be published soon, and that a WODC report and cabinet position will follow by February and summer 2015.
By February at the latest, the cabinet will send you the WODC report 'The use of drones; an exploratory study of unmanned aircraft', with a first cabinet position in outline.

Uiterlijk in februari zal het kabinet het WODC-rapport «Het gebruik van drones; Een verkennend onderzoek naar onbemande luchtvaartuigen», met een eerste kabinetsstandpunt op hoofdlijnen, aan u doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over storingen bij ProRail en de personeelsactie op 2 december 2014 bij NS

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary about rail disruptions on 2 December 2014 caused by a morning staff meeting at NS in The Hague, and about the causes of reported disruptions, staff grievances, and steps to make the network more robust. The state secretary answered that the meeting was effectively a work stoppage, that NS estimates about 40,000 passengers were delayed, that the government has no formal role in employer-employee contacts, and that infrastructure disruption counts show no increase in recent years.
I have no formal role or involvement in the contacts between employers and employees, including at NS.
Ik heb geen formele rol of betrokkenheid bij de contacten tussen werkgevers en werknemers, ook niet bij NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de grote brand op het industrieterrein in Maastricht

The MP asked whether toxic substances and asbestos were released in a large fire at a Maastricht industrial estate, why residents did not receive a NL-Alert, and about permits, inspections and fire safety. The Minister answered that no harmful concentrations were found, the NL-Alert was mistakenly replaced by Burgernet, inspections found the companies in order, and the distances to housing were adequate.
It is not known at which company the fire started.
Niet bekend is bij welk bedrijf de brand is ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht “melkvee heeft geen negatief effect op natuur”

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a V-focus article claiming dairy cattle have no negative effect on nature, and about a report on land-use interweaving in Noordoost-Twente. The State Secretary largely rejected the article's conclusions, stated that nature remains harmed by nitrogen deposition, and declined further studies and early answers while noting the EU Habitats Directive evaluation timetable.
Government policy aims to further build on this recovery while also giving agriculture (and other economic sectors) room, among other things through the Programmatic Approach to Nitrogen.

Het regeringsbeleid is erop gericht om dit herstel verder uit te bouwen én ook de landbouw (en andere economische sectoren) ruimte te geven, onder andere door middel van de Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat duizenden vliegpassagiers onterecht geen compensatie kregen bij vertraging

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether thousands of air passengers wrongly lost delay compensation and how the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) informs passengers and enforces their rights. The government denies that thousands were wrongly refused, says the ILT applies European Court rulings immediately, handles complaints and fines airlines that ignore its rulings, and promises an improved ILT passenger-rights website and continued consultation with consumer groups.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht ‘Treinstoring? Binnen 45 seconden een nooddienstregeling’

An MP asked the state secretary about news reports on a PhD thesis proposing mathematical models for rapid timetable adjustment during rail disruptions, and what recommendations, implementation plans and benefits apply. The state secretary replied that timetabling is NS's responsibility, that NS supports the research and is adapting its personnel software, and that models will supplement rather than replace standard draft plans, with predefined measures to be tested in 2015.
There are no plans to replace standard draft plans with automatic computer models.
Er zijn geen plannen om standaard draaiboeken te vervangen door automatische computermodellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over een kranteninterview met NS-topman Timo Huges

An MP asked the state secretary about a newspaper interview with the NS chief executive on door-to-door travel, cooperation among operators, single check-in pilots, student travel and overcrowded trains. The state secretary answered that cooperation is promoted through existing platforms, pilots and concession requirements, and that NS will be held to account on capacity without any compensation obligation.
I will inform the House very shortly about the transport plan.
Ik informeer uw Kamer zeer binnenkort over het vervoerplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de overlast veroorzaakt door ratten

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about rising rat nuisance, the effects of the 2014 ban on outdoor use of rodenticides, the status of the European pest management standard, and prevention plans. The government answered that rat reports rose from 2012 and the ban was partly reversed under conditions requiring Integrated Pest Management certification, with a transition period to 2017.
I will make an effort to ensure that this process is organised efficiently and cost-effectively.
Ik zal me inspannen om te zorgen dat dit proces efficiënt en kosteneffectief ingericht wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever, Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat een zwaar gesubsidieerde elektrische auto bijna net zoveel fijnstof produceert als een benzinewagen

Three PVV MPs asked whether the government will stop subsidising electric cars after a report claimed they emit almost as much fine particulate matter as petrol cars, and whether VAT and registration tax should be cut instead. Minister Kamp answered that total particulate emissions including brake and tyre wear are about a third lower for electric cars, that subsidies will be reconsidered in the Autobrief 2.0, and that the 160,000 euro-per-car figure is not recognised.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de uitstoot van elektrische auto’s

An MP asked the state secretary about a study claiming electric cars emit as much particulate matter as petrol cars, and whether a full lifecycle, real-world assessment of car pollution will be commissioned. The government calls the study one-sided, says electric cars emit about a third less particulate matter overall, and points to a recent CE-Delft/TNO lifecycle study showing about 35% lower CO2 but does not commit to a new independent study.
Are you willing to commission an independent study that at least includes the elements mentioned in question 4?
Bent u bereid om een onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten uitvoeren, waarin in ieder geval de in vraag 4 genoemde elementen worden betrokken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het schrappen van de OV-chipkaart op Texel

MP Bashir asks why the OV-chipkaart will no longer be accepted for bus travel on Texel from 14 December 2014, and whether the flat fare, loss of discounts and loss of student and annual-pass benefits are acceptable. The Staatssecretaris calls the situation undesirable, says the card will be valid again as soon as possible after a short gap of about 3-4 months, and says fare-setting is a provincial competence with the provincial authority promising lenient treatment of subscription holders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over de Isla raffinaderij in verhouding tot internationale milieuverdragen

MPs Hachchi and Van Veldhoven asked how the government's position that the Isla refinery's pollution and CO2 emissions are a purely Curaçao matter fits with Kingdom-wide treaty obligations, why the refinery is absent from the biodiversity report, and why some environmental treaties apply to the whole Kingdom and others only to the European part. The government answered that each country within the Kingdom is responsible for implementing environmental policy and its treaty obligations, that the refinery was excluded from the CBD report because it concerns green environment and little data exists, and that treaty application depends on extension requests and implementing legislation.
However, within the Kingdom each country is itself responsible for implementing environmental policy.
Echter binnen het Koninkrijk is elk land zelf verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van het milieubeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over de relatie tussen ammoniakuitstoot en emissiearme bemesting

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked whether measurement data cast doubt on the link between low-emission manure application and ammonia emissions, and whether the NEMA emission model was sound. The State Secretary answered that the scientific basis of ammonia policy was reviewed internationally without doubts, that the CDM was asked for a quick scan of the significant trend difference, and that Dutch ammonia measures are a national choice within EU ceilings.
Thereupon I asked the Expert Committee on the Fertilisers Act (CDM) to prepare a quick scan to explain the difference between the trends.
Daarop heb ik de Commissie Deskundigen Meststoffenwet (CDM) gevraagd een quick scan op te stellen om het verschil tussen de trends te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Dik-Faber en Van der Staaij over de vuurwerkopslag in Heerde

Three MPs (Oskam, Dik-Faber, Van der Staaij) asked whether a fireworks storage facility in Heerde close to a care centre and supermarket is safe, and whether other veiligheidsregio's should inventory similar risks. The state secretary replied that the Vuurwerkbesluit's construction requirements, sprinklers and fire resistance keep the effects of any calamity within the storage facility, declined to order a nationwide inventory, and described the uniform incident-response approach.
As I indicated in the answer to question 1, the consequences of any calamity are limited to the storage facility itself.
Zoals ik in het antwoord op vraag 1 heb aangegeven, beperken de gevolgen van een eventuele calamiteit zich tot de bewaarplaats zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht ‘Gevoel dat het heftiger wordt’ over de vele storingen en treinvertragingen in het noorden van Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about rail disruptions and delays in northern Netherlands, including ProRail's performance, causes of disruptions on the Roodeschool-Groningen line, regional authorities' influence over maintenance, and the usage fee increase. The state secretary answered that punctuality has been stable or improved, detailed causes of disruptions, pointed to consultation rights and performance indicators for regional authorities, and explained the fee methodology.
In addition, ProRail developed methodological changes at the instigation of the ACM and in line with the EU directive.
Daarnaast heeft ProRail vernieuwingen in de methodiek ontwikkeld op instigatie van de ACM
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het pleidooi van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) om het hoofdrailnet op te splitsen

An SP MP asked whether an ACM board member's call at Mobiliteitspoort for a study into splitting the main rail network, and his public comments, were appropriate, and whether ACM can be expected to make more such political statements. Minister Kamp replied that ACM is an independent authority that may speak publicly on its supervisory tasks but is limited on policy matters, that the speech fits its powers, that an independent study found negative effects for passengers from splitting the network, and that political positions belong to the ministers.
The government is currently considering whether the procedure for the Signal document should be included in the working agreements in the 2013 ACM–ministers relationship statute.
Momenteel wordt bezien of de werkwijze rondom het Signaal een plaats zou moeten krijgen in de onderlinge werkafspraken in het Relatiestatuut ACM en ministers 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Smaling en Ouwehand over het bericht dat de EU ervan afziet om teerzandolie te labelen

MPs Jasper van Dijk, Smaling and Ouwehand asked whether the EU's dropping of a separate label for tar sands oil, its impact on climate ambitions, CETA and TTIP, and possible import bans or labelling are acceptable. The State Secretary answered that tar sands oil is still legally importable, that no import ban or consumer labelling is feasible given traceability limits, and that EU climate targets are not weakened.
I have no plans to exclude tar sands oil from the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen plannen om teerzandolie te weren uit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over een statiegeldproject op een school in Apeldoorn

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that a school project in Apeldoorn on waste and recycling was obstructed by the Afvalfonds, which allegedly pressured the school into supporting a deposit scheme. The State Secretary answered that the initial application was rejected for lack of clarity on side effects, was approved after revision, that the Afvalfonds plays no substantive role in assessment, and listed the assessment criteria.
The Afvalfonds foundation plays no substantive role in assessing an application.
Stichting Afvalfonds speelt geen inhoudelijke rol bij de beoordeling van een aanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Van Dekken over het ongeval op de spoorwegovergang in Winsum van 14 oktober jongstleden

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary about a fatal accident at the Voslaan level crossing in Winsum and what measures ProRail would take to prevent future accidents. The government answered that talks with the municipality on closing or securing the crossing are ongoing, that a study of 22 crossings in Winsum is underway with concrete measures being costed, and that an evaluation of the non-actively secured crossings and a follow-up approach will be requested from ProRail.
To this end I will ask ProRail to carry out an evaluation in the coming months of the effectiveness of the approach to non-actively secured level crossings in recent years.
Daartoe zal ik ProRail vragen in de komende maanden een evaluatie te doen op de effectiviteit van de aanpak van de niet-actief beveiligde overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het ongeluk met fatale afloop op een onbeveiligde overgang bij Winsum

An MP asks the State Secretary about a fatal accident at an unprotected level crossing near Winsum and whether the crossing should be secured urgently under the national crossing improvement programme, and whether a mini-AHOB barrier could be installed quickly. The State Secretary regrets the accidents, says the programme budget is insufficient for this crossing, asks ProRail to evaluate the approach for unprotected crossings, and reports that ProRail and local authorities are assessing concrete options for Winsum.

To that end I will ask ProRail to carry out an evaluation over the coming months of the effectiveness of the approach to non-actively secured crossings in recent years and to submit a proposal for a follow-up approach to me soon.

Daartoe zal ik ProRail vragen de komende maanden een evaluatie te doen op de effectiviteit van de aanpak van de niet-actief beveiligde overwegen in de afgelopen jaren en mij spoedig een voorstel te doen voor een vervolgaanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Remco Dijkstra over Spoorhinder in Den Bosch en Rosmalen

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about rail noise and vibration complaints from residents in Den Bosch and Rosmalen, and about agreements made with them and possible speed limits for freight trains. The state secretary said the two cases differ, that noise and safety rules are met, that vibration is being studied and talks are ongoing, and that a speed-limit pilot in Rosmalen and an investigation for Den Bosch will be carried out.
Together with residents, the municipality and ProRail, my ministry will look into setting up a pilot.
Samen met omwonenden, de gemeente en ProRail zal mijn ministerie kijken naar de inrichting van een proef.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat de NS in Schotland gaat rijden

Two PVV MPs asked whether NS's Scottish rail subsidiary Abellio carries financial risks for the State as shareholder, and whether NS should stop international concessions to focus on domestic rail after the Fyra debacle. The Secretary of State replied that the UK concession model leaves most asset and personnel risk with the authority, that NS needs no capital or guarantees from the shareholder, that the €3.2 billion is a fixed operating payment rather than a price paid by NS, and that NS decides its own foreign concessions within agreed financial frameworks.
I do not share that view. NS has not paid €3.2 billion for the Scottish concession, but receives a fixed amount to cover operating costs.
Ik deel die mening niet. NS heeft geen € 3,2 miljard betaald voor de Schotse concessie, maar ontvangt een vast bedrag ter dekking van de exploitatiekosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Cegerek over louche asbestverwijderaars.

MPs Kerstens and Cegerek asked whether the government can stop asbestos removal firms that re-apply for certification through new legal entities after losing a certificate, and whether certification rules and oversight should change. Minister Asscher acknowledged about five firms tried to circumvent the rules, committed to tightening the certification scheme and intensifying Inspectorate enforcement, while rejecting a shift to a different oversight system for now.
I find it unacceptable that companies or persons, after a certificate has been withdrawn, continue their work in the same way under another certificate.
Ik vind het onaanvaardbaar dat bedrijven of personen na het intrekken van een certificaat onder een ander certificaat hun werkzaamheden op dezelfde manier voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de achteruitgang van vogelsoorten en de werkzame stof imidacloprid

An MP asked the state secretaries whether research showing that neonicotinoids such as imidacloprid also harm birds means the temporary EU moratorium is too limited, and whether the government will act and raise the study in Brussels. The state secretary refers to a separate letter to parliament of 27 October 2014 for all answers, without giving substantive content here.
For the answers to questions 1 through 4 I refer you to the letter to parliament.
Voor de antwoorden op de vragen 1 tot en met 4 verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Cegerek over het bericht “Duurzaam betekent niets meer”

MPs de Vries and Cegerek asked about a report claiming that 'sustainable' no longer means anything in construction, questioning builders' attitude to environmental rules, innovation, the National Environmental Database, and the reliability of certificates. The minister rejected the claim that builders reject environmental rules, defended the Nationale Milieudatabase and Green Deals, and said the government will study how consumers use certification labels and report to parliament.
The Tweede Kamer will be informed further about the results.
Over de resultaten wordt de Tweede Kamer nader ingelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het uitblijven van informatie over de nadere vormgeving van ketenverantwoordelijkheid in de chemische sector

Mr Smaling (SP) asked why the Veiligheid Voorop chemical sector partnership was given more time than agreed to produce a vision on supply-chain responsibility, and asked for a substantive letter before the 2015 budget debate. State Secretary Mansveld answered that primary responsibility lies with industry, that a sector-wide vision is being prepared and will be published soon, and that he will inform the House in the first quarter of 2015.
I will inform you in the first quarter of 2015 about the vision advocated by industry, assuming it has then been completed.
Ik zal u in het eerste kwartaal van 2015 over de door het bedrijfsleven voorgestane visie informeren, er van uitgaande dat deze dan is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman naar aanleiding van het bericht in de Gelderlander dat de gemeente Neder-Betuwe dumping van drugsafval hard gaat aanpakken

MPs Smaling and Kooiman asked how many drug waste dumpings occur, how much police and inspection capacity is devoted to them, and who pays for clean-up. The government answered that no national figures exist, that Brabant recorded about 150 dumpings in 2013, and that dedicated police capacity and cost recovery from offenders are being pursued.
As I set out in answer to earlier parliamentary questions, I do not have national figures on drug waste dumpings.
Antwoord 1, 2 Zoals ik in antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen 2 uiteen heb gezet beschik ik niet over landelijke cijfers over dumpingen van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Cegerek over de afvalstoffenbelasting

MPs Dijkstra and Cegerek asked about the waste tax taking effect in 2015, including export leakage, the effect on storage tonnages, the competitive position of the sector, and whether other EU countries have comparable export levies. The state secretary answered that export effects are expected to be limited but will be monitored, that the level playing field in the EU is not currently ensured, and that measures will be considered if leakage appears.
Should this monitoring show that undesirable leakage abroad does occur, it will be considered which measures are appropriate.
Mocht uit deze monitoring blijken dat er toch sprake is van een ongewenste ontwikkeling met weglek naar het buitenland dan zal worden bezien welke maatregelen passend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het advies van de Commissie voor de milieueffectrapportage over het ‘Luchthavenbesluit Lelystad Airport’

MP Kuiken asked the state secretary about the Commissie m.e.r. advice that the environmental impact report for the Lelystad Airport decision is incomplete, including the late nature-feasibility study, noise exposure in new neighbourhoods and handling of objections. The state secretary partly disagreed with the advice, explained the timing of the feasibility study, agreed to supplement noise data for route variants, and said objections will be documented and published after the Raad van State advice.

At the Commission's request, to complete the comparison material between the route variants, the picture of the number of people disturbed by noise and sleep disturbance for the other route variants will also be supplemented.

Op verzoek van de Commissie wordt om het vergelijkingsmateriaal tussen de verschillende routevarianten compleet te maken, ook het beeld van het aantal geluidgehinderden en slaapverstoring bij de overige routevarianten aangevuld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Cegerek over het bericht ‘Akzonobel overweegt chloortransport’

MPs Hoogland and Cegerek asked about risks of a possible chlorine transport by Akzo Nobel, who responsibility if something goes wrong, the criteria for incidental transports, and the necessity given a strike-related shortage. The State Secretary replied that strict rules and ILT supervision apply, that the company is primarily responsible, that a 2002 covenant allows limited incidental transports, and that the labour conflict is a matter between employer and employees.
For incidental chlorine transports there is 100% control, meaning all chlorine transports are checked against the applicable regulations.
Bij incidentele chloortransporten is er sprake van 100% controle wat inhoudt dat alle chloortransporten op de van toepassing zijnde regelgeving worden gecontroleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Smaling over het bericht ‘Mogelijk chloortrein van AkzoNobel door Overijssel vanwege staking Rotterdam’

Two SP MPs asked whether AkzoNobel's planned chlorine train transport through Overijssel, during a strike at its Rotterdam Botlek plant, is permitted under a 2002/2006 convenant and amounts to strike-breaking, and whether the government will intervene or press the employer on labour conditions. The Secretary of State answered that the convenant allows incidental transport to meet contracts, that the strike is a matter between employer and employees for the courts, that there is no legal basis to stop the transport, and that the ministry does not deal with labour relations.
In such cases it is for the court to rule on whether this constitutes strike-breaking.
Het is in voorkomende gevallen aan de rechter om een uitspraak te geven of dit stakingsbreking betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het grote aantal klachten over reizen met de OV-chipkaart

An MP asked the State Secretary about the large number of complaints over OV-chipkaart travel, including multiple check-ins, pay-by-account travel, bank card payment and the 2.50 euro fee for refunding card balance. The State Secretary answered that pilots and NOVB discussions are underway, and committed to report progress and to raise the refund fee within the NOVB.
I undertake to raise this in the NOVB.
Ik zeg u toe dat ik dit in zal brengen in het NOVB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over de milieueffectenanalyse van de Raamovereenkomst Verpakkingen

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary whether the environmental impact analysis of the packaging framework agreement, supported by the KIDV funded by industry, can be considered independent, given industry ties and the KIDV director's prior role in drafting the agreement. The state secretary replied that he formulated the assignment himself, the KIDV only supports and tenders the research, an advisory group with NGOs will be set up, the board is balanced between industry and government, and he will cover part of the costs.
Following the request by Ms Cegerek during the committee meeting of 18 June, an advisory sounding-board group will also be established.
Naar aanleiding van het verzoek van mevrouw Cegerek tijdens het AO van 18 juni jl. zal er ook een klankbordgroep opgericht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over het statiegeldsysteem van Aldi en Lidl

The SP MPs asked whether the Stichting Afvalfonds Verpakkingen may use waste-management levies to compensate supermarket chains Aldi and Lidl for ending their own deposit systems, and whether deposit packaging reduces litter. The state secretary answered that levies are used only for the declared purposes under the AVV, that no compensation is currently in play since no national deposit abolition has been decided, and that the deposit system is one of several litter-reduction instruments.
The board of the Afvalfonds Verpakkingen adopts the budget and ultimately checks the final settlement.
Het bestuur van het Afvalfonds Verpakkingen stelt de begroting vast en controleert uiteindelijk de eindafrekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de tarieven van NS op korte afstanden

An MP asked the state secretary about NS fare rules on short-distance trips, including the minimum fare, the double boarding fare on transfers, and the price gap between outward and return journeys. The state secretary defended the minimum fare as covering costs, said changing the fare system would have financial trade-offs for travellers, and committed only to raising the single-boarding-fare idea within the national public transport consultative body.
I think it is a good idea that the rail operators look at this together.
Ik vind het een goed idee dat de spoorvervoerders hier samen naar kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over snelheidsbeperkingen in de Drontermeertunnel en de spoortunnel Best

An MP asked the State Secretary about speed restrictions in the Drontermeer tunnel and the Best rail tunnel, including whether the design was flawed and whether damages should be recovered from the builder. The State Secretary answered that there is no design defect, the tunnel meets applicable norms, the issue arises from interaction between infrastructure and rolling stock, and no immediate action is needed beyond asking the sector to coordinate on comfort norms for future tunnels.
Although the observed nuisance gives no cause for immediate action, it is for me a reason to ask the rail sector to coordinate among themselves when building new tunnels.
Hoewel de geconstateerde hinder geen aanleiding geeft tot onmiddellijke actie, is het voor mij wel aanleiding om de spoorsector te verzoeken om bij aanleg van nieuwe tunnels onderling af te stemmen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de de spoorlijn Maastricht-Lanaken

An MP asked why the Maastricht–Lanaken rail line, renovated at great cost, has seen almost no freight traffic and whether it can be revived. The State Secretary said the line remains available, freight demand did not materialise on either side of the border, and he is positive about a light-rail proposal from the province, now under discussion with ProRail and the province.
I am positive about this proposal. ProRail, the Province of Limburg and I are in discussion about it.
Ik sta positief tegenover dit voorstel. ProRail, Provincie Limburg en ik zijn daarover in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over open sky tussen Suriname en de voormalige Nederlandse Antillen

An SP MP asked whether the Dutch government had signalled no interest in a full open-sky regime with Suriname and how the current air agreement works for flights between Schiphol and Paramaribo. The Foreign Minister answered that the existing agreement works satisfactorily, that Dutch airlines can still add two carriers per country, that the Antilles and Aruba air relations with Suriname are their own competence, and that Curaçao may conclude its own air deals.
The current air transport regime between the Netherlands and Suriname has so far been satisfactory.
Het huidige luchtvaartregime tussen Nederland en Suriname voldoet tot op heden naar tevredenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht dat toegangspoortjes op stations gevaarlijk kunnen zijn

MP Hoogland asked the State Secretary whether NS ticket gates that close suddenly are dangerous, how often people are injured, whether they meet safety requirements, and what will be done. The State Secretary answered that 25 people reported injuries to NS between January and September 2014, that the gates meet European safety rules and 76 acceptance criteria, and that NS will monitor incidents and evaluate gate timing if more occur.
I ask NS to closely monitor and evaluate incidents.
Ik vraag NS om nauwlettend incidenten te monitoren en te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het behouden van de nachttrein naar Kopenhagen, Praag en Warschau

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the planned cancellation of international night trains to Copenhagen, Prague and Warsaw by Deutsche Bahn and DSB, and whether the government would act to keep them. The government replied that international night trains are liberalised, the Dutch state has no formal relationship with DB or DSB and limited powers, that the Amsterdam-Berlin-Prague/Warsaw service ends in 2015 with a connection alternative, and that it will convey parliamentary concerns to NS and urge it to offer attractive products.
For international night trains, the national government therefore cannot grant concessions or prescribe rules.
Voor internationale nachttreinen kan de nationale overheid dus geen concessies verlenen of voorschriften bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over het bericht dat Lidl en Aldi afgekocht zijn

SP MPs asked the state secretary whether industry offered Lidl and Aldi compensation to stop collecting PET bottles, whether this lobbying aimed to abolish the deposit system, and whether competition law applies. The state secretary answered that compensation, if any, would come from the packaging industry's own fund (StAV), that the deposit system is not being abolished now, that parliament's review is planned for June 2015, and that competition-law assessment is for the companies themselves.
Making arrangements about offering compensation for possible financial disadvantages that Aldi and Lidl may suffer, I see as a private matter in which the government has no role.

Afspraken maken over het aanbieden van een compensatie voor de mogelijke financiële nadelen die Aldi en Lidl kunnen ondervinden, zie ik als een private aangelegenheid, waar de overheid geen rol in heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht dat Lidl en Aldi afgekocht zijn

An MP asked whether the CBL offered Aldi and Lidl compensation to drop their own deposit systems, and whether taxpayer money is involved. The Secretary of State said the offer comes from StAV's own funds financed by industry contributions, not taxpayers, and that such private arrangements are not a government matter.
Making arrangements about offering compensation for possible financial disadvantages Aldi and Lidl may suffer, I regard as a private matter in which the government has no role.

Afspraken maken over het aanbieden van een compensatie voor de mogelijke financiële nadelen die Aldi en Lidl kunnen ondervinden, zie ik als een private aangelegenheid, waar de overheid geen rol in heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Kooiman en Van Gerven over de publicatie ‘Verstand op veilig’

MPs Smaling, Kooiman and Van Gerven asked whether the government shares concerns from a Rathenau Instituut report that marketisation has strained the core tasks of national-security knowledge institutes, and whether it will convene stakeholders, examine horizontal cooperation and review inspectorates' reliance on these institutes. The minister denied that marketisation is a problem, cited existing funding and statutory safeguards, and declined new round-tables, new horizontal structures or a review, saying existing forums suffice.
The cabinet sees no reason in the report to sit down with the institutions concerned and other relevant parties outside existing forums where this already happens.
Het kabinet ziet in het rapport geen aanleiding om met de betrokken instellingen en andere relevante partijen om tafel te zitten buiten verbanden waarin dat al gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Ziengs en Van Veen over het artikel 'Miljoenenstrop door stoffen'

MPs Dijkstra, Ziengs and Van Veen asked about the European Commission's plan to add five substances to the RoHS II restriction list, whether the process followed REACH procedures, and what the costs and benefits would be. The Secretary of State answered that the Commission acted within the RoHS framework after consulting member states and stakeholders, that the costs are real but the benefits of phasing out hazardous substances justify them, and that the government sees no reason to intervene, while it will monitor exemption applications.
I therefore see no reason to hold the Commission to account on this.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding de Commissie hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht 'Loom-gekte over, dan plasticberg in afval'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Loom bands, made of non-recyclable or biodegradable plastic, should be sold, whether product requirements or collection schemes are needed, and whether producers can be pressed toward sustainable materials. The State Secretary said waste prevention is the market's responsibility, saw no need for product requirements or collection at present, and promised talks with retail and the toy sector on materials and end-of-life disposal.
I will consult with parties from retail and the toy industry about the materials used and how toys can be disposed of in an environmentally friendly way at the end of their life.

Ik zal met betrekking tot dit dossier met partijen uit de detailhandel en de speelgoedbranche in overleg treden over de gebruikte materialen en de wijze waarop speelgoed aan het eind van de levensduur milieuvriendelijk kan worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht met betrekking tot de mogelijke risico’s van loombandjes

An MP asked the state secretary about media reports that loom rubber bands may contain harmful substances and could end up as waste, and whether toy recycling receives attention. The government answered that the bands meet EU toy-safety chemical rules, are not harmful, that toy waste is not measured, and that toy recycling will be examined within the 'From Waste to Raw Material' programme.
From the 'From Waste to Raw Material' programme I will look into whether toys are a waste stream with potential for closing loops.
Ik zal vanuit het programma «Van Afval naar Grondstof» bekijken of speelgoed een stroom is die potentie heeft voor het sluiten van ketens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht ‘Bedrijven staan niet te trappelen om hun stukje spoor over te nemen’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that companies are unwilling to take over rail sidings, whether maintaining rail links for businesses is important, what measures will bring more freight onto rail, whether public funding should cover freight rail, and whether NS's siding duties could move to ProRail. The state secretary confirmed the importance of rail freight, listed Long-Term Rail Agenda actions and a rail freight table, said no figures exist on firms' rail use, and said a scenario study on moving siding tasks to ProRail is under way at no cost to the state.
I am currently researching, together with the sector, how the tasks of NS Spooraansluitingen can best be carried out.
Momenteel onderzoek ik samen met de sector hoe de taken van NS Spooraansluitingen het beste kunnen worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een nieuw treindebacle

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary about high breakdown rates and falling punctuality of the IC Direct trains, the reliability of NS's Traxx locomotives, and what measures would be taken. The State Secretary answered that NS and ProRail have introduced measures including a quick-response team, new rolling stock, and periodic reporting to parliament.
I have asked NS and ProRail to periodically inform me about the progress and effects of these measures.
Ik heb NS en ProRail gevraagd mij periodiek te informeren over de voortgang en de effecten van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat ook de opvolger van de Fyra steeds vaker uitvalt

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about rising cancellations on the IC Direct high-speed train (Fyra successor) between Amsterdam and Breda, requesting statistics, causes, remedial measures, and penalties. The government answered with monthly cancellation and punctuality figures, attributed causes mainly to rolling stock shortages and partly to infrastructure and external factors, listed NS and ProRail measures, and noted a penalty regime from 2015.
NS and ProRail have meanwhile taken measures to bring the cancellations down quickly again.
NS en ProRail hebben inmiddels maatregelen genomen om de uitval weer snel omlaag te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat recyclebaar afval wordt verbrand als gevolg van extra overheidssteun voor biomassa

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked whether SDE+ subsidies for bioenergy divert recyclable biomass and waste (A-wood, pallets, pruning wood, potato peels) away from material reuse, contrary to the circular economy goal. The minister replied that bioenergy is needed for renewable targets and cascading will be monitored, that the SDE+ uses market prices for biomass, and that the Landelijk Afvalbeheerplan and VANG programme will be evaluated or explored without committing to binding restrictions.
In my letter to the House of Representatives on cascading I indicated that a condition of government steering is that no structural displacement effects arise that obstruct high-value applications.

In mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer over cascadering heb ik aangegeven dat een randvoorwaarde bij overheidssturing is dat er geen structurele verdringingseffecten ontstaan die hoogwaardige toepassingen belemmeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de aanpak van drugsafval

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked whether a fund could be created, financed from Plukze proceeds, to compensate landowners for clearing dumped drug waste, and what clean-up costs were in 2012 and 2013. The minister answered that no legal barriers exist but the cabinet is reluctant to create budget funds, that costs should fall on the perpetrator, and estimated Noord-Brabant clean-up costs at about 1.5 million euro in 2012 and 3 million euro in 2013.
The costs that landowners face for clearing dumped drug waste should primarily be borne by the perpetrator.
De kosten waarmee grondeigenaren worden geconfronteerd om gedumpt drugsafval op te ruimen dienen primair ten laste te komen van de dader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en De Graaf over het bericht dat een buschauffeur een persoon in een boerka heeft geweigerd

MPs Madlener and De Graaf asked the government about a report that a bus driver refused a woman wearing a burqa, and whether burqa bans should be pursued given security concerns. The State Secretary answered that the government considers face-covering clothing undesirable where communication is seriously hindered, that a legal ban in education, care, public transport and government buildings is being prepared, and that the driver's refusal was contrary to the carrier's rules, so apologies were offered.
According to the carrier's company rules, the burqa wearer should have been treated in the same way as all other passengers.
Volgens de bedrijfsregels van de vervoerder had de boerka-draagster op dezelfde manier behandeld moeten worden als alle andere reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over statiegeld op bierflesjes

An MP asked the state secretary whether beer bottles without deposit (statiegeld) undermine the deposit system, whether that increases litter, and whether producers should compensate landowners and be forced to introduce deposits on small bottles. The state secretary answered that deposit is a producer's free choice, that reusable bottles still carry deposit, that the effect on litter is still being studied, and that she will not mandate deposit on beer bottles in the 2014 decree.
As previously stated in parliamentary debates, I steer on goals and means such as deposit are subordinate to them.
Zoals eerder in Kamerdebatten aangegeven, stuur ik op doelen en zijn de middelen, zoals statiegeld, daaraan ondergeschikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid het lid Visser over de introductie van de dienst UberPOP in Amsterdam

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about the launch of UberPOP in Amsterdam, the ILT's enforcement, the legal basis for banning it, tax treatment, taxi maximum tariffs, enforcement capacity and the Taxiwet evaluation. The state secretary answered that unlicensed UberPOP driving is illegal taxi transport that the inspectorate rightly tackles, outlined the tax and liability position, and committed to evaluating the Taxiwet and informing the House around the turn of the year.
Private drivers who operate without a licence and driver's card, including via UberPOP, as a result carry out illegal taxi transport.
Particuliere chauffeurs die zonder een vergunning en chauffeurskaart opereren, ook via UberPOP, verrichten als gevolg daarvan illegaal taxivervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over rotte-eierenlucht bij Deurne

MPs Smaling and Van Gerven asked about H2S (rotten-egg) gas near Deurne, the expert panel's findings on health risks, pyrite and fertiliser causes, and whether fertiliser levels should be reviewed. The government answered that exposure effects are temporary, that more regional and local pyrite knowledge is needed, and that the nitrate action programme and a manure-fermentation evaluation are under way, with results promised for early 2015.
A policy evaluation on manure fermentation is under way, and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and I will send you the results in the first quarter of 2015.
Ten aanzien van mestvergisting is een beleidsevaluatie gaande, waarvan de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en ik u in het eerste kwartaal van 2015 de resultaten zullen doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren naar aanleiding van het bericht “CPB onderzoekt gevolgen “instortend” Schiphol”

An MP asked whether the CPB is studying the economic effects of Schiphol losing its hub function and whether this affects the Lelystad expansion. The government denied any such commissioned study, explaining only that the CPB and PBL are updating long-term scenarios in which the hub position is one uncertainty, without economic effects being examined.
No. The Netherlands Bureau for Economic Policy Analysis (CPB) is not conducting research into the economic consequences of Schiphol losing its hub function, including in relation to Lelystad.
Nee. Het Centraal Planbureau (CPB) doet geen onderzoek naar de economische gevolgen van het wegvallen van de hubfunctie van Schiphol, ook niet in relatie tot Lelystad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmermans betreffende de leeftijdgrens in de ballonvaart

Baay-Timmermans asks whether a new EU rule bars commercial balloon pilots aged 65 and over, whether sector consultation took place, and whether the Netherlands will exempt balloon pilots or compensate them. The state secretary confirms the EU age limit of 65 under FCL.065, says the sector was consulted, and states the Netherlands supports a UK proposal for an exemption at EASA while rejecting national compensation.
The Netherlands has expressed support in the EASA Committee for the proposal of the United Kingdom.
Nederland heeft steun uitgesproken in het EASA Comité voor het voorstel van Groot-Brittannië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de arbeidsvoorwaarden bij de luchtvaartmaatschappij Norwegian Air Shuttle

An MP from the PvdA asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the Irish-registered Norwegian Air structure, Irish oversight of its operations, and Dutch measures to protect jobs and fair competition. The State Secretary said the matter is under EU discussion, the US decision is pending, and pointed to an EU social-partner study due at year end and a sector employment plan.
As long as there is no decision on this, I do not consider it advisable to comment on the statements mentioned.
Zolang hierover nog geen uitsluitsel is vind ik het niet raadzaam om commentaar te geven over de genoemde uitspraken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Visser over het aan te leggen stuk spoor bij Beverwijk en overige werkzaamheden naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek van de leden van de VVD-fractie aan Tata Steel in IJmuiden

Two VVD MPs asked about extending the Beverwijk rail head track to 750 metres, the cost of rail freight, and coordination of overlapping infrastructure works in the North Sea Canal area. The State Secretary answered that ProRail is responsible for the track extension due in 2016, that rail freight measures are in the Long-Term Rail Agenda, and that Rijkswaterstaat coordinates works through annual multi-year planning and regional consultation.
It is of great importance for businesses that infrastructure works are well coordinated with one another.
Het is voor bedrijven van groot belang dat werkzaamheden aan de infrastructuur goed op elkaar worden afgestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht invallen en arrestaties in afvalfraude

An MP asked the government about reports of raids and arrests in a waste-fraud case, including why the illegal activity was not stopped earlier, to whom illegal waste was sold, and whether public health was endangered. The Minister of Justice declined to answer the questions on who was involved and why action came late, citing the ongoing criminal investigation, and said only that waste fraud can pose risks, which the investigation must establish.
The criminal investigation being conducted under the direction of the Public Prosecution Service has not yet been concluded.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat plaatsvindt onder leiding van het Openbaar Ministerie is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het klimaat- en energiebeleid

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about internal EU-level preparations on the 2030 climate and energy framework, including whether surplus 'hot air' could carry into the post-2020 period and weaken the 40% emissions target. The state secretary answered every question only by referring to ongoing preparatory work, the forthcoming PBL/ECN study and future briefings, and restated the government's position of at least 40% CO2 reduction and 27% renewables at EU level.

At present it is still unknown how the European balance of power will develop, which negotiating options will be on the table, and what consequences the different options may have for the Netherlands.

Momenteel is nog onbekend hoe het Europese krachtenveld zich zal ontwikkelen, welke onderhandelingsopties op tafel zullen liggen, en welke consequenties verschillende opties voor Nederland kunnen hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het Ontwerpbesluit tot wijziging van het Besluit personenvervoer 2000 en andere besluiten in verband met de Wet afschaffing plusregio’s

MP Van Raak asked why the draft decree implementing the abolition of the plusregio's was submitted for consultation during the summer recess, whether this conflicts with the rules on consultation periods, and why it was not postponed until the Senate had dealt with the underlying bill. The Staatssecretary answered that the consultation period was extended to 30 September 2014 under the rules for recesses, that the earlier letter is supplemented rather than withdrawn, and that the draft could be submitted before the Senate finished the bill because the delegation scope is fixed once the House has adopted it.
The letter of 14 July 2014 is supplemented with this letter and not withdrawn.
