De brief van 14 juli 2014 wordt met deze brief aangevuld en niet ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries, Jacobi en Kuiken over de plannen voor ontwikkeling van het KNSF-terrein in Muiden

PvdA MPs asked the minister about the draft zoning plan for the former KNSF site in Muiden, including very high building heights, its effect on the Kruitbos nature area, the EUR 376 million damage claim, and Schiphol flight path and Stelling van Amsterdam implications. The minister answered that zoning is the municipality's responsibility and that the Council of State is the appeal forum, while stating that nature agreements are upheld and that the damage claims are frozen pending the plan becoming final.
Under the Spatial Planning Act (Wro), it is the municipality's responsibility to adopt zoning plans for 'good spatial planning'.
Op grond van de Wet ruimtelijke ordening (Wro) is het de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente om bestemmingsplannen vast te stellen ten behoeve van «een goede ruimtelijke ordening».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Smaling over het bericht “Geen doorstart luchthaven Twente”

MPs Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven and Smaling asked whether the Twente airport decision procedure should be halted after the regional initiator stopped pursuing a commercial airport, and whether the military airport designation and regulation could still apply. The state secretary replied that talks with the region are ongoing, that the procedure's consequences will be reviewed, and that military designation of Twente will be extended to 1 November 2016 for existing users.
I will consult with the region about the situation that has arisen.
Ik ga met de regio in overleg over de ontstane situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het stilleggen van de dienstregeling op het spoor rond Alkmaar, Haarlem en Den Haag

An MP asked why train services around Alkmaar, Haarlem and The Hague were fully halted in May 2014 due to GSM-R and telephone exchange failures, whether the back-up systems worked, and how passengers were informed. The State Secretary answered that the GSM-R network itself functioned, the failures were in local exchanges, the back-up partly failed, and he will require ProRail and NS to improve reliability, disaster tolerance by end-2015, and passenger information in new concessions.
I believe passenger information and service must improve.
Ik vind dat de informatievoorziening en dienstverlening aan de reiziger beter moet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het schrappen van de laatste trein tussen Hoorn – Enkhuizen

MP Smaling asked why the last two trains between Hoorn and Enkhuizen were cut for track maintenance, whether alternatives like single-track operation or buses were considered, and whether the minister would talk with NS and ProRail. The state secretary answered that low ridership justified cutting the late trains, that single-track alternatives do not apply on this single-track line, and that he sees no need for further talks since the timetable is NS's responsibility.
I do not consider it necessary to talk with ProRail and NS about this.
Ik vind het niet nodig hierover met ProRail en NS in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Leegte over de brandstoffenmix

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about double-counting of CO2 emissions in well-to-wheel calculations of fuel mixes, and whether a future vision process could be independently reviewed. The state secretary answered that electricity generation and refining are equivalent in double-counting terms, gave a table comparing electric and combustion vehicles, and said the vision process is open to stakeholders, reviewed, and will become a recurring three-yearly exercise under new EU rules.
There is no fundamental difference between electricity generation and refining when it comes to double counting in the well-to-wheel emissions calculation.
Er is geen principieel verschil tussen elektriciteitsopwekking en raffinage als het gaat om dubbeltelling in de berekening van well-to-wheel emissies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en De Rouwe over de oldtimermaatregel

Members Omtzigt and De Rouwe (CDA) asked about the implementation of the oldtimer vehicle tax exemption, including information given to owners, the handling of bills and objections, and revenue estimates. The government answered that rushed implementation strained the Tax Authority's information and processing, that bills were sent in April and May 2014 with thousands of objections received, and that current data are insufficient to revise the EUR 137 million revenue estimate.
The very short implementation period of the oldtimer measure has put the implementation by the Tax Authority and the information provided to taxpayers under pressure.
De zeer korte implementatietijd van de oldtimermaatregel heeft er toe geleid dat de uitvoering door de Belastingdienst en de voorlichting aan de belastingplichtigen onder druk is komen te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman over de mishandeling van spoorwegpersoneel

MPs Smaling and Kooiman asked the government about the assault on rail staff, prevention measures, operator practices and court sentencing. The state secretary answered that the case is under investigation, outlined a Veilige Publieke Taak programme and existing measures, and said regional operators' cost and measure details would follow later.

I have asked the relevant subnational governments and PT authorities, as responsible concession grantors toward the regional rail operators, to provide insight into measures and costs regarding social safety.

Ik heb aan de betreffende decentrale overheden en OV- autoriteiten als verantwoordelijk concessieverlener richting de regionale spoorvervoerders (Arriva, Connexxion, Syntus en Veolia) gevraagd om inzicht te geven in maatregelen en kosten op het gebied van sociale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en De Boer over een bericht in het Eindhovens Dagblad van 28 mei 2014, dat reizen naar Brussel per Thalys goedkoper is met een kaartje naar Parijs

MPs Hoogland and De Boer asked why a Thalys ticket to Brussels can be cheaper when bought as a ticket to Paris, and whether the minister would negotiate with NS to offer the cheapest possible fare. The state secretary explained that Thalys uses yield management pricing set by seat availability and expected demand, that the Thalys is not regulated by national or European rules so operators set their own fares, and that more Thalys services are expected to increase cheaper ticket options.
The Thalys is a train product that is not regulated by national or European rules.
De Thalys is een treinproduct dat niet door nationale of Europese regels wordt gereguleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de strijd tegen hennep en het dumpen van illegaal afval in Noord-Brabant

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice and the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the fight against cannabis and synthetic drug crime and illegal drug-waste dumping in North Brabant, including police capacity, cross-border cooperation, legal frameworks and a proposed guarantee fund. The minister answered that enforcement capacity is sufficient and is being strengthened, that legalising cannabis cultivation is not a solution, that a joint approach and cross-border action programme are in preparation, and that Pluk Ze funds cannot be earmarked for victims of dumping.
Police and the Public Prosecution Service are on track to meet the target I set when I took office in 2010.
Politie en OM liggen op koers bij de realisatie van de doelstelling die ik bij mijn aantreden in 2010 heb gesteld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Dik-Faber over het bericht dat het eerste schip met teerzandolie volgende week in Europa aankomt

MPs Van Veldhoven and Dik-Faber asked whether the first shipment of Canadian tar sands oil reaching Europe would reach the Netherlands, whether consumers could choose non-tar-sands fuel, and how this fits EU climate policy. The minister replied that the government has no insight into individual oil transactions or origin data, that mandatory origin labelling is not required internationally, and that the Fuel Quality Directive rules on crude sourcing will be discussed once the Commission proposal is out.
The Dutch government also does not hold data on the place of purchase and origin of oil.
De Nederlandse overheid beschikt ook niet over gegevens over plaats van aankoop en herkomst van olie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht dat het mestbeleid een koude douche voor boeren is

An MP from the CDA asked the government about a press report that manure policy is a cold shower for farmers, questioning whether the cabinet ignores business input, why LTO's proposals on the fifth Nitrates Action Programme were not adopted, the status of equivalent-measures and phosphate-chain agreements, and whether negotiation documents with the European Commission on the derogation will be shared. The State Secretary largely defended the process, refused to release negotiation documents and departmental involvement details, and acknowledged that communication on the phosphate-fertiliser ban could have been better, without offering an apology.
I will not make available any documents relating to the course of the negotiations with the European Commission.
Ik zal geen documenten ter beschikking stellen die betrekking hebben op het verloop van de onderhandeling met de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht «Antifraudecomputer in taxi zo lek als mandje»

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that the taxi onboard computer (BCT) is leaky, privacy-invasive, fraud-prone and late, and about the deadline extensions. The state secretary answered in detail, defending the BCT's fraud-resistance and privacy safeguards, acknowledging the deadline shifts, and explaining the subsidy extension and costs.

My ministry has regularly consulted with representatives of the taxi sector, KNV Taxi and individual entrepreneurs, the manufacturers, the RDW and the Tax Administration on the specifications of the BCT.

Met vertegenwoordigers van de taxibranche, KNV Taxi en individuele ondernemers, met de fabrikanten, met de RDW en met de Belastingdienst heeft mijn ministerie regelmatig overleg gevoerd over de specificaties van de BCT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Jan Vos over de dubbeltellingregeling voor betere biobrandstoffen

MPs Bisschop and Jan Vos asked the government about the Corbey Commission's advice to simplify the double-counting scheme for advanced biofuels, including abolishing partial double counting, and about the lack of a level playing field in the EU. The Secretary of State agreed to adopt the advice on removing partial double counting using a 70/30% threshold, to be implemented by the NEa by year-end, and offered affected parties a choice about existing decisions.
I adopt this part of the advice and will swiftly amend the regulations accordingly.
Ik neem dit gedeelte van het advies over en pas de regelgeving daarop snel aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en van Tongeren over de mogelijkheid om een spoorverbinding tussen Utrecht en Breda te realiseren langs de A27

MPs Smaling and van Tongeren asked why the government chose to widen the A27 between Utrecht and Breda for over 800 million euro rather than a rail link, and whether a rail line was studied, including its jobs and benefits. The State Secretary answered that the widening addresses a capacity problem on a national freight and traffic corridor, that the rail link was studied and rejected on a cost-benefit score of 0.05 with investment costs above 4 billion euro, and that infrastructure investment will continue to support jobs.
From these studies the conclusion was drawn that it is not justified to take further steps regarding this possible new railway line.
Uit deze onderzoeken is de conclusie getrokken dat het niet verantwoord is verdere stappen te ondernemen ten aanzien van deze mogelijke nieuwe spoorlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de openbaarheid van punctualiteitsgegevens van ProRail

An MP asked the State Secretary why RTL could not obtain detailed punctuality data for trains, and whether ProRail should publish route-level and real-time data as open data. The State Secretary answered that the detailed data belong to the operators and are confidential under access agreements, that ProRail is not subject to the Dutch Open Government Act, and that new concessions will require more transparency on punctuality by line and by time and location.
ProRail does not fall under the Open Government Act (Wet openbaarheid van bestuur), as recently confirmed by the Council of State.
ProRail valt, zoals recentelijk is bevestigd door de Raad van State, niet onder de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Van Dekken over het bericht dat milieuvergunningen voor veehouderijen al jaren op verkeerde geurberekeningen zijn gebaseerd

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about reports that livestock environmental permits were based on flawed odour calculations using the V-Stacks model, and whether this harms residents and the transition to sustainable farming. The state secretary acknowledged the Noord-Brabant study, said discrepancies appear only in specific situations, promised further testing, a model adjustment within months and guidance to municipalities, but disputed the call for a full evaluation of the odour system.
I expect to have an answer within a few weeks on the exact situations in which deviations in the model affect a permit decision and how often those situations occur.

Ik verwacht binnen enkele weken antwoord op de vraag in welke exacte situaties afwijkingen binnen het model gevolgen heeft voor een besluit tot vergunningverlening en hoe vaak die situaties voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over het bericht ‘vergunningen veehouderij gebaseerd op rekenfouten’

Two SP MPs asked the state secretaries about reports that livestock odour permits rest on calculation errors, including the legal consequences, the province of Noord-Brabant's requests, health effects, and whether the odour law and maximum odour loads should be tightened. The government says the V-Stacks model works in most situations, that existing permits are unaffected, and that a targeted model adjustment and guidance for municipalities will follow, but it declines to tighten the law now and leaves cumulative odour checks to municipalities.
I will ensure a solution for the short term.
Ik zal zorgen voor een oplossing voor de korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het recyclen van luiers

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about recycling nappies, the cost of recycling versus incineration, and the government's plans. The state secretary said a study with the waste association NVRD will examine options for incontinence material, with results expected in the first half of 2015, and that no Dutch facility currently recycles it.
Together with the Dutch association for waste and cleansing management (NVRD), a study will be carried out, and other chain partners will be involved.
Samen met de Nederlandse Vereniging van afval- en reinigingsmanagement (NVRD) zal een onderzoek worden verricht, andere ketenpartners worden hier bij betrokken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Otwin van Dijk over het oordeel van het College voor de Rechten van Mens over het door Veolia gemaakte onderscheid op basis van handicap of chronische ziekte

MPs Hoogland and Van Dijk asked the State Secretary about a College for Human Rights ruling that transport operator Veolia discriminated against a wheelchair user by not providing temporary assistance. The State Secretary said the ruling reinforces the need for broader accessibility measures, that the province as concession grantor is responsible and has held talks, and that he will bring the ruling to the attention of the concession-granting bodies' associations.
I will also bring this to the attention of the province of Limburg, which manages the concession, by letter.
Ik zal dit ook per brief onder de aandacht brengen van de provincie Limburg die de concessie beheert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over vervuilende tweetakt scooters

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about a Swiss study finding two-stroke scooters a major air polluter, and whether bans, stricter EU emission norms, local low-emission zones and stronger inspection could be pursued. The state secretary rejected a short-term sales ban as incompatible with EU type-approval rules, pointed to 2017 EU emission limits and an evaluation, said local restrictions are problematic, and promised a letter on enforcement.
A sales ban in the Netherlands in the short term is not on the agenda.
Een verkoopverbod in Nederland op korte termijn is niet aan de orde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Agnes Mulder en Geurts over de olielekkage uit opslag in lege zoutmijnen in het natuurgebied Amtsvenn (bij Enschede) en de geplande extra opslag van diesel in lege zoutmijnen onde

MPs Omtzigt, Mulder and Geurts asked about an oil leak from strategic oil storage in salt caverns at Amtsvenn in Germany and about planned diesel storage in salt caverns under Enschede, including risks to the Netherlands and whether operations should wait. The minister replied that the leak likely lies in a borehole casing, that Dutch risks are considered low, that the Enschede design differs and is monitored, that the regulator SodM can intervene, and that AkzoNobel may proceed with preparatory work but has said it will not store diesel until the German cause is clear.
If at any point I see a need to intervene, I can, under article 50 of the Mining Act, prescribe measures in cases of serious harm to safety or the environment or ground movement.

Indien ik op enig moment noodzaak zie tot ingrijpen, kan ik op grond van artikel 50 van de Mijnbouwwet, in gevallen van ernstige aantasting van de bescherming van de veiligheid, het milieu of in gevallen van beweging van de aardbodem, maatregelen voorschrijven.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de olielekkage uit opslag in lege zoutmijnen in het natuurgebied Amtsvenn (Duitsland, bij Enschede) en de geplande extra opslag van diesel in lege zoutmijnen onder Ensche

An MP from D66 asked about liability for oil leaks in nature areas, the location and subsurface suitability of planned diesel storage in salt caverns under Enschede, alternatives, and risks by substance. The minister answered that the permit holder would be liable, that the planned storage is near several nature and drinking water areas, and that underground storage was chosen for cost, safety and strategic reasons.
Under the Civil Code article 175 and 177, the permit holder is liable for damage to nature and the living environment if oil leaks in nature areas were to occur in the Netherlands.

Op grond van het Burgerlijk Wetboek 6, artikel 175 en artikel 177, is de vergunninghouder aansprakelijk voor schade aan natuur en leefomgeving indien olielekkages in natuurgebieden zich in Nederland voor zouden doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het voorstel dat een nationaal teeltverbod op gengewassen mogelijk zou moeten maken

Deputy MP Ouwehand asked the state secretaries whether the proposal giving member states a national power to ban GM crop cultivation had changed, which countries block it, whether the Netherlands can support a proposal that does not meet the Ouwehand motion, and whether a political debate should precede any decision. The government answered only by referring the Chamber to a recent letter on the proposal and the expected Environment Council discussion.
For the answers to your questions I refer you to the recent letter sent to your Chamber on the proposal for national cultivation competence
Voor de beantwoording van uw vragen verwijs ik u naar de recent aan uw Kamer gestuurde brief over het voorstel voor nationale teeltbevoegdheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Veldhoven naar aanleiding van het bericht van 28 april 2014 dat de alternatieve taxidienst Uber wordt verboden in Brussel en Berlijn

MPs Verhoeven and Van Veldhoven asked whether Dutch law accommodates innovative platforms such as Uber and Airbnb, after bans in Brussels and Berlin. The minister answered that existing taxi rules pose no obstacles to intermediaries like Uber, that the taxi part of the Passenger Transport Act will be evaluated in autumn 2014, and that the German and Belgian rulings do not affect EU internal market policy.
In autumn 2014 the taxi part of the Passenger Transport Act 2000 will be evaluated.
In het najaar van 2014 wordt het taxideel van de Wet personenvervoer 2000 geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Smalling over het bericht ’10 euro voor 780 meter trein’

MPs Bashir and Smaling asked whether a Belgian senior train ticket being invalid at the border, while a Dutch ticket was valid up to it, was confusing for passengers, and how many fines were issued on the Essen-border stretch. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the confusing ticket conditions, said the fine figures were requested from NMBS and not yet available, and committed to asking NS to seek a solution with the Belgian operator and to inform the Chamber.
NMBS has been asked whether it has this information.
Aan NMBS is gevraagd of zij beschikt over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de advisering door de Technische Commissie Bodem

MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether the Technical Commission Soil Protection (TCB) may legally consider ammonia emissions when advising on a research exemption for surface spreading of manure, arguing its advice should be limited to soil protection. The state secretary answered that the law does not restrict TCB advice to soil protection, that ammonia effects fall within its remit, and that the government will weigh but not be bound by TCB advice.
In the final decision that the State Secretary for Infrastructure and the Environment and I take, the views of the TCB are weighed, but we make our own assessment.
In het uiteindelijke besluit dat de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en ik nemen, wegen de opvattingen van de TCB mee, maar wij maken onze eigen afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Paulus Jansen inzake het voornemen dienstregeling Uithoflijn door het BRU

Two SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that the Uithoflijn tram, built with 110 million euro in national subsidy, will not run in evenings and at weekends, and whether the national government agreed service hours with the regional authority BRU. The state secretary replied that no specific service-hour agreements were made, that service levels are the responsibility of the regional authority under the Wet Personenvervoer, and that he will not intervene in that responsibility.
Investigating traveller needs in the Utrecht region and determining a suitable public transport offer is primarily a responsibility of the decentralised authorities (Passenger Transport Act).

Het onderzoeken van de behoeften van reizigers in de regio Utrecht en het bepalen van een daarbij passend OV-aanbod is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de decentrale overheden (Wet Personenvervoer).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Leegte over het visietraject duurzame brandstoffenmix

MPs Dijkstra and Leegte asked about a working group on a sustainable fuel mix, the tank-to-wheel versus well-to-wheel CO2 accounting, consumer choice, environmental effects of batteries, and whether the chair of the gas-vehicle table, linked to a company with gas interests, could guarantee an objective outcome. The government answered that the process is broad and multi-stakeholder, that the vision and an action plan with cost-benefit analysis will follow, and that stakeholder diversity ensures objectivity.
I will send the vision to your House after the summer.
Ik zal de visie na de zomer aan uw Kamer toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek, Nijboer en van Dekken Milieu over overlast vanwege laagfrequent geluid

MPs Cegerek, Nijboer and van Dekken asked the State Secretary about residents' complaints of low-frequency noise near the NAM gas storage site at Grijpskerk, Zuidhorn. The government answered that studies found no clear cause for the complaints, so no basis remains for targeting a specific source, and it informed the Zuidhorn mayor accordingly.
In this specific case, research has not identified a clear cause for the complaints.
In dit specifieke geval is uit onderzoek geen duidelijke oorzaak voor de klachten naar voren gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over landingsbeperkingen voor vrachtvliegtuigen op Schiphol

An MP asked whether the Dutch government refuses cargo airlines landing rights at Schiphol and whether it would consult stakeholders on easing conditions for freight flights. The state secretary answered that non-EU carriers need route permits based on bilateral agreements or case-by-case weighing, that refusals occur in a limited number of cases, that the government cannot assess other countries' decisions, and that it is willing to consult the air cargo sector on the assessment framework.
I have no insight into requests for traffic rights made in other countries, such as Belgium and Germany.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de verzoeken voor verkeersrechten die worden gedaan in andere landen, zoals België en Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Kuiken over het bericht dat de Raad van State een streep heeft gezet door de bouw van 700 woningen bij Schiphol

MPs Albert de Vries and Kuiken asked whether the Council of State's ruling blocking 700 homes near Schiphol affects future housing plans and the airport, and whether support was sought before the zoning plan was adopted. The state secretary answered that the municipalities bear responsibility for weighing aircraft noise in zoning decisions, that the ruling does not affect airport use, and that Haarlemmermeer ran a broad participation process linked to the A9 relocation.
This concerns the responsibility of the relevant municipalities to seek support and ensure a sound weighing of interests.
Het betreft hier de verantwoordelijkheid van betreffende gemeenten om draagvlak te zoeken en te zorgen voor een goede afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Rouwe over een tunnel bij Hurdegaryp

An MP asks whether the government will support a proposed tunnel at Hurdegaryp that would replace two level crossings, and why the project dropped off the earlier crossing-safety subsidy list. The minister says the benefits cannot yet be judged, the project was not registered in time for the earlier programme, and it may be considered for the second tranche of a national crossings programme, with a decision expected in autumn 2014.
As promised in the committee debate of 15 April, I will inform your House after the May recess about the progress of the LVO.
Zoals toegezegd in het AO LTSa van 15 april jongstleden zal ik uw Kamer na het meireces informeren over de voortgang van het LVO
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Lodders, Visser en De Liefde over het einde aan de betutteling van het milieubeleid

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government's Duurzaam Doen website and planned environmental measures amount to an end to paternalism in environmental policy, and about its cost, related initiatives, and the basis for recommending meat reduction. The minister answered that the site offers practical guidance rather than mandates, cost about 49,909 euros, that similar initiatives exist, and that reducing meat consumption benefits health and sustainability per official reports.
The cabinet wants to make use of the energy and ambitions that many parties and residents in our country have in the area of environment and sustainability.
Het kabinet wil gebruik maken van de energie en ambities die veel partijen en bewoners in ons land hebben op het gebied van milieu en duurzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over een website over duurzaam gedrag

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about the cost of the duurzaamdoen.nl sustainability website, which organisations were involved and funded, and why the government promotes sustainable behaviour, questioning the purpose and possible indoctrination. The secretary answered that the site cost 49,909.16 euro, that Milieu Centraal (two-thirds government-funded) is the main partner, and that the aim is to inform citizens as required by the Aarhus Convention, not to impose norms.
The cabinet wants to make use of the energy and ambitions that many parties and residents in our country have in the field of environment and sustainability.
Het kabinet wil gebruik maken van de energie en ambities die veel partijen en bewoners in ons land hebben op het gebied van milieu en duurzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de voortgang van het convenant ‘Asbestdak eraf, zonnepanelen erop’

An MP asked the state secretary about progress on the covenant 'Asbestos roof off, solar panels on' for agricultural buildings, including how much asbestos has been removed, whether the 2024 full-removal target will be met, and the low uptake of the subsidy. The government answered that about 430,000 m2 has been subsidised (around 1 million m2 including pipeline), that current pace is too slow but it expects to reach the target with the planned 2024 ban and extra measures, and that it is consulting with the provinces on adjusting the covenant.
The current pace of roughly 4 million m2 of asbestos roof removed per year is too low to reach the goal of full removal.
Het huidige tempo van ongeveer 4 miljoen m 2 gesaneerd asbestdak per jaar ligt te laag om het doel van volledige sanering te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de realisatie van Randstadspoor Utrecht-Harderwijk en de ontwikkeling van de spoorcorridor Utrecht-Zwolle

An ChristenUnie MP asks the state secretary about the stalled Randstadspoor Utrecht-Harderwijk project, the stopped planning study, the cause of longer stopping times, and the lack of an integrated plan for the Utrecht-Zwolle corridor. The state secretary answers that the planning study was converted into a broader MIRT study due for results in 2015, explains the stopping-time and norm issues, and says no rail-siding reservation at Bilthoven was needed.

The planning study was, in consultation between the parties involved, converted into a MIRT study that will be more in-depth and integral in character. I will inform you once further decisions are taken based on the outcomes in 2015.

De planstudie is in overleg tussen de betrokken partijen omgezet in een MIRT-onderzoek dat diepgaander en integraler van karakter zal zijn. Ik informeer u hierover zodra op basis van de uitkomsten in 2015 nadere besluiten worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de situatie bij ProRail

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about ProRail's performance figures, the departures of its president-director and finance director, the absence of a crisis manager, and a safety/punctuality baseline report. The state secretary explained that the rijdendetreinen.nl figures cover different things than ProRail's data, attributed the departures to the new long-term rail agenda, said the leadership remains complete with interim arrangements, and promised a proposal from the supervisory board and a forthcoming ILT report.
I expect a proposal from the Supervisory Board in the short term on how both the temporary and the definitive arrangement will take shape.
Ik verwacht op korte termijn een voorstel van de Raad van Commissarissen hoe zowel de tijdelijke als de definitieve invulling vorm krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de reductie van zwerfafval en statiegeld op kleine plastic flessen en bierflesjes

An MP asked the State Secretary about the rise in small plastic bottles, the reduction targets for litter of bottles and cans, the cost of litter clean-up, and deposit (statiegeld) on small plastic bottles and beer bottles after the abolition of the product boards. The government answered that no verifiable figures on bottle numbers or litter quantities exist, that current monitoring measures cleanliness scores rather than item counts, and that deposit on beer bottles will continue through private sector arrangements.
There are no verifiable figures known to us on the development of the number of plastic bottles in the Netherlands.
Er zijn bij ons geen controleerbare cijfers bekend omtrent de ontwikkeling van de hoeveelheid plastic flesjes in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het afschaffen van statiegeld

Rep. Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment whether abolishing deposit fees on large PET bottles would prevent bottle-to-bottle recycling and whether the Plastic Heroes collection system is mature. The State Secretary answered that bottle-to-bottle recycling is feasible without deposit, cited progress figures for the Plastic Heroes system, and said separate collection of bottles would likely encourage separation of other plastic packaging, while leaving the efficiency of the system to packaging industry.
There therefore does not appear to be any reason to assume that large PET bottles collected with the Dutch Plastic Heroes system cannot be used for bottle-to-bottle recycling.
Er lijkt dus geen reden te zijn om aan te nemen dat grote PET-flessen die ingezameld worden met het Nederlandse Plastic Heroes systeem niet ingezet kunnen worden voor bottle to bottle recycling.
Antwoord op vragen van lid De Boer over uitspraken van de directeur Openbaar Vervoer van het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu

An MP asks whether the Secretary of State agrees with the Ministry's public transport director that NS will keep running the main rail network after 2020, and how that squares with the option to shorten the concession and tender it if NS fails its conditions. The answers say the concession runs 10 years with a midterm review that can lead to changes, and that under the 2000 passenger transport act the concession can be wholly or partly withdrawn for serious negligence, though this would be a proportionate, carefully considered step whose conditions will be set out in the concession itself.
This does not affect the fact that at a midterm review I will assess NS's performance sharply.
Dit laat onverlet dat ik bij een midterm review de prestaties van NS scherp ga beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het rapport van CE Delft «Kosten statiegeldsystemen voor grote PET-flessen»

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the government accepts CE Delft's review finding that the WUR cost basis for lifting the deposit (statiegeld) on large PET bottles was wrong and that the decision rested on incorrect data. The State Secretary declined to judge which of the two conflicting cost analyses is correct, stating the framework agreement rests on target-steering rather than the cost analysis, and that the deposit lift is a matter of producer responsibility.
It is not my role to give a judgement on the correctness of the two reports.
Het is niet mijn rol een oordeel te geven over de juistheid van de twee rapporten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de veiligheidssituatie op rangeerterrein Kijfhoek

MP Van Tongeren asked the State Secretary about the Council of State's annulment of local safety conditions for the Kijfhoek shunting yard, and how hazardous-goods safety and emergency access will be protected. The State Secretary replied that external safety limits are met, that the court ruling bars local rules on transport matters, and that a voluntary framework and national general rules under the Environment Act are being prepared.
Given the Council of State's ruling, it is legally not possible to impose additional local conditions for this; that can only be done through national regulation.
Gelet op de uitspraak van de Raad van State is het juridisch niet mogelijk om lokaal hiervoor aanvullende voorschriften te stellen; dat kan uitsluitend in landelijke regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Remco Dijkstra over de veiligheidssituatie op rangeerterrein Kijfhoek

MPs De Boer and Dijkstra asked about the safety situation at the Kijfhoek rail yard after the Council of State annulled added safety conditions in its environmental permit, and about the risks for nearby municipalities. The Secretary of State answered that the site meets all legal requirements, that the Council of State ruling limits local rules, that a working framework with stakeholders is planned by end April 2014, and that additional measures for the Betuweroute will be sent to parliament after the summer.
Consultations have meanwhile taken place between the municipality of Zwijndrecht and the ministry, in consultation with the parties involved, about the ruling.
Over de uitspraak is inmiddels ook overleg gevoerd tussen de gemeente Zwijndrecht en het ministerie, in samenspraak met betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het rapport ‘Een Gevoelige Kwestie’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about the report 'Een Gevoelige Kwestie', which challenges IPCC climate sensitivity estimates and the case for the Klimaatagenda, and asked whether the government would withdraw that agenda. The state secretary answered that the IPCC is sound, that independent evidence supports human-caused warming, that climate policy is needed even under low sensitivity, and declined to withdraw the Klimaatagenda.
No, I am not willing to withdraw the Climate Agenda.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid de Klimaatagenda terug te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek van de VVD-fractie aan het station in Hoorn

The VVD MP De Boer asked the State Secretary about timetable changes that skip stops at Hoorn Kersenboogerd, leaving overcrowded trains, and asked whether NS will restore more stops. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems, explained NS measures to reduce Sprinter delays and said NS is considering restoring stops and working with ProRail on a lasting solution.
Without an extensive customer survey, NS cannot determine how these passengers now travel and how many passengers now board at Hoorn instead of Kersenboogerd.
NS kan zonder een uitvoerig klantenonderzoek niet vaststellen hoe deze reizigers nu reizen en hoeveel reizigers nu op station Hoorn instappen in plaats van op Kersenboogerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht “‘Ozonvreters’ in atmosfeer ondanks succes CFK-verbod’’

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports that ozone-depleting gases persist in the atmosphere despite the CFC ban, and whether industry transparency and the Montreal Protocol agenda should respond. The state secretary said the findings are minor and known, that existing EU and Dutch reporting duties already cover by-production, and that she will raise transparency in Montreal Protocol discussions while prioritising the largest effects.
Dutch (and European) companies are already obliged under current regulations to report on by-production of ozone-depleting substances.
Nederlandse (en Europese) bedrijven zijn op grond van de huidige regelgeving al verplicht om te rapporteren over bijproductie van ozonlaagaantastende stoffen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht dat vervoer van en naar stations een struikelblok is

An MP asked whether the government's innovation subsidy programme for transport to and from stations distorts the market and whether taxi companies and evaluations were properly examined. The state secretary rejected the distortion claim, said the subsidies are short-term and cannot be reclaimed for unsuccessful projects, and declined to make a specific evaluation method mandatory.
The aim of the subsidy programme was to stimulate innovation. Inherent in innovation is that some innovations succeed and others do not.
Het doel van het subsidieprogramma was stimuleren van innovaties. Inherent aan innovaties is dat sommige innovaties een succes worden en anderen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven en Smaling over het ontwerp luchthavenbesluit luchthaven Twente

MPs Van Tongeren, Van Veldhoven and Smaling asked the state secretary about the draft airport decree allowing Twente airport to grow to 22,000 aircraft movements, including the absence of a European Commission state-aid ruling, the withheld business plan and financial figures, passenger forecasts, the operator's inexperience, and the 6-km nature restrictions. The state secretary answered that the decree rests on a tendered concession and a verified low-growth scenario, that the business plan and parts of the financial report are withheld as commercially sensitive, and that the decree will only be finalised after a positive Commission state-aid decision.
The business plan for Twente airport was drawn up by the operating company.
Het businessplan voor luchthaven Twente is opgesteld door de exploitatiemaatschappij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Verhoeven en Hachchi over drones die huizen fotograferen

MPs from D66 asked whether the commercial drone firm Billionhomes may photograph homes from the air and publish them without owners' consent, and how privacy is protected under the Wbp and drone permit rules. The Minister answered that the Wbp applies only where data are traceable to persons, that the ILT has received no permit application from Billionhomes, that privacy is not part of the aviation-safety permit assessment, and that a WODC study on privacy and drones is under way.

I have recently informed your House about a study that the WODC is carrying out at the cabinet's request into various questions surrounding unmanned aircraft (UAS), with particular attention to the possible negative effects of their use on privacy and how that privacy can be safeguarded most effectively.

Ik heb uw Kamer recent geïnformeerd over een onderzoek dat het WODC op verzoek van het kabinet uitvoert naar diverse vragen rondom onbemande luchtvaartuigen (UAS), met daarbij bijzondere aandacht voor de mogelijk negatieve effecten van het gebruik van onbemande luchtvaartuigen op de privacy
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over ultrasone kattenverjagers

The MP asks whether ultrasonic cat repellers producing 10 kHz-plus tones at 140 dB may be sold and installed in the Netherlands, whether permits or limits apply, and whether the government will set maximum noise limits or ban them. The government replies that sale and installation are not prohibited or permit-required beyond municipal nuisance rules, that the devices fall under the Warenwetbesluit electronische producten, that NVWA measurements show no health risk under normal use, and that no new limits or ban will be set.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht dat de verbinding Alkmaar - Haarlem louter zal bestaan uit stoptreinen

An MP asked the State Secretary about NS plans to convert the Alkmaar–Haarlem intercity into stopping trains and whether a fast connection would be kept. The State Secretary answered that NS is responsible for timetable design within concession rules, that a consumer advisory procedure is pending, and that the government will not intervene in the timetable beyond setting broad frameworks.
The role of the government is to set frameworks from the public interest.
De rol van de overheid is kaders stellen vanuit het maatschappelijk belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht ‘Pandemie uit Brabant is mogelijk’

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the government about reports that a pandemic originating in Brabant is possible, including calls to reduce animal numbers, close farms, and separate pig and poultry farms by a kilometre. The minister answered that current hygiene and early-warning measures are sufficient, that reducing animals or fully closed farms is not the solution, and that the RIVM distance advice did not lead to a policy change.
We are of the view that the current measures are sufficient to keep the chance of an outbreak as small as possible.
Wij zijn van mening dat de huidige maatregelen voldoende zijn om de kans op een uitbraak zo klein mogelijk te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht dat CO2-opslag in de Noordzee toch doorgaat

An MP asked the ministers whether the CO2 storage project under the North Sea would go ahead, what it costs taxpayers, why, and whether the risks to flora and fauna justify it. The government confirmed the subsidy of 150 million euros, argued CCS is unavoidable in the energy accord, rejected the environmental objections citing the environmental impact report, and said investors have not withdrawn.
The Netherlands granted a subsidy of 150 million euros to the ROAD project in 2010.
Nederland heeft in 2010 een subsidie van € 150 miljoen toegekend aan het ROAD-project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Tongeren over het ontgassen door de binnenvaart

MPs Van Gerven and Van Tongeren asked the state secretary about timing of an international ban on degassing by inland shipping, the legal room for a unilateral ban or municipal measures, risk zones around residential areas, the basis for calling emissions incidental, enforcement compliance, and RIVM emission estimates. The state secretary committed to pursuing a degassing ban via the CDNI treaty and to informing parliament, while stating that municipalities have little legal room and that a unilateral national ban is possible but less preferred.
I will inform the House, as I promised you at the General Consultation on 12 December 2013, when an (international) ban on degassing by inland vessels will take effect.
Ik zal de Kamer informeren, zoals ik u bij het Algemeen Overleg op 12 december 2013 toegezegd heb, wanneer een (internationaal) verbod op ontgassen door binnenvaartschepen van kracht zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over het vergassen van ganzen

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that goose gassing (CO2) cannot be used on Schiphol throughout 2014, and whether the European exemption applies, why winter rest is maintained, and why interim measures are not taken. The government says CO2 use awaits a biocide authorisation under an ongoing EU procedure, that gassing and scaring were done under exemptions in 2012–2013, and that a multi-track approach runs with results to be reported at year-end.
Once the substance is officially placed on the EU list of permitted agents, the Ctgb can grant an authorisation for a CO2-based product in the Netherlands.

Zodra de stof in Europa officieel op de lijst is geplaatst van toegestane middelen kan door het College voor de toelating van Gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden (Ctgb) een toelating voor een middel op basis van CO 2 in Nederland worden afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over mobiliteitskaarten en OV-chipkaart 2.0

An MP asked the state secretary about business transit cards (such as Mobility Mixx) failing on regional rail lines, the delayed availability of pay-on-account travel, NS's refusal to let rivals put NS subscriptions on their cards, exclusion of card issuers from NOVB and TLS governance, and whether roaming should be included in the OV-chip law. The secretary answered that the problems stem from private contracts and vendor technology, that responsibility is for the parties to settle, that a TLS platform for pay-on-account is due at the earliest in Q4 2014, and that the Wet personenvervoer 2000 will be amended to increase market-access supervision, while declining to commit to roaming in the law.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Oosenbrug over de gebrekkige dekking van telefoonproviders in het spoor- en metronettunnels

MPs Hoogland and Oosenbrug asked the State Secretary about poor mobile coverage in rail and metro tunnels, including whether ProRail and telecom providers can improve it and who is responsible for new tunnels. The State Secretary replied that providers initiate permit applications which ProRail assesses for safety and interference, that constructive talks are underway, that metro networks are primarily the responsibility of municipalities, and that he will raise the issue with local authorities.
ProRail has informed me that several permit applications are currently being processed and that constructive consultation is taking place on them.
ProRail heeft mij geïnformeerd dat er momenteel verschillende vergunning-aanvragen in behandeling zijn en dat hierover constructief overleg plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het voorstel van ‘Kap op de bak’ in Lansingerland

An MP asks the State Secretary about the 'Kap op de bak' (open cover) proposal from the Stop Geluidshinder HSL foundation for noise reduction in Lansingerland, and whether the Chamber will be informed about the plan and the feasibility of a pilot. The State Secretary welcomes the initiative and states that a letter on the feasibility of a pilot is being sent to the Chamber alongside the answers.
At the same time as this answer, I am sending the Chamber a cover letter informing it about the feasibility of a pilot of this 'Open Kap' plan.
Tegelijkertijd met deze beantwoording stuur ik uw Kamer een aanbiedingsbrief waarmee ik de Kamer informeer over de haalbaarheid van een pilot van dit «Open Kap»-plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht dat EBS buslijnen met een sociale functie schrapt

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that EBS was cutting bus lines with a social function after a costly tendering miscalculation, and whether service, cao compliance, tender costs and legal risks were affected. The state secretary answered that responsibility lies with the Stadsregio Amsterdam and EBS, that the changes are seen as an improvement by the Stadsregio, that consumer groups are broadly positive, and gave tender cost figures, while declining to take responsibility for staff policy.
In this matter, responsibility therefore lies with the Stadsregio Amsterdam as concession grantor and with bus company EBS as concession holder.
In deze kwestie ligt de verantwoordelijkheid dan ook bij de stadsregio Amsterdam als concessieverlener en bij het busbedrijf EBS als de concessiehouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de verduurzaming van regionale OV-aanbestedingen

An MP asks whether the government will follow up on reports that CO2-reduction sustainability criteria are ignored in regional public transport tenders and will engage regional authorities on enforcement and measurable CO2 targets. The State Secretary answers that responsibility lies primarily with regional authorities, points to existing criteria and a Green Deal on zero-emission buses, and promises to raise the criteria again at the Bestuurlijk Koepeloverleg.
I note that responsibility for regional concessions lies primarily with the decentralised authorities.
Ik merk op dat de verantwoordelijkheid voor de regionale concessies primair ligt bij de decentrale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Van Gerven over geluidreducerend asfalt

Two SP MPs asked the minister about quieter road surfaces: whether savings would fund noise relief for households above noise limits, whether wet-road noise and aging effects are modelled, and the design and reporting of trial programmes. The minister answered that the new PERS surface is still in early development with cost-effectiveness under study until 2018, that noise models use annual averages without a wet-road correction judged not to underestimate exposure, and that results will be reported to parliament then.
Cost-effectiveness is one of the topics in the research now started.
Kosteneffectiviteit is een van de onderwerpen in het nu gestarte onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en De Boer over problemen met de wissels op het spoor

MPs Hoogland and De Boer asked the state secretary about railway switch failures and related ProRail maintenance and knowledge gaps, including the lack of spare parts and whether preventive replacement was done. The state secretary answered that no specific repair deadlines are set in the management plan, that spare parts were procured via a Swedish counterpart and urgent order, and that the ILT and Safety Board investigations are ongoing with ILT results expected in Q3 2014.
The ILT investigation focuses on the role of the switch and the rolling stock in the derailment and the operation of the signals.
Het onderzoek van de ILT richt zich op de rol van het wissel en het materieel bij de ontsporing en de werking van de seinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Bisschop en Geurts over het bericht van een werkbezoek aan de gemeente Barneveld op 16 januari 2014

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether a rail terminal in Barneveld would reduce road freight and whether the ministry would help assess its feasibility, and about multimodal terminals generally. The state secretary answered that such initiatives are primarily a market responsibility, that ProRail will review any concrete proposal against existing policy, and that the national terminal network is considered sufficient until 2020, with selective strengthening on key corridors also under study.
For new market initiatives for rail terminals, ProRail will examine whether such projects meet the policy starting points set out in the policy framework.
Bij nieuwe marktinitiatieven voor railterminals zal ProRail bekijken of dergelijke projecten voldoen aan de beleidsuitgangspunten, zoals die verwoord staan in het beleidskader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de gevolgen van miscalculatie van de busvervoerder EBS

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about the consequences of bus operator EBS's miscalculation, including whether concession holders may change timetables mid-contract and what happens to drivers. The state secretary answered that the regional authority (Stadsregio Amsterdam) is responsible, that timetable changes within concession terms are permitted, and that staffing is outside national government's remit.
In this matter, responsibility therefore lies with the Amsterdam city region as concession grantor and with bus company EBS as concession holder.
In deze kwestie ligt de verantwoordelijkheid dan ook bij de stadsregio Amsterdam als concessie-verlener en bij het busbedrijf EBS als de concessiehouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘extra ammoniakeisen dreigen vanuit Brussel’

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked about reports that the European Commission would propose tighter ammonia and fine-particle emission ceilings, and what this means for intensive livestock farming in the Netherlands. The Secretary of State answered that the proposed ceilings can likely be met under existing policy, that no direct effect on intensive livestock farming is expected, and that further Dutch stable and manure rules are being prepared but will not be suspended.
I do not want to suspend these measures because that would cause problems with implementing the PAS and with meeting the agreements already made under the European air quality directive.

Ik wil deze maatregelen niet opschorten omdat er dan problemen ontstaan met de implementatie van de PAS en ten aanzien van het voldoen aan de reeds gemaakt afspraken in het kader van de Europese luchtkwaliteitsrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Kamerleden Cegerek en Dikkers over het bericht dat er teveel dioxine gevonden is in eieren nabij de afvalverbrandingsoven Harlingen

MPs Cegerek and Dikkers asked about reports of excessive dioxin in eggs from backyard hens near the Harlingen waste incinerator, whether eggs and milk should be removed, and whether the incinerator and its enforcement by a regional agency posing a conflict of interest are adequately checked. The minister replied that the eggs were not marketed, that existing consumption advice still applies, that a re-evaluation of the EU tolerable weekly intake will be pushed in Europe, that incinerator emissions are continuously monitored and tested twice yearly, that no extra research is needed, and that the regional agency only advises municipalities and enforcement is not delegated.
The province is the competent authority for the waste incineration installation and is not a shareholder.
De provincie is bevoegd gezag voor de afvalverbrandingsinstallatie en geen aandeelhouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over de beantwoording van vragen over de berichten ‘Dode door brand in windmolen in Ooltgensplaat’ en ‘Tweede dode bij brand windmolen Ooltgensplaat’

An MP asked why fire-response plans specific to wind turbines are absent, how high brigades can reach, how quickly specialist rescue teams arrive, and how offshore turbines are regulated. The Minister answered that generic procedures apply, that municipal safety regions are responsible for instructions, and that offshore permits require certification and emergency plans reviewed by Rijkswaterstaat.
Drawing up instructions, deployment procedures and attack plans is a responsibility of the safety regions.
Het opstellen van instructies, inzetprocedures en aanvalsplannen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de veiligheidsregio’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de voortgang van de capaciteitsverhoging op de Valleilijn

An MP asked the State Secretary about the delays and financing of capacity and robustness measures on the Valleilijn rail line, including the Barneveld Zuid station, the Hoevelaken station, the overbelasting declaration, and extending a quarter-hourly service to Ede-Wageningen or Arnhem. The State Secretary answered that Barneveld Zuid does not depend on the capacity measures, that the four robustness measures are expected by end 2016, and that extending the line to Arnhem is not part of ProRail's study and will not receive additional funding for now.
I regret, like the questioner, that the realisation of the robustness-enhancing measures is taking longer than foreseen in 2009.
Ik betreur net als de vragensteller dat de realisatie van de robuustheid verhogende maatregelen langer op zich laat wachten dan in 2009 werd voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de toelating van gentechgewassen in de Europese Unie

The MP Ouwehand asked why the government voted for EU import approval of genetically modified maize MON 87460 without first informing parliament, and whether it considers GMO safety proven given scientists' concerns. The government replied that its vote followed EFSA, COGEM and RIKILT advice, that it trusts the EFSA risk assessment, and that it will place a parliamentary reservation and inform parliament on its approach to GMO approvals, including maize 1507, before that vote.
Until I have discussed this cabinet approach with you, I will enter a parliamentary reservation on votes concerning this crop.
Totdat ik deze kabinetsaanpak met u besproken heb, zal ik een parlementair voorbehoud aantekenen bij stemmingen over dit gewas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het ontgassen van binnenvaartschepen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about a CE Delft report claiming higher emissions from degassing inland vessels than RIVM estimated, enforcement arrangements and sanction figures, and whether a reporting duty or revised RIVM protocol is needed. The Secretary explained the methodological differences, listed the enforcing bodies and 2012-2013 enforcement results, and committed to asking RIVM to examine the new data and to a ban on degassing via the CDNI treaty revision.
This yielded the following results: 2012: 38 warnings and 14 official reports; 2013: 6 warnings and 17 official reports.
Dit gaf het volgende resultaat 2012: 38 waarschuwingen en 14 processen-verbaal; 2013: 6 waarschuwingen en 17 processen-verbaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over vrijkomende schadelijke stoffen bij het ontgassen van schepen in Rotterdam

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about degassing emissions from inland tankers in Rotterdam, including the gap between CE Delft and RIVM figures, health and air-quality effects, the definition of residential areas, and a MTBE ban. The state secretary acknowledged the CE report, said health effects cannot be determined, committed to pursuing a degassing ban via the CDNI treaty with a decision expected in June 2014, and did not give the MTBE quantity.
Moreover, I am working towards a ban on degassing by inland vessels by amending the convention on the collection, delivery and reception of waste in the Rhine and inland navigation (CDNI).
Overigens werk ik toe naar een verbod op het ontgassen door binnenvaartschepen door aanpassing van het verdrag inzake de verzameling, afgifte en inname van afval in de Rijn- en binnenvaart (CDNI).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het artikel ‘Husa stapt uit spoorvervoer’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about Husa's exit from rail freight, the continued subsidy to rail freight, the level playing field with neighbouring countries, cost recovery rules and competitiveness versus road transport. The State Secretary answers that Husa made its own business decision, that EU rules govern the playing field, that the subsidy scheme (EUR 42.2 million in 2008-2013) ends after 2013, and that an action plan for rail freight is being prepared.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Bashir over de bediening van station Utrecht Lunetten

MPs Jansen and Bashir asked why NS sprinter stops at Utrecht Lunetten are halved from December 2013 and whether alternatives were explored. The Secretary of State answered that ProRail's stricter planning norms, after the Amsterdam Singelgracht collision, force the cut for westbound trains until infrastructure is adapted by end 2015, that alternatives were explored with operators, and that he urged ProRail and NS to reduce the hindrance.
I have urged ProRail and NS to jointly inform travellers as well as possible and in good time about travel options.
Ik heb er bij ProRail en NS op aangedrongen om samen de reizigers zo goed mogelijk en tijdig te informeren over de reismogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Karabulut over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Spoorwegen vast personeel van de fietsenstallingen wil vervangen door werklozen

MPs Smaling and Karabulut asked whether NS was replacing permanent bicycle-parking staff with unemployed re-integration workers and whether it was negotiating with Halfords; the state secretary replied that the reports were largely inaccurate, NS had terminated nine parking contracts with a planned uniform national formula, and expects new operators to take over existing staff. The answers rely on NS's account and refuse to exercise any power over private operators' personnel policy.
I have no relationship with these operators and no authority to enforce that one operator rehires the staff of another operator in such cases.

Ik heb geen enkele relatie met deze exploitanten en ik heb geen bevoegdheid om af te dwingen dat de ene exploitant in voorkomende gevallen het personeel van de andere exploitant opnieuw in dienst neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de bouw van een vuurwerkopslagplaats in Heerde

An MP asked the state secretary whether a fireworks storage bunker near a care home and supermarket in Heerde could be stopped, citing explosion risk and conflict with fire brigade guidance. The state secretary replied that the municipality is responsible, safety rules in the Fireworks Decree were met, the building permit is irrevocable, and no further options to stop it exist.

No, there are none. The environmental permit is irrevocable and the related notification under the Activities Decree and the Fireworks Decree was reviewed by the Noord Veluwe Environmental Service and the Noord-Oost Gelderland Safety Region.

Nee, die zijn er niet. De omgevingsvergunning is onherroepelijk en de bijbehorende melding op grond van het Activiteitenbesluit en het Vuurwerkbesluit zijn getoetst door de Omgevingsdienst Noord Veluwe en de Veiligheidsregio Noord-Oost Gelderland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Marcouch over de toename van agressie tegen treinpersoneel

MPs Hoogland and Marcouch asked the ministers about rising aggression against rail staff, the measures taken with NS, the role of passengers and bystanders, use of Burgernet, and the arrest rate and sentences for offenders. The minister answered that NS takes measures such as cameras, security teams, training and a 24-hour control centre, that bystander e-learning and a publicity campaign are planned, that Burgernet is unsuitable, and that offender statistics are not registered separately and referred to an earlier study on sentencing.
In the judicial systems, aggression and violence against NS staff are not registered separately; they fall under the category of qualified victims.
In de justitiële systemen wordt agressie en geweld tegen NS personeel niet apart geregistreerd, zij vallen in die systemen onder de categorie gekwalificeerde slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid De Rouwe over Keyrail

The MP De Rouwe (CDA) asked the State Secretary about tensions between the commercial Keyrail and ProRail, the planned single freight counter, capacity allocation, and whether the government would avoid irreversible steps before a sector-wide plan exists. The State Secretary answered that ProRail remains the independent capacity allocator, Keyrail becomes the single freight counter and chain coordinator, the design is being tested with sector parties, and a Long-Term Rail Agenda with the detailed proposal will be sent to Parliament in Q1 2014.
As previously promised, I will inform you about this when the integral elaboration of the LTSA is presented.
Ik zal u hierover, zoals eerder toegezegd, bij de integrale uitwerking van de LTSA informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Rouwe over de capaciteitsbeperking op de Betuweroute door de bouw van het derde aansluitspoor in Duitsland

MP De Rouwe asked the State Secretary about capacity restrictions on the Betuweroute during construction of a third track in Germany, including expected loss of rail freight market share and whether alternatives and early mitigation plans would be developed. The State Secretary confirmed the planned works from 2016 to 2022, said work with stakeholders on an alternatives package is under way, and promised to present a package to the Chamber after the summer.
I will present that package to the House of Representatives after the summer.
Dat maatregelenpakket zal ik na de zomer voorleggen aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Klever over het bericht ‘Miljoenensubsidie voor taxi's die amper reden’

Two PVV MPs asked about press reports of a subsidy for taxi firm Prestige GreenCab that barely operated, asking how the former director behaved, how the money would be recovered, and what electric-driving subsidy projects exist with measurable targets. The minister answered that the project submitted incomplete financial proof, the subsidy was set at zero with a six-week objection period before recovery, and listed the subsidy programmes with their monitoring and disbursement rules.
On that basis, AgentschapNL decided on 16 December to set the subsidy for the project at zero.
Op grond daarvan heeft AgentschapNL op 16 december jl. besloten de subsidie van het project vast te stellen op «nihil».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het handhaven van de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij

An SP MP asked whether the Dutch food authority NVWA and the Dienst Regelingen enforce the fur-farming ban, and why a municipality reported that enforcement was being held back pending court challenges. The state secretary answered that enforcement is ongoing, with 17 inspections and one proces-verbaal, denied that municipalities were told not to enforce, and said unlawful expansions are checked against the 15 January 2013 baseline.
The quotation you cite does not give a correct account of the NVWA's enforcement policy.
Het door u opgevoerde citaat geeft geen correcte weergave van het handhavingsbeleid van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht ‘Jongeren vragen om meer klimaatonderwijs’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Beertema asked the State Secretary whether climate education promoted through youth representatives is appropriate, given the lack of proof of human influence and the parliamentary inquiry's call for schools to focus on core tasks. The State Secretary answered that the IPCC science is clear, climate education is already embedded in the curriculum, and schools decide how to organise it, without committing to any new action.
Subsequently, it is up to schools how they organise and shape education and which methods and teaching materials they wish to use.
Vervolgens is het aan scholen hoe zij het onderwijs inrichten en vormgeven en welke methoden en leermiddelen zij daarbij willen gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Ypma over het bericht dat een school in Zwolle is gesloten vanwege de vondst van asbest

MPs Leenders and Ypma asked whether a Zwolle school closed over asbest exposed pupils and staff, and how many schools have completed asbestos inventories. The state secretary answered that no one was exposed, air and adhesive samples were clean, 64% of pre-1994 school buildings are inventoried for asbestos, and referred to an earlier letter for the action on other schools.
There has been no health risk for pupils or staff.
Er is geen gezondheidsrisico geweest voor leerlingen of het personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Litjens over het feit dat een megabiovergister in Foxhol niet doorgaat

MPs Dijkstra and Litjens asked whether a mega biogas plant in Foxhol is blocked by an unintended side effect of legislation, how the government assesses this and whether it will act. The state secretary replied that responsibility for permits under noise, spatial planning and environmental law lies with the province of Groningen, which has proposed refusing the permit, so the central government has no formal role and the courts would decide any dispute.
It is not possible for me to take a formal role and responsibility in this case. That lies solely with the province of Groningen.
Het is mij niet mogelijk in deze casus een formele rol en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Die ligt enkel en alleen bij de provincie Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, Jacobi en Monasch over de spoorverbinding met Leeuwarden in verband met het besluit Leeuwarden te nomineren als Culturele Hoofdstad 2018

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary how rail services to Leeuwarden will cope with extra visitors if it is Culturele Hoofdstad 2018, and whether NS will offer incentives or a cultural-capital train. The state secretary answered that rail choice is up to travellers, that organisers should contact NS early about visitor numbers, that discounts and marketing are commercial matters for NS, and that Leeuwarden and NS should take up the train-promotion ideas themselves.
This is primarily a consideration for NS.
Dit is primair een afweging voor NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Dik-Faber, De Rouwe en Van Tongeren over het bericht dat NS stations overslaat bij vertraging

Four MPs asked the state secretary about reports that NS skips stations when trains are delayed, asking for figures, justification, passenger information, and whether the practice should be restricted. The state secretary said skipping is in principle unacceptable but may be a last-resort measure to prevent wider delays, provided passengers are informed; NS will report annually on the practice and no new restrictions or overload declaration are planned.

I have therefore agreed with NS that the company will provide me annually with an overview of figures, as NS has now compiled for the years 2010 through 2013, with an explanation of the routes where the measure is most often applied.

Ik heb daarom met NS de afspraak gemaakt dat het bedrijf mij jaarlijks een overzicht met cijfers levert zoals NS dat nu voor de jaren 2010 t/m 2013 heeft opgesteld en daarbij een toelichting geeft op de trajecten waar de maatregel het meest wordt getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de externe en interne veiligheid van windturbines

An MP asked the government about the safety of wind turbines after the storm of 28 October 2013 and a fatal accident at Ooltgensplaat, including damage overviews, applicable safety and occupational health rules, and inspection practice. The minister answered that no national damage overview exists, that existing Arbo and Warenwet rules apply, that the Inspectie SZW is investigating the Ooltgensplaat accident and may adjust rules, and that inspections occur only in response to signals.
The Inspectie SZW investigation will determine whether the applicable provisions of the Working Conditions Act and the Consumer Goods Act have been adequately complied with.
Het onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW zal uitwijzen of de van toepassing zijnde voorschriften van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet en Warenwet adequaat zijn nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over de berichten ‘Dode door brand in windmolen in Ooltgensplaat’ en ‘Tweede dode bij brand windmolen Ooltgensplaat’

An MP from the PVV asked whether the regional fire brigade was equipped to fight a turbine fire at height, how municipalities account for fire height when granting permits, and whether emergency plans exist for rescuing people from turbines. The government answered that the Rotterdam-Rijnmond fire service considers itself generally equipped, that an investigation is underway into the cause and firefighting options, that permits account for collapse and blade-failure risks, and that no turbine-specific emergency plans exist, relying instead on general working-at-height procedures and specialist rescue teams.
The Rotterdam-Rijnmond Safety Region is launching an investigation into the fire at the wind turbine in Ooltgensplaat.
De Veiligheidsregio Rotterdam-Rijnmond stelt een onderzoek in naar de brand van de windturbine in Ooltgensplaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de ontsporing van een goederentrein bij Borne

An MP asked the state secretary to find the cause of a freight train derailment near Borne, whether equipment quality standards should be tightened, how residents are to be reassured, whether alternatives to rail freight through East Netherlands exist, and whether highly dangerous substances can be excluded from this line. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate is investigating (preliminary finding: a broken wheel tyre), will report before summer 2014, that tighter EU rules can only be pursued at European level, that alternatives were studied in 2012 with limited potential, and that dangerous goods transport cannot be fully excluded.
The Inspectorate aims to complete its investigation before summer 2014.
De Inspectie streeft er naar haar onderzoek vóór de zomer van 2014 af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht in de Telegraaf dat ‘luchtvaartmaatschappijen massaal de compensatieregeling ontwijken’

MP Kuiken asked the state secretary about reports that airlines widely evade the flight compensation rule, including a Consumentenbond finding that 95% of compensation claims are initially rejected, and about a SEO study linked to a claimed 10 million euro figure. The state secretary said the Consumentenbond study is not available to the government, that consumers can complain to the ILT, that the SEO study uses scenario assumptions and does not support the 10 million figure, and gave no new action.
The underlying research is not publicly available and I have also not obtained it in any other way.
Het onderliggende onderzoek is niet publiek beschikbaar en heb ik ook niet op andere wijze verkregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Graus en De Graaf over het bericht ‘Afspraken over intercity snel maken’

MPs Graus and De Graaf asked the state secretary about delays in the Eindhoven–Heerlen–Aachen intercity link, the Heerlen mayor's concerns, steps taken, infrastructure agreements, and the link with rail decentralisation in Limburg. The state secretary said a decision is targeted for November 2013 pending the province's report, that the Euregiobahn service will continue in 2014–2015, and that decentralisation is not directly linked to the cross-border study.
Once those agreements have been made, I will inform the House of Representatives about them.
Zodra die afspraken zijn gemaakt, zal ik de Tweede Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over Stortplaatsen Apeldoorn

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about soil contamination around former landfills in Apeldoorn, drinking water risks, nationwide prevalence and oversight of aftercare. The State Secretary answered that the provinces, as competent authorities, judge the sites harmless, that no drinking water threat exists, and that no current national overview is available since responsibility is decentralised.
Due to the decentralisation of responsibility for former landfills, the Ministry has no current nationwide data on the status of their remediation.

Vanwege de decentralisatie van de verantwoordelijkheid voor NAVOS-stortplaatsen zijn bij het Ministerie geen actuele gegevens op landelijk niveau beschikbaar over de huidige stand van zaken rond de aanpak van deze stortplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Paulus Jansen over de voorgenomen sluiting van spoorwegovergangen tussen station Heemstede-Aerdenhout en Hillegom met een aanmerkelijk recreatief belang

MPs Dik-Faber and Paulus Jansen asked whether the level crossings at Laantje van Alverna and Laantje van Leyduin, which have recreational value, may be closed, and why ProRail's procedure and risk analysis were not followed. The State Secretary rejected the claim that the crossings are public and recreational, stated that a closure agreement with the right-holders for Laantje van Alverna has been reached, and said no decision has yet been taken on Laantje van Leyduin.
However, the policy is equally aimed at preventing that a change in the traffic function of existing crossings worsens crossing safety.
Het beleid is er echter evenzeer op gericht om te voorkomen dat door een wijziging van de verkeersfunctie van bestaande overwegen de overwegveiligheid verslechtert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht in de Telegraaf “Fyra-debacle dupeert reiziger”

MP Hoogland asked whether travel by Thalys to Brussels is too expensive, how its fares compare with the Fyra, and whether the government will negotiate cheaper Thalys tickets. The Secretary of State explained that Thalys fares follow yield management, noted Fyra fares were somewhat lower in the introductory period, and declined to press for changes because planned extra frequencies will add cheaper tickets.
