Given the planned increase in frequencies, more tickets at lower fares will become available. For this reason I see no reason to press for further adjustments.
Gezien de geplande verhoging van het aantal frequenties komen meer kaartjes met lagere tarieven beschikbaar. Hierdoor zie ik geen reden aan te dringen op verdere aanpassingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over de mogelijkheid om hagelkanonnen in te zetten om de oogst te beschermen

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked whether anti-hail cannons may be used by fruit growers and whether municipalities should decide, and how enforcement by fines should be handled. The state secretary said the balancing of crop protection against noise nuisance is a local decision for municipalities, that no national rule or exception is appropriate, and that enforcement is up to the municipality.
The balancing of interests for the use of the anti-hail cannon must take place at the local level.
De belangenafweging voor het gebruik van het antihagelkanon dient op lokaal niveau plaats te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen, De Rouwe en Hoogland inzake het meenemen van de fiets in de Fyra en de Thalys

Three MPs asked why bicycles cannot be carried on the Fyra trains between Rotterdam/Breda and Den Haag/Brussel and on the Thalys, despite suitable space, and how this fits EU rail passenger rules. The state secretary explained that high-speed line safety management excludes loose bicycle transport, that folding or dismantled bikes are allowed as hand luggage, and that adjustments to the safety system are being examined.
For the Intercity to Brussels and the domestic connections on the high-speed line, it is currently being examined whether there is a solution to allow loose bicycle transport.
Voor de Intercity naar Brussel en de binnenlandse verbindingen over de hogesnelheidslijn wordt momenteel onderzocht of er een oplossing is om los vervoer van fietsen mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het vrijstellingsbesluit voor luchthaven Twente

An MP asked the state secretary why the development company ADT, rather than an airport operator, applied for an exemption decision for Twente airport, and about its obligations and oversight. The secretary said ADT is already de facto operator, that it will be bound by safety obligations and needs a safety certificate, and that the ILT (inspectorate) enforces compliance, while deferring the decision pending an appeal ruling.
The ILT is responsible for enforcing the obligations under the exemption decision.
De ILT is verantwoordelijk voor de handhaving van de verplichtingen uit het vrijstellingsbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Rouwe over overvolle treinen

An MP asks the state secretary about overcrowded trains after hundreds of complaints to Rover, and whether NS will be pressed to find causes and prevent a winter chaos from reduced timetables. The state secretary acknowledges overcrowding is unacceptable, says NS is analysing causes and taking measures, and accepts that some winter train reductions are a temporary trade-off.
I can understand that the deployment of rolling stock at the start of a new timetable is not immediately optimal but needs some adjustment.
Ik kan er begrip voor opbrengen dat de materieelinzet bij de start van een nieuwe dienstregeling niet meteen optimaal is maar enige aanpassing behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jan Vos over een dreigend tekort aan laadpalen voor elektrische auto's

MPs Kuiken and Jan Vos asked the state secretary and the minister of Economic Affairs about a looming shortage of public charging points for electric cars, including projected car numbers, charging infrastructure, and municipal support. Minister Kamp answered that around 20,000 EVs are expected by end 2013, that charging infrastructure will grow under the 'ladder van laden' approach, and that an agreement with stakeholders is expected by year end.
The hope and expectation is that this agreement can be signed before the end of this year.
De hoop en verwachting is dat deze afspraak voor eind van dit jaar kan worden ondertekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over “immer oplopende Fyra-kosten”

An MP asked whether the Fyra train debacle could cost NS and the state up to 300 million euro and how dividend losses would affect infrastructure investment. The ministers said the 0 to 300 million bandwidth is highly uncertain, withheld details of the ongoing settlement with Ansaldobreda, and outlined a 119 million dividend shortfall to be offset by cutting the Infrastructure Fund, with further budget agreements at the Spring Memorandum.
To avoid harming the interests of the State and its holding, I cannot inform you further on the progress of that at this time.
Om de belangen van de Staat en diens deelneming niet te schaden kan ik u over het verloop daarvan op dit moment niet nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de opbrengsten van gemeenten voor textielinzameling en de fijnsortering van het ingezamelde textie

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about municipal fees charged to charitable textile collectors, whether textile collection is at risk from falling market prices, and the role of retail chains and permits. The state secretary replied that municipalities have autonomous responsibility for textile collection and lack data on fees, said it is not appropriate to charge fees that cover other municipal costs, noted a Green Deal study due in 2014, and reported that inspections found export textiles correctly sorted.
I therefore cannot assess whether the fees have doubled, nor whether they are as high as the amount left for the charitable purpose.
Ik kan dus niet beoordelen of de vergoedingen zijn verdubbeld en ook niet of deze net zo hoog zijn als het bedrag dat overblijft voor het goede doel.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Dik-Faber en Rebel over het hergebruik van datadragers van de overheid

MPs Dik-Faber and Rebel asked why government destroys reusable phones, tablets and computers instead of reusing them, and whether data safety can be guaranteed for reuse. The state secretary agreed reuse is preferable, cited AIVD security rules and a study due early 2014 into alternatives, and promised to consider them.
Since spring 2013 a study has been running that looks for alternatives.
Sedert het voorjaar 2013 loopt een onderzoek waarin er naar alternatieven wordt gezocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over de OV-chipkaart voor blinden en slechtzienden

An SP MP asked the state secretary why the OV-chipkaart problems for blind and partially sighted travellers in regional public transport remain unresolved, whether reservation-based travel was pursued as the Dik-Faber motion requested, whether the cheaper Viziris subscription should be reinstated, and asked for early answers. The state secretary answered that a working group is examining travel on account with check-in/check-out, that the decentralised authorities aim for clarity in early 2014, that the Viziris subscription is not feasible because its costs did not match actual travel, and that answers were provided in time.
A working group is now starting, in which the authorities, carriers and the Oogvereniging are all represented.
Er start nu een werkgroep, waarin zowel de overheden, vervoerders als de Oogvereniging zijn vertegenwoordigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de bijdrage aan luchtvervuiling door houtkachels

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about health and air-pollution risks from wood-burning stoves, citing research that wood smoke can contribute substantially to local fine particulate levels, and whether the government would study this, adopt measures used abroad, or treat it as a problem. The state secretary said the evidence is not conclusive, that the problem is mainly local nuisance best handled by municipalities, and that a stakeholder meeting would be organised in the autumn.
The primary responsibility lies with the citizen who burns a wood stove to do so without causing nuisance.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de burger die een houtkachel stookt om dat zo te doen dat geen overlast wordt veroorzaakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de ongezonde lucht in de grote steden

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about Milieudefensie measurements showing unhealthy air in big cities, the causes of nitrogen dioxide pollution, and whether the 2012 raising of the motorway speed limit to 100 km/h should be reversed. The government answered that more measures are needed, that improvement is a shared responsibility of national and local authorities, that a joint action plan with big-city aldermen is being prepared, and that the speed increase has negligible air-quality effects so lowering limits is not warranted.
Yes, more measures are needed. That is why I sat down with aldermen of the big cities.
Ja er zijn meer maatregelen nodig. Daarom heb ik ook om de tafel gezeten met wethouders van de grote steden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over mogelijke monopolievorming bij de nationale databank OV in relatie tot de recente DDoS-aanvallen

An MP asks the State Secretary about possible monopoly formation in the national public transport data databank (NDOV) following DDoS attacks, including concerns about one provider's conflicting roles, delayed loket launches, and data access. The State Secretary replies that both NDOV loketten were tested and meet the criteria, that vervoerders may choose how to supply data, and that most requested tariff and rail data matters remain the responsibility of the vervoerders.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en de Liefde over een schadelijk buitenlands fruitvliegje dat de Nederlandse fruitoogst bedreigt

MPs Lodders and De Liefde asked why the government was slow to grant an exemption for a biological pesticide against the harmful spotted-wing drosophila fruit fly and what it will do to act faster. The state secretary answered that the fly is spreading in the Netherlands, that the exemption for Tracer was requested in March and has now been granted for the affected crops, and did not commit to further specific reforms.
The agent has now been exempted for the mentioned crops.
Het middel is inmiddels vrijgesteld voor de genoemde gewassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over grondstoffenvoorzieningszekerheid

An MP from D66 asked the government why it lacks a clear vision on raw materials and whether supply shortages and conflict-sourced inputs threaten Dutch agriculture, chemicals and textiles. Minister Kamp answered that raw-material security is primarily the responsibility of business, cited existing initiatives such as conflict-free tin and the planned monitoring and research, but declined to commit to a new overarching strategy or to a partnership with the TNO/HCSS expertise centre.
Raw-material supply security and procurement policy are in the first instance the responsibility of the companies themselves.
Grondstoffenvoorzieningszekerheid en inkoopbeleid zijn in eerste aanleg de verantwoordelijkheid van de bedrijven zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts en Dijkgraaf over de Nederlandse inzet inzake het vijfde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

Dutch MPs from VVD, CDA and SGP asked the state secretaries about the Dutch negotiating position on the fifth Nitrates Directive action programme, including the 50 mg nitrate standard, phosphate norms, the derogation and the lack of sector support. The government answered that the 50 mg standard is a binding target Netherlands committed to, that equivalent measures are being developed with LTO, and that it will press the Commission on monitoring results and the derogation.

I am in consultation with LTO on a number of these measures, with a view to having the required justification and assurance in place before the nitrogen use standards for leaching-sensitive crops in the southern sand and loess region are lowered on 1 January 2015.

Ik ben met LTO in overleg over een aantal van deze maatregelen met het oog op het beschikbaar hebben van de vereiste onderbouwing en borging voordat op 1 januari 2015 de stikstofgebruiksnormen voor uitspoelingsgevoelige gewassen in het zuidelijke zand- en lössgebied worden verlaagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Belgen tegen lijn Den Haag-Brussel’

An MP asked whether Belgium's rail authority refuses to grant 2014 train paths for the Lage Landen Lijn (The Hague–Brussels) and whether the minister will ask Belgian counterparts for clarification. The state secretary answers that Arriva's Belgian safety certificate application failed, so no train paths could be allocated, is positive in principle about the line, and sees no need to seek further clarification from Belgium.
I am already well informed at official level about the Belgian admission process and on that basis see no need to ask my Belgian counterpart for further clarification.
Ik ben reeds op ambtelijk niveau goed geïnformeerd over het Belgische toelatingsproces en zie op basis daarvan geen noodzaak om verdere opheldering te vragen bij mijn Belgische ambtgenoot.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, De Boer en De Rouwe over het project Zwolle Spoort

MPs asked the state secretary why the Zwolle Spoort rail project was delayed, what extra measures and budget are needed, whether the research report will be shared, and what the preferred variant and timetable consequences are. The government replied that a broader alternatives study is being deepened over the summer, a preferred alternative will be chosen in autumn in consultation with regional authorities, and a final report is expected in October and will be sent to parliament.
I can send this final report to your House.
Dit eindrapport kan ik aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Geurts over het bericht van de aangifte tegen Odfjell wegens het verzwijgen van een groot Methanol-incident

Opposition MPs Omtzigt and Geurts asked the government about reports that Odfjell concealed a major methanol incident in 2009, including whether it was reported, whether confidential dossiers can be made public, and whether management can be trusted. The state secretary said the incident should have been reported to the DCMR, that a criminal complaint has led to a prosecutor's assessment, that the dossier was released after a balancing test, and that Odfjell is under heightened supervision.

The public prosecution service informed the Minister of Security and Justice that it is currently considering whether, in view of this complaint, there is reason to launch a criminal investigation against Odfjell.

Het openbaar ministerie heeft de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie meegedeeld dat het momenteel beziet of er, gezien deze aangifte, aanleiding bestaat een daarop gericht strafrechtelijk onderzoek in te stellen tegen Odfjell.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en De Rouwe over een mogelijk ongeoorloofde subsidiëring en staatssteun bij de verkoop van Syntus aan Keoli

MPs Mulder and De Rouwe asked whether NS's reported 11 million euro loss on the sale of Syntus to Keolis implies state-funded subsidy or illegal state aid, and whether the state ultimately bears the loss. The minister answered that the loss was a write-off on a loan and the company's value, that the sale avoided a bankruptcy, and that no state aid or distortion of competition was involved because the state is not a party to the transaction.
In this transaction there was no question of loss compensation or state aid, as the State is after all not a party to this transaction.
Bij deze transactie was geen sprake van verliescompensatie danwel staatssteun, de Staat is immers geen partij in deze transactie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en De Boer over de verdeling van verantwoordelijkheden bij het opstellen van de Lange Termijn Spooragenda

MPs Dik-Faber and De Boer asked why the ministry assigns elaboration of the long-term rail agenda (LTSA) to NS and ProRail, and how FMN transport companies can be meaningfully involved. The state secretary answers that the ministry keeps the lead on priorities and concessions, that NS and ProRail are responsible for the operational rail concept under their concessions, and that FMN is being involved through meetings and invitations.
I have the lead in the recalibration and possible reprioritisation of rail programmes and projects based on the goals of the rail agenda.
Ik heb het voortouw bij de herijking en mogelijke herprioritering van de spoorprogramma’s en projecten op basis van de doelen van de Spooragenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over nazorglocaties bodemverontreiniging

An MP asked the state secretary how many aftercare locations with residual soil contamination exist, who is responsible for aftercare, how provinces prioritise it given limited staff, and who guarantees the funding. The state secretary said there is no national overview, that competent authorities are responsible, that a survey will be sent in November, and that funding has been provided through 2014 with reservations planned for 2015 onward.
I have no overview of the number of aftercare locations in the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen overzicht van het aantal nazorglocaties in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Hachchi over het milieuprobleem veroorzaakt door oude boten in havens

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary about abandoned sailing and motor yachts in Dutch harbours, including ownership tracing, a national registration system, a disposal levy and a clean-up fund. The state secretary answered that harbour managers are responsible for records, that existing registration suffices, that disposal levies and funds are for producers and industry, and that abandoned vessels are not currently a significant environmental problem.
I see no need for the central government to introduce a new system in addition to these two systems.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om als Rijksoverheid aanvullend aan deze twee systemen een nieuw systeem in te voeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) niet over de veiligheid van de Fyra gaat

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether ILT certification of the Fyra V250 means the train is safe, and how ILT can call the Fyra unsafe-verdict premature while stating it does not certify on safety. The state secretary replied that a type approval only confirms basic safety requirements and not per-train production quality, that ILT inspections did not on their own show the Fyra failed safety standards, and that an audit of the licensing process would be completed by 1 November 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht dat de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) niet zegt te gaan over de veiligheid van vervoersmiddelen zoals de Fyra

MP Van Tongeren asked whether the ILT should take a more active role in checking the safety of vehicles such as the Fyra, given that type approval does not guarantee safety, and whether the ILT has the capacity for this. State Secretary Mansveld answered that the ILT is legally obliged to grant type approval once the technical file and procedure are complete, that individual train quality is the responsibility of the client and producer, and that an audit of the approval process will report by 1 November 2013.
In my earlier letter I indicated that I am having an audit carried out of the licensing process.
In mijn eerdergenoemde brief heb ik aangegeven dat ik een audit laat uitvoeren op het proces van vergunningverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over uitspraken over certificering van treinen

An MP asked the state secretary about the ILT's role in certifying trains, after an inspector-general said certification does not mean a train is safe. The state secretary explained that ILT grants type approval only when legal requirements are met, that approval does not guarantee production quality, and that an audit of the approval process will be completed by 1 November 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht in het Algemeen Dagblad van 15 juli 2013 dat Randstadrail wordt geplaagd door wisselstoringen

An SP MP asked the state secretary about recurring switch failures on Randstadrail and whether the regional operators should use the same switch supplier. The state secretary replied that responsibility lies with the regional authorities and operators, that the switches will be replaced before winter, and that supplier choice is for those parties.
Although responsibility for Randstadrail lies with the regional governments and their operators HTM and RET, I of course take note of the reports on this subject.
Hoewel de verantwoordelijkheid voor Randstadrail bij de regionale overheden en hun vervoerders HTM en RET ligt neem ik uiteraard wel kennis van de berichten over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de spoorplannen bij station Naarden-Bussum

An MP asked the state secretary about ProRail's plans for Naarden-Bussum station, including removing overtaking tracks, level-crossing closure times, underpass options and future-proofing. The state secretary answered that a ProRail proposal is in preparation, crossing closure data will only be available in 2014, no additional overtaking is needed on the line according to studies, and no underpass or lowered-track study by the ministry is underway.
I cannot go further into the breakdown you asked for at the Naarden-Bussum level crossing now, since I do not yet have the measurement data for the crossings in Naarden-Bussum.
Ik kan op de door u gevraagde uitsplitsing op de overweg in Naarden-Bussum nu niet verder ingaan, aangezien ik nog niet beschik over de meetgegevens van de overwegen in Naarden-Bussum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht ‘Wachten op vergunning anti-hagelkanon’

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary why municipalities such as Borssele still face difficulties permitting anti-hail cannons despite the 2013 Bor amendment, and whether guidance or an exemption for occasional use would be issued. The state secretary replied that the amendment met the earlier commitment by placing permitting with local authorities, that the 2011 guidance and a May 2013 letter support municipalities, and that no general exemption or rule is appropriate given local noise concerns.
In my view there is therefore no discrepancy between the commitment I made to regulate the use of the anti-hail cannon and its concrete implementation.
Naar mijn mening is er dan ook geen sprake van discrepantie tussen de door mij gedane toezegging voor het regelen van het gebruik van het anti-hagelkanon
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Ziengs over aanbesteding van busvervoer

Two VVD MPs asked whether regional tender requirements such as high turnover and public transport experience exclude new entrants from regional bus concessions, and whether small private bus operators could be considered. The state secretary said tender requirements are public, that regions have wide discretion under EU and national rules, and that the points will be raised with a working group on more flexible tenders.
Therefore I will bring the points you mentioned (turnover and public transport experience requirements) to the attention of the working group
Daarom zal ik de door u genoemde punten (eisen van omzet en ervaring met openbaar vervoer) onder de aandacht brengen van de werkgroep
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over een volledige open sky tussen Nederland en Suriname

An MP asked the state secretary about a full open-skies agreement with Suriname, given reported Turkish and US moves and high fares on Amsterdam-Paramaribo. The state secretary replied that the existing open-character agreement already allows three carriers per country, that ACM found no excessive fares, and that no new open-skies treaty is needed now, though he is willing to talk if necessary.
I am always willing to talk about a further liberalisation of the current air transport agreement should the need arise in the future.
Ik ben altijd bereid om te praten over een nog ruimere mate van liberalisatie van het huidige luchtvaartverdrag indien daar in de toekomst noodzaak toe blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over uitspraken van econoom Philippe Boucher over de levensvatbaarheid van regionale luchthavens

MP Bashir asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment how the government views economist Boucher's claim that many regional airports are not viable, whether public investment in them makes sense, and whether provinces should keep supporting loss-making airports and Ryanair receives discounts at regional airports. The State Secretary answered that airport viability is left to market parties under a market-oriented approach, that the central government generally does not finance regional airports except in exceptional, consulted cases, that airports' financial results are not reported to government, that provincial support is a provincial decision, and that airport-airline discount deals are a matter for the airport and, if contested, the competition authority ACM.
Airports report their financial results to their shareholders. There is no obligation to report these to me.
Luchthavens rapporteren hun financiële resultaten aan hun aandeelhouders. Er is geen verplichting om deze aan mij te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het spoor bij station Elst en bouwplannen van de gemeente Overbetuwe

An MP asked the state secretary about a proposed fourth track at Elst station, a municipal town hall construction plan, and rail safety distances. The state secretary answered that a fourth track is not spatially or financially feasible, that the planned building respects the statutory rail buffer, and that no provincial or national funding for a fourth track is foreseen.
I am still awaiting the definitive proposal from the regional authorities in East Netherlands on the use of that one-off €25 million.
Ik ben nog in afwachting van het definitieve voorstel van de betrokken regionale overheden uit Oost Nederland voor de inzet van die eenmalige € 25 mln.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over scholen die laks zijn met asbestcontrole

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether schools' failure to carry out asbestos inventories is acceptable, and whether a statutory inventory duty should be introduced. The state secretary replied that schools' boards remain responsible for health, that inspection will sample non-responding schools with findings due end 2013, and that permanent attention is preferred to a one-off obligation.
I announced at the committee meeting of 20 June that the ILT will carry out a sample among schools that did not respond.
Ik heb in het AO d.d. 20 juni aangekondigd dat de ILT een steekproef gaat uitvoeren onder scholen die niet hebben gereageerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over grondwaterzuiveringsinstallaties bij boeren

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked whether strict Activiteitenbesluit rules and rare discharge exemptions leave farmers with groundwater treatment installations no option but costly chemical waste disposal of brine, and whether the rules should be loosened. The state secretary replied that the rules are not stricter than the former Lozingenbesluit, that transitional rules and case-by-case maatwerkvoorschriften offer flexibility, and that no amendment is needed.
The decree gives the competent authority ample opportunities, within the appropriate frameworks, to broaden discharge possibilities case by case through a maatwerkvoorschrift.
Het besluit biedt het bevoegd gezag ruime mogelijkheden om binnen de geëigende kaders bij maatwerkvoorschrift de lozingsmogelijkheden per individueel geval te verruimen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hoogland en Jacobi over het bericht voorstellen van Rederij Doeksen om de winterdienstregeling te versoberen en de tarieven te verhogen

MPs Hoogland and Jacobi asked the state secretary about Doeksen's plan to cut winter ferry services and raise fares to Terschelling and Vlieland due to competition from EVT, which sails at dumping prices while the concession is suspended pending a court case. The state secretary said he is consulting the island municipalities on short-term options and will report later this summer, and that the best solution is for the concessions to become final, which depends on the pending appeal.
The concessions becoming final would be the best solution to the problem.
Het onherroepelijk worden van de concessies zou de beste oplossing voor het probleem zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over de inkrimping dienstregeling veerdienst Vlieland en Terschelling

MPs Aukje de Vries and De Boer asked about the planned winter reduction of ferry and fast-ferry sailings to Vlieland and Terschelling, the island councils' protest letter, and the transparency of Doeksen's finances. The state secretary said he is taking the matter seriously, will explore options with the island authorities, and has commissioned an external review whose conclusions are not yet final, while refusing to disclose the review's results and deferring to the independent Commissie Bootdiensten.
We will come back to this later this summer.
Later deze zomer zullen wij hierop terugkomen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het beschadigen en weghalen van een beverburcht door het waterschap

An SP MP asked whether the water board Peel en Maasvallei violated the Flora- and faunawet by destroying beaver dams without a permit, and what the consequences and safeguards are. The State Secretary answered that the water board acted carefully and in line with the law, that lowering and removing the dams was unavoidable to prevent flooding, and that no further consequences or new measures were planned.
The water board Peel en Maasvallei has acted in accordance with the Flora- and faunawet.
Het waterschap Peel en Maasvallei heeft conform de Flora- en faunawet gehandeld.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber inzake de permanente structuur OV-chipkaart

MP Dik-Faber asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the permanent structure for the OV-chipkaart, including the kwartiermaker's letter, a feasibility study on single check-in/check-out, deadlines, consumer representation, and whether a legislative proposal for an authority with binding power will be introduced. The state secretary answered by referring each question to a letter to the Tweede Kamer of 11 July 2013 and to an earlier answer, without providing the substance requested.
I refer you for this to my letter to the House of Representatives of 11 July 2013 on motions and commitments regarding the OV-chipkaart
Ik verwijs hiervoor naar mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 11 juli 2013 over moties en toezeggingen OV-Chipkaart
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de mogelijke privatisering van de luchtverkeersleiding

MP Kuiken asked the state secretary whether he agreed that partial privatisation of the monopolistic air traffic control provider LVNL, which bears heavy responsibility for aviation safety, is unwise, and what the aviation sector thinks of it. The state secretary answered that the CEO spoke in a personal capacity, that privatisation is not current government policy, that the internal organisational form should stay open pending Single European Sky considerations, and that the aviation parties broadly agree on the themes.
Partially privatising Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland is currently not cabinet policy.
Het (gedeeltelijk) privatiseren van de Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland is op dit moment geen Kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de veiling van GSM-frequenties en de mogelijke interferentie met GSM-R(ail)

MP Dik-Faber asked the ministers about the status of the GSM-R interference problem caused by public mobile networks, cost liability, legal options to require better train radio equipment, EU-level action, licence conditions and 4G timing. The government answered that a coordination model is nearing completion with results due later in summer, that the legal options for mandating equipment still need study, that EU-wide work is underway, and that it cannot yet commit to a solution.
The results will become available later this summer.
De resultaten zullen later deze zomer beschikbaar komen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de privacybestendigheid van de anonieme OV-chipkaart

An MP from D66 asks the state secretary whether the government's position that the anonymous OV-chipkaart does not involve personal data holds, given the CBP's view and research showing transit data can be traced to individuals, and asks whether the government will take steps to better protect travel data. The state secretary answers that the CBP is the competent supervisor, that TLS does not collect name or address data, that the online transaction overview is popular, and that he sees no reason to change his position.
Supervision of compliance with privacy legislation has not been assigned to me but to the CBP as the independent supervisor.
Toezicht op de naleving van de privacywetgeving is niet bij mij belegd maar bij het CBP als onafhankelijke toezichthouder.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘OV-chipkaart weer gekraakt’

An MP asked the state secretary about a report that the OV-chipkaart had been cracked again, the history of fraud and hacking incidents, privacy risks, and whether the system should be scrapped. The state secretary replied that the reported scenario is not currently possible, gave an overview of past incidents with limited damage, and rejected abandoning the system, citing rising user satisfaction.
No, I do not share this view. The OV-chipkaart is increasingly appreciated by travellers.
Nee, deze mening deel ik niet. De OV-chipkaart wordt in toenemende mate gewaardeerd door de reizigers.
Antwoord vragen Van Tongeren over de onregelmatigheden bij chloortransport door Amersfoort

An MP asked the state secretary about irregularities during chlorine rail transports through Amersfoort, including route deviations, unreported timetable deviations and alternative routing. The state secretary said the ILT recorded the irregularities, drew up official reports for criminal prosecution, found the Betuweroute alternative less safe, and declined a meeting with the German counterpart.
The results of the criminal investigation being conducted by the Public Prosecution Service, however, will not be made public.
De resultaten van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat bij het Openbaar Ministerie loopt, worden echter niet openbaar gemaakt.

Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf en Helder over het bericht dat toezichthouders van het Openbaar Vervoer in Amsterdam geen boete voor vernieling meer mogen geven van het Openbaar Ministerie wanneer er sprake is van

Two PVV MPs asked whether Amsterdam public transport inspectors may no longer issue fines for vandalism when OV gates are forced open, and whether the government would reverse this and widen inspectors' powers. The state secretary answered that Amsterdam's VOV inspectors, who are employed by the municipality, cannot issue zwartrijden fines under article 70 of the Wet personenvervoer, so an OM policy line and an adjustment of working methods are being pursued, while refusing to withdraw the OM policy or change the regulations.
To achieve a more uniform method of settlement, the OM recently issued a policy line on fare evasion and electronic access gates.
Om tot een meer eenduidige afdoeningswijze te komen heeft het OM onlangs een beleidslijn uitgevaardigd over zwartrijden en elektronische toegangspoortjes.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het vergassen van ganzen in de wijde omgeving van Schiphol in 2013

MP Thieme asks the state secretaries about the 2013 CO2 gassing of geese around Schiphol, the exemption granted to Duke Faunabeheer, lease conditions, the Luchthavenindelingbesluit, the grain-ploughing subsidy, transparency of the goose management plan, the Raad voor Dierenaangelegenheden advice, costs, and the scientific basis for the cull. The government answers that the exemption was granted, lease conditions and bird-test plans are being developed, the subsidy runs to 2017, the Stichting withheld tender details, and costs are about 5 euro per goose.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hoogland en Tanamal over het bericht  “fouten bij chloortransport Amersfoort”

MPs Hoogland and Tanamal asked the state secretary about reported errors in a chlorine transport through Amersfoort, including whether deviations from the plan raised risk, the ILT's role, and the Betuweroute. The state secretary said deviations were found but risk can only be concluded after the ongoing criminal investigation, and declined to send a finished investigation because none exists yet.
Whether there was an increased risk can only be concluded on the basis of the criminal investigation, which is still ongoing.
Of er sprake is geweest van een verhoogd risico kan pas worden geconcludeerd op basis van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek, dat nog loopt.
Antwoord vragen Van Veldhoven over vuilstortplaatsen

An MP asked the state secretary about contaminated waste dumps in The Hague, whether other municipalities should be warned, whether contaminated sites should be inventoried nationwide, and the progress of a motion and a Green Deal on sustainable landfill management. The government answered that The Hague's sites pose no current risk, the GGD is advising, national data is decentralised, and the Green Deal is delayed to early 2014 with a methane study expected around September.
Because of the decentralisation, the ministry has no data available at national level on Navos landfill sites.
Vanwege de decentralisatie zijn bij het ministerie geen gegevens op landelijk niveau beschikbaar over Navos-stortplaatsen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over de veerbotenoorlog

MPs De Vries and De Boer asked about the ferry dispute between EVT and Doeksen on the Wadden islands routes, its long duration, the timing of the CBb court case, effects on service, the winter timetable and Doeksen's compensation request. The state secretary said the concession is not yet final so the ODC applies and competition is allowed, that a request for expedited court handling must come from the CBb, that a winter timetable proposal is under review with municipalities, and that compensation is premature.
That is why I have asked the CBb whether it wishes to submit a request to the European Court for expedited handling of the case.
Daarom heb ik het CBb gevraagd of zij een verzoek willen indienen bij het Europese Hof voor versnelde behandeling van de zaak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Fokke en Jacobi over “overtredingen door veehouderijen met luchtwassers”

MPs Van Dekken, Fokke and Jacobi asked about violations by livestock farms with air scrubbers, including 58% of inspected cases with breaches and 16% serious ones, and their effect on fine-particle and nitrogen calculations, enforcement in Brabant versus other provinces, and sanctions. The state secretary acknowledged the non-compliance, pointed to mandatory electronic monitoring from 2016, said enforcement is delegated to municipalities and provinces without a national register, and promised to take further measures if compliance does not improve.

There is no national system in which the competent authorities under the Wabo record inspections, so no overview of the results of inspections of intensive livestock farms with air scrubbers can be given.

Er is geen landelijk systeem waarin de bevoegde gezagen voor de Wabo de controles registreren, waardoor geen overzicht van de resultaten van controles op intensieve veehouderijen met luchtwassers gegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de veiligheid van stationsgebieden bij vervoer gevaarlijke stoffen

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked whether legal requirements should be set for sewerage at rail locations, such as mandatory separation of rainwater and wastewater, and whether the minister would map risky rail-site sewers and consider isolation measures. The state secretary answered that municipalities hold the sewerage and incident-preparedness duty under the Leidraad Riolering, that the national government sets generic norms while local authorities implement them, and that no judgement on rail-specific requirements can be made until the Belgian investigation into the Wetteren accident is available.
Once the results of the investigation in Belgium become available, I will examine whether the specific situation in Wetteren could also occur in the Netherlands.
Zodra de resultaten van het onderzoek in België beschikbaar komen zal ik nagaan of de specifieke situatie in Wetteren zich ook in Nederland kan voordoen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevaren van mestvergisters voor de volksgezondheid

MP Ouwehand asked whether manure digesters pose public health risks, citing a 2012 biogas leak in Coevorden that forced evacuations, and whether local permitting and oversight are adequate and whether national rules or a construction stop are needed. The government answered that the RIVM risk assessment was sound, that the permit and enforcement questions are for the competent local authority and that it has no information on the Coevorden permit, and that it will evaluate co-digestion policy in two years but sees no need for a construction stop.
I have no insight into the permit for the digester in Coevorden and its enforcement by the competent authority.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de vergunning voor de vergister in Coevorden en de handhaving daarvan door het bevoegde gezag.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over giftige gassen in vliegtuigen

MPs Kerstens and Kuiken asked the state secretary whether the Zembla broadcast on toxic gases in aircraft cabins and cockpits warranted further investigation, what was done after the 2010 broadcast, and whether the issue would be raised internationally. The government answered that EASA is primarily responsible, that prior inquiries found no grounds for new rules, that REACH analysis of TCP is scheduled for 2014, and that EASA will report semi-annually and Parliament will be informed of developments.
I note that various parties continue to want to be kept informed about developments regarding TCP.
Ik constateer dat er bij diverse partijen behoefte blijft om op de hoogte te blijven over de ontwikkelingen in het kader van TCP.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Bashir over vervoer gevaarlijke stoffen

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about the composition of a hazardous-goods train that derailed at Wetteren in Belgium, whether rules were broken, whether emergency services are informed in advance, and whether tank wagons and safety norms are adequate. The government answered that no rules were broken, emergency services are not notified per train but have category-level data via OVGS, tank wagons met Dutch norms at departure, and it will raise safety improvements internationally only if the Belgian investigation finds grounds.
If not, are you willing to make such advance information provision mandatory?
Zo nee, bent u bereid dergelijke informatievoorziening vooraf te gaan verplichten?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Ulenbelt over nieuwe technieken voor asbestverwijdering

MPs Van Gerven and Ulenbelt asked the ministers how the new Foamshield asbestos-containment technique was assessed, whether workers and residents will be protected, who supervises the trial, and what the products and costs are. The government answered that the work meets existing Arbo rules, that exposure will stay below limit values, that Inspectie SZW will inspect alongside local bodies, and that the certification body Ascert is still studying whether the technique can be validated.
Yes, I am aware of the planned application in Zeist of a new technique, under the name Foamshield.
Ja, ik ben bekend met de voorgenomen toepassing in Zeist van een nieuwe techniek, onder de naam Foamshield.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de plannen voor Doorstroomstation Utrecht

The MP Dik-Faber asks the state secretary about the plans for the Utrecht doorstroomstation (flow-through station), including its costs, the loss of a direct Gouda-Utrecht-Arnhem intercity, robustness against disruptions, reroute options, and ERTMS. The state secretary answers that the design follows the chosen variant, cost breakdown is withheld as tender-sensitive, a direct intercity is not included but remains technically possible, and that ERTMS choices are still under study.
The further breakdown of costs concerns tender-sensitive information and therefore cannot be released.
De nadere onderverdeling in kosten betreft aanbestedingsgevoelige informatie en kan om die reden niet worden vrijgegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over "harde eisen van de arbeidsinspectie aan Odfjell na ernstige overtredingen" (De bijlage is ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd, alleen voor de leden, bij het Centraal I

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked whether the Labour Inspectorate's 2007 letter with eleven hard demands to Odfjell was complied with, and asked for the full file and all inspectorate letters to Odfjell over ten years to be made public. Minister Asscher confirmed the letter, listed the inspection visits and which violations were resolved, noted that the ATEX violation led to a criminal report and court ruling, and made the file and letters available only for confidential inspection by MPs due to the company's commercial interests.
Given Odfjell's commercial interests, I make this data available to your House only for confidential inspection.
Gelet op het bedrijfsbelang van Odfjell stel ik u deze gegevens vertrouwelijk, alleen ter inzage aan uw Kamer, ter beschikking.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over de Tweede Nota Duurzame Gewasbescherming

An MP asked the state secretaries how the Second Pesticide Reduction Policy Note is progressing, the status of the Grashoff motion on glyphosate use and comparative studies of chemical versus non-chemical weed control, who is responsible for promoting non-chemical methods (Nefyto), and when the Note will be sent. The government answered that the Note will be finalised and sent in May, the two studies are nearly ready and will be forwarded with the Note, and responsibility for non-chemical methods lies with the ministers, not with industry.
I will finalise the Note and send it to you in May.
Ik zal de Nota afronden en u deze in mei toezenden.
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over de opmerkingen van de president-directeur van KLM dat de problemen tussen KLM en Schiphol alleen maar op papier zijn opgelost, maar dat de echte problemen er nog liggen

An MP asked the state secretary how to interpret KLM's CEO saying the KLM-Schiphol problems were solved only on paper and that real problems remain. The state secretary declined to comment on media reports, said the Shared Vision Commission should finish its second part, and said the report would be sent to parliament in May.
It is my intention to send this report to the House in May.
Het is mijn intentie om dit rapport dan ook nog in mei aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord vragen Van Veldhoven over de privacybestendigheid van de anonieme ov-chipkaart

An MP asked the state secretary whether travel histories of anonymous OV-chipkaart holders can be viewed with only the card number and expiry date, and whether this is undesirable. The state secretary answered that only card number and expiry are needed, that TLS holds no personal data on anonymous cards, and that no further action is needed, while pointing to personal cards as a privacy-protective option.
I will not ask TLS to require additional safeguards from TLS when viewing the transaction data of the anonymous OV-chipkaart.
Ik zal TLS niet verzoeken om extra waarborgen van TLS te verlangen bij het inzien van de transactiegegevens van de anonieme ov-chipkaart.
Antwoord vragen De Boer over buitenlandse vervoerders op de HSL-Zuid

MP De Boer (VVD) asked whether Eurostar's plans for an Amsterdam-London high-speed link were known, why foreign operators are admitted to the HSL-Zuid under Dutch rules, and how Dutch high-speed track charges compare with neighbouring countries. The state secretary answered that the link is under study but not before 2018 and that the market should decide, explained that the Dutch cost model differs from other countries so no clean comparison is possible, and declined to disclose the Thalys charge, leaving it to the concessionaire and Thalys.
The amount Thalys pays for its trains is a matter between HSA and Thalys.
De hoogte van het bedrag dat voor Thalys-treinen betaalt wordt, is een zaak tussen HSA en Thalys.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert, Jan Vos en Van Dekken over het aardbevingsbestendig maken van de olie- en gasopslag in Groningen

MPs asked whether oil storage in Eemshaven, licensed on older earthquake assumptions, must be made earthquake-proof, whether systematic risk studies cover licensed firms, and whether NAM should pay for upgrades. The government replied that Vopak is still assessing its terminal, that 11 studies including effects of quakes above 3.9 Richter are underway, that NAM will be approached if preventive upgrades are needed, and that COVA can rely on Vopak's licence compliance.
As part of the 11 studies mentioned, the possible surface effects of an earthquake larger than 3.9 Richter are also being examined.
Als onderdeel van de genoemde 11 onderzoeken wordt ook onderzocht wat de mogelijke effecten aan het oppervlak zijn van een aardbeving groter dan 3.9 Richter
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Bruins Slot over het bericht “Uitstoot van ammonia bij BASF De Meern”

MPs Geurts and Bruins Slot asked whether BASF De Meern was shut down over safety concerns after an ammonia and nitrogen oxide emission, and requested inspection histories, violations, sanctions and emission data. The government answered that the municipality halted the plant temporarily by administrative coercion, that the Inspectorate SZW found no worker safety risk, and listed past exceedances and inspection results, while noting that the ILT does not supervise the BRZO and that the answers needed more time.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over onderzoek giftig gas in vliegtuigen

An MP asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about reports of toxic fumes (TCP) in aircraft cabins and cockpits and whether EASA should be asked to study the issue. The state secretary said the evidence does not show a link to health effects, that airlines are responsible for cabin air quality and worker health, and that REACH-based research by RIVM will examine TCP properties, with no regulatory change planned for now.
I share EASA's view that, on the basis of objective data, it cannot be said that fume events lead to a direct dangerous situation.
Ik deel de mening van de EASA dat op basis van objectieve gegevens er niet kan worden gesteld dat fume-events leiden tot een directe gevaarlijke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht ‘Kwaadwillende kan vliegtuig op afstand hacken’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment how the computer security of the Dutch aviation sector stands after a report that a malicious actor could hack an aircraft remotely, and what the government will do. The state secretary answered that aviation is part of critical infrastructure covered by existing regulation and inspection, that the tested vulnerability concerns a simulation setup rather than certified onboard systems, and that the NCSC has informed partners, without announcing a new concrete measure.
The research in question explicitly concerns a test setup and a theoretical vulnerability.
Bij voornoemd onderzoek betreft het nadrukkelijk een testopstelling en een theoretische kwetsbaarheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, De Rouwe, De Boer en Dik-Faber over het geluidsniveau langs de HSL-Zuid

MPs asked when TNO's noise measurements and the pilot along the HSL-Zuid in Lansingerland would be reported and completed, whether the 57 dB(A) limit is exceeded, and about costs, planning, speed reduction and a local residents' plan. The state secretary replied that five of eight measured homes will likely exceed the limit in the end situation by 1 to 6 dB, that the first pilot phase costs about 5.5 million euros with effect measurements planned for autumn, and that speed reduction is undesirable and not legally possible under the Spoorwegwet.

TNO currently concludes that for five of the eight homes (in the municipalities of Hoogmade and Lansingerland) where noise was measured, the calculated noise load in the final situation will be higher than the limit values in the Tracébesluit, namely 57 dB(A).

TNO concludeert op dit moment dat bij vijf van de acht woningen (in de gemeenten Hoogmade en Lansingerland) waar het geluid is gemeten, de berekende geluidbelasting in de eindsituatie hoger zal zijn dan de grenswaarden uit het Tracébesluit, namelijk57 dB(A).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Roemer over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over het bericht dat meer treinen door rood rijden

MPs Bashir and Roemer asked the state secretary why he had not yet responded to earlier questions on the rise in trains passing red signals (STS-passages), why 2012 per-operator figures were withheld, and what would be done to get other operators to invest in driver training. The state secretary replied that the annual STS report will be sent to parliament in June 2013, that he sees no reason to anticipate its analysis, and that operators give sufficient attention to the problem under the joint improvement plan.
With this in view, I have answered that I see no reason to anticipate this analysis.
Met het oog daarop heb ik geantwoord dat ik geen aanleiding zie om op deze analyse vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Veldhoven over over het gebrek aan voortgang van de doelstelling om in 2015 65%van het huishoudelijk afval te hergebruiken

An MP asked the state secretary why household waste recycling is lagging behind the 65% target for 2015, including which municipalities recycle under 40%, the Den Haag pilot status, and what concrete measures will be taken. The state secretary answered that 27 municipalities collected under 40% in 2011, that municipalities are autonomous in waste collection, and that consultation with municipalities will follow, without committing to binding measures.
I have no control over how a municipality organises collection and which instruments it uses.
Ik heb geen zeggenschap over hoe een gemeente de inzameling vormgeeft en welke instrumenten men daarbij inzet.
Antwoord vragen Remco Dijkstra over schaarse grondstoffen

Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked whether the Dutch government has sufficient insight into which scarce raw materials are critical to the economy, what the plan to secure essential materials entails, and the state of cooperation with business and bilateral agreements with source countries. The government answered all three questions by referring to a forthcoming letter on raw materials, without giving substance in this reply.
I refer you to the cabinet's state-of-affairs letter on raw materials, which the cabinet will send to you in April.
Graag verwijs ik u naar de stand van zakenbrief van het kabinet over grondstoffen welke het kabinet in april aan u zal sturen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Gerven over het bericht  “met vaststellen van nieuwe blootstellingsnormen voor asbest per 1 juli 2013 de bestaande voorzorgsmaatregelen onvoldoende bescherming bieden”

Two SP MPs asked whether new asbestos exposure limits effective 1 July 2013 would leave existing precautions insufficiently protective, and questioned the sector's safety awareness, respirator adequacy, and inspection compliance. The minister acknowledged that current methods will need adjustment, postponed the new limits to 1 January 2014, committed to a TNO study and an Inspectorate report around summer, and reported high rates of enforcement at asbestos removal sites.
Because I attach importance to a careful implementation, I have decided in response to postpone the introduction of the new limit values until 1 January 2014.
Omdat ik hecht aan een zorgvuldige uitwerking heb ik naar aanleiding daarvan besloten de invoering van de nieuwe grenswaarden uit te stellen tot 1 januari 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vos Mei Li en Vos Jan over het bericht ”Brandgevaar bij 650 duizend zonnepanelen”

MPs Mei Li Vos and Jan Vos asked about reports of fire hazards in 650,000 solar panels, whether all systems can be tested before summer, whether the company was obliged to report known defects, whether other manufacturers' panels are linked to fires, whether certification registers should be mandatory and linked to subsidies, and who is liable for buyers of a bankrupt manufacturer's panels. The minister answered that testing is the producers' responsibility, that the NVWA advises owners to switch off the affected system, that failure to report known dangers is an economic offence, that no other fires are known, that certification is voluntary and mandating it is not desirable, and that liability is a civil matter handled by the curator and insurer.
Testing of solar panel systems is the responsibility of the companies that place the products on the market, not of the NVWA.
Keuring van zonnepaneelsystemen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de bedrijven die de producten in de handel brengen en niet van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Alleen provincie mag windmolenfilm zien’

An MP from the PVV asked whether the 3D wind farm visualisation film used by the Groningen provincial government should be public, and whether the minister would use her former influence to release it. The minister said the film is a preparatory tool for the environmental impact assessment of wind park N33, that she knows its content, and that public information evenings with the visualisations are planned for late April.
I do not consider that the provincial government is withholding crucial information, since the wind farm film is a 3D visualisation used in the preparatory phase of the EIA.

Ik ben niet van oordeel dat sprake is van het achterhouden van cruciale informatie door het provinciebestuur aangezien de windmolenfilm i.c. een 3D visualisatie is gebruikt in de voorbereidingsfase van het MER.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Boer over de boete opgelegd aan NS

An MP asked the state secretary why NS customer satisfaction on punctuality and seat availability lagged behind objective performance, what action would be taken, and whether the fine was sufficiently incentivising. The state secretary explained NS's analysis of five causes, said no additional action was needed beyond monitoring, and argued the fact of being fined matters more than its size.
I will, however, closely monitor NS's actions and the results thereof.
Wel zal ik de acties van NS en de resultaten daarvan nauwgezet volgen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Kooiman over illegale lozing door zeeschepen

MPs Van Gerven and Kooiman asked the ministers about illegal night-time oil discharges by sea-going vessels, enforcement and detection chances, fines compared with Belgium and France, and port reception facilities. The minister acknowledged night-time discharges are harder to detect and that enforcement is difficult, promised further study of detection and fines, and said EU-level tightening of waste discharge obligations is preferred.

I of course also have the ambition to further reduce illegal discharges and will examine the report's conclusions and recommendations on increasing the chance of detection for feasibility and effectiveness.

Ik heb uiteraard ook de ambitie om de illegale lozingen verder terug te dringen en ga de conclusies en aanbevelingen uit het rapport inzake het verhogen van de pakkans onderzoeken op uitvoerbaarheid en effectiviteit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het KNMI

An MP asked the state secretary whether the KNMI performs tasks beyond its statutory mandate, how such tasks are monitored, the status of a promised note on the KNMI Act amendment, and when the KNMI Act will be evaluated. The state secretary answered all five questions together by referring to a separate letter on the repositioning of the KNMI, without addressing them on substance.
For the points raised in the questions, I would like to refer you to that letter.
Voor de punten die in de vragen aan de orde worden gesteld, verwijs ik graag naar deze brief.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de zorgkosten als gevolg van luchtverontreiniging door zware bedrijfswagens (zogenaamde heavy goods vehicles, hierna: HGV’s)

MP Van Veldhoven (D66) asked the state secretary about health costs of air pollution from heavy goods vehicles, citing EEA estimates, and asked whether HGV fleet renewal, emission shares and stricter EU rules would be pursued. The state secretary answered that Euro standards are being tightened, a Eurovignet and city/Maasvlakte zones exist, the cost figures are broadly accepted though mostly reflect lost life-years, and the government will work on EU-level policy revision.
The RIVM calculates annually the number of premature deaths resulting from acute exposure to elevated air pollution.
Het RIVM berekent jaarlijks het aantal vroegtijdige sterfgevallen ten gevolge van acute blootstelling aan verhoogde luchtverontreiniging.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Hachchi over het ‘mislukken van Single European Sky’

An MP asked the state secretary about airline criticism that the Single European Sky compromise on performance and charging regulations undermines the goal of a single European airspace. The state secretary acknowledged the criticism, argued the revisions balance airline and state interests, and outlined Dutch and FABEC steps including a joint 2015-2019 performance plan.
The Netherlands will continue to focus on the implementation of FABEC.
Nederland zal zich blijven richten op de implementatie van FABEC.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de veiling van GSM-frequenties en de mogelijke interferentie met GSM-rail

An MP asked the state secretary and economic affairs minister about GSM-R rail interference from the 4G frequency auction, including cost allocation, EU access rules, and legal options. The government replied that a coordination model is nearly finished and that it will answer the questions substantively in April, deferring full answers until then.
For a correct and complete answer to the questions posed, it is in our view desirable that the development of this model has been completed.
Voor een juiste en volledige beantwoording van de gestelde Kamervragen is het volgens ons gewenst dat de ontwikkeling van dit model is afgerond.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over de vergoeding van luchtvaartmaatschappijen aan passagiers bij vertraging

MP Kuiken asked the state secretary about airlines not compensating passengers for delays after a 2013 CJEU ruling, and about stricter sanctions. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said airlines state they respect the ruling and the inspectorate sees this in practice, and announced fines as a new sanction regime.
For that reason, I already announced a change to the sanctions regime in my letter of 27 February 2013.
Om die reden heb ik bij brief van 27 februari 2013 reeds een wijziging van het sanctieregime aangekondigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over de verwerking van teerhoudend asfalt

An SP MP asks whether policy on tar-containing asphalt granulate is working, given continued export of large volumes to Baltic states, what has been done since a motion to prevent export, and why not all road managers require thermal cleaning in their tenders. The state secretary replies that Dutch policy works for Dutch-origin material but about half is still exported legally under EU rules, lists actions such as revising CROW guidance and standard tender clauses, and gives 2012 export figures without naming individual exporters.
Can you indicate how many tonnes of asphalt have been exported since the motion was adopted, where to, and by whom?
Vraag 3 Kunt u aangeven hoeveel ton asfalt sinds het aannemen van de motie is geëxporteerd, waarheen en door wie?
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over asbestsanering in de scholen van Bonaire

MPs Hachchi and Van Veldhoven asked the state secretary whether asbestos removal from Bonaire schools would follow Dutch rules, where the material would go, who is responsible and pays, and whether BES law should be aligned with Dutch standards. The government answered that Dutch rules are used as the benchmark, that the material will likely be shipped to the Netherlands for processing with temporary storage on Bonaire, that the Rijksgebouwendienst is responsible for storage while the Bonaire public body and the education ministry bear the costs, and that full alignment of BES law is deferred to a 2015 evaluation.
Until then, in principle the principle of legislative calm is maintained.
Tot die tijd wordt in beginsel vastgehouden aan het uitgangspunt van legislatieve rust.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Elias en Litjens over het mogelijk stellen van natuur boven mensen in Flevoland

MPs Elias and Litjens asked the state secretary whether nature protection in Flevoland is placed above residents' living conditions, given that Natura 2000 areas are overflown at higher altitudes than inhabited areas like Zeewolde, and whether the government will work with the municipality on a solution. The state secretary answered that existing national noise and nature standards apply equally, that the Alders advice ensures a minimum flight altitude over protected areas, and that the Alders table will continue working on route design and noise-reduction measures with the municipality.
At the end of last year I gave Mr Alders the assignment to draw up an implementation programme for elaborating the Alders advice on Lelystad.
Ik heb eind vorig jaar de heer Alders de opdracht gegeven om een uitvoeringsprogramma op te stellen voor de uitwerking van het Aldersadvies Lelystad
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Tongeren over het weigeren van blindengeleidehonden door taxichauffeurs

MPs Voortman and Van Tongeren asked whether taxi drivers refusing guide dogs, shown on PowNews, is acceptable and what measures exist to guarantee taxi accessibility. The state secretary condemned refusals, said municipalities can impose accessibility and carriage duties under the Taxiwet, promised to urge municipalities to act, and said national legislation is not needed.
I will urge the municipalities to include this point in their local taxi regulations.
Ik zal bij de gemeenten aandringen dit punt in hun locale taxiregelgeving op te nemen
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Boer en Lodders over aanzienlijke prijsstijgingen in het openbaar vervoer, naar aanleiding van prijsstijgingen op het Hanzelijn-traject

Two VVD MPs asked why train fares on the Hanzelijn route are 15-25% higher than on parallel routes, and whether fares were agreed to be based on distance. The state secretary explained NS's tariff-unit system that equalises fares across parallel routes, denied any agreement to base fares on kilometres, declined to change the tariffs, and said regional fares are the responsibility of decentralised authorities.
It is not correct that it was agreed that the fare would be based on the number of kilometres.
Het klopt niet dat was afgesproken dat de ritprijs zou worden gebaseerd op het aantal kilometers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het tariefsysteem op het spoor

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary about rail fare inconsistencies, including higher fares on parallel routes, unexplained tariff units and the Hanzelijn pricing, and asked for a distance-based fare system in the new concession. The state secretary defended the current tariff-unit system as offering traveller flexibility, admitted some anomalies, and refused to impose a distance-based fare condition in the concession.
I see no reason to change my policy on this point.
Ik zie geen aanleiding mijn beleid op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over een onderzoek dat uitwijst dat een meerderheid van lokale bestuurders voorstander is van een vuurwerkverbod

An MP asked the government whether it would act on a DirectResearch survey showing that most local councillors and mayors favour a ban on consumer fireworks, and whether declining support for fireworks justifies a total ban. The minister answered that the survey sample (420 of 2000 respondents) may not be representative, that municipalities manage fireworks nuisance with existing tools and oppose shorter firing hours, and that most citizens still oppose a ban, so the government sees no reason to change course.
I do not know whether this outcome is representative of the total of around 10,000 councillors in the Netherlands.
Ik weet niet of deze uitkomst representatief is voor het totaal aantal van circa 10.000 raadsleden in Nederland.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over verlichting en energiebesparing

An MP asks whether the Netherlands should follow France in requiring offices and shops to switch off lighting at night to save energy, and how much energy this would save. The minister answers that switching off unnecessary lighting is sensible, estimates 2 PJ savings, but rejects a blanket obligation, pointing to existing building and activity-decree rules and promising a further energy-saving plan in spring 2013.
An obligation to switch off all lighting is not an obvious course in the Netherlands.
Een verplichting om alle verlichting uit te schakelen ligt in Nederland niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over luchtkwaliteit

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about air quality: why there are no measurements in Maastricht, whether the government agrees that Dutch air quality remains poor despite policy, whether it accepts RIVM's warning about uncertain input data, and why measures only apply at 'serious' smog. The state secretary answered that the monitoring network is designed for national coverage, that policy has reduced fine dust, that data quality is the responsibility of road managers with steps taken, and that 'moderate' smog does not imply serious health consequences.
I can agree with that statement to the extent that further improvement of air quality is certainly desirable, given the health effects.
Ik kan die uitspraak in zoverre onderschrijven, dat verdere verbetering van de luchtkwaliteit zeker gewenst is, gezien de effecten op de gezondheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat meer treinen door rood rijden

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the rise in trains passing red signals (175 last year), what would reduce this before ERTMS is installed, whether rail operators pay enough attention, the per-operator figures, and whether others should follow NS's driver training. The state secretary pointed to the joint ProRail/industry improvement plan and the ILT's pending analysis, gave only indicative figures, and declined to pre-empt the ILT's annual report on driver training.
The ILT is expected to have final figures at the end of February. As usual, I will send Parliament the annual report with the analysis of the figures in June.
Naar verwachting heeft de ILT eind februari definitieve cijfers beschikbaar. Zoals gebruikelijk zend ik uw Kamer in juni de jaarlijkse rapportage met de analyse van de cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Van Dekken over het bericht dat Groningen is ontsnapt aan een treinramp met gevaarlijke stoffen

Two Labour MPs asked the state secretary whether a near-accident at Groningen Europapark rail yard in March 2012, where a train carrying dangerous goods was routed onto the wrong track, was serious and what caused it. The state secretary answered that the cause was an incorrect drawing and missing acceptance checks, that ProRail has since added drawing checks and physical tests, and that the Inspectorate continues to monitor, with results expected in autumn 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over een incident met een trein met gevaarlijke stoffen

De Boer (VVD) asked the state secretary about an ILT report on a train carrying dangerous goods that ran through a signal in Groningen, asking whether ProRail's error was the cause, whether the fragmented safety process should be unified, whether this was structural, and whether ProRail would be asked to respond. The state secretary confirmed ProRail was responsible, attributed the cause to an incorrect drawing, said procedures had been tightened and a broader ILT audit of drawing management was underway, and committed to sharing ProRail's response.
Yes. As soon as I have received this response, I will share it with your House.
Ja. Zodra ik deze reactie heb ontvangen zal ik die met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over energiebesparing door minder en duurzame verlichting

An MP asked the government about reducing energy use through less and more sustainable road and building lighting, including switching off road lighting after 21:00, dimmable or presence-sensitive lighting, LED road markings, cooperation with provinces and municipalities, night-time lighting rules for offices and shops, and designating dark areas. The state secretary answered that the road-lighting switch-off was being prepared for spring 2013, that presence-sensitive lighting is unsuitable on main roads, that existing rules already cover energy-saving measures in buildings, and that dark-area designation is a provincial responsibility, though the topic can be raised with local climate ambassadors.
However, I am willing to raise this topic at the local level in the consultations with the 'climate ambassadors'.
Wel ben ik bereid om in het overleg met de «klimaatambassadeurs» dit onderwerp op lokaal niveau te agenderen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Jan Vos en Van Tongeren over de sterke daling van de CO2-prijs

Three MPs (Van Veldhoven, Jan Vos, Van Tongeren) asked the state secretary whether the sharp fall in the EU ETS carbon price after the ITRE vote was unexpected, whether confidence in the ETS is structurally at stake, and what the timetable is for backloading and structural reform. The secretary answered that the price drop was foreseeable given the emissions-rights surplus, that the ETS itself is not in question but needs strengthening, and gave a timetable (EP vote on backloading around 15 April, PBL follow-up study in April) and a count of member states' positions.
I recently informed you by letter about the input the government intends to provide
Ik heb u recentelijk bij brief geïnformeerd over de inbreng die de regering voornemens is te leveren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over zonder gewasbeschermingsplan drie procent minder subsidie

An MP asked whether farmers lacking a crop protection plan should really lose three percent of income support, and whether the NVWA should drop these checks while a replacement is being developed with the sector. The state secretary refused to reverse the decision, saying the absence of a plan can no longer be remedied under EU cross-compliance rules, while a sector-agreed alternative is being explored.
I do not share your views in questions 2 and 3.
Ik deel uw opvattingen onder 2 en 3 niet.
Antwoord vragen Voordewind en Dik-Faber over de stijgende regionale vervoertarieven voor scholieren vanaf het schooljaar 2013-2014

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked about sharp regional public transport fare increases for pupils from 2013-2014, the lack of clarity for schools and parents, and whether alternative subscriptions or harmonisation were agreed. The state secretary said fare decisions are regional, acknowledged the criticism, pointed to a compensation scheme in Zuid-Holland and to a planned permanent structure for harmonising discount products, but declined to take formal action or set a maximum increase.
From my current role, however, I have no formal powers to act against this.
Vanuit mijn huidige rol heb ik echter geen formele bevoegdheden om hier tegen op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Van Klaveren over het meenemen van geleidehonden in de taxi

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether refusing blind passengers with guide dogs in taxis is unacceptable, whether the government will enforce this or legislate, and whether it will act despite religious objections to dogs. The state secretary called refusal unacceptable, said a national legal obligation is unnecessary, and said he will urge municipalities to use their power under the Taxi Act to bar such refusals.
However, I will explicitly point the municipalities to the possibility the Taxi Act offers to impose additional requirements on taxi transport.
Wel zal ik de gemeenten nadrukkelijk wijzen op de mogelijkheid die de Taxiwet biedt aanvullende eisen aan het taxivervoer te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over gebrek aan veiligheid in overdekte zwembaden

An MP asks about a lamp falling in a Dordrecht indoor swimming pool, use of corrosion-prone stainless steel fixings, the status of a 2004 practice guideline, enforcement gaps by municipalities, and whether the national government will re-inspect pools. The minister answers that the guideline remains usable and NEN will update it, that the Rijk no longer has interbestuurlijk toezicht over municipalities since oversight moved to provinces, and declines a new ILT inspection.
Supervision of the municipalities no longer lies with the national government but with the provinces.
Het toezicht op de gemeenten ligt niet meer bij het Rijk maar bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Mei Li Vos over afspraken tussen spooraannemers over de prijs van onderhoud van het spoor

MPs Hoogland and Mei Li Vos asked whether rail contractors Volker Rail, BAM Rail and Strukton Rail were engaging in unlawful price agreements on track maintenance, whether the competition authority should be consulted, and how the government would respond to a pending court ruling on performance-based maintenance (PGO) tenders and the experience with those contracts. The state secretary replied that there were no concrete indications of cartel behaviour, that the NMa supervises competition and may investigate, that ProRail was vindicated and may proceed with the Eemland award, and that PGO contracts have raised quality and lowered costs according to ProRail, with further inspection research underway.
At this moment I have no concrete indications that this is the case regarding the agreements between rail contractors.
Op dit moment heb ik geen concrete aanwijzingen dat daarvan in het geval van de afspraken tussen spooraannemers sprake is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren inzake de borging van kennis bij de Raad voor de leefomgeving en infrastructuur (Rli)

An MP asked the state secretary whether the knowledge and expertise of the dissolved Adviesraad Gevaarlijke Stoffen would be preserved within the new Rli advisory council, including why former AGS members were not reappointed.
