The government answered that former members were invited as associate members, a former project leader was hired, the Rli is independent and responsible for its own knowledge, and a former AGS member sits on a Rli committee on BRZO-company supervision.
The Rli is an independent advisory council and is therefore itself responsible for safeguarding the necessary knowledge and expertise.
De Rli is een onafhankelijke adviesraad en is dus zelf verantwoordelijk voor het borgen van de benodigde kennis en knowhow.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over de rapporten over de BRZO-rapportage van Odfjell van oktober 2012

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked the state secretary about the October 2012 BRZO inspection reports on Odfjell, fines imposed on Seveso firms, incident reports, safety after the reorganisation, pipe-thickness checks and whistleblower channels. The secretary released the inspection report, which found violations enforced against but not dangerous enough to stop operations, and described the monitoring, enforcement and whistleblower arrangements, promising a monitoring report by mid-2013.
The inspection report for inspection days 1, 9, 10, 11, 16 and 17 October 2012 was released on 8 February 2013.
Het inspectierapport van inspectiedagen 1, 9, 10, 11, 16 en 17 oktober 2012 is op 8 februari 2013 vrijgegeven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de charitatieve kledinginzameling

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether municipalities profit from tendering textile collection, which harms charities, and how collection and municipal rules work. The state secretary said he lacks an overview of municipal practice because municipalities are autonomous, defended the legal definition of textile waste, and said he finds it inappropriate to charge fees that cover other municipal costs, with the Interior Ministry to consult VNG.
Therefore I have no overview of collection methods, tenders, costs and revenues.
Daarom heb ik geen overzicht van inzamelmethoden, aanbestedingen, kosten en inkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Geurts over het artikel «Achterhoek is spoorproblemen spuugzat»

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about recurring rail disruptions on the Arnhem-Winterswijk line since 2010, whether ProRail and operators implemented promised measures, punctuality and passenger compensation, and how remaining problems will be solved. The state secretary acknowledged poor performance, attributed the December 2012 failures to start-up problems of new operators, reported most measures implemented and punctuality recovering, and said operators would compensate passengers and a team is monitoring performance.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht «Achterhoek is spoorproblemen spuugzat»

MPs Hoogland and Otwin van Dijk asked the state secretary about reported rail problems on the Arnhem–Winterswijk line and whether he would talk with the province and municipalities. The state secretary attributed the disruption mainly to new rolling stock and single-track vulnerability rather than train sharing, gave punctuality figures, and said the responsibility for train operations is decentralised and he is willing to discuss infrastructure issues if asked.
The responsibility of the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment in principle concerns only the rail infrastructure.
De verantwoordelijkheid van het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu betreft in principe alleen de spoorweginfrastructuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over het bericht dat Arriva een gevaar is op het spoor

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a near-collision involving an Arriva train at Herfte, whether it was reported to the ILT, and whether Arriva's safety and driver familiarity were adequate, along with STS-passage statistics, the effects of market liberalisation on rail safety, and progress on a warning system and capacity funding. The state secretary replied that the incident was reported immediately, the ILT found no dangerous situation and opened no further investigation, that no broader safety problems were found, and described the warning-system pilot and capacity projects.
The ILT decided not to launch a follow-up investigation into this incident.
De ILT heeft besloten geen vervolgonderzoek naar dit incident in te stellen.
Antwoord vragen Fokke en Jan Vos over het bericht 'niet ondertekenen verdrag export onbegrijpelijk'

Two PvdA MPs asked why the Netherlands is not ratifying ILO Convention 170 on chemical safety, and whether this endangers workers abroad and imposes low administrative costs on firms. The minister answered that the government will consult the social partners and the SER on ratification, pointed to alternative chemical information sources, and noted that five of 27 EU states have ratified.
Following the consultation between the Cabinet and the Labour Foundation on 19 December, I informed the House by letter.
Naar aanleiding van het overleg tussen Kabinet en de Stichting van de Arbeid op 19 december heb ik de Kamer per brief geïnformeerd
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over een vuurwerkverbod tijdens het broedseizoen

Member Ouwehand asked the state secretaries whether municipalities should be barred from permitting fireworks at events such as Queen's Day during the bird breeding season, citing a court ruling on Weesp. The state secretary replied that the court ruling concerned a handhavingsverzoek rejected by the Dienst Regelingen, not a municipal permit, and rejected a national fireworks ban, relying instead on the Flora- en faunawet's prohibition of intentional disturbance and organisers' duty to assess locations case by case.
I do not share your view.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht dat treinkaartjes mogelijk duurder worden

MP De Boer asked whether NS's monopoly over travel information lets it set tariffs for regional operators, and whether the cost-allocation method is fair. The state secretary replied that the NMa approved the takeover under strict conditions, with a prescribed tariff method for 2013 and cost-based tariffs from 2014, and that the government will follow the negotiations between operators without commenting on media-reported methods.
I will continue to follow the outcomes of the discussion on tariffs for 2014.
Ik zal de uitkomsten van de discussie over tarieven 2014 blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht dat regionale treinen mogelijk duurder worden

An MP asked whether NS plans to make regional rail operators pay more for travel information and whether a dispute over it could be resolved quickly. The state secretary said the cost-sharing history was proportional, that talks are ongoing under the NMa decision, and that she cannot guarantee continuity of travel information but will hold operators to their shared responsibility.
I cannot give you guarantees, but I will certainly hold the operators to their shared interest and responsibility to properly secure travel information for the traveller.
Ik kan u geen garanties geven, maar ik zal vervoerders zeker aanspreken op hun gezamenlijke belang en verantwoordelijkheid om reisinformatie goed te borgen voor de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Gemeente verdient aan kledinginzamelaars’

An MP asked whether municipalities profit from charity clothing-collection containers by charging fees that exceed costs and using the proceeds to balance municipal budgets. The government answered that municipalities are autonomous in organising textile collection and it lacks an overview of fees and revenues, but agreed that fees should not cover other municipal costs and will consult the VNG.
I am of the view that a municipality may charge third parties a fee that is necessary to cover the costs the municipality must incur.
Ik ben van mening dat een gemeente aan derden een vergoeding in rekening mag brengen die noodzakelijk is voor het voldoen van de kosten die de gemeente moet maken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over geluidsoverlast van goederentreinen bij Borne

An SP MP asked the state secretary about noise from freight trains near Borne, including measurement discrepancies, publication of operator names, horn signals and the reliability of the noise register. The state secretary said the variation is real and that source measures are needed, but declined to publish operator names, denied the horn practice, and deferred conclusions on the discrepancies until a full-year measurement report.
A measurement period of only 4 months is in my view insufficient to base conclusions on; I am awaiting the definitive report.
Een meetperiode van slechts 4 maanden acht ik onvoldoende om conclusies op te baseren, ik wacht daarvoor de definitieve rapportage af.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuiken over mogelijke onveiligheid in de luchtvaart

An MP asked the state secretary whether defects reported on the Turkish Airlines aircraft before the 2009 crash went unrepaired, and how the Inspectorate (ILT) checks defect reporting, inspection frequency and sanctions. The government denied unrepaired defects, said all reported defects are repaired, described the inspection regime and said sanctions for such findings target airlines.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Rouwe over de berichten ‘Geen 19 miljoen maar 2,6 miljoen reizigers voor Fyra’ en de dagstatistieken zoals bijgehouden door Failra

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that the Fyra high-speed train carried far fewer passengers than claimed, plus its punctuality, cancellations, causes of delay, and how the operator would be held to its concession norms. The state secretary acknowledged the problems (RBC and infrastructure faults, insufficient rolling stock until H2 2013), said sanctions were deliberately deferred, and promised monthly progress reports to parliament.

I consider it important that in this start-up phase the focus of all parties involved lies on implementing structural improvements in the performance of this new train connection. That is why I have not yet imposed the sanctions the concession allows me to impose on NS Hispeed (HSA).

Ik vind het belangrijk dat in deze opstartfase de focus van alle betrokken partijen ligt op het doorvoeren van structurele verbeteringen in de prestatie van deze nieuwe treinverbinding. Daarom heb ik nog niet de sancties, waartoe de concessie mij de mogelijkheid biedt, opgelegd aan NS Hispeed (HSA).
Antwoord vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Fokke over de privatisering van het toezicht in de bouw

MPs De Vries and Fokke asked the government about privatising building inspection, including whether private checks on structural safety would be independent, who would be liable, and whether regional inspection services would be a better option. Minister Blok answered that private quality assurance is planned from 2015 with checks and balances, that liability and sanctions will be clarified by mid-2013, and that a national inspection body proposal is still under consideration.
My intention is to make private supervision possible alongside municipal supervision.
Mijn voornemen is om naast het gemeentelijk ook privaat toezicht mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord vragen Kuiken over mogelijke onveiligheid in de luchtvaart

An MP asked the state secretary whether defects in aircraft are noticed but not reported or repaired, whether financial pressure on airlines could cause this, and whether an independent investigation or logbook checks would be undertaken. The state secretary said inspections find no evidence of unreported defects, that oversight cannot guarantee full compliance, and that no independent investigation or logbook check is warranted at present unless inspection outcomes give cause.
At airlines, everything is aimed at addressing possible problems as quickly as possible.
Bij luchtvaartmaatschappijen is alles erop gericht mogelijke problemen zo snel mogelijk aan te pakken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over aanpassing van het station Meppel

An MP asked the state secretary why the Meppel station adjustments for extra trains from Leeuwarden were delayed until spring 2013 and what this means for passengers. The state secretary answered that the works turned out larger than estimated (platform and signalling), that passengers must wait until May 2013, and that earlier delivery is not possible.
Mainly because of the mentioned change in the signalling installation, earlier delivery is however not possible.
Vooral vanwege de genoemde wijziging in de beveiligingsinstallatie is een eerdere oplevering echter niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf, Klever, Graus, Bosma en Van Vliet over het bericht “Topsalaris staatsbedrijven nog ruim boven Balkenendenorm”?

PVV MPs asked whether state-owned enterprise executive pay exceeding the Balkenende norm should be clawed back, and whether the Balkenende norm is high enough. The minister replied that state holdings fall outside the Balkenende pay-cap law because they are not publicly funded, but that the state's pay policy for these holdings is assessed against its own framework, which will be revised.
state holdings do not fall under the Public and Semi-Public Sector Senior Officials (Remuneration) Act, because they are not financed with public funds
staatsdeelnemingen vallen niet onder de Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semipublieke sector, omdat zij niet met publieke middelen worden bekostigd
Antwoord vragen Hachchi over de voortgang van het Single European Sky (SES)

An MP (Hachchi, D66) asked the state secretary about progress on the Single European Sky, the European Parliament resolution, Eurocontrol recommendations on Dutch oversight of airspace, and the FABEC functional airspace block. The state secretary answered largely by describing existing oversight arrangements, the FABEC ratification timeline, and commitments to pursue implementation.
The head of the NSA has an independent position as prescribed by European regulations.
Het hoofd van de NSA heeft een onafhankelijke positie zoals voorgeschreven in de Europese regelgeving.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Rouwe en Geurts naar aanleiding van het artikel ‘De meerwaarde van dynamisch rekenen aan emissies’ d.d. 31 oktober 2012 van Verkeersadviesbureau Goudappel Coffeng en de Universiteit Twe

Two CDA MPs asked the minister whether static traffic models ignore congestion and whether dynamic models should be used to re-examine air quality and noise at knooppunten like the A10 and A13 and to modernise the models. The minister rejected both, saying static models give reliable forecasts for air and noise policy while dynamic models suit detailed design and traffic management.
No. Static models provide good forecasts of future traffic volumes and the associated effects.
Nee. Statische modellen leveren goede prognoses van de verkeersomvang in de toekomst en de bijbehorende effecten.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de hernieuwde poging een zelftest voor darmkanker op de Nederlandse markt te brengen (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about a Belgian-website self-test for colorectal cancer marketed in the Netherlands, its reliability, costs of false results, legal status, and the timing of a national screening programme. The minister answers that FOB self-tests are already sold, that CE-marking and a channelling rule govern them, that EU enforcement is hard, and that a national screening decision awaits a RIVM feasibility study expected at year end.
I expect this report at the end of the year.
Ik verwacht dit rapport aan het einde van het jaar.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over eiceltoerisme in het buitenland (ingezonden 15 september 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about egg-cell tourism to Spain, where donors remain anonymous (unlawful in the Netherlands), and whether insurers may reimburse such IVF abroad and how premiums are kept to Dutch quality standards. The minister answers that IVF with anonymous donation abroad is an insurable benefit, that EU free-movement law precludes limiting reimbursement to Dutch quality rules, and that no new measures are planned.
Health insurers are therefore obliged to reimburse that treatment.
Zorgverzekeraars zijn dus gehouden die behandeling te vergoeden.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Heijnen (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het ondersteunen van mantelzorgers (ingezonden 22 septembe

MPs Wolbert and Heijnen asked the ministers of Health and Interior about a reported Erasmus study on care-giver support delaying nursing-home admission, the number of care offices with case management, and the government's own care-friendly employment policy. The minister said he did not know the study, answered that all care offices include dementia care in procurement with varying regional coverage, and described awareness campaigns and partnerships with employers, plus a planned conference on care-friendly HR policy for government departments.
This study is not known to me.
Dít onderzoek is mij niet bekend.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ziekte Meervoudige chemische overgevoeligheid (MCS) (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the health minister about multiple chemical sensitivity (MCS), its classification abroad, why the Netherlands does not recognise it as a disease, the Gezondheidsraad 1999 conclusions, research on chemical exposure, and reducing chemicals in consumer products. Minister Klink answered that MCS is not a classified disease, that complaints are addressed by professionals, that no new Gezondheidsraad advice is needed, and that existing product safety rules and a complaints portal apply.
At this moment I do not consider it necessary to ask the Gezondheidsraad for a new advice.
Ik vind het op dit moment niet nodig om de Gezondheidsraad om een nieuw advies te vragen.

Vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Gerven en Gesthuizen (allen SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Economische Zaken over het opleggen van een boete door de Nederlandse Mededingingsautoriteit

SP MPs asked the ministers of Health and Economic Affairs about the NMa fining the LHV for a broken seal on a room, and whether they would intervene and commission research into market competition in GP care. The ministers answered that the NMa is an independent regulator, the fine is for the courts and the LHV to contest, and that competition rules protect patient choice and quality, with the NMa currently investigating the GP sector.
This concerns an individual case in which the NMa, as an independent regulator, has discretionary power to seal premises and impose a fine when a seal is broken.

Het betreft hier een individuele zaak, waarin de NMa als onafhankelijke toezichthouder de discretionaire bevoegdheid heeft om ruimtes te verzegelen en om een boete op te leggen wanneer een verzegeling verbroken is.

Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een onderzoek naar de relatie tussen abortussen en prenatale screening bij Downsyndroom (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

An SGP MP asks the health minister about a study reporting that about 90 percent of pregnancies with a Down syndrome diagnosis after prenatal screening are terminated, and asks what has been done since 2008 to ensure complete and objective information. The minister replies only that the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because extra information must be gathered, and promises answers as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that extra information must be gathered to answer the questions.
De reden van het uitstel is dat voor de beantwoording van de vragen extra informatie moet worden ingewonnen.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de uitvoering van de adviezen van de Stuurgroep zwangerschap en geboorte (ingezonden 23 september 2010).

The MP asks the health minister about whether hospitals can provide 24/7 obstetric emergency care, the NVZ-commissioned Plexus study, and how the Stuurgroep's recommendations on concentrating maternity care will be implemented. The minister says the Plexus scenarios need further consultation, defers the final decision to the next cabinet, and promises to inform the House before the 2011 budget debate.
I am willing to inform the House before the 2011 budget debate of the steps I will take to convert the Stuurgroep's recommendations into policy.

Ik ben bereid de Kamer vóór de behandeling van de begroting van Volkgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport 2011 te informeren over de stappen die ik zal nemen om de aanbevelingen van de Stuurgroep om te zetten in beleid.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over strengere richtlijnen voor spermabanken (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

An MP asked the health minister whether sperm banks should have accepted a neo-Nazi donor's condition that his sperm be used only by white couples, and how donor guidelines could be tightened. The minister said the banks should not allow donors to impose population preferences, that the professional association will draft stricter guidelines in cooperation with the obstetrics association, and that the Health Care Inspectorate will supervise compliance.
The Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) supervises compliance with guidelines established by professional groups.
De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) houdt toezicht op de naleving van richtlijnen die door beroepsgroepen zijn vastgesteld.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman (SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over het advies aan zwangere vrouwen over alcohol dat te vrijblijvend is (ingezo

MPs Kooiman and Voordewind asked the health minister how he would respond to research showing midwives give non-committal advice on alcohol in pregnancy, and what he would do about midwives' knowledge, consultation practice, training and warning labels. The minister said he finds the advice worrying, commissioned an intervention card and a study of how intermediaries use professional information, left training to the KNOV, and kept the government's position of no warning labels pending evidence.
I find it worrying that non-committal advice on alcohol use is given to pregnant women.
Ik vind het zorgelijk dat er vrijblijvend over alcoholgebruik wordt geadviseerd aan zwangere vrouwen.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de berichten dat de minister van VWS een salaris van 285.000 euro voor vrij gevestigde specialisten als maximum salaris aanvaa

An SP MP asked the health minister whether a 285,000 euro maximum salary for self-employed medical specialists, above the Balkenende norm, is acceptable, and why the Balkenende norm is not applied. The minister answered that no decision has been taken on maximum or minimum incomes, that the specialist remains responsible for medical content, and that the income policy would need separate legislation.
I have not taken a decision on the level of the average or on a maximum or minimum income for medical specialists.
Ik heb geen besluit genomen over de hoogte van het gemiddelde of over een maximum- of minimuminkomen voor de medisch specialisten.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht onderbezetting in zorginstellingen (ingezonden 17 september 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about reports of summer understaffing in care institutions and whether this is a structural problem, and what measures institutions and the government could take. The minister said the problem is not known to be structural or national, that institutions are primarily responsible for solutions, and that the government subsidises regional cooperation and is discussing an agenda with social partners.
As far as I am aware, this does not constitute a structural and national problem in care.
Voor zover mij bekend vormt dit geen structureel en landelijk probleem in de zorg.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over onnodige pijn bij bevalling (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

An MP asked the health minister why many hospitals do not guarantee 24-hour epidural pain relief during childbirth despite a national guideline, and what measures will ensure compliance. The minister answered that all hospitals offer some pain relief, that a few lack 24-hour epidural availability mainly for staffing reasons, that hospitals should be transparent, and pointed to a quality indicator survey showing most hospitals now offer 24/7 epidural relief.
It is up to the hospitals to be transparent about the care they can provide, and it is also up to the hospitals to deliver that care as far as possible in line with the guidelines.

Het is aan de ziekenhuizen om transparant te zijn over de zorg die zij kunnen bieden en het is eveneens aan de ziekenhuizen om die zorg zo veel mogelijk overeenkomstig de richtlijnen te doen plaatsvinden.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat te weinig kinderen worden ingeënt tegen mazelen (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

MP Arib asks the health minister about reports that too few children are vaccinated against measles, whether the 95% threshold is being missed, its causes and consequences, and plans to keep vaccination rates high. The minister acknowledges the shortfall, attributes it mainly to groups rejecting vaccination, notes measles elimination cannot fully be excluded, and commits to continuing and strengthening information efforts rather than new binding measures.
Yes. My policy is to support parents in their decision whether or not to vaccinate their child through good information.
Ja. Mijn beleid is om de ouders in hun besluit tot wel of niet vaccineren van hun kind te ondersteunen door een goede voorlichting.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de effecten van concurrentie tussen ziekenhuizen (ingezonden 15 september 2010).

SP MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister about a CPB report finding that hospital competition reduced costs but may have worsened some quality indicators such as pressure ulcers, waiting times for hip surgery and cancelled operations, and asked whether prices should be regulated in the B-segment. The minister replied that quality indicators improved over 2004-2008, that the negative effects are partly explained by data issues and are for the Inspectorate to assess, and that competition policy should continue without price regulation, with no concrete new action committed.
The CPB indeed concludes that there is a significant relationship between competition and the mentioned indicators.
Het CPB concludeert inderdaad dat er een significant verband bestaat tussen concurrentie en de genoemde indicatoren.

Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over promotieactiviteiten van Heineken tijdens de huldiging van het Nederlands elftal (ingezonden

An MP asks ministers whether Heineken's promotional activities during the Dutch football team's celebration reached many minors, whether the 25% minors rule in the alcohol advertising code was adequate, and what action is planned on alcohol sponsorship in sport. The minister acknowledges that 165,000 youths were reached, says no revision of the 25% rule is needed for now, notes no evidence yet that municipal policy was discouraged, and declines to ban alcohol sponsorship in sport at present.
There is no reason for this at present.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over de toename van het aantal zwerfjongeren (ingezonden 19 augustus 2010).

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers of Health and of Youth and Family about reports that the number of street youths is rising due to the crisis, the gap between the Stichting Zwerfjongeren Nederland estimate and the Court of Audit figure, whether a single definition of street youths exists, and what the Handreiking has achieved. The ministers answered that signals are taken seriously, that a unified definition has been adopted by letter of 24 June 2010, that the handreiking was distributed but its effects were not studied, and referred to the progress report on shelter policy.

What is your reaction to the report that the Stichting Zwerfjongeren Nederland (SZN) assumes two to three times as many youths without a fixed residence as the Court of Audit, which at the end of 2008 assumed 6,000?
Wat is uw reactie op het bericht dat de Stichting Zwerfjongeren Nederland (SZN) uitgaat van twee tot drie keer zoveel jongeren zonder vaste woon- of verblijfplaats dan de Algemene Rekenkamer
Vragen van het lid van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de weigering inzage te geven in een Inspectierapport (ingezonden 24 augustus 2010).

SP MP van Gerven asks the health minister why a freedom-of-information request for documents on the Inspectorate's handling of a neurologist case was refused, and why the report on the Inspectorate's own conduct is not public. The minister says the criminal investigation justified withholding nearly all documents, points to the public report and later independent studies already sent to parliament, and rejects the claim that the government has something to hide.

Given the ongoing criminal investigation into neurologist J.S., following the Public Prosecution Service's view it was judged that the interest of investigating and prosecuting criminal offences must prevail over the general interest of disclosure.

Gelet op het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar neuroloog J.S. is naar aanleiding van de zienswijze van het OM geoordeeld dat het belang van opsporing en vervolging van strafbare feiten in dit geval dient te prevaleren boven het algemene belang van openbaarmaking

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het in opspraak raken van artsen in ziekenhuizen te Amstelveen, Emmen, Enschede en Purmerend die jarenlang hun gang konden gaan

An MP asked the health minister how to prevent poorly functioning doctors from practising for years and harming patients, and about the roles of hospital boards, peer review and the inspectorate in the case of an orthopaedic surgeon in Waterland hospital. The minister answered that steps were already taken (new board information on visitation reports, IGZ guidelines), rejected a mandatory reporting duty, and explained that the inspectorate and hospital board had no earlier signals beyond a 2008 tribunal warning until new tribunal rulings in March 2010.

As I already informed your House in the letter 'Status of commitments AO IGZ and supervision of medical specialist conduct (31 March 2010)', many steps have already been taken to identify dysfunction of doctors at an early stage and take appropriate measures.

Zoals ik uw kamer al heb laten weten in de brief «Stand van zaken toezeggingen AO IGZ en toezicht met betrekking tot medisch specialistisch handelen (31 maart 2010)» zijn er al veel stappen gezet om disfunctioneren van artsen in een vroegtijdig stadium te signaleren en passende maatregelen te nemen.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verzaken van de acceptatieplicht door verzekeraars (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

MP Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about NZa investigations into insurers allegedly breaching the statutory duty to accept insured persons (acceptatieplicht), including which insurers, motives, risk equalisation, non-payment measures, and sanctions. The minister confirmed the NZa is investigating, declined to name insurers, promised evaluations and a report to parliament in autumn/December 2010, and noted NZa sanction powers.
I am not aware of which health insurers are being investigated.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte welke zorgverzekeraars worden onderzocht.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over chaos bij het CAK (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

MP Leijten asks the minister about reported complaints over the CAK, including inconsistent letters, unanswered emails and poor reachability, and whether a deduction of extraordinary costs in calculating the personal contribution was lawful. The minister denies chaos, says complaint numbers are not elevated nationally, notes the CAK is handling the Drenthe complaints and that information provision has improved, and states the CAK must add rather than deduct extraordinary expenses.
The CAK has made arrangements with Zorgbelang Drenthe on receiving and handling these complaints.
Het CAK heeft met Zorgbelang Drenthe afspraken gemaakt over de ontvangst en afhandeling van deze klachten.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een nieuwe reeks misstanden in de ouderenzorg (ingezonden 3 september 2010).

MP Leijten (SP) asks the health minister about a new series of abuses in elderly care, including a year of poor conditions at Loevestein in The Hague, and whether a bewindvoerder (administrator) should be possible when quality is seriously deficient, plus whether a dedicated elderly-care complaints point should be opened at the Inspectie. The minister acknowledges the problems and staffing strain, says the IGZ already has adequate instruments, is still studying bewindvoerderschap for financial continuity, and defers the complaints-point decision until the new disability-care point has been evaluated.
I do not consider bewindvoerderschap necessary, because the IGZ can impose intensified supervision in case of persistently poor quality.
Bewindvoerderschap vind ik niet nodig, omdat de IGZ bij voortdurende slechte kwaliteit verscherpt toezicht kan instellen.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat dementerenden in een verpleeghuis over een langere periode voedsel voorgeschoteld kregen dat (ver) over de datum wa

An MP asked the health minister how she reacts to reports that dementia patients in a nursing home were served food long past its expiry date, whether the director's response is adequate, whether the Inspectorate will investigate, and whether the home will be given a directive or placed under enhanced supervision. The minister regrets the incidents, says the board is addressing the problem and staff have been instructed, that the Inspectorate and VWA are investigating with a VWA visit finding no violations, but that there is currently no reason for a directive or enhanced supervision.
The investigation by the IGZ has been initiated in cooperation with the Food and Goods Authority (VWA).
Het onderzoek door de IGZ is in gang gezet in samenwerking met de Voedsel en Waren Autoriteit (VWA).

Vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en voor Wonen Wijken en Integratie over het bericht dat Turken en Marokkanen tijdens een gratis haarknipbeur

PVV MPs asked why Turkish and Moroccan pensioners receive free haircuts with explanations of the AIO supplement in their own language, and why they need not buy AOW buy-in like others. The minister answered that the SVB uses bilingual staff to reach a hard-to-reach group and reduce non-take-up, that the AOW buy-in is voluntary for all, and that autochthonous Dutch pensioners may also use the free haircut.
The haircut campaign was set up as part of further combating unwanted non-take-up.
De kappersactie is in het kader van het verder bestrijden van ongewenst niet-gebruik opgezet.
Vragen van het lid Van Hijum (CDA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Uitleg over uitkering tijdens gratis knipbeurt allochtonen». (Ingezonden 10 september 2010)

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about the Sociale Verzekeringsbank's plan to offer free haircuts to migrants to promote the AIO supplement, and whether this was a proper motivation and what other information the SVB provides. The minister confirmed the pilot in Utrecht, said the SVB has a responsibility to combat non-take-up, listed its other communication activities, and said expansion depends on effectiveness and cost-efficiency.
It concerns a pilot in Utrecht.
Het gaat om een pilot in Utrecht.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een stijgend aantal medewerkers uit de zorg dat is ingeschreven bij het UWV (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about a rising number of care workers registered with the UWV, and whether reorganisations, company size or fragmented jobs might cause burnout. The minister answered that personnel policy is primarily the employers' responsibility, that labour conditions inspection falls under the social affairs ministry, and that concerns would be raised with social partners and included in a research programme, without committing to a new investigation.
I will ask social partners about this in my contacts with them.
Daarom ga ik sociale partners daar naar vragen in mijn contacten met hen.

Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de toepassing van de Rollkür en Laag-Diep-Rondmethode (LDR) in de Nederlandse dres

An MP asked ministers about the use of Rollkür and LDR training methods in Dutch dressage, the controversy over the Dutch dressage coach's emails to a journalist, and rules on coach conduct. The government said it does not judge training methods, that the FEI and KNHS now permit only LDR and have steward guidelines, and that coach conduct and appointments are matters for the sports federation and private parties.
It is not my responsibility or that of the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality to form a judgment on the various training methods used in Dutch sport.

Het behoort niet tot mijn taak of de taak van de Minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (LNV) om een oordeel te vormen over de verschillende trainingsmethoden die gebruikt worden in de Nederlandse sport.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de berisping van de internetapotheek door het Medisch Tuchtcollege (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister about a Medical Disciplinary Board reprimand of an internet pharmacy selling prescription drugs without valid Dutch prescriptions, and why the site dokteronline.com remained operational despite earlier promises. The minister replied that the pharmacy had stopped the practice after an enforcement order, that existing laws suffice, that the Geneesmiddelenwet omission is being fixed in a pending bill, and that foreign-operated sites are hard to reach across EU borders.
Vragen van lid Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bij voorbaat uitsluiten van alleenstaanden voor een IVF-behandeling (ingezonden 28 juli 2010).

An MP asked the health minister whether IVF clinics still exclude single women in advance, whether this complies with other rules, and whether measures will be taken. The minister acknowledged some fertility centres exclude single women, said they must follow current rules, and committed to writing to the clinics by end 2010 that single women with a medical indication must not be excluded in advance.
I am of the view that single persons with a medical indication may not be excluded in advance from fertility treatments.
ben ik van mening dat alleenstaanden met een medische indicatie niet bij voorbaat mogen worden uitgesloten van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het feit dat patiënten de dupe worden van voortdurende onduidelijkheid over ziekenhuisverplaatste zorg

MPs Wolbert and Van der Veen asked the health minister about insurer Menzis ending reimbursement for home-administered immunoglobulins, forcing patients toward hospital day treatment and raising unclear NZa rules. The minister answered that Menzis contracted hospitals for this care, that patient-side options exist, and that the bekostiging of home nursing will be evaluated, while not committing to a change in the rules.
Moreover, the House of Representatives has been promised that this new form of funding for nursing will be evaluated.
Overigens is aan de Tweede Kamer toegezegd dat deze nieuwe bekostigingsvorm van de verpleging zal worden geëvalueerd.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bij voorbaat uitsluiten van alleenstaanden voor een IVF-behandeling (ingezonden 28 juli 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about clinics that exclude single women and lesbian couples from IVF before assessment, and whether this conflicts with existing policy. The minister confirms the 2000 policy still applies, that such groups may not be excluded in advance, and promises a letter to fertility centres by end 2010 and an evaluation of the laws in 2011.
I am willing to inform the fertility centres about the policy on fertility treatments for lesbian couples and single women.
Ik ben bereid de vruchtbaarheidscentra te informeren over het beleid rondom vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen bij lesbische stellen en alleenstaanden.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie, van Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de Somalische gemeenschap een qatverbod wil (ingezonden 11 au

An SP MP asked the ministers about the size of the qat-using population in the Netherlands, whether qat causes aggression, public order problems, social-economic harm and organised crime, and how other countries regulate it. The minister answered that no figures exist on qat users, that CAM risk assessments found little public-order or addiction risk, that qat is not the main cause of Somali disadvantage, and that a few municipalities use local bylaws against nuisance.
No figures are known on the number of people within the Somali population who use qat.
Over het aantal mensen binnen de Somalische bevolkingsgroep dat qat gebruikt zijn geen cijfers bekend.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over sponsoring patiëntenorganisaties (ingezonden 19 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about industry sponsorship of patient organisations, including transparency gaps and whether conflicts of interest are excluded, and asked for an overview of sponsorship levels and tighter rules. The minister answered that existing safeguards (subsidy rules, industry codes, audits) are adequate, promised to advise the EMA on HAI's recommendations and to review CBG practice, and said the subsidy scheme would be evaluated.
However, I cannot provide you with a complete overview.
Een compleet overzicht kan ik u echter niet verstrekken.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de onduidelijke eigen bijdragen bij ziekenhuisverblijf (ingezonden 20 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister why hospitals charge different rates for TV and telephone, whether profits are made, and whether such costs should be covered by health insurance. The minister answered that these are optional extras not part of medical care, that hospitals are free to offer them, and that transparency and client council consultation should be ensured, but declined to regulate tariffs or change the insurance law.
Whether hospitals make profit on these services and how much money is involved nationally is not known to me.
Of ziekenhuizen op deze diensten winst maken en hoeveel geld hier landelijk mee omgaat, is mij niet bekend.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het functioneren van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg inzake Cordaan en HWW-zorg. (Ingezonden 31 augustus 2010)

An SP MP asks the health minister why the Inspectorate for Health Care was satisfied with Cordaan's improvement plans and then launched a large investigation after incidents, and whether the inspectorate, care office and regulators could have acted sooner, including on the HWW-zorg case and the 2008 Amsterdam Thuiszorg merger. The minister answers that improvement plans seemed sufficient at the time, that the inspectorate follows a graduated enforcement framework, that boards bear primary responsibility for care quality, that the inspectorate lacks powers to suspend a board, and that the NZa and NMa found the merger conditions met.
Of course I regret the incidents that took place last summer, and therefore I support the inspectorate conducting a large investigation at Cordaan.
Natuurlijk betreur ik de incidenten die afgelopen zomer hebben plaats gevonden en daarom ondersteun ik dat de inspectie een groot onderzoek gaat doen bij Cordaan.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een terminale patiënt geen zorg heeft gehad (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

An MP asks the health minister how a terminally ill patient was left without care after the payment-scheme (pgb) stop, and whether waiting lists are larger than visible. The minister acknowledges the care insurer's failure to refer the patient to in-kind care, announces investigations into pgb choices and waiting lists, but rejects a duty to mediate in all cases and sees no barriers for pgb providers.
I deeply regret that as a result a person in his last phase of life has missed the necessary and in principle available AWBZ care.
Ik betreur het ten zeerste dat hierdoor een persoon in zijn laatste levensfase de benodigde en in principe ook beschikbare AWBZ-zorg is misgelopen.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ziekte Meervoudige chemische overgevoeligheid (MCS) (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

An MP (Ouwehand, PvdD) asks the health minister whether MCS is recognised as an allergy in neighbouring countries, why it is not recognised in the Netherlands, whether the 1999 Health Council conclusions need revision, and whether chemicals in cosmetics and household products should be curtailed. The minister's reply only announces that the answers will be delayed due to interdepartmental consultation and promises them as soon as possible.
The questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD) about the illness Multiple Chemical Sensitivity (MCS) cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.
De vragen van het Kamerlid Ouwehand (PvdD) over de ziekte Meervoudige chemische overgevoeligheid (MCS) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over afschaffing van de afstandsindicatie AWBZ (ingezonden 30 augustus 2010).

An MP asked the minister why boarding places at the Haren deaf institute were still granted via an AWBZ distance indication while the Grave blind school was refused, and whether parents were given too little notice of the CIZ decision. The minister explained the 2009 transition arrangement ended distance indications from 2010–2011, that the Haren case was a coulance exception due to a CIZ error, and that the CIZ decided within legal deadlines.
The coulance arrangement for the Haren deaf boarding school for the 2010–2011 intake was made solely because the CIZ mistakenly still issued positive distance indication decisions.
De coulance afspraak voor het doveninternaat te Haren voor de lichting 2010–2011 is uitsluitend gemaakt omdat het CIZ abusievelijk toch positieve besluiten voor «afstandsindicaties» heeft afgegeven.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën over de besteding van AWBZ-premies (ingezonden 17 juni 2010).

MP Leijten asks whether AWBZ premiums are in fact spent on tax credits (heffingskortingen), whether this conflicts with art. 17(3) AWBZ, and how the BIKK compensation relates to the fund. The minister answers that premiums are not spent on tax credits, that the BIKK fully compensated the AWBZ fund for lower premium income after the 2001 tax reform, and that the AFBZ ran negative balances in 2008–2010.
Tax credits are not a use of AWBZ premiums.
Heffingskortingen zijn geen besteding van AWBZ-premies.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over tekorten voor GGZ-preventie (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister about threatened cuts to mental health prevention, the unclear division of responsibility between municipalities and insurers, evidence requirements for preventive care, and whether prevention funds in the Wmo should be earmarked. The minister says municipalities hold responsibility for selective prevention, promises consultations with stakeholders to clarify responsibilities, states that only depression and alcohol prevention currently meet evidence requirements, and rejects earmarking as contrary to integral Wmo policy.

Given the apparent lack of clarity, I will consult with GGZ Nederland, Zorgverzekeraars Nederland and the Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten to assess whether there is a problem and, if necessary, reach agreements on the division of responsibilities.

Gelet op de kennelijke onduidelijkheid zal ik in overleg treden met GGZ Nederland, Zorgverzekeraars Nederland en de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten om te bezien in hoeverre er sprake is van een probleem en zo nodig te komen tot afspraken over de onderlinge verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling.

Vragen van de leden Zijlstra en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Economische Zaken over de verkoop van alcoholische streekproducten (ingezonden 11 augustus 2010).

MPs Zijlstra and Ziengs (VVD) asked why the Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (VWA) tolerates sales of low-alcohol regional products at markets and tourist shops in Veere without enforcement, and how this unequal treatment can be ended. The minister explains that a 2005 directive to the VWA, prompted by a parliamentary motion, tolerates such sales at fairs for regional development reasons, denies the practice is unfair competition, and says the directive will not be withdrawn for now.
For the time being I do not intend to withdraw the directive to the VWA.
Voorlopig ben ik niet voornemens de aanwijzing aan de VWA in te trekken.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het in opspraak raken van artsen in ziekenhuizen te Amstelveen, Emmen, Enschede en Purmerend die jarenlang hun gang konden gaan

An MP asks the health minister how to prevent poorly functioning doctors from practising for years, including questions on peer review, a reporting duty, and why hospital management and the Inspectorate acted late against an orthopaedic surgeon. The minister only sends a holding reply stating that the answers will be delayed pending consultation with various parties.
The reason for the delay is that consultation with various parties is necessary for a careful answer to the questions.
De reden van het uitstel is dat voor een zorgvuldige beantwoording van de vragen afstemming met diverse partijen noodzakelijk is.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de negatieve effecten van Indiaas OK-personeel (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

SP MPs asked the health minister about the negative effects of Indian operating-theatre staff in Dutch hospitals, including cultural and language problems, extra costs, pay, hygiene standards and whether the practice should be banned. The minister only sent an interim notice saying the questions could not be answered within the deadline because the hospitals had to be consulted on costs.
As soon as I have received a response from the institutions concerned, I will answer the parliamentary questions immediately.
Zodra ik een reactie heb gehad van de betreffende instellingen zal ik de Kamervragen terstond beantwoorden.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet vergoeden van Penthotal bij euthanasie (ingezonden 1 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister for reaction to a press article about the non-reimbursement of Penthotal used in euthanasia, whether it should be covered as part of the euthanasia procedure, whether the KNMG and KNMP positions on full reimbursement are endorsed, and whether it will be added to the basic package. The minister's reply is only an interim notice: the questions cannot be answered within the usual period, the problem is complex, and VWS is seeking a solution with insurers and professional bodies, promising to report shortly.
I will inform you about this shortly.
Ik zal u hier op korte termijn over berichten.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Leijten en Irrgang (allen SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het werven van Indiaas OK-personeel door de Tergooiziekenhuizen (ingezon

SP MPs asked the ministers whether hospitals recruiting operating-theatre assistants in India for cost savings was acceptable, whether it breached government policy, and what the status was of the WHO code, the sector consultation and a training fund. The minister answered that cost savings were doubtful, that recruitment from outside the EU should be a last resort, that the WHO code is non-binding and that no mandatory Dutch code will be introduced.
I see no reason to move towards drafting a binding Dutch code for recruiting care staff from developing countries outside the EU.
Ik zie geen reden om over te gaan tot het opstellen van een verplichtende Nederlandse code voor de werving van zorgpersoneel in ontwikkelingslanden buiten de EU.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Leijten en Irrgang (allen SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het werven van Indiaas personeel door het Refaja ziekenhuis en het Sint

SP MPs asked why two Dutch hospitals (Refaja and Sint Jans Gasthuis) recruited Indian operating-theatre assistants, whether this conflicts with the cabinet's stance that recruiting non-EU care staff should be a last resort, and whether the WHO code can prevent such recruitment. The minister answers that the hospitals acted within the knowledge-migrant scheme after domestic and EU recruitment failed, that the recruitment was ethical and circular, and that the government will explore intensifying recruitment in other EU member states.
I will examine together with industry organisations which options for intensifying the recruitment of care staff in other EU member states are possible.
Ik zal samen met brancheorganisaties bekijken welke opties voor het intensiveren van werving van zorgpersoneel in andere EU-lidstaten mogelijk zijn.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en sport over psychofarmaca en kinderen (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister about a Danish study on adverse reactions to psychotropic drugs in children, rising psychotropic use in the Netherlands, Dutch adverse-event reports, prenatal SSRI risks, and whether independent research or new monitoring is warranted. The minister answers that the Danish study cannot be compared to Dutch data, that the CBG monitors all registered drugs continuously, and that no separate independent study is currently planned.
Setting up specific studies on adverse effects is not the government's task, but the outcomes of studies are of course closely monitored by the registration authorities.

Het opzetten van specifieke onderzoeken naar bijwerkingen is niet de taak van de overheid, maar de uitkomsten van onderzoeken worden uiteraard nauwgezet in de gaten gehouden door de registratie autoriteiten.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minster van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ontslagvergoeding van bijna een miljoen bij het CAK (ingezonden 11 augustus 2010).

MPs Leijten (SP) asked the health minister why the CAK annual report showed a severance-related provision of 875,000 euro for a board member, and whether it was paid from public funds and whether the CAK should recover it. Minister Klink answered that it is a balance-sheet provision for a wachtgeld (income supplement) scheme under the applicable collective agreement, not a lump-sum severance, that it is covered within CAK's budget, and that no wrongdoing or recovery power exists; he promised the CAK will become a public-law body with rijksambtenaren pay rules.
The CAK does not make a profit on the execution of government tasks.
Het CAK maakt geen winst op de uitvoering van overheidstaken.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over vrees voor grote uitval van voormalig psychiatrisch patiënten (ingezonden 27 juli 2010).

MP Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about a new 12-euro-per-four-weeks own contribution for day-care and supervision for former psychiatric patients, and whether it is reasonable and whether the government is systematically cutting care. The minister replied that the contribution is based on income, is limited for those on welfare level, was announced in 2008 and publicized, and that its effects will be monitored by a client monitor.
The NPCF will examine to what extent it can indicate whether people forgo supervision because of the introduction of the own contribution.
De NPCF zal daarbij onderzoeken in hoeverre zij kan aangeven in hoeverre mensen door de invoering van de eigen bijdrage afzien van begeleiding.

Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de ministers van Justitie, Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over verschuivende problemen drugshandel in Brabant (ingezonden 10 august

MP Van der Ham asks the ministers about the Franzel commission's findings on drug policy in Brabant cities and about displacement of drug problems from Bergen op Zoom and Roosendaal to neighbouring towns. The government says most recommendations will be taken over, that regional coffeeshop limits are not yet adopted, and that a one-year impact study will report in late 2010.
At the end of 2010 the final report will be published.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over pesten in verzorgingshuizen (ingezonden 24 augustus 2010).

MP Voortman asks the minister about reported bullying in nursing homes, linking it to staffing, resident choice and the absence of a protocol. The minister denies any link to law changes, staffing or resident choice, says there is no national protocol, and welcomes the Ouderenfonds protocol while leaving responsibility to care institutions.
Research has already been done by Radboud University, so I do not need to do it again.
Er is al onderzoek gedaan door de Radboud Universiteit, dus dat hoef ik niet nogmaals te doen.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Dijk (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over dat jongeren vaak alcoholreclame in de bioscoop zien (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

MPs Kooiman and Van Dijk (SP) asked the ministers of Health and Youth whether they would act against alcohol advertising in cinemas that reaches young audiences, and whether they would tighten self-regulation or make it statutory. The minister replied that talks with cinema operators and the alcohol industry body STIVA would come first, that self-regulation should be given a chance before any legal rules, and that a future cabinet could regulate by AMvB if needed.
I want to use this option first before considering statutory measures.
Ik wil deze mogelijkheid eerst benutten voordat ik wettelijke maatregelen overweeg.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de resistente schimmels

An MP asked three ministers about reports that resistant fungal infections in hospitals may be causing deaths and whether agricultural azole use contributes, including the scale of deaths, resistance trends and whether azoles should be banned. The ministers answered that the data is too limited to estimate deaths nationally or confirm the link to azoles, announced an expert meeting and a VWA research project, and pointed to Nethmap 2010 figures on MRSA and ESBL.
To gain more insight into the problem, the Centre for Infectious Disease Control (CIb) of the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) will convene an expert meeting.
Om meer inzicht te krijgen in de problematiek zal het Centrum Infectieziektenbestrijding (CIb) van het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) een deskundigenberaad beleggen.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de RIVM analyse Noord-Oost Groningen (ingezonden 28 juli 2010).

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister why the RIVM analysis of Noord-Oost Groningen considered only Groningen residents, why it differs from earlier studies, and what closing one or two hospitals would mean for the 45-minute emergency access norm and related system effects. Minister Klink answered that the analysis crossed provincial borders, that the model is an update of earlier work with newer data, that closing one emergency department would still meet the norm, and that hospital financing (beschikbaarheidstoeslag) will be decided by the NZa after a cost study.
I cannot tell you now which hospitals will and will not qualify.
Ik kan u nu niet zeggen welke ziekenhuizen wel en niet in aanmerking komen.
Vragen van het lid Smilde (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de sluiting van de Spoedeisende Eerste Hulp (ingezonden 28 juli 2010).

MP Smilde asks the health minister about a RIVM study suggesting that closing the emergency department at either Stadskanaal or Winschoten would still leave residents within the 45-minute norm, and why this differs from earlier advice and from an ARGO study. The minister confirms the RIVM findings, explains the 45-minute norm is applied as a spreading norm rather than a performance measure, and commits to a response in the autumn after a further ambulance-times note.
I am willing to respond to the studies in the autumn, once the note on ambulance response, treatment and transport times is also available.
Ik ben bereid in het najaar te reageren op de onderzoeken, nadat ook de notitie over de ambulance respons- behandel en bezorgtijd beschikbaar is.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over sponsoring van een voetbalclub door een zorginstelling (ingezonden 11 augustus 2010).

MPs Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about a care provider receiving state-backed support while sponsoring a football club, and about hospital sponsorship of football clubs generally. The minister said the sponsorship money came from the marketing budget rather than the state support, that the NZa monitors the use of support funds, and that the decision on sponsorship lies with the institutions' boards.
I see no reason to start such an investigation, as I assume the commotion surrounding these two cases will make institutional boards more aware of the need to weigh such expenditure.

Ik zie ook geen aanleiding een dergelijk onderzoek te starten omdat ik aanneem dat de commotie rond deze twee casussen er voor zal zorgen dat instellingsbesturen zich er extra van bewust zullen worden.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over exclusietesten voor Huntingtonpatiënten (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An MP asks why Dutch couples at risk of carrying the Huntington gene cannot use an exclusion test during embryo selection without learning their own genetic status, and whether other countries allow it. The minister confirms it is not permitted in the Netherlands because IVF and PGD would be used unnecessarily, and says the test does not fall within the ethics policy framework and will not be authorised.
I do not intend to permit the exclusion test in the case of PGD.
Ik ben niet voornemens de exclusietest in geval van PGD toe te staan.

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het verbod op de exclusietest voor de ziekte van Huntington en op HLA-typering (Human Leukocyten Antigeen) (ingezonden 13 juli 201

MP Arib asks the health minister about the ban on exclusion PGD for Huntington's disease and on HLA typing, including comparisons with prenatal testing, foreign practice, and expected request volumes. The minister restates that exclusion testing and HLA typing for donor siblings remain prohibited in the Netherlands, declines to extend the Indicatiecommissie PGD's remit, and says 2009 figures are not yet available.
I see no reason to extend the remit of the PGD indication committee.
Ik zie geen aanleiding de taak van de indicatiecommissie PGD uit te breiden.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zorginstellingen benadelen bewoners (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

An MP asked the health minister whether it agrees with the NZa that AWBZ-covered items such as coffee and fruit may not be charged to care home residents, and what measures will prevent recurrence and compensate residents already charged. The minister agrees charging for covered services is unlawful, relies on care offices and the NZa for enforcement, asks providers to refund in consultation with client councils, but says he has no powers to enforce refunds.
I have no powers or instruments to enforce this as minister.
Ik heb geen bevoegdheden of instrumenten om dit als minister af te dwingen.

Vragen van de leden Agema en Wilders (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat steeds meer zorginstellingen kosten aan bewoners doorrekenen voor zaken die vallen onder de AWBZ (inge

PVV MPs Agema and Wilders asked the health minister about reports that care institutions charge residents for AWBZ-covered services and whether residents have enforceable rights comparable to prisoners. The minister answered that such charges are unlawful, that the NZa has written to providers and expects 50 to 100 cases of improper payments, and that client rights are adequately protected under existing laws and a new client rights bill.
Charging supplementary payments for services that belong to insured care is not permitted.
Het vragen van bijbetalingen voor diensten die tot de verzekerde zorg behoren is niet geoorloofd.

Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat succesvolle en geldbesparende zorgprojecten in Leiden en Nijmegen dreigen te stoppen (ingezonden 21 juli 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about Leiden and Nijmegen care projects at risk of closure, including the NZa's 65 euro hourly cap on GP out-of-hours pay and the NZa's enforcement approach. The minister said cooperation is desirable, explained the tariff rationale, described enforcement steps, and said she was examining rule changes to allow budget transfer from the emergency department to the GP post, though she left funding of future innovations to the field.
In consultation with the NZa I am currently examining whether it is possible in the short term to amend the regulations so that budget can be transferred from the SEH to the GP out-of-hours post.
In overleg met de NZa ben ik momenteel aan het bekijken of het op korte termijn mogelijk is om de regelgeving aan te passen zodat er budget overgeheveld kan worden van de SEH naar de huisartsenpost.
Vragen van het lid Ferrier (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de dood van een zwangere Somalische vrouw in het asielzoekerscentrum van Leersum (ingezonden 2 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister of Health whether emergency medical care for asylum seekers is guaranteed after care was transferred to new health centres, following the death of a pregnant Somali woman in an asylum centre, and whether an investigation will be started. The minister answers that access should match care for residents, that the Health Inspectorate is already studying the new system, and that the Inspectorate will also investigate this incident, while declining to comment on the circumstances of death pending results.
The IGZ will also launch an investigation into the present incident.
De IGZ zal ook naar het onderhavige incident een onderzoek instellen.
Vragen van de leden Arib, Spekman en Dijsselbloem (allen PvdA) aan de ministers voor Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over medische zorg aan asielzoekers (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

MPs from the Labour party asked about the death of a pregnant Somali asylum seeker at the Leersum reception centre, including GP access, out-of-hours care, interpreter use, ambulance response and the Public Prosecution Service inquiry. The minister declined to comment on the circumstances pending the Health Care Inspectorate investigation, explained the care model and interpreter responsibility, and noted the inspectorate and prosecutor inquiries.
Pending this investigation, I make no statements about the circumstances under which the woman died.
In afwachting van dit onderzoek doe ik geen uitspraken over de omstandigheden waaronder de vrouw is overleden.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat zwangere vrouwen in asielzoekerscentra vijf keer zoveel kans hebben op lev

Two SP MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers whether the Health Inspectorate will investigate quality of care for asylum seekers in 2010 and whether it will include an unpublished LUMC study showing higher pregnancy complication risks in asylum centres. The government answered that the inspectorate's research will be presented in summer 2011 and will take the LUMC findings into account.
The IGZ will take the outcomes of the LUMC study into account in the research it conducts.
De IGZ zal de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van het LUMC betrekken bij het door haar uit te voeren onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport naar aanleiding van de door de KNVB behaalde winst tijdens het WK Voetbal (ingezonden 3 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about football clubs' financial problems, the KNVB's World Cup profit, and whether government should require financial or youth-training obligations from the football sector and the KNVB. The minister replies that sports bodies are autonomous private organisations, the KNVB made about 3 million euro profit, government invests no specifically in football youth academies, and the KNVB's use of its profit is its own decision.
In the Netherlands sports federations are autonomous private organisations, including the KNVB.
In Nederland zijn sportbonden autonome private organisaties, ook de KNVB.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de misstanden bij zorginstelling Cordaan (ingezonden 23 juli 2010).

MP Leijten (SP) asks the health minister how persistent neglect at care provider Cordaan, including a resident's death, could go unaddressed by the Inspectorate for Health Care, whether the inspectorate needs more staff and powers, and whether the municipality bears responsibility for residents. The minister says the inspectorate is investigating and monitoring the provider, that the provider bears primary responsibility for quality care, denies the inspectorate was budget-cut beyond a limited share, and places AWBZ care duties with insurers rather than municipalities.
I am awaiting the IGZ investigation, under which Cordaan will have to make improvements at various locations.
Ik wacht het onderzoek van de IGZ af, waarbij Cordaan voor diverse locaties verbeteringen zal moeten treffen.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de topsalarissen van ziekenhuisbestuurders (ingezonden 3 augustus 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether hospital board salaries above the Balkenende norm, the failure of sector self-regulation, interim manager payments and a planned 2011 savings target are acceptable. The minister defends the sector code (BBZ) and promises a statutory power to impose a code, but postpones conclusions until his own analysis of 2009 annual reports is finished.
In the forthcoming legislation it will be arranged that the minister of VWS is given the power to impose a code regulation.
In de komende wetgeving wordt geregeld dat de minister van VWS de bevoegdheid krijgt een coderegeling op te leggen.

Vragen van het lid Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het «Modelprotocol mogelijke morele contra-indicaties bij vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen» (ingezonden 22 juni 2010).

An SGP MP asks the health minister whether the NVOG model protocol on moral contra-indications in fertility treatment implies that prospective parents must be willing to undergo abortion if the child has defects, and what the value is of asking parents whether they will cooperate with prenatal or pre-implantation genetic diagnosis. The minister denies that the protocol implies an abortion duty, explains it is a non-binding framework applying a case-by-case 'yes unless' policy, and declines to take steps to ensure fertility treatment is not restricted to parents willing to abort.
The model protocol merely offers a framework for weighing how to handle difficult decisions around fertility treatments.
Het modelprotocol biedt slechts een afwegingskader hoe om te gaan met moeilijke beslissingen rondom vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen.
Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het nieuwe ivf-protocol (ingezonden 24 juni 2010).

A ChristenUnie MP asked the health minister whether the new IVF protocol, which conditions treatment on parents' willingness to terminate a pregnancy if a serious handicap is found, is acceptable, whether it shifts parental responsibility onto doctors, how it fits the legal framework, and whether the minister will ask the professional body to revise it. The minister replied that the protocol is only a decision framework for doctors, that doctors share responsibility for the child's welfare, that the protocol's legal fit is governed by licensing and planning rules, and that he will not ask the NVOG to amend it.
No, I am not willing to do so. Moreover, I do not see this as my responsibility.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid. Ik zie dit overigens ook niet als mijn verantwoordelijkheid.

Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de wens van landen van de Europese Unie om een einde te maken aan discriminatie

An MP asked ministers whether the Dutch government had taken a position at an informal EU health council on ending discrimination against blood donors, whether binding EU proposals might follow, whether Dutch policy (including on gay men) would be revised, and whether a donor blood shortage exists. The government answered that the topic was not on the agenda so no official position was taken, that the Commission has not yet responded and Parliament will be informed via BNC fiches, that it sees no reason to revise Dutch policy, and that there is currently no donor blood shortage.
If a proposal from the Commission appears, the House of Representatives will be informed through the usual channel (BNC fiches).
Als er een voorstel van de Commissie verschijnt zal de Tweede Kamer via de gebruikelijke wijze (BNC fiches) geïnformeerd worden.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over vrees voor grote uitval van voormalig psychiatrisch patiënten (ingezonden 27 juli 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about a new own-contribution charge for day care for former psychiatric patients, questioning its fairness and whether it will push people back into costlier care. The minister's reply is only a notice that the answers will be delayed and will follow as soon as possible.
The questions from MP Leijten (SP) about fears of large-scale dropout of former psychiatric patients cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.

Mededeling De vragen van het Kamerlid Leijten (SP) over de vrees voor grote uitval van voormalig psychiatrisch patiënten (ingezonden op 27 juli 2010) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over kleine zorginstellingen voor verstandelijk gehandicapten en psychiatrische patiënten die failliet dreigen t

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the minister whether small care farms serving people with intellectual disabilities and psychiatric patients risk bankruptcy due to the temporary national stop on new persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) allocations, and how many farms are affected. The minister replied that the farm in question was already in financial difficulty before the stop, that no farm is known to have failed because of the pgb measures, and that the affected group is mainly new potential pgb holders who can be placed through other financing routes.
To my knowledge, no care farm has yet got into trouble because of the pgb problems.
Bij mijn weten is er nog geen zorgboerderij door de pgb-perikelen in de problemen gekomen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over substitutie van XTC (ingezonden 23 juli 2010).

An MP asks the health and justice ministers about the shift from XTC to more dangerous substitutes such as crystal meth, GHB and new drugs, and whether drug policy backfires. The ministers answer that current data do not justify major policy changes, that GHB prompts targeted measures, and that the Opiumwet listing system will be reviewed by an expert commission.

We sent Parliament a letter on 12 July 2010 stating that, although the main-lines drug policy letter had been declared controversial, there is sufficient reason to thoroughly re-examine the listing system of the Opium Act.

Wel hebben we op 12 juli 2010 een brief aan uw Kamer gezonden, waarin is aangegeven dat, hoewel de hoofdlijnenbrief drugsbeleid controversieel is verklaard, er voldoende aanleiding is om de lijstensystematiek van de Opiumwet grondig tegen het licht te houden.
