Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de situatie bij de gehandicapteninstelling Sherpa (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister about the governance crisis at the disability care institution Sherpa, including the court suspension of the supervisory board chair, the adequacy of supervisory bodies, liability of supervisors, the inspectorate's inaction and a missing housing-wishes survey. The minister answered that existing procedures are adequate, that the Enterprise Chamber's ruling is a legitimate remedy, that supervisory board members cannot be held liable under current law (the proposed Wcz would extend this), and that the inspectorate received no complaints about substandard care.
I am of the opinion that the existing procedures are adequate.
Ik ben van mening dat de bestaande procedures adequaat zijn.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over het innen van de bestuursrechtelijke zorgpremie bij onderbewindgestelden (ingezonden 8 jul

SP MPs asked the health and justice ministers about the 130% administrative health insurance premium imposed on debtors, including a 76-year-old dementia patient under guardianship whose debts were pursued by a bailiff and split into multiple claims. Minister Klink defended the premium as an incentive, said guardians should pay premiums, rejected separate treatment of guardianship cases, and pointed to a planned statutory cap on collection costs and a complaint to the disciplinary court against the bailiff's office.
The CVZ will still refund the 100% premium withheld from the AOW pension and the collection of the remaining 30% will be stopped.
Het CVZ zal de op het AOW-pensioen ingehouden 100%-premie alsnog restitueren en de incasso van de resterende 30% zal worden stopgezet.

Vragen van het lid Venrooy-van Ark (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het stopzetten van het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb) in kleine zorginstellingen (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

MP Venrooy-van Ark asks the health minister about the temporary halt on new personal budgets (pgb) hitting small care providers, including whether the delays in converting in-kind care to a pgb can be fixed. The minister denies the cited case stems from the pgb stop, says the 6-week processing norm poses no financial problem for providers, and promises to monitor affected clients and encourage solutions without giving counts.
How many clients are involved cannot be stated, because they are new pgb clients.
Hoeveel cliënten hierbij betrokken zijn, is niet aan te geven, omdat het om nieuwe pgb-cliënten gaat.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat steeds meer mantelzorgers stoppen met werken (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

MP Wolbert asked the health minister about reports that more informal carers are quitting or reducing paid work, linked to AWBY package measures, and about support, leave awareness and a carer-friendly employment policy. The minister acknowledged the trend, pointed to existing programmes and municipal support, disputed the 20% leave-awareness figure, and said further measures are for the next cabinet to decide.
It is for the new cabinet to decide whether other measures should be taken, and how developments in this area will be monitored and reported on.
Het is aan het nieuwe kabinet om te bepalen of nog andere maatregelen moeten worden ingezet, en hoe de ontwikkelingen op dit terrein zullen worden gevolgd en hoe daarover zal worden gerapporteerd.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zijn aanwijzing aan twee thuiszorgaanbieders (ingezonden 23 juli 2010).

MP Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about his directive to two home-care providers, Cura Domestica and Hanimeli, after IGZ found serious risks, and whether licensing or stronger oversight of new entrants is needed. The minister answered that the directive was issued after IGZ advice and a hearing, rejected a licensing system and a rethink of commercial providers, and pointed to existing IGZ oversight.
On 2 July the IGZ advised me to give Cura Domestica and Hanimeli a directive under article 8, paragraph 1 of the Quality of Care Institutions Act.
Op 2 juli jl. heeft de IGZ mij geadviseerd Cura Domestica en Hanimeli een aanwijzing te geven op grond van artikel 8, lid 1, Kwaliteitswet zorginstellingen.
Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat ouderen bij een zorginstelling wekenlang niet gewassen worden (ingezonden 23 juli 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about reports that elderly residents at care facility Cordaan go unwashed for weeks, along with other alleged failures such as missed medication and residents absconding from a locked ward, and whether supervision is lacking. The minister says the IGZ is investigating the reports, rejects the claim that supervision falls short, and will act on the outcome of the investigation.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) is conducting an investigation into these reports.
De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) doet een onderzoek naar deze meldingen.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het hogere risico op overlijden bij spoedopname in het weekend en sterftecijfers van ziekenhuizen (ingezonden 26 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister about a UK study finding higher mortality for weekend emergency admissions, whether the findings apply to the Netherlands, and whether hospitals' uncorrected mortality figures were scientifically valid. The minister said extrapolation to the Netherlands requires caution, pointed to IGZ-commissioned RIVM and TNO research due in 2011, and defended publication of the uncorrected figures alongside explanatory text while promising corrected figures in 2011.
As soon as the research results are available I will inform you.
Zo gauw de onderzoeksresultaten beschikbaar zijn informeer ik u.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het dreigend overschot aan dialysecentra (ingezonden 26 juli 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether the removal of the planning system for dialysis centres in 2002 caused a doubling of centres and threatens quality and home dialysis. The minister says the 2002 deregulation was not driven by market forces, that centre numbers were not a set target, and that quality is assured by ex-post review and insurers, declining to commission new research.
Guarantees in advance, with a few exceptions, cannot therefore be given either.
Garanties vooraf zijn op een enkele uitzondering na dus ook niet te geven.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat 17000 ouderen vereenzamen door de pakketmaatregelen (ingezonden 29 juli 2010).

MP Leijten asks the health minister how she responds to reports that 17,000 elderly people will become isolated because of AWBZ package cuts, and whether cuts shift costs to more expensive care. The minister disputes the figure, says the cuts are less severe than expected, points to alternative support routes and prevention initiatives, and says the AWBZ savings may not be fully realised.
The report is not entirely based on facts.
Het bericht berust niet geheel op feiten.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de berichten dat de minister van VWS een salaris van 285.000 euro voor vrij gevestigde specialisten als maximum salaris aanvaa

An SP MP asked the health minister whether a maximum salary of 285,000 euros for self-employed medical specialists was acceptable, why pay differences were justified, why the Balkenende norm was not applied, and how specialists' professional autonomy would be guaranteed. The minister replied that the questions could not be answered within the usual deadline and would be addressed together with parliamentary committee questions on the specialist management model in early September.

The questions from MP Van Gerven (SP) about reports that the minister of VWS finds a salary of 285,000 euros for self-employed specialists acceptable as a maximum cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual deadline.

De vragen van het Kamerlid Van Gerven (SP) over de berichten dat de minister van VWS een salaris van 285 000 euro voor vrij gevestigde specialisten als maximum salaris aanvaardbaar vindt (Ingezonden 15 juli 2010) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zorginstellingen benadelen bewoners (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether he agrees with the NZa that AWBZ-covered items such as coffee and fruit may not be charged to care home residents, and what measures will prevent recurrence and compensate residents already charged. The minister replied only with a notice that the answers will be delayed because talks with the NZa, client organisations and care offices are ongoing.
The questions from MP Voortman (GroenLinks) about care institutions disadvantaging residents cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.
De vragen van het Kamerlid Voortman (Groen Links) over zorginstellingen benadelen bewoners kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van de leden Agema en Wilders (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat steeds meer zorginstellingen kosten aan bewoners doorrekenen voor zaken die vallen onder de AWBZ (inge

Two PVV MPs ask the health minister whether he knows of reports that care institutions charge residents for items covered by the AWBZ, whether he will reprimand and instruct those institutions, and whether residents should be given enforceable rights. The minister replies only that the answers will be delayed because talks with the NZa, client organisations and care offices are ongoing, and promises them as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that I am still in discussion with the NZa, client organisations and care offices.
De reden van het uitstel is dat ik nog in gesprek ben met de NZa, cliëntenorganisaties en zorgkantoren.
Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over bezuinigingen op de thuiszorg (ingezonden 3 juni 2010).

MPs Wolbert and Hamer asked the health minister about reported cuts of 200 million euros to municipal Wmo home-care budgets, alleged use of that money for medical specialist overruns, and a delayed or reduced reimbursement of Wmo implementation costs. The minister confirmed a structural downward adjustment of 200 million linked to expected efficiency gains and lower personal budgets, said specialist overruns play no role, and stated that no agreement with the VNG has yet been reached and talks continue in September.
After final conclusion of the administrative consultation, I will inform your House and the municipalities of the outcomes.
Na definitieve afronding van het bestuurlijk overleg zal ik uw Kamer en de gemeenten informeren over de uitkomsten.
Vragen van het lid Voortman (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over onderzoek naar vermeende wantoestanden bij een abortuskliniek (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

Rep. Voortman asked the health minister about reported mismanagement and quality-of-care risks at a Hague abortion clinic, including whether financial oversight of such clinics is adequate. Minister Klink answered that the Inspectorate found no serious threats to care quality, a clinic action plan is being monitored, the CVZ oversees subsidy spending while a police fraud complaint is pending, and the subsidy regulation is being revised.
Because of the problems in Amsterdam and now in The Hague, it has become apparent that the arrangement concerning abortion care requires adjustments.
Door de problemen in Amsterdam en nu in Den Haag is gebleken dat de regeling rondom de abortushulpverlening aanpassingen vereist.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bevel van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) aan HWW Zorg te Den Haag (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

MP Leijten (SP) asks the health minister why the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) had to issue an order to HWW Zorg over safety risks to residents, whether a fine-backed order is too light, whether the board still has confidence, and whether the regulatory toolkit should be expanded to allow administration takeover. Minister Klink answers that HWW Zorg complied within the seven-day order period, the order was lifted after unannounced inspections, and she sees no need to add tools to the inspectorate's toolkit since administrator appointment should be explored via legislation for a later cabinet.
I am of the view that the current supervisory instruments regarding quality contain sufficient tools to improve quality of care where necessary.
Ik ben van mening dat het huidige toezichtsinstrumentarium wat betreft kwaliteit voldoende instrumenten bevat om kwaliteit van zorg te verbeteren waar dat nodig is.

Vragen van het lid Dille (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht van een groepsverkrachting door bewoners van een instelling voor licht verstandelijk gehandicapten (ingezonden 9 juli

An MP asked the health minister about reports of a group rape by residents of an institution for people with mild intellectual disabilities, asking whether supervision was inadequate, how the parties would be approached, whether recurrence could be guaranteed, and how a girl could run away from a closed facility. The minister replied only that answers are delayed because the police investigation is ongoing and promised to send answers once it concludes.
The reason for the delay is that the police investigation on the matter is still ongoing.
De reden van het uitstel is dat het politieonderzoek terzake nog gaande is.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en sport over psychofarmaca en kinderen (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister about a Danish study on adverse reactions to psychotropic drugs in children, Dutch trends in psychotropic use, reporting of side effects, and monitoring of prescribing and birth defects in pregnancy, and whether the CBG will act. The minister replies only that the answers will be delayed because they depend on expert input, with no substantive answers yet.
The reason for the delay is that I depend on information from various experts.
De reden van het uitstel is dat ik afhankelijk ben van informatie van verscheidene experts.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over tekorten voor GGZ-preventie (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

MP Leijten (SP) asks the health minister whether cuts threaten GGZ mental health prevention programmes, who is responsible for selective prevention between municipalities and insurers, whether prevention funding should be earmarked, and whether billing for family members is bureaucratic. The minister only sends an interim notice that the answers will be delayed until September 2010, without substantive answers.
The questions from MP Leijten (SP) on shortages for GGZ prevention, submitted 25 June 2010, cannot to my regret be answered within the usual period.
De vragen van het Kamerlid Leijten (SP) over tekorten voor GGZ-preventie, ingezonden 25 juni 2010) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het Neppérus (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de verplichtingenpauze voor sportbonden (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about the spending commitment pause for sports federations, and the minister's supplementary answer states that the pause was lifted on 20 July. The answer adds a clarification to the earlier answer to question 6 and does not address oversight or accountability directly.
that the commitments pause was lifted as of 20 July last.
dat de verplichtingenpauze per 20 juli jongstleden is opgeheven.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over Let’s Go Thuiszorg te Hasselt (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

MP Leijten asked the health minister about Let's Go Zorg in Hasselt, including unpaid wages, its tax debt, continuity of care, and whether its contracts were moved to a holding. The minister answered that wage disputes are a private employer-employee matter outside VWS's role, that the company was declared bankrupt on 22 June 2010 with care largely transferred, and that other questions fall to the health insurance office, the curator or other bodies.
Of course it is undesirable if employees do not receive the wages they are entitled to.
Uiteraard is het onwenselijk als medewerkers niet het loon krijgen waar zij recht op hebben.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de traagheid van het ministerie van VWS leidt tot woekerprijzen voor medisch isotopen (ingezonden 1 juli 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether slow ministry decision-making caused tripled medical isotope prices, whether a TU Delft back-up reactor proposal should be funded, and why TU Delft has not received promised money. The minister denies that decision-making caused the price rise, says an OECD review is ongoing, and says he is considering the TU Delft proposal without having committed the funds.
No general or official data are known about this.
Hierover zijn geen algemene of officiële gegevens bekend.
Vragen van het Neppérus (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de verplichtingenpauze voor sportbonden (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP asked the health and sport minister about the extended spending freeze on sports subsidies, its uncertainty for sports federations, and its consistency with support for World Cup bids and talent development. The minister said the freeze was necessary due to the ministry's budget problems, that talent subsidies will in principle be granted after lifting, and that the freeze will be lifted once the budget problem is solved.
As soon as a solution is found for my department's budget problems, I will lift the commitment freeze.
Zodra er een oplossing ligt voor de begrotingsproblematiek van mijn departement zal ik de verplichtingenpauze opheffen.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de belangenverstrengeling bij de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO) rondom de Mexicaanse griep (ingezonden 15 juni 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the Netherlands was aware of the WHO's acknowledgement of conflicts of interest around the H1N1 pandemic, including experts advising the WHO who were also on payroll of vaccine producers, and what steps would prevent this. The minister answered that the WHO Director-General denies commercial interests played a role, that an evaluation by a Review Committee is underway, that the Netherlands will press for stricter rules via WHO channels if needed, and that transparency about adviser ties to industry should be promoted.
I assumed that the WHO works with adequate procedures to prevent conflicts of interest.
Ik ben ervan uitgegaan dat de WHO werkt met toereikende procedures om belangenverstrengeling te voorkomen

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een keten van commerciële gezondheidscentra in eigendom van een zorgverzekeraar (ingezonden 15 juni 2010).

MP Van Gerven asks the minister about Menzis's joint venture with investment firm Reggeborgh to run a chain of health centres, including profit distribution limits, whether investor and insurer co-ownership is desirable, and risks to care quality and GP independence from vertical integration. Minister Klink says he has no objection to investor co-ownership, describes the shareholder agreement's five-year no-dividend rule and conditions, and states that the existing supervisory framework (NZa, IGZ, NMa) is adequate, asking the NZa only to proactively monitor GP referral independence.
I have no reason to assume that the supervisory framework described above is inadequate or not properly applied to prevent or correct negative effects of vertical integration.

Ik heb geen reden aan te nemen dat het hiervoor beschreven toezichtskader niet toereikend is, of niet adequaat wordt toegepast, om negatieve effecten van verticale integratie te voorkomen of corrigeren.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over gifgehalten in vis (ingezonden 2 juli 2010).

MP Ouwehand asked ministers whether dietary advice to eat fish twice weekly, based on average contaminant levels, adequately accounts for higher toxin exposure from fish caught in polluted areas, and whether fish origin and traceability should be communicated. The ministers replied that the advice follows the Health Council guidelines, that imported fish meets legal safety norms enforced by the VWA, and that further traceability beyond the FAO catch area offers little public health benefit.
Further traceability offers too little additional benefit from a public health perspective.
Verdere traceerbaarheid biedt vanuit volksgezondheidsoogpunt te weinig extra’s.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de noodzaak om de verloskundige zorg radicaal te veranderen (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

MP Arib asks the Minister of Health about a Erasmus MC study finding that 25% of high-risk pregnancies go unrecognised, and whether the system and gynaecologist–midwife cooperation should be overhauled. The Minister responds that risk assessment is being improved (revised midwife indication list, College Perinatale Zorg, mandatory home visits), rejects the claim that Dutch mothers are to blame or that an IGZ re-analysis is needed, and commits to further studies and reviewing the extra third ultrasound.
I will therefore look at possibilities to adapt the financing to this.
Ik ga dan ook kijken naar mogelijkheden om de financiering hierop aan te passen.

Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het feit dat patiënten de dupe worden van voortdurende onduidelijkheid over ziekenhuisverplaatste zorg

Two PvdA MPs asked the health minister about insurer Menzis stopping reimbursement of home-administered immunoglobulins and hospitals' conduct in shifting care to day-admission, including an NZa policy rule and a 9-year-old patient's case. The minister's reply is only a postponement, citing ongoing consultation with Menzis on its care-purchasing process and a request for case details.
The reason for the delay is that your questions relate to Menzis's care-purchasing process.
De reden van het uitstel is dat uw vragen betrekking hebben op het zorginkoopproces van Menzis.

Vragen van de leden Elias en Neppérus (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over bureaucratische beslissingen waardoor onderneme

MPs Elias and Neppérus asked why a biocide disinfectant product may be distributed in other EU states but not the Netherlands, and what the government will do to solve the problem. The minister answered that the substance is still under EU assessment, the company did not apply under the differentiated enforcement policy, and no exception will be made.
I do not intend to make an exception for this product.
Ik ben niet voornemens om voor dit middel een uitzondering te maken.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de handel in apen voor dierexperimenten door RC Hartelust bv (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

An MP asked the health minister for detailed figures on primate imports, origins, transport deaths, housing and inspections at RC Hartelust bv, a Tilburg primate trader for animal experiments, and about why a visit by the Party for the Animals was refused. The minister declined to give company-specific data citing the Wet openbaarheid van bestuur and privacy law, pointed to general CITES and Wod rules, said the 2005 transport deaths were handled by the VWA without criminal enforcement, and stated the company may decide whom it admits.
Under the Government Information (Public Access) Act and the Personal Data Protection Act, I cannot provide specific company information about individual businesses.
In het kader van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur en de wet bescherming persoonsgegevens kan ik over individuele bedrijven geen specifieke bedrijfsinformatie verschaffen.

Vragen van het lid Zijlstra (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, van Economische Zaken en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het Top Instituut Pharma (ingezonden 10 juni 2010).

MP Zijlstra asked whether the EUR 6 million bridging finance granted to TI Pharma secures its continuity, what TI Pharma requested, and whether the government values the public-private partnership enough. The minister replied that the EUR 6 million only secures short-term continuity, leaving long-term funding to the next cabinet, and that the government is willing to consult partners.
The bridging amount of EUR 6 million is not intended to secure the long-term continuity of TI Pharma; it guarantees its continuity in the short term.
Het overbruggingsbedrag van € 6 mln. is niet bedoeld om de langetermijncontinuïteit van TI Pharma zeker te stellen; het waarborgt de continuïteit van TI Pharma op de korte termijn.

Vragen van het lid Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet meer melden van suïcidepatiënten bij de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) (ingezonden 23 juni 2010).

An MP asked the health minister why GGZ mental health institutions would no longer have to report every suicide to the Inspectorate for Health Care, questioning the pilot's value, the lack of consultation with patient groups, and the quality of care. The minister answered that three institutions will pilot a revised procedure where all reports are evaluated with the Inspectorate, that the change follows a Huisman doctoral study, that patient groups were not consulted beforehand but later met, and that the Inspectorate will keep oversight through systemic supervision and annual aggregated review.
In the second half of this year a pilot with a revised suicide reporting procedure will take place in three GGZ institutions.
In de tweede helft van dit jaar vindt in drie GGZ instellingen een pilot plaats met een aangepaste meldprocedure bij suïcide.
Vragen van het lid Zijlstra (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over verpleegkundig specialisten (ingezonden 25 juni 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether hospitals stopping the use of nurse specialists is undesirable, whether the pending Wet BIG amendment will fully solve the problem, what additional measures will prevent hospitals stopping, and whether direct contracting of nurses is a solution to the tariff problem. The minister agrees that stopping is undesirable and that task reallocation matters, says the BIG amendment will make a major contribution but not fully solve it, and defers the measures to the forthcoming cabinet position on the numerus fixus report, mentioning financing and task reallocation.
In the cabinet position on the RVZ report on the numerus fixus for medicine, the financing and task reallocation theme will be further addressed as a possible additional measure.
In het kabinetsstandpunt op het RVZ-rapport over de numerus fixus geneeskunde zal als mogelijke aanvullende maatregel nader op het thema bekostiging en taakherschikking worden ingegaan.

Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de resistente schimmels

An MP asked three ministers whether they knew of reports of deaths from resistant fungal infections in hospitals, how they assess the risk, and whether azole fungicides in agriculture and other products are responsible and should be banned. The government only sent a holding notice saying the answers would be delayed because it depends on expert information, promising answers as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that I am dependent on information from various experts.
De reden van het uitstel is dat ik afhankelijk ben van informatie van verscheidene experts.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de start van SOS-arts (ingezonden 8 juni 2010).

MPs Van Gerven and Leijten asked the health minister whether SOS-arts, which started home visits for Maetis on 1 June 2010 without an NZa tariff, substitutes for GP care, breaches the Marijnissen motion on non-medical queue-jumping, and endangers equal access to care. The minister replied that the initiative may operate as an innovative choice-enhancing provider, that the NZa has asked for documentation to assess it, and that the NZa could intervene if access worsens.

Following the new situation, in which SOS-arts has an agreement with occupational health service Maetis, the NZa has asked the parties involved for documentation in order to assess SOS-arts' services.

Naar aanleiding van de nieuwe situatie, waarbij de SOS-arts een overeenkomst heeft met arbodienst Maetis, heeft de NZa de betrokken partijen om documentatie gevraagd om de diensten van de SOS-arts te kunnen beoordelen.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Leijten en Irrgang (allen SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het werven van Indiaas personeel door het Refaja ziekenhuis en het Sint

SP MPs asked the health and foreign affairs ministers whether hospitals Refaja and Sint Jans Gasthuis recruiting Indian nursing staff complies with the government's position and the WHO code, and what action will be taken. The government only replied that the answers are delayed due to interdepartmental coordination, promising them as soon as possible.
The questions from MPs Van Gerven, Leijten and Irrgang (SP) on recruiting Indian OR staff cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.

Mededeling De vragen van de Kamerleden Van Gerven, Leijten en Irrgang (SP) over de werving van Indiaas ok-personeel ( 2010Z09461 ) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het Utrechts college dat AWBZ-geld achterhoudt (ingezonden 10 juni 2010).

An MP asked the minister whether the Utrecht municipal executive is withholding part of the AWBZ package-measure funds, how many clients lost day care, and whether this conflicts with a motion requiring the funds to be used only for that purpose. The minister confirmed the report, said the number of affected clients is unknown, and said municipalities are free to decide how to support citizens under the Wmo compensation principle.
The municipality of Utrecht is therefore free in how it supports, in 2010 and 2011, citizens affected by the package measure.
De gemeente Utrecht is dus vrij in de wijze waarop zij in 2010 en 2011 burgers die te maken hebben gehad met de gevolgen van de pakketmaatregel ondersteunt

Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over de toename van het aantal jongeren met overgewicht in Nederland (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

An MP asked the health and youth ministers why youth overweight is rising despite the Convenant Overgewicht, whether that covenant is succeeding and what it costs, and whether the government will act more forcefully, including on food industry advertising to children. The ministers acknowledged the rise, defended continuing and tightening existing policy and the Convenant Gezond Gewicht, and deferred stronger advertising measures pending monitoring results due in mid-2011.
As the youth minister and I informed you in the letter on food advertising to children, we will closely monitor the self-regulation.
Antwoord 6 Zoals de minister voor Jeugd en Gezin en ik u in de brief over voedingsreclame bij kinderen 4 hebben laten weten, zullen wij de zelfregulering nauwgezet volgen.

Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de brief van Verpleegkundigen & Verzorgenden Nederland (V&VN) met als onderwerp «Chief Nursing Officer» (ingezonden 25 maart 201

An MP asked the minister whether the new chief inspector for nursing and chronic care would also serve as Chief Nursing Officer and how nursing expertise is secured in that post. The minister answered yes to both, describing the IGZ's selection criteria and the appointment of a new inspector starting 1 October 2010.

The new Chief Inspector for Nursing and Long-term Care must also be able to function well both in the government circuit with national inspectorates, ministries and other public organisations and in the care sector.

Ook de nieuwe Hoofdinspecteur Verpleging en Langdurige Zorg dient zowel goed te kunnen functioneren in het overheidscircuit met rijksinspecties, ministeries en andere overheidsorganisaties als in het zorgveld.
Vragen van de het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vergunningverlening voor radiotherapie aan de Hansa Oncology Clinics (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

An MP asks the minister why a radiotherapy licence was granted to Hansa Oncology Clinics after the new 2009 planning decision, despite risks of overcapacity and quality loss, and whether consultation with professional bodies and the Gezondheidsraad was bypassed. The minister answers that the clinic will serve a national function, that the licence was assessed under the 2009 planning decision, that consultation with the NVRO took place, and that the Inspectie will assess quality before patient treatment starts.
I assessed the licence application against the applicable framework, namely the Planningsbesluit Radiotherapie 2009 adopted on 23 October 2009.
Ik heb de vergunningsaanvraag beoordeeld aan de hand van het geldende kader, in casu het Planningsbesluit Radiotherapie 2009 dat op 23 oktober 2009 is vastgesteld.

Vragen van het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het advies van het College voor Zorgverzekeringen (CVZ) inzake extra financiering Beleidsregel NZa (ingezonden 3 mei 2010)

An MP asked the health minister about the NZa's decision to add pemetrexed for first-line non-small-cell lung cancer to the expensive-drugs policy rule with retroactive effect, the procedure followed, its consultation of Zorgverzekeraars Nederland, the French assessment, and a Lilly claim on its website. The minister answered that the NZa followed the usual procedure with adequate consultation, that documents are not public beyond the parties, that the procedure may be reviewed with CVZ and NZa, and that the inspectorate considers the Lilly statement informative and not grounds for removal.
The documents underlying the decision-making, including the minutes, are not public, except for the parties involved.
De stukken die ten grondslag liggen aan de besluitvorming – waaronder de notulen – zijn niet openbaar, behalve voor de betrokken partijen.
Vragen van het lid Sap (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over onderzoek naar te hoge declaraties door apothekers (ingezonden 4 mei 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about reports that pharmacists billed insurers for medicines not actually handed to patients, and how such billing is supervised. The minister says insurer UVIT is investigating, that the NZa supervises pharmacists and could act, and declines for now to ask the NZa for its own investigation.
I do not yet see an immediate reason to ask the NZa to conduct an investigation.
Ik zie op dit moment nog niet direct aanleiding om de NZa te vragen onderzoek te doen.
Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over illegale praktijken in de gezondheidszorg (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

MPs Leijten and Van Gerven asked the health minister about reports of task-shifting in hospitals where nurse specialists treated patients and hospitals billed the top DBC rate, whether this should be seen as fraud, why the NZa and IGZ did not act, and whether whistleblower rules and a broader investigation are needed. The minister replied that supervised task-shifting is not illegal fraud, that the NZa intervenes mainly on structural or consumer-interest violations, that a whistleblower scheme was added to the governance code with a review before any statute, and that no separate investigation is planned beyond a monitoring study linked to a pending bill.
Under the legislation the NZa supervises compliance with the billing rules, including the declaration provisions.
Vanuit de wet- en regelgeving ziet de NZa toe op de handhaving van de naleving van de bekostigingsregels, waaronder de declaratiebepalingen.

Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het stopzetten van de financiering van projecten van het Platform Palliatieve Zorg (ingezonden 2

An MP asked the health minister whether a funding freeze for palliative care projects was real, whether the coalition agreement commitments would be kept, and the status of a commitment on a chair in spiritual care at Tilburg University. The minister confirmed a temporary departmental commitment pause due to a possible budget overrun, promised to resume subsidy processing after a review by 1 August 2010, and deferred the chair question until then.
A temporary departmental commitment pause has been announced.
Departementsbreed is een tijdelijke verplichtingenpauze afgekondigd.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de voortgang van onderzoeksprojecten naar palliatieve zorg (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

Labour MP Wolbert asked the Minister of Health about a reported halt to subsidies for palliative care research projects due to a departmental commitment pause. Minister Klink answered that the pause stems from a possible budget overrun, that subsidy applications will resume once it is lifted, and that institutions are asked to limit adverse effects until 1 August 2010.
As soon as the temporary commitment pause can be lifted, the processing of the subsidy applications for the projects will resume.
Zodra de tijdelijke verplichtingenpauze kan worden opgeheven, wordt de behandeling van de subsidieaanvragen voor de projecten hervat.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Van der Vlies (beiden SGP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gereserveerde middelen voor palliatieve zorgprojecten (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

Two SGP MPs asked the health minister why funds earmarked for palliative care projects were frozen under a departmental commitment pause, now extended to 1 August 2010, and whether stalled follow-up projects could be funded retroactively. The minister confirmed the extension due to a possible budget overrun, said the pause applies regardless of the palliative care dossier not being declared controversial, and promised to resume processing of subsidy requests once the pause is lifted.
Until 1 August 2010 it will be examined which measures can be taken to prevent a budget overrun.
Tot 1 augustus 2010 wordt bekeken met welke maatregelen een overschrijding op de begroting voorkomen kan worden.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Anorexia-patiënt: Ik zocht herkenning» (ingezonden 8 juni 2010).

An MP from the CDA asked the health minister about the Proud2beme website as a counter to pro-anorexia sites, possible government funding, integrating prevention into the healthy weight covenant, and a CDA action plan on eating disorder care chains. The minister answered that no structural funding exists yet, that research funding is being sought, that the covenant will not include internet prevention, and that a range of existing care-quality and follow-up initiatives are underway, while declining to designate the SABN as an overarching body.
There is no structural government funding of the Proud2beme site at this moment.
Er is geen sprake van (structurele) financiering door de overheid van de site Proud2beme op dit moment.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over bijbetaling voor een ommetje, douche en zwemmen (ingezonden 10 juni 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about nursing-home residents in Groningen being charged for a walk, a shower and swimming, and whether this is intended under the care-weight funding system. The minister answers that additional services may be charged for if basic care is secured, that the IGZ supervises the standards, and that no new study is needed.
I see no reason for a new study.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een nieuw onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het bericht dat vleeslijm niet in de hele EU is toegelaten (ingezonden 15 juni 2010).

MP Thieme asks the agriculture minister about meat glue (thrombin-based binder) reportedly not being approved across the EU, whether it can make small meat pieces appear as one piece, its health risks, and whether it will be banned in the Netherlands. The minister replies that it is not banned in the Netherlands but must be labelled, that the European Commission is still considering measures, that trombin is sourced from cattle or pig blood, and that consumers should know whether meat was treated with it.
It is not prohibited in the Netherlands.
Het is in Nederland niet verboden.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën over de besteding van AWBZ-premies (ingezonden 17 juni 2010).

Labour MP Leijten (SP) asks the ministers of Health and of Finance whether AWBZ premiums are spent on AWBZ care, given that half of them go to tax credits, and whether this is lawful, including under article 17(3) AWBZ, and how the BIKK compensation and the premium and surplus figures add up. The reply is only an interim notice that the answers will be delayed due to interdepartmental consultation and will follow as soon as possible.
The questions from MP Leijten (SP) on the spending of AWBZ premiums cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.
De vragen van het Kamerlid Leijten (SP) over de besteding van AWBZ-premies kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Sap (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over vergunningverlening aan dottercentra in Zeeland (ingezonden 25 februari 2010).

MP Sap (GroenLinks) asked the minister of Health about the licensing of cardiac catheterisation (PCI) centres in Zeeland, including the conditions on ZorgSaam's licence, the role of the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital, and the status of its licence application. The minister answered that ZorgSaam's licence was adjusted and made definitive, that cooperation with the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital is recommended, that the NMa left the choice of partners and location to the hospital, and that an independent third party will assess patient flows before a decision is taken on the Admiraal de Ruyter licence.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en De Roos (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een negatief advies van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg met betrekking tot de aanvraag van het Admiraa

SP MPs asked the minister whether the Inspectorate for Health Care gave a negative opinion on Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital's application to perform cardiac catheterisation at Goes, why the advice is not published, and whether the minister will implement a unanimously adopted motion limiting Zeeland to one such centre. The minister confirmed the negative advice, declined to publish it citing detailed information about the hospital and staff, and said an independent third party will be commissioned to examine patient flows before a final decision, with the Chamber to be informed.
The advice contains detailed information about the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital and about persons working there.
Het advies bevat gedetailleerde informatie over het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis en over personen die daar werkzaam zijn.
Vragen van het lid Vos (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, van Justitie en van Economische Zaken over de vergunning van een restaurant (ingezonden 11 mei 2010).

MP Vos asks the ministers about a Amsterdam Italian restaurant denied a Drank- en Horecawet license because part of the premises falls below the 2.40 m ceiling height requirement, which leads it to close at 17.00. Minister Klink confirms the licence refusal on height grounds, states the height rules are independent of ventilation and smoking rules, and refuses to loosen the requirements, citing stress and fire-safety risks.
We do not intend to loosen the height requirements in the Besluit eisen inrichtingen Drank- en Horecawet.
Wij zijn niet voornemens de hoogte-eisen in het Besluit eisen inrichtingen Drank- en Horecawet te versoepelen.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over omstreden pijnexperimenten bij muizen (ingezonden 17 mei 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about a McGill University study that inflicted pain on mice to code their facial expressions, and whether Dutch ethics committees or government funding were involved. The minister replied that the Dutch animal experiments committee (DEC) does not assess foreign studies, that the Dutch government does not fund the research, and that the government has no specific programme on pain expression in lab animals.
This experiment was carried out in Canada and therefore is not subject to assessment by a Dutch DEC.
Deze proef is in Canada uitgevoerd en daarom is dit niet ter beoordeling van een Nederlandse DEC.
Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en De Roos (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het dottercentrum in Goes (ingezonden 28 mei 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about claims that the NMa made a cardiac catheterisation (dotter) centre in Goes a condition of the Ziekenhuis Walcheren/Oosterscheldeziekenhuizen merger, whether the centre can start immediately once licensed, and how the minister will implement the unanimously adopted motion for one shared dotter centre in Zeeland. The minister confirmed the NMa conditions were based on IGZ advice, explained that the NMa left partner and location choices to the hospital, said IGZ found the hospital did not yet meet all licence conditions, and announced an independent review of patient numbers before deciding.
I cannot assess within what period the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital will be able to meet all the conditions.
Ik kan niet beoordelen binnen welke termijn het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis in staat is aan alle voorwaarden te voldoen.
Vragen van het lid Van Miltenburg (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de beloning van de crisismanager bij de GGZ Delfland (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about the reported 65,000 euro monthly pay of a crisis manager at GGZ Delfland, including the claim that the sector pay code was not yet in force, the role of the Inspectorate, and whether the excess pay can be recovered. The minister acknowledged the code should have been followed, said the Inspectorate had no role in the appointment but intensified supervision, and said recovery is not yet possible until the WNT takes effect.
The Inspectorate has intensified its supervision of GGZ Delfland and is closely monitoring developments within GGZ Delfland.
De IGZ heeft het toezicht op GGZ Delfland geïntensiveerd en volgt de ontwikkelingen binnen GGZ Delfland nauwlettend.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat een crisismanager van een GGZ-instelling een megasalaris heeft ontvangen (ingezonden 4 juni 2010).

MP Agema (PVV) asks the health minister about reports that an interim crisis manager at GGZ Delfland earned about 65,000 euro per month, more than double the sector salary cap. Minister Klink answers that the annual report shows about 2 million euro for four months including employer costs and fees, that the Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) is being prepared to set pay norms, and that appointing executives is the responsibility of the supervisory boards.
To ensure that the pay of executives of care institutions reaches a socially responsible level, this cabinet has prepared a bill, the WNT (Wet normering topinkomens).

Om te bewerkstelligen dat de honorering van bestuurders van zorginstellingen op een maatschappelijk verantwoord niveau komt, heeft dit kabinet een wetsvoorstel voorbereid, de WNT (wet normering topinkomens).

Vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Gerven en De Roos (allen SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over inkomens boven de Balkenendenorm van bestuurders in de zorg (ingezonden 7 juni 2010).

SP MPs asked the health minister about hospital and mental health directors earning above the Balkenende norm, including interim directors at Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis and a crisis manager and departing director at GGZ Delfland, and what can be done. The minister said interim pay should follow the BBZ code (which took effect after the appointments), declined to precisely calculate the salary component and referred to earlier answers, deferred 2010 salary data to the annual report, and said supervisory boards must act lawfully on departures.
That is why I also find the approach of the BBZ appealing, which I referred to in my answer to question 2.
Daarom spreekt mij ook de benadering van de BBZ zo aan waar ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 aan refereerde.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ontslagvergoeding van zeven ton voor zorgbestuurders (ingezonden 10 juni 2010).

MP Leijten asks the health minister about a seven-million-euro severance payment to a care board chair dismissed for insufficient support, and whether such payments should be banned. The minister says the dismissal was not for poor performance, that contracts must be honoured but supervisory boards should apply sober standards to new contracts, and that a ban on severance for care executives will be included in the WNT bill.
It is of course essential that the supervisory boards also apply the latest insights on severance payments when concluding new employment contracts with new executives.
Het is natuurlijk zaak dat de Raden van Toezicht bij nieuwe arbeidsovereenkomsten met nieuwe bestuurders ook de nieuwste inzichten over ontslagvergoedingen verwerken.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over invoering van de Balkenendenorm voor zorgbestuurders door weer een megavertrekbonus van vier ton (ingezonden 18 juni 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether she knows that a care-institution director received a four-million-euro severance bonus and whether the Balkenende norm for top salaries should apply to care executives. The minister refers to earlier answers, noting that the WNT pay-norm bill has been drafted, places healthcare under the code regime, and is awaiting Council of State advice before it is sent to parliament.
In brief, the answers to questions 3, 4 and 6 amount to the statement that the cabinet has meanwhile drafted a bill for norming top incomes, the WNT.
Kort samengevat komen die antwoorden op de vragen 3, 4 en 6 neer op de mededeling dat het kabinet inmiddels een wetsvoorstel voor de normering van topinkomens heeft opgesteld, de WNT
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het preferentiebeleid van zorgverzekeraar UVIT (ingezonden 25 mei 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister about insurer UVIT's preference policy extending to biologicals and biosimilars (epo, somatropin, filgrastim) from July 2010, questioning safety, legality of substitution for different indications, lack of home-injection service consideration, and the sealed-tender (onder-couvert) system's transparency. The minister's reply is only an interim notice that the answers cannot be given within the usual deadline because information has been requested from parties involved.
The questions from MP Van Gerven (SP) about insurer Uvit's preference policy cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual deadline.
De vragen van het Kamerlid Van Gerven (SP) over het preferentiebeleid van zorgverzekeraar Uvit kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.

Vragen van het lid Van der Vlies (SGP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over het aantal alcoholintoxicaties bij jongeren in de periode 2007 tot en met 2009 (ingezonden 22 apri

MP Van der Vlies asked the ministers about the rise in alcohol intoxications among young people between 2007 and 2009, including the 48% increase in 2009, school prevention programmes, aftercare and hospital registration. Minister Klink answered that the rise is worrying, partly explained by better registration and alcohol affordability, that schools have adequate programmes, that a hospital aftercare pilot is running with an interim evaluation due in June, and that registration coverage is sufficient.
We find it worrying that the number of alcohol intoxications rose from 337 in 2008 to 500 in 2009.
Wij vinden het zorgwekkend dat het aantal alcoholintoxicaties is gestegen van 337 in het jaar 2008 naar 500 in 2009.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de situatie bij de gehandicapteninstelling Sherpa (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister how the government views the court suspension of the Sherpa care institution's supervisory board chair, the need for works councils to go to court to remove supervisors, the functioning of supervision by the Inspectorate and the Ombudsman's findings, and the whereabouts of a 1998 residential-wishes study. The minister replies only that the answers will be delayed because Sherpa still has to supply information.
The reason for the delay is that Sherpa still has to provide information.
De reden van het uitstel is dat Sherpa nog informatie moet verstrekken.

Vragen van de leden Elias en Neppérus (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over bureaucratische beslissingen waardoor onderneme

Two VVD MPs asked ministers about bureaucratic biocide rules that threaten entrepreneurs, such as hand disinfectants, and why other EU countries allowed such products. The government only announced that answers would be delayed because interdepartmental coordination takes longer, without answering the questions.
The questions from MPs Elias and Neppérus (both VVD) on bureaucratic decisions that threaten to put entrepreneurs in a tight spot cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.

Mededeling De vragen van de Kamerleden Elias en Neppérus (beiden VVD) over bureaucratische beslissingen waardoor ondernemers in het nauw dreigen te komen (Ingezonden 9 juni 2010) kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat in Nederland jaarlijks zeker 200.000 ouderen mishandeld worden (ingezonden 16 juni 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about reports that at least 200,000 elderly people are abused in the Netherlands each year, and whether the minister would implement previously proposed measures such as mandatory certificates for care workers, municipal reporting points, a national register, and a higher maximum penalty. The minister responded that abuse is already a priority, pointed to existing and planned measures such as the reporting code and regional reporting points, said the costs and benefits of the registry and mandatory certificates will be examined, and declined to raise the maximum penalty.
As for the suggestions of a national registry, the need for a mandatory certificate and the question of disciplinary law, I want to have the pros and cons mapped out.
Voor wat betreft de suggesties van een landelijke registratiepunt, de noodzaak van een verplichte VOG en de kwestie van tuchtrecht wil ik de voors en tegens daarvan in kaart laten brengen.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over te veel aangekochte griepvaccins (ingezonden 17 mei 2010).

MPs Arib asked the minister of Health about over-purchased H1N1 flu vaccines, including efforts to resell them, contract terms, expiry, and an evaluation of the pandemic response. Minister Klink confirmed surplus stock, said vaccines were sold at purchase price while demand was limited, and committed to an external evaluation with results expected at the end of 2010.
The evaluation is carried out by independent external party or parties.
De evaluatie wordt uitgevoerd door (een) onafhankelijke externe partij(en).
Vragen van het lid Schippers (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over tandartsbehandelingen (ingezonden 19 mei 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about a TV report on dental care: insufficient quality supervision (one half-time inspector for dental care), whether patients are told when a dental assistant treats them, limits on preventive assistants performing tandarts tasks, and whether assistant treatment should carry a lower tariff. The minister says he will examine expanding inspection capacity, will consult the Inspectorate on tightening its 2008 circular, will not amend the Wet BIG, and sees no need for separate assistant tariffs.
Given a rising number of reports of quality problems, especially at large dental care institutions, I want to examine whether there are grounds to expand inspection capacity for this care domain.

Gelet op een stijgend aantal meldingen over kwaliteitsproblemen, vooral bij de grote instellingen voor mondzorg, wil ik nagaan of er gronden bestaan om de inspectiecapaciteit voor dit zorgdomein uit te breiden.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat personeel in de zorg het werk dreigt neer te leggen (ingezonden 27 mei 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister how she views the threatened strike by care workers over a stalled collective agreement, whether the sector's loyalty weakens workers' bargaining position, and whether she will withdraw her call for wage restraint. The minister replies that strikes are bounded by case law, that the sector's labour relations follow the normal Dutch model, and that she maintains her call for wage moderation while disputing the reading of her earlier remarks.
It is cabinet policy to draw the social partners' attention to the need for wage moderation.
Het is kabinetsbeleid om de noodzaak tot matiging van de lonen onder de aandacht van sociale partners te brengen.
Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Toch weer isotopentekort; kankerpatiënten de dupe» (ingezonden 20 mei 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about a shortage of medical isotopes harming cancer patients, its cause, steps taken, and guarantees against recurrence. The minister confirms the shortage stems from a delayed Canadian reactor restart, outlines a possible Delft production alternative that is not realistic before September, and declines to guarantee no future shortages.
However, I cannot give a guarantee that shortages will not arise again in the coming years.
Een garantie dat er niet opnieuw tekorten zullen ontstaan kan ik echter niet geven voor wat betreft de komende jaren
Vragen van het lid Aasted Madsen-van Stiphout (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over onveilig speelgoed (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

The MP asked the minister about the EU finding that 25 percent of tested toys are unsafe, the reasons for rising unsafe-product notifications, what happens to unsafe products in the Netherlands, and importer responsibilities. The minister answered that enforcement is risk-based by the VWA, that unsafe products can be withdrawn or recalled with sanctions available, and that the new Toy Directive will clarify importer duties from 2011.
The VWA oversees this and can impose sanctions.
De VWA ziet hier op toe en kan sancties opleggen.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Jasper van Dijk (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het inschakelen van tandartsassistenten die verdoven, wort

MPs Van Gerven and Jasper van Dijk asked whether dental assistants with short training perform invasive procedures such as anaesthesia, root canal treatment, drilling and filling, and about related dental-care oversight, capacity and quality issues. The minister said such delegation is lawful under strict conditions, that the Inspectorate may review its circular, and that the Inspectorate's oversight capacity and training capacity questions will be addressed in a forthcoming cabinet response.
I will therefore consult with the Inspectorate to examine whether its aforementioned circular needs tightening.
Om die reden zal ik in overleg met de Inspectie nagaan of haar voornoemde circulaire aanscherping behoeft.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en De Roos (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de ontmanteling van het ziekenhuis in Vlissingen door het bestuur van het Admiraal De Ruyter Ziekenhuis (in

MPs Van Gerven and De Roos (SP) asked the health minister about the downsizing of the Admiraal De Ruyter hospital in Vlissingen, including bed cuts, job losses, specialist disagreements, emergency care criteria, whether financial motives drove the plans, and a delayed decision on cardiac dilation permits. The minister largely defended the hospital's plans as a relocation of functions, said the Gezondheidsraad advice was not needed before acting, and promised an independent review before deciding on the permit.
Before taking a final decision on the permit application of the Admiraal de Ruyter Hospital, I want to have some questions examined further.
Alvorens een definitieve beslissing te nemen over de vergunningaanvraag van het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis wil ik nog enkele vragen nader laten onderzoeken.
Vragen van de leden Aasted Madsen-van Stiphout en Jan de Vries (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over het mentoraat (ingezonden 4 mei 2010).

MPs from the CDA asked whether the government is ending the temporary subsidy for regional mentorship foundations, what the consequences would be for vulnerable adults, whether a structural financing arrangement exists in the draft legislation, and why the government is winding down support it had built up. The minister answered that no decision has been taken yet but no new subsidies are currently granted pending budget decisions, that the draft law does not provide central government financing, and that the subsidies were always explicitly temporary with no guaranteed continuity.
That this appreciation has been given concrete form in temporary stimulation and bridging subsidies does not mean I guarantee the continuity of this funding.
Dat die waardering is geconcretiseerd in tijdelijke stimulerings- en overbruggingssubsidies betekent niet dat ik continuïteit van deze financiering garandeer.
Vragen van het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de Giro d’Italia (ingezonden 11 mei 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about the costs and benefits to central and municipal government of the Giro d'Italia start in the Netherlands, how this compares to larger events like the Olympics and World Cup, and whether a cost-benefit analysis framework for major sports events would be prepared. The minister said the Giro costs were not yet clear due to missing budget information, that the bigger events are of a different order, and that a cost-benefit evaluation instrument is being developed with a project subsidy while analyses for the 2018/2022 World Cup and 2028 Olympics are underway or done.
Due to insufficient insight into the budget of the Giro d'Italia, it is not yet possible to state well what the costs and benefits of the event are.
Vanwege onvoldoende inzicht in de begroting van de Giro d’Italia is nog niet goed aan te geven wat de kosten en baten van het evenement zijn.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het artikel «Wielerronde op rantsoen» (ingezonden 26 april 2010).

MP Neppérus asks the health minister about reports that host municipalities expected maximum subsidies for the Giro d'Italia start and whether ministry staff raised those expectations. Minister Klink answers that the ministry held careful preliminary talks without any budgetary commitment, and that the final subsidy amount depends on the organiser's definitive budget.
I am of the opinion that the ministry acted carefully during this process and that no budgetary commitment was made.
Ik ben van mening dat het ministerie tijdens dit traject zorgvuldig heeft gehandeld en dat er geen budgettaire toezegging is gedaan.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over zorgverzekeraars die hun zorgplicht niet nakomen (ingezonden 7 mei 2010).

Dutch MP Van Gerven asked the health minister about a pharmacy fraud complaint by insurer UVIT, the pharmacists' criticism of insurers not meeting their duty of care, and the links to preferential drug policy and a motion on administrative burdens. The minister declined to comment on the substance while UVIT's investigation is ongoing, said preferential policy does not affect prescribing and that no general conclusions can be drawn, and pointed to ongoing consultation (Commissie Alders) as the basis for the motion response.
I cannot and will not respond now that the facts are not established and it is primarily a matter between insurer UVIT and the pharmacists who claim from UVIT.
Ik kan en wil geen reactie geven nu het feitencomplex niet vaststaat en het primair een aangelegenheid betreft tussen zorgverzekeraar UVIT en de desbetreffende apothekers die declareren bij UVIT.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de zorg aan mensen met oorsuizen (Tinnitus) (ingezonden 11 mei 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister about funding for tinnitus care at Adelante, a research-linked audiology centre, after CIZ and CVZ denied coverage pending research results, risking interruption of treatment. The minister replies that the research is self-initiated by Adelante, AMC and Maastricht University with ZonMw contributing funds, that regular tinnitus care falls under the Zvw, that no serious situation exists, and declines to intervene in the initiators' decisions while offering supplementary ZonMw subsidy.
It is not my responsibility to judge this decision-making or to interfere in it.
Het is niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid om over deze besluitvorming te oordelen of mij daarin te mengen.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het uitwijken van honderden Lymepatiënten naar het buitenland uit onvrede over de medische hulp in Nederland (ingezonden 26 ap

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views hundreds of Lyme patients going abroad to Germany and Slovakia out of dissatisfaction with Dutch medical care, and about the treatment controversy and whether current diagnostics and treatment adequately address the rise in infected ticks. The minister regrets patients feel poorly treated, leaves treatment judgments to the professional groups, points to a forthcoming guideline and a ZonMW-funded antibiotic duration study, and announces an expert meeting by RIVM before summer.
I regret that people in the Netherlands do not feel adequately treated and feel compelled to seek care outside the Netherlands.
Ik betreur het dat mensen zich in Nederland niet adequaat behandeld voelen en zich genoodzaakt voelen zorg buiten Nederland te zoeken.
Vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over omstreden pijnexperimenten bij muizen (ingezonden 17 mei 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about a McGill University study inflicting pain on mice to code pain facial expressions, questioning its ethical justification, the role of Dutch institutions and funding, and existing alternatives such as 3V approaches. The ministry's reply is only an interim notice stating the questions cannot be answered within the usual deadline because more time is needed to gather information.
The reason for the delay is that obtaining the required information takes more time.
De reden van het uitstel is dat het verkrijgen van de benodigde informatie meer tijd vergt.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Smilde (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over samenwerkingsverbanden tussen huisartsen (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Health whether VAT rules unnecessarily frustrate cooperation between GPs and what steps will be taken. The minister replied that the issue is covered in an earlier letter of 11 May and referred to that letter for the answers.

Since in that letter – also on behalf of the Minister of Finance – I discussed the problem extensively, the (im)possibilities for practice and the steps to be taken, I refer integrally to the earlier letter for the answers to the questions now asked.

Aangezien ik in die brief – ook mede namens de minister van Financiën – uitgebreid op de problematiek ben ingegaan, de (on)mogelijkheden voor de praktijk heb besproken en de te nemen stappen heb aangegeven, verwijs ik voor de beantwoording van de nu gestelde vragen integraal naar eerder genoemde brief.
Vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Leerdam (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de financiering van Jellinek Retreat op Curaçao (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

Two MPs from the Labour Party asked the health minister how the Jellinek Retreat clinic on Curaçao is financed, whether public funds or premium money are used, and whether local Antillean addicts can access it. The minister answered that the clinic is financed partly by a subsidy from the Programme for Cooperation with the Netherlands Antilles and partly by private investment, that it is a private foreign clinic open to all at the same rate, and that an evaluation of the programme is under way with a report expected in June 2010.
A subsidy provided from the Programme for Cooperation with the Netherlands Antilles
Een subsidie verstrekt vanuit het Programma Samenwerking Nederlandse Antillen
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de situatie bij Huize Roël (ingezonden 17 mei 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether the bankruptcy of Huize Roël was reported to the inspectorate, where residents were relocated, whether NeVeP registration is a sufficient quality check, and whether a bankruptcy-fraud investigation will be requested. The minister replies that the inspectorate was informed during visits, no reporting duty exists, residents were moved in consultation with families, no fraud signals exist so no investigation is planned, and fraud investigations occur only when suspected.
There is no obligation for the care organisation to inform the inspectorate of a bankruptcy.
Er is geen verplichting voor de zorgorganisatie om de inspectie op de hoogte te stellen van een faillissement.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Leijten en Gesthuizen (allen SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Economische Zaken over de inval van de NMa bij de LHV (ingezonden 4 mei 2010).

SP MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about the NMa's raid on the LHV, the scope of competition law in GP care, and whether it hampers care chains. The ministers answered that the NMa acts independently under the Mededingingswet, that cooperation is generally allowed while market-sharing and price agreements are not, and that the raid does not harm chain-care development.
The NMa decides independently to carry out a raid.
De NMa besluit zelfstandig tot een inval.
Vragen van het lid Sap (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de subsidieregeling voor kleinschalig wonen die na negen weken al op is (ingezonden 4 mei 2010).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Health whether the subsidy scheme for small-scale dementia care, which was exhausted within nine weeks, was fairly allocated, whether the plans were assessed for feasibility, and whether the budget should be extended or the first-come-first-served 'molenaarsprincipe' reconsidered. The Minister replies that the rapid uptake was expected, that the zorgkantoren assessed plans under clear instructions, that the budget is considered sufficient for 19,000-20,000 additional places, and that first-come-first-served avoids delay and keeps per-place funding fixed.
I have received no signals that this assessment by the zorgkantoren was not carried out carefully.
Ik heb geen signalen ontvangen dat deze beoordeling door de zorgkantoren niet zorgvuldig zou zijn uitgevoerd.
Vragen van de leden Smilde en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het kwijtraken van collectieve zorgverzekering na ontslag (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

MPs Smilde and Omtzigt asked the health minister whether insurers may withdraw the 10% collective discount when employees lose their jobs, and whether a regulation should guarantee the discount until year-end. The minister confirmed awareness, said insurers and collectives may agree arrangements, and declined to legislate, leaving it to insurers.
Since the law provides sufficient scope to make such agreements, I do not intend to legally require insurers to give a dismissed employee a discount until the end of the year.

Aangezien de wet voldoende ruimte biedt om dit soort afspraken te maken, ben ik niet voornemens het wettelijk voor te schrijven aan verzekeraars dat zij een ontslagen werknemer tot het eind van het jaar een korting moeten geven.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het faillissement van Tootas (ingezonden 13 april 2010).

MP Leijten asked the health minister about the bankruptcy of care provider Tootas, how many clients were affected, whether PGB funds can be recovered, whether the owner can restart, and whether complaints will be prosecuted. The minister confirmed the bankruptcy, said the number of affected clients is unclear, placed PGB recovery and prosecution with the curator, the care office and the Public Prosecution Service, and declined to press for leniency.
It is not for me to press the care office for lenient treatment.
Het is niet aan mij om bij het zorgkantoor aan te dringen op een coulante behandeling.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een themabijeenkomst van het RIVM (ingezonden 19 april 2010).

Arib (PvdA) asked whether RIVM was organising a thematic meeting on uniform pregnancy information and whether RIVM was pre-empting the College Perinatale Zorg's role in implementing the Stuurgroep recommendations. Minister Klink answered that the meeting is a positive knowledge-sharing initiative, that RIVM's information tasks are regular, and that the College will coordinate the process while RIVM remains responsible for independent information.
I do not get the impression that the intention is to formulate a concrete message during this meeting.
Ik heb niet de indruk dat het de bedoeling is om tijdens deze bijeenkomst een concrete boodschap te formuleren.
Vragen van het lid Aasted Madsen-van Stiphout (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over onveilig speelgoed (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about the reported high share of unsafe toys in the EU, rising product safety failures, what happens when unsafe products are found (withdrawal and consumer notification), and the responsibility and consequences for importers. The Minister of Health (Klink) only sends a notice that the answers are delayed due to required interdepartmental coordination, with no substantive answers yet.
The questions from MP Aasted Madsen-van Stiphout (CDA) on unsafe toys cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual time limit.
De vragen van het Kamerlid Aasted Madsen-van Stiphout (CDA) over onveilig speelgoed kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de financiële nood bewust is overdreven door Orbis (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about reports that Orbis hospital deliberately exaggerated its financial distress, and whether guarantees given by local and provincial government were improperly extracted and whether controls were lacking. The minister answers that the lawyer stated only widely known facts, that the court found no illegal state aid, and that Orbis provided full transparency to guarantors, while declining to act because the province and municipality chose the guarantees themselves.
The Orbis Board of Management chose option 2 out of good employer practice.
De Raad van Bestuur heeft vanuit goed werkgeverschap gekozen voor optie 2.
Vragen van de het lid Van der Veen (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vergunningverlening voor radiotherapie aan de Hansa Oncology Clinics (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about licensing radiotherapy to Hansa Oncology Clinics, raising concerns about overcapacity, quality loss, consultation with the professional body and Gezondheidsraad, and the Inspectie's role. The minister's reply is only a notice that the answers will be delayed pending consultation with the professional association and will follow as soon as possible.
The questions from MP Van der Veen (PvdA) about the licensing of radiotherapy to Hansa Oncology Clinics cannot, to my regret, be answered within the usual period.
