De vragen van het Kamerlid Van der Veen (PvdA) over de vergunningverlening voor radiotherapie aan de Hansa Oncology Clinics kunnen tot mijn spijt niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord.
Vragen van de leden Aasted Madsen-van Stiphout en Jan de Vries (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over het mentoraat (ingezonden 4 mei 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked whether the subsidy for recruiting, training and supporting volunteer mentors for legally incapable adults is being stopped, what this means for continuity of regional mentorship foundations, when a structural financing scheme in a draft bill will take effect, and whether bridge funding will be provided. The minister only announced that the questions cannot be answered within the normal period because the information is not yet available, and promised answers as soon as possible.
The reason for the delay is that the information needed for the answers cannot be gathered within the usual period.
De reden van het uitstel is dat de benodigde informatie voor de antwoorden niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn verzameld kan worden.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya (D66) en Neppérus (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over dopingcontroles in strijd met de Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

MPs Koşer Kaya and Neppérus asked whether the lack of a specific legal basis for doping controls makes the current whereabouts obligations unlawful, whether sanctions for refusing them must lapse, and what the government will do to align WADA rules with EU and Dutch data-protection law. The minister answered that current practice rests on consent under the Wbp and that courts rejected challenges, but that a specific statutory basis will be created; sanctions remain possible, and the government will press WADA on the pending privacy issues.
This allows Dutch sport to continue meeting the requirements arising from global anti-doping rules.
Daarmee kan de sport in Nederland blijven voldoen aan de eisen die uit de mondiale anti-doping regels voortvloeien.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het weigeren van een patiënte door huisartsen uit Drunen (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister about GP practices in Drunen refusing a patient, the role of insurer CZ, the NZa and the Inspectorate. The minister answers that the KNMG guideline requires continued necessary care until another provider is found, that the insurer's duty is limited to mediation and enforcing treatment is a private matter, and that the NZa and IGZ have supervisory roles.
Enforcing the provision of care by the GP is, however, a (private law) matter between the patient and the doctor and ultimately not one for the health insurer.
Het afdwingen van zorgleverantie door de huisarts is echter een (privaatrechtelijke) zaak tussen de patiënt en de arts en uiteindelijk dus niet van de zorgverzekeraar.
Vragen van het lid Joldersma (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over langdurig verblijf van psychiatrische patiënten in de isoleercel (ingezonden 20 april 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about long-term isolation of psychiatric patients, the status of research into reducing seclusion, medical care guarantees for involuntarily admitted patients, strengthening family roles, and suicide prevention with the guideline on assisted suicide requests. The minister says a study by IVA is underway with results expected in June 2010, cites Wet bopz treatment-plan rules, describes planned family advocate reforms in the WvGGZ bill, and refers to professional responsibility and the euthanasia review committee.
The results of this study are expected in early June 2010. The House of Representatives will then be informed of the study results as soon as possible.
De resultaten van dit onderzoek worden begin juni 2010 verwacht. Vervolgens wordt de Tweede Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd over de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het openen van filialen door het Oogziekenhuis Rotterdam (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

An MP asked the health minister how the Oogziekenhuis Rotterdam's plan to open 20 franchise branches in other hospitals squares with the rules banning profit-making in hospital care, including what the franchise fees amount to, where any surplus goes, and whether staff could benefit personally. The minister answered that hospitals decide their own activities under the budget system, that the Oogziekenhuis is a non-profit foundation so profit distribution is excluded, and that the Nza could only judge once the franchise structure is known.
It is up to the hospitals that want to run the franchise and the Oogziekenhuis to assess whether the franchise, its benefits and costs fit within the goals and conditions of their own organisation.

Het is dus aan de ziekenhuizen die de franchise willen voeren en het Oogziekenhuis om te beoordelen of de franchise, de baten en kosten daarvan passen binnen de doelen en randvoorwaarden van de eigen organisatie.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de publieke verkoopcampagne van HWW Zorg en Thuiszorg Groningen (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister about the public sales campaign of the temporary foundations HWW Zorg and Thuiszorg Groningen, raising questions on the NZa's role, continuity of care, financial health, and staff uncertainty. The minister answers that the sale is a condition of state support set by the NZa, that the foundations are designed as temporary, and that continuity of care remains the responsibility of the care office and the new owners.

In the decision granting support of 7 December 2009, the NZa expressly stipulated as a condition that HWW Zorg and TZG must make demonstrable efforts to divest (parts of) the care activities to a third party, in line with the foundations' statutory purpose.

In het besluit tot de steunverlening van 7 december 2009 is door de NZa uitdrukkelijk als voorwaarde gesteld dat HWW Zorg en TZG conform de doelstelling uit artikel 2, eerste lid, van de statuten van de stichtingen aantoonbare inspanningen moeten leveren tot vervreemding
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ontslagen bij HWW Zorg (ingezonden 4 mei 2010).

Parliamentarian Leijten (SP) asked the minister of Health about HWW Zorg's dismissal of five staff despite an IGZ inspection finding of inadequate training, and about the adequacy of the care improvement plan and a contingency plan. Minister Klink answered that the IGZ was satisfied with the plan, that the employment decisions are matters between HWW Zorg and its staff, and that a separate letter addresses a fallback scenario.
It is not for me to pass a substantive judgment on that; I leave that to the IGZ.
Het is niet aan mij om daar een inhoudelijk oordeel over te vellen, dat laat ik over aan de IGZ.
Vragen van het lid Van Miltenburg (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over HWW Zorg en TZG (ingezonden 4 mei 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about HWW Zorg and TZG's newspaper advertisement, why the former Meavita organisations were not required to be sold as a condition of state aid, whether the aid is embedded in their market price, how the Meavita bankruptcy was handled, whether the aim is to recoup aid through sale, and how the quality of care is judged given Inspectorate criticism. The minister answered that sale was made a conditional obligation in the NZa aid decision, that the market price is not yet formed, that the bankruptcy is still ongoing, that no recoupment is intended, and that the Inspectorate is satisfied with the improvement plan, with a verdict expected in June.
The bankruptcy of Meavita has not yet been concluded.
Het faillissement van Meavita is nog niet afgerond.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat subsidie aan patiëntorganisaties stagneert (ingezonden 14 april 2010).

MP Leijten asks the health minister to respond to reports that subsidies to patient, disability and elderly organisations (PGO) are stagnating, and whether this amounts to cuts, whether project subsidies are too narrow, whether independence is endangered, what hardship relief will be given, and whether the loss of organisations like Pandora is desired. The minister rejects the cuts framing, explains the rebalancing of historic subsidy inequalities over four years, defends the project criteria and says hardship relief can be granted case by case.
Decisions on possible application of the hardship clause are taken by me on a case-by-case basis.
Over eventuele toepassing van de hardheidsclausule besluit ik per individueel geval.
Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Schermers (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over mogelijke verdwijning van de ambulancepost in Oostkapelle (ingezonden 19 april 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about news that the ambulance post in Oostkapelle might disappear and whether efficiency would outweigh access for residents and tourists on Walcheren. The minister replied that the regional emergency care partners must apply the 45-minute norm carefully, that the norm will be reviewed, and that the regional ambulance service decides how its posts are distributed.

It will be examined whether the structure of this norm, 15 minutes ambulance response time, 5 minutes stabilising the patient and 25 minutes driving time to the hospital, gives cause for possible new insight given the high quality of Dutch ambulance care.

Gekeken wordt of de opbouw van deze norm, 15 minuten aanrijdtijd voor de ambulance, 5 minuten stabiliseren patiënt en 25 minuten rijtijd naar het ziekenhuis in relatie tot de hoogstaande kwaliteit van de Nederlandse ambulancezorg aanleiding vormt voor mogelijk nieuw inzicht.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Justitie over de Genderkliniek in Utrecht die volgens berichten op 1 februari jl. haar de

An SP MP asked the health and justice ministers whether the Utrecht gender clinic had reopened, whether sex-selection methods are scientifically valid and legal under the Embryo Act, and why prosecution was dropped in 2002. The minister answered that no physical clinic exists (only a website, which the Inspectorate found misleading), that the albumin method lacks scientific support, that the 2005 prosecutor's decision to drop the case was based on insufficient evidence, and that the website is not removable as it contains no punishable content, while committing to further Inspectorate review.
It turned out there is no physical gender clinic where treatments take place; there is only a website.
Daaruit bleek dat er geen fysieke Genderkliniek is waar behandelingen plaatsvinden; er is alleen een website.

Vragen van de leden Langkamp en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over het bericht dat het aantal zelfmoorden onder jongeren in West-Friesland onrustbarend

SP MPs asked whether youth suicide in West-Friesland is higher than the national average, following a news report. The minister answers that a GGD Hollands Noorden analysis of ten years of data finds no clearly higher overall suicide risk in the region, though the youth rate there (3.1 vs 2.3 per 100,000) is somewhat higher.

Based on this study, in which the GGD analysed suicide numbers over the past ten years, the GGD Hollands Noorden reports that it cannot be concluded that the suicide risk in Noord-Holland Noord, among the general population or among young people in West-Friesland, is (much) higher than nationally.

Op basis van dit onderzoek waarin de GGD de aantallen suïcides van de afgelopen tien jaar heeft geanalyseerd, bericht de GGD Hollands Noorden dat niet geconcludeerd kan worden dat het risico op zelfdoding in Noord Holland Noord onder de algemene bevolking of onder jongeren in West-Friesland (veel) hoger is dan landelijk.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het onderzoek van het RIVM onder 15- en 16-jarige meisjes (ingezonden 1 april 2010).

MP Arib asks the health minister about the purpose and length of a RIVM study following 15- and 16-year-old girls, including repeated sampling, privacy safeguards, the small gift-voucher incentive, and the timing of the study. The minister answers that the study monitors HPV infections and vaccine effects, explains the consent and data-separation arrangements, rejects the claim that the voucher is a lure, and says the study was already ongoing and communicated openly.
The RIVM acknowledges these doubts and uncertainties and therefore communicates openly and clearly about HPV vaccination.
Het RIVM erkent deze twijfels en onzekerheden en communiceert dan ook open en duidelijk over het vaccineren tegen HPV.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over de HPV-enquête van het RIVM (ingezonden 1 april 20

MPs from the ChristenUnie asked whether the RIVM HPV survey sent to 15- and 16-year-old girls was appropriate, including its sexual framing, parental information, a ten-euro voucher incentive for a vaginal brush sample, and 15-year storage of the material. The minister answered that the study falls under the WMO, was approved by an ethics committee, and that parents and girls consented; the RIVM will keep the material 15 years as agreed and not use it beyond the consented purpose.
It is not for the Minister to pronounce on the content of a scientific study.
Het is niet aan de Minister om zich uit te spreken over de inhoud van een wetenschappelijk onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de openbaarmaking van de voor de griepvaccins betaalde prijs (ingezonden 8 april 2010).

An MP asked the health minister why the prices paid for pandemic flu vaccines are not public, as they are in other EU states, and what the status of talks with the suppliers is. The minister answered that both suppliers invoke confidentiality, that he is unaware of other contract terms, and that disclosing prices could weaken the state's position in future tenders.
Disclosing the price makes it clear to competitors what the commercial room is to be awarded or not awarded.
Openbaarmaking van de prijs maakt het immers voor de concurrent inzichtelijk wat de commerciële ruimte is om wel of niet gegund te worden.
Vragen van de leden Smilde en Jager (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Menzis legt Refaja wil op» (ingezonden 13 april 2010).

The CDA MPs Smilde and Jager asked the health minister about reports that insurer Menzis wants to reduce hospital capacity in East Groningen, including whether only one hospital should remain near the A7 and the consequences for acute care access. The minister replied that Menzis has no concrete proposals yet, that the government stands behind the insurer's responsibility in consultation with hospitals, and that RIVM is analysing acute care accessibility scenarios, with results to be sent to parliament.
I will inform you in writing about the accessibility of acute care in the region once I receive the outcomes.
Ik zal u na ontvangst van de uitkomsten schriftelijke informeren over de bereikbaarheid van de acute zorg in de regio.

Vragen van de leden Arib en Gill'ard (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over het heropenen van de Genderkliniek in Utrecht (ingezonden 4 februari 2010).

MPs Arib and Gill'ard asked the ministers of Health and Justice whether the Utrecht clinic offering child sex selection had reopened, whether this is prohibited under the Embryo Act, and whether the clinic's director continued giving advice and referring people abroad despite an earlier complaint. The minister replied that the reopening reports were incorrect according to Inspectorate research, that providing deliberately false information is inappropriate, that closure is not an issue since the clinic had not opened, and that giving information and referrals is not a prohibited act under Article 26 of the Embryo Act.

Contrary to his website claim that he keeps statistical data for international umbrella organisations, health inspectorate and governments, the director could not provide the inspectorate with any figures on this.

In tegenstelling tot zijn bewering op de website dat hij «ten behoeve van internationale koepelorganisatie, gezondheidsinspectie en overheden statistische gegevens bewaart», kon de directeur de inspectie hierover echter geen cijfers verstrekken.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de rol van Menzis bij het ontmantelen van ziekenhuisvoorzieningen in Oost-Groningen (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether insurer Menzis should be pressuring hospital concentration in Oost-Groningen, whether a Refaja hospital without operating rooms would be acceptable, and whether 45-minute emergency access is threatened. The Minister replied that insurers must manage their duty of care through contracting, that emergency access is being checked by RIVM and that he will report the results, while stating that insurers are accountable to their insured.
I have asked the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) to carry out an accessibility analysis in North East Groningen.
Om die reden heb ik het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) gevraagd een bereikbaarheidsanalyse in Noord Oost Groningen uit te voeren.
Vragen van de leden Smilde en Jager (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Menzis legt Refaja wil op» (ingezonden 15 april 2010).

The CDA MPs ask whether it falls within a health insurer's duty of care to intervene so actively in a hospital's new-build plans and push for a merger with another hospital. The minister answers that securing care is primarily the insurer's responsibility, that contract negotiations are the main tool, and that discussions on mergers and new builds can be necessary for efficient, high-quality care.
Which measures are necessary to ensure the health insurer can meet its duty of care is in principle up to the health insurer itself.
Welke maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn om ervoor te zorgen dat de zorgverzekeraar aan zijn zorgplicht kan voldoen is in principe aan de zorgverzekeraar zelf.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de rol van Menzis bij het ontmantelen van ziekenhuisvoorzieningen in Oost-Groningen (ingezonden 9 april 2010).

An SP MP asked the Health Minister whether insurer Menzis should be pressing for hospital consolidation in East Groningen, which could leave Refaja hospital without operating theatres and weaken access to care. The minister replied that managing care provision is for insurers and providers under their duty of care, that emergency access will be checked via a RIVM accessibility analysis, and that no concrete consolidation plans yet exist.
I have asked the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) to carry out an accessibility analysis in North and East Groningen.
Om die reden heb ik het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) gevraagd een bereikbaarheidsanalyse in Noord Oost Groningen uit te voeren.
Vragen van de leden Leijten en Bashir (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën over het bericht «Beperking aftrek nekt minima» (ingezonden 26 maart 2010).

The SP MPs Leijten and Bashir asked whether the 2009 removal of the buitengewone uitgaven deduction for medical costs, moved into the Wtcg, causes income losses for elderly, minima, chronically ill and disabled people, and why some groups receive a UWV-linked allowance while others do not. The ministers answered that most chronically ill people gain net income through the Wtcg compensations, that remaining losers are accepted as consistent with the goal of more equal compensation, and that no additional measures are planned.
On balance, the transition from the BU to the Wtcg means an income improvement for most chronically ill people.
Per saldo betekent de overgang van de BU naar de Wtcg voor de meeste chronisch zieken een inkomensverbetering
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en Justitie over kankerbehandelingen met zoutoplossingen door dokter S (Ingezonden 1 april 2010).

MP Van Gerven (SP) asks the health and justice ministers about cancer patients treated with salt solutions by Dr S, whether the Public Prosecution Service should have prosecuted despite a possible link to a patient's death, whether S is still active, and whether such treatments should be banned. The minister answers that the OM found no convincing evidence of a causal link, the Inspectorate forced the clinic to stop the therapy, and the Dutch BIG law leaves most alternative treatments unregulated, though injections are reserved acts for which the clinic is responsible.
Filing a complaint under article 12 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is the appropriate route if a directly interested party disagrees with a prosecutorial decision not to prosecute.
Het indienen van een klacht op grond van artikel 12 Wetboek van Strafvordering is de geëigende weg als een rechtstreeks belanghebbende het niet eens is met een sepotbeslissing van het OM.

Vragen van het lid Van Dijken (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over de begeleiding van ouders met een verstandelijke beperking en een enquête onder zorgverleners (ingez

An MP asks the health and youth ministers about support for parents with intellectual disabilities, a broadcast documentary, and a survey of care workers that shows strong support for discouraging further pregnancies and for forced contraception, and whether this should change policy. The minister says the survey is informative, the current discouragement policy stays, that centrally kept data on repeat removals are not collected, and that no new debate or policy change is planned given the caretaker cabinet.
Against this background, I currently see no reason to start a public debate or to revise the policy direction that has been set.
Tegen deze achtergrond zie ik nu geen aanleiding een maatschappelijk debat te gaan starten of de ingezette beleidslijn te herzien.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volkgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de situatie in Huize Roël (ingezonden 16 maart 2010).

MP Leijten asked the health minister about the situation at care home Huize Roël, including unanswered threats, IGZ inspections, the electricity cut-off, former staff wages, the NeVeP quality label, and closure powers. The minister answered that no threats or refusals to take complaints were established, the IGZ found no improper care, and closure powers are adequate, while the residents' care and relocation are being monitored.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ) made an unannounced visit to Huize Roël on Friday 9 April 2010.
De Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) heeft op vrijdag 9 april 2010 onaangekondigd Huize Roël bezocht.

Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het elektronisch patiëntendossier (EPD) niet goed beveiligd is (ingezonden 12 april 2010).

An MP asked the health minister whether she agrees with a University of Amsterdam finding that the national electronic patient record (EPD) is leaky, what will be done to fix flagged weaknesses, and about the rollout timeline for the electronic medication record. The minister said the risks were weighed at design stage and the study adds no new insight, that periodic testing gives no direct reason for specific measures, and that she sees no reason to redesign the architecture, while pointing to regular progress reports and a five-yearly evaluation after the law takes effect.
The study contains no new insights.
Het onderzoek bevat geen nieuwe inzichten.
Vragen van de leden Willemse-van der Ploeg en Jonker (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het artikel «Bejaarde homo’s terug in de kast» (ingezonden 6 april 2010).

CDA MPs asked the health minister about reports of gay elderly residents being pushed back into the closet in care homes, including the extent of negative treatment, institutional anti-discrimination policy, complaint procedures, and the role of elderly organisations. The minister answered that client satisfaction surveys show residents are satisfied, pointed to the Roze Ouderen project, Roze Loper tolerance scans and the complaints act, and promised continued monitoring and further projects without committing to new binding measures.
No specific figures are known about this, but every institution should pay attention to the treatment of clients in their institution.
Hier zijn geen specifieke cijfers over bekend, maar elke instelling dient aandacht te besteden aan de bejegening van de cliënten in hun instelling.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het weren van familieleden door zorginstellingen (ingezonden 1 april 2010).

Parliamentarian Leijten asks the health minister how care institutions may bar family members from visiting residents, when that is justified, and whether the government will study how often and on what grounds this happens. The minister answers that it is a last resort that a judge should review, that the institution is a private party able to enforce a ban, and that he sees no signs of a major problem so will not start research.
I believe that ultimately the judge must assess whether denying access is justified.
Ik vind dat in laatste instantie de rechter moet beoordelen of ontzegging van de toegang terecht is.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gevolgen van het faillissement STN voor de kraamzorg (ingezonden 1 april 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister whether care providers harmed by the ATC bankruptcy should be repaid, why insurers refused to compensate them, and whether intermediary contracting in maternity care should be banned. The minister replied that the bankruptcy is a curator and insurer matter, that the government lacks legal grounds to intervene, that preferred-creditor status is set by law and will not be changed, and that no new rules on intermediaries are planned.
That is why it is impossible and undesirable for me to play a role in this matter.
Daarom is het voor mij onmogelijk en onwenselijk om een rol te spelen in deze zaak.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over sluikreclame/informatie gericht op kinderen (ingezonden 7 april 2010).

MP Van Gerven asks the health minister about covert advertising for ADHD drug Concerta aimed at children, including school talk texts and a brochure, and whether such marketing should be treated as banned covert advertising. The minister says the supervisory bodies (IGZ, CGR, KOAG/KAG) will assess the activities under their agreements, that informational health content is permitted if not linked to a medicine, and that the boundary is hard to draw, so clearer rules are being discussed.
I have taken note of these activities commissioned by Janssen-Cilag. Whether these activities fall within the laws and regulations on this subject I leave to the supervisory bodies.

Ik heb kennis genomen van deze activiteiten in opdracht van Janssen-Cilag. De beoordeling of deze activiteiten binnen de wet- en regelgeving t.a.v. dit onderwerp vallen laat ik aan de toezichthoudende instellingen
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de Schengenverklaring medicijnen (ingezonden 15 maart 2010).

An MP asks whether travelling with Opiumwet-controlled medicines such as Ritalin across Schengen borders requires a doctor-signed, IGZ-stamped declaration limited to 30 days, and whether this impedes patients' freedom of movement and can be simplified digitally. The minister confirms the rules follow from Schengen and EU law, acknowledges an administrative burden, and says EU rules must first be revised, though he will examine whether some declarations can skip IGZ stamping.

However, I will examine whether it is possible for certain medicines to suffice with a Schengen declaration signed by a doctor, without the Inspectorate for Health Care (IGZ) having to stamp the declaration afterwards.

Wel zal ik onderzoeken of het in dit verband mogelijk is dat voor bepaalde middelen kan worden volstaan met het ondertekenen van een Schengenverklaring door een arts, zonder dat de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) de verklaring daarna nog eens hoeft te waarmerken.

Vragen van het lid Zijlstra (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over verdragsgerechtigden in de VWS-verzekerdenmonitor 2009 en de brief herziening zorgstelsel van 3 juni 2009 (ingezonden 25 maart

An MP asks the health minister to reconcile the number of treaty-entitled persons and contribution revenue in the VWS insurance monitor, and to explain the cost-contribution figures paid to countries of residence. The minister acknowledges the table should be presented more clearly, provides per-country breakdowns, and explains why the Netherlands' listing in Annex IV does not change the planned treaty contribution.

In future I will continue to use this breakdown, which makes the composition of the group of treaty-entitled persons and the yield of the treaty contribution more transparent, in the VWS insurance monitor.

Ik zal in de toekomst deze onderverdeling, die de samenstelling van de groep verdragsgerechtigden en de opbrengst van de verdragsbijdrage meer inzichtelijk maakt, blijven hanteren in de VWS-verzekerdenmonitor.

Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de actie van de LHV om herhaalrecepten voor bepaalde merkgeneesmiddelen terug te verwijzen naar de specialist (ingezonden 30

An MP asks the health minister about the LHV's campaign to refer repeat prescriptions for certain brand-name drugs back to specialists, and whether patient care and guidelines are protected. The minister says patient interest must come first, huisartsen remain responsible for repeat prescriptions, and no concerning signals or cost effects have yet been received.
For me, it is paramount that the action of the Landelijke Huisartsen Vereniging (LHV) must not come at the expense of the patient's interest.
Voor mij staat voorop dat de actie van de Landelijke Huisartsen Vereniging (LHV) niet ten koste mag gaan van het belang van de patiënt.
Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een computerstoring bij KPN (ingezonden 6 april 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about a KPN network outage that briefly blocked access to GP and medication records, the maximum allowed downtime for EPD systems, whether single-point-of-failure storage is lawful, and liability for medical errors caused by inaccessible records. The minister said he had no direct access to the site, that national EPD outages may occur at most twice a year and must be resolved within a day with sanctions only after the law takes effect, that KPN had backups and a KPN evaluation was underway, that NEN 7510 covers backup requirements so extra measures are unnecessary, and that liability follows the professional standard of care.
As long as the EPD bill has not yet entered into force, there is no sanction possibility.
Zolang het EPD-wetsvoorstel nog niet inwerking is getreden is er geen sanctiemogelijkheid.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het veelvuldig afzonderen van een cliënt verblijvende in de Van der Hoeven Kliniek in Utrecht (Ingezonden 1 maart 2010).

MPs Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister about prolonged isolation of a patient at the Van der Hoeven Kliniek, delayed diagnosis and treatment, lack of professional care, and whether the Inspectorate for Health Care (IGZ) protects the patient's interests under the Bopz Act. The minister answered that individual treatment is outside his competence, that isolation must never be a sanction, that the IGZ is a supervisor rather than an advocate and found no structural shortcomings, and that the IGZ later sent the requested separation data to the patient's lawyer.
As Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport I do not have the competence or insight to judge the treatment of individual patients.
Als minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport heb ik niet de bevoegdheid en het inzicht te oordelen over de behandeling van individuele patiënten.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de afname van de instroom van buitenlandse artsen (ingezonden 1 april 2010).

An MP from D66 asks the health minister whether the 2005 assessment procedure for foreign-trained doctors, including its language test, effectively excludes them, and why the number of foreign doctors allocated to medical faculties fell sharply. The minister rejects that conclusion, cites a 2007 quick scan and a 64% pass rate, says language preparation is available, and agrees to ask the CBGV to publish annual reports but sees no need yet for a second evaluation.

I will ask the chair of the CBGV to publish annual reports from 2010 onwards, paying attention to figures on requests for declarations of competence and participants in the assessment of BIG professionals trained outside the EEA.

Ik zal de voorzitter van de CBGV verzoeken vanaf 2010 jaarverslagen te publiceren, waarin aandacht besteed wordt aan cijfers van verzoeken voor een verklaring van vakbekwaamheid en van deelnemers aan het assessment van buiten de EER opgeleide BIG-beroepbeoefenaars.

Vragen van de leden Uitslag en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën over zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp’ers) in de zorg (ingezonden 25 maart 2010).

MPs Uitslag and Omtzigt (CDA) asked whether self-employed care workers holding a VAR declaration can rely on it for tax, social insurance and pension status, and under which AWBZ, Wmo and Zvw conditions self-employed workers may provide care, plus whether a new convenant on intermediation in home care would be drawn up. The minister answered that a VAR can be revised if facts differ, that AWBZ direct contracting of self-employed providers is planned for around 2012 pending impact checks, that subcontracting is currently the main route, and that no new convenant is intended.
It is my intention to amend the AWBZ care entitlements decree so that care offices can also contract natural persons for AWBZ care.
Het ligt in mijn bedoeling het Besluit zorgaanspraken AWBZ zo te wijzigen dat zorgkantoren ook natuurlijke personen voor AWBZ-zorg kunnen contracteren.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Justitie over hulp bij zelfdoding (ingezonden 11 februari 2010).

An MP asks whether a man who helped his mother end her life in 2008 acted lawfully, whether he will be prosecuted, and whether a public debate on assisted dying for completed life is needed. The minister confirms the case is under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service with no prosecution decision yet, restates the statutory due-care criteria, and refers to earlier answers on the completed-life debate without committing to organise a new one.
The Public Prosecution Service has not yet taken a prosecution decision because the investigation is still ongoing.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft nog geen vervolgingsbeslissing genomen omdat het onderzoek nog loopt.

Vragen van de leden Koşer Kaya (D66), Van Miltenburg (VVD) en Halsema (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Justitie over een «voltooid leven» (ingezonden 5 februar

Three MPs asked the state secretary for health and the justice minister about reports of elderly care-home residents ending their lives because they felt their lives were complete, and what should be done about it. The minister answered that such euthanasia does not meet the statutory due-care requirements and is not allowed, that he will not facilitate responses to loneliness or perceived meaninglessness, and that research on professionals' and citizens' views will report by end 2010.
Euthanasia based on the feeling that life is complete does not meet the due-care requirements of article 2 of the act and is therefore not permitted.
Euthanasie op basis van het gevoel dat er sprake is van voltooid leven voldoet niet aan de zorgvuldigheidseisen van artikel 2 van de wet en is daarom niet toegestaan.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het vastlopen van de cao-onderhandelingen voor verpleeg-, verzorgingshuizen en thuiszorg (ingezonden 8 april 2010).

An MP asks the health minister how she responds to the stalled collective labour agreement talks in the care sector, and asks about employer demands on night shifts, flexibility and the ova-convenant. The minister replies that labour conditions are primarily a matter for the social partners and that the ministry's only role is implementing the ova-convenant, so she declines to intervene.
Labour conditions policy is primarily a matter for the social partners.
Het arbeidsvoorwaardenbeleid is primair een zaak van de sociale partners.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over privéklinieken en toezicht (ingezonden 15 oktober 2009).

An SP MP asked the health minister about the reopened Acura clinic, including unqualified surgeons, surgical quality and oversight by the Inspectorate, and whether clinics should be closed or a register introduced. The minister answered that the clinic was reopened after meeting conditions, that the Inspectorate found misleading titles but judged closure disproportionate, and that he saw no need for a register or statutory list of operations.

The inspectorate will consult with the NVPC and ZKN to discuss what these parties can do to reduce possible unclarity over the division of responsibility between general practitioners and plastic surgeons.

De inspectie gaat met de NVPC en ZKN in overleg om te bespreken wat deze partijen kunnen doen om mogelijke onduidelijkheden rond de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling tussen basisartsen en plastisch chirurgen terug te dringen.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over besnijdenissen in privéklinieken (ingezonden 24 november 2009).

MP Van Gerven asked the Minister of Health about circular (non-medically necessary) circumcisions in private clinics, including quality, complications, Inspectorate oversight and who may perform them. The minister answered that the same rules apply to private clinics as to hospitals, that no signals of increased complications were known, and that the Inspectorate's risk-based supervision is adequate.
I am of the view that the IGZ, through risk-based supervision, adequately supervises the quality of care in private clinics.
Ik ben van mening dat de IGZ middels het risicogestuurd toezicht op adequate wijze toezicht houdt op de kwaliteit van zorg in particuliere klinieken.
Vragen van het lid Sap (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het toezicht op besnijdenisklinieken (ingezonden 24 november 2009).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the health minister about IGZ oversight of circumcision clinics after a NOVA broadcast, including whether the IGZ supervises all medical acts, how many clinics and complications exist, and whether aftercare is provided. The minister answers that the IGZ conducts risk-based supervision of all medical acts and private clinics, that 14 clinics are known, complication reporting covers only a few calamities per year, and that aftercare is the institution's responsibility.
For supervision and the requirements the care must meet, it makes no difference whether the care is insured or not.
Het maakt voor het toezicht en de eisen waaraan de zorg moet voldoen geen verschil of het verzekerde zorg betreft of niet.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Leijten en Irrgang (allen SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Ontwikkelingssamenwerking over de jacht op Indiaas OK-personeel. (Ingezonden 8 februari 2010)

MPs from the SP asked ministers whether hospitals Flevoziekenhuis and AMC Amsterdam actively recruiting Indian operating-theatre staff was acceptable, and what measures would stop it. The minister regretted the recruitment, stated hospitals act within the cabinet's policy that recruitment from outside the EU is a last resort, and pointed to WHO code tightening and a planned training fund as responses, without committing to stop hospitals' recruitment.
We regret that Flevoziekenhuis and AMC Amsterdam felt compelled to actively recruit 6 and 22 Indian operating-theatre assistants respectively.
Wij betreuren het dat het Flevoziekenhuis en het AMC Amsterdam zich genoodzaakt zagen om op actieve wijze respectievelijk 6 en 22 Indiase ok-assistenten te werven.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het aantal ziekenhuizen dat kinderhartchirurgie uitvoert (ingezonden 17 maart 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the number of children's heart surgery centres could be clarified, whether three centres is too few for regional spread, and how he judges a plan by centres to form a fourth centre together. The minister answered that his position is unchanged, that Dutch criteria do not allow four centres unless patient flows change, that a final choice will follow in early 2012 based on performance, and that the joint plan was not mentioned in the centres' letter so he cannot assess it.
I therefore cannot assess these plans.
Ik kan deze plannen dan ook niet beoordelen.

Vragen van de leden Willemse-van der Ploeg en Van Bochove (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over woonzorgwoningen (ingezonde

CDA MPs asked the health and housing ministers about allocation rules for care-housing units (woonzorgwoningen), including whether a 5-hour care-need threshold excludes some disabled people. The minister replied that allocation criteria are set locally or regionally, that no national norm exists, that he lacks insight into actual allocations, and that existing rules suffice, pointing to a 2007-2011 action plan and a report on allocation.
Because the rules for housing allocation are determined locally or regionally, I have no insight into the allocations and the match between limitations and dwellings.
Omdat de regels voor woonruimteverdeling lokaal of regionaal worden bepaald, heb ik geen inzicht in de toewijzingen en de match daarbij tussen beperkingen en woningen.
Vragen het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het Inspectierapport particuliere klinieken 2008 (ingezonden 22 oktober 2009).

An SP MP asked the health minister how she responds to the 2008 Inspectorate report on private clinics, raising concerns about risk classification, staffing, 24-hour availability, licensing, and a fat-removal surgery offered via a TV programme. The minister largely defended the sector as generally sound, said the Inspectorate will investigate flagged clinics and apply graduated sanctions, rejected a licensing regime, and declined to change basic insurance coverage.
Following the report, the IGZ will carry out further investigation on a number of points.
De IGZ zal naar aanleiding van het rapport op een aantal punten nader onderzoek uitvoeren.

Vragen van het lid Vietsch (CDA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Economische Zaken over het bericht «Bouwimpuls overheid werkt niet» (ingezonden 7 december

An MP asks the health minister about reports that the government's construction stimulus and GO guarantee schemes for hospitals, care and mental health are not working, requesting an overview of applications and obstacles. The minister reports GO Cure guarantees of 54.7 million euro granted, care construction funds fully allocated to 58 projects, 160 million euro for hospitals redirected to transition financing, and about 247.65 million euro in GO Cure guarantees still available.
What are the obstacles in the schemes for applying for, assessing and granting credit?
Wat zijn de belemmeringen in de regelingen voor de aanvraag, beoordeling en afgifte van krediet?

Vragen het lid Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat steeds meer vrijwilligersorganisaties verdwijnen als gevolg van de invoering van de

An MP asks the health minister about reports that volunteer organisations are disappearing under the Wmo, including waiting lists for psychosocial help and difficult municipal subsidy applications. The minister says he has no central data on waiting lists, that funding for volunteer work is a municipal responsibility he does not intend to take over, and that the subsidy issue is for municipalities to address.
I do not intend to intervene in this competence of the municipalities.
Ik heb niet het voornemen in deze bevoegdheid van gemeenten te treden.
Vragen van het lid Verdonk (Verdonk) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over beperkte zorg voor mevrouw Y.M. J. (ingezonden 5 februari 2010)

An MP asked the health minister whether the CIZ wrongly reduced the care hours for a patient despite her doctors' diagnosis and what would be done to guarantee adequate care. The minister explained the CIZ procedure, said the medical adviser based the decision on available medical information and an ongoing objection, and rejected the claim that the CIZ was negligent.
The CIZ used the available medical information, the GP was involved, and a hearing for the objection procedure was held at the woman's home.
Het CIZ heeft de beschikbare medische informatie gebruikt, de huisarts is betrokken geweest en er is een hoorzitting voor de bezwaarprocedure bij mevrouw thuis geweest.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister voor Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het Kennisinstituut Bier (ingezonden 24 maart 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about the Kennisinstituut Bier, a brewer-funded body whose Bierwijzer misquoted Gezondheidsraad advice and targets public-sector professionals, questioning its independence and disclosure of funding. The minister says the first Bierwijzer's error has been corrected, that the state cannot oversee private information bodies or require disclosure of funders, and that no intervention is planned.
Moreover, it is not the task of the central government to check the accuracy of alcohol information material from private organisations and to act when errors are found.
Overigens is het geen taak van de rijksoverheid om voorlichtingsmateriaal over alcohol van private organisaties op juistheid te controleren en op te treden als er fouten worden geconstateerd.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de compensatie door gemeenten voor ex-AWBZ-cliënten (ingezonden 24 maart 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether municipalities are compensating former AWBZ clients who lost their care eligibility, how many municipalities use the 127 million euro allocated for this, and whether rising social isolation among elderly is undesirable. The minister says he does not know which municipalities cut welfare work, reports that a December 2009 letter urged municipalities to support affected citizens, and promises the results of a survey of municipal policies that will determine whether further action is needed.
In it she called on the Wmo aldermen to support citizens affected by the AWBZ package measure
Daarin heeft zij de wethouders Wmo opgeroepen burgers die te maken hebben met de AWBZ-pakketmaatregel te ondersteunen
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de cao ambulancezorg (ingezonden 17 maart 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the ambulance care collective agreement's entry into force is conditional on resolving the functional age discharge (FLO) and older-worker arrangements, and how the minister would break the impasse. The minister answered that the older-worker issue is materially resolved and not a precondition, while a uniform financing scheme is still being developed, with a response promised before 31 December 2010.
In my view, the older-worker policy, including the FLO, has been substantively resolved and need not hinder the entry into force of the collective agreement.
Naar mijn mening is het ouderenbeleid, waaronder de FLO, in materiele zin opgelost en hoeft dit geen belemmering te zijn voor de inwerkingtreding van de cao.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën over het bericht dat € 70 miljard aan AWBZ-premies is verdwenen (ingezonden 17 maart 2010).

Leijten (SP) asks the ministers of Health and Finance whether EUR 70 billion in AWBZ premiums has disappeared, and whether premium revenue has been spent on other things since 1996. Minister Klink answers that no money has vanished, that the press calculation ignores tax reductions and the BIKK compensation, and that AWBZ revenue and spending broadly balance over the decade.
There is no EUR 70 billion missing and AWBZ premiums are spent on AWBZ care.
Er is geen € 70 miljard zoek en AWBZ-premies worden uitgegeven aan AWBZ-zorg.
Vragen van het lid Neppérus (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over dopingcontroles (ingezonden 9 maart 2010).

An MP asks whether the Dutch national anti-doping regulation conflicts with the ECHR and the Convention on the Rights of the Child, and what role the minister sees for herself. The minister answers that the regulation is a sports-law framework without direct horizontal effect of those treaties, that harmonisation with the World Anti-Doping Code is required, and that Dutch efforts continue within the Council of Europe on rules for minors.
That does not alter the fact that the Netherlands is very active internationally in advocating a lasting good balance between anti-doping rules and athletes' rights.
Dit neemt niet weg dat Nederland internationaal zeer actief is om een blijvend goede balans tussen de anti-dopingregels en de rechten van sporters te bepleiten.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over het bericht dat het RIVM rekening houdt met meer Q-koortspatiënten (ingezonden 17 maa

An MP asked whether the RIVM's expectation of more Q-fever patients reflects a delay in government measures, and whether the internal newsletter will be published. The minister answered that the newsletter is for medical professionals and will not be published, that the epidemic cannot be fully eliminated given environmental persistence, and that the ban on breeding and supply will only be lifted if two conditions are met.
The message will therefore not be made public.
Het bericht zal daarom niet openbaar gemaakt worden.

Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een Drentse zorgboerderij die langdurig ondermaats presteert en tegelijkertijd het kwaliteitscertificaat van de Vereniging Land

An MP asked the health minister how a Drenthe care farm under intensified Inspectorate supervision could hold a quality certificate from the Verenigde Zorgboeren, and about the role of personal budget holders and parents in buying quality care. The minister answered that the certificate is only a self-evaluation step, that the Inspectorate judges quality on outcomes and law rather than the certificate, and that the certificate does not exempt the care farm from Inspectorate oversight, while saying the sector body is tightening its system with the Inspectorate.
The certificate alone indeed offers too few guarantees of quality.
Het certificaat alleen biedt inderdaad te weinig waarborgen voor de kwaliteit.
Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Studente zwicht niet voor seksbehoefte van patiënt» (ingezonden 15 maart 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about a news report of a nursing student refusing a patient's sexual demands, whether such requests are known to occur, how misuse of personal budgets for sexual services is addressed, and whether care workers and training are adequately prepared. The minister answered that no data on frequency is known, that sexual contact with patients is criminal, that misuse of personal budgets would be reclaimed, and that existing standards and training are sufficient, with a planned discussion with Per Saldo.
No data on this are known to me.
Hierover zijn mij geen gegevens bekend.
Vragen van het lid Wolbert (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over seks in de thuiszorg (ingezonden 15 maart 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether care workers in home care are pressured into sexual acts paid from personal budgets, and whether training, norms and coaching should address intimacy and sexuality. The minister answers that training already covers ethical conduct, that the press case involved a student rather than a self-employed worker, that sexual acts are criminal under the Criminal Code, and that no new norms are needed.
Respectful and responsible handling of intimacy and sexuality is part of the professional practice of nurses and care workers.
Het respectvol en verantwoordelijk omgaan met intimiteit en seksualiteit behoort bij de beroepsuitoefening van verplegenden en verzorgenden.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Leeuwen (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over mantelzorgwoningen (inge

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister for Housing whether requiring care-recipients to occupy garden care dwellings (mantelzorgwoningen) obstructs permits, and whether the rules should be relaxed. The minister answered that no such obstruction emerged from the survey, that municipalities decide who may occupy such dwellings, and that the planning rules will be simplified so occupancy by carer or care-recipient does not matter.
The starting point for the new regulation is that it does not matter whether the new structure is used by the person receiving care or the person providing it.
Het uitgangspunt bij het opstellen van de nieuwe regeling is dat het niet uitmaakt of het nieuwe bouwwerk gebruikt wordt door degene die mantelzorg ontvangt of verleent.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over seksuele behoeften van een patiënt (ingezonden 12 maart 2010).

Leijten (SP) asks the health minister how she views a report that a care student refused a patient's sexual request, whether care indications can cover sexual acts, whether PGB funds are used for sex, and whether the government will investigate demand for sexual services in long-term care. Minister Klink answers that sexual services are not AWBZ care, that care workers are criminally liable for sexual contact with patients, and that she will not investigate the scale of the problem.
Sexual acts do not belong to AWBZ-insured care.
Seksuele handelingen behoren niet tot de AWBZ-verzekerde zorg.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het afstoten van de basiszorg door het Universitair Medisch Centrum in Utrecht (ingezonden 17 februari 2010).

MP Van Gerven asks the minister whether the UMC Utrecht's plan to drop basic hospital care is acceptable, what motivates it, whether it is in the public interest, and whether academic centres coordinate their offerings. The minister replies that UMCs may choose to limit basic care, that top-referral care is protected through academic funding, that the UMCU's strategy is not yet decided and media reports are premature, and that UMCs agree among themselves on specialised services.
As indicated in answer 1, the Executive Board has not yet taken a definitive decision on the focal points it wishes to pursue.
Zoals aangegeven bij antwoord 1 heeft de Raad van Bestuur nog geen definitief besluit genomen over de speerpunten waarop zij zich wil richten.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over ambtenaren die dure pillen wel vergoed krijgen (ingezonden 11 maart 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister whether VNG employees covered by the IZA collective restitution policy receive more expensive medicines than others, bypassing preferential drug policy, and whether this creates an unwanted two-tier system. The minister answered that the IZA policy is a private collective contract outside his responsibility, that preferential policy remains a good cost-control tool, and that other insurers and collectives also offer non-preferential policies, so no unwanted two-tier system arises.
I am not responsible for the mutual agreements that the parties make with each other in a collective contract.
Ik ga niet over de onderlinge afspraken die de partijen in een collectief contract met elkaar maken.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over gevolgen van zorgzwaartepakketten (ZZP's) voor ondersteuning in instellingen (ingezonden 15 maart 2010).

MP Leijten (SP) asked the health minister about the effects of care-weight packages (ZZP's) on support services in care institutions, including closed kitchens, job losses and budget cuts at specific organisations. Minister Klink answered that the reform redistributes funds macro-wise, that institutions choose how to spend their budgets, and that he sees no need for a study into forced dismissals.
I am of the view that the introduction of care-weight funding is proceeding carefully and gradually and I therefore have no intention of conducting an investigation into forced dismissals.
Ik ben van mening dat de invoering van de zorgzwaartebekostiging zorgvuldig en geleidelijk verloopt en ben dan ook niet van plan om een onderzoek te doen naar gedwongen ontslagen.
Vragen van het lid Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over gameverslaving (ingezonden 23 februari 2010).

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks ministers whether industry should be required to inform consumers about gaming addiction risks, whether gaming addiction should be part of school prevention programmes, whether Centra voor Jeugd en Gezin can refer to specialised help, and whether a government website should contain information on gaming addiction. The minister answers that existing awareness programmes, PEGI labelling and referral via the existing website are sufficient for now, that no specific evidence-based treatment yet exists, and that the EU is discussing a possible addictive-effect pictogram.
The European Commission is consulting with the game industry to see whether more can be done to better protect young people from possible harmful effects of games.
De Europese Commissie voert overleg met de game-industrie om te bezien of er méér gedaan kan worden om de jeugd beter te beschermen tegen mogelijk schadelijke effecten van games.
Vragen van de leden Wolbert en Van Dijken (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volkgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een woonboerderij voor verstandelijk gehandicapten (ingezonden 15 maart 2010).

MPs Wolbert and Van Dijken asked the health minister about the Diogenes care farm for people with intellectual disabilities, including the timing of inspection, the inspectorate's reliance on the supervisory board, the quality of persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) care, enforcement against non-annual-report institutions, and a quality mark for commercial PGB providers. The minister defended the inspectorate's gradual approach and the board's actions, defended PGB use while acknowledging risks, said enforcement applies equally to all institutions, and explained why a quality mark was not feasible, promising a keuze-informatie instrument by 2011.
The inspectorate has given the management of Diogenes until the summer to make improvements in care provision, in cooperation with the Supervisory Board.
De inspectie heeft de directie van Diogenes tot de zomer de tijd gegeven om – in samenwerking met de Raad van Commissarissen – verbeteringen in de zorgverlening aan te brengen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Vlies (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een gat in de uitkering van het mantelzorgcompliment (ingezonden 22 januari 2010).

An SGP MP asks the state secretary about a gap in the carers' compliment (mantelzorgcompliment) after the 1 August 2009 rule change, where people with overlapping 52-week care indications may miss out on the 2009 payment, and asks why this conflicts with a 2008 pledge. The minister acknowledges the gap can occur, says the overlap situation was not provided for, and commits to retroactively granting the 2009 compliment to such cases, provided the combined indication duration reaches 371 days.
I do not consider this a desirable situation and am willing to correct this with retroactive effect in the implementation of this scheme
Ik vind dit geen wenselijke situatie en ben bereid dit met terugwerkende kracht bij de uitvoering van deze regeling te corrigeren

Vragen van de leden Atsma en Joldersma (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over gameverslaving (ingezonden 17 februari 2010).

CDA MPs asked ministers about gaming addiction, citing an IVO report on tens of thousands of affected Dutch people, and whether warning labels, industry engagement or other measures should be introduced. The minister said addiction is treatable within existing care, that EU-level discussion with the industry on a possible warning pictogram is the proper route, and pointed to parental controls and existing awareness programmes without committing to new national measures.
Possible additional measures by the industry can, as stated in the answer to question 3, be discussed at EU level.
Eventuele aanvullende maatregelen door de industrie kunnen zoals gesteld in het antwoord op vraag 3 in EU-verband besproken worden.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (beiden ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over een handboek met methoden voor hulp bij zelfdoding (ingez

MPs Voordewind and Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink asked whether the government knows the book 'Uitweg' giving methods for assisted suicide, whether it undermines suicide-prevention policy, and whether article 294 of the Criminal Code can be used against such books. The minister confirms awareness, agrees the book conflicts with suicide-prevention policy, says it does not prompt new measures, and refers to earlier legal explanations on article 294.
The appearance of this book does not give me cause to take additional policy measures or further action.
Het verschijnen van dit boek vormt voor mij geen aanleiding om aanvullende (beleids)maatregelen of nader actie te ondernemen.

Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over preventieve ouderengezondheidszorg en de uitvoering van het amendement Kant (ingezonden 5 februari 2010).

MP Leijten asks the minister and state secretary of Health, Welfare and Sport why implementation of the Kant amendment on preventive elderly care is disappointing, whether municipalities will be informed and funded, what the Inspectorate's supervisory guidelines are, and whether Consultation Bureaus for Older People will be set up. The minister answers that municipalities are primarily responsible, gives general frameworks without an AMvB, refers to existing funding streams, says the Inspectorate sets its own methods, and treats Consultation Bureaus as one option rather than a goal.
On the entry into force, from 1 July 2010, I will inform the municipalities further.
Over de inwerkingtreding, per 1 juli 2010, zal ik de gemeenten nog nader informeren.
Vragen van het lid Joldersma (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over dakloze gezinnen (ingezonden 2 februari 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about rising homelessness among families and whether municipalities may refuse emergency shelter to homeless families for lack of regional ties or income. The minister denied that shelters overlook families, said the regional-ties agreements guarantee low-threshold shelter to all acutely homeless people, and said the data are contradictory so the Federatie Opvang has been asked to substantiate claims before deciding whether to address municipalities.
I have therefore asked the Federatie Opvang to substantiate the statements in the Ombudsman's broadcast with facts and figures.
Ik heb de Federatie Opvang daarom gevraagd de uitspraken in de uitzending van de Ombudsman te onderbouwen met feiten en cijfers.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vrije vestiging van huisarts E. te D. en de tegenwerking door collega's (ingezonden 23 december 2009).

An SP MP asked the health minister about a GP who settled in Schinnen with municipal support but was allegedly obstructed by colleagues, refused entry to the local out-of-hours service, and about the roles of the competition authorities and the health inspectorate. The minister said GPs are free to settle, called obstruction generally inappropriate, declared the service dispute purely private law, said the Inspectorate could intervene if access or quality were at risk, and noted that the NZa and NMa had not been aware of the conflict and that the involved parties had reported to regulators without action.
Inquiries show this is a strictly private-law matter on which I cannot and do not want to pass judgment.
Navraag leert dat dit een strikt privaatrechterlijke aangelegenheid is waarover ik geen oordeel kan en wil uitspreken.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Langkamp (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet verstrekken van gegevens van een oorspronkelijk spermadonor door het Delfzicht Ziekenhuis Delfzij

MPs Van Gerven and Langkamp (SP) asked the health minister why Delfzicht Hospital refused a lesbian couple donor-sperm information after a mix-up, whether the Inspectorate should investigate, and whether a central register of fertility-clinic errors is needed. The minister declined to judge the court case, said the mix-up was reported in 2004 and handled internally, stated the Inspectorate's criteria did not require further investigation, and rejected a central register, pointing to hospitals' own quality systems.
The hospital reported the sperm mix-up involving the couple in 2004. No other mix-ups have been reported.
Het ziekenhuis heeft de verwisseling van sperma, betrekking hebbend op voornoemde stel, in 2004 gemeld. Er zijn geen andere verwisselingen gemeld.
Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de reactie van Ab Osterhaus op de bestelling van de 34 miljoen vaccins (ingezonden 18 februari 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether she accepts that Ab Osterhaus's visible joy at the 34 million vaccine order was shameless, and whether his integrity is still unaffected after seeing the VPRO footage. The minister disagrees with the characterisation, sees no reason to doubt his integrity, and says his joy is understandable given his consistent warnings about pandemic risk.
I do not think that the integrity of Mr Osterhaus is at stake.
Ik vind niet dat de integriteit van de heer Osterhaus in het geding is.

Vragen van het lid Zijlstra (VVD) aan de staatsecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de ministers van Financiën en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de gerechtelijke vonnissen in de respectievelijke zaken van het

MP Zijlstra asked the government whether Dutch court rulings on Indonesia-related claims (Comité Civiele Vorderingen, Stichting Opeising, Froeling) mean the claims lie against Indonesia rather than the Dutch State, and whether the 1966 Wassenaar Treaty extinguished private claims and transferred liability. The minister answered that the rulings only found Indonesia the correct party without substantive assessment, that the treaty aimed at a final lump-sum settlement, did not transfer liability, and that Indonesia had fully paid, with claimants given a chance to file claims in 1966-67.
In the cited judgments the court only ruled on whether the correct party was before it in these cases.
De rechter heeft in de genoemde arresten slechts een oordeel gegeven op de vraag of in de betreffende zaken de juiste partij in het geding is.

Vragen van het lid Sap (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Verkeer en Waterstaat over medicijnresten in oppervlaktewater (ingezonden 22 februari 2010).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the health and transport ministers about how medicine residues enter surface water, what measures exist, whether Swiss-style mandatory treatment and a one-cent levy per pill are feasible, and whether hospitals and pharmaceutical firms should contribute. The minister answers that the government is studying advanced treatment and financing options with a report due in 2010, points to earlier letters for existing measures, and says there is no basis for the fertility and MRSA links raised.
That is why the 2009 letter committed to examining how these purification measures can be scaled up for Dutch practice.
Vandaar dat in de brief van 2009 is toegezegd dat nader onderzocht wordt hoe deze zuiveringsmaatregelen kunnen worden opgeschaald voor de Nederlandse praktijk.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over orthodontisten die meer verdienen dan het norminkomen (ingezonden 11 maart 2010).

SP MPs asked the health and justice ministers about orthodontists earning far above the norm income, their BV dividend structures, the chair-count of practices, and former orthodontists keeping the title. The minister answered that the NZa is running a cost study, that BV income is subject to normal tax rules with no plan to end such structures, and that the IGZ will investigate the title misuse.
If not, what steps are you willing to take to put an end to such constructions?
Zo nee, welke stappen bent u bereid te nemen om aan dergelijke constructies een einde te maken?
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bewaren van medische dossiers (ingezonden 3 maart 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the statutory duty to destroy medical records after 15 years, effective 1 April 2010, could be temporarily avoided and whether a minimum retention of 30 years should apply. The minister agreed the 15-year period is too short, plans to lengthen it in the Wet cliëntenrechten zorg, and will urge providers to take extra care, without proposing a formal temporary solution.
I share the view of the KNMG, among others, that the current retention period is too short.
Ik deel de mening van onder andere de KNMG dat de huidige bewaartermijn te kort is.

Vragen van het lid Biskop (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, mw. Van Bijsterveld-Vliegenthart, over de bestrijding van schoolverzuim in Amsterdam (ingezonden 13 januari 2010).

An MP asks whether orthodontists delisting from the BIG register to charge higher tariffs as dentists is a problem, and whether the Inspectorate monitors unlawful use of the orthodontist title. The minister answers that 117 of 188 orthodontists have deregistered, tariff gaps have narrowed, and the Inspectorate will investigate the title misuse given its scale.

Given the scale on which title misuse of 'orthodontist' may be occurring and its negative effect on patients' trust in healthcare, the Inspectorate will conduct further investigation and act depending on the findings.

Gezien de schaal waarop hier mogelijk sprake is van misbruik van de titel «orthodontist» en gezien de negatieve invloed die dit kan hebben op het vertrouwen van de patiënt in de gezondheidszorg zal de Inspectie nader onderzoek doen en afhankelijk van de bevindingen optreden.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over levensgevaarlijke genezers (ingezonden 21 januari 2010).

An SP MP asked the health minister about dangerous alternative healers after a TV report, including whether the Inspectorate acted properly over a physiotherapist who applied craniosacral therapy to a baby who died, whether unproven therapies should be banned, and whether the 1993 BIG Act change allowing anyone to call themselves a healer should be reversed. The minister mostly referred to earlier answers, said a list of harmful therapies cannot reliably be compiled, and defended the BIG Act and the view that questioning a diagnosis is not a reserved act.
In my view such a list would create a suggestion that cannot be substantiated.
Naar mijn mening wekt een dergelijke lijst daarmee een suggestie die niet waargemaakt kan worden.

Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de wachttijden van meer dan acht maanden voor operaties van jeugdige patiënten met een scoliose door de nieuwe vorm van financ

An SP MP asked the health minister about waiting times of over eight months for paediatric scoliosis operations, which the orthopaedic association attributes to the DBC funding system, and about related issues including surgery abroad, complications and orthopaedic training places. The minister replied that scoliosis care is in segment A with fixed tariffs, that waiting times are a matter for treating doctors case by case, that cross-border care is a valuable supplement, and that training places remain at 34 per year with a new capacity plan due later this year.
I intend to make these places available for 2011 after all.
Ik ben voornemens deze plaatsen voor 2011 alsnog ter beschikking te stellen.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat alternatieve behandelingen veel schade kunnen aanrichten (ingezonden 25 januari 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about the effectiveness of alternative treatments, insurers' role in informing policyholders, the duty of practitioners to warn patients, oversight by the Health Inspectorate, and why the Public Prosecution Service did not prosecute alternative healers shown in a TV documentary. The minister answered that insurers should inform policyholders, that practitioners must give risk information under civil law, that BIG-registered professionals are bound by care standards, that the Inspectorate handles complaints only when structural risks exist, and that prosecution depends on complaints being filed.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service depend on reports or complaints from those involved to investigate and prosecute possible criminal offences committed by alternative healers.
Politie en Openbaar Ministerie zijn voor de opsporing en vervolging van mogelijke strafbare feiten gepleegd door alternatieve genezers afhankelijk van meldingen of aangiften van betrokkenen.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over alternatieve geneeswijzen (ingezonden 21 januari 2010).

MP Arib asks the ministers of Health and Justice about the regulation of alternative medicine, including unchecked 'healers', insurer reimbursement, the Gezondheidsraad advice, and the death of a three-month-old baby after craniosacral therapy. Minister Klink answers that the Wet BIG deliberately leaves unregulated practice free, that the IGZ is reviewing reporting and enforcement powers with new measures planned, that the criminal investigation into the baby's death is ongoing and cannot be discussed, and that the IGZ has limited its role on treatment content.
Where it concerns abuses in healthcare, I announced in my letter to the House of Representatives measures for a more effective approach.
Waar het gaat om misstanden in de zorg heb ik in mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer maatregelen ten behoeve van een effectievere aanpak aangekondigd.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het niet vergoeden van acetylcysteïne (ingezonden 23 februari 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether the removal of reimbursement for acetylcysteine (a mucolytic) is justified, given that it is no longer in physicians' guidelines and that patients with lung fibrosis will now pay 400-800 euro per year. The minister replies that the decision rests on insufficient evidence of efficacy assessed by the CVZ's Commissie Farmaceutische Hulp, not on guidelines alone, and refuses to make an exception or wait for pending US research.
Should new research data become available, this could give reason to reassess this application.
Mochten nieuwe onderzoeksgegevens beschikbaar komen, dan zou dit aanleiding kunnen vormen om deze toepassing opnieuw te beoordelen.

Vragen van de leden Van Gerven , Leijten en Gesthuizen (allen SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Economische Zaken over de garantstelling van de overheid bij Bergman Clinics (ingezonden 23

SP MPs asked why the government guarantees a bank loan for Bergman Clinics under the GO Cure scheme while refusing a similar guarantee for the Atrium hospital in Heerlen, and questioned the liberalisation of capital charges and the care-sector building funds. The minister replied that Bergman's orthopaedic clinic qualifies under the scheme, that Atrium does not provide a crucial care function justifying state support, and that no further general guarantee or extra funds would be provided, with a fuller hospital-funding proposal postponed.
The general consultation of 17 March on hospital funding has been cancelled.
Het algemeen overleg van 17 maart over de ziekenhuisbekostiging is afgelast.
Vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya (D66) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de openingstijden van huisartsen niet toereikend zijn (ingezonden 2 februari 2010).
