An MP asked the health minister about NPCF surveys showing that huisarts opening hours and phone access are inadequate, and what measures would widen access. The minister acknowledged the shortcomings, pointed to insurer-provider agreements and the IGZ follow-up study on phone access, and said further steps would depend on those results.
Once the outcomes of the IGZ are known, I will consider whether follow-up steps are necessary.
Zodra de uitkomsten bekend zijn van de IGZ, zal ik mij beraden of vervolgstappen noodzakelijk zijn.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het functioneren van het CAK (ingezonden 1 maart 2010).

Leijten (SP) asks the minister about the CAK's failures in handling client complaints, the computer system problems, incorrect payments and withholding of contributions, and the treatment of separated couples for income contributions. Minister Klink replies that the problems stem mainly from faulty data supply by chain partners, that the CAK resolves cases manually and commits to improvement measures, and that restitution follows within two weeks.
It was indicated that unfortunately it is not always the case that a client is helped quickly and accurately by the CAK with a question or complaint.
Er is aangegeven dat het helaas nog niet altijd het geval is dat een cliënt op een vraag of klacht snel en accuraat wordt geholpen door het CAK.

Vragen van de leden Van der Veen en Gill'ard (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de NVALT-8 trial (onderzoek bij mensen) en het advies van het College voor zorgverzekeringen (CVZ) ove

MPs Van der Veen and Gill'ard asked the health minister about the NVALT-8 trial, the insurer Menzis' objection to it, the CVZ advice on extra funding for Alimta, and conflicts of interest in the advisory bodies. The minister defended the ethics review process and the CFH's advisory procedures, said the IGZ and CCMO handled the complaint correctly, and promised a CCMO investigation and further review of the Alimta advertising.
In my view this sufficiently guarantees that complaints and reports about the assessment of research protocols are handled carefully.
Naar mijn mening is hiermee voldoende gewaarborgd dat de klachten en meldingen over de beoordeling van onderzoeksprotocollen op een zorgvuldige wijze worden behandeld.
Vragen van het lid Arib (PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over problemen in de zorg ten gevolge van interculturele verschillen (ingezonden 25 januari 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about intercultural problems in care, including a doctor refusing a veiled patient, discrimination by patients against staff, religious conflicts with care duties, and conscientious objection in training. The minister said no clear signals exist, that providers may ask veiled patients to remove face coverings when safety is at stake, and that intercultural care is primarily the responsibility of field parties, declining a full inventory by the requested date.
At this moment I do not consider it possible to draw up such an inventory by the date you mentioned, in addition to the existing initiatives and contacts.
Ik acht het op dit moment niet mogelijk om naast de reeds bestaande initiatieven en contacten een dergelijke inventarisatie op te stellen voor de door u genoemde datum.

Vragen van de leden Schermers en Koppejan (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het mogelijke voornemen om spoedeisende hulp te verplaatsen van Vlissingen naar Goes (ingezonden 10 maart

MPs Schermers and Koppejan asked the health minister whether moving emergency care from Vlissingen to Goes would leave Walcheren residents outside the 30-minute norm, especially in summer, and how the ambulance accessibility norm would be guaranteed. The minister said a RIVM study found 4,100 residents would miss the 45-minute norm, that an extra ambulance post was realised to cover this, that RIVM was asked to add summer population figures, and that the situation would be monitored.
I have now asked RIVM to supplement its calculation and to take into account the summer period when more people (tourists) are in the area.
Ik heb het RIVM inmiddels gevraagd haar berekening aan te vullen en daarbij rekening te houden met de zomerperiode waarin er meer mensen (toeristen) zich in het gebied bevinden.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Wachtlijsten onnodig als TU Delft medisch isotopen mag produceren» (ingezonden 18 februari 2010).

An MP asks the health minister whether the shortage of medical isotopes is urgent, what measures will keep production going from 1 March, and why TU Delft has not yet been allowed to produce them. The minister refers to a letter on radiopharmaceutical availability, explains that licences from the environment ministry and technical reactor changes take about four months, and says TU Delft's contribution will not resolve the shortage.
Regarding questions 2 and 4, I refer you to the letter of 16 February to the House of Representatives on the availability of radiopharmaceuticals in 2010.
Met betrekking tot vraag 2 en vraag 4 verwijs ik u naar de brief van 16 februari jl. aan de Tweede Kamer over Beschikbaarheid radiofarmaca in 2010.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat ouderenzorg onrendabel is (ingezonden 1 maart 2010).

MP Leijten asks the health minister whether care provider Cordaan intends to stop nursing-home care as unprofitable, and about inspection complaints, risk selection and building subsidies. The minister replies that Cordaan denies abandoning nursing-home care, that the IGZ received 37 reports, and that zorginstellingen may decide which care to offer while keeping a duty to find solutions for existing clients.
There have been 37 reports between 1 January 2009 and 1 March 2010.
Er zijn 37 meldingen geweest tussen 1 januari 2009 en 1 maart 2010.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er weer een klacht is over ernstige verwaarlozing in Huis in de Duinen (ingezonden 23 februari 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that relatives of a deceased resident of Huis in de Duinen intend to file a complaint over neglect, and whether the Inspectorate for Healthcare would investigate further. The minister answered that no complaint had yet reached the Inspectorate, that it had visited the home in 2009 and found improvements, and that it saw no reason for additional investigation.
Since no new reports have been received by the inspectorate, I see no reason to have additional investigation carried out.
Aangezien er geen nieuwe meldingen zijn binnen gekomen bij de inspectie, zie ik geen reden om extra onderzoek te laten verrichten.
Vragen van het lid Leijten (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het faillissement van STN Zorg (ingezonden 8 januari 2010).

An MP asks the state secretary about the bankruptcy of STN Zorg, its care continuity, unpaid subcontractors and wages, and possible fraud. The minister answers that the curators and the care offices are responsible, care continuity is not at risk, and he declines to investigate further or comment on most points.
It is the task of the curators to investigate the causes of the bankruptcy and report on them.
Het behoort tot de taak van de curatoren om onderzoek te doen naar de oorzaken van het faillissement en daarover te rapporteren.

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health about Actiz's second kort geding win against the state over a convenant on intermediary agencies in home care, and questions the wider implications for zzp workers, pricing, quality and consumer protection (39 questions). The minister replies that no further implementation of the convenant takes place, that the ruling concerned a different draft on quality responsibility, that all providers need Wtzi authorisation and fall under the Kwaliteitswet, and that the sector and BTN handle the rest, while declining to go into the convenant's drafting history.
At this moment I no longer consider it opportune to go into detail on the drafting of the convenant.
Ik acht het op dit moment niet meer opportuun om uitgebreid in te gaan op de totstandkoming van het convenant.
Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Onderzoek darmkanker later door specialistentekort» (ingezonden 18 februari 2010).

An MP asks the health minister about reports of a specialist shortage delaying colorectal cancer screening, the planned training intake, use of nurse endoscopists, and why a screening decision is deferred to spring 2011 despite estimated lives saved. The minister says the shortage was anticipated with increased training intake, task-shifting is being explored, and the final decision on a national screening programme is postponed due to budget constraints, with a decision targeted for spring 2011.
At present, however, the cabinet finds itself compelled to postpone the final decision on introducing a population screening programme for colorectal cancer.
Op dit moment ziet het kabinet zich echter genoodzaakt om de definitieve beslissing over invoering van een bevolkingsonderzoek naar darmkanker uit te stellen.

Vragen van het lid Agema (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Justitie over het overlijden van mevrouw E. in de koelcel van het verpleeghuis waar zij woond

An MP asked the state secretary and ministers of health and justice about the death of a nursing-home resident in a cold cell, the handling of her medical file, the prosecution's failure to seize records, and the low number of doctors disciplined. The minister answered that the disciplinary chairman's remarks were misreported, that no concrete evidence of crimes justified seizure, that a new complaint is under police investigation, and that the Inspectorate has received reports now under review.
In the interest of the ongoing investigation into this new complaint, I cannot provide any information about it.
In het belang van het lopende onderzoek naar deze nieuwe aangifte kan ik daarover geen mededelingen doen.
Vragen van het lid Sap (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de sluiting van operatiekamers van Atrium MC te Heerlen (ingezonden 16 februari 2010).

An MP asked the health minister about the closure of operating theatres at Atrium MC in Heerlen after the health inspectorate found inadequate ventilation and poor infection-prevention compliance, and about the hospital's claimed financing problems for a new building. The minister acknowledged the inspectorate's concerns, said the board is responsible for safe care, declined to take responsibility for building finance since 2008, and promised a transitional arrangement for capital costs while declining to say whether he would intervene if the hospital got into financial trouble.
The board of a hospital is responsible for ensuring that responsible care is delivered.
De Raad van Bestuur (RvB) van een ziekenhuis is ervoor verantwoordelijk dat verantwoorde zorg geleverd wordt.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gratis behandeling met de Cytotron van ernstig zieke patiënten in India (ingezonden 16 februari 2010).

An SP MP asks the health minister whether the free Cytotron treatment offered to seriously ill cancer patients in India by a private clinic is acceptable, given earlier answers that the clinic had stopped treatment, and whether government should intervene against unproven private treatments. The minister replies that the treatment is not offered by the clinic itself, that government has no active powers absent unacceptable care or criminal conduct, and that the Inspectorate for Health Care has launched an investigation into the clinic.
Unless unacceptable care is provided or there is, for example, criminal conduct because patients are denied regular treatment, the government has no means to act actively.

Tenzij er onverantwoorde zorg wordt geleverd of er bijvoorbeeld sprake is van strafbaar handelen doordat patiënten een reguliere behandeling wordt onthouden, heeft de overheid geen middelen om actief op te treden.

Vragen van het lid Uitslag (CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over de rapportage van Kidsvitaal «Dubbel 30: Doe je ding!» (ingezonden 19 februari 2010).

An MP from the CDA asks whether the government recognises the Kidsvitaal 'Dubbel 30' report as a logical implementation of its obesity policy and whether it will take the report into account when carrying out the Uitslag motion on campaigns. The minister replies that Kidsvitaal is a self-regulatory industry initiative supporting healthy-eating projects, that it will be treated as a first step towards restricting food advertising to children, and that the next prevention note will address campaign design, but individual campaign concepts will not be discussed.
When carrying out your motion, however, I will not go into individual campaign concepts.
Bij de uitvoering van uw motie zal ik echter niet ingaan op individuele campagne concepten.
Vragen van het lid Gerkens (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, van Justitie en voor Jeugd en Gezin over de zorgen rondom gameverslaving (ingezonden 5 februari 2010).

An MP asked three ministers about concerns over game addiction, including whether the game industry takes enough responsibility, whether to adopt advice on consumer warnings and help for players, and how many addicts receive treatment. The government answered that the evidence base is thin, pointed to existing industry measures like PEGI and parental controls and ongoing EU talks, said about 150–200 people a year are treated in addiction care, and said no specific treatment places are needed.
There is therefore no need for specific treatment places for adults or young people with a game addiction.
Er is dus geen behoefte aan specifieke behandelplekken voor volwassenen of jongeren met een gameverslaving.

An SP MP asked the health minister about the closure of abortion clinic ACSG/MR70 in Amsterdam, including capacity replacement, the transfer of donor sperm and KID activities, the status of licence applications by SeZoz and Stisan, and reopening the clinic. The minister said extra capacity from nearby clinics would ensure continuity, the licence applications are under review by the Inspectorate and the College for Health Insurance, and reopening is not possible because the foundation is being wound down.
The College Sanering Zorginstellingen (CSZ) will monitor this additional capacity until all procedures with the new foundation at the Slotervaart hospital have been completed.
Het College Sanering Zorginstellingen (CSZ) zal deze extra opvang monitoren tot alle procedures met de nieuwe stichting in het Slotervaartziekenhuis zijn afgerond.

SP MPs Van Gerven and Polderman asked the health and agriculture ministers why the government allegedly acted too slowly against the Q-fever epidemic, withheld advice from the Coutinho group, and misled the House about vaginal swab testing. The ministers answered that the relevant advice was disclosed and that measures were taken as knowledge developed, while rejecting claims of misleading the House and pointing to the Van Dijk committee for evaluating responsibility.
We have not misled the House, as is suggested in the preamble on the NOVA website.
Wij hebben de Kamer niet misleid, zoals wordt gesuggereerd in de aanhef op de NOVA website.

An SP MP asked the health minister whether the planned closure of the Amsterdam abortion clinic MR'70 threatens continuity of abortion care, and whether the minister would arrange relocation of staff or delay closure. The minister answered that the clinic had already closed, that the CSZ monitors continuity and its report is attached, and that a board decision to close cannot be overruled by the minister.
It is not for a minister of VWS to intervene in such a decision of a board.
Het is niet aan een minister van VWS om te treden in een dergelijke beslissing van een bestuur.

An SP MP asks the health minister how the Amsterdam AMC and VUmc can refuse patients based on postcode, and whether the minister will stop this practice given the parliamentary consensus against it. The minister answers that refusing purely on postcode is undesirable, that referrals for capacity reasons are allowed if patient communication is careful and the patient keeps the final choice, and that the AMC is tightening its protocols and the IGZ is investigating.
I will ask the university medical centres, via the NFU, to improve patient communication in these cases and to keep me informed of progress.
Ik zal de UMC's via de NFU vragen de communicatie richting de patiënt in deze gevallen te verbeteren en mij op de hoogte te houden van de voortgang hieromtrent.

MPs Timmer, Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink and Zijlstra asked the health minister about the LHV action urging GPs to return specialty repeat prescriptions to specialists, the financial responsibility of specialists for efficient prescribing, and related benchmarks and guidelines. The minister answered that the GP remains responsible for prescriptions, that the action is a signal rather than a large-scale change, that a benchmark and an Orde guideline are being developed, and that equal financial responsibility between specialists and GPs cannot be expected given the different budget sizes.
There is no overview of the discounts that pharmaceutical manufacturers offer hospitals on frequently used specialities.
Er is geen overzicht van de kortingen die farmaceutische fabrikanten van veelgebruikte spécialités bieden aan ziekenhuizen.

MP Agema asked the health minister why the Netherlands would not reduce its order of H1N1 flu vaccines and instead pursue resale, and how likely other countries are to buy the surplus, plus the damage if resale fails and whether the contract hinders renegotiation. The minister answered that reduction talks with manufacturers are ongoing alongside resale negotiations with countries short of vaccine, that other countries likely will buy some surplus, that the amount of leftover vaccine cannot yet be stated, and that the contracts explicitly allow resale.
Because the negotiations on cancellation and sale are still ongoing, I cannot yet say anything about the number of remaining vaccines.
Omdat de onderhandelingen over afbestellen en verkopen nog lopen, kan ik nog geen uitspraak doen over het aantal restant vaccins.

An MP asked the health minister whether the Netherlands was pursuing a reduction of its H1N1 flu vaccine order, why the surplus doses were not cut, and how resale and pricing were handled. The minister said negotiations to cancel and resell unused vaccines were ongoing, declined to give the price details and promised a closed briefing.
I make no statements about the price of vaccines.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over de prijs van vaccins.

MPs Gill'ard and Zijlstra asked the health and justice ministers whether they know an ISSCR guidelines report on clinical stem cell translation, whether they will respond substantively, whether the Inspectorate (IGZ) is investigating XCell for offering stem cell therapy abroad, and when a ruling is expected. The minister answered that the guidelines are tools for institutions and the CCMO, that the IGZ is preparing an investigation into XCell with no findings yet, and that its duration cannot be predicted.
The Investigation Bureau of the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) is preparing an investigation into the practices of XCell-Center.
Het Bureau Opsporing van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) heeft een onderzoek in voorbereiding naar de praktijken van XCell-Center.

An MP (Zijlstra, VVD) asks the health minister about contributions paid by cross-border insured persons (verdragsgerechtigden) in the 2009 VWS insurance monitor, including solidarity, the calculation of the country-of-residence factor, moral hazard from the new EU regulation, the EHIC card and information for affected persons. The minister answers that differentiated contributions are based on residence-country costs, that the right to care is legally guaranteed, that contribution levels will be adjusted to reflect care in the Netherlands, and that the CVZ will inform beneficiaries.
The CVZ will ensure that all beneficiaries are informed in time about the changes contained in the new Regulation.
Het CVZ zal er voor zorg dragen dat alle verdragsgerechtigden tijdig worden geïnformeerd over de wijzigingen die de nieuwe Verordening bevat.

An MP asked the health minister about the share of hospitalised children found malnourished (16-20%), whether screening results are representative, how widely the malnutrition performance indicator and toolkit are used, and whether they should be mandatory with a target norm. The minister confirmed the figures, said the indicator is already mandatory since 2008 with inspectorate oversight, and pointed to existing 80% targets for screening and intake.

An MP asks the state secretary about plans to open the Sherpa care institution grounds to private housing, possibly forcing 175 disabled residents to move, and asks about participation rules, a housing-preference study, and the Ombudsman's criticism. The minister replies that client choice is central, that there is no forced relocation since enough places remain on site, that the IGZ sees no problem with the participation arrangements, and refers back to earlier answers.
I will respond in a separate letter to your Chamber on the remarks of the National Ombudsman.
Ik zal in een afzonderlijke brief aan uw Kamer reageren op de opmerkingen van de Nationale Ombudsman.

An MP asks the state secretary about the sharing of client data between municipalities and the CIZ after cuts to AWBZ care packages left people without day care, and whether this data is needed for municipal Wmo policy. The minister confirms ongoing talks with VNG, describes agreed data sets based on written client consent, and says municipalities can respond without extra individual data, while promising a handbook and a review of municipal action.
Where cooperation has not yet been established, I call on the parties to get to work as soon as possible on finding creative solutions to absorb the consequences of the package measure.

Daar waar samenwerking nog niet tot stand is gekomen, roep ik partijen op zo snel mogelijk aan de slag te gaan met het zoeken naar creatieve oplossingen voor het opvangen van de gevolgen van de pakketmaatregel.

An MP asks the health minister how the Ondernemingskamer ruling that a care merger (WWZ-Mariënstaete-Valent) was not reasonably decided, due to insufficient financial insight, should inform care institutions and the design of the merger effect report and care-specific merger test. The minister acknowledges the ruling, declines to judge the specific case, and says it confirms the planned mandatory merger effect report.
With the merger effect report I want to achieve two things.
Met de fusie-effectrapportage wil ik twee dingen bereiken.

MP Arib asked the health minister about alleged pharmaceutical industry influence on the WHO's H1N1 pandemic declaration, the claim that H1N1 was mild, vaccine purchase guarantees, and a register of financial ties between industry and doctors. The minister rejected claims of WHO bias, said Dutch government had no such guarantee contracts, and said a register would be pursued through self-regulation for now, with the timetable still to be informed.
I am not in favour of such sales guarantees.
Ik ben geen voorstander van dergelijke verkoopgaranties.

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the health minister about adverse behavioural effects of antidepressants, rising prescription rates, GP warnings, pharmaceutical industry influence, post-marketing research and an independent medicines research fund. The minister answered that the Radar survey is not representative, that prescriptions have plateaued since 2005, that existing guidelines and leaflets cover side effects, and that a ZonMW signal on research gaps is being further examined with a decision expected in spring 2010.
I expect the further elaboration of the signal and the related decision-making in spring 2010.
Ik verwacht de verdieping van het signalement en de bijbehorende besluitvorming in het voorjaar van 2010.

An MP asks the health minister about care institutions pressuring the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) over how it applies Freedom of Information Act (Wob) requests, including whether this amounts to blackmail and what transparency measures are planned. The minister rejects the blackmail characterisation, explains institutions fear medical confidentiality breaches from disclosure of suicide-related reports, names four organisations, and says the inspectorate will publish more detailed final reports.
I do not share your characterisation of blackmail practices.
Ik deel uw kwalificatie van chantagepraktijken niet.

An MP asked the state secretary about people with intellectual disabilities who lose specialised care during hospital stays, asking about responsibility, bed-retention days and the risks to their residential security. The minister acknowledged hospitals must provide adequate care, said beds are freed when residents are admitted to hospital, and left coordination largely to the institutions and families without committing to a regulatory change.
At the interface you mention, cooperation between the hospital, the specific institution and the client's representatives is desirable.
Op het door u genoemde snijvlak is samenwerking tussen ziekenhuis en specifieke instelling en vertegenwoordigers van de cliënt wenselijk.

An MP asked the health minister about medical self-tests after a TV programme and Health Council findings that most tested products lacked scientific support, asking about consumer protection and a quality mark. The minister answered that EU rules already regulate self-tests via CE marking, that a national quality mark would be too voluntary and confusing, and that the Netherlands will push for revision of the EU directive.
As I already indicated in the Kaderbrief Screening, I am of the view that the solution for the quality of self-tests and in-vitro diagnostics in general must not be found at national level.

Zoals ik reeds in de Kaderbrief Screening heb aangegeven ben ik van mening dat de oplossing voor de kwaliteit van de zelftests en in-vitro diagnostica in het algemeen, niet op nationaal niveau moet worden gevonden.

An MP asked the health minister about press reports of disagreement between ministers over hospital care, the expected cost savings from performance-based pay, and whether more research should precede expanding market competition. The minister acknowledged the report, said the cabinet expects the measures to improve efficiency, rejected the claim of no clear vision on market forces, and referred to a letter for details.
The cabinet decided as a unit on the measures set out in the letter 'Appreciation for better care IV'.
Het kabinet heeft als eenheid besloten tot de maatregelen zoals neergelegd in de brief «Waardering voor betere zorg IV»

An MP asks the health minister whether the reported 20,000 addicted youths from gaming warrant structural monitoring, more treatment capacity, and inclusion of gaming addiction in prevention programmes. The minister answers that the problem is real but affects a small group, that existing treatment capacity is sufficient, that monitoring through existing surveys is adequate, and that gaming addiction is not yet part of national prevention programmes.
In view of this, I currently see no reason to take additional measures in the area of treatment.
Gelet hierop zie ik vooralsnog geen reden om extra maatregelen te treffen op het gebied van behandeling.

An MP asks the health minister about St. Lucas Andreas Hospital implanting ICDs without the required permit, whether the minister's planned abolition of the permit system was expected, and whether patients and the website should be corrected. The minister says the hospital stopped, applied for a permit, the permit requirement remains until conditions are met, and patients' GPs were informed and the website partly updated.
SLAZ therefore immediately stopped this procedure when the IGZ addressed it on this, and has since applied to me for a permit.
Het SLAZ is dan ook onmiddellijk gestopt met deze verrichting toen het hierop aangesproken werd door de IGZ en heeft inmiddels een vergunning bij mij aangevraagd.

An MP asks the health minister whether the CVZ chair's suggestion that people with unhealthy lifestyles may lose entitlement to insured care is acceptable, and how any lifestyle control could work. The minister rejects lifestyle as a criterion for care entitlement, while promoting prevention measures such as a smoking-cessation programme from 2011.
In the current healthcare system, the cause of illness, such as lifestyle, plays no role.
In het huidige zorgstelsel speelt de oorzaak van de ziekte, zoals bijvoorbeeld leefstijl, geen rol.

An MP asks the health minister whether he endorses warnings that outdated maintenance of medical equipment threatens hospital care and how he will meet the 50% reduction target for avoidable harm by 2012 and progress on certification of maintenance services. The minister acknowledges the issue, says the field must take the initiative while he facilitates, and lists concrete steps: a November/December 2009 conference, a follow-up in April 2010, exploring legal certification requirements, a new performance indicator, and an expert group on the top five risky technologies.
I have already organised an invitational conference on maintenance together with the IGZ on 3 December 2009.
Ik heb inmiddels op 3 december 2009 in samenwerking met de IGZ een invitational conference georganiseerd over het onderwerp onderhoud

An MP asks the health and agriculture ministers about the rise of livestock-linked MRSA, including infection rates on farms, household spread, screening, antibiotic use, costs and possible stricter regulation. The government answers that MRSA is indeed increasing due to antibiotic use in livestock, that detailed research is ongoing, and that it sees no reason for mandatory screening, cost recovery from farmers or stringent state intervention, relying on the existing convenant.

I do not share your view. Livestock-associated MRSA can spread through irresponsible behaviour by a few, but I am convinced that the majority of the livestock sector is very aware of the need to change course.

Ik deel uw mening niet. Dierhouderij gerelateerde MRSA kan zich weliswaar uitbreiden door onverantwoord gedrag van enkelen, maar ik ben er van overtuigd dat de meerderheid van de dierhouderij zich zeer bewust is van de noodzaak de bakens te verzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken waarschuwde voor humanitaire gevolgen stop steun UNRWA’

An MP asked whether the government was warned in a February memo that suspending UNRWA funding would cause regional destabilisation and human suffering, and how the January suspension decision was reached. The minister answers that the memo concerned risks of prolonged or suspended committed support, that funding was paused to signal seriousness about allegations, and that the decision lies with the minister for foreign trade and development, without detailing internal disagreement.
The decision on financing to UNRWA falls within the responsibility of the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Assistance.
Het besluit over financiering aan UNRWA ligt binnen de verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingshulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat er een nieuwe rechtszaak komt over het exportverbod voor F-35 onderdelen naar Israël

MP Dobbe asked the government about reports of a new lawsuit over the export ban on F-35 parts to Israel, and whether parts could still reach Israel via transit countries. The minister answered that it is not considered likely that parts made in the Netherlands reach Israeli F-35s, relying on confidential data, and that the court ruling is being implemented via amended licences while the government keeps the F-35 programme going.
The cabinet bases this conclusion on confidential data.
Het kabinet baseert deze conclusie op vertrouwelijke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de gevolgen van de apparaattaakstelling voor het postennet

An MP asked whether the 22 percent cut to the ministry's operating budget would close 34 diplomatic posts and weaken Dutch security, prosperity and international position. The minister replied that the effects are still unclear, that the government aims to keep an adequate network, that 34 closures will not happen, and that choices will follow later.
It is still unclear what the effects of this cut are
Het is nog onduidelijk wat de effecten zijn van deze taakstelling
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat Unilever nog steeds tientallen miljoenen verdient aan Rusland

An SP MP asked whether Unilever's continued earnings in Russia, reported in the media, breach sanctions and whether the government would investigate sanctions compliance. The minister declined to judge individual cases, said enforcement is for prosecutors and courts, and rejected a separate compliance investigation while pointing to a forthcoming debate and letter.
It is established practice that no statements are made about individual cases.
Het is staande praktijk dat er geen uitspraken worden gedaan over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Teunissen over de exportkredietverzekering voor het LNG-project in Mozambique

MPs Hirsch and Teunissen asked the government about the export credit insurance for the TotalEnergies LNG project in Mozambique, including the 2021 Palma attacks, independent investigations, security conditions, civil society input and the transparency of the review by Atradius DSB. The Secretary of State answered that the review is ongoing, that the Palma events are part of it, that no claims have been made under the policies, and that the government will keep the usual decision procedure without parliamentary discussion beforehand, while promising to inform parliament once the decision is final.

The cabinet attaches great value to transparent implementation of the export credit insurance, but at the same time takes into account commercial confidentiality and competition considerations and an international level playing field for a well-functioning system.

Het kabinet hecht veel waarde aan een transparante uitvoering van de ekv en er wordt tegelijkertijd voor een goed functioneren van de ekv rekening gehouden met bedrijfsvertrouwelijke- en concurrentieoverwegingen en een internationaal gelijkspeelveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Dobbe over ontwikkelingen in Jemen

MPs Ceder and Dobbe asked the government about humanitarian needs in Yemen, stalled peace talks, follow-up on a motion to pursue war crimes investigations, and the abolition of the national arms export presumption of denial for Saudi Arabia and the UAE. The ministers answered that Nederland remains a substantial humanitarian donor with no additional funding planned, supports the UN envoy and multilateral efforts, could not secure support in the Human Rights Council for a war crimes investigation, and maintains strict arms export review under EU rules.
The Netherlands will continue to support the mandate of the UN envoy and to consistently draw attention to this forgotten conflict in multilateral settings.
Nederland blijft het mandaat van de VN gezant ondersteunen en in multilateraal verband voortdurend aandacht vragen voor dit vergeten conflict.
Antwoord op de leden Bamenga, Hirsch, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Ceder over het bericht ‘Nederlands bedrijf negeert ernstige schendingen in Saudi-Arabië’

Five MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about an Amnesty International briefing alleging that a Dutch company, with government support, contributed to human rights violations in Saudi Arabia linked to The Line project, and about IMVO due diligence, trade missions, the CSDDD and Amnesty's recommendations. The minister answered that the government takes such findings seriously, that due diligence is the companies' own responsibility, that the trade mission self-scans raised no reason for further inquiry, and that conditions for government support would be reinforced in practice without tightening the framework.
The cabinet takes the findings of civil society organisations, including Amnesty International, seriously.
Het kabinet neemt bevindingen van maatschappelijke organisatie waaronder Amnesty International serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Becker over het bericht ‘In Gambia dreigt genitale verminking weer legaal te worden’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the government would act against a Gambian bill that would legalise female genital mutilation, including aid, diplomatic contacts and prevention in the Netherlands. The government answered that it opposes FGM, has raised the issue with the Gambian government and works through EU projects and campaigns, but has no direct Dutch programmes on FGM in Gambia.
Our ambassador in Dakar has repeatedly discussed the Dutch position on the bill to legalise female genital mutilation with representatives of the Gambian government.

Onze ambassadeur in Dakar heeft de Nederlandse positie met betrekking tot het wetsvoorstel betreffende legalisering van vrouwelijke genitale verminking meermaals met vertegenwoordigers van de Gambiaanse regering besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over de situatie in Soedan

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the humanitarian crisis in Sudan, regional arms supplies, access for local aid groups and Emergency Response Rooms, EU and Jeddah-process diplomacy, civil society involvement in peace talks, and support for accountability and monitoring mechanisms. The Minister answered that Nederland is engaging regional partners and the EU, funds local organisations through the Sudan Humanitarian Fund and the Dutch Relief Alliance, supports civil society in peace processes, and backs accountability efforts including the Fact Finding Mission, while noting UN funding constraints.
The Netherlands will work to extend the mandate of the Fact Finding Mission on Sudan at the September session of the Human Rights Council this year.
Nederland zal zich inzetten voor verlenging van het mandaat van de Fact Finding Mission on Sudan tijdens de septemberzitting van de Mensenrechtenraad dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Bamenga over de humanitaire crisis in Oost-Congo

Two MPs (Boswijk, CDA, and Bamenga, D66) asked the minister about the humanitarian crisis in eastern DRC, including the Rwandan role, aid, protection in displacement camps, diplomacy, and the EU Great Lakes envoy. The minister answered that the situation is very serious, outlined Dutch humanitarian funding, diplomatic efforts with Rwanda, DRC and the AU, and said the EU envoy appointment is near completion so no agenda item is needed at the Foreign Affairs Council.
In view of these developments, I do not consider it necessary for the Netherlands to put this on the agenda of the next Foreign Affairs Council.
Gezien de voorgenoemde ontwikkelingen acht ik het niet nodig dat Nederland dit tijdens de eerstvolgende Raad Buitenlandse Zaken agendeert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Paternotte over het bericht 'Etnische zuiveringen in Darfur en mogelijk zelfs genocide, stelt Human Rights Watch'

MPs Bamenga and Paternotte asked the government about Human Rights Watch's findings of possible ethnic cleansing and genocide in West Darfur, including sanctions, ICC cooperation, fact-finding access, humanitarian access and resettlement. The minister responded that the government is very concerned, is working with the EU on expanded sanctions, supports the ICC and the FFM, and explains the current asylum moratorium that blocks resettlement of Sudanese refugees.
The cabinet is very concerned about the situation in Darfur.
Het kabinet is zeer bezorgd over de situatie in Darfur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hirsch over hoe Nederlandse klimaatfinanciering ten goede komt aan vrouwen en gemarginaliseerde groepen

An MP asked the minister how Dutch climate finance through the Dutch Fund for Climate and Development (DFCD) benefits women and marginalised groups, citing an ActionAid report and evaluations. The minister acknowledged that more attention to marginalised groups and gender is needed in DFCD implementation, noted the fund's primary aim of climate-resilient growth, and described measures and other programmes reaching these groups, while leaving the design of a successor fund to a new minister.
The cabinet appreciates it when third parties such as ActionAid carry out research.
Het kabinet waardeert het als derden zoals ActionAid onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ram over het vervangen en vervolgen van UNRWA

An MP (PVV) asked whether UNRWA staff in Gaza were linked to Hamas, whether UNRWA should lose all Dutch support, whether it can be sued or banned, and whether COGAT and WFP could take over its work. The minister acknowledged the reports, declined to cut support or pursue legal action citing UN immunity, and argued there is no alternative to UNRWA in Gaza at this stage.
Only the UN can lift this immunity or suspend operations.
Alleen de VN kan deze immuniteit opheffen of werkzaamheden opschorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de deelname van Abou Rashed aan een Nederlandse Handelsmissie in Qatar in 2020

An MP asked how Hamas-linked Abou Rashed was able to attend a Dutch trade mission to Qatar in 2020, who invited him, what the ministry knew of his ties, and what will prevent recurrence. The ministers answer that he attended some programme parts as a listener invited by a participant, that the government did not invite him, that the ministry had no advisory role for him, that individual vetting of such contacts is impractical, and that they will tighten registration conditions.
Vetting business contacts and attendees at the individual level is practically not feasible, partly because of the large numbers.
Een toetsing van zakelijke contacten en toehoorders op individueel niveau is praktisch niet uitvoerbaar, mede vanwege de grote aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Thijssen en Van der Lee over de Rabobank en de ontbossers

MPs asked the government about Rabobank financing deforestation actors, whether financial services should be regulated like deforestation-free products, and whether Dutch and EU policy on livestock reduction and financing is consistent with the Paris goals. The ministers answered that banks are responsible for due diligence under OECD guidelines, that the Commission will assess regulating financial institutions by mid-2025, and that the Finance Minister will report on financial-sector measures by year end.
The cabinet expects financial institutions to act in line with international standards for responsible business conduct.
Het kabinet verwacht van financiële instellingen dat zij handelen conform de internationale standaarden voor internationaal verantwoord ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dijk over de doorlevering van F-35-onderdelen naar Israël

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Israel used F-35s with 2,000-lb bombs in Gaza, whether F-35 parts flow via the European Regional Warehouse in Woensdrecht without case-by-case export review under general licence NL009, and why that licence was not suspended for Israel. The government said it lacks verified information on bomb types and Israeli F-35 use, maintains its decision not to intervene in the licence after an integrated foreign-policy and security assessment, and that the investigation into intervening in NL009 is not yet complete.
The government does not have verified information about the specific bombs Israel uses in its F-35 operations.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over geverifieerde informatie over de specifieke bommen die Israël gebruikt bij zijn F-35-inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over omstreden activiteiten van FMO in Nicaragua

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the minister about FMO's controversial investments in Nicaragua, including whether they rose to a record amount, how they compare with other donors, how the government supervises them, and whether FMO should show restraint given Nicaragua's human rights record and its severance of diplomatic relations. The minister denied the claimed increase (portfolio fell from EUR 171m to 161m), said oversight runs through agreed frameworks and dialogue with FMO without a formal tightening, and defended continued investment while noting room for improvement.
The cabinet remains in dialogue with FMO on these improvements, offers support where possible and calls FMO to account when it believes FMO is making insufficient progress.
Het kabinet blijft in gesprek met FMO over deze verbeteringen, biedt waar mogelijk ondersteuning en spreekt FMO aan wanneer het van mening is dat FMO onvoldoende voortgang boekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de levering van JSF-onderdelen aan Israël

MPs Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the government would stop F-35 parts flowing through the European Regional Warehouse to Israel despite warnings of humanitarian law violations. The ministers answered that the government decided not to intervene in the general licence NL009, citing an integrated security assessment, that the F-35 deters regional threats, and alliance reliability, while no export licence test applies to these US-owned parts.
It was decided not to intervene in the operation of the General Licence NL009 regulation.
Er is besloten niet in te grijpen in de werking van de Regeling Algemene vergunning NL009.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de levering van F-35 onderdelen

An MP asks why the government did not block Dutch-routed deliveries of F-35 parts to Israel despite advice warning of possible humanitarian law violations, and asks for the advice, prior refusals and civilian casualty figures. The ministers answer that they chose not to intervene in the general licence NL009 on integrated foreign-policy and security grounds, provide the two internal memos and legal annexes, and decline to share diplomatic implications.

To meet your request as transparently as possible, we provide you with the full memos containing the legal elements as well as the other elements that contributed to the broad assessment underlying the decision taken.

Om zo transparant mogelijk aan uw verzoek tegemoet te komen geven we u de volledige nota's waarin u de juridische elementen aantreft evenals de andere elementen die hebben bijgedragen aan de brede afweging die ten grondslag ligt aan het genomen besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de NCP-analyse van de voorstellen voor de CSDDD en de Nederlandse inzet in de EU

Volt MP Koekkoek asks the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the NCP's analysis that the EU CSDDD deviates from the OECD Guidelines, and what the Dutch government is doing about it. The minister says the CSDDD remains largely based on the OECD Guidelines, that some points still need work in the trilogues, and that the government has shared the analysis with negotiators and will assess impacts.
The cabinet welcomes the NCP analysis, but does not share the NCP's concern about a "serious risk of damage" and "dilution of the OECD Guidelines".
Het kabinet verwelkomt de analyse van het NCP, maar deelt de zorg over «een ernstig afbreukrisico» en «verwatering van de OESO-richtlijnen» van het NCP niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Thijssen en Van der Lee over de aardbevingen in Afghanistan

MPs asked about the humanitarian needs after the October 2023 Herat earthquakes in Afghanistan, and whether Dutch aid could be provided without supporting the Taliban. The minister listed needs and aid channels (Dutch Relief Alliance, CERF, OCHA fund, EU funding) and stated that aid runs under strict conditions barring direct Taliban involvement.
They work in line with humanitarian principles, without interference from the de facto authorities or direct support to the Taliban regime.
Zij werken conform de humanitaire principes, zonder inmenging van de de facto autoriteiten of directe steun aan het Taliban-regime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Podt, Thijssen en Ceder over het onderzoek Oxfam “From Development to Deterrence”

MPs Koekkoek, Podt, Thijssen and Ceder asked whether EU development aid (ODA) under NDICI is being used for migration deterrence, citing an Oxfam report on Libyan and Tunisian coast guard funding and weak EU transparency. The minister says the Commission must check ODA eligibility and that the Netherlands will press for better reporting and human rights risk analysis, but gives no firm new commitments and says there is no misuse so far.

In the context of the mid-term evaluation of NDICI, the Netherlands has asked the Commission for insight into the calculation of migration-related expenditure and access to the markers used to attribute spending to NDICI's migration objective.

In het kader van de mid-term evaluatie van NDICI heeft Nederland de Commissie gevraagd om inzicht in berekening van migratie gerelateerde uitgaven en inzage in de markers die worden gebruikt om uitgaven aan de migratiedoelstelling van NDICI toe te rekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Hammelburg en Van der Lee  over het bericht dat het moederbedrijf van Douwe Egberts en Pickwick, JDE Peet's, weigert om zich terug te trekken uit Rusland

MPs Boswijk, Hammelburg and Van der Lee asked whether JDE Peet's, parent of Douwe Egberts and Pickwick, should exit Russia, whether government contracts with such firms are acceptable, and whether the Russia sanctions package should ban non-essential goods. The minister answered that firms may trade in Russia if they comply with EU sanctions, that existing government contracts will not be ended while compliance holds, that a list of firms with government contracts will be sent confidentially, and that the luxury goods list may be broadened without disclosing future measures.
This overview will be sent to the House for confidential inspection.
Dit overzicht wordt ter vertrouwelijke inzage aan de Kamer nagezonden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de berichten 'China-led AIIB’s communications chief quits, criticises bank’s management' en 'Canada freezes ties with China-led AIIB, probes allegations of Communist domina

A GroenLinks MP asked the Finance and Foreign Trade ministers about reports that the AIIB's communications chief resigned alleging Chinese Communist Party domination, and that Canada froze ties and launched a probe. The government replied that an internal review found no evidence of covert CCP influence, identified governance and HR improvements to pursue as a shareholder, and defended delegated decision-making at the bank as common among multilateral development banks.
The Netherlands will work to ensure proper follow-up on these recommendations.
Nederland zal zich inzetten voor een gedegen opvolging van deze aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over wijzigingen in het wapenexportbeleid

An SP MP asked the minister about a NRC op-ed on weak legal accountability of European arms makers, illegal arms flows, end-user certificates, the planned accession to the Franco-German-Spanish defence export control treaty, and scrapping the presumption of denial. The minister answered that the government shares concerns about illegal arms trade, points to existing export criteria, transparency tools and civil court access, but intends to join the treaty and proceed with the accession process.
The cabinet intends to accede to the treaty on export control in the defence domain.
Het kabinet is voornemens toe te treden tot het verdrag inzake exportcontrole in het defensiedomein
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over dubieuze investeringen in wapenbedrijven

An SP MP asked the minister whether pension funds and insurers investing in arms companies that supply high-risk countries conflicts with due diligence norms, and whether the minister would urge them to withdraw. The minister acknowledged the report, stated that the Netherlands applies strict export control, that financial institutions should apply OECD and UNGP due diligence, but declined to re-engage the funds or insurers, saying investment decisions are their own responsibility.
I therefore see no reason to now re-engage with these financial institutions about their investments in arms companies.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om nu opnieuw met deze financiële instellingen in gesprek te gaan over hun beleggingen in wapenbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat illegaal teakhout uit Myanmar gebruikt is bij de renovatie van de Groene Draeck

An MP asked whether illegal Myanmar teak was used in the publicly co-funded renovation of the royal yacht Groene Draeck, whether its origin can be verified, and whether an independent investigation will be held. The Prime Minister replied that the renovation is a matter for the Royal Household, that the wood was bought from a German supplier within the EU with a due diligence declaration, that its origin cannot be traced because records were discarded, and that no independent investigation is warranted.
The public interest is not at stake, and I therefore see no reason for an investigation.
Het openbaar belang is niet aan de orde, en ik zie derhalve geen aanleiding voor onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de aanstaande verkiezing van een nieuw onafhankelijk VN-expert op het gebied van seksuele oriëntatie en genderidentiteit

An MP asked the government whether it would back a successor to the UN independent expert on sexual orientation and gender identity, and what criteria should apply to the selection. The minister agreed the mandate is important, described the transparent selection process run by OHCHR and the Human Rights Council, and noted the three shortlisted candidates and the proposed appointment of Graeme Reid, without committing to specific Dutch support beyond the existing mandate.
The process for appointing Victor Madrigal-Borloz's successor is organised independently and transparently.
Het proces rondom de benoeming van de opvolger van Victor Madrigal-Borloz is onafhankelijk en transparant georganiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Christine Teunissen over de Nederlandse bilaterale investeringsakkoorden

MP Teunissen asked the minister, citing a SOMO/TNI/Both ENDS report, whether the Netherlands will end or renegotiate its roughly 75 bilateral investment treaties, particularly given risks to public-interest regulation and the energy transition, and about withdrawal from the Energy Charter Treaty. The minister rejects terminating the treaties, describes a renegotiation track (Ghana, Nigeria) based on the 2019 model text, and states the ECT withdrawal is pending with expected end in late 2024 while denying that treaties hinder climate policy.
The cabinet is committed to reforming the investment protection system.
Het kabinet zet in op hervorming van het investeringsbeschermingssysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het mogelijk stopzetten van voedselhulp door het World Food Programme in de Palestijnse gebieden

An SP MP asked the minister whether WFP food aid in the Palestinian territories risks suspension due to a funding shortfall, and what the Netherlands will do to prevent it. The minister confirmed the suspension of aid to 205,000 beneficiaries, pointed to nearly doubling Dutch unearmarked WFP funding to 60 million euros and an additional 19 million to UNRWA, and said Dutch influence is limited as one of many donors.
Yes, it is correct that WFP is forced to suspend part of its food aid due to a lack of funding.
Ja, het klopt dat WFP noodgedwongen een deel van hun voedselhulp moet stopzetten vanwege een gebrek aan financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het definitief invoeren van de anti-LHBTIQ+ wet in Oeganda

An MP asked whether the government would impose targeted sanctions and visa bans on Ugandan politicians responsible for the anti-LGBTIQ+ law, halt trade-promotion instruments with Uganda, and ensure do-no-harm and backlash risks are weighed, plus the status of Equal Rights Coalition action. The minister answered that national sanctions are not possible without an EU or UN basis and the matter is under discussion in Brussels, that trade instruments will not be stopped, that backlash risks are weighed, and that the coalition sent a letter and joint statement.
The Netherlands cannot impose national sanctions in this matter.
Nederland kan geen nationale sancties instellen in dezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over ‘Meer haat tegen lhbti'ers in sommige Afrikaanse landen, hoe komt dat?’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about rising hostility toward LGBTI people in some African countries, including Ghana's proposed anti-LGBTI bill, and asked about aid, diplomatic pressure and whether aid should be used as leverage. The minister answered that the Ghana bill conflicts with Dutch values, that the Netherlands has raised concerns through diplomatic channels and multilateral fora, and that aid suspension must be weighed carefully against side effects, with support for LGBTI organisations to continue.
The Netherlands has no programmes relating to law enforcement in Ghana.
Nederland heeft geen programma’s die betrekking hebben op de rechtshandhaving in Ghana.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Klink over het bericht 'Eindhovense toeleverancier van Philips en ASML opent vestiging in China'

Two VVD MPs asked whether a Dutch chip-supplier opening a plant in China could evade US restrictions, whether export controls, EU Chips Act goals, IP protection and screening of outward investment were adequate, and what sanctions were possible. The government answered that production abroad is not bound by Dutch law, that dual-use exports remain licensable, that outward-investment screening is awaiting an EU Commission analysis, and that no concrete measures against the firm were planned.
The cabinet has taken note of the European Commission's intention to examine the risks that may arise from outbound investments.
Het kabinet heeft kennisgenomen van het voornemen van de Europese Commissie om de risico’s die mogelijk voortkomen uit uitgaande investeringen te gaan onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over berichten ‘VN-top over steun voor Hoorn van Afrika levert veel minder op dan gehoopt’ en ‘Italy looks to ‘strategic’ Horn of Africa for continental stability’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports on weak UN pledges for the Horn of Africa and Italy's strategic interest there, asking about Dutch humanitarian aid, aid priorities, cooperation with Italy and Dutch agri-business. The minister answered in detail on aid amounts, priorities, EU coordination and migration policy, committing to continued EU-level engagement but not to a specific bilateral talk with Italy.
The Netherlands therefore actively pursues a joint approach through the EU (and together with some member states), the World Bank and IFAD on various themes including food security.

Nederland zet daarom actief in op een gezamenlijke aanpak via de EU (en samen met sommige lidstaten), de Wereldbank en het International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) op verschillende thema’s waaronder voedselzekerheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Hagen en Van der Graaf over het mislukken van het textielconvenant

MPs asked whether the government should reconsider its role as a party to voluntary sector agreements on responsible supply chains after the textile agreement collapsed, and what the failure means for garment workers and for the need for IMVO legislation. The minister answered that sectoral cooperation remains important, that the government's role will be evaluated in September 2023 with stakeholder consultation, and that the government is pursuing EU and national due-diligence legislation while keeping its existing policy mix.
In doing so I will of course evaluate the role of the government, also in relation to the future entry into force of legislation.
Daarbij zal ik uiteraard de rol van de overheid evalueren, ook in relatie tot inwerking treden van wetgeving in de toekomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het terugtrekken door Nederlandse ontwikkelingsbank FMO van Plantations et Huileries du Congo (PHC)

Opposition MP Futselaar asks the minister about FMO's exit from the PHC palm-oil project in the DR Congo, alleged human rights abuses, the functioning of the Independent Complaints Mechanism (ICM), and the sale of loans to a Mauritius-based fund. The minister answers that the loans were sold to a Kuramo subsidiary so FMO no longer has a legal relationship or enforceable influence, that the ICM offers protections and mediation, and that a joint demarche is possible but unlikely to be prioritised by Congolese authorities.
At the same time, by selling the loans the development banks no longer have a legal basis to enforce the environmental and social action plan.
Tegelijkertijd hebben de ontwikkelingsbanken door de verkoop van de leningen geen juridische basis meer om het milieu en sociaalactieplan af te dwingen.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over de petitie van Yezidi-vrouwen

MPs Van der Werf, Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg (D66) asked the Justice, Foreign Affairs and Development ministers about justice and support for the Yezidi community, including aid in camps, missing Yezidis, evidence gathering with UNITAD, a Joint Investigation Team and the petition by Yezidi women. The government answered that it funds psychosocial aid, the Yezidi Survivors Law implementation and UNITAD, that it cannot verify figures or conditions in Al Hol, and that cooperation agreements and expertise contributions are still being explored.
It is not possible for the cabinet to determine how many Yezidis are staying in the Al Hol camp.
Het is voor het kabinet niet mogelijk om vast te stellen hoeveel Yezidi’s verblijven in kamp Al Hol.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Van der Lee over het bericht 'OESO tikt Just Eat Takeaway op de vingers om tegenwerking vakbondsvorming'

MPs Thijssen and Van der Lee asked the minister whether the government will hold Just Eat Takeaway to account after the OECD National Contact Point found it violated trade union rights and the OECD Guidelines, and what consequences apply when a firm rejects such a ruling. The minister answered that the Guidelines are voluntary but the government attaches consequences to non-compliance, such as withholding trade support, procurement exclusion options and talks with the company, and noted the NCP ruling supports Israeli couriers without a direct Dutch role.
Compliance is not legally enforceable. The NCP is a non-judicial complaints mechanism.
Naleving is niet juridisch afdwingbaar. Het NCP is een niet-juridisch klachtenmechanisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het opstappen van Speciaal Oekraïne-gezant

An MP asked the minister why a former ambassador appointed as Special Envoy for Ukraine, who had made pro-Russian and derogatory remarks about Ukraine before the appointment, was chosen, whether screening was skipped, and how recurrence would be prevented. The minister answered that the remarks predated the role and reflected no government view, that the envoy was selected for regional and business expertise with a clean record, that a security screening was not standard for this function, and that candidates will be asked about sensitivities in future.
For functions identified as positions of trust, a security screening is moreover a standard part of the procedure.
Bij functies die als vertrouwensfuncties worden geïdentificeerd is een veiligheidsscreening bovendien standaard onderdeel van de procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het begrip huwelijkse gevangenschap

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about forced marriage detention (huwelijkse gevangenschap), its relation to SDG and CEDAW commitments, consular support, and international action. The Minister answered that the government opposes it, supports women's rights organisations through the SDG5 Fund, provides limited consular assistance, and raises the issue in EU and UN forums.
Antwoord op vragen va de leden Jasper van Dijk en Teunissen over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie parlementen buitenspel wil zetten inzake het Mercosur verdrag

MPs Van Dijk and Teunissen asked whether the European Commission plans to split the EU-Mercosur agreement to bypass national parliaments and whether the government will insist national parliaments have the final say on full trade agreements. The minister rejects the premise: under the Lisbon Treaty the Council must approve signature and conclusion, usually with European Parliament consent, and the Commission has not yet decided the form of the agreement, with no decision expected before 2024; the government will take a position only once the full documents are submitted and will push in the EU for an integral association agreement.

As with any treaty, the cabinet will only determine a position on a possible agreement between the European Union and the Mercosur countries once all necessary documents are submitted by the Commission to the Council for decision-making.

Zoals bij ieder verdrag, zal het kabinet pas een positie bepalen ten aanzien van een mogelijk akkoord tussen de Europese Unie en de Mercosurlanden op het moment dat alle daartoe noodzakelijke stukken door de Commissie ter besluitvorming aan de Raad worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Van Raan over Nederlandse investeringen in een oliepijplijn in Oeganda met grote risico’s voor mens, dier en natuur

MPs Akerboom and Van Raan asked the government about Dutch investment in the EACOP oil pipeline in Uganda, covering land displacement, arrests of protesters, CO2 emissions, and Dutch financial institutions' investments in TotalEnergies. The minister answered that the government does not assess the project itself, relies on companies and financial institutions to apply due diligence, and defers to Uganda's sovereignty, while promising to raise human rights concerns and pursue EU and national IMVO legislation.
The cabinet does not make its own assessment of the consequences of this project.
Het kabinet maakt geen eigen appreciatie van de gevolgen van dit project
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over berichten over export van goedkoop vlees en melkpoeder naar Ghana en Kenia

An MP asked the trade and development minister, with agriculture, whether Dutch exports of cheap meat and milk powder to Ghana and Kenya undermine local food security and whether trade policy conflicts with development goals. The minister denied an active export-promotion policy, said trade is compatible with local food systems, and argued the EPA would not affect tariffs on dairy.
The cabinet has no policy intention to actively stimulate the export of meat and milk powder to developing countries in the coming years.
Het kabinet heeft geen beleidsvoornemen om de export van vlees en melkpoeder naar ontwikkelingslanden de komende jaren actief te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bericht dat de Oegandese regering het mensenrechtenkantoor van de Verenigde Naties niet zal verlengen

An MP asked the government about Uganda's decision not to renew the UN human rights office mandate, UN torture-committee criticism of torture and unauthorised detention ('safe houses'), and the implications. The minister answered that the government regrets the non-renewal, condemns the practices, will raise them bilaterally and in EU settings, and will monitor the situation.
The Netherlands will raise these practices with the Ugandan authorities bilaterally, either alone or within the EU.
Nederland zal de Oegandese autoriteiten over deze praktijken bilateraal, al dan niet in EU verband, aanspreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de aangenomen anti-LHBTI-wet in Oeganda

MP Hammelburg asked ministers how the Netherlands would respond to Uganda's anti-LGBTI law adding the death penalty, including pressure on the president, sanctions, aid to civil society and joint action. The ministers answered that they have voiced strong concern, are working with the Equal Rights Coalition and partners, are reviewing some aid such as the JLOS programme, and would not publicly disclose specific measures.

Given that the situation is still developing, it is not in the interest of the matter to make public statements about which specific measures are under consideration if the legislation is definitively adopted.

Mede gezien de situatie nog in ontwikkeling is, is het niet in het belang van de zaak om publieke mededelingen te doen over welke maatregelen concreet in beeld zijn als de wetgeving definitief wordt aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bericht ‘Oeganda scherpt anti-homowetten nog verder aan, jezelf LHBTI+ noemen al strafbaar’

An MP asked the ministers whether the government knows of Uganda's new anti-LGBTI law, what it will do to protect LGBTI rights there, and whether aid to Uganda should be halted. The ministers condemned the law, described diplomatic démarches through the embassy, EU and Equal Rights Coalition, and said aid cannot be fully stopped though the law's consequences for rule-of-law support are being considered.
Dutch support for law enforcement programmes in Uganda will also be reconsidered.
Ook zal de Nederlandse steun aan rechtshandhavingsprogramma's in Oeganda worden heroverwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Van der Graaf, Van der Lee, Klink, Jasper van Dijk en Thijssen over de situatie in Turkije en Syrië na de aardbevingen van 5/6 februari jl.

Members of parliament asked about access for international aid to Syria after the February 2023 earthquakes, the role of civil society in opposition areas, EU reconstruction funding, psychosocial and care needs, and aid worker safety. The minister answered that aid access to northwest Syria remains dependent on Turkey-based UN deliveries, that the EU is coordinating mid- to long-term support through existing channels, and that psychosocial support is integrated into programmes.

As promised during the committee debate on humanitarian aid after the earthquake in Turkey and Syria of 22 February, I asked the European Commission on behalf of the cabinet, ahead of the EU donor conference, to prepare a proposal for medium- and long-term aid and to coordinate its implementation.

Zoals toegezegd tijdens het commissiedebat Humanitaire Hulp na de aardbeving in Turkije en Syrië van 22 februari jl. heb ik voorafgaand aan de EU-donorconferentie namens het kabinet de Europese Commissie verzocht een voorstel te maken voor het leveren van middellange- en lange-termijnhulp en de implementatie hiervan te coördineren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat een ex-werknemer van ASML bedrijfsinformatie verduisterde

An MP asked the minister whether a former ASML employee who allegedly stole company data was dismissed, what protocols prevent such theft, what information was taken, and whether this affects chip export agreements with China. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, saying companies are primarily responsible for their own information security, and said the incident does not affect chip exports to China while referring to earlier export-control letters.
The cabinet does not comment on individual cases.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraak over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bericht ‘Ik wil dat Wim wordt uitgeleverd aan Nederland. Zedenzaken tegen reformatorische hulpverlener stagneren’

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about stalled sexual-abuse cases against a Reformed aid worker abroad, and about orphanage tourism. The minister said the government cannot prevent such crimes abroad, outlined steps taken since 2022 (screening via VOG, travel advice, awareness campaigns, a working group) but declined to reopen the 2020 Ecorys recommendations or rule out orphanage-tourism measures.
There is no reason for new research.
Er is geen aanleiding voor nieuw onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over abortus als “mensenrecht”

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign and Development Ministers whether abortion is being treated as a human right, whether the right to life of unborn children is protected, and how partner organisations delivering abortion services are monitored for coercion. The ministers answered that international law does not settle whether human rights apply to the unborn, that Dutch policy supports safe abortion as part of SRGR, and that partners monitor care quality against WHO guidelines.
Your questions have been answered with all due care, attention and transparency.
Uw vragen zijn met alle zorgvuldigheid, aandacht en transparantie beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de levering van chipmachines aan China

MP Eppink asked why the minister's 8 March letter did not name China specifically, how transshipment of Dutch chip machines to China would be prevented, and why export licences are assessed case by case, among other questions. The minister answered that Dutch export control is country-neutral, relies on case-by-case assessment against the strategic framework, notes practical barriers to relocating advanced machines, and says the new measure will be shared with EU partners without setting an end date.
Dutch export control policy is country-neutral.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boutkan over de samenwerking tussen Japan en Zuid-Korea als reactie op de Amerikaanse CHIPS-Act

An MP asked the minister about a Business Korea report quoting Rapidus official Yasumitsu Orii on US chip regulation and Korea-Japan cooperation, and how Japan's export controls on chip technology to China relate to Dutch measures. The minister declined to comment on the Korean article, refused to detail confidential talks with partners, said Japan makes its own export-control decisions, and rejected withdrawing Dutch export measures.
As also reported in the answer of 8 November 2022 to VOLT's parliamentary questions, I cannot go into details about discussions on this subject with partner countries.
Zoals ook gemeld in het antwoord van 8 november 2022 op Kamervragen van VOLT, kan ik niet in details treden over gesprekken over dit onderwerp met partnerlanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over de Nederlandse steun voor het project van Boskalis in Manila

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked the government about Dutch support (export credit insurance) for Boskalis's New Manila International Airport project, including alleged rights and environmental harms, information-sharing, compensation of fishers and the Global Witness allegations. The government answered that ADSB and Boskalis meet OECD/UN standards, that compensation is being carried out under monitoring by independent consultants, and that it sees no need for additional measures or an independent investigation, while commissioning a monitoring review by Steward Redqueen.
This picture is confirmed by ADSB, which had an independent consultant investigate this aspect.
Dit beeld wordt bevestigd door ADSB die een onafhankelijke consultant onderzoek heeft laten doen naar dit aspect.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over Nederland betaalde verdachte stichting in corruptieschandaal Europees Parlement

An MP asked the minister whether the Dutch government funded No Peace Without Justice, a foundation suspected in the European Parliament corruption scandal, and about the grants, conditions, evaluation and termination of that funding. The minister answered that the ministry gave small grants in 2013, 2018 and 2022 (including EUR 500,000 for Afghanistan activities with conditions and reporting), no evaluation was done after 2022 media reports, and funding was not renewed pending the Belgian investigation.
The ministry will closely follow developments surrounding this dossier.
Het ministerie zal de ontwikkelingen rondom dit dossier nauwgezet blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over wapens uit Estland die via een Nederlands bedrijf aan Oekraïne zouden zijn geleverd

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Defence whether a Dutch firm, ARLE, supplied anti-tank missiles from Estonia to Ukraine via a Czech company, whether the deal was registered with Dutch authorities, what profits were made, whether customs were aware or investigating, and how such arms trading will be prevented. The government declined to comment on individual cases, said high profit margins are plausible given demand, saw no reason to change export control policy, and noted that licences are required and breaches are punishable.
The cabinet does not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het bericht dat geld voor ontwikkelingshulp in belastingparadijzen belandt

MPs Alkaya and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch development aid routed through PIDG, its Mauritius-based trust and the Guernsey-managed EAIF fund, could end up in tax havens, and how that fits Dutch anti-avoidance policy. Minister Schreinemacher answered that PIDG's trust is fiscally resident in the UK, that the fund manager was selected in 2016 under older tax rules, that PIDG now applies EDFI responsible tax principles, and that the ministry will explore a tax guideline and discuss a structure analysis with donors.
I am examining the possibilities for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Finance to draw up a guideline for this.
Ik ben aan het bezien wat de mogelijkheden zijn om vanuit het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en het Ministerie van Financiën een richtlijn hiervoor op te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de staatsrechtelijke opstelling kabinet nieuwe wetgeving

MP Van der Plas asked whether the cabinet was blocking the IMVO initiative bill and whether ministers would implement a law passed by parliament, and questioned the constitutional relationship. The ministers deny refusing the bill, say talks with initiators are ongoing, confirm they will implement any law adopted by both chambers after royal assent, and promise to inform parliament of the outcome.
These exploratory talks are still ongoing. We undertake to inform your House of the final outcome of these talks.
