Deze verkennende gesprekken lopen nog. Wij zeggen toe uw Kamer op de hoogte te brengen van de einduitkomst van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Akerboom over de aangifte van de dochter van een vermoorde mensenrechtenactivist tegen de Nederlandse Financieringsmaatschappij voor ontwikkelingslanden (FMO)

Akerboom (PvdD) asked the minister about the criminal complaint filed by Berta Cáceres's daughter against FMO, the status of the case, FMO's monitoring of the Agua Zarca project, and why the minister declined to answer questions citing the civil proceedings. The minister answered that a civil case is pending and paused, FMO says funds did not reach hitmen, the ministry is not a party and does not rule on individual investments, and FMO has strengthened its ESG and integrity policies.
To avoid disturbing the course of justice, I will not make further statements about FMO's role.
Om de rechtsgang niet te verstoren doe ik over de rol van FMO geen nadere uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over Woede van Afrikaanse leiders tegen Europa vanwege ‘koloniaal gedrag’

An MP asked whether the EU and Netherlands attach conditions on abortion and LGBTI rights to trade and partnership agreements with African and other third countries, and whether this amounts to neocolonial behaviour. The minister answered that no such preconditions are known, that the commitments referenced are in the Post-Cotonou agreement and framed as dialogue on equal terms, and that universal human rights are not Western values.

As far as is known, there are no requests, demands or conditions to amend legislation on sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) and LGBTIQ+ issues as a precondition for concluding (trade) agreements.

Voor zover bekend zijn er geen verzoeken, eisen en/of voorwaarden voor het aanpassen van wet- en regelgeving op het terrein van Seksuele en Reproductieve Gezondheid en Rechten (SRGR) en LHBTIQ+ als preconditie voor het afsluiten van (handels-)verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over het bericht dat teakhout uit Myanmar illegaal bij Nederlandse superjachtbouwers belandt

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked the ministers about reports that illegal teak from Myanmar reaches Dutch superyacht builders despite EU sanctions on Myanmar Timber Enterprise, and about enforcement differences across member states, a total import ban, and humanitarian support. The government answered that sanctions are strictly implemented in the Netherlands, that enforcement is a national competence, that companies are responsible for compliance, and that it is pursuing EU-level clarification, while offering no commitment to a total ban beyond the existing de facto ban via MTE sanctions.
The Netherlands interprets and implements EU sanctions in a strict manner. Enforcement of sanctions is a national competence.
Nederland interpreteert en implementeert EU-sancties op een strikte manier. Handhaving van sancties is een nationale competentie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Ceder over het voornemen van Vanuatu om het Internationaal Gerechtshof te vragen om een Advisory Opinion over de verantwoordelijkheden van staten op het gebied van klimaat

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the Dutch government whether it would support Vanuatu's draft UN General Assembly resolution requesting an ICJ advisory opinion on state responsibility for climate change, and how it would use diplomacy to build support. The government answered that it intends to support and co-sponsor the resolution, that the resolution has broad support, and that no additional diplomatic effort is needed.

Given the Netherlands' ambitious national and international climate policy, the cabinet intends, like the UK, Japan, and nearly all EU countries, to support the resolution if it is put to a vote in the UN General Assembly.

Gelet op het ambitieuze nationale en internationale klimaatbeleid van Nederland is het kabinet voornemens om, net als het VK, Japan, en vrijwel alle EU landen, de resolutie te steunen als deze in stemming wordt gebracht in de Algemene Vergadering van de Verenigde Naties.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Raan over de Uitvoeringsagenda Internationale Sociale Voorwaarden (ISV)

An MP asked why the government's International Social Conditions (ISV) implementation agenda lacks measurable targets, timelines and responsible departments for procurement, and whether it will impose stronger obligations. The minister answered that research on targets, sector scope and award criteria is underway with completion targeted for Q4 2023, and that the approach mixes support measures with an examination of mandatory use.
The aim is to complete this research in Q4 2023.
Het streven is dit onderzoek in Q4 2023 af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over de situatie in Myanmar

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg asked about the crisis in Myanmar: the lack of political attention, EU-UN efforts toward a ceasefire, ASEAN's role, sanctions coordination, aviation fuel sanctions, a Myanmar funding overview, a Human Rights Council resolution and an emergency summit. The minister answers that the Netherlands is active through EU, UN and ASEAN channels, supports humanitarian aid and inclusive dialogue, will lead on a strong Council resolution, and gives a funding table, while declining to publish 2021-2022 Human Rights Fund project details for security reasons.

The projects supported from the Human Rights Fund in 2021 and 2022 cannot be publicly shared, given the high security risk to the persons and organisations involved since the military coup of 1 February 2021.

De projecten die in 2021 en 2022 zijn ondersteund vanuit het MRF, kunnen gezien het hoge veiligheidsrisico dat betrokken personen en instanties lopen sinds de militaire staatsgreep op 1 februari 2021, niet publiekelijk worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op de leden Hammelburg en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Miljoenen chips Nederlandse fabrikanten belanden in Rusland ondanks sancties’

MPs Hammelburg and Sjoerdsma asked when the cabinet learned that Dutch chips were found in Russian military equipment, why the media were answered but not Parliament, what was done about Iranian drones, how sanctioned intermediaries could still supply Russia, and what measures could curb resale. The ministers answered that the government was first informed in March 2022, that the goods were added to EU sanctions after a Dutch proposal, that sanctions are being pursued via EU listings and a non-paper, and that full control over trade in these components is not feasible.
The ministry sent the relevant news editors a written response to a specific request for clarification.
Het ministerie heeft de betreffende nieuwsredacties een schriftelijke reactie gestuurd op een specifiek verzoek om verduidelijking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer, Klink en Inge van Dijk over exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs Stoffer, Klink and Inge van Dijk asked how the government accepts higher risks in green export credit insurance, what room Atradius DSB has, and how green export can be stimulated alongside phasing out fossil-related insurance. The government answered by listing measures such as lower financial requirements for small green transactions, longer loan terms, a green cover product, and OECD negotiations to modernise the Arrangement, noting 48 green transactions were insured in 2022.
The cabinet provides the maximum room within the set national and international frameworks, such as the EU state aid frameworks and the OECD Arrangement.
Het kabinet biedt de maximale ruimte binnen de vastgestelde nationale en internationale kaders zoals de EU-staatssteunkaders en de OESO Arrangement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitwerking van de COP26-verklaring over het beëindigen van overheidssteun voor fossiele projecten in het buitenland

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development how the COP26 pledge to end export credit support for overseas fossil projects is being implemented, including the transition period, the pipeline of fossil deals, exemptions and transparency. The government answers that new applications for fossil-related export credit insurance were stopped from 1 January 2023, with a transition for applications filed earlier, lists ten pipeline cases and six pledges with limited detail, explains the exemptions, and commits to reporting in an annual monitor.
Information on company names and the country has been omitted from the overview so that it cannot be traced to specific projects and companies, given commercial sensitivity.
Informatie over bedrijfsnamen en het land zijn in het overzicht achterwege gelaten zodat de informatie niet herleidbaar is tot specifieke projecten en bedrijven, gelet op de bedrijfsgevoeligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het bericht ‘Zware aardbeving treft Turkije en Syrië, honderden doden en gewonden’

An MP asked the minister about the scale of casualties and damage from the 2023 earthquake in Turkey and Syria, whether humanitarian aid would be provided quickly, and whether the Chamber would be informed. The minister answered briefly that the Chamber had been informed of the humanitarian impact and aid efforts by letter.
Yes. The Chamber was informed about the humanitarian consequences of the earthquakes and the (international) aid efforts via a letter to the Chamber.
Ja. De Kamer werd geïnformeerd over de humanitaire gevolgen van de aardbevingen en de (internationale) hulpinspanningen via Kamerbrief
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de onafhankelijke review naar de veiligheidssituatie LNG project Mozambique

An MP asked why the government has not yet sent Parliament the promised independent review of the security situation at the Mozambique LNG project, and whether it will arrive before year end. The State Secretary says the review was extended with an additional assignment, the final report is expected in February 2023 with a policy response before the 23 February debate, and gives a brief security update.

The expectation is that the final report will be delivered in February, so that it, accompanied by a policy response, can be sent to your House before the committee debate on export credit insurance of 23 February 2023.

De verwachting is dat het eindrapport in februari zal worden opgeleverd, zodat het, vergezeld van een beleidsreactie, voorafgaand aan het commissiedebat exportkredietverzekeringen van 23 februari 2023 aan uw Kamer kan worden gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bericht dat de VN nog 38 miljoen dollar tekort komt voor de berging van FSO Safer.

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a reported USD 38 million shortfall for salvaging the FSO Safer tanker, the role of Yemen's government, and the timing and feasibility of the operation. The minister answered that enough funds exist for the first phase, that Nederland is pressing the UN for speed, and that the Dutch firm Smit Salvage is negotiating the operation with the UN.
I recently also clearly conveyed the urgency of the situation and my great concerns about the progress to the head of UNDP.
Ik heb onlangs de urgentie van de situatie en mijn grote zorgen over de voortgang ook helder kenbaar gemaakt bij het hoofd van UNDP
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Agnes Mulder over ‘Zwarte Russen’ in Oekraïne: Afrikanen geronseld door Wagner en Russisch leger’

Two CDA MPs asked the minister about reports of Wagner recruiting convicted murderers and sex offenders from prisons in Russia and Africa, sexual violence by Russian forces in occupied Ukraine, aid for victims, and diplomatic responses. The government acknowledged signs of widespread sexual violence, noted under-reporting, described Dutch funding to UNFPA and humanitarian organisations, and said it lacks its own data on the recruited prisoners and sees no legal ban on recruiting convicts, while pointing to general EU and UN capacity programmes.
The cabinet has no independent information on the precise number of prisoners convicted of murder and sex offences recruited by the Wagner Group for the Russian army.

Het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over de precieze omvang van de groep voor moord en zedenmisdrijven veroordeelde gevangenen die door de Wagner Groep zijn gerekruteerd voor het Russische leger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over de mensenrechtensituatie in Oeganda

An MP asked about the human rights situation in Uganda, Dutch aid oversight, the withheld JLOS payment of €850,000 over unaccountable police violence, and the effectiveness of JLOS and private sector programmes. The minister said the government remains concerned, describes monitoring of aid projects, defends the withholding as a signal, and commits to conditional responses but declines any change to the aid relationship.
Currently there are no indications that development aid funds in Uganda are being used for activities other than those intended.
Momenteel zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat er OS-gelden in Oeganda worden ingezet voor andere activiteiten dan bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over Nederlands belastinggeld in Afrikaanse ontwikkelingslanden

An MP from JA21 asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Dutch aid spending in African countries, including a per-country breakdown for 2011-2021, estimates of illicit capital flight, and how correct use of aid is enforced. The minister provided a country table, said capital flight cannot be reliably measured, noted that no cases of illicit capital flight involving Dutch aid are known, and described contractual audit, recovery and zero-tolerance mechanisms against misuse.
The ministry, in turn, reports all proven misappropriations to the House via the annex to the departmental annual report, and also interim when more than EUR 100,000 of Dutch share is involved.

Het ministerie, op haar beurt rapporteert alle bewezen malversaties aan de Kamer via de bijlage van het departementaal jaarverslag, alsmede tussentijds wanneer meer dan EUR 100.000 Nederlands aandeel betrokken is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bericht dat Nederlands plan om Jakarta te redden van de zee hapert door «stroperig Indonesisch bestuur»

An MP asked why the Dutch-Korean Jakarta coastal protection plan (NCICD) stalls, whether it is a long-term solution, its costs and Dutch company involvement, and whether the minister will engage Indonesian counterparts. The minister replied that Indonesia decides on the measures and timing, that Dutch funding of about EUR 9 million ended in 2020, and offered to discuss cooperation if Indonesia requests it.
It is up to the Indonesian government to decide whether it wants to implement the proposed measures, how it wants to do so and when.
Het is aan de Indonesische overheid te besluiten of ze de voorgestelde maatregelen willen uitvoeren, hoe ze dat willen doen en wanneer.
Antwoord op op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Akkoord over beperken export chiptech naar China'

D66 MPs asked whether the cabinet agreed to export restrictions on chip-making machinery and technology to China, why parliament was not informed, and about security effects, consultation with Brussels and Dutch firms, and China's WTO complaint against the US. The ministers refused to share the content of talks with partners citing confidentiality, pointed to the 1 December letter and a confidential briefing, said no policy change is currently at stake, and declined to speculate on Chinese reactions or possible complaints against the Netherlands.
I cannot go into the content of discussions the Netherlands holds with partner countries because of confidentiality.
Op de inhoud van gesprekken die Nederland voert met partnerlanden kan ik vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid niet ingaan.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over het World Economic Forum

Van Houwelingen (FvD) asked how many Dutch civil servants have a @weforum.org email account. The minister answers that one civil servant has such an account, on secondment for the Global Coordinating Secretariat for the Food Innovation Hubs, and refers to a parallel answer from the Minister of Economic Affairs.
There is one civil servant with a personal email account with the extension @weforum.org, in the context of a secondment to staff the Global Coordinating Secretariat for the Food Innovation Hubs.

Er is een rijksambtenaar met de beschikking over een eigen mailaccount met de extensie «@weforum.org», in het kader van een detachering voor de invulling van het Global Coordinating Secretariat voor de Food Innovation Hubs.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Teunissen over het feit dat de mondiale biodiversiteitsdoelen alleen te behalen zijn door het hervormen van voedsel- en energiesystemen en een sterke beleidsinzet op natuurhers

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked ministers how the government will act on PBL findings that global biodiversity targets require transforming food and energy systems and stronger nature and climate policy, including on protein transition, financial-sector investment and COP negotiations. The minister acknowledges the urgency, points to the coalition agreement, national protein strategy, a forthcoming subsidy review and an inter-departmental biodiversity study, but largely restates existing policy and defers concrete steps to later.
The cabinet acknowledges that there is no time to lose and that a joint approach is required to tackle the climate and biodiversity crisis.
Het kabinet erkent dat er geen tijd te verliezen is en dat een gezamenlijke aanpak vereist is om de klimaat- en biodiversiteitscrisis aan te pakken.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van der Lee en Thijssen over de intentieverklaring tussen Nederland en met Oman over samenwerking op het gebied van groene waterstof

MPs Kröger, Van der Lee and Thijssen asked why the Dutch-Omani green hydrogen memorandum lacks safeguards on human rights, environment and labour rights, given Oman's weak labour record and the port of Sohar joint venture. The government answered that MoUs are non-binding, that Dutch companies must apply OECD due diligence, that an IMVO risk analysis on hydrogen chains is under way, and that future MoUs may refer to the SDGs.
A letter of intent does not create legally binding agreements from which safeguards, rights or obligations can be derived.
In een intentieverklaring worden geen juridisch bindende afspraken gemaakt waaraan waarborgen, rechten of plichten kunnen worden ontleend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Van der Plas en Jasper van Dijk over het plan van de Europese Commissie om het Mercosur-verdrag geïmplementeerd te krijgen door nationale parlementen te omzeilen

MPs Teunissen, Van der Plas and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the Commission is splitting the EU-Mercosur agreement to avoid national parliamentary ratification and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that talks with Mercosur continue without new developments, that the form of any agreement is not yet decided, and that national democratic procedures will apply once a proposal reaches the Council.

As the cabinet has repeatedly indicated, it will only take a position on the agreement with the Mercosur countries once the Commission has submitted the necessary decision-making documents to the Council.

Zoals herhaaldelijk door het kabinet aangegeven zal het kabinet pas een standpunt innemen over het akkoord met de Mercosur-landen wanneer de Commissie de benodigde documenten voor besluitvorming aan de Raad heeft aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bericht dat Rusland voorlopig niet akkoord gaat met verlenging van de graandeal

An MP asked the minister whether Russia's refusal to extend the Black Sea grain deal and its claims about unmet export commitments were accurate, how sanctions relate to the deal, and how Dutch support is shaped. The minister replied that the deal was extended by four months, that the UN and UNCTAD manage sanctions exemptions for food and fertiliser, and that the Netherlands funds UNCTAD, CHD and WFP initiatives in support of the deal.
On 17 November it became known that, thanks to the efforts of the UN and Turkey, the grain deal has been extended by 4 months.
Op 17 november jl. werd bekend dat met dank aan de inzet van de VN en Turkije, de graandeal is verlengd met 4 maanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het WEF

An MP asked the minister whether the Dutch Permanent Representation in Geneva acts as intermediary for other private foreign foundations besides the World Economic Forum, and asked for all communication from 2020 onward about inviting and supporting ministerial visits to the WEF. The minister listed other Geneva-based organisations the Permanent Representation serves as first contact for, and pointed to earlier answers and the invitations for the January 2023 Davos meeting attached as an annex.
Necessary information has already been shared with the House in response to earlier requests regarding recent participation of Dutch ministers in past annual meetings of the World Economic Forum.

Er is in reactie op eerdere verzoeken al de nodige informatie met de Kamer gedeeld inzake recente deelname van Nederlandse bewindspersonen aan eerdere jaarlijkse vergaderingen van het World Economic Forum
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Hammelburg over de berichtgeving dat Oeganda kampt met een nieuwe ebola-uitbraak

MPs Sjoerdsma and Hammelburg asked the government about reports of a new Ebola outbreak in Uganda, including flight links, airport screening, WHO response capacity and Dutch assistance. The minister answered that the government is concerned, that screening protocols are being strengthened, that the WHO has an emergency programme and funding gap, and that Dutch contributions go via WHO funds.
The cabinet is concerned about the Ebola outbreak in Uganda.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over de Ebola uitbraak in Oeganda.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de bewuste stellingname van Shell geen plannen te maken om net zero emission te bereiken binnen de komende tien à twintig jaar en doorgaat met het zoeken naar nieuwe olie en gas

MP Kröger asks the government how it views Shell's stated lack of plans to reach net zero within 10 to 20 years and its continued search for new oil and gas, including the court ruling requiring a 45% CO2 cut by 2030 and Scope 3 emissions. The minister answers that the government holds Shell to EU and national climate targets, declines further comment while the appeal is pending, notes Shell's low-carbon initiatives, and states the government remains committed to the Paris goals.
As long as the appeal is before the court, I refrain from further comment.
Zolang het hoger beroep onder de rechter is, onthoud ik mij van verder commentaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het bericht dat Nederlandse halfgeleiderproducenten op het boodschappenlijstje van Rusland staan ter bevoorrading van het rakettekort

Klink (VVD) asked the minister about reports that Dutch semiconductor producers appear on Russia's shopping list for its missile shortage, including possible Chinese ownership, export controls, sanctions evasion via intermediaries, and government subsidies. The minister answered that the components are universal and widely traded, that no evidence shows direct Dutch supply to Russian weapons makers, that the goods were added to EU sanctions in the eighth package, and that details of enforcement cannot be disclosed publicly.
On the Dutch information position regarding circumvention of trade bans, and the conduct of supervision, I make no statements in public.
Over de Nederlandse informatiepositie omtrent omzeiling van handelsverboden, en uitvoering van het toezicht, doe ik in de openbaarheid geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen, Agnes Mulder, Dassen en Boucke over het bericht “COP27: Egypt pressed to make human rights move before climate summit”

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA, CDA, Volt and D66 asked the government about reports that Egyptian authorities restrict civil society and that many Egyptian organisations could not register for COP27, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister answered that the Netherlands is concerned about shrinking civic space, has raised accreditation inclusiveness and human rights with Egypt bilaterally and at EU level, but stressed that UNFCCC and Egypt as host carry the responsibility for participation.
The Netherlands, like other European countries, urges both bilaterally and multilaterally for an inclusive COP27 without participating organisations having to fear oppression or repercussions.

Nederland dringt, net als andere Europese landen, zowel bilateraal als in multilateraal verband, aan op een inclusieve COP27 zonder dat deelnemende organisaties hoeven te vrezen voor onderdrukking of repercussies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het recent uitgebrachte VN rapport over de mensenrechtenschendingen jegens de Oeigoeren in Xinjiang

MP Van der Lee asked the government about the UN OHCHR report on serious human rights violations against Uyghurs in Xinjiang, whether it changes Dutch policy, the share of Dutch trade with Xinjiang, and whether trade measures or mandatory supply-chain due diligence should follow. The ministers answered that the report is credible, Dutch policy is unchanged, Xinjiang accounts for under 1% of trade with China, and they pointed to EU and national due diligence and forced-labour proposals, while stating Nederland cannot unilaterally impose trade measures and that Dutch efforts continue in the Human Rights Council.
As an EU member state, the Netherlands cannot independently introduce a trade measure.
Nederland kan als EU-lidstaat niet zelfstandig een handelsmaatregel introduceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over de nieuwe Amerikaanse wet die de export van geavanceerde chips en machines naar China verder aan banden wil leggen

Volt MP Dassen asked the Dutch ministers whether the US had requested Dutch-style export bans on chipmaking technology to China, whether a Dutch DUV machine ban was under discussion, and about the geopolitical implications. The government answered that it regularly consults the US on export controls but would inform parliament of relevant policy changes, declined to disclose the content of a confidential meeting, acknowledged economic interests, and said export control is a national competence while Dutch policy aims for European coordination.
Due to the confidentiality of this conversation, I cannot make statements about the precise content discussed.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van dit gesprek kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de precieze besproken inhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het EU-handelsverdrag met Nieuw-Zeeland

Teunissen (PvdD) asks the government about the EU-New Zealand trade agreement: its sustainability claims, transport emissions, lobbying by Zespri, sector impacts on dairy, beef and sheep, food safety, enforcement of labour and Paris commitments, fossil fuel subsidy reform and gender provisions. The minister answers largely by describing the negotiated text and impact studies, stating the cabinet will form a final view when the Council decides, and committing to updated cumulative agricultural impact studies and a more detailed fossil subsidy policy letter before COP27.
It is up to the New Zealand government to provide information about the organisations it contacted during the negotiation of the trade agreement.
Het is aan de overheid van Nieuw-Zeeland om informatie te verstrekken over de organisaties waarmee door deze overheid contact is geweest tijdens de onderhandeling van het handelsakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het op grote schaal dumpen van plastic afval in landen als Vietnam & Indonesië door Nederland

An MP asked the government about Dutch plastic waste exports to non-OECD countries such as Indonesia and Vietnam, which reportedly doubled and may end up dumped or burned. The minister acknowledged the concern, said export is allowed only for clean recyclable waste under strict rules, and pointed to the pending EU Waste Shipment Regulation revision and enforcement measures.
However, I believe the rules for exports from the EU should be further tightened, which is also currently happening in the ongoing revision of the European Waste Shipment Regulation (EVOA).

Wel ben ik van mening dat de regels voor export uit de EU verder moeten worden aangescherpt, wat op dit moment ook gebeurt in de huidige herziening van de Europese Verordening Overbrenging Afvalstoffen (EVOA).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over het rapport 'Global Estimates of Modern Slavery: Forced Labour and Forced Marriage'

An ChristenUnie MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the ILO/Walk Free/IOM report on modern slavery (50 million people), what the cabinet will do, and whether the OECD guidelines should be embedded in Dutch and EU due diligence law. The minister acknowledges the scale and rise, points to existing anti-trafficking programmes, the planned modernisation of article 273f of the Criminal Code, support for the EU CSDDD and a forced-labour products ban, and says the figures underline the need for ambitious due diligence legislation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Klink over het bericht dat de Europese Unie voornemens is een waterstofbank in het leven te roepen

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that the EU plans a hydrogen bank with three billion euros and whether it could be located in the Netherlands. The minister answered that little is known yet, that the Commission is still developing the concept, that the government will monitor it and may align with Germany's H2Global, and that a full assessment must await more concrete information.
Little is yet known about the planned hydrogen bank.
Er is nog weinig bekend over de voorgenomen waterstofbank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de impact van Nederlandse import op natuurverlies wereldwijd

An MP asked the government about the worldwide nature loss caused by Dutch imports of commodities such as soy, palm oil, cocoa, timber and beef, and what the government will do about it, including the EU deforestation regulation. The minister acknowledged the high land footprint, pointed to EU regulation and national targets such as halving the footprint by 2050, and promised to set out concrete steps in the NBSAP in 2023 while declining to answer one question in full.
As previously announced, I am therefore willing to make clear which steps are needed to reduce the Dutch footprint and how the cabinet intends to address this.

Zoals eerder aangekondigd (Kamerstuk 2022Z06909 ) ben ik dan ook bereid om inzichtelijk te maken welke stappen nodig zijn om de Nederlandse voetafdruk te verkleinen en hoe het kabinet dit wil aanpakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de Nederlandse rechtstatelijke steun aan Oeganda

MP Thijssen asked why Dutch rule-of-law support to Uganda was paid out despite suspension threats after violent 2020 elections, and questioned the contractual limits and the lack of parliamentary notice. Minister Schreinemacher answered that the agreement cannot be shared, the final €850,000 payment was withheld as a signal, the €2.4 million was paid for already incurred costs, and the Netherlands will continue selective JLOS support.
No, the agreement cannot be shared with the House, because it is an arrangement signed in confidence with the Ugandan authorities.
Nee, de overeenkomst kan niet worden gedeeld met de Kamer, omdat het een in vertrouwen getekend arrangement met de Oegandese autoriteiten betreft
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht 'Nederland betaalde opgeschorte steun aan Oeganda toch uit, ondanks gewelddadige verkiezingen vorig jaar'

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development why the Netherlands paid out a suspended aid tranche to Uganda's justice sector (JLOS) despite violent elections, and why Parliament was not informed. The Minister answers that only the first payment was made for already-completed activities, the final €850,000 was withheld in September 2022 to press for accountability over election-related police violence, and that Parliament was informed later via the evaluation and the answers, while rejecting calls to end aid immediately.
Parliament was not informed at the time of the first payment because the expectation was that the decision on the final payment would follow within a few months.
De Kamer is destijds niet geïnformeerd over de eerste betaling omdat de verwachting was dat het besluit over de slotbetaling binnen enkele maanden zou volgen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het PAX rapport betreffende foute investeringen van de ING en andere grote banken in de wapenindustrie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about a PAX report finding that major European banks, including ING, financed arms producers supplying states with high risk of using weapons against civilians, such as Saudi Arabia. The government answered that banks must apply due diligence under OECD guidelines and UNGP, that exporters with valid licences operate within legal frameworks, and that it sees no reason to meet ING, while pointing to forthcoming due diligence legislation.

The government expects Dutch banks such as ING, in line with the OECD Guidelines and the UN Guiding Principles, to map risks to people and the environment in their value chain for their investments in the defence industry.

Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse banken zoals ING dat zij, conform de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen (OESO-richtlijnen) en UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP's), voor hun investeringen in de defensie-industrie de risico's voor mens en milieu in hun waardeketen in kaart brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de situatie in Suriname

Sylvana Simons (BIJ1) asked the ministers about Suriname's flooding, the strained health system including infant deaths in the single NICU, shortages of nurses, and the critique by Kruijt and Maks of past Dutch aid under the Verdragsmiddelen. The minister confirms awareness, describes UNICEF and DRR water support, Dutch health advisers and a Zorg Transitie Fonds, and says Makandra technical assistance supports sustainable capacity building.
Through the Makandra programme of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, technical assistance is financed.
Via het Makandra-programma van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken wordt technische assistentie gefinancierd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Van der Graaf over de noodsituatie in Pakistan wegens overstromingen

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked whether the government knows of the flood emergency in Pakistan and whether it will provide emergency aid and involve local and civil society organisations. The minister confirmed awareness, pointed to over EUR 3.5 million via the Dutch Red Cross and Dutch Relief Alliance plus expert deployments and flexible funding to UN and Red Cross partners, and said local organisations are engaged in line with Grand Bargain commitments.
The Netherlands has already made emergency aid available for Pakistan.
Nederland heeft reeds noodhulp beschikbaar gesteld voor Pakistan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over misstanden binnen de United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS)

An MP asked the Foreign Trade and Development minister about mismanagement at UNOPS, including Dutch funds linked to the WSSCC, the S3i initiative, a whistleblower not being heard, and suspension of payments. The minister answered that Dutch payments were paused and resumed under conditions, that whistleblowers are always heard, and that a temporary payment freeze and stricter commitment procedure were introduced while external investigations proceed.
Whistleblowers who report to Foreign Affairs are always heard.
Klokkenluiders die zich melden bij Buitenlandse Zaken worden altijd gehoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het charmeoffensief van Rusland in Afrikaanse landen

An MP asked the foreign trade and development minister about Russia's charm offensive in African countries, Lavrov's July 2022 visits, the African states that abstained or voted against the UN resolution on aggression against Ukraine, and Dutch aid funds flowing to their governments. The minister replied that the visits had limited impact, that Dutch aid to governments is mostly channelled through other actors with some exceptions, and that aid to Ethiopia, Mali and Burkina Faso is being reviewed for security and rule-of-law projects.

For this reason, a review is currently being carried out of the Dutch development cooperation projects in the field of security and rule of law, so that funding does not go through the central governments of Ethiopia, Mali and Burkina Faso.

Om deze reden wordt er thans een herziening uitgevoerd van de Nederlandse ontwikkelingssamenwerkingsprojecten op het gebied van veiligheid en rechtsorde, opdat financiering niet via de centrale overheden van Ethiopië, Mali, en Burkina Faso loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een onderzoek dat uitwijst dat de bedrijvenlobby het Europese IMVO voorstel heeft beïnvloed

An MP asked the minister about the CEO report 'Inside Job' claiming business lobbying through the EU Regulatory Scrutiny Board weakened the EU CSDDD proposal, and about Denmark's request for Dutch lobbying support, the ATR's role, and transparency of RSB contacts. The minister answered that the RSB is independent, that the Commission chose to proceed despite negative opinions, that the Netherlands backs EU transparency initiatives, and that a Dutch national due diligence bill with ATR and Council of State advice will follow.
The cabinet cannot assess to what extent business has or has not successfully lobbied the RSB, nor to what extent the RSB has been able to weigh the various interests.
Het kabinet kan niet beoordelen in hoeverre het bedrijfsleven al dan niet succesvol bij de RSB heeft gelobbyd, noch in hoeverre de RBS in staat is geweest verschillende belangen af te wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over Nederlandse bedrijven die actief zijn in Qatar vanwege het WK-voetbal

An SP MP asked the foreign trade and development minister about Dutch firms earning money from World Cup construction in Qatar, including worker exploitation, deaths, lack of due diligence and corporate transparency, and FIFA's liability. The minister answered that companies bear responsibility under OECD guidelines, that Dutch policy is to promote EU and national due diligence legislation and CSRD reporting from 2024, and that the causes of worker deaths could not be attributed clearly to World Cup works.
At EU level the cabinet promotes due diligence legislation and is implementing national due diligence legislation.
Het kabinet bevordert op EU-niveau IMVO-wetgeving en voert nationale IMVO-wetgeving in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over belemmering van de Russische wapenindustrie

An SP MP asked the Dutch ministers whether Russian arms-industry figures and firms were left off EU sanctions, whether Western electronics feeding Russian weapons were being curbed, and whether Dutch and EU arms and dual-use exports to Russia had been stopped. The government answered that the EU has listed major Russian defence firms and related persons, that no military exports to Russia have been licensed or made since 2014, and that no dual-use export licences have been granted since February 2022, while declining to comment on specific new sanction proposals and noting that a universal UN arms embargo is unlikely given Russia's veto.
The cabinet supports additional sanctions measures but does not comment on specific proposals for new sanctions.
Het kabinet is voorstander van aanvullende sanctiemaatregelen, maar doet geen uitlatingen over specifieke voorstellen voor nieuwe sancties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Graaf over de kwetsbare positie van ouderen in conflicten, waaronder de oorlog in Oekraïne

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation how older people in conflicts, including Ukraine, are protected in humanitarian aid, and whether their rights and needs are addressed in Dutch policy. The minister answered that older people are recognised as vulnerable and raised in policy dialogue with partners, but declined a separate approach for specific groups and committed only to raising the issue in relevant fora.

Yes, as also explained during the Emergency Aid Committee debate (14 April), the Netherlands raises attention in various relevant fora for people who are particularly affected and at extra risk due to the war in Ukraine.

Ja, zoals ook tijdens het Commissiedebat Noodhulp (14 april jl.) toegelicht, vraagt Nederland in uiteenlopende relevante fora aandacht voor mensen die extra getroffen zijn en extra risico lopen door de oorlog in Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de zorgwekkende situatie rondom de FSO Safer olietanker in Jemen

An MP asked the minister about the deteriorating situation around the FSO Safer oil tanker off Yemen, the funding gap for salvage, timing, private oil company contributions and contingency planning. The minister answered that funding remains insufficient despite about USD 65 million raised, that Netherlands contributes EUR 7.5 million and lobbies donors, and that the VN coordinates the operation with the timeline dependent on funding.
The Netherlands will continue to actively raise this issue in bilateral contacts with (potential) donors, in multilateral fora and with the private sector.
Nederland zal deze kwestie actief blijven opbrengen in bilaterale contacten met (potentiële) donoren, in multilaterale fora en bij de private sector
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de relatie van het kabinet met het WEF

An FvD MP asked the minister whether cabinet members attend WEF events in an official capacity, whether the cabinet suggests invitees, and asked for full release of all WEF-government communications. The minister confirmed WEF invitations go to official addresses, could not rule out cabinet suggestions of invitees, and pointed to previously sent correspondence while answering each question separately.
No, I cannot rule that out.
Nee, dat kan ik niet uitsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het World Economic Forum (WEF)

An FvD MP asked the minister whether many earlier questions on the World Economic Forum were left unanswered, why a 'close cooperation' with Dutch officials on the WEF annual meeting was not documented, and why a meeting readout would not be shared. The minister maintains all questions were answered, declines to share the special agenda and documentation citing privacy, and says the WEF objects to publishing the readout because discussions are confidential.
This special agenda cannot be shared for privacy reasons.
Deze special agenda kan uit privacyoverwegingen niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over communicatie tussen Ministers, Staatssecretarissen en ambtenaren en het WEF

An FvD MP asked the government to provide all communication between ministers, state secretaries, officials and the central bank president on one side and the World Economic Forum on the other. The minister pointed to correspondence attached to an earlier letter and an invitation to the 2022 WEF meeting, but said inventorying all official contacts was not feasible, while promising to act on specific, targeted document requests.
It is not feasible to inventory all documents that played a role in those contacts and to check them for information whose disclosure should be withheld in the interest of the state.

Het is niet haalbaar om alle stukken die daarbij een rol hebben gespeeld te inventariseren en te toetsen op de aanwezigheid van informatie waarvan de openbaarmaking gelet op het belang van de staat achterwege moet blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Koningin Maxima en het WEF

An MP from FvD asks the minister whether notes, minutes or agendas exist of WEF meetings and of a 2020 conversation between the Queen, the Prime Minister, Minister Kaag and Klaus Schwab, and questions the Queen's role in WEF stewardship bodies. The minister replies that minutes are generally not made, the conversation was an exchange of views with no agenda or notes, and the Queen's roles stem from her UNSGSA and related functions with ministerial responsibility, while denying the Great Reset is a government-committed WEF programme.
Because of the nature of the conversation, no report of it was made.
Vanwege de aard van het gesprek is hiervan geen verslag gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over juridisch bindende overeenkomsten tussen het kabinet en het WEF

An MP asked the government for a list and full documentation of legally binding agreements between the Dutch state and the World Economic Forum, and for the meetings that led to them. The minister replied that only four named agreements exist, that the relevant subsidy documents and implementation agreement have been made public, and that no agreements were concluded at ministerial or civil-servant meetings.

Besides the mentioned legal agreements (Sustainable Investment Policy; Tropical Forest Alliance; Food Systems Initiative; Food Innovation Hubs), no other legally binding agreements have been made with the WEF.

Naast de genoemde juridische afspraken (Sustainable Investement Policy; Tropical Forest Alliance; Food Systems Initiative; Food Innovation Hubs) zijn er geen andere juridisch bindende afspraken gemaakt met het WEF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Koninklijk Huis en het WEF Young Global Leader programma

An FvD MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether members of the Royal House took part in the WEF Young Global Leaders programme, why, who decides invitations, and whether the Prime Minister is accountable for such activities. The minister confirmed some members participated, referred to a public overview, said the WEF decides invitations, and noted the Prime Minister's general ministerial responsibility for the Royal House while members of the Royal Family not in the Royal House carry no such responsibility.
For members of the Royal Family who are not also members of the Royal House, no ministerial responsibility applies as such.
Voor leden van de Koninklijke Familie, niet tevens lid van het Koninklijk Huis, geldt geen ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid als zodanig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het WEF-tasje van de premier

An FvD MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Prime Minister carrying a World Economic Forum bag, including whether he was a candidate to succeed Klaus Schwab and whether the bag signals endorsement of the WEF. The minister answered briefly: she was unaware of any succession candidacy, the PM received the bag at a WEF event, the PM likes it, the WEF is an inspirational platform not comparable to companies, and no signal is intended.
The WEF aims to offer an inspiring platform for exchanging ideas on solving global issues, and cannot be compared with the companies you mentioned.
Het WEF wil een inspirerend platform bieden voor de uitwisseling van ideeën over de oplossing van wereldwijde vraagstukken, en kan niet vergeleken worden met de door u genoemde bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Mark Rutte en Klaus Schwab

An FvD MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Prime Minister's contacts with WEF founder Klaus Schwab, including the Great Reset, meetings, the Young Global Leaders programme and phone contact. The government answered that correspondence concerned a book on COVID-19, that Davos welcome talks and a 2018 Catshuis session were informal and not minuted, and that there were two phone contacts in 2015 and 2016.
Because of the informal and non-conclusive nature of these conversations, no minutes are made of them.
Vanwege het informele en niet-conclusieve karakter worden van deze gesprekken geen verslagen van gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het ‘Memorandum of Understanding’ tussen het WEF en Denemarken

An MP from FvD asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether she knew of the Memorandum of Understanding between the World Economic Forum and Denmark, whether the Netherlands had a similar agreement, and whether the Chamber could receive any such memoranda the WEF may have concluded with the Dutch state. The minister answered that she knows of the Danish MoU, that the Netherlands has no comparable agreement, and that no such memoranda exist.
No, the Netherlands has not concluded a similar Memorandum of Understanding.
Nee, Nederland heeft geen dergelijk Memorandum of Understanding afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de relatie van kabinetsleden met het WEF

An MP from FvD asks the minister why the government's answer about cabinet members' status at the WEF is inconsistent with other answers and with documents showing former minister Kaag attended several WEF meetings, and requests a complete overview of Dutch officials' WEF attendance since 2014. The minister defends the earlier answer as limited to formal status, points to the December 2021 letter for the full overview, lists ministers attending the May 2022 annual meeting, and points to WEF website livestreams.
Can you finally come back with an answer to question two, clearly listing which WEF meetings (online and offline) Dutch ministers and officials have attended from 2014 to date?

Kunt u alsnog met een antwoord op vraag twee komen, waarbij (nu eindelijk eens) overzichtelijk op een rijtje wordt gezet welke WEF-bijeenkomsten (online en offline) door Nederlandse bewindspersonen en ambtenaren zijn bezocht vanaf 2014 tot heden?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Agnes Mulder over het stopzetten van een door Buitenlandse Zaken gefinancierd vrouwenrechtenactivistenprogramma in Afghanistan

Two MPs from the CDA asked why the Dutch government stopped funding a women's rights activist programme in Afghanistan, citing deteriorating conditions for Afghan women, and what unacceptable security risks meant. The minister answered that the decision followed careful weighing of security risks against impact, that support for Afghan civil society and women's rights continues through other adapted projects, and that a further letter on longer-term engagement will address this.
The decision to stop this specific project was taken on the basis of a careful weighing of substantive arguments about security risks and achievable impact.
Het besluit om dit specifieke project stop te zetten, is genomen op basis van een zorgvuldige afweging van inhoudelijke argumenten over veiligheidsrisico's en te behalen impact.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klink en Kamminga over het bericht dat de Britten een wetsvoorstel hebben ingediend om Brexit-afspraken Noord-Ierland eenzijdig te wijzigen

Two MPs from the VVD asked the government about a UK bill that would allow unilateral changes to Brexit Northern Ireland Protocol arrangements, including its impact on trade, Ireland, Dutch-UK relations and the role of the EU Court of Justice. The Minister answered that the government shares EU concerns, supports Commission dialogue and pressure measures, and urges the UK to honour its international obligations, while the bill's final content and implications remain uncertain.
The cabinet has, in the EU and in contacts with the UK, expressed its concerns about any form of unilateral action.
Het kabinet heeft de afgelopen periode in de EU en in de contacten met het VK zijn zorgen uitgesproken over iedere vorm van unilaterale actie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Piri over het bericht ‘’Honderden gemartelde homo’s in Tsjetsjenië, toch doen PwC, Deloitte en KPMG er zaken’

MPs Thijssen and Piri asked the ministers about reports that PwC, Deloitte and KPMG do business in Chechnya despite serious human rights abuses, and whether the Dutch government will hold these firms to account under OECD guidelines and due diligence rules. The ministers said the government has concerns about Chechnya, that sanctions target individuals rather than firms, that the firms are largely not Dutch-registered, and that the government will pursue IMVO legislation at EU level without committing to a specific action against the firms.
The cabinet cannot assess whether these companies have insufficiently met their due diligence obligation.
Het kabinet kan niet beoordelen of deze bedrijven hun due diligence-verplichting onvoldoende zijn nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de toename van extreme armoede in de wereld

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Oxfam's report on rising extreme poverty, its link to tax policy favouring the rich, debt relief, IMF SDR pledges and social protection funds. The minister answered that poverty reduction is a core aim, that a tax policy study is underway, that Nederland supports the Common Framework and global minimum tax, that the SDR commitment is pending possible future decisions, and that Nederland supports social protection programmes.
Unfortunately, no consensus has yet been reached on these measures.
Over deze maatregelen is helaas nog geen consensus bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over de uitzonderingen op Europese mededingingsregels van containerrederijen en prijsafspraken

An MP asked whether the EU competition exemption for container shipping consortia lets large carriers control capacity and prices, and what can be done about price transparency and the exemption's expiry in 2024. The State Secretary answered that the Commission found no evidence of anticompetitive conduct, attributed high prices mainly to supply-chain disruption, said transparency is the Commission's task, and said the Netherlands will await the Commission's review before acting.
Because oversight of this lies primarily with the European Commission, I would like to await its findings.
Omdat het toezicht hierop primair bij de Europese Commissie ligt, zou ik haar bevindingen willen afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de kosten van deelname aan WEF-bijeenkomsten

An FvD MP asked the minister whether cabinet members paid WEF membership fees in 2018-2020 and which special duties required Minister Kaag to stay longer at WEF meetings. The minister confirmed that cabinet members paid no WEF membership fee and explained that Kaag's BHOS portfolio overlapped with WEF themes, so she had a relatively extensive programme in Davos.

Given the duties of the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, which have many points of contact with the themes discussed at WEF annual meetings in recent years, such as the SDGs, Minister Kaag as Minister for FTDC had a relatively extensive programme in Davos.

Gelet op de taken van de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking, die veel raakvlakken vertonen met de thema's die gedurende de afgelopen jaren in de jaarvergaderingen van het WEF aan de orde zijn gekomen, zoals de SDG's, had Minister Kaag als Minister voor BHOS een relatief uitgebreid programma in Davos.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Minister: 'Rode diesel keert niet terug'

Two MPs asked whether the government will reinstate red diesel for farmers, given that Belgium and Germany offer farmers cheaper fuel and that Dutch farmers face heavy regulation. The minister refused to reinstate red diesel, pointing to the temporary fuel excise cut and EU crisis reserve funds, and gave no separate scheme for farmers.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht dat Nederland dictatoriaal Rwanda ondanks mensenrechtenschendingen financieel bleef steunen

The MP Eppink asked why the Netherlands financed Rwanda with nearly 140 million euros despite alleged human rights abuses, and whether Rwanda is a dictatorship, among ten questions. The minister explained that Dutch support focused on rebuilding Rwanda's justice sector after the 1994 genocide, that aid is being phased out, and that the government does not maintain lists of dictatorships but raised human rights concerns bilaterally.

After the genocide, the Netherlands focused on the justice sector because ending the culture of impunity, and attention to the rule of law generally, was seen as a requirement for lasting peace in the country.

Nederland richtte zich na de genocide op de justitiesector omdat het beëindigen van de cultuur van straffeloosheid, en aandacht voor het recht in den brede, werd gezien als vereiste voor duurzame vrede in het land.
Antwoord op op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over exportsteun uit Nederlands Belastinggeld voor een omstreden project op de Filipijnen (deel 2)

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the Finance and Foreign Trade ministers about Dutch export credit insurance (ekv) for the contested New Manila International Airport project, covering biodiversity, flood and subsidence risks, the Boskalis dredging role, the absence of independent review and the lack of an environmental impact assessment. The state secretary answered most questions by defending the ekv due diligence, stating that the project's ESIA was adequate and that mangrove loss and forced resettlement are considered acceptable if mitigated, while committing to no new action.
I am of the view that the CSR assessment and testing against the CSR standards for the ekv was carried out carefully.
Ik ben van mening dat de IMVO-beoordeling en toetsing aan de IMVO-standaarden voor de ekv zorgvuldig heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over mogelijk gebruik van Nederlands defensiematerieel door Egyptische speciale eenheden tegen Palestijnse burgers

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade whether Dutch defence equipment supplied to Egypt has been used against Palestinian civilians and whether the government knew of naval support to Egyptian units in Sinai. The ministers answered that no independently verified link has been established between licensed military goods and the incidents, that naval support is acknowledged but no concrete link to abuses is found, and that there is no basis to revoke the licence.
Information on the use of the licence is commercially confidential and under customs legislation may not be disclosed publicly.
Het gebruik van de vergunning betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie die conform de douanewetgeving niet openbaar mag worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Segers, Ceder en De Roon over de brief  ‘Uitkomsten en kabinetsappreciatie extern onderzoek UAWC’

MPs asked the government to disclose the Proximities report on UAWC, defend its definition of the PFLP and the choice to treat Palestinian civil society organisations as PFLP-linked, and explain aid transparency and due diligence. The government declined to publish the report, citing a do-no-harm principle, said it does not share Proximities' broader definition, and promised further EU-level assessment and tightened due diligence.
The cabinet believes that publication of the report could cause disproportionate harm to the civil society organisations concerned.
Het kabinet meent dat openbaarmaking van het rapport de betreffende maatschappelijke organisaties onevenredige schade zou kunnen toebrengen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de wederopbouw van Oekraïense steden en dorpen

An MP asked the government whether it would commit to Ukraine's reconstruction, to a reconstruction plan showing Dutch involvement, and to exploring partnerships between Dutch municipalities and Ukrainian towns. The minister answered yes to each point and promised letters to parliament on a European recovery programme and on the Kuzu motion.
Yes, your House will be informed by letter in the short term about the Dutch contribution in line with the Amhaouch et al. motion on a European recovery programme for Ukraine.
Ja, uw Kamer zal op korte termijn per brief geïnformeerd worden over de Nederlandse inzet conform motie Amhaouch c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over de donorconferentie voor Moldavië en de acute crisis die zich daar voltrekt ten gevolge van de oorlog in Oekraïne

An MP from D66 asked the minister about the Moldova donor conference and the refugee crisis caused by the war in Ukraine, including Dutch contributions and Moldova's needs. The minister answered that the Netherlands pledged 10 million euros for refugee reception, supports Moldova's access to World Bank concessional funding, and has provided aid in kind and a plan to take in 500 refugees.
The Netherlands supported Moldova in its efforts to gain access to this instrument, and if this bid is successful, we will channel this contribution through this facility.
Nederland heeft Moldavië gesteund bij zijn inspanningen om toegang te krijgen tot dit instrument, en indien dit bod succesvol is, zullen wij deze bijdrage via deze faciliteit laten lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Van der Graaf en Piri over de situatie aan de grens met Oekraïne

MPs from ChristenUnie and PvdA asked the government about long border waits for Ukrainian refugees, humanitarian funding, reported discrimination against Roma at the Hungarian border and trafficking risks. The government answered that it finds long waits undesirable, is supporting neighbouring states via Frontex, EUAA and EU civil protection, increased humanitarian funding, and found no evidence of discrimination on the EU side while stating it monitors the situation closely.
The Netherlands intends to respond positively to this.
Nederland is voornemens hier positief op te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over de handelsmissie van NABC naar Kameroen tussen 21 en 25 maart

MP Klink (VVD) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about an NABC trade mission to Cameroon, including whether the travel advice was outdated, which sectors were safe for Dutch businesses, EPA and Global Gateway opportunities, food security, and the absence of a Dutch embassy in Cameroon. The Minister acknowledged the travel advice had been updated after COVID-related delays, pointed to trade opportunities in agriculture and other sectors, and explained that embassy support is provided via Benin and an honorary consul, while committing to no concrete new step.
The travel advice is updated periodically.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Tjeerd de Groot over het bericht 'Honger dreigt in Hoorn van Afrika, te weinig hulpgeld door 'concurrerende rampen''

MPs Hammelburg and Tjeerd de Groot (D66) asked the minister about a warning that hunger threatens the Horn of Africa and that aid is insufficient, covering food security, WFP funding, the aid budget, UN coordination, food import dependence and geopolitical risks. The minister replied that the Netherlands is engaging partners and the UN, cites existing funding (EUR 44 million to WFP), says no room exists in the emergency aid budget for increases but that the Chamber will be informed in the spring memorandum, and promises further UN talks.
If additional funds become available, a decision on additional contributions will be taken based on an analysis of needs worldwide.
Indien additionele middelen beschikbaar komen, wordt op basis van een analyse van de noden wereldwijd een besluit genomen over aanvullende bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het feit dat de Nederlandse Ontwikkelingsbank FMO voor €230 miljoen leningen heeft uitstaan in Oekraïne en buurland Wit-Rusland

An MP asked the ministers about FMO's EUR 230 million in loans in Ukraine and Belarus, the specific activities funded, the financial risks, and the implications for the Dutch state as shareholder. The ministers answered that FMO is monitoring risks, has written down part of its loans, is considering payment suspensions with clients, and that FMO's capital position remains strong, though the full impact is too early to assess.
The Minister of Finance and I will of course keep a close eye on the situation and remain in close contact with FMO about it.
De Minister van Financiën en ik zullen de situatie uiteraard goed in de gaten houden en hierover in nauw contact blijven met FMO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over transvrouwen Oekraïne

An MP asked whether the government knows that transgender women in Ukraine cannot leave the country because their documents say male, and what it will do to protect them. The ministers confirmed the situation is distressing, said they raise the issue with UN agencies and the Equal Rights Coalition, and agreed to raise it with European and Ukrainian counterparts.
Yes, I am willing to bring this issue further to the attention of European and Ukrainian counterparts.
Ja, ik ben bereid om dit onderwerp verder onder de aandacht te brengen bij Europese en Oekraïense counterparts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het artikel 'VVD-handelsminister hielp bedrijfslobby tegen aanpak kinderarbeid en milieuschade'

An MP asks the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether VNO-NCW took a different stance in the Netherlands than in Brussels on due diligence and CSR legislation, and whether the OECD guidelines will guide the Dutch position on the EU proposal, and which stakeholders were consulted. The minister says no concrete signs of a different VNO-NCW position were received, the OECD guidelines are supported, the Commission proposal is under study with a BNC-fiche to follow, and a stakeholder overview was previously shared, without detailing how input shaped the position.
The cabinet is currently studying the recently published Commission proposal on CSR.
Momenteel bestudeert het kabinet het recent gepubliceerde Commissievoorstel inzake IMVO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over een luchtbrug voor zieke kinderen in Oekraïne

An MP asked the ministers whether they would prioritise evacuating sick Ukrainian children, including children with cancer, by airlift to hospitals with capacity, and whether Dutch hospitals would be made available. The minister answered that evacuation is coordinated by the European Commission, that the Netherlands is willing to help, that a national inventory of hospital capacity is underway, and that a decision on Dutch coordination will follow.
On that basis I will make a decision on coordination and organisation on the Dutch side.
Op basis daarvan zal ik een besluit nemen over de coördinatie en organisatie aan Nederlandse zijde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Sjoerdsma over de mensenrechtensituatie in Oeganda

Two MPs (Simons and Sjoerdsma) asked the ministers about the human rights situation in Uganda, including police violence, detention of opposition MPs, election observation and the use of aid conditionality. The ministers answered at length, describing EU and bilateral diplomatic pressure, a withheld EUR 850,000 payment to the justice sector, and a planned evaluation of Dutch support, while giving no details on the detained MPs' case.
Because it is an ongoing case, the Ugandan government provides no explanation of it.
Omdat het een lopende zaak betreft wordt er door de Oegandese overheid geen toelichting op gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Inge van Dijk en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Chinese douanescanners Schiphol en Rotterdamse haven onder vuur: 'Dit is onbegrijpelijk''

CDA MPs asked ministers about reports that Chinese-owned Nuctech scanners are used by Dutch customs and whether Nuctech's ties to the Chinese state, low bids and security risks were properly assessed. The government answered that it weighs national security risks case by case, found no abnormally low bids, cannot guarantee that the Chinese state has no access to the scanners, and is conducting follow-up security research.
The cabinet cannot give any guarantees about this.
Het kabinet kan hier geen garanties over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de voorbereiding van de WHO om een «International treaty on pandemic prevention and preparedness», dat het verdrag van 2005 (de Internationale Gezondheidsregeling) uitbreidt (

An MP asked the ministers how Dutch representation and commitments in the WHO pandemic treaty process are organised, who decides on pandemic measures, whether national sovereignty and parliamentary control are preserved, and whether the WHO is independent. The government answered that the treaty content is not yet fixed, that the Staten-Generaal would have to approve ratification, that Dutch parliamentary control is ensured through that approval, and that the WHO is not independent of its member states; it declined to answer the provisional-application question yet and noted the negotiation timetable.
In the Netherlands this means the treaty must be submitted to the States General for approval before it can enter into force for the Netherlands.
In Nederland betekent dit dat het verdrag aan de Staten-Generaal ter goedkeuring moet worden voorgelegd, voordat het voor Nederland in werking kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Boucke over het bericht dat de roestende olietanker FSO Safer voor de kust van Jemen kan leiden tot één van de grootste olierampen in de geschiedenis

MPs Hammelburg and Boucke asked about the deteriorating FSO Safer oil tanker off Yemen, including the Dutch funding for an inspection mission, UN negotiations with the Houthis, available Dutch expertise, liability, and further contributions. The minister answered that the Netherlands is working with the UN and partners, that the earlier USD 1.686 million project was halted due to lack of Houthi cooperation with only 161,000 USD spent, and that further support depends on a new UN project plan.
At the end of 2020 the Netherlands made USD 1.686 million available for an earlier UN-led project aimed at an inspection and light maintenance mission.
Nederland heeft eind 2020 een bedrag van USD 1,686 miljoen beschikbaar gesteld ten behoeve van een eerder door de VN geleid project met als doel een inspectie- en lichte onderhoudsmissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline.
