The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het kabinetsbesluit UAWC niet langer te financieren en Israëls criminalisering van Palestijnse maatschappelijke organisaties

An MP from DENK asks the government about its decision to end funding for the Union of Agricultural Work Committees (UAWC) over alleged links to the PFLP and about the consequences for Palestinian civil society, including UN rapporteurs' objections. The ministers answer that the government found individual ties to the PFLP, sees no basis to classify UAWC as terrorist, has consulted the Palestinian side, and will coordinate with other donors and the EU without giving a timeline.
Based on the external investigation, the cabinet has no reason to classify UAWC as a terrorist organisation.
Het kabinet heeft op basis van het externe onderzoek geen reden om UAWC te kwalificeren als een terroristische organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het exporteren van hamsters naar Hongkong

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked whether the government would share its exchanges with Hong Kong authorities after hamsters exported from the Netherlands tested positive for the Delta variant, and whether it would halt live rodent exports. The minister said the correspondence was shared with parliament via the health minister, that existing EU and OIE rules were followed without a SARS-CoV-2 requirement, and that no direct reason for a ban exists while exports stay within those rules, with a national zoonosis action plan to follow.
As long as the trade in live rodents to other member states or export to third countries takes place within the framework of this regulation, I see no direct reason to ban the trade.
Zolang de handel van levende knaagdieren naar andere lidstaten of export naar derde landen binnen de kaders van deze regelgeving plaatsvindt, zie ik geen directe aanleiding de handel te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klink, Kamminga en Van Campen over de nadelige gevolgen van het sluiten van de grenzen in Groot-Brittannië met betrekking tot de invoer van aardappelpootgoed uit de EU

MPs asked whether Brexit trade barriers harming the Dutch seed potato sector, including SMEs, would be eased by a derogation or by Brexit Adjustment Reserve support. The minister acknowledged the sector's difficulties, rejected a special derogation for seed potatoes, said export options to the UK are being explored but are complex, and pointed to an internationalisation programme and individual support.
However, this is extremely complex and time-consuming.
Dit is echter uiterst complex en tijdrovend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over het bericht dat Janssen tijdelijk gestopt is met productie coronavaccins in Leiden

An MP asked the health and foreign trade ministers about reports that Johnson & Johnson temporarily paused COVID-19 vaccine production in Leiden, and about the effect on global vaccination and COVAX/African Union supply commitments. The minister answered that J&J pledged to honour its supply contracts, production has since resumed, and the government is investing in country readiness in developing countries.
Johnson & Johnson stated in a response to the press report that it will honour its contractual obligations to COVAX and the African Union.
Johnson & Johnson heeft in een reactie op het genoemde persbericht laten weten hun contractuele verplichtingen aan COVAX en de Afrikaanse Unie na te zullen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Minister samenwerkte met de bedrijfslobby tegen de aanpak van kinderarbeid en milieuschade

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether she collaborated with the business lobby (VNO-NCW) against supply-chain due diligence rules on child labour and environmental harm, and whether her own past amendments to an EU report reflected lobby arguments. The Minister denied a formal lobbying alliance, said she had submitted 92 amendments on feasibility and legal certainty, abstained on the report, and committed to pursue Dutch and EU IMVO legislation in line with the coalition agreement.
Whether VNO-NCW was an ally to me in that regard is not for me to judge.
Of VNO-NCW daarbij aan mij een bondgenoot had, is niet aan mij om te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de inzet van Nederland voor de VN-Biodiversiteitstop

An MP asked the government about Dutch preparations for the UN biodiversity summit (CBD COP-15), including timelines, binding targets, the 30% protection goal, financing gap, and stakeholder involvement. The minister answered at length, committing to stronger monitoring and reporting and ratcheting-up mechanisms, but largely described existing positions and processes without concrete new institutional changes.
Due to the privacy of the involved civil society organisations and companies, no statement can unfortunately be made about who participated in the online stakeholder consultations.
Vanwege de privacy van de betrokken maatschappelijke organisaties en bedrijven kan helaas geen uitspraak worden gedaan over wie deelnamen aan de online stakeholderconsultaties
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Simons en Jasper van Dijk over het besluit om financiering aan de Palestijnse organisatie UAWC stop te zetten

MPs Simons and Van Dijk asked why the government ended funding to the Palestinian organisation UAWC, whether the external Proximities report clears it of terrorism links, and why the government does not apply the same scrutiny to Israeli entities or the EU-Israel Association Agreement. The ministers answered that the decision rests on documented individual ties between UAWC staff and the PFLP, that the government will not revisit it, that no external study of Israeli firms is planned, and that suspension of the Association Agreement is not on the table.
The cabinet found that the individual ties, including within the UAWC board and the dual mandates with the PFLP, were widespread and covered the entire 2007–2021 research period.

Het kabinet heeft geconstateerd dat de individuele banden – zeker ook binnen het bestuur van UAWC en de daar geconstateerde dubbelmandaten met de PFLP – wijdverbreid waren en de gehele onderzoeksperiode 2007–2021 bestreken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hammelburg over humanitaire actie in Oekraïne

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about preparations for humanitarian crisis scenarios and emergency aid for Ukraine, including reserved funds and the response strategy. The minister answered that the Netherlands is coordinating closely with OCHA, ECHO and the Red Cross, committed 20 million euros immediately plus in-kind aid, and will keep parliament informed.
The House will be kept informed of all relevant developments and further humanitarian aid for the victims of the war in Ukraine.
De Kamer zal op de hoogte worden gehouden van alle relevante ontwikkelingen en verdere humanitaire hulp voor de slachtoffers van de oorlog in Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het nieuws dat supermarkten samen met FNV de misstanden in de Italiaanse tomatenteelt willen aanpakken

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about supermarkets and FNV working to stop exploitation in Italian tomato farming, including the government's view on the CBL research findings, whether it is responsible for pressing Italy, and whether Italian products could be banned. The minister welcomed the industry initiative, said systemic risks lie largely outside Dutch influence, that Italy must enforce its own labour law, and that a ban is impossible under EU free movement of goods.
Calling Italy to account by the Dutch government is not an appropriate response.
Het aanspreken van Italië door de Nederlandse overheid is geen passende reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg en Bikker over voortgang en problemen rondom vaccindonatie

MPs Hammelburg and Bikker asked the government about rejected COVID-19 vaccine donations, unused stock, the status of Dutch donations to COVAX, and financing. The minister answered that rejections stem from storage, shelf-life, supply and hesitancy problems, that COVAX reallocates refused doses, that about 14 million of 17.8 million donated doses had arrived, and that further calls for funding will be made in the coming months.

The implementation of the Hammelburg motion on mobilising business support for COVAX will be explained in the letter 'Global COVID-19 efforts', which will be sent to the House before the debate of 10 March 2022.

De uitvoering van de motie Hammelburg betreffende de inzet op het mobiliseren van steun van bedrijven voor COVAX zal worden toegelicht in de kamerbrief «Wereldwijde inzet COVID-19», die voor het debat op 10 maart 2022 naar de kamer wordt gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Jasper van Dijk over een verplichte VOG om misbruikschandalen te voorkomen

MPs Van der Plas and Van Dijk asked whether a sector-specific VOG (certificate of conduct) should be made mandatory for humanitarian aid workers to prevent sexual abuse scandals. The minister said screening is a shared responsibility of organisations, that no specific sector request was received, and that she is open to further talks with aid organisations and COVOG on evaluating screening instruments.

I am open to a follow-up conversation with aid organisations to evaluate experiences with the various available personnel screening instruments and to arrive at an effective instrument as quickly as possible.

Ik sta open voor een vervolggesprek met hulporganisaties om de ervaringen met de verschillende beschikbare instrumenten voor screening van personeel te evalueren en zo snel mogelijk tot een effectief instrument te komen.
